local opponent_manager = newclass('BBRacingOpponentManager')

local opponent_state_base = newclass('IBBRacingOpponentState')
local opponent_normal_state = newclass('BBRacingOpponentNormalState', opponent_state_base)
local opponent_move_state = newclass('BBRacingOpponentMoveState', opponent_state_base)

local manager_container = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/BombBugRacing/ManagerContainer')

--region opponent_state_base

--맨처음 시작 opponent_manager에서 self를 넣음
--npc_number로 npc를 체크
function opponent_state_base:init(controller, number)
	self.controller = controller
	self.opponent_number = number

	--필요한거
	--npc가 여러 명일 수 있음
end

function opponent_state_base:update_frame(dt)
end

function opponent_state_base:exit()

end

function opponent_state_base:dispose()

end

--endregion opponent_state_base

function opponent_normal_state:init(controller, number)
	self.super:init(controller, number)

end

function opponent_normal_state:start()

end

function opponent_normal_state:enter(prev_state)

end

function opponent_normal_state:exit()

end

function opponent_normal_state:dispose()

end

--region opponent_move_state

function opponent_move_state:init(controller, number)
	self.super:init(controller, number)

	--opponent
	self.target = nil

	--1부터 36까지 이동
	self.next_move_number = 1

	self.move_count = nil

	--이동 경로 및 등등 정리 필요
	self.pos_list = {}
	self.anim_data = nil

	self.move_time_passed = 0

	self.speed = 4

	self.marker_count = nil

	self.direction = nil

	self.start_pos = nil
	self.next_pos = nil

	-- 수치 보정용 최소값 (상수)
	self.min_speed_eps = 0.0001
	self.min_duration_eps = 0.0001
end

function opponent_move_state:enter()
	self.move_count = self.controller.constants_data[self.opponent_number].marker_count

	self.default_height = self.controller.common_constants_data.default_height

	do
		--이동 거리 만들기
		local target_npc_data = self.controller.constants_data[self.opponent_number]

		--manager 접근
		self.target = self.controller.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_player(self.opponent_number)

		--시작 위치
		self.start_pos = self.target.Position

		--다음 도착 위치
		self.next_pos = self.controller.get_marker_pos.game_move(self.opponent_number, self.next_move_number)

		self.target.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		-- 해당 npc 데이터
		self.speed = target_npc_data.speed
		local anim_data = target_npc_data.anim
		self.marker_count = target_npc_data.marker_count

		--애니메이션 세팅
		scene_util.set_anim(self.target, self.controller, anim_data)

		self.target.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

		--wp_util.move(target_npc, move_pos_list, speed, nil, { y_mode = 'flying' })

		-- 속도/시간 보정
		if self.speed == nil or self.speed <= 0 then
			self.speed = self.min_speed_eps
		end

		local distance = (self.next_pos - self.start_pos).magnitude
		self.duration = distance / self.speed
		if self.duration <= 0 then
			self.duration = self.min_duration_eps
		end

		-- 초기 진행 방향 설정
		self.direction = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(vector_util.to_direction(self.next_pos - self.start_pos))
	end
end

function opponent_move_state:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.controller then
		return
	end

	self.move_time_passed = self.move_time_passed + dt

	-- Unity API 로컬 캐싱
	local unity_mathf = unity_class.mathf
	local unity_vector3 = unity_class.vector3

	--이동 루틴
	local progress = unity_mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
			self.move_time_passed, 0, 1, self.duration))

	local pos = vector_util.get_x0z(unity_vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.next_pos, progress), self.default_height)
	self.target.Position = pos

	-- 구간 완료 체크
	if self.move_time_passed >= self.duration then
		if self.next_move_number >= self.marker_count then
			--게임 종료
			self.controller.controller.current_game_state = self.controller.controller.game_state.ending
			self.controller:change_state(self.opponent_number, opponent_normal_state(self, self.opponent_number))

			return
		end

		self.move_time_passed = 0
		self.next_move_number = self.next_move_number + 1

		--시작 및 도착 위치 갱신
		self.start_pos = self.next_pos
		self.next_pos = self.controller.get_marker_pos.game_move(self.opponent_number, self.next_move_number)

		local distance = (self.next_pos - self.start_pos).magnitude
		self.duration = distance / self.speed
		if self.duration <= 0 then
			self.duration = self.min_duration_eps
		end

		self.direction = direction_util.to_vector3_ver2(vector_util.to_direction(self.next_pos - self.start_pos))
		scene_util.set_direction(self.target, vector_util.to_direction(self.direction), false)
	end
end

function opponent_move_state:exit()

end

function opponent_move_state:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end

function opponent_move_state:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height, direction, marker_number)
	if direction == vector(0, 0, 1) then
		if marker_number % 2 == 1 then
			direction = vector(1, 0, 0)
		else
			direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)
		end
	elseif direction == vector(0, 0, -1) then
		if marker_number % 2 == 1 then
			direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)
		else
			direction = vector(1, 0, 0)
		end
	elseif direction == vector(1, 0, 0) then
		if marker_number % 2 == 1 then
			direction = vector(0, 0, 1)
		else
			direction = vector(0, 0, -1)
		end
	elseif direction == vector(-1, 0, 0) then
		if marker_number % 2 == 1 then
			direction = vector(0, 0, -1)
		else
			direction = vector(0, 0, 1)
		end
	end

	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + (direction * height) * 0.75,
		end_pos + (direction * height) * 0.75,
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end
--endregion opponent_move_state

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  상태편 매니저
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region opponent_manager

function opponent_manager:init()
	self.opponent = nil
	self.opponent_data = nil

	self.states = nil

	--region Character

	self.get_character = nil

	--endregion Character

	--region Marker

	self.get_marker_pos = {
		game_move = function(npc_number, number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_bombbug_racing_game_move_pos_' .. npc_number .. '_' .. number)
		end
	}

	--endregion Marker

	--region FX

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		oppose_spark = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_twosword_oppose_spark')
		end,
	})

	self.fx_list = nil

	--endregion FX

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
end

function opponent_manager:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end

----Container에서 개별 실행 필요
function opponent_manager:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	--states 테이블 초기화
	self.states = {}

	--table 형태
	self.constants_data = controller.opponent_constants_data
	self.common_constants_data = controller.common_constants_data
	
	self.get_character = self.controller.get_character
	
	--npc 자동 이동
	for idx = 1, #self.constants_data do
		-- npc
		local target_npc_data = self.constants_data[idx]

		local target_npc = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_player(target_npc_data.number)

		target_npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		-- 해당 npc 데이터
		local marker_count = target_npc_data.marker_count
		local move_pos_list = {}

		for pos_idx = 1, marker_count do
			table.insert(move_pos_list, vector_util.get_x0z(self.controller.get_marker_pos.game_move(idx, pos_idx), self.default_height))
		end

		local data = { number = idx, state = nil }

		table.insert(self.states, data)
	end

	metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()
end

--Container에서 개별 실행 필요
function opponent_manager:start_routine()
	for idx = 1, #self.states do
		self.states[idx].state = self:change_state(idx, opponent_move_state(self, idx))
	end
end

function opponent_manager:update_frame(dt)
	if self.controller.time_stop then
		return
	end

	for idx = 1, #self.states do
		local state = self.states[idx].state

		if state ~= nil and
				not (self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending) then

			state:update_frame(dt)

			--현재 게임이 끝났는지 체크
			if not self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.playing then
				self.states[idx].state = self:change_state(self.opponent_number, opponent_normal_state(self, idx))
			end
		end
	end
end

function opponent_manager:reset_setting()
	if self.state then
		self.state:exit()
		self.state:dispose()
	end

	self:dispose()
	self:clean()
end

function opponent_manager:clean()
	self.opponent = nil
	self.opponent_data = nil

	self.state = nil
end

function opponent_manager:change_state(number, next_state)
	if self.states[number].state then
		self.states[number].state:exit(next_state)
		self.states[number].state:dispose()
	end

	local prev_state = self.states[number].state
	self.states[number].state = next_state

	if next_state ~= nil then
		self.states[number].state:enter(prev_state)
	end

	return self.states[number].state
end

--endregion opponent_manager

return {
	create = function()
		return opponent_manager();
	end
}

--region ranking_manager

function ranking_manager:init()
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	self.common_constants_data = nil

	--region Character

	--endregion Character

	--region Marker

	self.get_marker_pos = {
		quest_marker = function(number)
			return field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_bombbug_racing_game_quest_marker_pos_' .. number)
		end,
	}

	--endregion Marker

	self.ranking_data_list = nil
	self.player_list = nil

	self.res_holder = nil

function ranking_manager:dispose()

----Container에서 개별 실행 필요
function ranking_manager:init_manager(controller)

	self.count_data = {
		min_count = 0,
		max_count = 7,
	}

	self.get_character = self.controller.get_character

	local noel_name = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel().Name

	--region ranking data setting
	self.name_list = {
		noel = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel().Name,
		player_1 = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_player(1).Name,
		player_2 = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_player(2).Name
	}

	self.ranking_data_list = {}

	self.ranking_data_list[self.name_list.noel] = {
		target = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel(), check_point = 0, dist = 0, is_leader = true }

	self.ranking_data_list[self.name_list.player_1] = {
		target = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_player(1), check_point = 0, dist = 0 }

	self.ranking_data_list[self.name_list.player_2] = {
		target = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_player(2), check_point = 0, dist = 0 }

	--endregion ranking data setting

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/short_story_noel/ui', 'noel_count_ui', function(prefab)
				self.ranking_ui = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.gameObject, prefab)
				self.ranking_ui_label = self.ranking_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Button/item/Label'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
				self.ranking_ui_ranking = self.ranking_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Button/item/Ranking'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))

				local name_label = self.ranking_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Button/item/Name'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
				name_label.text = game_string:GetString('ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_mini_game_noel_name')

				self.ranking_ui_portrait = self.ranking_ui.transform:Find('Contents/Button/item/portrait/Clip panel/Sprite'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite))

				self.ranking_ui_ranking.text = game_string:Format('ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_mini_game_noel_ranking', 1)

				self.ranking_ui_label.text = self.count_data.min_count .. '/' .. self.count_data.max_count
			end)

	--table 형태
	self.common_constants_data = controller.common_constants_data
end

--Container에서 개별 실행 필요
function ranking_manager:start_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function ranking_manager:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.controller or self.controller.time_stop then
		return
	end

	-- 시간 업데이트 (중복 조건 제거)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	--거리 체크
	self:set_ranking()
end

function ranking_manager:reset_setting()
	self:dispose()
	self:clean()
end

function ranking_manager:clean()
	self:dispose_ranking_ui()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

--region event

function ranking_manager:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.controller.current_game_state ~= self.controller.game_state.playing then
		return
	end

	local check_point_zone_name = 'sub_bomb_bug_racing_game_play_zone_'
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local game_play_state = self.controller.game_play_state

	local npc_list = {
		self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel(),
		self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_player(1),
		self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_player(2)
	}

	--게임 존 n개 루프
	for zone_idx = game_play_state.first, game_play_state.sixth do
		--npc n마리 체크
		for idx = 1, #npc_list do
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, npc_list[idx], check_point_zone_name .. zone_idx) then
				self:set_check_point_count(npc_list[idx].Name, zone_idx)

				return
			end
		end
	end

	return
end

--endregion event

--region custom
function ranking_manager:set_ranking()
	local ranking_list = {}

	-- 거리 업데이트
	for _, data in pairs(self.ranking_data_list) do
		--거리 체크
		data.dist = self:get_distance(data.target.Position, data.check_point)

		table.insert(ranking_list, data)
	end

	--첫번째로 체크포인트 체크
	table.sort(ranking_list, function(a, b)
		-- [첫 번째 조건] 체크포인트 개수 비교 (많은 사람이 위로)
		if a.check_point ~= b.check_point then
			return a.check_point > b.check_point
		end

		-- [두 번째 조건] 체크포인트가 같다면? -> 남은 거리 비교 (작은 사람이 위로)
		-- sqrMagnitude 값은 작을수록 목표에 가까운 것입니다.
		if a.dist ~= b.dist then
			return a.dist < b.dist
		end

		-- [세 번째 조건] 거리까지 완벽히 같다면?
		-- 그냥 넘어감 (Lua에서는 false를 반환하면 순서를 바꾸지 않음)
		return false
	end)

	-- 순위 파악
	for idx = 1, #ranking_list do
		if ranking_list[idx].is_leader then
			--리더일 경우  값을 세팅하고 탈출
			self:set_ranking_ui(idx)

			break
		end
	end
end

--체크 포인트와 타겟의 거리 반환
function ranking_manager:get_distance(target_pos, target_check_point)
	local target_data = data
	local check_point_pos = self.get_marker_pos.quest_marker(target_check_point + 1)

	return (vector_util.get_x0z(check_point_pos) - vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos)).sqrMagnitude
end

--체크포인트 세팅 (메인 파일(BumbBugRacing.lua))
function ranking_manager:set_check_point_count(target_name, check_point)
	local target_data = self.ranking_data_list[target_name]
	target_data.check_point = check_point

	if target_data.is_leader then
		self.ranking_ui_label.text = target_data.check_point .. '/' .. self.count_data.max_count
	end

	return
end

function ranking_manager:set_ranking_ui(ranking_number)
	self.ranking_ui_ranking.text = game_string:Format('ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_mini_game_noel_ranking', ranking_number)
end

function ranking_manager:dispose_ranking_ui()
	if not is_unity_null(self.ranking_ui) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ranking_ui)
		self.ranking_ui = nil
		self.ranking_ui_label = nil
		self.ranking_ui_ranking = nil
		self.ranking_ui_portrait = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.res_holder) then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function ranking_manager:set_portrait_sprite(sprite_name)
	if not self.ranking_ui_portrait then
		return
	end

	self.ranking_ui_portrait.spriteName = sprite_name
end

--endregion custom

--endregion ranking_manager

return {
	create = function()
		return ranking_manager();
	end
}

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/BombDelivery/BombDeliveryConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	self.shoot_order = self.constants_data.shoot_order

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	self:pre_setting()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.attack_range:dispose()

	self.constants_data = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.util = nil

	if self.boss_sfx ~= nil then
		self.boss_sfx:Stop()
		self.boss_sfx = nil
	end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_bomb(), 's17_bomb_target_zone') then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.clear
		return true
	end

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's17_bomb_outside_zone') then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.reset
		self.util:start_scene(self.outside_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play and
			self.current_player_state == self.player_state.normal and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, get_party_leader()) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_bomb()) then
		self.current_player_state = self.player_state.hold_up
		start_coroutine(self.player_hold_up_routine, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		start_coroutine(self.player_throw_routine, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:game_start()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.play

	--메인 퀘스트 하위 이벤트 노란 마커 지정
	local marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s17_bomb_target_pos')
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_point(self.goal_marker_name, self.main_quest_id, true, marker_pos)
	quest_marker_util.add_quest_marker_to_ifo(self.bomb_marker_name, self.main_quest_id, true, self.get_bomb())

	--시작시 대사
	start_coroutine(self.start_speech, self)

	start_coroutine(self.game_loop, self)
end

function local_class:game_loop()
	while self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.clear do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		--명령 업데이트
		if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play then
			self:order_update(dt)
		end

		--스나이퍼 업데이트
		self.sniper_manager:foreach(function(key, info)
			self:sniper_update(key, info, dt)
		end)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--게임 클리어 시 이벤트 호출
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.clear then
		self:game_end()

		--게임 클리어 퍼블리시
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
	end
end

function local_class:game_end()
	local bomb = self.get_bomb()
	local bomb_bhv = bomb.FieldObjectBehaviour
	cast(bomb_bhv, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectBehaviour))
	bomb_bhv.ResetOnWrongPosition = false

	self:player_throw_routine()

	--마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.goal_marker_name)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.bomb_marker_name)
end

function local_class:order_update(dt)
	local wait_duration = self.shoot_order[self.current_order].wait_duration

	self.order_timer = self.order_timer + dt

	--대기 시간 지났을 경우
	if self.order_timer > wait_duration then
		--명령 목록에 있는 npc들 스테이트 변경(명령 하달)
		for _, num in pairs(self.shoot_order[self.current_order].npc) do
			self.sniper_manager:set_state('sniper_' .. num, self.sniper_state.zoom)
		end

		--명령 후 타이머 초기화 및 다음 명령 변경
		self.order_timer = 0

		--마지막 오더 일 경우 처음으로
		if self.current_order == #self.shoot_order then
			self.current_order = 1
		else
			self.current_order = self.current_order + 1
		end

	end
end

-- 스나이퍼 발사 행동 루틴
function local_class:sniper_update(key, info, dt)
	local sniper = info.npc
	local state = info.state
	local attack_range = info.attack_range
	local timer = info.timer
	--타입별 방향 세팅

	if state == self.sniper_state.zoom then
		--어택 레인지로 저격 줌 연출
		attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, sniper.Position, vector(-1, 0, 0), 0)
		attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 0)

		state = self.sniper_state.zoom_after
		timer = 0
	elseif state == self.sniper_state.zoom_after then
		--줌 끝날 때 까지 대기
		timer = timer + dt

		if timer > info.zoom_duration then
			attack_range:Hide()
			state = self.sniper_state.shoot
		end
	elseif state == self.sniper_state.outside_zoom then
		--장외 저격 줌 연출
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position - sniper.Position).normalized

		attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, sniper.Position, shoot_dir, 0)
		attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 0)

		state = self.sniper_state.outside_zoom_after
		timer = 0
	elseif state == self.sniper_state.outside_zoom_after then
		--장외 줌 끝날 때 까지 대기
		timer = timer + dt

		if timer > info.outside_zoom_duration then
			attack_range:Hide()
			state = self.sniper_state.outside_shoot
		end
	elseif state == self.sniper_state.shoot then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minigun_shoot_01')
		--총알 발사
		local shoot_dir = vector(-1, 0, 0)
		info.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(sniper.Position, shoot_dir, 999, -1, nil, false, 0)
		state = self.sniper_state.shoot_end
	elseif state == self.sniper_state.outside_shoot then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_02')
		--장외 총알 발사
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position - sniper.Position).normalized
		info.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(sniper.Position, shoot_dir, 999, -1, nil, false, 0)
		state = self.sniper_state.shoot_end
	elseif state == self.sniper_state.shoot_end then
		--발사 후 재장전
		character_util.remove_anim(sniper)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_02', 0.5)
		scene_util.set_anim(sniper, self, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
		state = self.sniper_state.wait
	elseif state == self.sniper_state.reset then
		--게임 리셋
		scene_util.set_anim(sniper, self, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, keep_anim = true })
		attack_range:Hide()
		timer = 0
		state = self.sniper_state.wait
	elseif state == self.sniper_state.wait then
		--대기
	end

	info.state = state
	info.timer = timer

	self.sniper_manager:update_info(key, info)
end

-- 프로젝타일 명중 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, get_party_leader()) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_dark_01')
			self.fx:purple_shot():Instantiate(hit_info.position)
			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.reset
			self.util:start_scene(self.player_hit_routine, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.get_bomb()) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_dark_01')
			self.fx:purple_shot():Instantiate(hit_info.position)
			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.reset
			self.util:start_scene(self.bomb_hit_routine, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.get_signboard(1)) then
			--표지판 엄폐물 타격 fx
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_dark_01')
			self.fx:purple_shot():Instantiate(hit_info.position)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, self.get_signboard(2)) then
			--표지판 엄폐물 타격 fx
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_dark_01')
			self.fx:purple_shot():Instantiate(hit_info.position)
			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.reset then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, get_party_leader()) then
			self.fx:purple_shot():Instantiate(hit_info.position)
			--플레이어 장외 시 조준 사격
			self.current_player_state = self.player_state.out_hit
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--총알에 플레이어가 맞았을 경우
function local_class:player_hit_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.is_speech then
		self.operator_ui:set_active(false)
	end

	--폭탄을 들은 채로 맞았다면 오브젝트를 바로 앞에 내려놓으면서 연출
	self:player_throw_routine()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.reset

	local emerge_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_teatan_robot_emerge_01',
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		loop = false,
	})

	--가디언(damaged,dead) 모션재생과 함께 검은 틴트가 30%까지 상승
	local dead_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'dead')
	character_util.add_color(leader, leader.Name, unity_color({ 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1 }), 1, dead_duration)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	emerge_sfx:Stop()
	emerge_sfx = nil

	--서큘러 페이드 아웃 서큘러 페이드 인 후 재시작 위치에서 시작
	self:reset_routine()
end

--총알에 폭탄이 맞았을 경우
function local_class:bomb_hit_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local bomb = self.get_bomb()
	local bomb_offset = vector(0.5, 0, 1)

	if self.is_speech then
		self.operator_ui:set_active(false)
	end

	--폭탄을 들고있는 와중일 경우
	self:player_throw_routine()

	self.boss_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01', loop = false })

	--obj_bomb에 FX_explosion_boss 재생되기 시작
	self.explosion_fx = self.fx:explosion():Instantiate(bomb.Position + bomb_offset)

	--가디언이 obj_bomb를 바라보며 (scared,embarrassed)
	character_util.look_at(leader, bomb)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'embarrassed')

	--화면이 obj_bomb로 이동 화면 shake 0.15
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 1)
	camera_util.move(bomb.Position + bomb_offset, 0.5)

	--1초 후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--서큘러 페이드 아웃 서큘러 페이드 인 후 재시작 위치에서 시작
	self:reset_routine()
end

--플레이어 도망 갈 경우
function local_class:outside_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if self.is_speech then
		self.operator_ui:set_active(false)
	end

	--폭탄을 들은 채로 맞았다면 오브젝트를 바로 앞에 내려놓으면서 연출
	self:player_throw_routine()

	--이때 가디언(right,surprise,idle)(jump1회)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'surprise')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')

	--[좌측 shout]: 놈이 도망친다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(leader, {
		key = 'cw_main_s17_minigame_1',
		skip = false,
		bubble_type = 'shout',
		viewport_pos = vector(0.2, 0.5),
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		scale = 1,
		type_speed = 0,
		keep_display = true,
	})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')

	--1~8 라인에 일제히 프로젝타일이 발사된다.
	for num = 1, self.sniper_count do
		self.sniper_manager:set_state('sniper_' .. num, self.sniper_state.outside_zoom)
	end

	--플레이어 총에 맞을 때 까지 대기
	local timer = 0
	while self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.clear and
			self.current_player_state ~= self.player_state.out_hit do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		--혹시 총알에 안 맞을 경우
		if timer > self.bullet_life_time then
			self.current_player_state = self.player_state.out_hit
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_dark_01')

	local emerge_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_teatan_robot_emerge_01',
		type_priority = 'event',
		player_priority = 'npc',
		loop = false,
	})

	--가디언이 피격 후 (damaged,dead) 모션재생과 함께 검은 틴트가 30%까지 상승
	local dead_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(leader, 'dead')
	character_util.add_color(leader, leader.Name, unity_color({ 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1 }), 1, dead_duration)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(leader, self, { name = 'dead', loop = false, keep_anim = true })

	emerge_sfx:Stop()
	emerge_sfx = nil

	--서큘러 페이드 아웃 서큘러 페이드 인 후 재시작 위치에서 시작
	self:reset_routine()
end

function local_class:reset_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	--서큘러 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if self.boss_sfx ~= nil then
		self.boss_sfx:FadeOut(1)
		self.boss_sfx = nil
	end
	--reset
	do
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		--player
		self.current_player_state = self.player_state.normal
		local leader_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s17_bomb_restart_pos')
		character_util.remove_color(leader, leader.Name, 0)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_position(leader, leader_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)

		--order
		self.order_timer = 0
		self.current_order = 1

		--sniper
		for num = 1, self.sniper_count do
			self.sniper_manager:set_state('sniper_' .. num, self.sniper_state.reset)
		end

		--bomb
		local bomb = self.get_bomb()
		local bomb_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s17_bomb_spawn_pos')
		bomb.Position = bomb_pos

		if self.explosion_fx ~= nil then
			self.explosion_fx:Dispose()
			self.explosion_fx = nil
		end

		--sginboard
		local sginboard_count = 2
		for i = 1, sginboard_count do
			local fo = self.get_signboard(i)
			fo.Position = self.get_signboard_pos(i)
		end
	end

	--다시 서큘러 페이드 인후 재 시작 위치에서 시작
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--재시작시 대사
	start_coroutine(self.start_speech, self)

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.play
end

--게임 시작 및 재시작 시 크로셀 대화
function local_class:start_speech()
	--	크로셀 : 다시 한번 폭탄을 사용해야겠군요.
	self.is_speech = true
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_operator', 'cw_main_s17_minigame_2', { can_skip = false })
	self.is_speech = false
end

local local_class = newclass('BombDodge')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'BombDodge'

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	-- 추후 다른 입장 케이스가 필요한 경우 처리용
	self.constants_data_key = ''

	-- Constants Data
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_brazier = function(num) return get_field_object('bomb_dodge_brazier_' .. num) end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_start_position_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('bomb_dodge_start_position') end

	-- 이벤트 존을 가져오는 함수
	--self.get_bomb_area_zone = function() return field:GetZone('bomb_dodge_bomb_area') end

	-- 미니게임이 진행 중인가
	self.is_playing_game = false

	-- 미니게임을 실패 했는가
	self.is_fail = false
	self.is_clear = false

	-- 타이머 시간
	self.timer_time = 0
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/BombDodge/BombDodgeConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	self.timer_time = self.constants_data.timer_time

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	-- 플레이어 위치 설정
	local start_position = self.get_start_position_marker()
	user_party.Leader.Position = start_position.position
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, start_position.direction)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	self:game_end()
	self:end_timer()
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self.is_playing_game = true
	self.is_fail = false

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

function local_class:game_end()
	self.is_playing_game = false

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
end

--region event
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, user_party.Leader) then
		self.is_fail = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm_event(e)
	if e.IsComplete then
		self.is_clear = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:game_routine()
	-- start
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)

	-- 플레이어가 들기/던지기를 못하게
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
		stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	self:start_timer()

	-- BGM 재생
	if self.constants_data.bgm_name then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.constants_data.bgm_name, state = 'event' })
	end

	yield_return_func(self.game_loop, self)

	-- end
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	-- 실패하지 않고 성공했을 경우 Sfx 재생
	if self.is_clear then
		if self.constants_data.success_sfx_name ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.constants_data.success_sfx_name)
		end
	end

	self:end_timer()
	self:game_end()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.is_fail then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, false))
	elseif self.is_clear then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
	end

	character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, false)

	user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
		stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
end

function local_class:game_loop()
	local pattern_list = self.constants_data.pattern

	for i = 1, #pattern_list do
		if self.is_fail or self.is_clear then
			break
		end

		local pattern = pattern_list[i]
		local enabled_list = lua_helper.get_or_default(pattern.enabled, {})
		local disabled_list = lua_helper.get_or_default(pattern.disabled, {})
		local wait_num = lua_helper.get_or_default(pattern.wait, 3)

		-- 화로 비활성화
		--region disabled
		for j = 1, #disabled_list do
			local disabled_num = disabled_list[j]
			local brazier = self.get_brazier(disabled_num)

			command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, brazier)
		end
		--endregion

		-- 화로 활성화
		--region enabled
		for j = 1, #enabled_list do
			local enabled_num = enabled_list[j]
			local brazier = self.get_brazier(enabled_num)

			command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier, false)
		end
		--endregion

		-- 다음 패턴까지 대기
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < wait_num and not self.is_fail and not self.is_clear do
			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
		--wait_for_sec(wait_num)
	end

	local brazier_num = self.constants_data.brazier_num
	for i = 1, brazier_num do
		local brazier = self.get_brazier(i)

		command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, brazier)
	end

	--self:all_bomb_reset()
end

--[[
function local_class:all_bomb_reset()
	local zone = self.get_bomb_area_zone()
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, zone.Bounds)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		if string.find(string.lower(fo.Name), '[gimmick]') then
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = nil
			heal_info.target = fo
			heal_info.heal = fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

			command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end
]]

--region timer
function local_class:start_timer()
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.EventTimer)

	local game_timer = CS.Oak.InGameTimer.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, self.timer_time, nil)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAddEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, game_timer))
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm_event')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, true))
end

function local_class:end_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRemoveEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStopEvent.Instance)
end
--endregion

function local_class:get_timer_time()
	return self.timer_time
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('BoundBall')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)

	-- game name
	self.game_name = 'BoundBall'
	self.constants_data_key = ''

	-- Constants Data
	self.constants_data = nil

	--비치볼 item
	self.ball_item_number = 20685
	self.ball = nil

	--바나나 item
	self.banana_item_number = 20696
	self.bananas = {}

	--비치볼 attack range
	self.attack_range = nil

	--flag range
	self.flag_ranges = {}

	--marker
	self.get_ball_load_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('bound_ball_moderator_pos').position
	end

	--marker
	self.get_ball_start_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('bound_ball_game_start_pos').position
	end

	--ball update
	self.free_fall = nil
	self.ball_progress = 0
	self.ball_velocity = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.rotate_axis = 0
	self.rotate_power = 0

	--이벤트 변수
	self.is_game_playing = true
	self.is_clear = false
	self.flag_count = 0
	self.flag_check = { true, true, true }
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/BoundBall/BoundBallConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource('FieldUINumCounter')

	yield_return_func(self.game_load, self)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.free_fall:Dispose()
	self.is_game_playing = false

	--비치볼 item 제거
	if self.ball ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.ball)
		self.ball = nil
	end

	--바나나 제거
	for i = 1, #self.bananas do
		if self.bananas[i] ~= nil then
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.bananas[i])
			self.bananas[i] = nil
		end
	end

	--attack range 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	--flag range 제거
	for i = 1, #self.flag_ranges do
		if not is_unity_null(self.flag_ranges[i]) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.flag_ranges[i])
		end
		self.flag_ranges[i] = nil
	end
end

--게임 종료 시 초기화
function local_class:game_init()
	self.is_clear = false
	self.ball_progress = 0
	self.rotate_axis = 0
	self.rotate_power = 0
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.ball_velocity = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.ball.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.ball.Position, 0)
	self.flag_check = { true, true, true }
	self.flag_count = 0
	for i = 1, #self.flag_ranges do
		self.flag_ranges[i]:Hide()
	end
end

function local_class:game_load()
	self.free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(15, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * 3, 0, 0)

	--비치볼
	self.ball = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.ball_item_number,
		pos = self.get_ball_load_pos() + vector(0, 1, 0),
		notforinven = true,
		showoncharacter = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})
	self.ball.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(self.ball.ShadowTransform.localPosition, 0.03)

	--바나나 트랩
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.trap_pos_table do
		local pos = vector(self.constants_data.trap_pos_table[i].x, 0,
				self.constants_data.trap_pos_table[i].z)

		local banana = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.banana_item_number,
			pos = pos,
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
		})
		table.insert(self.bananas, banana)
	end

	--attack range
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(999, 0, 999), 0.20)
	self.attack_range.CacheTransform.localScale = vector(2, 1, 1)

	self.attack_range:Show()

	--flag range 3개
	local range_light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76)
	local range_dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local pos = vector(self.constants_data.flag_pos_table[i].x, 0.1,
				self.constants_data.flag_pos_table[i].z)
		local size = unity_class.vector2(1.5, 1.5)
		local flag_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(pos, size, range_light_color, range_dark_color)

		flag_range:Show()
		table.insert(self.flag_ranges, flag_range)
	end
end

function local_class:game_start()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_summer/audio:bgm_summer_game', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	--최초 1회 공 던지는 운동량 지정
	local throw_vector = self.get_ball_start_pos() - self.get_ball_load_pos()
	self.ball_velocity = throw_vector
	self.ball_progress = unity_class.time.deltaTime

	self.rotate_power = self.ball_velocity.magnitude
	self.rotate_axis = -1

	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.ball.Position + self.ball_velocity, 0)
	attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, 0)

	for i = 1, #self.flag_ranges do
		self.flag_ranges[i]:Show(0)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
	self.is_game_playing = true
	character_util.hide_weapon(user_party.Leader, true)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.trap_loop, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.flag_loop, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ball_rotate, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_loop, self))
end

function local_class:game_loop()
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.is_game_playing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		self:ball_update(dt)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--액티비티 실패
	if not self.is_clear then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.is_clear))
	end

	self:game_init()
end

function local_class:ball_update(dt)
	local ball_y = self.free_fall:GetDistance(self.ball_progress)
	local pinnacle = self.free_fall:GetPinnacleDistance()
	local xz_move = self.ball_velocity * dt

	self.ball.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.ball.Position + xz_move, ball_y)
	self.ball.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * unity_class.mathf.Max((pinnacle - ball_y) / pinnacle, 0.2)
	self.ball:SetSortingLayer(user_party.Leader.Position.z >= self.ball.Position.z)

	--바닥 도착 시 조건 처리
	if ball_y <= 0 then
		self.ball_progress = 0
		self.ball_velocity = self:get_distance()

		local player_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position, 0)
		local ball_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.ball.Position, 0)

		if not self:rect_check(player_pos, ball_pos, 1) or self.is_clear then
			-- 바운스 실패
			self.is_game_playing = false
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		else
			if not self.is_clear then
				character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader, true)
				character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'unique/bounce', next_anim = 'idle', upper = true })
			end

			--바운스
			--music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_head_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bounce_head_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

			self.ball_velocity = self:squish_distance(self.ball_velocity) *
					unity_class.mathf.Clamp(self.ball_velocity.magnitude, 0, 0.6) * 3

			--공 회전값 조절
			self.rotate_power = self.ball_velocity.magnitude

			if self.ball_velocity.x > 0 then
				self.rotate_axis = -1
			else
				self.rotate_axis = 1
			end

			--도착 지점 이미지 재설정
			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.ball.Position + self.ball_velocity, 0)
			attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, 0)
		end
	end

	self.ball_progress = self.ball_progress + dt
end

function local_class:ball_rotate()
	local cur_rotation = 0

	--회전 증폭값
	local volume = 10

	while self.is_game_playing do
		cur_rotation = cur_rotation + self.rotate_axis * self. rotate_power * volume

		self.ball.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)
		self.ball.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right) *
				unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(cur_rotation, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:player_hold()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader, true)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slide_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if self.is_game_playing then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end
end

function local_class:trap_loop()
	local trap_count = #self.bananas
	while self.is_game_playing do
		for i = 1, trap_count do
			if self.bananas[i] ~= nil then
				local player_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position, 0)
				local trap_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.bananas[i].Position, 0)

				local diff = player_pos - trap_pos

				if diff.magnitude < 0.4 then
					drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.bananas[i])
					self.bananas[i] = nil

					--1초간 스턴
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_hold, self))
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:flag_loop()
	local clear_count = #self.constants_data.flag_pos_table

	while self.is_game_playing do
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if self.flag_check[i] then
				local ball_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.ball.Position, 0)
				local flag_pos = vector(self.constants_data.flag_pos_table[i].x, 0,
						self.constants_data.flag_pos_table[i].z)

				if self:rect_check(flag_pos, ball_pos, 0) then
					self.flag_check[i] = false
					self.flag_count = self.flag_count + 1
					self.flag_ranges[i]:Hide()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_02')

					if self.flag_count == clear_count then
						party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')
						CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
						character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader, true)
						self.is_clear = true
						message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.is_clear))
					end
				end
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:rect_check(src, dest, case)
	local l = src.x - 0.75
	local r = src.x + 0.75
	local t = src.z + 0.75
	local b = src.z - 0.75

	if case == 1 then
		l = src.x - 0.75
		r = src.x + 0.75
		t = src.z + 0.9
		b = src.z - 0.6
	end

	if l < dest.x and r > dest.x and t > dest.z and b < dest.z then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_distance()
	local player_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position, 0)
	local ball_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.ball.Position, 0)

	local diff = ball_pos - player_pos
	local norm = vector(diff.x, 0, diff.z * 2).normalized
	local dist = vector(diff.x, 0, diff.z * 2).magnitude

	return norm * dist
end

function local_class:squish_distance(v)
	return vector(v.x, 0, v.z * 0.5)
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader, { key = 'ds_cactus_pickle_minigame_3',

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()

function local_class:get_coctus_pickle(pos)
	for i = 1, #self.cactus_pickle do
		if self.cactus_pickle[i].use == false then
			self.cactus_pickle[i].use = true
			self.cactus_pickle[i].item:SetPosition(pos)
			return self.cactus_pickle[i]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- 혈액팩 가져오기
function local_class:get_blood_pack(pos)
	for i = 1, #self.blood_pack do
		if self.blood_pack[i].use == false then
			self.blood_pack[i].use = true
			self.blood_pack[i].item:SetPosition(pos)
			return self.blood_pack[i]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

	item.use = false
	item.item:SetPosition(vector(999, 0, 999))

end

	local cur_ref = nil

	for _, target in pairs(self.carpenter_character_list) do
		if (is_vampire and target.is_vampire) or (not is_vampire and not target.is_vampire) then
			if not target.active then
				target.active = true
				cur_npc = target.character
				cur_ref = target

				break
			end
		end
	end

	-- 만약 해당 npc가 부족하면 반대편 npc 찾음
	if cur_npc == nil then
		if is_vampire then
			is_vampire = false
		else
			is_vampire = true
		end

		for _, target in pairs(self.carpenter_character_list) do
			if (is_vampire and target.is_vampire) or (not is_vampire and not target.is_vampire) then
				if not target.active then
					target.active = true
					cur_npc = target.character
					cur_ref = target

					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 대기 줄 NPC 리스트에 삽입
	self.wait_npc_list[index] = {
		character = cur_npc,
		is_vampire = is_vampire,
		ref = cur_ref
	}

	self.total_wait_npc = self.total_wait_npc + 1
end

-- 미니게임 시작 전에 인부 줄지어서 내려오는 연출
function local_class:walk_down_npc_at_first()
	local speed = 2

	for i = 1, #self.wait_npc_list do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wait_npc_list[i].character, 1, 1)

		self:walk_down_npc(
				self.wait_npc_list[i].character, -8 + self.constants_data.character_dist * i, speed)

		wait_for_sec(self.constants_data.character_dist / speed)
	end
end

-- 인부 순차적으로 걸어 내려오는 연출
function local_class:walk_down_npc(character, dist_z, speed)
	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list:Add(character.Position + vector(0, 0, dist_z))

	character_util.move_waypoint(character, waypoint_list,
			speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')
end

-- UI 셋업
function local_class:set_up_ui_button()

	local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight)

end

-- 미니게임 로직
function local_class:minigame_loop()
	-- 버튼 연속 누르기 방지
	local timer = 0
	local disadvantage_timer = 0
	local ignore_touch_delay = self.constants_data.ignore_touch_delay
	local disadvantage_time = 1

	-- 버튼 눌러진 상태 체크
	local left_pressed = self.left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
	local right_pressed = self.right_button_touch_handler.Pressed

	local left_button_pos = self.left_button.transform.localPosition
	local right_button_pos = self.right_button.transform.localPosition

	while self.game_loop do
		-- 전체 성공 횟수 >= 목표 성공 횟수면 미니게임 종료
		if self.correct_num >= self.constants_data.correct_max then
			self.game_loop = false

			timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

			break
		end

		-- 터치 상태면 일정 시간 대기 후 다시 터치 가능한 상태로 변경
		if self.is_ignore_touch_event then
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if timer >= ignore_touch_delay then
				timer = 0
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = false
			end
		end

		-- 잘못된 선택지를 골라 터치 불가 불이익을 받는 상태
		if self.fail_disadvantage_time then
			disadvantage_timer = disadvantage_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if disadvantage_timer >= disadvantage_time then
				disadvantage_timer = 0
				self.fail_disadvantage_time = false
			end
		end

		-- 터치 체크 (버튼에서 손 땔 때 애니메이션 처리도 해야 되서 ignore_touch_event 상태여도 실행함)
		-- 버튼 누르거나 떼는 Animation 처리 (down : 누른 상태, up : 뗀 상태)
		local left_down = false
		local left_up = false
		local right_down = false
		local right_up = false

		-- 버튼이 눌러졌는지 체크 코드
		local current_left_pressed = self.left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
				or self.gamepad_left_button_pressed == true

		local current_right_pressed = self.right_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D)
				or self.gamepad_right_button_pressed == true

		self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
		self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

		self.left_button_touch_handler:Update()
		self.right_button_touch_handler:Update()

		-- 눌렀는지 떼었는지 확인
		if current_left_pressed ~= left_pressed then
			if current_left_pressed then
				left_down = true
			else
				left_up = true
			end

			left_pressed = current_left_pressed
		elseif current_right_pressed ~= right_pressed then
			if current_right_pressed then
				right_down = true
			else
				right_up = true
			end

			right_pressed = current_right_pressed
		end

		-- 왼쪽 버튼 눌렀을 때 애니메이션 처리
		if left_down then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')

			self.left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)

			self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1}),
					unity_color({1, 0.7921, 0.3647, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))

			-- 버튼 터치 가능한 상태면 입력 처리
			if not self.is_ignore_touch_event and not self.fail_disadvantage_time then
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = true

				self:touch_left_button()
			end
		-- 왼쪽 버튼 떼었을 때 애니메이션 처리
		elseif left_up then
			self.left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos

			self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
					unity_color({0.7255, 0.1059, 0.1059, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))
		end

		-- 오른쪽 버튼 눌렀을 때 애니메이션 처리
		if right_down then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')

			self.right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)

			self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1}),
					unity_color({1, 0.7921, 0.3647, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))

			-- 버튼 터치 가능한 상태면 입력 처리
			if not self.is_ignore_touch_event and not self.fail_disadvantage_time then
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = true

				self:touch_right_button()
			end
		-- 오른쪽 버튼 떼었을 때 애니메이션 처리
		elseif right_up then
			self.right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos

			self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
					unity_color({0.1059, 0.7255, 0.1059, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 터치 이벤트 로직
function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if not self.is_ignore_touch_event then
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftTriggerDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftShoulderDown then
			self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
			self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = true
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 버튼 애니메이션
function local_class:set_button_tint(button, ic_color, circle_color, border_color)
	local ic_sprite = button.transform:Find('ic'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local circle_sprite = button.transform:Find('circle'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local border_sprite = button.transform:Find('border'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	ic_sprite.TintColor = ic_color
	circle_sprite.TintColor = circle_color
	border_sprite.TintColor = border_color

	ic_sprite:Rebuild()
	circle_sprite:Rebuild()
	border_sprite:Rebuild()
end

-- 우측 버튼 입력 처리 (인부가 우측으로 이동하고 올바른 선택이면 완료 숫자 증가)
function local_class:touch_right_button()
	if #self.wait_npc_list < 1 then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 대기 중인 인부 정보
	local cur_carpenter = self.wait_npc_list[1]
	local correct = false

	-- 대기 중인 인부이 마족 인부면 성공
	if cur_carpenter.is_vampire then
		correct = true
		-- 대기 리스트에서 현재 인부 제거하고 새 인부 추가함
		self:wait_list_update()
	end

	-- 성공 시
	if correct then
		self:success_ui(cur_carpenter.character)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_saloon_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(cur_carpenter.character, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(cur_carpenter.character, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.carpenter_move, self, cur_carpenter, false))
	-- 실패 시
	else
		self:fail_ui(cur_carpenter.character)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.choose_wrong_snack, self, cur_carpenter))
	end

	-- 플레이어 행동 처리
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(
			get_party_leader(), vector(0.3, 0, 0.5), 0.12, 0.06)
	character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'spear_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	-- 성공, 실패 UI 표시
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_feedback_ui, self, correct))
end

-- 좌측 버튼 입력 처리 (인부가 좌측으로 이동하고 올바른 선택이면 완료 숫자 증가)
function local_class:touch_left_button()
	if #self.wait_npc_list < 1 then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 대기 중인 인부 정보
	local cur_carpenter = self.wait_npc_list[1]
	local correct = false

	-- 대기 중인 인부가 마족 인부면 성공
	if not cur_carpenter.is_vampire then
		correct = true
		-- 대기 리스트에서 현재 인부 제거하고 새 인부 추가함
		self:wait_list_update()
	end

	-- 성공 시
	if correct then
		self:success_ui(cur_carpenter.character)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_tree_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(cur_carpenter.character, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(cur_carpenter.character, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.carpenter_move, self, cur_carpenter, true))
	-- 실패 시
	else
		self:fail_ui(cur_carpenter.character)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.choose_wrong_snack, self, cur_carpenter))
	end

	-- 플레이어 행동 처리
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(
			get_party_leader(), vector(-0.3, 0, 0.5), 0.12, 0.06)
	character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'spear_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	-- 성공, 실패 UI 표시
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_feedback_ui, self, correct))
end

-- 성공 연출 UI 처리
function local_class:success_ui(effect_character)
	-- 콤보 증가
	self.combo_count = self.combo_count + 1
	self.combo_text_object:SetActive(true)
	self.combo_text.text = string.format('%d', self.combo_count)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.minigame_correct_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			effect_character.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	-- 숫자 카운터 UI 증가
	self.correct_num = self.correct_num + 1
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(self.correct_num)
end

-- 실패 연출 UI 처리
function local_class:fail_ui(effect_character)
	-- 콤보 초기화
	self.combo_count = 0
	self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.minigame_fail_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			effect_character.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
end

-- 대기줄 갱신 (첫 번째 원소를 제거하고 나머지 1개씩 앞으로 당긴 다음 마지막 원소 추가함)
function local_class:wait_list_update()
	-- 첫 원소 제거 + 나머지 원소 1개씩 당김
	for i = 2, #self.wait_npc_list do
		self.wait_npc_list[i - 1] = self.wait_npc_list[i]
	end

	-- 아직 인부가 다 나오지 않았다면 마지막 원소 추가
	if self.total_wait_npc < self.constants_data.correct_max then
		self:add_wait_list(#self.wait_npc_list)

		local new_npc = self.wait_npc_list[#self.wait_npc_list]
		character_util.set_position(new_npc.character,
				self.wait_npc_list[#self.wait_npc_list - 1].character.Position +
						vector(0, 0, self.constants_data.character_dist))
		character_util.set_direction(new_npc.character, 'down')
	end

	-- 대기 위치 1칸씩 이동
	for i = 1, #self.wait_npc_list do
		local cur_npc = self.wait_npc_list[i].character

		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list:Add(cur_npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -(self.constants_data.character_dist)))

		character_util.move_waypoint(cur_npc, waypoint_list,
				4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')
	end
end

-- 인부 이동 루틴
function local_class:carpenter_move(cur_carpenter, left)
	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	local item
	local item_pos
	if left then
		waypoint_list:Add(cur_carpenter.character.Position + vector(-8, 0, 0))
		item = self:get_coctus_pickle(cur_carpenter.character.Position)
		item_pos = vector(-0.1, 0, 0.8)
	else
		waypoint_list:Add(cur_carpenter.character.Position + vector(8, 0, 0))
		item = self:get_blood_pack(cur_carpenter.character.Position)
		item_pos = vector(0.1, 0, 0.8)
	end

	local move = true
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(cur_carpenter.character, waypoint_list,
					self.constants_data.npc_speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', false)
			move = false
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			while move do
				item.item:SetPosition(cur_carpenter.character.Position + item_pos)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end)
	})

	self:remove_item(item)
	character_util.set_position(cur_carpenter.character, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_emotion(cur_carpenter.character)
	character_util.remove_anim(cur_carpenter.character, true)

	cur_carpenter.ref.active = false
end

-- 인부 이동 루틴
function local_class:choose_wrong_snack(cur_carpenter)
	self.fail_disadvantage_time = true
	local release_time = 0.934

	character_util.set_anim(cur_carpenter.character, { name = 'release', remove_after = release_time, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(cur_carpenter.character, { name = 'attack' })

	wait_for_sec(release_time)
	character_util.remove_emotion(cur_carpenter.character)
end

-- OX UI 표시
function local_class:show_feedback_ui(success)
	self.ui_ox:SetActive(true)
	self.ui_ox.transform.localScale = vector(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.ui_ox.transform, 'UI')

	local ox_ani = self.ui_ox:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
	ox_ani.timeScale = 2

	if success then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_01')

		ox_ani.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, 'good', false)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')

		ox_ani.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, 'bad', false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self.ui_ox:SetActive(false)
end

-- 제한 시간 다 되서 실패하는 연출
function local_class:timer_finished()
	self.game_loop = false

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 동적 할당 NPC 초기화
	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end

	if self.cactus_pickle ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.cactus_pickle do
			self.cactus_pickle[i].item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end
	self.cactus_pickle = nil

	if self.blood_pack ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.blood_pack do
			self.blood_pack[i].item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end
	self.blood_pack = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ClayShootingMiniGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'ClayShootingMiniGame'

	-- 게임의 데이터 키

	-- shot 버튼
	self.shot_button = nil

	-- 패턴 list
	self.pattern_list = nil

	-- 표적 list
	self.target_list = nil

	-- 게임 중앙위치
	self.game_center_pos = nil

	-- 실패 횟수

	-- 실패 ui

	self.count_ui = nil
