	self.sniper_bullet = nil

	-- 락온 icon
	self.shot_icon = nil

	-- 표적 state
	self.target_state = {
		ready = 0,
		appear = 1,
		dont_move = 2,
		move = 3,
		hide = 4,
		dead = 5,
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	local constants_data = require('minigame/ClayShootingMiniGame/ClayShootingMiniGameConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	--region 게임 타겟 세팅
	self.pattern_list = self.constants_data.pattern
	table.sort(self.pattern_list, function(a, b)
		return a.appear_time < b.appear_time
	end)

	self.target_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.constants_data.target_npc_count do
		local npc = get_character(self.constants_data.target_npc_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.target_list, { npc, self.target_state.ready })
	end

	local panda = get_character(self.constants_data.special_npc_name)
	table.insert(self.target_list, { panda, self.target_state.ready })
	--endregion

	--region object pool 세팅
	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'FieldUIFailCounter',
			'custom_sprite',
			'Manual_AssaultRifle_Sniper_Bullet_SmokeTrail',
			'shot_cross_hair',
			'FX_hit',
			'FX_lasthit')
	--endregion

	-- 총알 로드
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)
	self.sniper_bullet = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	local bullet_sprite = self.sniper_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'sniper_shot_middle.png'
	bullet_sprite:Rebuild()

	res_holder:Dispose()

	--게임 위치로 이동
	self.game_center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_start_marker_name).position

	camera_util.resize_to(self.constants_data.mini_game_camera_size, 0.01)

	local camera_pos = self.game_center_pos + vector(self.constants_data.camera_offset[1],
			self.constants_data.camera_offset[2], self.constants_data.camera_offset[3])
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.01)

	self.game_center_pos = self.game_center_pos + vector(0,0.25,0)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	--region 기존 조작 제거
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	--endregion

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.game_loop and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction1TouchDown then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shot_bullet, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_timer_alarm_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) and e.IsComplete then
		-- 시간이 지나면 게임 클리어
		self.game_loop = false
		self.game_clear = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 게임 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	--region 조작 버튼 세팅
	-- 스크롤 버튼 생성
	local shoot_ui_transform = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(field_ui_manager.Transform, 'shoot_pad(Clone)')
	local shoot_ui = shoot_ui_transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShotButton))

	shoot_ui:SetPosition(vector(230, 120), CS.Oak.Direction.DownLeft)

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)

	self.shot_button = field_ui_manager:GetUI(user_party)[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad]
	local button = self.shot_button.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShotButton))

	button:ChangeIcon('ic_shooting_target.png', unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8)
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		button:SetIconSpeed(self.constants_data.pad_speed)
	else
		button:SetIconSpeed(self.constants_data.touch_speed)
	end

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)
	local special_func_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(user_party)[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1]
	local special_func_button_component = special_func_ui.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUISpecialFunctionButton))
	special_func_button_component:SetButtonCoolTime(self.constants_data.shot_delay)
	special_func_button_component:SetButtonSound('02_gun_shoot_01', '02_gun_reload_01')

	self.shot_icon = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("shot_cross_hair"):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.shot_icon.transform, "FieldUI")
	--endregion

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_routine, self))
end

-- 게임 진행 루틴
function local_class:play_routine()
	self.game_loop = true
	self.game_clear = false

	-- 타이머 실행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.constants_data.mini_game_time, handler = self, callback = 'on_timer_alarm_event' })

	-- 실패 UI 세팅
	self:attach_count_ui()
	self.fail_count = 0

	local game_time = 0
	local pattern_index = 1

	-- 타겟 아이콘 루틴
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shot_icon_routine, self))

	while self.game_loop do
		game_time = game_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 게임 진행 시간에 맞춰 타겟 등장
		if #self.pattern_list >= pattern_index and self.pattern_list[pattern_index].appear_time <= game_time then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.target_routine, self, pattern_index))

			pattern_index = pattern_index + 1
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	if self.game_clear then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')
	end
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 1, #self.target_list do
		character_util.set_position(self.target_list[i][1], vector(999,0,999))
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	local special_func_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(user_party)[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1]
	local special_func_button_component = special_func_ui.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUISpecialFunctionButton))
	special_func_button_component:SetButtonSound(nil, nil)

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.game_clear))
end

-- 표적 루틴
function local_class:target_routine(pattern_index)
	local is_special_target = self.pattern_list[pattern_index].special_target
	local character_index = self.pattern_list[pattern_index].target
	local move_index = self.pattern_list[pattern_index].move

	local anim_key = self.constants_data.character[character_index].anim
	local direction_key = self.constants_data.character[character_index].direction

	local create_time = self.constants_data.move[move_index].create_time
	local life_time = self.constants_data.move[move_index].life_time

	local start_x = self.constants_data.move[move_index].start_x * self.constants_data.mini_game_x_size
	local end_x = self.constants_data.move[move_index].end_x * self.constants_data.mini_game_x_size

	local anim_loop = (start_x ~= end_x) and true or false

	-- 표적 세팅
	local npc = nil
	local npc_index = 1

	for i = 1, #self.target_list do
		if not is_special_target then
			if self.target_list[i][2] == self.target_state.ready
					and self.target_list[i][1] ~= get_character(self.constants_data.special_npc_name) then
				self.target_list[i][2] = self.target_state.appear
				npc = self.target_list[i][1]
				npc_index = i
				break
			end
		else
			if self.target_list[i][2] == self.target_state.ready
					and self.target_list[i][1] == get_character(self.constants_data.special_npc_name) then
				self.target_list[i][2] = self.target_state.appear
				npc = self.target_list[i][1]
				npc_index = i
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if npc == nil then
		return
	end

	local is_dead = false

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = npc.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.sender = nil
	heal_info.target = npc
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

	coroutine.yield()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, npc)
	character_util.set_direction(npc, direction_key)

	if anim_loop then
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = anim_key, loop = anim_loop })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = anim_key, loop = anim_loop, scale = 10 })
	end

	-- 표적 등장
	local start_pos = self.game_center_pos + vector(start_x, 0, 0)
	local end_pos = self.game_center_pos + vector(end_x, 0, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')
	character_util.set_position(npc, start_pos + vector(0, -1.5,0))
	character_util.move_to_async(npc, start_pos, create_time)

	if anim_loop then
		self.target_list[npc_index][2] = self.target_state.move
	else
		self.target_list[npc_index][2] = self.target_state.dont_move
	end

	if is_special_target then
		-- 나…나는 쏘지말라고… 사격장 청소중이야!
		-- 잠…잠깐! 난 표적이 아니야!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc,
				{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_' .. random_util.get_random_int(25, 26)
				, bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'cb', scale = 2 })
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while self.game_loop and time_passed <= life_time and not is_dead do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / life_time)
		npc.Position = cur_pos

		if self.target_list[npc_index][2] == self.target_state.dead then
			is_dead = true
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 게임 진행중일 때만 연출 처리
	if self.game_loop then
		-- 해당 표적이 죽지 않았다면
		if not is_dead then
			self.target_list[npc_index][2] = self.target_state.hide
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')
			character_util.move_to_async(npc, end_pos + vector(0,-1.5,0), create_time)
			if not is_special_target then
				self:update_count_ui()
			end
		else
			-- 죽었을 경우
			if is_special_target then
				self:update_count_ui()
				-- 으악!
				-- 악! 거긴 민감한 곳이라고!
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc,
						{ key = 'nightmare_futurecastle_2_clay_shooting_' .. random_util.get_random_int(27, 28)
						, bubble_type = 'shout', scale = 2, screen_pos = vector(50, -100) })
			end

			if anim_loop or is_special_target then
				character_util.set_side_direction(npc)
				character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'prostrate' })
				character_util.spine_rotate(npc, 360 * 3, 0.5)
				character_util.jump(npc, 1.5, 0.5)
				character_util.move_to_async(npc, vector(npc.Position.x, 0, npc.Position.z + 2), 0.5)

				character_util.shake(npc, 0.05, 0.5)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
				character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0.5 })
				character_util.move_to_async(npc, vector(npc.Position.x, 0, npc.Position.z - 1), 1)
				character_util.move_to_async(npc, vector(npc.Position.x, -2, npc.Position.z - 1), 1)
			else
				character_util.air_spin(npc)
				wait_for_sec(1)
			end
		end
	end

	if self.game_loop then
		-- 준비 상태로 변경
		character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999,0,999))
		self.target_list[npc_index][2] = self.target_state.ready
	end
end

-- 락온 icon 루틴 함수(조작, 타겟팅 처리)
function local_class:shot_icon_routine()
	local button = self.shot_button.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIShotButton))

	while self.game_loop do
		-- 발사 위치 저장
		self.shot_pos = self.game_center_pos + vector(button.Ratio.x * self.constants_data.mini_game_x_size, 0.5 , 0)

		-- 그려질 위치
		local icon_pos = stage_camera.Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(self.shot_pos)
		icon_pos = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera:ViewportToWorldPoint(icon_pos)
		icon_pos.z = 0

		self.shot_icon.transform.position = icon_pos

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:shot_bullet()
	local start_pos = self.game_center_pos + vector(0,0,-10)
	local shoot_dir = (self.shot_pos - start_pos).normalized
	local move_time = self.constants_data.bullet_life_time
	local bullet_distance = self.constants_data.bullet_distance
	local end_pos = start_pos + shoot_dir * bullet_distance

	local bullet_sprite = self.sniper_bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
			* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local cur_pos = start_pos
	local radius = 0.5

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= move_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local next_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / move_time)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = cur_pos

		-- 맞춰야 하는 타겟 검사
		for i = 1, #self.target_list do
			if (self.target_list[i][2] == self.target_state.move or
					self.target_list[i][2] == self.target_state.dont_move) then

				local npc = self.target_list[i][1]

				-- 직선과 원 검사
				local cx = npc.Position.x
				local cz = npc.Position.z

				local dx = next_pos.x - cur_pos.x
				local dz = next_pos.z - cur_pos.z

				local a = dx * dx + dz * dz
				local b = 2 * (dx * (cur_pos.x - cx) + dz * (cur_pos.z - cz))
				local c =  (cur_pos.x - cx) * (cur_pos.x - cx) + (cur_pos.z - cz) * (cur_pos.z - cz) - radius * radius
				local det = b * b - 4 * a * c

				local t = (-b + math.sqrt(det)) / (2 * a)

				if t <= 1 and t >= 0 then
					self.target_list[i][2] = self.target_state.dead
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_hit_wall_01')
					character_util.spine_pulse_color(npc, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_hit"):Instantiate(bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition)
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_lasthit"):Instantiate(bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition)
					bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
					return
				end
			end
		end

		cur_pos = next_pos
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

--region 실패 카운트 UI 함수
-- ui 생성
function local_class:attach_count_ui()
	local ui = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.count_ui_object = ui;

	self.count_ui = ui.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))

	self.count_ui:SetFailCount(0)
	self.count_ui:Reposition()
end

-- ui 갱신
function local_class:update_count_ui()
	if self.count_ui == nil then
		return
	end
	-- 실패 카운트, ui 갱신
	self.fail_count = math.min(self.fail_count + 1, self.constants_data.life)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	self.count_ui:SetFailCount(self.fail_count)

	-- 모든 목숨 소진 시 게임 종료
	if self.fail_count >= self.constants_data.life then
		self.game_loop = false
	end
end

-- ui 삭제
function local_class:detach_count_ui()
	if self.count_ui_object ~= nil then
		self.count_ui_object:Dispose()
	end
	self.count_ui_object = nil
	self.count_ui = nil
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomSidePad)

	self.shot_button = nil

	timer_util.end_timer(self)
	self:detach_count_ui()

	self.pattern_list = nil
	self.target_list = nil

	if self.sniper_bullet ~= nil then
		self.sniper_bullet:Dispose()
		self.sniper_bullet = nil
	end

	if self.shot_icon ~= nil then
		self.shot_icon:Dispose()
		self.shot_icon = nil
	end

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('CleaningGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'CleaningGame'

	-- 게임의 데이터 키
	self.constants_data_key = ''
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 게임이 진행도 체크용
	self.mini_game_routine = {
		load = 1,
		playing = 2,
		game_end = 3,
	}

	self.cur_game_routine = self.mini_game_routine.load

	-- 게임 클리어 여부
	self.game_clear = false

	-- 조작 처리
	self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	-- 쓰레기 아이텀 관리 list
	self.leader_trash = nil
	self.npc_trash = nil

	-- vs 처리
	self.vs_npc = nil
	self.move_count = 1

	-- weapon 처리
	self.save_weapon_1 = user_party.Leader.Weapon1
	self.save_weapon_2 = user_party.Leader.Weapon2
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	local constants_data = require('minigame/CleaningGame/CleaningGameConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')

	-- 공용 값 세팅
	self.move_duration = self.constants_data.move_duration

	-- 리더 세팅
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(leader, field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.init_pos_marker).position)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'unique/cleaning_idle' }, { name = 'idle' })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.constants_data.camera_size, 0.2)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.2)

	self.leader_trash = {}
	if self.constants_data.game_zone_name then
		self:make_map(self.constants_data.game_zone_name, leader)
	end

	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'twohand_mop_normal')
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')

	-- vs 모드 세팅
	if self.constants_data.vs_mode then
		self.vs_npc = get_character(self.constants_data.vs_info.npc_name)
		character_util.set_position(self.vs_npc, field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.vs_info.init_pos_marker).position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.vs_npc, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.vs_npc, { name = 'unique/cleaning_idle' }, { name = 'idle' })

		self.npc_trash = {}
		self:make_map(self.constants_data.vs_info.game_zone_name, self.vs_npc)

		self.vs_npc.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'twohand_mop_normal')
	end

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	self:ui_show()
	self.cur_game_routine = self.mini_game_routine.playing
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if self.cur_game_routine == self.mini_game_routine.playing and self.input_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None
			and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		self.input_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			self:move_action(self.input_direction)

			-- 게임 종료 체크
			self:game_end_check()

			self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
			if self.mini_game_routine.game_end == self.cur_game_routine then
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.game_clear))
			end
		end))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- 게임 UI 처리
function local_class:ui_show()
	-- UI를 DPad로 초기화
	-- ResetControllers를 호출하지 않도록 처리하여 파티원이 따라오는 상황 방지
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
end

--- 패턴 처리
function local_class:move_action(direction)
	-- 리더 처리
	local move_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(direction)
	print('move vector : ', move_vector.x, move_vector.z)
	local next_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + move_vector
	print('leader pos : ', user_party.Leader.Position.x, user_party.Leader.Position.z)

	if self:is_floor(next_pos.x, next_pos.z) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_game_move_01')
		-- npc 대전 모드일 경우
		if self.constants_data.vs_mode then
			wait_all({
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.npc_action, self)),
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'unique/cleaning_walk' })
					-- 해당 위치 쓰레기 지우기
					self:check_trash(user_party.Leader, next_pos)
					character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, next_pos, self.move_duration, nil, true)
					print('move to next pos : ', next_pos.x, next_pos.z)
					print('move to leader pos : ', user_party.Leader.Position.x, user_party.Leader.Position.z)
					character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'unique/cleaning_idle' })
				end))
			})
		else
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'unique/cleaning_walk' })
			-- 해당 위치 쓰레기 지우기
			self:check_trash(user_party.Leader, next_pos)
			character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, next_pos, self.move_duration, nil, true)
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'unique/cleaning_idle' })
		end

		wait_for_sec(self.move_duration / 2)
	else
		print('not floor : ', next_pos.x, next_pos.z)
	end
end

--- 대전 npc 패턴 처리
function local_class:npc_action()
	local move_pattern = self.constants_data.vs_info.move_pattern
	local dir = move_pattern[math.min(self.move_count, #move_pattern)]
	local move_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)
	local next_pos = self.vs_npc.Position + move_vector

	if self:is_floor(next_pos.x, next_pos.z) then
		character_util.set_anim(self.vs_npc, { name = 'unique/cleaning_walk' })
		-- 해당 위치 쓰레기 지우기
		self:check_trash(self.vs_npc, next_pos)
		character_util.move_to_async(self.vs_npc, next_pos, self.move_duration, nil, true)
		character_util.set_anim(self.vs_npc, { name = 'unique/cleaning_idle' })
	end

	self.move_count = self.move_count + 1
end

--- 게임이 종료되는지 체크
function local_class:game_end_check()
	if #self.leader_trash == 0 then
		self.game_clear = true
		self.cur_game_routine = self.mini_game_routine.game_end
	elseif #self.npc_trash <= #self.leader_trash - 2 then
		self:lose_action()
		self.game_clear = false
		self.cur_game_routine = self.mini_game_routine.game_end
	elseif self.constants_data.vs_mode and #self.npc_trash == 1 and #self.leader_trash > 0 then
		self:draw_action()
		self.game_clear = false
		self.cur_game_routine = self.mini_game_routine.game_end
	end
end

--- 해당 위치가 바닥인지 체크
function local_class:is_floor(x, z)
	return field:IsThereFloorAt(unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z))
end

--- 처리용 맵 함수
function local_class:make_map(zone_name, target)
	local zone = field:GetZone(zone_name)
	local x_size = zone.Bounds.size.x
	local z_size = zone.Bounds.size.z
	local offset = 0.5 -- 맵 가운데 체크용
	local x_start = vector_util.get_x0z(zone.Bounds.center).x - x_size / 2 + offset
	local z_start = vector_util.get_x0z(zone.Bounds.center).z - z_size / 2 + offset
	local x_end = vector_util.get_x0z(zone.Bounds.center).x + x_size / 2 - offset
	local z_end = vector_util.get_x0z(zone.Bounds.center).z + z_size / 2 - offset

	for x = x_start, x_end do
		for z = z_start, z_end do
			if field:IsThereFloorAt(unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z)) then
				self:make_trash(target, x, z)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 아이템 생성 함수
function local_class:make_trash(target, x, z)
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(vector(x, 0, z) - target.Position)) then
		return
	end

	local index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.constants_data.trash_object_list)
	local item_id = self.constants_data.trash_object_list[index]
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = item_id, pos = vector(x, 0, z),
											  notforinven = true, sprscale = 1,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

	local angle = 90 * random_util.get_random_int(0, 3)
	item.SpriteTransform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, angle, 0)
	item.ShadowTransform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, angle, 0)

	if self:is_leader(target) then
		table.insert(self.leader_trash, item)
	else
		table.insert(self.npc_trash, item)
	end
end

--- 리더 체크용
function local_class:is_leader(target)
	return lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_party_leader())
end

--- 쓰레기 체크
function local_class:check_trash(target, target_pos)
	if self:is_leader(target) then
		for i, trash in ipairs(self.leader_trash) do
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(trash.Position - target_pos)) then
				table.remove(self.leader_trash, i)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.remove_trash, self, trash))
				return
			end
		end
	else
		for i, trash in ipairs(self.npc_trash) do
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(trash.Position - target_pos)) then
				table.remove(self.npc_trash, i)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.remove_trash, self, trash))
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 쓰레기 알파처리 후 제거 루틴
function local_class:remove_trash(trash)
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = self.move_duration
	local custom_alpha = 1
	local shadow_alpha = 1
	local custom_sprite = trash.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_sprite = trash.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local alpha_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(1 - (time_passed / duration))

		custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ custom_alpha * alpha_progress
		, custom_alpha * alpha_progress, custom_alpha * alpha_progress, custom_alpha * alpha_progress })
		shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_alpha * alpha_progress
		custom_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	trash:ConsumeComplete()
	trash = nil
end

-- 졌을 때 연출
function local_class:lose_action()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	local camera_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.vs_info.npc_win_camera_marker).position
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(self.vs_npc, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.vs_npc, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.set_emotion(self.vs_npc, { name = 'burning' })
	local trash_count = #self.npc_trash + 1
	self.move_duration = 0.1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lana_01')
	for i = 1, trash_count do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_game_move_01')
		self:npc_action()
	end

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(self.vs_npc.Position, 0.5)
end

-- 비겼을 때 연출
function local_class:draw_action()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	--플레이어 right, surprise 상태.
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader)

	--라나 중심으로 카메라 빠르게 패닝하며 줌 인.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(self.vs_npc.Position, 0.5)

	local move_pattern = self.constants_data.vs_info.move_pattern
	local dir = move_pattern[math.min(self.move_count, #move_pattern)]
	local move_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)
	local next_pos = self.vs_npc.Position + move_vector

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_game_move_01')
	--라나 left, attack, 유니크 애니메이션을 실행하며 1타일 앞으로 도착.
	if self:is_floor(next_pos.x, next_pos.z) then
		character_util.set_emotion(self.vs_npc, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(self.vs_npc, { name = 'unique/cleaning_walk' })
		-- 해당 위치 쓰레기 지우기
		self:check_trash(self.vs_npc, next_pos)
		character_util.move_to_async(self.vs_npc, next_pos, self.move_duration, nil, true)
		character_util.set_anim(self.vs_npc, { name = 'unique/cleaning_idle' })
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cur_game_routine = self.mini_game_routine.game_end

	if self.vs_npc ~= nil then
		self.vs_npc:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, nil)
		self.vs_npc:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, nil)
		self.vs_npc = nil
	end

	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, self.save_weapon_1)
	user_party.Leader:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, self.save_weapon_2)
	user_party.Leader:RefreshWeaponAttachments()

	self.move_count = 1
	self.move_duration = nil
	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))

	-- 습득 못한 아이템 제거
	if self.leader_trash ~= nil then
		for _, trash in ipairs(self.leader_trash) do
			trash:ConsumeComplete()
			trash = nil
		end
		self.leader_trash = nil
	end

	if self.npc_trash ~= nil then
		for _, trash in ipairs(self.npc_trash) do
			trash:ConsumeComplete()
			trash = nil
		end
		self.npc_trash = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ClimbingGame')

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require(
			'minigame/ClimbingGame/ClimbingGameConstants')
	self.data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	-- 점프, 낙하 계산기 생성
	self.jump_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(13.5, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * 3, 0, 0)
	self.free_fall_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * 3, 0, 0)
	self.death_jump_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(5, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * 3, 0, 0)

	-- 플레이어 시작 위치 마커
	self.player_pos_marker = field:GetMarker(self.data.player_start_stand_name)

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 원경 셋팅
	self.mini_game_scene = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/theatres/arcade_climbing', 'guild_arcade_climbing_game_back')
	self.mini_game_scene.transform.position = vector(7.5, -0.1, 14)
	self.mini_game_scene.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)

	-- 빙벽 셋팅
	self.mini_game_scene2 = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/theatres/arcade_climbing', 'guild_arcade_climbing_game_back2')
	self.mini_game_scene2.transform.position = vector(7.5, 0, 14)
	self.mini_game_scene2.transform.localScale = vector(2, 2, 2)

	-- 조이스틱 표시
	gamepad_util.preload_joypad_label()

	-- 오브젝트 풀 로드
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
	while not CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.IsLoaded(pool) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- UI를 위한 스프라이트 생성
	local pooled_object = {}
	for i = 1, self.data.sprite_id.max do
		pooled_object[i] = pool:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one * 999)
	end

	-- Atlas 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/ui', 'GuildArcadeBuffUI', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
			end)

	if self.custom_atlas ~= nil then
		self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end

	self.custom_sprite = {}
	for i = 1, self.data.sprite_id.max do
		self.custom_sprite[i] = pooled_object[i]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if not is_unity_null(self.custom_sprite[i]) then
			self.custom_sprite[i].Atlas = self.custom_atlas
			self.custom_sprite[i].SortingLayer = 'UI'
		end
	end

	-- 점수 이펙트
	for i = self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_begin, self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_end do
		self:init_sprites_data(i, 'arcade_num_1000_00.png', 0, 2)
	end

	self:game_pre_init()

	user_party.Leader.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_player)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:init_sprites_data(sprite_id, file_name, background_order, scale)
	self.sprites_data[sprite_id] = {
		sprite = self.custom_sprite[sprite_id],
		sprite_name = file_name,
		local_scale = unity_class.vector2.one * scale,
		init_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
	}

	local data = self.sprites_data[sprite_id]
	data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	data.sprite.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))
	data.sprite.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
	data.sprite.SpriteName = data.sprite_name
	data.sprite.LocalScale = data.local_scale
	data.sprite:SetSortingOrder(background_order)
	data.sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:show_sprites_data(data, is_show)
	if is_show then
		data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = data.init_pos
	else
		data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	end
end

function local_class:init_npc_data_list()
	self.npc_data_list = {}
	local npc_list = stage.CharacterManager:GetAllNpcs()
	for i = 0, npc_list.Count - 1 do
		local npc = npc_list[i]
		if npc ~= user_party.Leader then
			npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			npc.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
			npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			-- 보너스 아이템
			if string.match(npc.Name, self.data.bonus_npc_name) then
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.bonus)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
			-- 보스
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.boss_npc_name) then
				self.boss_npc_data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.boss)
				self.boss_npc_data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
			-- 발판
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.foothold_npc_name) then
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.foothold)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.02
			-- 적
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.enemy_npc_name) then
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.enemy)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
			-- 고드름
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.icicle_npc_name) then
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.icicle)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:add_npc_data(fo, type)
	local npc_data = {
		fo = fo,		-- 필드 오브젝트
		type = type,	-- 타입
	}

	table.insert(self.npc_data_list, npc_data)
	return npc_data
end

-- 비활성화 된 NPC 찾기
function local_class:get_disable_npc(data_list)
	for _, data in ipairs(data_list) do
		if data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			return data
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 보스 행동
function local_class:boss_action()
	local fo = self.boss_npc_data.fo
	local boss_speed = 8 + math.max(self.pattern.level - 4, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'idle' })
	while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing do
		-- z 좌표 추적
		local target_pos = vector(fo.Position.x, fo.Position.y, user_party.Leader.Position.z)
		character_util.move_to_async(fo, target_pos, nil, boss_speed)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		-- x 좌표 추적
		target_pos = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, fo.Position.y, fo.Position.z)
		if target_pos.x >= fo.Position.x then
			character_util.set_direction(fo, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(fo, 'left')
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.boss_move_sfx_name)
		character_util.move_to_async(fo, target_pos, nil, boss_speed)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
end

-- 대미지를 입었을 때 보스 처리
function local_class:boss_damaged()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.hit_sfx_name)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.boss_scream_sfx_name)

	-- 동전 뿌리기
	if self.boss_hp <= 1 then
		self:throw_bonus_item()
		self:add_score(self.data.boss_defeat_score)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.boss_fall_sfx_name)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.data.main_bgm_name, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
		if self.wing_sfx ~= nil then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.wing_sfx)
			self.wing_sfx = nil
		end
		character_util.move_to(self.boss_npc_data.fo, self.boss_npc_data.fo.Position - vector(0, 0, 12), nil, self.data.boss_fall_speed)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.boss_hp = self.boss_hp - 1
	self.is_boss_damaged = false
	if self.boss_hp <= 0 then
		self:next_pattern()
		character_util.stop(self.boss_npc_data.fo)
		self.boss_npc_data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	else
		self.boss_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_action, self))
	end
end

-- 동전 뿌리기
function local_class:throw_bonus_item()
	-- 화면 최하단 구하기
	local center_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
	local size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size() / 2
	local bottom_z = center_pos.z - size.y
	local boss_pos = self.boss_npc_data.fo.Position
	local spawn_z = math.max(boss_pos.z + 0.5, bottom_z)

	local item_per_line = 5
	for i = 1, 10 do
		local x = self:get_foothold_x((i % item_per_line) + 1) + 1.5
		local z = self.foothold_next_z - 2
		if i > item_per_line then
			z = z - 3
		end
		local item_data = self:spawn_item(boss_pos.x, spawn_z, true)
		item_data.active = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jump_bonus_item, self, item_data, x, z))
	end
end

function local_class:jump_bonus_item(item_data, x, z)
	character_util.jump_move(item_data.fo, vector(x, 0, z), 12, 3)
	item_data.active = true
end

--region Event
-- 점프 버튼
function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then
		return true
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		self.jump_button_touched = true
	end

	return false
end

-- 치트키 받기
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'acg_cheat:kill_boss' then
		if self.boss_npc_data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
			self.boss_hp = 1
			self:hit_boss()
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'acg_cheat:level' then
		local level = math.max(tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1)), 1)
		self.pattern.level = level
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'acg_cheat:immortal' then
		local param = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		if param == 0 then
			self.cheat_immortal = false
		else
			self.cheat_immortal = true
		end
	end
end

-- 게임 패드
function local_class:on_gamepad_connected(_)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return true end

	self:show_gamepad_label()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_disconnected(_)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return true end

	self:hide_gamepad_label()

	return false
end

--endregion

--region Game Logic
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start_routine()
	self:game_init()
	self:game_ui_show()

	-- 이미 게임패드가 활성화되있는 상태라면 게임패드 라벨을 보여준다.
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self:show_gamepad_label()
	end

	self.game_loop = true
	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.data.main_bgm_name, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	self:game_routine()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:HideAndBackup()

	self.game_loop = false

	self:game_over()
end

function local_class:game_pre_init()
	self:change_manual_character(self.data.player_npc_name)

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'on_gamepad_connected')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'on_gamepad_disconnected')

	-- NPC 초기화
	self:init_npc_data_list()

	-- 발판 세팅
	self.foothold_data_list = {}
	for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.foothold then
			local data = {
				fo = npc_data.fo,
				type = self.data.foothold_type.normal,
				coroutine = nil,
				link_data = nil,
				step_on = false,
				footable = false
			}
			table.insert(self.foothold_data_list, data)
		end
	end

	-- 고드름 세팅
	self.icicle_data_list = {}
	for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.icicle then
			local data = {
				fo = npc_data.fo,
				state = self.data.icicle_state.normal
			}
			table.insert(self.icicle_data_list, data)
		end
	end

	-- 독수리 세팅
	self.enemy_data_list = {}
	for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.enemy then
			local data = {
				fo = npc_data.fo,
				dir = 0,
			}
			table.insert(self.enemy_data_list, data)
		end
	end

	-- 아이템 세팅
	self.item_data_list = {}
	for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.bonus then
			local data = {
				fo = npc_data.fo,
				active = true
			}
			table.insert(self.item_data_list, data)
		end
	end

	self:reset_leader()

	-- 파티 숨기기
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		member.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 카메라 초기화
	local center_x = 8.5
	self.center_pos = unity_class.vector3(center_x, 0, 7)
	camera_util.move_async(self.center_pos, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(5.5, 0)

	-- 아이템 초기 배치
	self:spawn_item(center_x, self.data.bonus_item_start_z, true)

	-- 기본 발판 세팅
	for i = 1, 5 do
		self:make_safe_pattern()
		self.foothold_next_z = self.foothold_next_z + 3
	end

	self:set_score(0)
end

function local_class:game_init()
	self.pattern.idx = 0
	self.pattern.level = 1
	self:generate_pattern_box()
	self:next_pattern()
end

function local_class:reset_leader()
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -0.25)
	self.highest_z = math.floor(user_party.Leader.Position.z)
	user_party.Leader.Direction = self.player_pos_marker.direction
	self.player_next_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })
end

function local_class:game_ui_show()
	-- 인터랙트, 공격, 들기, 스킬 전부 막아놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(user_party.Leader)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	user_party.Leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- 보물상자, 환경설정, 대화창, 미니맵 제거
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end

	-- DPad, 공격버튼 표시
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Run
end

-- 메인 게임 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'walk' })

	while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and self.game_loop == true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		dt = math.min(dt, 0.05)	-- 프레임 드랍에 의한 오작동 방지
		self:game_update(dt)
		self:player_action()
		self:check_collision()
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 유저의 행동 처리
function local_class:player_action()
	-- 점프 키 입력
	local jump_button_touched = false
	if self.jump_button_touched then
		jump_button_touched = true
		self.jump_button_touched = false
	end

	-- 점프 중일 때는 무시
	if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.jump then
		return
	end

	-- 낙하 중일 때 무시, 단 0.1초 유예를 줌(조작감 개선)
	if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.free_fall and self.jump_progress > 0.1 then
		return
	end

	-- 점프 실행
	if jump_button_touched == true then
		self:jump_start()
	end
end

function local_class:jump_start()
	self.jump_start_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
	self.jump_prev_z = 0
	self.jump_progress = 0
	self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.jump
	self.is_camera_move_start = true
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.jump_sfx_name)
end

function local_class:check_fall_end()
	local foothold_data = self:get_foothold_data(user_party.Leader.Position)
	if foothold_data ~= nil then
		self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.none
		-- 발판 바운더리로 z 좌표 보정
		user_party.Leader.Position = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, foothold_data.fo.Bounds.max.z + self.data.foothold_z_bound_offset)

		self:step_foothold(foothold_data)
	end
end

function local_class:jump_update(dt)
	-- 점프 z 값 적용
	self.jump_progress = self.jump_progress + dt
	local z = self.jump_calculator:GetDistance(self.jump_progress)
	user_party.Leader.Position = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, self.jump_start_z + z)

	-- 낙하 중 플레이어 발 아래에 발판이 있으면 점프 종료
	if self.jump_prev_z > z then
		self:check_fall_end()
	end
	self.jump_prev_z = z

	-- 점수 갱신
	local player_z = math.floor(user_party.Leader.Position.z)
	if self.highest_z < player_z then
		local score = (player_z - self.highest_z) * self.data.climb_score
		if score > 0 and self:get_current_pattern() ~= self.data.pattern.boss then
			self:add_score(score)
		end
		self.highest_z = player_z
	end
end

function local_class:free_fall_update(dt)
	-- 낙하 z 값 적용
	self.jump_progress = self.jump_progress + dt
	local z = self.free_fall_calculator:GetDistance(self.jump_progress)
	user_party.Leader.Position = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, self.jump_start_z + z)

	-- 낙하 종료 체크
	self:check_fall_end()
end

-- 발판 데이터 찾기
function local_class:get_foothold_data(pos)
	for _, data in ipairs(self.foothold_data_list) do
		local foothold = data.fo
		local old_bound = foothold.Bounds
		local center = unity_class.vector3(old_bound.center.x, old_bound.center.y, old_bound.center.z + self.data.foothold_z_bound_offset)
		local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, unity_class.vector3(2, old_bound.extents.y, 1))

		if foothold.ActiveState == active_state('enabled')
		and data.footable == true
		and CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(bounds, pos) then
			return data
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 1프레임당 움직임
function local_class:move_by_one_frame(fo, pos_from, pos_to, speed, dt)
	local dir = (pos_to - pos_from).normalized
	fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
			fo,
			dir,
			speed * dt)
end

-- 방향을 벡터로 변환
function local_class:direction_to_vector(direction)
	local v = vector(0, 0, 0)
	if(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) then
		v = vector(1, 0, 0)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) then
		v = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
		v = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
		v = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	return v
end

-- 발판 밟았을 때 처리
function local_class:step_foothold(foothold_data)
	if foothold_data.step_on == false then
		if foothold_data.type == self.data.foothold_type.breakable then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.break_foothold, self, foothold_data, 10))
		elseif foothold_data.type == self.data.foothold_type.breakable_fast then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.break_foothold, self, foothold_data, 2))
		elseif foothold_data.type == self.data.foothold_type.invisible then
			character_util.set_anim(foothold_data.fo, { name = 'normal' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.show_foothold_sfx_name)
		end
		foothold_data.step_on = true
	end
end

function local_class:game_update(dt)
	if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.free_fall then
		self:free_fall_update(dt)
	elseif self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.jump then
		self:jump_update(dt)
	else
		local foothold_data = self:get_foothold_data(user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), true)
		-- 발 아래 발판이 있음
		if foothold_data ~= nil then
			self:step_foothold(foothold_data)
		else	-- 낙하
			self.jump_start_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
			self.jump_prev_z = 0
			self.jump_progress = 0
			self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.free_fall
		end
	end

	-- 좌우 이동
	self:move_left_right(dt)

	-- 카메라 이동
	local prev_center_pos_z = self.center_pos.z
	local move_z = 0
	if self.is_camera_move_start == true then
		if self.center_pos.z < user_party.Leader.Position.z then
			self.center_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.center_pos.x, 0, user_party.Leader.Position.z)
		else
			self.center_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.center_pos.x, 0, self.center_pos.z + (dt / 2))
		end
		camera_util.move(self.center_pos, 0)
		move_z = self.center_pos.z - prev_center_pos_z
		self.move_z_accure = self.move_z_accure + move_z
		self.foothold_bottom = self.foothold_bottom + move_z
	end

	-- 빙벽 반복 시키기
	local bg_scroll_height = 12
	if self.move_z_accure >= self.wall_bg_z_move + bg_scroll_height then
		self.wall_bg_z_move = self.wall_bg_z_move + bg_scroll_height
		self.mini_game_scene2.transform.position = self.mini_game_scene2.transform.position + vector(0, 0, bg_scroll_height)
	end

	-- 원경 스크롤은 1/2 속도로
	if move_z > 0 then
		self.mini_game_scene.transform.position = self.mini_game_scene.transform.position + vector(0, 0, move_z / 2)
	end

	-- 반복 시키기
	bg_scroll_height = 32
	if (self.move_z_accure / 2) >= 12 + self.far_bg_z_move + bg_scroll_height then
		self.far_bg_z_move = self.far_bg_z_move + bg_scroll_height
		self.mini_game_scene.transform.position = self.mini_game_scene.transform.position + vector(0, 0, bg_scroll_height)
	end

	-- 게임 오버 검사
	if self:is_fo_in_screen(user_party.Leader.Position, { bonus_distance = 1 }) == false then
		if self.cheat_immortal == true then	-- 무적일 때는 뛰어오름
			self:jump_start()
		else
			self:fail(self.data.game_over_type.fall)
		end
	end

	self:map_update(dt)
end

function local_class:map_update(dt)
	-- 패턴에 맞게 발판 재배치
	if self.foothold_bottom + 12 >= self.foothold_next_z  then
		local pattern = self:get_current_pattern()
		if pattern == self.data.pattern.zigzag then
			self:make_zigzag_pattern(true)
			if self.pattern.level == 1 then
				self:make_zigzag_pattern(false)
			end
		elseif pattern == self.data.pattern.mix then
			self:make_mix_pattern()
		elseif pattern == self.data.pattern.obstacle then
			self:make_obstacle_pattern()
		elseif pattern == self.data.pattern.invisible then
			self:make_invisible_pattern()
		elseif pattern == self.data.pattern.safe then
			self:make_safe_pattern()
		elseif pattern == self.data.pattern.boss then
			self:make_boss_pattern()
		end

		self.foothold_next_z = self.foothold_next_z + 3
		self.pattern.progress = self.pattern.progress + 1
		if self:is_pattern_end() then
			self:next_pattern()
		end
	end

	-- 독수리 처리
	for _, data in ipairs(self.enemy_data_list) do
		local fo = data.fo
		if fo.Position.x <= self.data.player_x_min then
			data.dir = 1
			character_util.set_direction(fo, 'right')
		elseif fo.Position.x >= self.data.player_x_max then
			data.dir = -1
			character_util.set_direction(fo, 'left')
		end
		local distance = dt * data.dir * self.data.enemy_move_speed
		fo.Position = vector(fo.Position.x + distance, 0, fo.Position.z)
	end

	-- 스크롤 넘어간 NPC 숨기기(보스 제외)
	for _, data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if data.fo.ActiveState ~= active_state('disabled')
		and self:is_fo_in_screen(data.fo.Position, { bonus_distance = 1 }) == false
		and data.type ~= self.data.npc_type.boss then
			character_util.stop(data.fo)
			data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end
end

-- 고드름 & 적 패턴
function local_class:make_obstacle_pattern()
	if (self.foothold_next_z % 2) == 1 then
		self:make_enemy_pattern()
	else
		self:make_icicle_pattern()
	end
end

-- 고드름 패턴
function local_class:make_icicle_pattern()
	local count = 0

	-- 난이도별 숫자
	if self.pattern.level == 1 then
		count = 3
	elseif self.pattern.level == 2 then
		count = 4
	elseif self.pattern.level == 3 then
		count = 5
	elseif self.pattern.level >= 4 then
		count = 6
	end

	-- 발판 재배치
	local random_box = self:generate_random_box(self.data.foothold_per_line)
	for i = 1, self.data.foothold_per_line do
		local num = random_box[i]
		local x = self:get_foothold_x(num)
		local foothold_data = self:spawn_foothold(self.data.foothold_type.normal, x)

		-- 가시 붙이기
		if i <= count then
			self:spawn_icicle(foothold_data)
		end

		-- 아이템 놓기
		if i == 1 then
			self:spawn_item(x + 0.5, self.foothold_next_z + 1)
		end
	end
end

-- 적 패턴
function local_class:make_enemy_pattern()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.eagle_sfx_name)

	-- 난이도에 따른 숫자
	local count = 0
	if self.pattern.level == 1 then
		count = 1
	elseif self.pattern.level == 2 then
		count = 2
	elseif self.pattern.level == 3 then
		count = 3
	elseif self.pattern.level >= 4 then
		count = 5
	end

	-- 적 방향
	local dir = 0
	if random_util.get_random_int(1, 2) == 1 then
		dir = 1
	else
		dir = -1
	end

	-- 배치
	local random_box = self:generate_random_box(self.data.foothold_per_line)
	for i = 1, self.data.foothold_per_line do
		local num = random_box[i]
		local x = self:get_foothold_x(num)
		local foothold_data = self:spawn_foothold(self.data.foothold_type.normal, x)

		-- 적 배치
		if i <= count then
			self:spawn_enemy(foothold_data, dir)
		end

		-- 아이템 배치
		if i == 1 then
			self:spawn_item(x + 0.5, self.foothold_next_z + 1)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_invisible_pattern()
	-- 레벨에 따른 적 숫자 조절
	local enemy_count = 0
	local progress = 0
	if self.pattern.level == 1 then
		progress = 0
	elseif self.pattern.level == 2 then
		progress = 1
	elseif self.pattern.level == 3 then
		progress = 2
	elseif self.pattern.level >= 4 then
		progress = 3
	end

	self.invisible_pattern_enemy_progress = self.invisible_pattern_enemy_progress + progress
	local progress_max = 5
	if self.invisible_pattern_enemy_progress > progress_max then
		self.invisible_pattern_enemy_progress = self.invisible_pattern_enemy_progress - progress_max
		enemy_count = 1
	end
	if enemy_count > 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.eagle_sfx_name)
	end

	-- 적 방향
	local dir = 0
	if random_util.get_random_int(1, 2) == 1 then
		dir = 1
	else
		dir = -1
	end

	-- 아이템 수
	local item_count = 1

	-- 발판 재배치
	local hole_count = 1
	local random_box = self:generate_random_box(self.data.foothold_per_line)
	for i = 1, self.data.foothold_per_line do
		local num = random_box[i]
		local x = self:get_foothold_x(num)
		local foothold_exist = true

		-- 구멍
		if hole_count > 0 then
			local check_pos = vector(x, 0, self.foothold_next_z - 3)
			local down_foothold_data = self:get_foothold_data(check_pos)
			if down_foothold_data ~= nil then	-- 연속 구멍 방지
				foothold_exist = false
				hole_count = hole_count - 1
			end
		elseif item_count > 0 then
			-- 아이템 놓기
			self:spawn_item(x + 0.5, self.foothold_next_z + 1)
			item_count = item_count - 1
		end

		if foothold_exist == true then
			local foothold_data = self:spawn_foothold(self.data.foothold_type.invisible, x)

			-- 적 배치
			if enemy_count > 0 then
				self:spawn_enemy(foothold_data, dir)
				enemy_count = enemy_count - 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_mix_pattern()
	-- 난이도에 따른 고드름 수
	local obstable_count = 0
	if self.pattern.level == 1 then
		obstable_count = 1
	elseif self.pattern.level == 2 then
		obstable_count = 2
	elseif self.pattern.level == 3 then
		obstable_count = 3
	elseif self.pattern.level >= 4 then
		obstable_count = 4
	end

	-- 적 방향
	local dir = 0
	if random_util.get_random_int(1, 2) == 1 then
		dir = 1
	else
		dir = -1
	end

	-- 아이템 수
	local item_count = 1

	-- 발판 재배치
	local eagle_sound_played = false
	local hole_count = 3
	local random_box = self:generate_random_box(self.data.foothold_per_line)
	for i = 1, self.data.foothold_per_line do
		local num = random_box[i]
		local x = self:get_foothold_x(num)
		local foothold_enable = true
		local foothold_type = self.data.foothold_type.normal

		-- 구멍(또는 무너지는 발판)
		if hole_count > 0 then
			local check_pos = vector(x, 0, self.foothold_next_z - 3)
			local down_foothold_data = self:get_foothold_data(check_pos)
			if down_foothold_data ~= nil and down_foothold_data.type == self.data.foothold_type.normal then	-- 연속 구멍 방지
				if random_util.get_random_int(1, 2) == 1 then
					if self.pattern.level == 1 then
						foothold_enable = false
					elseif self.pattern.level == 2 then
						foothold_type = self.data.foothold_type.breakable
					elseif self.pattern.level == 3 then
						foothold_type = self.data.foothold_type.breakable
					elseif self.pattern.level >= 4 then
						foothold_type = self.data.foothold_type.breakable
					end
				else
					foothold_enable = false
				end
			end
			hole_count = hole_count - 1
		end

		if foothold_enable == true then
			local foothold_data = self:spawn_foothold(foothold_type, x)

			-- 아이템 놓기
			if item_count > 0 then
				self:spawn_item(x + 0.5, self.foothold_next_z + 1)
				item_count = item_count - 1
			end

			-- 가시 붙이기
			if obstable_count > 0 then
				if (self.foothold_next_z % 2) == 1 then
					self:spawn_icicle(foothold_data)
					obstable_count = obstable_count - 1
				else
					self:spawn_enemy(foothold_data, dir)
					obstable_count = obstable_count - 2
					if eagle_sound_played == false then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.eagle_sfx_name)
						eagle_sound_played = true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_zigzag_pattern(exist_item)
	self.zigzag_progress = self.zigzag_progress + 1
	if self.zigzag_progress > 12 then
		self.zigzag_progress = 1
	end

	-- 발판 재배치
	local zigzag_plus = false
	for i = 1, self.data.foothold_per_line do
		local num = i
		local x = self:get_foothold_x(num)
		local foothold_enable = true
		local foothold_type = self.data.foothold_type.normal

		local foothold_num = self.zigzag_progress
		if foothold_num > self.data.foothold_per_line then
			foothold_num = (self.data.foothold_per_line + 1) - math.abs(self.data.foothold_per_line - foothold_num)
		end

		if i ~= foothold_num then
			foothold_enable = false
		else
			if self.pattern.level == 3 then
				foothold_type = self.data.foothold_type.breakable_fast
			elseif self.pattern.level >= 4 then
				zigzag_plus = true
			end
		end

		if foothold_enable == true then
			self:spawn_foothold(foothold_type, x)
			if exist_item == true then
				self:spawn_item(x + 0.5, self.foothold_next_z + 1)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 빈칸 하나 더 만듦
	if zigzag_plus == true then
		self.zigzag_progress = self.zigzag_progress + 1
	end
end

-- 안전 패턴으로 발판 배치
function local_class:make_safe_pattern()
	local item_pos = random_util.get_random_int(1, self.data.foothold_per_line)
	for i = 1, self.data.foothold_per_line do
		local x = self:get_foothold_x(i)
		self:spawn_foothold(self.data.foothold_type.normal, x)
		if i == item_pos then
			self:spawn_item(x + 0.5, self.foothold_next_z + 1)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_foothold_x(num)
	return 1 + (num * 2)
end

function local_class:make_boss_pattern()
	-- 보스 등장
	if self.pattern.progress > 4 and self.boss_npc_data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
		self:spawn_boss(user_party.Leader.Position.x, user_party.Leader.Position.z - 9)
		self.boss_npc_data.fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_boss)
		self.boss_hp = math.min(self.pattern.level, 4)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.data.boss_bgm_name, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
		self.wing_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.data.boss_wing_sfx_name, loop = true})
	end

	-- 발판 재배치
	local hole_count = 2
	local random_box = self:generate_random_box(6)
	for i = 1, #random_box do
		local num = random_box[i]
		local foothold_type = self.data.foothold_type.normal
		local x = self:get_foothold_x(num)

		if hole_count > 0 then
			local check_pos = vector(x, 0, self.foothold_next_z - 3)
			local down_foothold_data = nil
			for _, data in ipairs(self.foothold_data_list) do
				if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(data.fo.Bounds, check_pos) then
					if data.type == self.data.foothold_type.normal then
						down_foothold_data = data
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if down_foothold_data ~= nil then
				foothold_type = self.data.foothold_type.breakable_fast
				hole_count = hole_count - 1
			end
		end

		local foothold_data = self:spawn_foothold(foothold_type, x)
		if foothold_type ~= self.data.foothold_type.normal then
			self:spawn_icicle(foothold_data)
		end
	end
end

-- 발판 재배치
function local_class:spawn_foothold(type, x)
	-- 비활성화된 발판 찾기
	local foothold_data = nil
	for _, data in ipairs(self.foothold_data_list) do
		if data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			foothold_data = data
			break
		end
	end

	-- 발판 찾을 수 없으면 nil 리턴(에러)
	if foothold_data == nil then
		print("climbing game error : foothold not found")
		return nil
	end

	local foothold = foothold_data.fo
	local x_offset = 0.5
	foothold.Position = vector(x + x_offset, 0, self.foothold_next_z)
	foothold.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	if type == self.data.foothold_type.normal then
		character_util.set_anim(foothold, { name = 'normal' })
	elseif type == self.data.foothold_type.breakable then
		character_util.set_anim(foothold, { name = 'weak' })
	elseif type == self.data.foothold_type.breakable_fast then
		character_util.set_anim(foothold, { name = 'veryweak' })
	elseif type == self.data.foothold_type.invisible then
		character_util.set_anim(foothold, { name = 'invisible', scale = 0.5 })
	end
	foothold.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	foothold.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_foothold)

	foothold_data.type = type
	foothold_data.link_data = nil
	foothold_data.step_on = false
	foothold_data.footable = true

	return foothold_data
end

-- 고드름 재배치
function local_class:spawn_icicle(foothold_data, offset_x, offset_z)
	offset_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset_x, 0)
	offset_z = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset_z, -0.4)

	local icicle_data = self:get_disable_npc(self.icicle_data_list)
	if icicle_data == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local x = foothold_data.fo.Position.x + offset_x
	local z = foothold_data.fo.Position.z + offset_z
	icicle_data.fo.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	icicle_data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	icicle_data.state = self.data.icicle_state.normal
	foothold_data.link_data = icicle_data
	icicle_data.fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_icicle)

	return icicle_data
end

-- 적 재배치
function local_class:spawn_enemy(foothold_data, dir, offset_x, offset_z)
	offset_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset_x, 0.5)
	offset_z = lua_helper.get_or_default(offset_z, -1)

	local enemy_data = self:get_disable_npc(self.enemy_data_list)
	if enemy_data == nil then
		return nil
	end

	-- 발판을 중심으로 좌표 초기화
	local x = foothold_data.fo.Position.x + offset_x
	local z = foothold_data.fo.Position.z + offset_z
	enemy_data.fo.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	enemy_data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	enemy_data.dir = dir

	-- 설정된 방향을 향함
	if dir == 1 then
		character_util.set_direction(enemy_data.fo, 'right')
	elseif dir == -1 then
		character_util.set_direction(enemy_data.fo, 'left')
	end

	enemy_data.fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_enemy)

	return enemy_data
end

-- 아이템 재배치
function local_class:spawn_item(x, z, is_force)
	is_force = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_force, false)

	local item_data = self:get_disable_npc(self.item_data_list)
	if item_data == nil then
		return nil
	end

	if is_force == false then
		if z <= self.data.bonus_item_start_z then
			return
		end

		if self.bonus_item_progress < self.data.bonus_item_progress_max then
			self.bonus_item_progress = self.bonus_item_progress + 1
			return
		end
		self.bonus_item_progress = 0
	end

	item_data.active = true
	item_data.fo.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	item_data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	item_data.fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_item)

	return item_data
end

-- 해당 타입의 npc를 찾아서 활성화
function local_class:spawn_boss(x, z)
	local fo = self.boss_npc_data.fo
	fo.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	-- 애니메이션 변경
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'idle' })
	fo.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	self.boss_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_action, self))
end

-- 좌우왕복 움직임
function local_class:move_left_right(dt)
	local look_dir = user_party.Leader.Direction
	local direction_vector = vector(0, 0, 0)
	if look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		direction_vector = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		direction_vector = vector(1, 0, 0)
	end
	local next_position = user_party.Leader.Position + direction_vector
	self:move_by_one_frame(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position, next_position, self.data.player_move_speed, dt)

	if user_party.Leader.Position.x < self.data.player_x_min then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	elseif user_party.Leader.Position.x > self.data.player_x_max then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	end
end

-- 점수 세팅
function local_class:set_score(score)
	self.current_score = math.min(score, CS.System.Double.MaxValue)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameScoreChangeEvent.Create('ClimbingGame', self.current_score))
end

-- 점수 증가
function local_class:add_score(score)
	self:set_score(self.current_score + score)
end

-- max까지의 숫자를 랜덤한 순서로 배열 생성
function local_class:generate_random_box(max)
	local random_box = {}
	for i = 1, max do
		table.insert(random_box, i)
	end
	self:random_shuffle(random_box)
	return random_box
end

-- 배열을 랜덤하게 섞음
function local_class:random_shuffle(list)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

-- 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_collision()
	-- 고드름과 보스 충돌 체크
	if self.boss_npc_data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and self.is_boss_damaged == false then
		local old_bound = self.boss_npc_data.fo.Bounds
		local center = unity_class.vector3(old_bound.center.x, old_bound.center.y, old_bound.center.z + 0.9)
		local boss_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, unity_class.vector3(1.5, old_bound.extents.y, 0.8))
		for _, data in ipairs(self.icicle_data_list) do
			local icicle = data.fo
			if icicle.ActiveState == active_state('enabled')
			and data.state == self.data.icicle_state.fall then
				local crash = icicle.Bounds:Intersects(boss_bounds)
				if crash == true then
					self:hit_boss()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어와 npc와의 충돌 체크
	local hit_npc_data_list = {}
	local hit_item_data_list = {}
	local radius = 0
	local hit_ifos = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(user_party.Leader.Position, radius)
	for i = 0, hit_ifos.Count - 1 do
		for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
			if npc_data.fo == hit_ifos[i] then
				table.insert(hit_npc_data_list, npc_data)
			end
		end

		-- 아이템 따로 리스트 만듦
		for _, item_data in ipairs(self.item_data_list) do
			if item_data.fo == hit_ifos[i] then
				table.insert(hit_item_data_list, item_data)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 아이템 충돌 검사
	for _, data in ipairs(hit_item_data_list) do
		if data.active == true then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_score_effect, self, data.fo.Position))
			self:add_score(self.data.bonus_item_score)
			character_util.stop(data.fo)
			data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.get_item_sfx_name)
		end
	end

	-- 다른 오브젝트 충돌 검사
	for _, data in ipairs(hit_npc_data_list) do
		if data.type == self.data.npc_type.boss and self.is_boss_damaged == false then
			self:fail(self.data.game_over_type.hit)
			return
		-- 고드름, 적
		elseif data.type == self.data.npc_type.icicle or data.type == self.data.npc_type.enemy then
			self:fail(self.data.game_over_type.hit)
			return
		end
	end
end

-- 보스가 공격 받음
function local_class:hit_boss()
	self.is_boss_damaged = true
	if self.boss_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.boss_coroutine)
		self.boss_coroutine = nil
	end
	character_util.set_anim(self.boss_npc_data.fo, { name = 'damaged' })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_damaged, self))
end

-- 필드 오브젝트가 화면 안에 있는지 검사
function local_class:is_fo_in_screen(fo_pos, args)
	local fo_position = lua_helper.get_or_default(fo_pos, user_party.Leader.Position)
	local bonus_dis = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'bonus_distance', 0)
	local center_pos = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'center_pos', stage_camera.LookAtPosition)

	local size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size() / 2
	size.y = size.y + bonus_dis

	-- 아래로 벗어난 경우만 체크
	if fo_position.z < center_pos.z - size.y then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 현재 스프라이트가 보이고 있는지 확인
function local_class:is_show_sprites_data(data)
	local invisible_position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	if data.sprite.Transform.localPosition == invisible_position then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 점수 이펙트 표시
function local_class:show_score_effect(position)
	for i = self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_begin, self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_end do
		local data = self.sprites_data[i]
		if self:is_show_sprites_data(data) == false then
			data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = position
			wait_for_sec(1)
			data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
			break
		end
	end
end

-- 발판 부수기
function local_class:break_foothold(data, shake_count)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.crack_sfx_name)

	local foothold = data.fo
	local origin_pos = foothold.Position
	for i = 1, shake_count do
		foothold.Position = vector(origin_pos.x - 0.1, 0, foothold.Position.z)
		wait_for_sec(0.05)
		foothold.Position = vector(origin_pos.x + 0.1, 0, foothold.Position.z)
		wait_for_sec(0.05)
	end
	foothold.Position = origin_pos
	data.footable = false
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(foothold, { name = 'weak_break', count = 1, scale = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.break_sfx_name)

	-- 고드름이 붙어 있다면 떨어뜨리기
	local link_data = data.link_data
	if link_data ~= nil then
		link_data.state = self.data.icicle_state.fall
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.icicle_fall, self, link_data))
	end
end

-- 고드름 낙하
function local_class:icicle_fall(data)
	while data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local distance = dt * self.data.icicle_fall_speed
		local fo = data.fo
		fo.Position = vector(fo.Position.x, 0, fo.Position.z - distance)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 현재 패턴 얻기
function local_class:get_current_pattern()
	if self.pattern.idx < 0 or self.pattern.idx > #self.pattern.box then
		return self.data.pattern.none
	end

	return self.pattern.box[self.pattern.idx]
end

-- 패턴 종료 확인
function local_class:is_pattern_end()
	-- 안전 패턴
	if self:get_current_pattern() == self.data.pattern.safe then
		if self.pattern.progress >= self.data.safe_pattern_progress_max then
			return true
		end
	-- 보스 패턴은 특정 조건을 만족할 때까지 계속 됨
	elseif self:get_current_pattern() == self.data.pattern.boss then
		return false
	else
		if self.pattern.progress >= self.data.pattern_progress_max then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 다음 패턴
function local_class:next_pattern()
	self.pattern.idx = self.pattern.idx + 1
	self.pattern.progress = 0
	self.zigzag_progress = 1

	if self.pattern.idx > #self.pattern.box then
		self:generate_pattern_box()
		self.pattern.idx = 1
		self.pattern.level = self.pattern.level + 1
	end
end

-- 패턴 세팅(1 ~ 5 순서대로)
function local_class:generate_pattern_box()
	self.pattern.box = {}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		table.insert(self.pattern.box, i)
		table.insert(self.pattern.box, self.data.pattern.safe)
	end
end

-- 게임오버 이벤트 발생
function local_class:fail(type)
	if self.cheat_immortal == true then
		return
	end

	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.fail then
		return
	end

	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.fail
	self.game_over_type = type
end

-- 게임오버
function local_class:game_over()
	-- BGM 종료
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})

	-- 부딪쳐서 게임 게임오버
	if self.game_over_type == self.data.game_over_type.hit then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.hit_sfx_name)
		-- dead 애니메이션 후 바닥까지 떨어짐
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dead' })
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local jump_start_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
			local jump_progress = 0
			local prev_z = jump_start_z

			local loop_end = false
			while loop_end == false do
				jump_progress = jump_progress + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local z = jump_start_z + self.death_jump_calculator:GetDistance(jump_progress)
				user_party.Leader.Position = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, z)

				coroutine.yield(nil)

				-- 떨어지면서 바닥 검사
				if z < jump_start_z then
					local foothold_data = self:get_foothold_data(user_party.Leader.Position)
					local prev_foothold_data = self:get_foothold_data(vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, prev_z))
					if foothold_data ~= nil and prev_foothold_data == nil then
						character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dead2' })
						loop_end = true
					end
				end

				prev_z = z
			end
		end, self))

		-- 독수리 달려듬
		local eagle_count = 0
		for _, data in ipairs(self.enemy_data_list) do
			if data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_player, self, data.fo, 2.5))
				eagle_count = eagle_count + 1
			end
		end
		if eagle_count > 0 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.eagles_wing_sfx_name)
		end
	elseif self.game_over_type == self.data.game_over_type.fall then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.player_fall_sfx_name)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.game_over_sfx_name)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	if self.wing_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.wing_sfx)
		self.wing_sfx = nil
	end
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
end

-- 플레이어에게로 이동
function local_class:move_to_player(fo, delay)
	local progress = 0
	while progress < delay do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		progress = progress + dt
		local diff = vector_util.magnitude(user_party.Leader.Position - fo.Position)
		if diff > 0.1 then
			self:move_by_one_frame(fo, fo.Position, user_party.Leader.Position, 4, dt)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 플레이어 캐릭터 변경
function local_class:change_manual_character(new_manual_character_name)
	self.saved_party_leader = user_party_leader
	local manual_character = get_character(new_manual_character_name)

	-- 파티 리더 변경
	party_util.switch_leader(manual_character)

	character_util.set_direction(manual_character, self.saved_party_leader.Direction)

	-- 기존 캐릭터 보이지 않는 곳으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.saved_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

-- 게임패드 UI 표시
function local_class:show_gamepad_label()
	self.gamepad_label = gamepad_util.show_joypad_label()
end

-- 게임 패드 UI 숨기기
function local_class:hide_gamepad_label()
	gamepad_util.hide_joypad_label(self.gamepad_label)

	self.gamepad_label = nil
end

--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent))

	self.game_loop = false

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.data = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.player_pos_marker = nil
	self.saved_party_leader = nil
	self.game_progress = nil
	self.sprites_data = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ClimbMiniGame')

local character_state_base = newclass('ClimbMiniGameCharacterState')

local guardian_screenplay_state = newclass('ClimbMiniGameGuardianScreenPlayState', character_state_base)

local princess_attack_state = newclass('ClimbMiniGamePrincessAttackState', character_state_base)
local princess_thanks_state = newclass('ClimbMiniGamePrincessThanksState', character_state_base)
local princess_spider_appear_attack_state = newclass('ClimbMiniGamePrincessSpiderAppearAttackState', character_state_base)

local enemy_screenplay_state = newclass('ClimbMiniGameScreenPlayChaseState', character_state_base)
local enemy_chase_state = newclass('ClimbMiniGameEnemyChaseState', character_state_base)
