local enemy_dead_state = newclass('ClimbMiniGameEnemyDeadState', character_state_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'ClimbMiniGame'

	-- 게임 진행중 여부
	self.is_game_playing = false

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- effect
	self.get_hit_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_window_break_effect_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_building_climb_windowbreak_1x1') end
	self.get_fire_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fire_smoke_right_view_weak') end
	self.get_human_emotion_pool = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('human_emotion') end
	self.get_falling_rock_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_break_lilithtower_obj1')  end
	self.get_falling_chair_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_break_lilithtower_obj2')  end
	self.get_warning_line = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_building_climb_alert_line')  end

	-- field object
	self.get_enemy_appear_window = function(num) return get_field_object('climb_enemy_appear_window_' .. num) end
	self.get_princess_rock = function() return get_field_object('princess_rock') end

	-- marker
	self.get_enemy_appear_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('climb_enemy_appear_' .. num) end

	-- ResourceHolder
	self.res_holder = nil

	-- 프리팹
	self.climb_prefab = nil

	-- 카메라
	self.camera = nil
	self.camera_shake_offset = nil
	self.camera_offset = nil

	-- 배경
	self.background = nil
	self.background_offset = nil

	-- shader
	self.shader_container = nil
	self.bend_offset_prop_id = nil

	self.guardian_origin_spine_controller_shader = nil
	self.princess_origin_spine_controller_shader = nil

	-- offset
	self.map_offset = vector(500, 0, 500)
	self.guardian_offset = vector(0, 0, 4)
	self.princess_offset = vector(0, 0.16, -0.1)
	self.climb_map_offset = vector(0, 0, -27)

	-- 외부 스크립트
	self.fall_manager = nil

	-- 거리 측정 UI
	self.distance_checker = nil

	-- constants
	self.enemy_speed = -0.3
	self.enemy_fast_speed = 0
	self.enemy_fall_speed = 10

	--NPC
	self.enemy_list = {}

	-- 낙하물 상태
	self.fall_state = {
		sleep = 0,
		awake = 1,
		fall = 2,
		fall2 = 3,	-- 거미랑 부딫친 후 궤도 수정
		disappear = 4
	}

	-- 적 상태
	self.enemy_state = {
		chase = 0,
		fall = 1,
		dead = 2,
		stun = 3,
		fast_chase = 4,
		appear = 5,
	}
	self.enemy_bullet_delay = 0
	self.enemy_max = 0
	self.is_enemy_appear = false
	self.enemy_stun_time = 1

	-- 주인공
	self.guardian = nil
	self.climb_height = 0
	self.max_climb_height = 40

	-- 공주
	self.princess = nil
	self.rock_item_id = 20019
	self.princess_away_event = false

	-- 효과
	self.break_glass_preset = 'fx_windowbreak'

	-- QTE 변수
	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.correct_swipe = ''
	self.is_qte_start = false
	self.turbo_tap_count = 0

	-- coroutine request id
	self.camera_shake_req_id = 0

	-- 기타
	self.dead_line = 530	--여기까지 낙하한 물체, 적은 사라짐

	-- 캐릭터 State
	self.guardian_state = nil
	self.princess_state = nil

	-- effect
	self.rotate_effect_list = {}

	-- 기존 파티
	self.origin_party = {}

	self.fire_sfx = nil

end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/ClimbMiniGame/ClimbMiniGameConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	-- QTE 스파인 불러오기
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	-- 효과 불러오기
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.break_glass_preset)
	self.get_hit_effect_pool()
	self.get_window_break_effect_pool()
	self.get_fire_effect()
	self.get_human_emotion_pool()
	self.get_warning_line()

	local checker = {}
	for _, v in pairs(self.constants_data.fall_list) do
		if checker[v.effect] == nil then
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(v.effect)
			checker[v.effect] = true
		end
	end

	-- 주인공 초기화
	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		self.guardian = get_character('climb_guardian_male')
	else
		self.guardian = get_character('climb_guardian_female')
	end
	character_util.set_active_state(self.guardian, 'enabled')
	coroutine.yield()

	-- 파티 제외(주인공 포함)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.origin_party, user_party[i])
	end
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.guardian, param)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.guardian, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.guardian, false)
	self.guardian.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.55, 0.75, 0.45))
	self.guardian:SetGiantFactor(self.game_name, 0.5)
	-- 캐릭터 손이 바닥에 파묻히지 않게, 약간 위로 끌어올림.
	self.guardian.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 0.08, 0)

	-- 공주
	self.princess = get_character('climb_princess')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.princess, 'enabled')

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.princess, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.princess, false)
	self.princess:SetGiantFactor(self.game_name, 0.5)
	-- 가디언 offset에 맞춰서 똑같이 조정.
	self.princess.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 0.08, 0)

	-- Load Prefab
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- climb prefab 로드
	local climb_prefab_asset_path = self.constants_data['climb_prefab_asset_path']
	local climb_prefab_asset_name = self.constants_data['climb_prefab_asset_name']
	self.climb_prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, climb_prefab_asset_path, climb_prefab_asset_name)
	self.climb_prefab.transform.position = self.map_offset	-- 이 위치를 수정하면 MatCap/Detail Bend의 Bend Offset값을 같이 수정해야 함.

	self.camera = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.climb_prefab.transform, 'Main Camera')
	self.camera_shake_offset = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.climb_prefab.transform, 'camera_offset')
	self.camera_offset = self.camera.localPosition

	self.background = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.climb_prefab.transform, 'background')
	self.background_offset = self.background.localPosition

	-- ShaderContainer 로드
	local shader_container_asset_path = self.constants_data['shader_container_asset_path']
	local shader_container_asset_name = self.constants_data['shader_container_asset_name']
	self.shader_container = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, shader_container_asset_path, shader_container_asset_name)

	-- distance_checker 로드
	local ui_root = stage.UISceneManager.UIRootTransform
	self.distance_checker = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, 'ui/stage/base', 'distance_checker', ui_root):GetComponent(typeof(CS.SimpleText))
	self.distance_checker:Show(false)
	self.distance_checker:SetCamera(stage.UISceneManager.UIRootTransform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera)))
	self.distance_checker.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.distance_checker.transform, CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer("UI"));

	self.bend_offset_prop_id = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.PropertyToID('_BendOffset')
	self.shared_material_list = {}

	local find_shared_material = function(shared_material)
		if self.shared_material_list[shared_material] ~= nil then
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	-- 타일맵에 있는 floor, gimmick, obj1, wall 레이어를 탐색
	local tilemap = field.Tilemap
	local layer_list = {
		tilemap.transform:Find('floor'),
		tilemap.transform:Find('gimmick'),
		tilemap.transform:Find('obj1'),
		tilemap.transform:Find('wall'),
	}

	for i = 1, #layer_list do
		local layer = layer_list[i]

		local renderers = layer:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer), true)
		for j = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
			local renderer = renderers[j]
			local shared_material = renderer.sharedMaterial

			-- _BendOffset 프로퍼티가 있는지 확인
			if shared_material ~= nil then
				if shared_material:HasProperty(self.bend_offset_prop_id) then
					-- 이미 shared_material_list 에 등록 되었는지 확인
					if not find_shared_material(shared_material) then
						-- 등록되어 있지 않으면, 카피해서 등록함
						self.shared_material_list[shared_material] = CS.UnityEngine.Material(shared_material)
						table.insert(self.shared_material_list, CS.UnityEngine.Material(shared_material))
					end

					-- 미니 게임에서 사용할, 복사 한 sharedMaterial을 사용하도록 교체
					renderer.sharedMaterial = self.shared_material_list[shared_material]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Manager 로드
	self.fall_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/ClimbMiniGame/ClimbMiniGameFallManager')
	self.fall_manager:init_manager(self)

	-- 카메라나 Spine이 회전하면서 찌그러지지 않게끔 하기 위해 미니게임 진행 동안에 Shader 변경
	local shader_list = self.shader_container:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShaderContainer)).ShaderList
	local shader = shader_list[0]
	self.guardian_origin_spine_controller_shader = self.guardian.SpineController.CustomShader
	self.princess_origin_spine_controller_shader = self.princess.SpineController.CustomShader
	self.guardian.SpineController.CustomShader = shader
	self.princess.SpineController.CustomShader = shader

	stage_camera.Enabled = false
	local audio_listener = stage_camera:GetComponentInParent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.AudioListener))
	audio_listener.enabled = false

	self:reset_game()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_22_lilithtower/audio:bgm_lilith_terror_02', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.fire_sfx then
		self.fire_sfx:Stop()
		self.fire_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.walk_robot_sfx then
		self.walk_robot_sfx:Stop()
		self.walk_robot_sfx = nil
	end

	stage_camera.Enabled = true
	local audio_listener = stage_camera:GetComponentInParent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.AudioListener))
	audio_listener.enabled = true

	self.get_human_emotion_pool().transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	if self.distance_checker then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.distance_checker.gameObject)
		self.distance_checker = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if self.climb_prefab then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.climb_prefab)
		self.climb_prefab = nil
	end

	if self.shader_container then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.shader_container)
		self.shader_container = nil
	end

	if self.shared_material_list then
	end

	if self.guardian_state then
		self.guardian_state:exit()
		self.guardian_state:dispose()
		self.guardian_state = nil
	end

	if self.princess_state then
		self.princess_state:exit()
		self.princess_state:dispose()
		self.princess_state = nil
	end

	self.rotate_effect_list = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self.is_game_playing = true

	-- 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- UI 초기화
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	-- HACK: 캐릭터는 0.5 크기로 줄였는데, 공용 이모션 크기는 그대로라 이상하게 보이는걸 해결하기 위한 코드.
	-- 캐릭터에 할당된 emotion이 private라 접근할 수 없기 때문에, 그냥 풀 전체의 크기를 줄여버림.
	self.get_human_emotion_pool().transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

	-- state 변경
	-- FIXME: State를 변경한 뒤, 1프레임 기다리고 UI를 변경해야 제대로 적용돼서 로직 수정 해야 함.
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(user_party.Leader)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	local rock = self.get_princess_rock()
	rock.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

	self:init_enemy()

	self:reset_game()

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_main_loop, self))
end

function local_class:game_end()
	self.is_game_playing = false

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	self.get_human_emotion_pool().transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	action_button.OverridenButtonAction = nil

	-- 기존 파티 합류
	for i = 1, #self.origin_party do
		local party = self.origin_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(party, user_party)
	end

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.origin_party[1])

	-- 더 이상 Shader 사용을 하지 않을 때, 원래 Shader 로 복구
	if self.guardian_origin_spine_controller_shader then
		self.guardian.SpineController.CustomShader = self.guardian_origin_spine_controller_shader
	end
	if self.princess_origin_spine_controller_shader then
		self.princess.SpineController.CustomShader = self.princess_origin_spine_controller_shader
	end
end

function local_class:reset_game()
	if self.fire_sfx then
		self.fire_sfx:Stop()
		self.fire_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.walk_robot_sfx then
		self.walk_robot_sfx:Stop()
		self.walk_robot_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.is_game_playing then
		self.fire_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.princess)

	-- 주인공
	self.guardian.Position = self.map_offset + self.guardian_offset
	if self.is_game_playing then
		self:change_guardian_state(guardian_ready_state(self, self.guardian))
	end
	self.climb_height = 0
	self.turbo_tap_count = 0

	-- 공주
	self.princess.Position = self.map_offset + self.guardian_offset + self.princess_offset
	self:change_princess_state(princess_ready_state(self, self.princess))
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.princess, 0, 0)
	self.princess_away_event = false

	-- 적 초기화
	self:reset_enemy()

	-- 낙하물 초기화
	self.fall_manager:reset_fall_object()

	-- 카메라 초기화
	self:background_bend_offset_update()
	self:camera_update()
	self:background_update()
	if self.is_game_playing then
		self:distance_checker_update()
	end

	--qte 초기화
	self.is_qte_start = false
	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
end

function local_class:game_main_loop()
	coroutine.yield()

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	-- 메인 루프
	while self.is_game_playing == true do
		local delta = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		self:update_guardian_state(delta)
		self:update_princess_state(delta)

		self:enemy_update(delta)
		self.fall_manager:update(delta)

		self:background_bend_offset_update()
		self:camera_update()
		self:background_update()
		self:distance_checker_update()

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.walk_robot_sfx then
		self.walk_robot_sfx:Stop()
		self.walk_robot_sfx = nil
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	self.distance_checker:Show(false)

	local camera_position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.camera.position, 0.5)

	-- FIXME: 임시 코드. 캐릭터가 배경 밑에 가려서, 안 가리도록 SortingLayer 조절
	self.guardian.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)
	self.princess.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	local jump_move = function(fo, position, height, duration)
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_position = fo.Position
		local end_position = position

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

			local now_position = vector_util.lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

			character_util.set_position(fo, now_position, true)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(jump_move, self.guardian, camera_position, 0.5, 1))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(jump_move, self.princess, camera_position + self.princess_offset, 0.5, 1))
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	if self.fire_sfx then
		self.fire_sfx:FadeOut(1)
		self.fire_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.walk_robot_sfx then
		self.walk_robot_sfx:FadeOut(1)
		self.walk_robot_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_window_01')
	self.get_window_break_effect_pool():Instantiate(self.camera.transform.position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0), nil)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	screen_util.fade_out(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	time_util.mod('climb_mini_game', 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	time_util.unmod('climb_mini_game')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:game_end()
end

--region guardian_climb_state
function guardian_climb_state:init(controller, character)
	self.super:init(controller, character)

	self.climb_force = 0.4
	self.side_move_speed = 0.5
	self.keep_prev_emotion_duration = 0.5

	self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
end

function guardian_climb_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function guardian_climb_state:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')

	character_util.set_direction(self.character, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'climbing', sfx_name = '01_climb_01' })
end

function guardian_climb_state:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
end

function guardian_climb_state:on_joypad_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		self.input_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function guardian_climb_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed >= self.keep_prev_emotion_duration then
		character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	-- 캐릭터가 좌표값이 변화하는 이동을 하였는가
	local is_move = false

	-- 조작 처리
	if self.input_direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		if self.input_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			is_move = true
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.character, vector(-1, 0, 0), self.side_move_speed * dt)
		elseif self.input_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			is_move = true
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.character, vector(1, 0, 0), self.side_move_speed * dt)
		end

		self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	end

	local prev_position = self.character.Position
	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.character, vector(0, 0, -1), self.climb_force * dt)

	local delta_position = self.character.Position - prev_position
	self.controller.climb_height = self.controller.climb_height + -delta_position.z

	if not float_util.is_almost_zero(delta_position.z) then
		is_move = true
	end

	-- 캐릭터의 좌표가 바뀌지 않았으면, 애니메이션을 멈춘다.
	if is_move then
		character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'climbing', sfx_name = '01_climb_01' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'climbing', scale = 0, sfx_name = '01_climb_01' })
	end

	-- 공주 날아가는 이벤트
	if self.controller.princess_away_event == false and self.controller.climb_height >= 24 then
		self.controller.princess_away_event = true
		self.controller:princess_away()
		return
	end

	-- 클리어 체크
	if self.controller.climb_height > self.controller.max_climb_height then
		self.controller:start_hit_window()
		return
	end
end
--endregion

--region guardian_reclimb_state
function guardian_reclimb_state:init(controller, character)
	self.super:init(controller, character)

	self.climb_force = -5
	self.duration = 0.1
end

function guardian_reclimb_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function guardian_reclimb_state:enter()
	character_util.set_direction(self.character, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'embarrassed'})
	character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'reclimbing', loop = false })
end

function guardian_reclimb_state:exit()
end

function guardian_reclimb_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	local prev_position = self.character.Position
	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.character, vector(0, 0, -1), self.climb_force * dt)
	local delta_position = self.character.Position - prev_position
	self.controller.climb_height = self.controller.climb_height + -delta_position.z

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		local pos = self.character.Position
		local is_climbable = true
		local obstacle_list = self.controller.fall_manager:get_obstacle_list()
		local trap_list = self.controller.fall_manager:get_trap_list()

		for _, obstacle in ipairs(obstacle_list) do
			local bounds= obstacle.fo.Bounds
			if  self.controller:check_collision_bounds(bounds, self.character.Bounds) == true then
				is_climbable = false
				break
			end
		end
		if is_climbable == true then
			for _, trap in ipairs(trap_list.cracked) do
				local bounds = trap.fo.Bounds
				if trap.fo.ActiveState == active_state('visible') and self.controller:check_collision_bounds(bounds, self.character.Bounds) == true then
					is_climbable = false
					break
				end
			end
		end

		-- 다시 매달릴 수 있는 곳이면 다시 매달리고 아니면 계속 매달리기 시도
		if is_climbable == true then
			self.controller:change_guardian_state(guardian_climb_state(self.controller, self.character))
		else
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:throw_rock()
	local rock = self.get_princess_rock()
	rock.Position = self.princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	rock.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

	-- 거미가 없을 땐, 돌이 10칸까지 날아가게끔 함.
	local target_z = self.guardian.Position.z + 10
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
		if enemy.state == self.enemy_state.chase then
			local rock_position = vector_util.get_xy0(rock.Position, enemy.fo.Position.z)

			if self:check_collision(enemy.fo.Bounds, rock_position) then
				if enemy.fo.Position.z < target_z then
					target_z = enemy.fo.Position.z
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local start_position = rock.Position
	local end_position = vector(rock.Position.x, rock.Position.y, target_z)
	local time_passed = 0
	local height = 1
	local duration = 1

	local diff = math.abs(rock.Position.z - target_z)
	height = math.min(diff / 3, 1)

	rock.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	local is_hit = false
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		rock.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)
		rock.Transform:Rotate(vector(1, 1, -1), 720 * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		-- 돌이 적에게 맞았는지 체크
		for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
			if enemy.state == self.enemy_state.chase
				and self:check_collision(enemy.fo.Bounds, rock.Position) == true then
				self:stun_enemy(enemy)
				is_hit = true
				break
			end
		end

		if is_hit then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	rock.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
end

function local_class:stun_enemy(enemy)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_comic_01', parent = enemy.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local hit_effect = self.get_hit_effect_pool():Instantiate(enemy.fo.Position)
	self:add_rotate_effect_list(hit_effect, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0))

	local duration = 0.5
	enemy.state = self.enemy_state.stun
	enemy.duration = self.enemy_stun_time
	character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, { name = 'walk', scale = 0 })
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(enemy.fo)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(enemy.fo)
	character_util.shake(enemy.fo, 0.02, duration)
end

function local_class:init_enemy()
	-- 기계 거미
	local idx = 1
	local offset_list = {
		vector(-2, 0, -0.5),
		vector(-1.5, 0, 0),
		vector(-2, 0, 0.5),

		vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
		vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		vector(-1, 0, 0.5),

		vector(0, 0, -0.5),
		vector(0, 0, 0.5),

		vector(1, 0, -0.5),
		vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		vector(1, 0, 0.5),

		vector(2, 0, -0.5),
		vector(1.5, 0, 0),
		vector(2, 0, 0.5)
	}

	self.enemy_max = #offset_list
	for i = 1, self.enemy_max do
		local enemy = {}
		local fo = get_character('climb_spider' .. i)

		enemy.fo = fo
		enemy.init_position = self.get_enemy_appear_marker(3).position + offset_list[i] + vector(0, 0, -1)
		enemy.duration = 0

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(enemy.fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		fo:SetGiantFactor(self.game_name, 0.5)
		table.insert(self.enemy_list, enemy)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_enemy()
	self.is_enemy_appear = false

	-- 적 배치
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
		enemy.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		character_util.spine_rotate(enemy.fo, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(enemy.fo, 'down')
		enemy.fo.Position = enemy.init_position
		enemy.state = self.enemy_state.dead
		enemy.duration = 0

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(enemy.fo, 0, 0)
		enemy.fo.SpineController:RemoveColor(nil, 0)
		-- 스파인 강제 업데이트
		enemy.fo.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local window = self.get_enemy_appear_window(i)
		window.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:appear_enemy()
	self.is_enemy_appear = true

	self.walk_robot_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 3, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })

	local appear_position_offset = vector(0, 0, 10)
	local middle_position = self.get_enemy_appear_marker(3).position

	local appear_duration = 12.875
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
		local position = middle_position + appear_position_offset
		local speed = (enemy.init_position - position).magnitude / appear_duration

		enemy.state = self.enemy_state.appear
		character_util.set_active_state(enemy.fo, 'visible')
		character_util.set_direction(enemy.fo, 'down')
		enemy.fo.Position = position
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, { name = 'walk', scale = 1.5 })
		enemy.fo.SpineController:AddColor(nil, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }), 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(enemy.fo, 0, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(enemy.fo, 1, 0.5)
		--character_util.move_to(enemy.fo, enemy.init_position, appear_duration, nil, false, false)
		character_util.spine_scale(enemy.fo, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0)
		character_util.spine_scale(enemy.fo, unity_class.vector3.one, appear_duration)
		character_util.move_waypoint(enemy.fo, enemy.init_position, speed)
	end
	wait_for_sec(appear_duration - 2.5)

	if not self.is_enemy_appear then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'up')
	local emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(self.princess.Transform, nil, 'notice', nil, { offset = vector(0, 0.9, 0) })
	emoticon.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	if not self.is_enemy_appear then
		return
	end

	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
		enemy.state = self.enemy_state.chase
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, { name = 'walk' })
		enemy.fo.SpineController:RemoveColor(nil, 0.5)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if not self.is_enemy_appear then
		return
	end

	-- 헤실미소! 뒤쪽에 거미들이!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	self:camera_shake(0.05, 0.5)
	character_util.set_direction(self.princess, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.princess, { key = 'lilithtower_main_s16_climb_1', bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'lb', scale = 2 })

	if not self.is_enemy_appear then
		return
	end

	self.is_attack_screenplay = true
	self:change_princess_state(princess_spider_appear_attack_state(self, self.princess))
end

function local_class:enemy_update(dt)
	self:enemy_action(dt)
	self:enemy_state_update(dt)
end

function local_class:enemy_action(delta)
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
		if enemy.state == self.enemy_state.chase then
			enemy.fo.Position = enemy.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, self.enemy_speed * delta)

			if enemy.fo.Position.z - self.guardian.Position.z <= 0.5 then
				self:die(enemy.fo)
				break
			end
		elseif enemy.state == self.enemy_state.fast_chase then
			enemy.fo.Position = enemy.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, self.enemy_fast_speed * delta)

			if enemy.fo.Position.z - self.guardian.Position.z <= 0.5 then
				self:die(enemy.fo)
				break
			end
		elseif enemy.state == self.enemy_state.fall then
			enemy.fo.Position = enemy.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, self.enemy_fall_speed * delta)
			if enemy.fo.Position.z > self.dead_line then
				enemy.state = self.enemy_state.dead
				enemy.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		elseif enemy.state == self.enemy_state.appear then
			if enemy.fo.Position.z - self.guardian.Position.z <= 0.5 then
				self:die(enemy.fo)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enemy_state_update(dt)
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
		if enemy.state == self.enemy_state.stun then
			enemy.duration = enemy.duration - dt

			if enemy.duration < 0 then
				enemy.state = self.enemy_state.chase
				character_util.remove_anim(enemy.fo)
				character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, { name = 'walk' })
			end
		end
	end
end

--region camera
function local_class:camera_update()
	local user_x = self.guardian.Position.x
	local user_z = self.guardian.Position.z

	-- 카메라
	local x = -((self.map_offset.x + self.guardian_offset.x) - user_x) / 2
	local z = -((self.map_offset.z + self.guardian_offset.z) - user_z)
	local pos = vector(x, 0, z)

	-- 카메라가 마지막 쯤에 다다르면, 더 이상 이동하지 않고 멈춘채로 캐릭터가 카메라 앞쪽으로 오게끔 함.
	pos.z = math.max(pos.z, -(self.max_climb_height - 1.5))
	self.camera.localPosition = pos + self.camera_offset

	local rot = self.camera.localRotation
	rot.z = -(500 - user_x) / 33
	self.camera.localRotation = rot
end

function local_class:camera_shake_async(magnitude, duration)
	self:camera_shake_stop()
	local req_id = self.camera_shake_req_id

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()

	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = true

	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	while req_id == self.camera_shake_req_id and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if shake_calculator.IsActive then
			shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			self.camera_shake_offset.localPosition = shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.camera_shake_offset.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:camera_shake(magnitude, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camera_shake_async, self, magnitude, duration))
end

function local_class:camera_shake_stop()
	self.camera_shake_req_id = self.camera_shake_req_id + 1
end

--region util
function local_class:check_collision(bounds, position)
	if position.x >= bounds.min.x and  position.x <= bounds.max.x
		and position.z >= bounds.min.z and position.z <= bounds.max.z then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_collision_bounds(bounds1, bounds2)
	if bounds2.min.x <= bounds1.max.x and  bounds2.max.x >= bounds1.min.x
		and bounds2.min.z <= bounds1.max.z and  bounds2.max.z >= bounds1.min.z then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_parabola_position(position, start_position, end_position, height, time_passed, duration)
	local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * (time_passed / duration)) * height
	position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, (time_passed / duration))
	position = position + vector(0, y, 0)
	return position
end

--region screenplay
function local_class:die(enemy)
	if self.walk_robot_sfx then
		self.walk_robot_sfx:Stop()
		self.walk_robot_sfx = nil
	end

	self:change_guardian_state(guardian_dead_state(self, self.guardian))
	self:change_princess_state(princess_dead_state(self, self.princess))
	character_util.stop(self.guardian)

	local duration = 0.5
	local height = 1
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
		if enemy.state == self.enemy_state.chase then
			local direction = (self.guardian.Position - enemy.fo.Position)
			local force = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(direction.magnitude < 1, direction.magnitude, 1)
			local position = enemy.fo.Position + direction.normalized * force

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_robot_03')
			character_util.stop(enemy.fo)
			character_util.move_to(enemy.fo, position, duration)
			character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
			character_util.jump(enemy.fo, height, duration)
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_robot_03')

	self:game_over()
end

function local_class:game_over()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
	self:reset_game()
	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
end

function local_class:user_fall()
	self:change_guardian_state(guardian_fall_state(self, self.guardian))
	self:change_princess_state(princess_fall_state(self, self.princess))
end

function local_class:princess_away()
	if self.walk_robot_sfx then
		self.walk_robot_sfx:Stop()
		self.walk_robot_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_02')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camera_shake, self, 0.1, 0.25))
	character_util.set_emotion(self.guardian, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, {name = 'surprise'})
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local away_direction = 'left'
	if self.guardian.Position.x < 500 then
		away_direction = 'right'
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	self.is_qte_start = true
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(away_direction)
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.3, 'princess_away')

	local princess_y_offset = 0.3
	local princess_start_position = self.princess.Position
	local princess_end_position = self.princess.Position
	if away_direction == 'left' then
		princess_end_position = princess_end_position + vector(-1.5, -princess_y_offset, 0)
	else
		princess_end_position = princess_end_position + vector(1.5, -princess_y_offset, 0)
	end
	local princess_time_passed = 0
	local princess_height = 0.5
	local duration = 2
	local catch_success = false

	-- 공주가 날아감
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.princess, 360, duration)
	while princess_time_passed < duration do
		self.princess.Position = self:get_parabola_position(self.princess.Position, princess_start_position, princess_end_position, princess_height, princess_time_passed, duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		princess_time_passed = princess_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.swipe_type == away_direction then
			catch_success = true
			break
		end
	end

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('princess_away')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	self.is_qte_start = false
	self.swipe_type = ''

	if catch_success == true then
		-- 가디언이 공주를 붙잡기 위해 점프
		local guardian_start_position = self.guardian.Position
		local guardian_end_position = self.guardian.Position
		if away_direction == 'left' then
			guardian_end_position = guardian_end_position + vector(-1.5, -princess_y_offset, 0)
		else
			guardian_end_position = guardian_end_position + vector(1.5, -princess_y_offset, 0)
		end
		local guardian_time_passed = 0
		local guardian_height = 1
		local is_play_princess_catch_sfx = false

		character_util.set_emotion(self.guardian, { name = 'attack' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(4, 'princess_away')
		while guardian_time_passed < duration do
			self.guardian.Position = self:get_parabola_position(self.guardian.Position, guardian_start_position, guardian_end_position, guardian_height, guardian_time_passed, duration)
			self:camera_update()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
			guardian_time_passed = guardian_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if guardian_time_passed >= princess_time_passed then
				if not is_play_princess_catch_sfx then
					is_play_princess_catch_sfx = true
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
				end

				self.princess.Position = self:get_parabola_position(self.princess.Position, princess_start_position, princess_end_position + vector(0, princess_y_offset, 0), princess_height, princess_time_passed, duration)
				princess_time_passed = princess_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end
		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('princess_away')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
		self:change_princess_state(princess_thanks_state(self, self.princess))
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.guardian)

		self.walk_robot_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 3, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

		character_util.stop(self.guardian)
		if away_direction == 'left' then
			character_util.move_to(self.princess, self.princess.Position + vector(-20, 0, 50), 1.4)
		else
			character_util.move_to(self.princess, self.princess.Position + vector(20, 0, 50), 1.4)
		end
		character_util.spine_rotate(self.princess, 360 * 10, 3)
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		self:game_over()
	end

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('princess_away')
end

function local_class:start_hit_window()
	character_util.set_emotion(self.guardian, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.princess, { name = 'attack' })

	self:change_guardian_state(guardian_hit_window_state(self, self.guardian))

	local min_distance = 99999
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
		enemy.state = self.enemy_state.fast_chase

		-- 적과 플레이어 간의 최단 거리를 구함.
		local distance = math.abs(enemy.fo.Position.z - self.guardian.Position.z)
		if distance < min_distance then
			min_distance = distance
		end
	end

	-- 거미들이 n초면 플레이어가 있는 꼭대기까지 도달하도록 속도 설정
	self.enemy_fast_speed = -min_distance / 5

	-- 대신, 거미와 플레이어 사이에 거리가 얼마 벌어져있지 않아서, 새로 설정한 속도가 기존 속도보다 느리면
	-- 그냥 기존 속도로 설정해줌.
	if self.enemy_fast_speed > self.enemy_speed then
		self.enemy_fast_speed = self.enemy_speed
	end

	-- 새로 설정한 속도에 맞춰서, 거미들의 걷는 속도를 그에 맞게끔 조절
	local animation_scale = self.enemy_speed / self.enemy_fast_speed
	if animation_scale > 1 then
		for _, enemy in ipairs(self.enemy_list) do
			character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, { name = 'walk', scale = animation_scale })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:appear_spider()
	self:appear_enemy()
end
--endregion

--region event
function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_qte_start then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.swipe_type = 'left'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.swipe_type = 'right'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.swipe_type = 'up'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.swipe_type = 'down'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
			self.swipe_type = 'tap'
			self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
			return true
		end
	else
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
			if not self:is_princess_attacking() and not self:is_princess_screenplay() then
				self:change_princess_state(princess_attack_state(self, self.princess))
				return true
			end
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.CustomFunction1TouchDown then
			if not self:is_princess_attacking() and not self:is_princess_screenplay() then
				self:change_princess_state(princess_attack_state(self, self.princess))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.guardian) then
			if not self.is_enemy_appear and e.Zone.Name == 'climb_mini_game_appear_spider' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.appear_spider, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'climb_mini_game_fire_sfx' then
				self.fire_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'default' })
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--region rotate_effect
-- 이리저리 회전하는 카메라에 맞춰, 지속적으로 회전시켜줄 이펙트를 등록한다.
function local_class:add_rotate_effect_list(effect, rotation)
	if self:is_contained_rotate_effect(effect) then
		return
	end

	local effect_data = {
		effect = effect,
		rotation = rotation
	}
	table.insert(self.rotate_effect_list, effect_data)

	-- rotate_effect_list_update_routine랑 호출 순서가 엇갈릴 수 있으므로, 최초에 등록 될 때 한번 카메라에 맞춰서 회전시켜 준다.
	effect.transform.localRotation = effect.transform.localRotation * rotation

	if #self.rotate_effect_list == 1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_effect_list_update_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:is_contained_rotate_effect(effect)
	for i = #self.rotate_effect_list, 1, -1 do
		local effect_data = self.rotate_effect_list[i]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(effect_data.effect, effect) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:remove_rotate_effect_list(effect)
	for i = #self.rotate_effect_list, 1, -1 do
		local effect_data = self.rotate_effect_list[i]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(effect_data.effect, effect) then
			table.remove(self.rotate_effect_list, i)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:rotate_effect_list_update_routine()
	while #self.rotate_effect_list > 0 do
		for i = #self.rotate_effect_list, 1, -1 do
			local effect_data = self.rotate_effect_list[i]
			local effect = effect_data.effect
			local rotation = effect_data.rotation

			-- 생명 주기가 끝났으면, list 에서 삭제함
			if not effect.gameObject.activeSelf then
				table.remove(self.rotate_effect_list, i)
			end

			effect.transform.localRotation = effect.transform.localRotation * rotation
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end
--endregion

-- FIXME: Stripping 으로 인해 새로 추가한 함수 호출이 되지 않아서 루아로 임시 땜빵. v2.23 이후 수정 해야함.
function local_class:set_text_adaptive(msg, screen_position, max_width, text_size, angle, text_color)
	max_width = lua_helper.get_or_default(max_width, 300)
	text_size = lua_helper.get_or_default(text_size, 25)

	self.distance_checker:SetText(msg, screen_position, max_width, text_size, 0, text_color)
	self.distance_checker.transform.eulerAngles = lua_helper.get_or_default(angle, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	if self.distance_checker_background == nil then
		self.distance_checker_background = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.distance_checker.transform, 'bg'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomFilledSprite))
	end

	self.distance_checker_background.Size = vector(max_width, self.distance_checker_background.Size.y)
	self.distance_checker_background:Rebuild(true)
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ClimbMiniGameFallManager')

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	self.fall_list = {}
	self.obstacle_list = {}
	self.trap_list = {
		cracked = {},
		broken = {},
		activated = false
	}

	-- 낙하물 상태
	self.fall_state = {
		sleep = 0,
		awake = 1,
		fall = 2,
		fall2 = 3, -- 거미랑 부딫친 후 궤도 수정
		disappear = 4
	}

	-- 물체가 보이는 최대 거리
	self.max_distance = 10

	-- 낙하물 회전 속도
	self.rot_speed = 720
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil

	self.fall_list = nil
	self.obstacle_list = nil
	self.trap_list = nil
end

function local_class:init_manager(mini_game_controller)
	self.controller = mini_game_controller

	-- 알파 레이어 뒤에 있는 이팩트는 제거 되도록 거리 조절
	-- FIXME : ClimbMiniGame에 해당 변수 추가 되면 거기서 가지고 오도록 수정 필요
	--local alpha_layer = self.controller.camera.transform:Find('lilithtower_climb_glow')
	--if alpha_layer ~= nil then
	--	local mesh = alpha_layer:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
	--	-- 여유거리 bounds.extents.z 만큼 추가
	--	self.max_distance = (mesh.bounds.center.z + mesh.bounds.size.z) - self.controller.guardian.Position.z
	--end

	self:init_fall_object()
end

function local_class:init_fall_object()
	local constants_data = self.controller.constants_data

	local zone = field:GetZone(constants_data.zone)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, zone.Bounds)

	-- 금이 간 유리창
	local idx = 1
	while true do
		local window_broken = get_field_object('window_broken_' .. idx)
		if window_broken == nil then
			break
		end

		table.insert(constants_data.obstacle_list, window_broken.Name)

		local window_crack = get_field_object('window_crack_' .. idx)
		if window_crack ~= nil then
			-- 핸들 네임 이름도 일시적으로 추가해서 검색 가능하도록

			local trap = {}
			trap.fo = window_crack
			trap.init_position = window_broken.Position
			table.insert(self.trap_list.cracked, trap)
			table.insert(self.trap_list.broken, window_broken)
		end
		idx = idx + 1
	end

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		-- 낙하물
		for k, _ in pairs(constants_data.fall_list) do
			if fo.Name == k then
				local fall = {}
				fall.fo = fo
				fall.init_position = fo.Position + vector(0, 0.25, 0)
				fall.init_scale = fo.transform.localScale
				fall.hit_player = false
				table.insert(self.fall_list, fall)
				break
			end
		end

		-- 깨진 창문
		for _, v in ipairs(constants_data.obstacle_list) do
			if fo.Name == v then
				local obstacle = {}
				obstacle.fo = fo
				obstacle.init_position = fo.Position
				obstacle.fire = fo.transform:GetChild(0)
				obstacle.sfx = nil
				table.insert(self.obstacle_list, obstacle)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	self:fall_action(dt)
	self:trap_action(dt)
	self:fire_effect_action(dt)
end

function local_class:fall_action(dt)
	for _, fall in ipairs(self.fall_list) do
		-- 주인공이 다가오면 작동
		if fall.state == self.fall_state.sleep then
			local trigger_z = fall.fo.Bounds.max.z + 2.5
			if fall.fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled')
					and self.controller.guardian.Position.z < trigger_z then
				local fall_start = function()
					fall.state = self.fall_state.awake

					self.controller.get_window_break_effect_pool():Instantiate(fall.fo.Bounds.center)

					local pos = vector(fall.fo.Bounds.center.x, fall.fo.Position.y - 0.25, self.controller.guardian.Position.z - 1)
					local warning_fx = self.controller.get_warning_line():Instantiate(pos)

					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_siren_loop_04', loop = false, play_pos = fall.fo.Position })
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_glass_01', loop = false, play_pos = fall.fo.Position })
					wait_for_sec(2)

					warning_fx:Dispose()

					fall.fo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
					fall.state = self.fall_state.fall

					local fall_sfx = self.controller.constants_data.fall_list[fall.fo.Name].sfx
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = fall_sfx, loop = false, play_pos = fall.fo.Position })
				end
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(fall_start, self))
			end
			-- 낙하
		elseif fall.state == self.fall_state.fall then
			fall.fo.Position = fall.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, dt * 6)

			-- 카매라를 기준으로
			local distance = math.abs(fall.fo.Position.z - self.controller.camera.position.z)
			local progress = distance / self.max_distance
			if progress > 1 then
				progress = 1
			end
			local scale = 1 - progress
			fall.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale

			-- 물체 회전
			fall.fo.transform:Rotate(vector(1, 1, -1), self.rot_speed * dt)

			-- 충돌 체크
			if fall.fo.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then

				local destroy_fall_obj = function(explosion_sfx, target)
					local effect_name = self.controller.constants_data.fall_list[fall.fo.Name].effect
					local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(fall.fo.Bounds.center)

					effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale

					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = explosion_sfx, loop = false, parent = target })

					fall.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
					fall.state = self.fall_state.disappear
				end

				-- 가디언과 충돌하면 가디언 추락시킴
				if self.controller:is_guardian_falling() and not fall.hit_player
						and self.controller:check_collision_bounds(fall.fo.Bounds, self.controller.guardian.Bounds) == true then
					fall.hit_player = true
					self.controller:user_fall()
					destroy_fall_obj('02_explosion_02', self.controller.guardian)
				end

				-- 거미와 충돌하면 폭파
				if fall.state ~= self.fall_state.disappear then
					for _, enemy in ipairs(self.controller.enemy_list) do
						if enemy.fo.ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
								and self.controller:check_collision_bounds(fall.fo.Bounds, enemy.fo.Bounds) == true then
							self.controller:stun_enemy(enemy)
							destroy_fall_obj('02_explosion_01', enemy.fo)
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- 일정 거리 이상 떨어지면 사라짐
			if math.abs(fall.fo.Position.z - self.controller.camera.position.z) >= self.max_distance then
				fall.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				fall.state = self.fall_state.disappear
			end
			-- 가구가 거미에게 부딫쳐서 튕겨 날아가는 경우 (안 쓰지만 일단 남겨 둠)
		elseif fall.state == self.fall_state.fall2 then
			fall.fo.Position = fall.fo.Position + vector(0, dt * 3, dt * 10)

			-- 카매라를 기준으로
			local distance = (fall.fo.Position - self.controller.camera.position).magnitude
			local progress = distance / self.max_distance
			if progress > 1 then
				progress = 1
			end
			local scale = 1 - progress
			fall.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale

			local r = fall.fo.transform.localRotation
			r.z = r.z + dt * 5
			fall.fo.transform.localRotation = r

			-- 일정 거리 이상 떨어지면 사라짐
			if math.abs(fall.fo.Position.z - self.controller.camera.position.z) >= self.max_distance then
				fall.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				fall.state = self.fall_state.disappear
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:trap_action(dt)
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.trap_list.cracked) do
		-- 주인공이 밟으면 작동
		if self.trap_list.cracked[i].fo.ActiveState == active_state('visible') then
			if self.controller:is_guardian_falling() then
				if self.controller:check_collision(self.trap_list.cracked[i].fo.Bounds, self.controller.guardian.Position) then
					self.controller.get_window_break_effect_pool():Instantiate(self.trap_list.cracked[i].fo.Position)
					self.controller:user_fall()

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_window_01')

					self.trap_list.broken[i].ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
					self.trap_list.cracked[i].fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fire_effect_action(dt)
	-- 거리에 따른 크기 조정
	for _, v in ipairs(self.obstacle_list) do
		if v.fo.ActiveState ~= active_state('disabled') then
			local magnitude = (v.fo.Position - self.controller.camera.position).magnitude
			local progress = magnitude / self.max_distance
			local is_clear = self.controller.climb_height > self.controller.max_climb_height

			if magnitude < 3.9 and not is_clear then
				if v.sfx == nil then
					v.sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
						sfx_name = '01_fire_05', loop = true, play_pos = v.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
						min_distance = 1, max_distance = 4, fade_in_time = 2
					})
				end
			elseif magnitude >= 3.9 or is_clear then
				if v.sfx ~= nil then
					v.sfx:Stop()
					v.sfx = nil
				end
			end

			if progress > 1 then
				progress = 1
			end
			local scale = 1 - progress

			if scale <= 0 then
				v.fire.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			else
				v.fire.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				v.fire.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale
			end
		else
			if v.fire.gameObject.activeSelf then
				v.fire.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:reset_fall_object()
	-- 낙하물 배치
	for _, fall in ipairs(self.fall_list) do
		fall.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		fall.fo.Position = fall.init_position
		fall.fo.transform.localScale = fall.init_scale
		fall.hit_player = false
		fall.state = self.fall_state.sleep
	end

	-- 깨진 유리창 배치
	for _, obstacle in ipairs(self.obstacle_list) do
		obstacle.fo.Position = obstacle.init_position
		obstacle.active_state = active_state('visible')
		if obstacle.sfx ~= nil then
			obstacle.sfx:Stop()
			obstacle.sfx = nil
		end
	end

	-- 금이 간 유리창 배치
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.trap_list.cracked) do
		self.trap_list.cracked[i].fo.Position = self.trap_list.cracked[i].init_position
		self.trap_list.cracked[i].fo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
		self.trap_list.broken[i].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

--region get
function local_class:get_fall_list()
	return self.fall_list
end

function local_class:get_obstacle_list()
	return self.obstacle_list
end

function local_class:get_trap_list()
	return self.trap_list
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	self.shaker = {
		--[[
			[id]: count
		]]
		slimes = {
			-- 빨강
			[1] = 0,
			-- 보라
			[2] = 0,
			-- 노랑
			[3] = 0,
			-- 파랑
			[4] = 0,
		},

		has_ice_ingredient = false,

		]]
		add_slime = function(self, slime_id)
			if slime_id < 1 or slime_id > 4 then
				logger_util.error('Given ingredient doesn\'t exist')
				return
			end

			local current_value = self.slimes[slime_id]
			self.slimes[slime_id] = current_value + 1
		end,

		switch_fruit_selection_state = function(self)
			self.has_fruit_ingredient = not self.has_fruit_ingredient
		end,

		switch_ice_selection_state = function(self)
			self.has_ice_ingredient = not self.has_ice_ingredient
		end,

		get_content = function(self)
			return {
				slimes = self.slimes,
				has_fruit_ingredient = self.has_fruit_ingredient,
				has_ice_ingredient = self.has_ice_ingredient,
			}
		end,

		has_sub_ingredient = function(self)
			return self.has_fruit_ingredient or self.has_ice_ingredient
		end,

		has_content = function(self)
			for _, v in ipairs(self.slimes) do
				if v > 0 then
					return true
				end
			end

			return self.has_fruit_ingredient or self.has_ice_ingredient
		end,

		reset = function(self)
			self.slimes = nil
			self.slimes = {
				[1] = 0,
				[2] = 0,
				[3] = 0,
				[4] = 0,
			}

			else
				self.current_slime_coin = constants_manager.get_max_slime_coins()
			end

			self.total_earned_from_this_stage = self.total_earned_from_this_stage + coins
		end,

		reset = function(self)
			self.num_got_customers = 0
			self.current_slime_coin = 0
			self.total_earned_from_this_stage = 0
			self.total_succeed_order = 0
			self.total_failed_order = 0
		end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	-- 스테이지 아이디 정보 등록
	constants_manager.set_constants_data_key(key)

	-- 유저 등급 갱신
	self.current_user_data.grade = constants_manager.get_user_grade_in_number()

	-- 유저 저장 데이터 로드
	self:load_user_data()

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 이펙트 로드
	quest_util.load_pool_resource('fx_dai_cocktail_get', 'FX_reward')

	-- 상수 데이터 키 세팅
	self.current_stage_data = constants_manager.get_current_stage_data()
	self.play_time = self.current_stage_data.play_time
	self.prev_time = self.play_time + 1

	-- 손님 리스트를 생성
	self.customer_spec_list = self:generate_customer_queue(self.current_stage_data)

	-- UI들 초기화
	if self.main_ui:is_loaded() then
		self.main_ui.controller:ResetUI()
	else
		self:load_main_ui()
		self:set_main_ui_button_callbacks()
	end

	self:load_recipe_ui()
	self:load_result_ui()

    if self:is_able_to_add_sub_ingredient() then
        self.main_ui.controller:SetLeftSubButtonActive(true)
        self.main_ui.controller:SetRightSubButtonActive(true)
    end

	local character_specs = self:convert_customer_specs_to_character_spec(self.customer_spec_list)
	yield_return_func(self.main_ui.controller.InitCustomers, self.main_ui.controller, character_specs)

	-- 모든 손님들을 잠시 투명하게 만들어놓는다.
	local customers = self.main_ui.controller.Customers
	for i = 0, customers.Length - 1 do
        customers[i]:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
    end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if (self.current_user_data.grade == 1) then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music(
				{ state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/short_story_dai/audio:bgm_dai_cocktail', volume = 0.4 })
	end


	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 게임 상태 변경
	if (self.current_user_data.grade == 1) then
		self:translate_game_state(game_states.tutorial_state(self))
	else
		self:translate_game_state(game_states.entry_state(self))
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if load_end_callback ~= nil then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.is_playing_game = false

	self:game_end()

	if self.main_ui ~= nil then
		self.main_ui:dispose()
	end

	if self.recipe_ui_prefab ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.recipe_ui_prefab)
		self.recipe_ui_prefab = nil
	end

	if self.result_ui_prefab ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.result_ui_prefab)
		self.result_ui_prefab = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:game_end()
	self.current_user_data:reset()
	self.shaker:reset()
	self:set_active_field_ui_part(true)
	self.num_customers_in_queue = 4
	self.current_customer_idx = 1
	self.customer_spec_list = nil
	self.enable_open_recipe = false
end

function local_class:is_time_over()
	return self.play_time <= 0
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self:set_active_field_ui_part(false)

	-- 미니 게임은 동시에 하나만 동작해야 한다.
	if self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	self.main_ui.controller:SetTimerLabel(math.floor(self.play_time))
	self.main_ui.controller:SetSlimePoint(self.current_user_data.total_earned_from_this_stage)

	self.is_playing_game = true

	start_coroutine(self.update_internal, self)
end

function local_class:update_internal()
	while self.is_playing_game do

		self.current_game_state:update()
		self:update_timer()

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_playing_game = false
end

function local_class:save_user_data()
	local data_storage_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.data_storage_id)
	local user_slime_coins = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.current_user_data.current_slime_coin, 0)

	local max_slime_coins = 300000
	local max_promotion_fail_count = 30

	user_slime_coins = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(user_slime_coins > max_slime_coins,
			max_slime_coins / 10,
			user_slime_coins / 10)

	quest_util.set_custom_state(data_storage_progress, self.custom_data_key.user_coins, user_slime_coins)
end

function local_class:load_user_data()
	if self.current_user_data == nil then
		return
	end

	local data_storage_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.data_storage_id)
	local user_coin = quest_util.get_custom_state(data_storage_progress, self.custom_data_key.user_coins)

	-- 유저가 소지한 슬라임 코인 금액
	if user_coin ~= -1 then
		self.current_user_data.current_slime_coin = (user_coin  * 10)
	end
end

function local_class:convert_customer_specs_to_character_spec(customer_specs)
	local character_specs = {}

	for i = 1, #customer_specs do
		table.insert(character_specs, self:convert_customer_spec_to_character_spec(customer_specs[i]))
	end

	return character_specs
end

function local_class:convert_customer_spec_to_character_spec(customer_spec)
	return CS.Oak.CharacterSpec.GetByName(customer_spec.sprite_name)
end

function local_class:create_random_customer_spec(stage_data, customer_spine_data)
	-- 손님 스펙 생성
	local customer_spec = self:create_empty_custom_spec()
	self:set_customer_spec_random_data(customer_spec, stage_data, customer_spine_data)

	-- 먼저 레시피 칵테일만 요구할 것인지 확인
	-- 트롤링 손님의 경우도 바로 리턴한다.
	if customer_spec.type == 1 then
		return customer_spec
	end

	-- 서브 재료를 1개만 요구하는지 확인
	if customer_spec.type == 2 then
		-- 반반 확률
		local temp = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 1)
		if temp <= 0.5 then
			-- 과일
			customer_spec.need_fruit_ingredient = true
		else
			-- 얼음
			customer_spec.need_ice_ingredient = true
		end
		return customer_spec
	end

	-- 서브 재료를 2개 전부 요구
	customer_spec.need_fruit_ingredient = true
	customer_spec.need_ice_ingredient = true

	return customer_spec
end

function local_class:create_random_customer_spec_ver2(customer_spine_data)
	local customer_spec             = self:create_empty_custom_spec()
	customer_spec.type              = 1
	customer_spec.sprite_name       = customer_spine_data
	customer_spec.need_cocktail_id  = constants_manager.get_random_recipe()

	return customer_spec
end

function local_class:draw_sub_ing(customer_spec)
	-- 반반 확률
	local temp = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 1)
	if temp <= 0.5 then
		-- 과일
		customer_spec.need_fruit_ingredient = true
	else
		-- 얼음
		customer_spec.need_ice_ingredient = true
	end
end

	customer_spec.order_random_text = nil
	customer_spec.need_cocktail_id  = nil
	customer_spec.need_fruit_ingredient = false
	customer_spec.need_ice_ingredient   = false

function local_class:draw_customer_ids_for_making_order_with_sub_ing()
	local cur_stage_data = constants_manager.get_current_stage_data()
	local num_customer_asking_only_cocktail = constants_manager.get_num_customer_asking_only_cocktail()
	local remainder = cur_stage_data.customer_random_list - num_customer_asking_only_cocktail

	local percent_asking_only_one_sub_ing = cur_stage_data.customer_random_persent_type_1
	local percent_asking_both_sub_ings = cur_stage_data.customer_random_persent_type_2
	local maximum = percent_asking_only_one_sub_ing + percent_asking_both_sub_ings

	local num_customers_asking_only_one_sub_ing = remainder * (percent_asking_only_one_sub_ing / maximum)
	local num_customers_asking_both_sub_ings = remainder - num_customers_asking_only_one_sub_ing

	local customer_id_list = {}

	for i = 1, cur_stage_data.customer_random_list do
		table.insert(customer_id_list, i)
	end

	local random_index_drawing_rule = {
		count = num_customers_asking_only_one_sub_ing,
		overlap = false
	}
	local customer_type_2_id_list, remained_customer_ids = random_util.get_values_in_array(customer_id_list, random_index_drawing_rule)
	random_index_drawing_rule.count = num_customers_asking_both_sub_ings
	local customer_type_3_id_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(customer_id_list, random_index_drawing_rule)

	return customer_type_2_id_list, customer_type_3_id_list
end

function local_class:draw_customer_ids_type_2(cur_stage_data, customer_id_list)
	if cur_stage_data == nil or customer_id_list == nil or #customer_id_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	local remainder = constants_manager.get_num_customer_asking_sub_ings()
	local total_percent_asking_sub_ings = constants_manager.get_total_percentage_customer_asking_sub_ings()
	local percent_customer_type_2 = cur_stage_data.customer_random_persent_type_1
	local random_index_drawing_rule = {
		count = remainder * (percent_customer_type_2 / total_percent_asking_sub_ings),
		overlap = false
	}

	return random_util.get_values_in_array(customer_id_list, random_index_drawing_rule)
end

function local_class:draw_customer_ids_type_3(cur_stage_data, customer_id_list)
	if cur_stage_data == nil or customer_id_list == nil or #customer_id_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	local remainder = constants_manager.get_num_customer_asking_sub_ings()
	local total_percent_asking_sub_ings = constants_manager.get_total_percentage_customer_asking_sub_ings()
	local percent_customer_type_3 = cur_stage_data.customer_random_persent_type_2
	local random_index_drawing_rule = {
		count = remainder * (percent_customer_type_3 / total_percent_asking_sub_ings),
		overlap = false
	}
	return random_util.get_values_in_array(customer_id_list, random_index_drawing_rule)
end

function local_class:set_customer_spec_random_data(customer_spec, stage_data, spine_data)
	-- 메인 재료 없이 칵테일만 요구하는지 구하는 함수
	local function is_requesting_only_cocktail(stage_data)
		local random_val = unity_class.random.Range(0, 100)
		return random_val <= stage_data.customer_random_persent_type_0
	end

	-- 메인 재료를 한 개만 요구하는지 구하는 함수
	local function is_requesting_cocktail_with_single_main_ingredient(stage_data)
		local max_range = stage_data.customer_random_persent_type_1
						+ stage_data.customer_random_persent_type_2
		local random_val = unity_class.random.Range(0, max_range)
		return random_val <= stage_data.customer_random_persent_type_1
	end

	local function generate_random_customer_type()
		-- 칵테일만 요구하는 타입
		if is_requesting_only_cocktail(stage_data) then
			return 1
		end

		-- 칵테일과 서브 재료 1개 요구하는 타입
		if is_requesting_cocktail_with_single_main_ingredient(stage_data) then
			return 2
		end

		-- 칵테일과 서브 재료 2개 요구하는 타입
		return 3
	end

	customer_spec.type              = generate_random_customer_type()
	customer_spec.sprite_name       = spine_data
	customer_spec.order_random_text = constants_manager.get_order_random_string_key_by_customer_type(customer_spec.type)
	customer_spec.need_cocktail_id  = constants_manager.get_random_recipe()
end


function local_class:generate_customer_queue(stage_data)
	if stage_data == nil then
		logger_util.error('CocktailMiniGame: Current Stage Data was nil')
		return
	end

	local customer_queue = {}
	local customer_id_list = {}

	for i = 1, stage_data.customer_random_list do
		table.insert(customer_id_list, i)
	end

	-- 중복되지 않는 손님 스파인 리스트를 생성한다.
	local customer_spine_data = constants_manager.generate_non_overlapped_customer_sprite_list()
	local non_overlapped_order_is_list = constants_manager.generate_non_overlapped_order_id_list(stage_data.customer_random_list)
	local customer_type_2_id_list, remained = self:draw_customer_ids_type_2(stage_data, customer_id_list)
	local customer_type_3_id_list = self:draw_customer_ids_type_2(stage_data, remained)
	if customer_type_2_id_list == nil or customer_type_3_id_list == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 기본 세팅
	for i = 1, stage_data.customer_random_list do
		local customer_spec = self:create_random_customer_spec_ver2(customer_spine_data[i])
		customer_spec.need_cocktail_id = non_overlapped_order_is_list[i]
		table.insert(customer_queue, customer_spec)
	end

	-- 부재료 1개 요구하는 손님 세팅
	for i = 1, #customer_type_2_id_list do
		local customer_spec = customer_queue[customer_type_2_id_list[i]]
		customer_spec.type = 2
		customer_spec.order_random_text
			= constants_manager.get_order_random_string_key_by_customer_type(customer_spec.type)
		self:draw_sub_ing(customer_spec)
	end

	-- 부재료 2개 요구하는 손님 세팅
	for i = 1, #customer_type_3_id_list do
		local customer_spec = customer_queue[customer_type_3_id_list[i]]
		customer_spec.type = 3

		-- 서브 재료를 2개 전부 요구
		customer_spec.need_fruit_ingredient = true
		customer_spec.need_ice_ingredient = true
	end

	-- 대사 세팅
	for i = 1, #customer_queue do
		local customer_spec = customer_queue[i]
		customer_spec.order_random_text
			= constants_manager.get_order_random_string_key_by_customer_type(customer_spec.type)
	end

	-- 트롤링 하는 손님들을 배치
	local num_trollers = constants_manager.get_current_stage_data().special_customer_number
	self:place_trolling_customer(customer_queue, num_trollers)

	return customer_queue
end

function local_class:place_trolling_customer(customer_spec_list, num_trolling_customers)
	local index_array = {}

	for i = 1, #customer_spec_list do
		table.insert(index_array, i)
	end

	local random_indexes = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_array,
	{ count = num_trolling_customers, overlap = false })


	local random_order_ids = constants_manager.get_randomed_recipe_id_list()

	if random_indexes == nil or random_order_ids == nil then
		logger_util.error('Failed to place trolling customers. Something went wrong')
		return
	end

	local max_troller_nums = constants_manager.get_max_special_customer_nums()
	local num_placed = num_trolling_customers > max_troller_nums and max_troller_nums or num_trolling_customers

	for i = 1, num_placed do
		local customer_spec = customer_spec_list[random_indexes[i]]
		customer_spec.is_troller = true
		customer_spec.need_cocktail_id = random_order_ids[i]
		customer_spec.sprite_name = constants_manager.get_special_customer_sprite_by_id(random_order_ids[i])
		customer_spec.order_random_text = constants_manager.get_troller_string_by_order_id(random_order_ids[i])

function local_class:start_slime_coin_increasing(earned)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_coin_01')

	local current_value = self.current_user_data.total_earned_from_this_stage
	local target_value = current_value + earned
	local increasing_action_count = 10
	local increasing_value_per_once = (target_value - current_value) / increasing_action_count

	while current_value < target_value do
		current_value = current_value + increasing_value_per_once
		self.main_ui.controller:SetSlimePoint(current_value)
		wait_for_sec(0.075)
	end
end

function local_class:update_timer()
	if not self.is_timer_updatable then return end

	self.play_time = self.play_time - unity_class.time.deltaTime

	if (self.prev_time - self.play_time) >= 1 then
		self.main_ui.controller:SetTimerLabel(math.floor(self.play_time))
		self.prev_time = self.play_time
	end
end

--#region 레시피 UI 관련 함수들
function local_class:open_recipe_ui()
	time_util.mod(self.game_name, 0)

	local recipe_list = constants_manager.get_recipe_list()

	local recipe_item_data_list = {}
	for i = 1, #recipe_list do
		table.insert(recipe_item_data_list, self:convert_recipe_to_cocktail_recipe_item_data(i, recipe_list[i]))
	end

	-- 칵테일 도감 UI를 열기 위해 상태 생성
	local cocktail_recipe_ui_state = CS.Oak.UI.CocktailRecipeUIState()
	cocktail_recipe_ui_state.RecipeList = recipe_item_data_list
	cocktail_recipe_ui_state.MyRank = self.current_user_data.grade
	cocktail_recipe_ui_state.CloseCb = function()
		time_util.unmod(self.game_name)
		self:set_timer_updatable(true)
	end

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.CocktailRecipeUI.Instance, cocktail_recipe_ui_state)
end

function local_class:evaluate_user_promotion()
	local stage_id = constants_manager.get_user_grade_in_number()
	local minimum_condition = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(stage_id == 1, 300, 1000)
	local base_promotion_condition = constants_manager.get_grade_promotion_conditions()
	local correction_factor = self.count_failed_current_level * 200
	local adjusted_condition = base_promotion_condition - correction_factor
	local actual_condition = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(adjusted_condition < minimum_condition, minimum_condition, adjusted_condition)
	return self.current_user_data.total_earned_from_this_stage >= actual_condition
end

function local_class:open_result_ui()
	local current_user_grade = self.current_user_data.grade
	local is_user_able_to_get_promotion = self:evaluate_user_promotion()

	self:set_user_data_based_on_promotion_status(is_user_able_to_get_promotion)

	self:save_user_data()

	ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()

	self:open_result_popup_ui()

	self:check_user_promotion(is_user_able_to_get_promotion, current_user_grade)
	self:check_recipe_unlock(is_user_able_to_get_promotion, current_user_grade)
	self:check_sub_ingredient_unlock(is_user_able_to_get_promotion, current_user_grade)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 필드 음악으로 돌려준다.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_user_able_to_get_promotion))
end

function local_class:set_user_data_based_on_promotion_status(is_user_able_to_get_promotion)
	if is_user_able_to_get_promotion then
		self.current_user_data.grade = self.current_user_data.grade + 1
		self.current_user_data.count_promotion_failed = 0
		return
	end

	if self.should_evaluate_result_at_the_end then
		self.current_user_data.count_promotion_failed = self.current_user_data.count_promotion_failed + 1
	end
end

function local_class:open_result_popup_ui()
	local keep_waiting = true
	local cocktail_result_popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.CocktailResultPopupState()
	cocktail_result_popup_state.CustomerCount     = self.current_user_data.num_got_customers
	cocktail_result_popup_state.SuccessOrderCount = self.current_user_data.total_succeed_order
	cocktail_result_popup_state.FailOrderCount    = self.current_user_data.total_failed_order
	cocktail_result_popup_state.GetCoinCount      = self.current_user_data.total_earned_from_this_stage
	cocktail_result_popup_state.CurrentCoinCount  = self.current_user_data.current_slime_coin
	cocktail_result_popup_state.CloseCb = function()
		keep_waiting = false
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cvs_01')
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.CocktailResultPopup.Instance, cocktail_result_popup_state)

	while keep_waiting do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
end

function local_class:check_user_promotion(is_able_to_promotion, current_user_grade)
	if not is_able_to_promotion or not self.should_evaluate_result_at_the_end then
		return
	end

	local wait_for_popup = true

	-- 실패한 횟수를 초기화한다.
	self.current_user_data.count_promotion_failed = 0

	local string_key = constants_manager.get_grade_promotion_string_key() .. current_user_grade
	local pop_up_state = CS.Oak.UI.PopUpState()
	pop_up_state.NoticePopUp = true
	pop_up_state.Title = game_string:GetString(constants_manager.get_promotion_popup_title())
	pop_up_state.Text = game_string:GetString(string_key)
	pop_up_state.IsShowFanfareEffect = true
	pop_up_state.SortingOrder = 54
	pop_up_state.OnYesOrNoClicked = function(ok)
		wait_for_popup = false
	end

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.PopUp.Instance, pop_up_state)

	while (wait_for_popup) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
end

	pop_up_state.IsShowFanfareEffect = true
	pop_up_state.SortingOrder = 54

		wait_for_popup = false
	end

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.PopUp.Instance, pop_up_state)

	while (wait_for_popup) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
end
