function local_class:convert_recipe_to_cocktail_recipe_item_data(idx, recipe)
	if recipe == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local recipe_item_data = CS.Oak.UI.CocktailRecipeItemData()
	recipe_item_data.Id = idx
	recipe_item_data.Rank = recipe.unlock_user_grade
	recipe_item_data.CocktailSprite = recipe.cocktail_item_sprite

	local ingredient_data = CS.Oak.UI.CocktailIngredientData()
	ingredient_data.RedSlime = recipe.cocktail_make_material_red
	ingredient_data.PurpleSlime = recipe.cocktail_make_material_purple
	ingredient_data.YellowSlime = recipe.cocktail_make_material_yellow
	ingredient_data.BlueSlime = recipe.cocktail_make_material_blue

	recipe_item_data.IngredientData = ingredient_data

	return recipe_item_data
end

function local_class:generate_speech_bubble(string_key, target_transform, direction, bubble_type, life_time)
	target_transform = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_transform, nil)
	life_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(life_time, -1)
	direction = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleDirection.CenterTop)
	bubble_type = lua_helper.get_or_default(bubble_type, CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleNew.BubbleType.Talk)

	local target
	if target_transform ~= nil then
		target = target_transform
	else
		target = self.main_ui.controller.CustomerSpeechBubbleTransform
	end

	local function determine_bubble_scale_based_on_screen_ratio()
		return CS.ScreenUtil.GetMainGameViewAspectRatio() < 1.34 and 0.8 or 1
	end

	local speech_bubble_param = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleGenerateParam(game_string:GetString(string_key), bubble_type, target)
	speech_bubble_param.DefaultOrthographicSize = 4
	speech_bubble_param.BubbleDirection = direction
	speech_bubble_param.IgnoreAutoLayoutAdjust = true
	speech_bubble_param.FlipTextHorizontal = not CS.Oak.GameStrings.Instance.IsRTL
	speech_bubble_param.Scale = determine_bubble_scale_based_on_screen_ratio()
	speech_bubble_param.TypeSpeed = 0

	if life_time > 0 then
		speech_bubble_param.LifeTime = life_time
	end

	speech_bubble_param.KeepDisplay = life_time < 0

	return speech_bubble_param
end

function local_class:set_sb_param_for_tutorial(speech_bubble_param, screen_position)
	speech_bubble_param.ScreenPosition = screen_position
	speech_bubble_param.Scale = 0.9
	speech_bubble_param.TypeSpeed = 0.05
	speech_bubble_param.ClickToProceed = true
end

function local_class:show_customer_speech_bubble(speech_bubble_param, on_end_cb)
	local speaker_transform = self.main_ui.controller.CustomerSpeechBubbleTransform
	speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubble(speech_bubble_param)

	-- 다른 UI 위로 올라가지 않도록 소팅 오더를 강제로 세팅해줌.
	speech_bubble.instance:Get(speaker_transform):SetDepthLevel(10)

	if on_end_cb ~= nil then
		on_end_cb(speaker_transform)
	end
end

function local_class:show_customer_speech_bubble_async(speech_bubble_param)
	yield_return(speech_bubble.instance, 'ShowSpeechBubbleAsync', speech_bubble_param)
end

function local_class:return_speech_bubble(transform)
	local speech_bubble = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Get(transform)
	if speech_bubble ~= nil then
		speech_bubble:ResetBubble()
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown, vector(0, 0)))
	CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Return(transform)
end

function local_class:show_system_notice(text, mod)
	local stage_title = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('stage_title'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	stage_title.transform.parent        = stage.UIRoot.transform
	stage_title.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
	stage_title.transform.localScale    = unity_class.vector3.one

	stage_title:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIPanel)).sortingOrder = 382
	stage_title:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UIStageTitle)):ShowStageTitle(text, mod, 110)
end

function local_class:format_order_string(cocktail_name_key, customer_spec)
    local cocktail_name = game_string:GetString(cocktail_name_key)

    local fruit_ing_text = customer_spec.need_fruit_ingredient
        and game_string:GetString(constants_manager.get_random_fruit_ingredient_text())
        or nil

    local ice_ing_text = customer_spec.need_ice_ingredient
        and game_string:GetString(constants_manager.get_ice_ingredient_text())
        or nil

    if customer_spec.type == 2 then
        local sub_ing_text

        if fruit_ing_text ~= nil then
            sub_ing_text = fruit_ing_text
        end

        if ice_ing_text ~= nil then
            sub_ing_text = ice_ing_text
        end

        return game_string:Format(customer_spec.order_random_text, cocktail_name, sub_ing_text)
    end

    return game_string:Format(customer_spec.order_random_text, cocktail_name, fruit_ing_text, ice_ing_text)
end


function local_class:set_active_field_ui_part(is_active)
	if is_active then
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
				CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	else
		field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
				CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	end
end

function local_class:is_out_of_customer_spec()
	return self.current_customer_idx > #self.customer_spec_list
end

function local_class:get_current_customer_id()

end

function local_class:get_created_cocktail()
	return self.created_cocktail
end

function local_class:is_able_to_add_sub_ingredient()
	return self.current_user_data.grade > 3
end

function local_class:get_timer_updatable()
	return self.is_timer_updatable
end

function local_class:set_timer_updatable(is_updatable)
	self.is_timer_updatable = is_updatable
end

function local_class:set_recipe_ui_openable()
	self.enable_open_recipe = true
end

function local_class:set_should_evalue_result_at_the_end(should_evaluate)
	self.should_evaluate_result_at_the_end  = should_evaluate
end

function local_class:set_current_level_failed_count(count)
	self.count_failed_current_level = count
end

--#endregion

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local constants_data = require('minigame/CocktailMiniGame/CocktailMiniGameConstants')

local function convert_grade_str_to_int(str_grade)
    local str_to_int_map = {
        ['beginner'] = 1,
        ['apprentice'] = 2,
        ['intermediate'] = 3,
        ['senior'] = 4,
        ['master'] = 5
    }

    return str_to_int_map[str_grade]
end

-- 한번에 화면에 보이는 스파인 종류가 중복되지 않도록 처리한 스파인 리스트 생성
local function generate_non_overlapped_customer_sprite_list()
    local num_customers_this_stage = get_current_stage_data().customer_random_list
    local customer_sprite_data = get_customer_sprite_data()
    local num_customer_spine_data = #customer_sprite_data
    local customer_spine_index_list = {}
    for i = 1, num_customer_spine_data do
        table.insert(customer_spine_index_list, i)
    end

    local randomzied_spine_index_list = { }
    for i = 1, num_customers_this_stage do
        randomzied_spine_index_list[i] = random_util.get_random_int(1, num_customer_spine_data)
    end

    local function remove_if_found(list, value)
        for i = 1, #list do
            if list[i] == value then
                table.remove(list, i)
                return
            end
        end
    end

    local function get_not_overlapped_index(first_val, second_val)
        local cloned_spine_index_list = table_util.duplicate(customer_spine_index_list)

        remove_if_found(cloned_spine_index_list, first_val)
        remove_if_found(cloned_spine_index_list, second_val)

        return random_util.get_values_in_array(cloned_spine_index_list)[1]
    end

    -- 첫 두 스파인이 중복되지 않음을 보장한다.
    -- 이들 먼저 보장하면, 그 뒤에 있는 스파인은 대기열의 마지막(3번째꺼) 스파인만 비교하면 되게 도와준다.
    if randomzied_spine_index_list[1] == randomzied_spine_index_list[2] then
        randomzied_spine_index_list[2] = get_not_overlapped_index(randomzied_spine_index_list[1], randomzied_spine_index_list[2])
    end

    -- 이제 순차적으로 돌면서 중복 되는 인덱스가 발견 되면 마지막 요소를 변경해준다.
    for i = 1, num_customers_this_stage - 2 do
        local is_third_element_overlapped = false

        -- 첫 번째와 세 번쨰가 중복되는지 비교
        if randomzied_spine_index_list[i] == randomzied_spine_index_list[i + 2] then
            is_third_element_overlapped = true
        end

        -- 두 번째와 세 번째가 중복되는지 비교
        if randomzied_spine_index_list[i + 1] == randomzied_spine_index_list[i + 2] then
            is_third_element_overlapped = true
        end

        -- 중복 되었다면, 세 번째 인덱스를 변경해준다.
        if is_third_element_overlapped then
            randomzied_spine_index_list[i + 2] = get_not_overlapped_index(randomzied_spine_index_list[i], randomzied_spine_index_list[i + 1])
        end
    end

    local customer_spine_data = {}
    for i = 1, num_customers_this_stage do
        customer_spine_data[i] = customer_sprite_data[randomzied_spine_index_list[i]]
    end

    return customer_spine_data
end

local function generate_non_overlapped_order_id_list(size)
    local non_overlapped_list = {}

    local available_id_list = get_available_recipe_id_list()
    local pivot = math.tointeger(#available_id_list / 2)
    local first_half, second_half = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_id_list, { count = pivot })
    local grouped_id_list = { first_half, second_half }
    local is_using_first_half = true

    local idx = 1
    while idx <= size do
        local using_grouped_idx_list = table_util.duplicate(grouped_id_list[is_using_first_half and 1 or 2])
        local mixed = random_util.get_values_in_array(using_grouped_idx_list, { count = #using_grouped_idx_list })

        for idx_mixed_list = 1, #mixed do
            non_overlapped_list[idx] = mixed[idx_mixed_list]
            idx = idx + 1
        end

        is_using_first_half = not is_using_first_half
    end

    return non_overlapped_list
end

local function find_cocktail_info_by_contents(contents)
    if contents == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local recipe_list = get_recipe_list()

    local function contains_same_slime_amount(contents, recipe_list)
        return contents.slimes[1] == recipe_list.cocktail_make_material_red
            and contents.slimes[2] == recipe_list.cocktail_make_material_purple
            and contents.slimes[3] == recipe_list.cocktail_make_material_yellow
            and contents.slimes[4] == recipe_list.cocktail_make_material_blue
    end

    local created_info = {}
    created_info.id = -1
    created_info.has_fruit_ing = false
    created_info.has_ice_ing = false

    for i = 1, #recipe_list do
        if contains_same_slime_amount(contents, recipe_list[i]) then
            created_info.id = i
            created_info.has_fruit_ing = contents.has_fruit_ingredient
            created_info.has_ice_ing = contents.has_ice_ingredient
            return created_info
        end
    end

    --TODO: 실패 판정용 칵테일 3개중 랜덤으로 하나 리턴
    return created_info
end

local cocktail_game_state_base = newclass('CocktailMiniGameStateBase')

function cocktail_game_state_base:exit()

function entry_state:init(mini_game_controller)

    start_coroutine(self.start_entry_scene, self):Then(function()

function entry_state:update()
end

end

-- 미니 게임 도입부 연출
function entry_state:start_entry_scene()
    music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/short_story_dai/audio:bgm_dai_cocktail', volume = 1 })
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')

    -- 게임 시작 타이틀을 보여주고
    self:show_start_message_async()

    -- 손님들이 몰려온다.
    self:customers_incoming_async()
end

function entry_state:show_start_message_async()
    local notice_duration = 2

    self.mini_game_controller:show_system_notice(game_string:GetString('short_story_cocktail_game_start'), notice_duration)

    wait_for_sec(notice_duration)
end

function entry_state:customers_incoming_async()
    local ui_controller = self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller()
    local customers = ui_controller.Customers

    local moving_in_duration = 1

    -- 손님들 한 칸씩 뒤로 이동 시키며, 스케일 조금 작게 해놓음.
    local dist_diff = vector(0, 70, 0)
    local scale_diff = vector(50, 50, 50)

    for i = 0, customers.Length - 2 do
        customers[i].SpineContainer.localPosition = customers[i].SpineContainer.localPosition + dist_diff
        customers[i].SpineContainer.localScale = customers[i].SpineContainer.localScale - scale_diff
    end

    -- 처음 좌표와 이동할 좌표 캐싱
    local original_position_list = {}
    local target_position_list = {}

    -- 스케일도 캐싱
    local original_scale_list = {}
    local target_scale_list = {}

    for i = 0, customers.Length - 2 do
        local original_position = customers[i].SpineContainer.localPosition
        local target_position = original_position - dist_diff

        table.insert(original_position_list, original_position)
        table.insert(target_position_list, target_position)

        local original_scale = ui_controller.Customers[i].SpineContainer.localScale
        local target_scale = original_scale + scale_diff

        table.insert(original_scale_list, original_scale)
        table.insert(target_scale_list, target_scale)
    end

    -- 투명도를 없애준다.
    local target_alpha = 1
    for i = 0, customers.Length - 2 do
        customers[i]:SetAlphaFade(target_alpha, moving_in_duration)
    end

    -- 걸어오는 애니메이션 틀어주며
    for  i = 0, customers.Length - 2 do
        customers[i]:SetAnimation('walk')
    end

    -- 손님들 앞으로 이동
    local timer = 0
    while timer <= moving_in_duration do
        timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        local progress = timer / moving_in_duration

        for i = 0, customers.Length - 2 do
            customers[i].SpineContainer.localPosition
                = vector_util.lerp(original_position_list[i + 1], target_position_list[i + 1], progress)

            customers[i].SpineContainer.localScale
                = vector_util.lerp(original_scale_list[i + 1], target_scale_list[i + 1], progress)
        end

        coroutine.yield()
    end

    -- 아이들 애니메이션으로 교체 틀어주며
    for i = 0, customers.Length - 2 do
        customers[i]:SetAnimation('idle')
        customers[i].SpineContainer.localPosition = target_position_list[i + 1]
    end

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_click_worldmap_01')
end

        self.mini_game_controller:translate_game_state(closing_state(self.mini_game_controller))

    local current_customer = self.mini_game_controller:get_current_customer()

    local formatted_string = self.mini_game_controller:format_order_string(cocktail_text_key, current_customer)

      self:play_troller_order_sfx(current_customer.need_cocktail_id)
    end

    local sb = self.mini_game_controller:generate_speech_bubble(formatted_string)
    self.mini_game_controller:show_customer_speech_bubble(sb)

function order_preparing_state:init(mini_game_controller)
    self.super:init(mini_game_controller)

    self.ui_controller = mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller()
    self.ui_controller:SetMakeButtonActive(false)

    if mini_game_controller:is_able_to_add_sub_ingredient() then
        self.ui_controller:SetLeftSubButtonActive(true)
        self.ui_controller:SetRightSubButtonActive(true)

    self:set_ui_button_actions()

    -- 이전 프레임에 리셋 버튼이 활성화 되었는지?
    self.was_reset_button_activated = false

    self.is_able_to_add_ingredient = true
end

    --

--region 칵테일 머신 관련
function order_preparing_state:add_slime(idx)
    if not self.is_able_to_add_ingredient then
        return
    end

    self.has_slime_touched_this_frame[idx + 1] = true

    -- 슬라임 스파인 흔들리는 스파인 애니메이션 실행
    -- 슬라임 떨어지는 애니메이션 실행
    local target_slime_sprite = self.ui_controller:FindTargetSlimeSpite()
    target_slime_sprite.spriteName = constants_manager.get_slime_sprite_by_idx(idx + 1)
	target_slime_sprite:MakePixelPerfect()

    start_coroutine(self.play_slime_touched_anim, self, idx)
    start_coroutine(self.add_ingredient_animation, self, target_slime_sprite)

	-- 쉐이커에 정보 추가
	self.mini_game_controller.shaker:add_slime(idx + 1)

    self.mini_game_controller:update_shaker_content_board()

    self:update_button_activate_state()
end

function order_preparing_state:is_input_state_updated(idx)
    return self.has_slime_touched_last_frame[idx]
            and self.has_slime_touched_last_frame[idx] == self.has_slime_touched_this_frame[idx]
end

function order_preparing_state:play_slime_touched_anim(idx)
    coroutine.yield(nil)

    if self.slime_spine_touched_status[idx + 1] then
        return
    end

    self.slime_spine_touched_status[idx + 1] = true

    local slime_spine_anim_set = constants_manager.get_slime_spine_anim_set_by_idx(idx + 1)
    local touched_anim_duration = 0.5

    self.ui_controller:SetSlimeSpineAnimation(idx, slime_spine_anim_set.touch, true)

    local keep_waiting = true
    local timer = 0

    while keep_waiting do
        timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        if timer > touched_anim_duration then
            -- 지잔 프레임에 터치가 들어왔다면 계속 연장한다.
            if self.has_slime_touched_last_frame[idx + 1] and self:is_input_state_updated(idx + 1) then
                timer = 0
            else
                keep_waiting = false
            end
        end

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    -- 아니라면 탈출하고, 바로 아이들 애니메이션을 변경
    self.ui_controller:SetSlimeSpineAnimation(idx, slime_spine_anim_set.idle, true)

    self.slime_spine_touched_status[idx + 1] = false
end

function order_preparing_state:add_ingredient_animation(ingredient)
    if ingredient == nil then
        return
    end

    local add_slime_sprite_origin = self.ui_controller.addSlimeSpriteOrigin
	ingredient.cachedTransform.localPosition = add_slime_sprite_origin.cachedTransform.localPosition
	ingredient.cachedTransform.localScale = add_slime_sprite_origin.cachedTransform.localScale
    ingredient.cachedGameObject:SetActive(true)

    local tween_pos = ingredient:GetComponent(typeof(CS.TweenPosition))
    local duration = (tween_pos ~= nil) and tween_pos.duration or 0

    lua_helper.call_nullable(tween_pos, 'PlayForward', tween_pos)
	if duration > 0 and not float_util.is_almost_zero(duration) then
        wait_for_sec(duration)
    end

	ingredient.cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
	ingredient.cachedTransform.localPosition = ingredient.cachedTransform.localPosition

    lua_helper.call_nullable(tween_pos, 'ResetToBeginning', tween_pos)
end

function order_preparing_state:update_button_activate_state()
    -- 쉐이커 내부에 내용물이 있다면
    if self.mini_game_controller.shaker:has_content() then
        -- 이전 프레임에 쉐이커 리셋 버튼이 비활성화 되어있었다면
        if self.was_reset_button_activated == false then
            self.ui_controller:SetResetButtonActive(true)
            self.was_reset_button_deactivated = true
        end

        -- 이전 프레임에 만들기 버튼이 비활성화 되어있었다면
        if self.was_make_button_activated == false then
            self.ui_controller:SetMakeButtonActive(true)
            self.was_make_button_activated = true
        end
    else
        -- 이전 프레임에 쉐이커 리셋 버튼이 활성화 되어있었다면
        if self.was_reset_button_deactivated then
            self.ui_controller:SetResetButtonActive(false)
            self.was_reset_button_deactivated = false
        end

        -- 이전 프레임에 만들기 버튼이 활성화 비되어있었다면
        if self.was_make_button_activated then
            self.ui_controller:SetMakeButtonActive(false)
            self.was_make_button_activated = false
        end
    end
end

    self:update_button_activate_state()

function order_preparing_state:make_cocktail()
    self.is_able_to_add_ingredient = false

    -- 버튼들 비활성화
    self.mini_game_controller:disable_buttons()

    local function make_cocktail_internal(duration, magnitude, wait_time)
        -- 쉐이커 스파인 활성화
        local shaking_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_cocktail_cup_01'})
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerSpineActive(true)
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerActive(false)
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerSpineAnimation('cocktail_cup_close', false)

        duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.3)
        magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(magnitude, 0.05)
        wait_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(wait_time, 0.3)

        wait_for_sec(duration + wait_time)

        if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then
            shaking_sfx:Stop()
            return
        end

        self.ui_controller:SetShakerSpineAnimation('cocktail_cup_shake', true, 1.5)
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerLidActive(false)

        local contained = self.mini_game_controller.shaker:get_content()
        self.mini_game_controller.created_cocktail = constants_manager.find_cocktail_info_by_contents(contained)

        -- 만들기로 넘어갔으니 기존 쉐이커의 내용물은 지워준다.
        self.mini_game_controller.shaker:reset()

        self.mini_game_controller:update_shaker_content_board()

        wait_for_sec(0.75)

        if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then
            shaking_sfx:Stop()
            return
        end

        self.ui_controller:SetShakerSpineAnimation('cocktail_cup_out', false)

        wait_for_sec(0.4)

        if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then
            shaking_sfx:Stop()
            return
        end

        self.mini_game_controller:translate_game_state(order_serving_state(self.mini_game_controller))
    end

    local function add_sub_ingredients()
        --local wait_duration = 0.125 / 2

        -- 부재료가 들어있다면 넣는 애니메이션 재생
        if self.mini_game_controller.shaker:has_sub_ingredient() then
            if self.mini_game_controller.shaker.has_fruit_ingredient then
                self:add_ingredient_animation(self.ui_controller.AddedFruitSprite)
            end

            if self.mini_game_controller.shaker.has_ice_ingredient then
                self:add_ingredient_animation(self.ui_controller.AddedIceSprite)
            end
        end
    end

    start_coroutine(function()
        yield_return_func( add_sub_ingredients)
        yield_return_func(make_cocktail_internal)
    end)
end

function order_preparing_state:reset_shaker()
    self.is_able_to_add_ingredient = false

    start_coroutine(function()
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerActive(false)
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerSpineActive(true)

        local cup_in_out_anim_duration = 0.375
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerSpineAnimation('cocktail_cup_out', false, 1.5)

        wait_for_sec(cup_in_out_anim_duration)

        if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then

        end

        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cocktail_cup_02')
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerSpineAnimation('cocktail_cup_in', false, 1.5)

        wait_for_sec(cup_in_out_anim_duration)

        if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then
            return
        end

        self.ui_controller:SetShakerActive(true)
        self.ui_controller:SetShakerSpineActive(false)

        self.is_able_to_add_ingredient = true
    end)

    self.mini_game_controller.shaker:reset()

    self.ui_controller:SetRightSubActive(self.mini_game_controller.shaker.sub_ingredient_right)

function order_serving_state:serve_cocktail()

    local cocktail_sprite

function order_evaluating_state:evaluate_order()
    local created_cocktail = self.mini_game_controller:get_created_cocktail()
    local current_customer = self.mini_game_controller:get_current_customer()

    -- 만든 칵테일의 아이디가 같은지 확인
    local evaluation_result = self:evaluate_order_condition(created_cocktail, current_customer)

    -- 주문 받은 총 손님 수 증가
    self.mini_game_controller.current_user_data:increase_num_got_customers()

    -- 결과 저장
    self:save_order_result_async(evaluation_result, created_cocktail, current_customer)

    if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then
        return
    end

    local current_customer = self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller().CurrentCustomer

    wait_all({
        -- 다음 손님들은 다가온다
        util.cs_generator(self.next_customers_approaching_async, self),
        -- 이전 손님은 떠나간다
        util.cs_generator(self.customer_move_away_async, self, current_customer),
        -- 그 사이 쉐이커는 리셋
        util.cs_generator(self.shaker_gets_ready, self)
    })

    if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then
        return
    end

    -- 맨 뒤로 간 손님 스파인 재설정
    self:reset_previous_customer_async(current_customer)
    if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then
        return
    end

    local ui_controller = self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller()
    -- 대기열 처음에 있는 손님을 맨 뒤로 보낸다.
    ui_controller:SendCurrentCustomerToLast(0)

    -- 원형으로 순회하며 소팅 순서를 바꿔준다.
    ui_controller:ChangeCustomerOrderInCircular()

    self.mini_game_controller:translate_game_state(making_order_state(self.mini_game_controller))
end

function order_evaluating_state:shaker_gets_ready()
    local cup_in_anim_duration = 0.5
    local ui_controller = self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller()
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cocktail_cup_02')
    ui_controller:SetShakerSpineAnimation('cocktail_cup_in', false)

    wait_for_sec(cup_in_anim_duration)

    ui_controller:SetShakerSpineActive(false)
    ui_controller:SetShakerActive(true)
end


function order_evaluating_state:save_order_result_async(evaluation_result, created_cocktail, current_customer)
    if evaluation_result then
        local total_reward = self:evaluate_reward(created_cocktail, current_customer)

        -- 성공 결과 저장
        if current_customer.is_troller and current_customer.need_cocktail_id == 4 then
            music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
        else
            music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
        end

        start_coroutine(self.mini_game_controller.start_slime_coin_increasing, self.mini_game_controller, total_reward)
        self.mini_game_controller.current_user_data:increase_succeed_order_count()
        self.mini_game_controller.current_user_data:earned_slime_coins(total_reward)
        self:show_customer_reaction_async('smile', self:get_succeed_reaction_string(current_customer))
    else
        -- 실패 결과 저장
        if current_customer.is_troller and current_customer.need_cocktail_id == 4 then
            music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
        else
            music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
        end

        self.mini_game_controller.current_user_data:increase_failed_order_count()
        self:show_customer_reaction_async('tired', self:get_failed_reaction_string(current_customer))
    end
end


function order_evaluating_state:get_succeed_reaction_string(current_customer)
    if current_customer.is_troller then
       return constants_manager.get_special_customer_succeed_reaction_by_id(current_customer.need_cocktail_id)
    end

    return constants_manager.get_random_reaction_string_by_result('succeed')
end

function order_evaluating_state:get_failed_reaction_string(current_customer)
    if current_customer.is_troller then
       return constants_manager.get_special_customer_failed_reaction_by_id(current_customer.need_cocktail_id)
    end

    return constants_manager.get_random_reaction_string_by_result('failed')
end

function order_evaluating_state:show_customer_reaction_async(emotion_name, string_key)
    local current_customer = self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller().CurrentCustomer
    -- 손님 반응 이모션 설정
    self:set_customer_emotion(current_customer, emotion_name)

    -- 손님 대사 설정
    local bubble_duration = 2
    local sb = self.mini_game_controller:generate_speech_bubble(string_key, nil, nil, nil, bubble_duration)
    self.mini_game_controller:show_customer_speech_bubble(sb)

    local timer = 0
    while timer <= bubble_duration do
        timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
        coroutine.yield()
    end

    self.mini_game_controller:return_speech_bubble(self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller().CustomerSpeechBubbleTransform)
end

function order_evaluating_state:customer_move_away_async(current_customer)
    local move_away_duration = 0.5
    local timer = 0
    local original_position = current_customer.SpineContainer.localPosition
    local target_position = original_position - vector(340, 0, 0)

    current_customer:SetDirection(direction_constants['left'])
    current_customer:SetAnimation('walk')

    -- 목적지로 주어진 시간 만큼 이동한다.
    while timer < move_away_duration and not self.super:is_game_not_alive() do
        timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        local progress = timer / move_away_duration

        current_customer.SpineContainer.localPosition
            = vector_util.lerp(original_position, target_position, progress)

        coroutine.yield()
    end

    if self.super:is_game_not_alive() then
        return
    end

    -- 마지막 좌표 보정
    current_customer.SpineContainer.localPosition = target_position
    current_customer:SetDirection(direction_constants['down'])
    current_customer:SetAnimation('idle')
    current_customer:SetEmotion('idle', true, -1)
end

function order_evaluating_state:customer_fade_out(current_customer)
    local target_alpha = 0
    local fade_out_duration = 0.1
    current_customer:SetAlphaFade(target_alpha, fade_out_duration)
end

function order_evaluating_state:evaluate_reward(created_cocktail, current_customer)
    local reward = 0

    -- 아무거나 주문한 손님이면 보상 6000 코인 고정.
    if current_customer.is_troller and current_customer.need_cocktail_id == 8 then
        return 500
    end

    -- 레시피 정보를 불러온다.
    local _, recipe_info = constants_manager.find_cocktail_info_by_id(created_cocktail.id)

    -- 기본 보상 세팅
    reward = recipe_info.cocktail_reward_slimecoin

    -- 과일 요청을 만족하면 추가 보상
    if current_customer.need_fruit_ingredient  then
        reward = reward + constants_manager.get_sub_ingredient_data('fruit').ingredient_reward_slimecoin
    end

    -- 얼음 요청을 만족하면 추가 보상
    if current_customer.need_ice_ingredient then
        reward = reward + constants_manager.get_sub_ingredient_data('ice').ingredient_reward_slimecoin
    end

    return reward
end

function order_evaluating_state:evaluate_order_condition(created_cocktail, current_customer)
    if current_customer.is_troller and current_customer.need_cocktail_id == 8 then
        return true, nil
    end

    if created_cocktail == nil then
        return false, nil
    end

    local is_same_cocktail = created_cocktail.id == current_customer.need_cocktail_id
    local has_satisfied_fruit_request =
        (not current_customer.need_fruit_ingredient) or
        (created_cocktail.has_fruit_ing and current_customer.need_fruit_ingredient)
    local has_satisfied_ice_request =
        (not current_customer.need_ice_ingredient) or
        (created_cocktail.has_ice_ing and current_customer.need_ice_ingredient)

    return is_same_cocktail and has_satisfied_fruit_request and has_satisfied_ice_request
end

function order_evaluating_state:set_customer_emotion(current_customer, emotion_name)
    current_customer:SetEmotion(emotion_name, true, -1)
end

function order_evaluating_state:reset_previous_customer_async(current_customer)    
    -- 대기열에 포함된 손님의 카운트 증가
    self.mini_game_controller.num_customers_in_queue = self.mini_game_controller.num_customers_in_queue + 1
    
    -- 다음 손님 정보를 가지고 와서 세팅해준다.
    local next_customer_spec = self.mini_game_controller:get_next_customer_spec()
    local character_spec = self.mini_game_controller:convert_customer_spec_to_character_spec(next_customer_spec)


    yield_return_func(current_customer.UpdateCharacter, current_customer, character_spec, function()
        --self:customer_fade_out(current_customer)
        current_customer:SetDirection(direction_constants['down'])
        self.spine_update_fail_safe = false
    end)

    while self.spine_update_fail_safe do
        coroutine.yield()
    end
end

function order_evaluating_state:next_customers_approaching_async()
    -- 다음 손님 인덱스 증가
    local timer = 0
    local move_forward_duration = 0.5

    local original_position_list = {}
    local target_position_list = {}

    local original_scale_list = {}
    local target_scale_list = {}

    local ui_controller = self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller()

    if not self.mini_game_controller:is_out_of_customer_spec() then
        ui_controller.Customers[ui_controller.Customers.Length - 1].SpineContainer.localPosition = vector(-60, 180, 0)
        ui_controller.Customers[ui_controller.Customers.Length - 1]:SetAlphaFade(1, move_forward_duration)
    end

    local position_interval = vector(-60, 130, 0)
    local scale_interval = vector(70, 70, 70)

    for i = 1, ui_controller.Customers.Length - 1 do
        local original_position = ui_controller.Customers[i].SpineContainer.localPosition
        local target_position = original_position - position_interval
        local original_scale = ui_controller.Customers[i].SpineContainer.localScale
        local target_scale = original_scale + scale_interval
        table.insert(original_position_list, original_position)
        table.insert(target_position_list, target_position)
        table.insert(original_scale_list, original_scale)
        table.insert(target_scale_list, target_scale)

        position_interval:Scale(vector(-1, 1, 1))
    end

    -- Walk 애니메이션 실행 시켜 준다.
    for i = 1, ui_controller.Customers.Length - 1 do
        local current_customer = ui_controller.Customers[i]
        current_customer:SetAnimation('walk')
    end

    while timer <= move_forward_duration and self.mini_game_controller.is_playing_game do
        timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        local progress = timer / move_forward_duration

        for i = 1, ui_controller.Customers.Length - 1 do
            local current_customer = ui_controller.Customers[i]
            current_customer.SpineContainer.localPosition
                = vector_util.lerp(original_position_list[i], target_position_list[i], progress)

            current_customer.SpineContainer.localScale
                = vector_util.lerp(original_scale_list[i], target_scale_list[i], progress)
        end

        coroutine.yield()
    end

    if not self.mini_game_controller.is_playing_game then
        return
    end

    -- 마지막으로 위치를 보정해주고, idle 애니메이션으로 바꿔준다.
    for i = 1, ui_controller.Customers.Length - 1 do
        local current_customer = ui_controller.Customers[i]
        current_customer.SpineContainer.localPosition = target_position_list[i]
        current_customer:SetAnimation('idle')
    end

    coroutine.yield(nil)

    self.mini_game_controller.current_customer_idx = self.mini_game_controller.current_customer_idx + 1
end

function tutorial_state:start_tutorial()
    self.super:customers_incoming_async()

    self:first_customer_made_order()
    wait_for_sec(2)

    local customer_speaker_transform = self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller().CustomerSpeechBubbleTransform
    self.mini_game_controller:return_speech_bubble(customer_speaker_transform)

    local tutorial_speech_bubble_pos =
    {
        vector(-250, -200),
        vector(225, 330),
        vector(-120, 320),
        vector(0, 0)
    }

    local speech_bubble_key = 'short_story_cocktail_tutorial_'
    local speaker_transform = self.mini_game_controller:get_main_ui_controller().TutorialSpeechBubbleTransform
    -- 먼저 손님의 주문을 보고 어떤 음료를 원하는지 확인하세요.
    local sb = self.mini_game_controller:generate_speech_bubble(speech_bubble_key .. 1, speaker_transform, speech_bubble_direction.none, nil, 2)
    self.mini_game_controller:set_sb_param_for_tutorial(sb, tutorial_speech_bubble_pos[1])
    self.mini_game_controller:show_customer_speech_bubble_async(sb)

    -- 레시피 북 아이콘 아래에 로레인 말풍선 출력
    -- 레시피를 열어서 주문에 맞는 제조법을 확인하고…
    sb = self.mini_game_controller:generate_speech_bubble(speech_bubble_key .. 3, speaker_transform, speech_bubble_direction.none, nil, 2)
    self.mini_game_controller:set_sb_param_for_tutorial(sb, tutorial_speech_bubble_pos[3])
    self.mini_game_controller:show_customer_speech_bubble_async(sb)

    -- 이후 칵테일 쉐이커 위에 로레인 말풍선 출력
    -- 이후에 여기 있는 재료들 중에 맞는 것을 골라서 섞는거예요.
    sb = self.mini_game_controller:generate_speech_bubble(speech_bubble_key .. 2, speaker_transform, speech_bubble_direction.none, nil, 2)
    self.mini_game_controller:set_sb_param_for_tutorial(sb, tutorial_speech_bubble_pos[2])
    self.mini_game_controller:show_customer_speech_bubble_async(sb)

    -- 화면 중앙에 로레인 말풍선 출력
    -- 손님이 원하는 음료를 완벽히 제조해야 슬라임 코인을 받을 수 있으니, 실수하지 않게 조심하시고요.
    sb = self.mini_game_controller:generate_speech_bubble(speech_bubble_key .. 4, speaker_transform, speech_bubble_direction.none, nil, 2)
    self.mini_game_controller:set_sb_param_for_tutorial(sb, tutorial_speech_bubble_pos[4])
    self.mini_game_controller:show_customer_speech_bubble_async(sb)

    -- 그럼 마스터 슬라임 바텐더가 될 때까지 한 번 열심히 해보세요.
    sb = self.mini_game_controller:generate_speech_bubble(speech_bubble_key .. 5, speaker_transform, speech_bubble_direction.none, nil, 2)
    self.mini_game_controller:set_sb_param_for_tutorial(sb, tutorial_speech_bubble_pos[4])
    self.mini_game_controller:show_customer_speech_bubble_async(sb)

    --튜토리얼 종료 후, 액티비티 스타트 문구 출력

    wait_for_sec(1.5)

    self:first_customer_made_order()
end

local local_class = newclass('CoolingGame')

local mana_storage_state_base = newclass('CoolingGameManaStorageState')
local mana_storage_state = {
	idle = newclass('CoolingGameManaStorageIdleState', mana_storage_state_base),
	berserk = newclass('CoolingGameManaStorageBerserkState', mana_storage_state_base)
}

local refrigerant_state_base = newclass('CoolingGameRefrigerantState')
local refrigerant_state = {
	idle = newclass('CoolingGameRefrigerantIdleState', refrigerant_state_base),
	cooling = newclass('CoolingGameRefrigerantCoolingState', refrigerant_state_base)
}

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- game name
	self.game_name = 'CoolingGame'

	-- data key
	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 게임 진행도
	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		in_game = 2,
		end_game = 3,
		exit_game = 4
	}

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none

	-- 크리스탈 색
	self.crystal_color = {
		gray = 1,
		green = 2,
		red = 3
	}

	-- 광폭화 시간
	self.berserk_time_passed = 0

	-- 게임 오버 시간
	self.game_over_time_passed = 0

	-- 게임 진행도
	self.game_progress = 0

	-- 게임 진행도 바
	self.progress_bar = nil

	-- 축퇴로 온도 게이지 바
	self.gauge_bars = {}

	-- 각 오브젝트 스테이트
	self.states = {
		mana_storage_state = mana_storage_state,
		refrigerant_state = refrigerant_state
	}

	-- state 풀
	self.pooled_states = nil

	self.fx = {
		blink = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/CoolingGame/CoolingGameConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 게임 진행도 바 ui 로드
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.UI.VinetteProgressBar.LoadVinetteProgressBar, self.res_holder)

	self.progress_bar = CS.Oak.UI.VinetteProgressBar.Instance
	self.progress_bar:UIOnOff(false)

	-- 축퇴로 게이지 바 ui 로드
	for mana_storage_name, data in pairs(self.constants_data.mana_storage_data) do
		local mana_storage = get_field_object(mana_storage_name)

		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/ui', data.gauge_bar_name,
			function(prefab)
				local gauge_bar = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.LaboseworldGaugeBar))
				self.gauge_bars[mana_storage] = gauge_bar
				gauge_bar:Init(mana_storage, vector(1, 0, 0))
				gauge_bar:UIOnOff(false)
			end)
	end

	self.fx:load_all()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	-- state 풀
	self.pooled_states = {
		mana_storage_state = {},
		refrigerant_state = {}
	}

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.exit_game

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.pooled_states then
		for _, types in pairs(self.pooled_states) do
			for _, states in pairs(types) do
				for i = 1, #states do
					states[i]:dispose()
				end
			end
		end

		self.pooled_states = nil
	end

	for i = 1, #self.mana_storages do
		local mana_storage = self.mana_storages[i]

		if self.gauge_bars[mana_storage] then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.gauge_bars[mana_storage])
			self.gauge_bars[mana_storage] = nil
		end
	end

	if self.progress_bar then
		self.progress_bar:Dispose()
		self.progress_bar = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil
end

--region on_event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then
		return false
	end

	for mana_storage, mana_storage_data in pairs(self.mana_storage_data) do
		if e.Zone.Name == mana_storage_data.zone_name then
			for refrigerant, refrigerant_data in pairs(self.refrigerant_data) do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, refrigerant) then

					self.refrigerant_data[refrigerant].target_mana_storage = mana_storage

					local state = self:get_or_create_state('refrigerant_state', 'cooling', refrigerant)
					self:change_state(self.refrigerant_data, refrigerant, state)

					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

--- 미니게임 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	-- 게임 성공했는지
	local is_success_game = true

	self:game_setting()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		screen_util.show_stage_title('cooling_game_count_' .. i, 2.1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/audio:bgm_queenship_assassin', state = 'event' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

	sp_util.exit_scene({ show_weapon = false }, leader)

	self:show_ui(true)

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_game

	-- 카메라 쉐이크 중인지
	local camera_shake = false

	is_success_game = true

	while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 관리 성공 중인지
		local is_management_success = true

		-- 관리 실패 했는지
		local is_management_failure = false

		-- 축퇴로 업데이트
		for _, mana_storage_data in pairs(self.mana_storage_data) do
			mana_storage_data.state:update(dt)

			-- 관리 성공 여부 체크
			if mana_storage_data.temperature < mana_storage_data.min_appropriate_temperature or
				mana_storage_data.temperature > mana_storage_data.max_appropriate_temperature then

				is_management_success = false
			end

			-- 관리 실패 여부 체크
			if mana_storage_data.temperature <= 0 or mana_storage_data.temperature >= 1 then
				is_management_failure = true
			end
		end

		-- 냉각제 업데이트
		for _, refrigerant_data in pairs(self.refrigerant_data) do
			refrigerant_data.state:update(dt)
		end

		-- 특정 주기마다 랜덤하게 광폭화
		self.berserk_time_passed = self.berserk_time_passed + dt

		if self.berserk_time_passed > self.constants_data.berserk_cycle + self.constants_data.berserk_duration then
			self.berserk_time_passed = 0

			local mana_storage = self.mana_storages[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.mana_storages)]
			local state = self:get_or_create_state('mana_storage_state', 'berserk', mana_storage)
			self:change_state(self.mana_storage_data, mana_storage, state)
		end

		-- 관리 성공 처리
		if is_management_success then
			self.game_progress = math.min(self.game_progress + self.constants_data.increase_game_progress * dt, 1)
		else
			self.game_progress = math.min(self.game_progress + self.constants_data.increase_normal_game_progress * dt, 1)
		end

		self.progress_bar:SetUI(self.game_progress)

		if self.game_progress >= 1 then
			break
		end

		-- 관리 실패 처리
		if is_management_failure then
			self.game_over_time_passed = self.game_over_time_passed + dt
		else
			camera_shake = false
			camera_util.cancel_shake()

			self.game_over_time_passed = 0
		end

		-- 게임 오버 1초 남았을 때, 화면 shake 0.1세기로 지속 출력
		if not camera_shake and self.game_over_time_passed > self.constants_data.game_over_time - 1 then
			camera_shake = true
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 999999)
		end

		if self.game_over_time_passed > self.constants_data.game_over_time then
			is_success_game = false
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.exit_game then
		return
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.end_game

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	for _, mana_storage_data in pairs(self.mana_storage_data) do
		if mana_storage_data.state.loop_sfx then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(mana_storage_data.state.loop_sfx)
			mana_storage_data.state.loop_sfx = nil
		end
	end

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	-- 위에서 내려놓지 못 했을 경우 다시 한번 내려놓음
	local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget

		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.publish_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
				leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end

	if is_success_game then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
	else
		screen_util.show_stage_title('cooling_game_fail')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magwi_explosion_01')

		-- 기사(보이는 방향, damaged, dead) 출력
		character_util.set_side_direction(leader)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dead')
	end

	wait_for_sec(3)

	self:show_ui(false)

	if is_success_game then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 축퇴로 초기화
	for mana_storage, mana_storage_data in pairs(self.mana_storage_data) do
		local state = self:get_or_create_state('mana_storage_state', 'idle', mana_storage)
		self:change_state(self.mana_storage_data, mana_storage, state)

		mana_storage_data.crystal_animator:Play('green')
	end

	-- 냉각제 초기화
	for refrigerant, refrigerant_data in pairs(self.refrigerant_data) do
		local state = self:get_or_create_state('refrigerant_state', 'idle', refrigerant)
		self:change_state(self.refrigerant_data, refrigerant, state)

		refrigerant.Position = refrigerant_data.origin_pos
	end

	if self.pooled_states then
		for _, types in pairs(self.pooled_states) do
			for _, states in pairs(types) do
				for i = 1, #states do
					states[i].using = false
				end
			end
		end
	end


	-- 게임 끝난 후 세팅
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success_game))
end

--- 게임 시작 시 세팅
function local_class:game_setting()
	self.game_progress = 0
	self.progress_bar:SetUI(self.game_progress)

	self.mana_storages = {}

	-- 마나 축퇴로 세팅
	self.mana_storage_data = {}

	for mana_storage_name, data in pairs(self.constants_data.mana_storage_data) do
		local mana_storage = get_field_object(mana_storage_name)
		table.insert(self.mana_storages, mana_storage)

		local mana_storage_animator = mana_storage.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		local crystal_animator = mana_storage.Transform:Find('mesh'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		self.mana_storage_data[mana_storage] = {
			zone_name = mana_storage.Name .. '_zone',
			-- 시작 온도 설정
			temperature = 0.5,
			-- 적정 최저 온도
			min_appropriate_temperature = data.min_appropriate_temperature,
			-- 적정 최고 온도
			max_appropriate_temperature = data.max_appropriate_temperature,
			-- 크리스탈 색
			crystal_color = self.crystal_color.green,
			-- 애니메이터
			mana_storage_animator = mana_storage_animator,
			crystal_animator = crystal_animator,
			-- 크리스탈 색 변경 중인지
			is_changing_color = false,
			-- 크리스탈 색 변경 시작 시간
			changing_color_start_time = unity_class.time.time,
			-- 상태
			state = self:get_or_create_state('mana_storage_state', 'idle', mana_storage)
		}

		self.gauge_bars[mana_storage]:SetGaugeArrow(self.mana_storage_data[mana_storage].temperature)

		crystal_animator:Play('green')
	end

	-- 냉각제 세팅
	self.refrigerant_data = {}

	local refrigerant_index = 1

	while true do
		local refrigerant = get_field_object(self.constants_data.refrigerant_name .. refrigerant_index)

		if not refrigerant then
			break
		end

		refrigerant_index = refrigerant_index + 1

		refrigerant.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()

		-- 축퇴로에 충돌되지 않도록 함
		for mana_storage, _ in pairs(self.mana_storage_data) do
			local field_object_pair = CS.Oak.FieldObjectPair(refrigerant, mana_storage)
			field:AddIgnoreCrash(field_object_pair)
		end

		self.refrigerant_data[refrigerant] = {
			origin_pos = refrigerant.Position,
			state = self:get_or_create_state('refrigerant_state', 'idle', refrigerant)
		}
	end

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.constants_data.center_pos_name)

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	leader.Position = center_pos
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(7, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 0)

	-- 시작 시간은 광폭화 진행 시간 빼고
	self.berserk_time_passed = 0 - self.constants_data.berserk_duration
end

--- 스테이트 변경
function local_class:change_state(data, target, next_state)
	local prev_state = data[target].state

	if prev_state then
		prev_state:exit(next_state)
		prev_state.using = false
	end

	if next_state ~= nil then
		next_state:enter(prev_state)
		data[target].state = next_state
	end
end

--- state 생성 및 가져오기
function local_class:get_or_create_state(state_name, type, fo)
	if not self.pooled_states[state_name][type] then
		self.pooled_states[state_name][type] = {}
	end

	for i = 1, #self.pooled_states[state_name][type] do
		local state = self.pooled_states[state_name][type][i]

		-- 사용 중이지 않은 state 가져옴
		if not state.using then
			state.super.fo = fo
			state.using = true

			return state
		end
	end

	-- 전부 사용 중일 때 state 생성
	local state = self.states[state_name][type](self)
	state.super.fo = fo
	state.using = true

	table.insert(self.pooled_states[state_name][type], state)

	return state
end

--- 상태별 온도 체크
function local_class:check_crystal_color(mana_storage_data)
	if mana_storage_data.temperature <= 0 and
		mana_storage_data.crystal_color ~= self.crystal_color.gray then

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magwi_shutdown_01')

		-- 적정 온도보다 낮으면 회색
		mana_storage_data.crystal_animator:Play('green_to_gray')
		mana_storage_data.crystal_color = self.crystal_color.gray
		return true
	end

	if mana_storage_data.temperature >= 1 and
		mana_storage_data.crystal_color ~= self.crystal_color.red then

		-- 적정 온도보다 높으면 빨간색
		mana_storage_data.crystal_animator:Play('green_to_red')
		mana_storage_data.crystal_color = self.crystal_color.red
		return true
	end

	if mana_storage_data.temperature > 0 and
		mana_storage_data.temperature < 1 and
		mana_storage_data.crystal_color ~= self.crystal_color.green then

		-- 적정 온도면 초록색
		if mana_storage_data.crystal_color == self.crystal_color.gray then
			mana_storage_data.crystal_animator:Play('gray_to_green')
		else
			mana_storage_data.crystal_animator:Play('red_to_green')
		end

		mana_storage_data.crystal_color = self.crystal_color.green
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 크리스탈 색 변경
function local_class:change_crystal_color(mana_storage_data)
	-- 크리스탈 색 변경 중복 방지
	if not mana_storage_data.is_changing_color and self:check_crystal_color(mana_storage_data) then
		mana_storage_data.is_changing_color = true
		mana_storage_data.changing_color_start_time = unity_class.time.time
	end

	if mana_storage_data.is_changing_color and unity_class.time.time - mana_storage_data.changing_color_start_time > 1 then
		mana_storage_data.is_changing_color = false
	end
end

--- UI 제어
function local_class:show_ui(show)
	self.progress_bar:UIOnOff(show)

	for i = 1, #self.mana_storages do
		local mana_storage = self.mana_storages[i]
		self.gauge_bars[mana_storage]:UIOnOff(show)
	end
end

--region ManaStorage State

--region Base State
function mana_storage_state_base:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.fo = nil

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.increase_temperature = self.controller.constants_data.increase_temperature
end

function mana_storage_state_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.fo = nil
end

function mana_storage_state_base:enter()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function mana_storage_state_base:exit()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function mana_storage_state_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local cur_temperature = math.min(1, self.controller.mana_storage_data[self.fo].temperature + self.increase_temperature * dt)
	self.controller.mana_storage_data[self.fo].temperature = cur_temperature

	self.controller:change_crystal_color(self.controller.mana_storage_data[self.fo])

	self.controller.gauge_bars[self.fo]:SetGaugeArrow(self.controller.mana_storage_data[self.fo].temperature)
end
--endregion Base State

--region Idle State
function mana_storage_state.idle:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function mana_storage_state.idle:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function mana_storage_state.idle:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.increase_temperature = self.controller.constants_data.increase_temperature
end

function mana_storage_state.idle:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function mana_storage_state.idle:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion Idle State

--region Berserk State
function mana_storage_state.berserk:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function mana_storage_state.berserk:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function mana_storage_state.berserk:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_magwi_chargeloop_01', loop = true, volume = 0.8 })

	self.increase_temperature = self.controller.constants_data.berserk_increase_temperature

	self.controller.mana_storage_data[self.fo].mana_storage_animator:Play('socket_red')
end

function mana_storage_state.berserk:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	if self.loop_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.loop_sfx)
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller.mana_storage_data[self.fo].mana_storage_animator:Play('socket_idle')
end

function mana_storage_state.berserk:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed > self.controller.constants_data.berserk_duration then
		local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('mana_storage_state', 'idle', self.fo)
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.mana_storage_data, self.fo, state)
	end
end
--endregion Berserk State

--endregion ManaStorage State

--region Refrigerant State

--region Base State
function refrigerant_state_base:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.fo = nil

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function refrigerant_state_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.fo = nil
end

function refrigerant_state_base:enter()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function refrigerant_state_base:exit()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function refrigerant_state_base:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion Base State

--region Idle State
function refrigerant_state.idle:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function refrigerant_state.idle:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function refrigerant_state.idle:enter()
	self.super:enter()
end

function refrigerant_state.idle:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function refrigerant_state.idle:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end
--endregion Idle State

--region Cooling State
function refrigerant_state.cooling:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
end

function refrigerant_state.cooling:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function refrigerant_state.cooling:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	if self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.in_game then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magwi_rock_fence_01')
	end

	message_system:SendSync(self.fo, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

	-- 온도 낮춤
	local target_mana_storage = self.controller.refrigerant_data[self.fo].target_mana_storage

	local cur_temperature = math.max(0,
		self.controller.mana_storage_data[target_mana_storage].temperature + self.controller.constants_data.decrease_temperature)
	self.controller.mana_storage_data[target_mana_storage].temperature = cur_temperature

	self.controller:change_crystal_color(self.controller.mana_storage_data[target_mana_storage])

	self.fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.disabled
end

function refrigerant_state.cooling:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	self.fo.ActiveState = active_state_type.enabled
	self.fo.Position = self.controller.refrigerant_data[self.fo].origin_pos
	self.controller.fx.blink():Instantiate(self.fo.Position + vector(0, 1.7, -1.3))

	if self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.in_game then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
	end
end

function refrigerant_state.cooling:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed > 1 then
		local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('refrigerant_state', 'idle', self.fo)
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.refrigerant_data, self.fo, state)
	end
end
--endregion Cooling State

--endregion Refrigerant State

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('DoodleJump')

local function to_vector3(pos)
	return vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
end

-- TODO  : obstacle spawn-despawn-update-충돌처리 / 함수 순서, 변수 중구난방 정리
-- FIXME : 각각 로컬 함수에서 전역변수 할당하는 거 init에서 전체적으로 모아야 함.
-- FIXME : 너무 전역변수를 남발하는 것 같음. 로컬 쓸 수 있는건 로컬로 모으자.
function local_class:init()
	--region Game
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'DoodleJump'

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = nil

	-- fx
	self.is_playing_game = false
	self.is_game_clear = false

	-- 튜토리얼을 봤는지
	self.is_tutorial = true
	self.touch_delay_timer = 0
	self.jump_key_press = false
	--endregion Game

	--region UI
	-- 좌우 버튼
	self.right_button = nil
	self.right_button_touch_handler = nil

	self.left_button = nil
	self.left_button_touch_handler = nil

	-- 게임패드 대응
	self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
	self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

	self.is_ignore_touch_event = false
	--endregion

	--region Background
	self.background = {
		pooled = {},
		scale = 4,
		count = 3,
		scrolling_end = false,
		end_update_routine = false,
		pool_destroy = false
	}

	--endregion Background

	--region fx
	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		twinkle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle')
		end,
		water_splash = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cg_water_splash_out_front')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.ui = {
		num_counter = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUINumCounter')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion

	--시어값 조절하기 위해 비쥬얼 컨트롤러 접근
	--TODO TilemapVisualConstants 수정 방식으로 수정해야한다면 대응해야함.
	self.get_visual_controller = function()
		return get_field_object('[gimmick]visualController')
	end

	--목표 프레임
	self.target_fps = 30

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
	
	self.fail_count = 0
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	local constants_data = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/DoodleJump/DoodleJumpConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[self.constants_data_key]

	self.constants_data.prefab = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.constants_data.prefab, {
		bg = {
			path = 'ondemand/v3_00_pixyworld/tilesets',
			name = 'pw_cliff_minigame_bg',
			pivot = vector(-7.5, 0, 1),
			size = vector(0, 24, 0),
		},
		shader_asset = {
			path = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/theatres/rungame',
			name = 'rungame_shader_container'
		},
		right_button = {
			path = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/theatres/rungame',
			name = 'RunGameRightArrow'
		},
		left_button = {
			path = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/theatres/rungame',
			name = 'RunGameLeftArrow'
		},
	})

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	self.fx:load_all()
	self.ui:load_all()
	self:load_all()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	self:unload_all()

	if self.rock_slide ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.rock_slide)
		self.rock_slide = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_all()
	self:dispose_resource_holder()

	if next(self.background.pooled) == nil then
		self:load_bg()
	end

	self:load_ui()
end

function local_class:unload_all()
	self:dispose_button()
	self:dispose_resource_holder()
	self:dispose_pooled_platform()
	self:dispose_bg()
	self:dispose_obstacle()

	self:dispose_num_counter()

	self:reset_camera()
	self:reset_shear()

	--FIXME : UI. 함수로 빼는 게 좋은듯
	if self.left_button ~= nil then
		local t = self.left_button
		self.left_button = nil
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(t)
	end

	if self.right_button ~= nil then
		local t = self.right_button
		self.right_button = nil
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(t)
	end
end

function local_class:load_bg()
	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)

	local bg_prefab_data = self.constants_data.prefab.bg

	self.background.pivot = bg_prefab_data.pivot
	self.background.size = bg_prefab_data.size

	local bg_pivot = self.background.pivot
	local bg_pos = pivot_pos - self.background.size + bg_pivot

	self.res_holder_bg = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local bg_path = bg_prefab_data.path
	local bg_name = bg_prefab_data.name

	--3개 이어 붙임.
	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		local bg_prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder_bg,
				bg_path, bg_name)

		bg_prefab.transform.position = bg_pos
		bg_pos = bg_pos + self.background.size
		self.background.pooled[i] = bg_prefab
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_bg()
	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		if self.background.pooled[i] ~= nil then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.background.pooled[i])
		end
		self.background.pooled[i] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_obstacle()
	if self.rock_slide ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.rock_slide)
		self.rock_slide = nil
	end

	if self.goat ~= nil then
		self.goat.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		self.goat.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
		character_util.remove_scale_factor(self.goat, self.goat.Name)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goat)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.goat, active_state_type.disabled)
	end

	if self.falling_people_dynamic ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.falling_people_dynamic)
		self.falling_people_dynamic = nil
		self.falling_people_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_ui()
	self.res_holder_ui = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local right_button = self.constants_data.prefab.right_button

	-- 화살표 UI 로드
	-- FIXME : 경로도 constants_data로 넘길까?
	if self.right_button == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder_ui, right_button.path, right_button.name, function(prefab)
					self.right_button = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.right_button:SetActive(false)
				end)
	end

	local left_button = self.constants_data.prefab.left_button

	if self.left_button == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder_ui, left_button.path, left_button.name, function(prefab)
					self.left_button = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.left_button:SetActive(false)
				end)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_resource_holder()
	if self.res_holder_bg ~= nil then
		self.res_holder_bg:Dispose()
		self.res_holder_bg = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder_ui ~= nil then
		self.res_holder_ui:Dispose()
		self.res_holder_ui = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_num_counter()
	-- 카운트 ui
	self.ui_num_counter_object = self.ui.num_counter():Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 1))
	self.ui_num_counter = self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUINumCounter))
	self.ui_num_counter:Reposition()
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(0)
	self.ui_num_counter:SetMaxCount(self.constants_data.game_info.max_height)

	self.ui_num_counter_background = self.ui_num_counter_object.transform:Find('background')
	self.ui_num_counter_background.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:dispose_num_counter()
	if self.ui_num_counter_background ~= nil then
		self.ui_num_counter_background.transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.ui_num_counter_background = nil
	end

	if self.ui_num_counter_object ~= nil then
		self.ui_num_counter_object:Dispose()
		self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
	end

	-- 카운터 ui 제거
	self.ui_num_counter = nil
end

-- 터치 이벤트 로직
function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play then
		--if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftTriggerDown
		--		or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftShoulderDown then
		--	self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = true
		--elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown
		--		or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
		--	self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = true
		--end
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonDown then
			-- 오른쪽으로 가는 버튼 누르고 있을 때
			self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = true
			return true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonUp
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonUp then
			-- 오른쪽으로 가는 버튼을 놓았을 때
			self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false
			return true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonDown then
			-- 왼쪽으로 가는 버튼 누르고 있을 때
			self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = true
			return true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonUp
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonUp then
			-- 왼쪽으로 가는 버튼을 놓았을 때
			self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
			return true
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:game_start()
	start_coroutine(self.game_start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_start_routine()
	--self:init_doodle()

	-- FIXME : 여기 아니라 on_load_resource 등으로 옮기는 것 고려
	self:load_pooled_platform()
	self:init_cur_game_info()
	self:init_platform()
	self:init_character()
	self:init_camera()
	self:setting_shear()
	self:init_obstacle()

	self:set_custom_shader(get_character(self.character_data.name))

	self:hide_common_ui()

	self:load_num_counter()

	--FIXME 게임 루틴 중으로 옮길지 고려
	self:set_up_ui_button()

	start_coroutine(self.game_update, self)
end

--FIXME game_state init으로 옮기기
function local_class:game_update()
	local constants_data = self.constants_data

	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		count_down = 3,
		play = 4,
		stun = 5,
		defeat = 6,
		restart = 7,
		victory = 8,
	}
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.start

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.count_down
	
	self:fade_in_waterfall_sfx()

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
		self.is_show_pc_narration = true
		field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')
	end

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	local start_count = 3
	local start_count_string_key = 'pw_doodle_jump_count'
	local title_mod = 2.1
	for i = start_count, 1, -1 do

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format(start_count_string_key, i), title_mod)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.play

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_china_day', volume = 0.8 })

	local time_passed = 0
	local target_dt = 1 / self.target_fps

	-- 캐릭터 및 플랫폼 업데이트
	local move_update = function(dt)
		local surplus = self:update_character_and_return_surplus(dt)

		if surplus >= 0 then
			self:update_height(surplus)
			--self:update_obstacle_list(self.obstacle_list, surplus)
		end

		self:update_num_count()

		self:update_platform(surplus)

		if surplus >= 0 then
			self:update_background(surplus)
		end

		self:update_obstacle(time_passed, surplus, dt)

		if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play then
			self:check_obstacle_hit()
			--내려갈 때 만 체크.
			if self.character_data.cur_speed < 0 then
				self:check_platform_hit()
			end
		end

		self:update_effect(surplus)

		self:caching_character_position()
	end

	while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play or
			self.current_game_state == self.game_state.stun do

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		-- 저프레임 대응
		if dt > target_dt then
			while dt >= target_dt do
				move_update(target_dt)
				dt = dt - target_dt
			end
			if not float_util.is_almost_zero(dt) then
				move_update(dt)
			end
		else
			move_update(dt)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.defeat then
		--카메라 그리드 아래로 떨어졌을 경우

		--추락하면서 실패 판정 시 1회 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--카메라는 고정된 상태에서 1초 뒤 ‘실패’ 텍스트 등장
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString("pw_doodle_jump_failed"))
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')

		--1초 뒤 fade out
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0.5 })
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		local character_data = self.character_data
		local character = get_character(character_data.name)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
		character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)

		self:unload_all()

		camera_util.move_async(vector(999, 0, 555), 0.1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.1, 'linear')
		
		self.fail_count = self.fail_count + 1

		--이후 선택지 등장
		local manual_retry = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.constants_data.game_info.manual_retry, true)

		local player_choice
		if manual_retry and self.fail_count % 2 == 0  then
			--박스 : mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_3 (액티비티를 넘기시겠습니까? 메모리얼 클리어 후, 다시 도전할 수 있습니다)
			player_choice = field_ui_util.show_narration_talk_branch_async({
				key = 'mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_3'
			}, {
				--좌측 선택지 : (mercy) mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_4 (액티비티를 넘긴다.)
				{ 'mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_4', 'mercy' },
				--우측 선택지 : (brutal) mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_5 (계속 도전한다.)
				{ 'mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_5', 'brutal' },
			})
		else
			player_choice = 2
		end

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		if player_choice == 2 then
			--우측 선택지 : (brutal) mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_5 (계속 도전한다.)
			--출발 발판에서 다시 게임 진행

			self:load_all()
			self:game_start()
		else
			--좌측 선택지 : (mercy) mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_4 (액티비티를 넘긴다.)
			--재시도 연출 진행
			self.fail_count = 0

			self:fade_out_waterfall_sfx()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
			self:show_common_ui()
		end

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.victory then
		self:dispose_button()
		self:dispose_num_counter()
		if self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'boomerang' then
			self:victory_scene_boomerang()
		elseif self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'carp_girl_normal' then
			self:victory_scene_carp_girl(false)
		elseif self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'carp_girl_hard' then
			self:victory_scene_carp_girl(true)
		else
			self:victory_scene()
		end
	end

end

function local_class:init_platform()
	local platform_list = self.constants_data.platform_list

	local height_limit = self.constants_data.game_info.height_limit

	self.cur_platform_list = {}
	self.wait_platform_list = {}

	-- height_limit 초과하는 데이터의 첫 번째 인덱스 찾기
	local split_index = 1
	for i, platform in ipairs(platform_list) do
		if platform.pos.y > height_limit then
			split_index = i
			break
		else
			-- height_limit 이하의 데이터는 lower_z_data, cur_platform_list에 추가
			table.insert(self.cur_platform_list, platform)
			-- FIXME : 솔직히 idx를 return 값으로 가지는 게 별로 직관적이지 않아 보임. 수정 요망
			platform.pooled_platform_idx = self:spawn_platform(platform)
		end
	end

	-- higher_z_data, wait_platform_list 초기화 및 데이터 추가
	for i = split_index, #platform_list do
		table.insert(self.wait_platform_list, platform_list[i])
	end
end

function local_class:load_pooled_platform()
	self.platform_info_list = self.constants_data.platform_info_list
	self.pooled_platform_list = {
		normal = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		normal2 = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		normal3 = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		fragile = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		fragile2 = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		jump = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		victory = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
	}

	self.res_holder_platform = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	for type_name, type_info in pairs(self.platform_info_list) do
		for idx = 1, type_info.max_num do

			local pooled_platform = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder_platform,
					type_info.asset_path, type_info.asset_name)
			pooled_platform.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			pooled_platform.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
			local pooled_platform_info = {
				index = idx,
				object = pooled_platform,
				type = type_name,
				is_active = false,
			}
			table.insert(self.pooled_platform_list[type_name].table, pooled_platform_info)
		end
	end

	if self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'boomerang' then
		local boomerang_data = self.constants_data.game_info.boomerang
		self.boomerang = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
			itemid = boomerang_data.item_id, notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = boomerang_data.sprscale, skip_text = true
		})

		self.boomerang:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Default', 1, 'Default', 0)

		self.boomerang.SpriteTransform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)

		self.boomerang.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

end

function local_class:dispose_pooled_platform()
	if self.pooled_platform_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for type_name, type_info in pairs(self.platform_info_list) do
		for i = 1, #self.pooled_platform_list[type_name].table do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.pooled_platform_list[type_name].table[i].object)
			self.pooled_platform_list[type_name].table[i].object = nil
		end
	end
	self.pooled_platform_list = nil

	if self.boomerang ~= nil then
		self.boomerang:ConsumeComplete()
		self.boomerang = nil
	end

	if self.fragile_platform_for_anim ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.fragile_platform_for_anim)
		self.fragile_platform_for_anim = nil
	end
end

-- FIXME : 솔직히 idx를 return 값으로 가지는 게 별로 직관적이지 않아 보임. 수정 요망
--현재 플랫폼 리스트 값에 풀링된 플랫폼 아이템 오브젝트를 할당해 주고 위치를 옮김.
function local_class:spawn_platform(platform)
	local platform_type = platform.type
	local platform_pos_raw = platform.pos
	local platform_pos = vector(platform_pos_raw.x, platform_pos_raw.y, platform_pos_raw.z)

	local cur_height = self.cur_game_info.height

	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name) + to_vector3(game_info.pivot.offset)

	local pooled_platform_list = self.pooled_platform_list[platform_type]
	local item_table = pooled_platform_list.table
	local cur_item_table_idx = pooled_platform_list.cur_idx
	local max_item_table_idx = table_util.get_size(pooled_platform_list.table)

	local is_spawn_successfully = false
	local pooled_platform_idx = -1

	for idx = cur_item_table_idx, max_item_table_idx do
		local item = item_table[idx]
		local platform_object = item.object
		local platform_transform = platform_object.transform
		local type = item.type
		local is_active = item.is_active

		local type_info = self.platform_info_list[type]
		local type_pos_offset = lua_helper.get_or_default(type_info.pos_offset,
				{ x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 })
		local platform_pos_offset = to_vector3(type_pos_offset)

		if not is_active then
			is_spawn_successfully = true
			platform_transform.position = pivot_pos + platform_pos + platform_pos_offset + vector(0, -cur_height, 0)

			if platform_type == 'fragile' or platform_type == 'fragile2' then
				local platform_animator = platform_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
				self:reset_animator(platform_animator)
				item.is_broken = false
			end

			--인덱스 바꿔줌
			self.pooled_platform_list[platform_type].cur_idx = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
					cur_item_table_idx == max_item_table_idx,
					1,
					idx + 1)

			--활성화 상태로 바꿔줌
			self.pooled_platform_list[platform_type].table[idx].is_active = true

			pooled_platform_idx = idx
			break
		end

		-- 테이블전체를 순회 할 수 있도록 설정.
		if idx == max_item_table_idx then
			max_item_table_idx = cur_item_table_idx - 1
			cur_item_table_idx = 1
		end

	end

	if is_spawn_successfully then
		return pooled_platform_idx
	else
		-- 플랫폼(바닥)을 스폰하지 못했다면, 오류 출력.
		-- FIXME : 최종 작업 까지도 있어야 할까? 싶긴 함.
		exception_stage_exit('The [' .. platform_type .. '] platform spawn failed : insufficient number of pooled objects available.')
		return pooled_platform_idx
	end
end

function local_class:despawn_platform(cur_platform)
	local pooled_platform_list = self.pooled_platform_list
	local pooled_platform = self.pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx]
	local platform_object = pooled_platform.object
	local platform_transform = platform_object.transform

	platform_transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx].is_active = false
end
