function local_class:update_platform(surplus)
	if self:is_max_height_reached(surplus) then
		return
	end
	-- FIXME : 스폰, 디스폰 시킨 다음에 움직여야 할까? 다시 고민해보고 순서 바꾸자.

	-- 플랫폼 움직임
	local despawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.cur_game_info.despawn_pos.name) + to_vector3(self.cur_game_info.despawn_pos.offset)
	local cur_platform_list = self.cur_platform_list

	local despawn_idx_list = {}

	for cur_platform_idx, cur_platform in pairs(cur_platform_list) do
		local pooled_platform_list = self.pooled_platform_list
		local pooled_platform = self.pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx]

		local platform_object = pooled_platform.object
		local platform_transform = platform_object.transform
		local platform_cur_pos = platform_transform.position

		platform_transform.position = vector(
				platform_cur_pos.x,
				platform_cur_pos.y - surplus,
				platform_cur_pos.z)

		-- 일정 높이 이하 디스폰 시키는 곳
		if platform_transform.position.y < despawn_pos.y then
			self:despawn_platform(cur_platform)
			table.insert(despawn_idx_list, cur_platform_idx)
		end

		if self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'boomerang' and
				cur_platform.type == 'victory' then
			local boomerang_offset = to_vector3(self.constants_data.game_info.boomerang.offset)
			self.boomerang.Position = platform_transform.position + boomerang_offset
		end

		--if pooled_platform.dispose_wait and
		--		cur_platform.type == 'fragile' then
		--	if pooled_platform.dispose_time < 0 then
		--		pooled_platform.dispose_wait = false
		--
		--		local platform_animator = platform_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		--		self:reset_animator(platform_animator)
		--		--platform_animator:Play('New State')
		--		--platform_animator.speed = 0
		--		self:despawn_platform(cur_platform)
		--		table.insert(despawn_idx_list, cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx)
		--	else
		--		pooled_platform.dispose_time = pooled_platform.dispose_time - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		--	end
		--end
	end

	-- 순회가 끝난 이후 리스트에서 제거
	for i = 1, #despawn_idx_list do
		table.remove(self.cur_platform_list, 1)
	end

	-- 일정 높이 이상 스폰 시키는 곳
	local height_limit = self.constants_data.game_info.height_limit + self.cur_game_info.height

	-- height_limit 초과하는 데이터의 첫 번째 인덱스 찾기
	local remove_index = -1
	for idx, platform in ipairs(self.wait_platform_list) do
		if platform.pos.y > height_limit then
			break
		else
			-- height_limit 이하의 데이터는 lower_z_data, cur_platform_list에 추가
			table.insert(self.cur_platform_list, platform)
			platform.pooled_platform_idx = self:spawn_platform(platform)
			remove_index = idx
		end
	end

	--TODO self.wait_platform_list가 큐 자료구조 면 이따구로 할 필요 없을 텐데…
	if remove_index ~= -1 then
		for i = 1, remove_index do
			table.remove(self.wait_platform_list, 1)
		end
	end
end


-- FIXME : 리턴 값이 존재하는 업데이트… 조금 불편할지도? 다른 방법 있을까 고민
function local_class:update_character_and_return_surplus(dt)
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = character_data.character
	local move_info = self.character_data.move_info

	--region 좌우 이동 관련 (X 축)

	-- 버튼 눌러진 상태 체크

	--FIXME 여기부분 뭔가 이상하니 한번 체크
	local left_pressed = false
	local right_pressed = false

	local current_left_pressed = self.left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
			or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
			or self.gamepad_left_button_pressed == true

	local current_right_pressed = self.right_button_touch_handler.Pressed
			or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D)
			or self.gamepad_right_button_pressed == true

	-- 터치 체크 (버튼에서 손 땔 때 애니메이션 처리도 해야 되서 ignore_touch_event 상태여도 실행함)
	-- 버튼 누르거나 떼는 Animation 처리 (down : 누른 상태, up : 뗀 상태)
	local left_down = false
	local left_up = false
	local right_down = false
	local right_up = false

	self.left_button_touch_handler:Update()
	self.right_button_touch_handler:Update()

	-- 눌렀는지 떼었는지 확인
	if current_left_pressed ~= left_pressed then
		if current_left_pressed then
			left_down = true
		else
			left_up = true
		end

		left_pressed = current_left_pressed
	elseif current_right_pressed ~= right_pressed then
		if current_right_pressed then
			right_down = true
		else
			right_up = true
		end

		right_pressed = current_right_pressed
	end

	local x_speed_limit = move_info.x_speed_limit
	local x_speed_peak_time = move_info.x_speed_peak_time
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.stun then
		if left_down and right_down then
			local x_speed = self.character_data.cur_x_speed

			if x_speed > 0 then
				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = self.character_data.cur_x_speed -
						x_speed_limit / x_speed_peak_time * dt

				if self.character_data.cur_x_speed < 0 then
					self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0
				end

			elseif x_speed < 0 then
				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = self.character_data.cur_x_speed +
						x_speed_limit / x_speed_peak_time * dt

				if self.character_data.cur_x_speed > 0 then
					self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0
				end


			else
				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0
			end

		elseif left_down then
			self.character_data.cur_x_speed = self.character_data.cur_x_speed -
					x_speed_limit / x_speed_peak_time * dt
			if self.character_data.cur_x_speed < -x_speed_limit then
				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = -x_speed_limit
			end
		elseif right_down then
			self.character_data.cur_x_speed = self.character_data.cur_x_speed +
					x_speed_limit / x_speed_peak_time * dt
			if self.character_data.cur_x_speed > x_speed_limit then
				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = x_speed_limit
			end
		else
			local x_speed = self.character_data.cur_x_speed

			if x_speed > 0 then
				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = self.character_data.cur_x_speed -
						x_speed_limit / x_speed_peak_time * dt

				if self.character_data.cur_x_speed < 0 then
					self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0
				end

			elseif x_speed < 0 then
				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = self.character_data.cur_x_speed +
						x_speed_limit / x_speed_peak_time * dt

				if self.character_data.cur_x_speed > 0 then
					self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0
				end


			else
				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0
			end

		end
	end

	local character_new_pos_x = character.Position.x +
			self.character_data.cur_x_speed * dt
	--endregion

	if self.character_data.cur_x_speed > 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'right')
	elseif self.character_data.cur_x_speed < 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(character, 'left')
	end

	-- 애니메이션은 좀 더 고민
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.stun then
		if self.character_data.cur_speed > 0 then
			scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'get')
		elseif self.character_data.cur_speed < 0 then
			scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'dagger_idle')
		end
	end

	--region 점프 관련(z 축)
	local peak_height = move_info.peak_height
	local peak_time = move_info.peak_time
	local gravity = peak_height * 2 / (peak_time * peak_time)

	self.character_data.cur_speed = self.character_data.cur_speed - gravity * dt

	local jump_height_limit = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.character_data.pivot.name).y
	local character_new_pos_y = character.Position.y +
			self.character_data.cur_speed * dt
	--endregion

	local surplus = character_new_pos_y - jump_height_limit

	if character_new_pos_y > jump_height_limit and not self:is_max_height_reached(surplus) then
		character.Position = vector(character_new_pos_x, jump_height_limit, character.Position.z)
		return surplus
	else
		local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
		local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
		local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name) + to_vector3(game_info.pivot.offset)

		if pivot_pos.y > character_new_pos_y then
			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.defeat
			return 0
		else
			character.Position = vector(character_new_pos_x, character_new_pos_y, character.Position.z)
			return 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:jump_character(height_multiplier, jump_offset)
	height_multiplier = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_multiplier, 1)
	local move_info = self.character_data.move_info

	--플랫폼 밟은 위치 만큼 점프 정도를 보정해 줌
	jump_offset = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(jump_offset < 0, 0, jump_offset)
	local peak_height = move_info.peak_height * height_multiplier + jump_offset

	local peak_time = move_info.peak_time * math.sqrt(height_multiplier)

	local speed = 2 * peak_height / peak_time

	self.character_data.cur_speed = speed

	local character_pos = self.character_data.character.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_01')
	self.water_splash = self.fx:water_splash():Instantiate(character_pos + vector(0, 0, 0))
	self.water_splash.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(20, 0, 0)
	self.water_splash.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function local_class:update_effect(surplus)
	if self.water_splash ~= nil then
		local cur_pos = self.water_splash.transform.localPosition
		local new_pos = cur_pos + vector(0, -surplus, 0)
		self.water_splash.transform.localPosition = new_pos
	end
end

function local_class:stun_character(speed_value)
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = character_data.character

	speed_value = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed_value, 0)

	self.character_data.cur_x_speed = speed_value
	self.character_data.cur_speed = 0
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.stun

	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	local last_hit_fx = self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
	last_hit_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local hit_fx = self.fx:hit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
	hit_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local angle = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(speed_value > 0, 720, -720)
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, angle, 2)
end

function local_class:update_background(move_rate)
	if self:is_max_height_reached(move_rate) then
		return
	end

	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name) + self.background.pivot

	local up_limit_pos = pivot_pos + self.background.size * 2
	local under_limit_pos = pivot_pos - self.background.size * 2

	for i = 1, #self.background.pooled do
		local cur_pos = self.background.pooled[i].transform.position
		local new_pos = cur_pos + vector(0, -move_rate, 0)
		self.background.pooled[i].transform.position = new_pos
	end

	for i = 1, #self.background.pooled do
		local cur_pos = self.background.pooled[i].transform.position
		if cur_pos.y < under_limit_pos.y then
			local max_y_index = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(i - 1 < 1, #self.background.pooled, i - 1)
			self.background.pooled[i].transform.position = self.background.pooled[max_y_index].transform.position + self.background.size
			break
		end
	end


end

function local_class:update_num_count()
	local game_info = self.cur_game_info
	local half_height_limit = game_info.height_limit / 2
	local cur_height = self.cur_game_info.height
	local num_count = 0

	if cur_height <= 0 then
		local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
		local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)

		local character_data = self.character_data
		local character = get_character(character_data.name)
		local character_pos = character.Position

		self.cur_game_info.max_height_before_scroll = math.max(half_height_limit + character_pos.y,
				self.cur_game_info.max_height_before_scroll)

		num_count = math.ceil(self.cur_game_info.max_height_before_scroll)
	else
		num_count = math.ceil((cur_height + half_height_limit))
	end

	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(num_count)
end

function local_class:caching_character_position()
	-- 충돌 체크 용 : 과거 위치 기억 해 두기
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)
	local character_pos = character.Position

	self.character_data.cached_pos = character_pos
end

function local_class:check_platform_hit()
	local cur_platform_list = self.cur_platform_list

	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)
	local character_cur_pos = character.Position
	local character_hitbox_pos = character_cur_pos + to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.offset)
	local character_hitbox_size = to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.size)

	--캐싱된 과거 캐릭터 위치
	local cached_pos = self.character_data.cached_pos
	local cached_hitbox_pos = cached_pos + to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.offset)
	local cached_hitbox_size = to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.offset)
	--과거와 현재 거리
	local moved_length = (character_cur_pos - cached_pos).magnitude

	local center_pos = character_cur_pos / 2 + cached_pos / 2

	local center_hitbox_pos = character_hitbox_pos / 2 + cached_hitbox_pos / 2
	local center_hitbox_size = vector(character_hitbox_pos.x + moved_length, character_hitbox_pos.y + moved_length, character_hitbox_pos.x)

	for cur_platform_idx, cur_platform in pairs(cur_platform_list) do
		local pooled_platform_list = self.pooled_platform_list
		local pooled_platform = pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx]

		local platform_object = pooled_platform.object
		local platform_type = pooled_platform.type
		local type_info = self.platform_info_list[platform_type]
		local is_broken = pooled_platform.is_broken

		local platform_cur_pos = platform_object.transform.position
		local platform_hitbox_offset = to_vector3(type_info.hitbox.offset)
		local platform_hitbox_pos = platform_cur_pos + platform_hitbox_offset

		local platform_hitbox_size = to_vector3(type_info.hitbox.size)
		local height_scale = type_info.height_scale

		--점프 오프셋, 플레이어가 플랫폼 히트박스를 밟은 위치가 낮으면 낮을 수록 그만큼 더 뛰게 만든다.
		--추가된 이유 : 플랫폼을 상대적으로 아래를 밟았을 때와 위를 밟았을 때랑 도달할 수 있는 높이가 달랐음.
		--이에 따라 잘못 밟으면(아래를 밟으면) 거리가 간신히 닿는 플랫폼 까지 뛰지 못하는 경우가 발생
		local jump_offset = platform_cur_pos.y + platform_hitbox_offset.y + platform_hitbox_size.y * 0.5 - character_cur_pos.y

		if self:platform_collision_check(character_hitbox_pos, character_hitbox_size, platform_hitbox_pos, platform_hitbox_size) and
				self:is_in_camera(platform_cur_pos) then
			if (platform_type == 'fragile' or platform_type == 'fragile2') and not is_broken then
				self:jump_character(height_scale, jump_offset)
				self:animate_platform(cur_platform, 'break')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_wood_01')
				pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx].is_broken = true
			elseif platform_type == 'jump' then
				self:jump_character(height_scale, jump_offset)
				self:animate_swell_platform(cur_platform, 'swell')
			elseif platform_type == 'victory' then
				self:win_game()
			elseif platform_type == 'normal' or platform_type == 'normal2' or platform_type == 'normal3' then
				self:jump_character(height_scale, jump_offset)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:platform_collision_check(c_pos, c_hitbox, p_pos, p_hitbox)
	return p_pos.x - (p_hitbox.x / 2) - (c_hitbox.x / 2) < c_pos.x and
			c_pos.x < p_pos.x + (p_hitbox.x / 2) + (c_hitbox.x / 2) and
			p_pos.y - (p_hitbox.y / 2) + (c_hitbox.y / 2) < c_pos.y and
			c_pos.y < p_pos.y + (p_hitbox.y / 2) + (c_hitbox.y / 2)
end

function local_class:is_in_camera(platform_cur_pos)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	local cur_y = platform_cur_pos.y
	local up_pos_y = camera_pos.y + cam_half_height
	local down_pos_y = camera_pos.y - cam_half_height

	return down_pos_y < cur_y and cur_y < up_pos_y
end

function local_class:check_obstacle_hit()
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)
	local character_pos = character.Position
	local character_hitbox_pos = character_pos + to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.offset)
	local character_hitbox = to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.size)

	if self.goat_data ~= nil then
		local goat_info = self.constants_data.obstacle.goat
		local goat = self.goat
		local goat_pos = goat.Position
		local goat_hitbox_info = goat_info.hitbox
		local goat_hitbox_pos = goat_pos + to_vector3(goat_hitbox_info.offset)
		local goat_hitbox = to_vector3(goat_hitbox_info.size)

		if self.cur_goat_state == self.goat_state.moving and
				self:obstacle_collision_check(character_hitbox_pos, character_hitbox, goat_hitbox_pos, goat_hitbox) then
			local speed_value = goat_info.dir_value * goat_info.speed
			self:stun_character(speed_value)
		end
	end

	if self.rock_slide_data ~= nil then
		local rs_info = self.constants_data.obstacle.rock_slide
		local rs = self.rock_slide
		local rs_pos = rs.Position
		local rs_hitbox_info = rs_info.hitbox
		local rs_hitbox_pos = rs_pos + to_vector3(rs_hitbox_info.offset)
		local rs_hitbox = to_vector3(rs_hitbox_info.size)

		if self.cur_rs_state == self.rs_state.falling and
				self:obstacle_collision_check(character_hitbox_pos, character_hitbox, rs_hitbox_pos, rs_hitbox) then
			self:stun_character(0)
		end
	end

	if self.falling_people_data ~= nil then
		local fp_info = self.constants_data.obstacle.falling_people
		local fp = self.falling_people_list[self.falling_people_dynamic_cur_idx]
		local fp_pos = fp.Position
		local fp_hitbox_info = fp_info.hitbox
		local fp_hitbox_pos = fp_pos + to_vector3(fp_hitbox_info.offset)
		local fp_hitbox = to_vector3(fp_hitbox_info.size)

		if self.cur_fp_state == self.fp_state.falling and
				self:obstacle_collision_check(character_hitbox_pos, character_hitbox, fp_hitbox_pos, fp_hitbox) then
			self:stun_character(0)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:obstacle_collision_check(c_pos, c_hitbox, o_pos, o_hitbox)
	return o_pos.x - (o_hitbox.x / 2) - (c_hitbox.x / 2) < c_pos.x and
			c_pos.x < o_pos.x + (o_hitbox.x / 2) + (c_hitbox.x / 2) and
			o_pos.y - (o_hitbox.y / 2) - (c_hitbox.y / 2) < c_pos.y and
			c_pos.y < o_pos.y + (o_hitbox.y / 2) + (c_hitbox.y / 2)
end

function local_class:init_obstacle()
	local obstacle_data = self.constants_data.obstacle

	--region goat
	self.goat_data = obstacle_data.goat
	if self.goat_data ~= nil then
		self.goat = get_character(goat_data.name)

		self.goat.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goat)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.goat, active_state_type.enabled)
		self.goat.SpineController.TimeScale = goat_data.anim_scale
		character_util.set_scale_factor(self.goat, self.goat.Name, goat_data.size_scale)

		self.goat_index = 1

		self.goat_state = {
			none = 1,
			wait_spawn = 2,
			spawn = 3,
			moving = 4,
			stop = 5,
		}
		self.constants_data.obstacle.goat.dir_value = 1

		self.cur_goat_state = self.goat_state.wait_spawn

		self.goat_state_change_time = 0
	end
	--endregion

	--region rock_slide
	self.rock_slide_data = obstacle_data.rock_slide

	if self.rock_slide_data ~= nil then
		if self.rock_slide == nil then
			self.rock_slide = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
				itemid = self.rock_slide_data.item_id, notforinven = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = self.rock_slide_data.sprscale
			})
			self.rock_slide.SpriteTransform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)
			self.rock_slide.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

		self.rock_slide_index = 1

		self.rs_state = {
			none = 1,
			wait_spawn = 2,
			spawn = 3,
			falling = 4,
			stop = 5,
		}
		self.cur_rs_state = self.rs_state.wait_spawn
		self.rs_state_change_time = 0
	end
	--endregion

	--region falling_people
	self.falling_people_data = obstacle_data.falling_people
	if self.falling_people_data ~= nil then
		if self.falling_people_dynamic == nil then
			local spec_name_list = self.falling_people_data.spec_name_list

			self.falling_people_dynamic = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_name_list)

			self.falling_people_list = {}
			for _, npc in pairs(self.falling_people_dynamic) do
				npc.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.falling_people)
				field_object_util.set_active_state(self.falling_people, active_state_type.enabled)

				self:set_custom_shader(npc)

				scene_util.set_direction(npc, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })

				table.insert(self.falling_people_list, npc)
			end
			self.falling_people_dynamic_cur_idx = 1

		end

		self.falling_people_index = 1

		self.fp_state = {
			none = 1,
			wait_spawn = 2,
			spawn = 3,
			falling = 4,
			stop = 5,
		}
		self.cur_fp_state = self.fp_state.wait_spawn
		self.fp_state_change_time = 0

		self.fp_speech_list = self.constants_data.obstacle.falling_people.speech_list
		self.cur_fp_speech_idx = 1
	end
	--endregion


	local obstacle_pattern_list = obstacle_data.pattern_list
	local pattern_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, table_util.get_size(obstacle_pattern_list))
	self.obstacle_pattern = obstacle_pattern_list[pattern_index]

	local spawn_pos_x = obstacle_data.spawn_pos_x
	self.obstacle_pattern_list = {}

	for obstacle_name, obstacle_height_list in pairs(self.obstacle_pattern) do
		local obstacle_pattern = {}

		for i = 1, #obstacle_height_list do

			local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, table_util.get_size(spawn_pos_x))
			local random_pos_x = spawn_pos_x[random_index]

			local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
			local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
			local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)

			local pattern = vector(random_pos_x, obstacle_height_list[i], pivot_pos.z)
			table.insert(obstacle_pattern, pattern)
		end

		self.obstacle_pattern_list[obstacle_name] = obstacle_pattern
	end
end

function local_class:update_obstacle(time_passed, surplus, dt)
	if self.rock_slide_data ~= nil then
		self:update_rock_slide(time_passed, surplus, dt)
	end

	if self.goat_data ~= nil then
		self:update_goat(time_passed, surplus, dt)
	end

	if self.falling_people_data ~= nil then
		self:update_falling_people(time_passed, surplus, dt)
	end
end

function local_class:update_rock_slide(time_passed, surplus, dt)
	local rs_info = self.constants_data.obstacle.rock_slide

	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)
	local offset = to_vector3(rs_info.offset)
	local spawn_pivot_pos = pivot_pos + offset

	local height_offset = rs_info.height_offset

	if self.cur_rs_state == self.rs_state.wait_spawn then
		local spawn_pos_list = self.obstacle_pattern_list['rock_slide']
		local cur_index = self.rock_slide_index
		local cur_height = self.cur_game_info.height

		if cur_index > table_util.get_size(spawn_pos_list) then
			self.cur_rs_state = self.rs_state.stop
			return
		end

		local spawn_pos_x = spawn_pos_list[cur_index].x
		local spawn_pos_y = spawn_pos_list[cur_index].y - height_offset

		if cur_height > spawn_pos_y then

			--이펙트 생성
			local fx_falling_rock = self.fx.falling_rock():Instantiate(vector(spawn_pivot_pos.x + spawn_pos_x, pivot_pos.y + offset.y, pivot_pos.z))
			fx_falling_rock.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)

			self.rs_state_change_time = time_passed

			self.cur_rs_state = self.rs_state.spawn
		end
	elseif self.cur_rs_state == self.rs_state.spawn then
		local wait_time = rs_info.wait_time
		if time_passed > self.rs_state_change_time + wait_time then
			local cur_index = self.rock_slide_index
			local spawn_pos_x = self.obstacle_pattern_list['rock_slide'][cur_index].x
			self.rock_slide.Position = vector(spawn_pivot_pos.x + spawn_pos_x, pivot_pos.y + offset.y, spawn_pivot_pos.z)
			self.cur_rs_state = self.rs_state.falling
			rs_info.cur_speed = 0
		end
	elseif self.cur_rs_state == self.rs_state.falling then
		local gravity = rs_info.gravity

		rs_info.cur_speed = rs_info.cur_speed - gravity * dt

		surplus = lua_helper.get_or_default(surplus, 0)

		local rock_new_pos_y = self.rock_slide.Position.y +
				rs_info.cur_speed * dt - surplus

		local obstacle_info = self.constants_data.obstacle
		local despawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(obstacle_info.despawn_pos.name) + to_vector3(obstacle_info.despawn_pos.offset)
		if rock_new_pos_y > despawn_pos.y then
			self.rock_slide.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.rock_slide.Position, rock_new_pos_y)
		else
			self.rock_slide_index = self.rock_slide_index + 1
			self.rock_slide.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

			self.cur_rs_state = self.rs_state.wait_spawn
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_goat(time_passed, surplus, dt)
	local goat_info = self.constants_data.obstacle.goat

	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)
	local offset = to_vector3(goat_info.offset)
	local spawn_pivot_pos = pivot_pos + to_vector3(goat_info.offset)

	local height_offset = goat_info.height_offset

	if self.cur_goat_state == self.goat_state.wait_spawn then
		local spawn_pos_list = self.obstacle_pattern_list['goat']
		local cur_index = self.goat_index
		local cur_height = self.cur_game_info.height

		if cur_index > table_util.get_size(spawn_pos_list) then
			self.cur_goat_state = self.goat_state.stop
			return
		end

		local spawn_pos_y = spawn_pos_list[cur_index].y - height_offset

		if cur_height > spawn_pos_y then

			self.rs_state_change_time = time_passed

			self.cur_goat_state = self.goat_state.spawn
		end
	elseif self.cur_goat_state == self.goat_state.spawn then

		local cur_index = self.goat_index

		local spawn_pos_x = self.obstacle_pattern_list['goat'][cur_index].x

		self.goat.Position = vector(spawn_pivot_pos.x + spawn_pos_x,
				pivot_pos.y + offset.y,
				spawn_pivot_pos.z + offset.z)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goat)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.goat, active_state_type.enabled)

		scene_util.set_anim(self.goat, self, { name = 'walk' })

		--초기 방향(랜덤)
		local random_num = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
		local random_dir_num = -2 * random_num + 3
		local random_dir_string = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(random_dir_num == 1, 'right', 'left')
		self.constants_data.obstacle.goat.dir_value = random_dir_num

		character_util.set_direction(self.goat, random_dir_string)

		self.cur_goat_state = self.goat_state.moving

	elseif self.cur_goat_state == self.goat_state.moving then
		--좌우 움직임 관련
		local moving_range_min_x = goat_info.offset.x + goat_info.moving_range.min + pivot_pos.x
		local moving_range_max_x = goat_info.offset.x + goat_info.moving_range.max + pivot_pos.x

		--좌우 범위 벗어나면
		local goat_pos_x = self.goat.Position.x
		if goat_pos_x < moving_range_min_x then
			self.constants_data.obstacle.goat.dir_value = 1
			character_util.set_direction(self.goat, 'right')
		elseif goat_pos_x > moving_range_max_x then
			self.constants_data.obstacle.goat.dir_value = -1
			character_util.set_direction(self.goat, 'left')
		end

		local goat_new_pos_x = goat_pos_x +
				goat_info.dir_value * goat_info.speed * dt

		--상하 움직임 관련
		surplus = lua_helper.get_or_default(surplus, 0)
		local goat_new_pos_y = self.goat.Position.y - surplus

		local obstacle_info = self.constants_data.obstacle
		local despawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(obstacle_info.despawn_pos.name) + to_vector3(obstacle_info.despawn_pos.offset)

		if goat_new_pos_y > despawn_pos.y then
			self.goat.Position = vector(goat_new_pos_x, goat_new_pos_y, pivot_pos.z + offset.z)
		else
			self.goat_index = self.goat_index + 1
			self.goat.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goat)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(self.goat, active_state_type.disabled)

			self.cur_goat_state = self.goat_state.wait_spawn
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_falling_people(time_passed, surplus, dt)
	local fp_info = self.constants_data.obstacle.falling_people

	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)
	local offset = to_vector3(fp_info.offset)
	local spawn_pivot_pos = pivot_pos + offset

	local height_offset = fp_info.height_offset

	local cur_falling_people = self.falling_people_list[self.falling_people_dynamic_cur_idx]
	local cur_speech = self.fp_speech_list[self.cur_fp_speech_idx]

	if self.cur_fp_state == self.fp_state.wait_spawn then
		local spawn_pos_list = self.obstacle_pattern_list['falling_people']
		local cur_index = self.falling_people_index
		local cur_height = self.cur_game_info.height

		if cur_index > table_util.get_size(spawn_pos_list) then
			self.cur_fp_state = self.fp_state.stop
			return
		end

		local spawn_pos_y = spawn_pos_list[cur_index].y - height_offset

		local random_rotate = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5, -1, 1)
		character_util.spine_rotate(cur_falling_people, 90 * random_rotate, 0)

		if cur_height > spawn_pos_y then
			self.fp_spawn_pos_x = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(self.constants_data.obstacle.falling_people.hard_mode,
					get_character(self.character_data.name).Position.x - spawn_pivot_pos.x,
					spawn_pos_list[cur_index].x)

			local speech_offset = to_vector3(fp_info.speech_offset)
			local speech_world_pos = vector(spawn_pivot_pos.x + self.fp_spawn_pos_x + speech_offset.x,
					pivot_pos.y + offset.y + speech_offset.y,
					spawn_pivot_pos.z + speech_offset.z)

			start_coroutine(function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(cur_falling_people, self, nil, nil, nil,
						{ key = cur_speech,
						  skip = false,
						  world_pos = speech_world_pos,
						  euler_angle = vector(0, 0, 0) })
			end)

			self.fp_state_change_time = time_passed

			self.cur_fp_state = self.fp_state.spawn
		end
	elseif self.cur_fp_state == self.fp_state.spawn then
		local wait_time = fp_info.wait_time
		if time_passed > self.fp_state_change_time + wait_time then
			local cur_index = self.falling_people_index

			self.fp_spawn_pos_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.fp_spawn_pos_x, self.obstacle_pattern_list['falling_people'][cur_index].x)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
			cur_falling_people.Position = vector(spawn_pivot_pos.x + self.fp_spawn_pos_x, pivot_pos.y + offset.y, spawn_pivot_pos.z)
			self.cur_fp_state = self.fp_state.falling
			fp_info.cur_speed = 0
		end
	elseif self.cur_fp_state == self.fp_state.falling then
		local gravity = fp_info.gravity

		fp_info.cur_speed = fp_info.cur_speed - gravity * dt

		surplus = lua_helper.get_or_default(surplus, 0)

		local rock_new_pos_y = cur_falling_people.Position.y +
				fp_info.cur_speed * dt - surplus

		local obstacle_info = self.constants_data.obstacle
		local despawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(obstacle_info.despawn_pos.name) + to_vector3(obstacle_info.despawn_pos.offset)
		if rock_new_pos_y > despawn_pos.y then
			cur_falling_people.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(cur_falling_people.Position, rock_new_pos_y)
		else
			self.falling_people_index = self.falling_people_index + 1
			cur_falling_people.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			character_util.spine_rotate(cur_falling_people, 0, 0)

			self.falling_people_dynamic_cur_idx = self.falling_people_dynamic_cur_idx + 1
			if self.falling_people_dynamic_cur_idx > #self.falling_people_list then
				self.falling_people_dynamic_cur_idx = 1
			end

			self.cur_fp_speech_idx = self.cur_fp_speech_idx + 1
			if self.cur_fp_speech_idx > #self.fp_speech_list then
				self.cur_fp_speech_idx = 1
			end

			self.cur_fp_state = self.fp_state.wait_spawn
		end
	end
end

function local_class:win_game()
	self.character_data.cur_speed = 0
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.victory
end

function local_class:is_max_height_reached(surplus)
	surplus = lua_helper.get_or_default(surplus, 0)
	return self.cur_game_info.height + surplus > self.cur_game_info.max_height - self.constants_data.game_info.height_limit / 2
end

function local_class:victory_scene()
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)

	local pivot_name = character_data.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)

	local character_pos = character.Position
	local is_qte_success = false


	--TODO constants_data에서 가져오는 것으로 수정
	local goat = self.goat

	-- 카메라 줌인 (5, 1)
	character_util.hide_weapon(character, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
	camera_util.move(vector_util.get_0yz(character_pos, pivot_pos.x), 1)
	wp_util.move(character, vector(pivot_pos.x, character_pos.y, character_pos.z), 1, nil)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 1)

	-- 마지막 발판 오르면 코르네 (right, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
	character_util.hide_weapon(character, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)

	character_pos = character.Position

	local euler_angle = vector(0, 0, 0)

	while not is_qte_success do

		-- 이후 대사 출력

		-- 코르네 (right, idle, idle): 이제… 거의 다 온 것 같은데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(character, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_doodle_jump_1', skip = true, euler_angle = euler_angle })

		-- 코르네 (right, idle, idle): 남은 부분은 단숨에 올라가자!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(character, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_doodle_jump_2', skip = true, euler_angle = euler_angle })

		-- 코르네 (right, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) 출력 시작되며 QTE 진행
		scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop' })

		-- 터치 QTE 진행
		--qte_play_util.show_turbo_tap()
		local is_camera_resized = false

		--터치 횟수 10회
		is_qte_success = qte_play_util.tap(10, {
			-- 제한 시간 3초
			duration = 3,
			-- 1회 터치 시
			tap_count_callback = function()
				-- 카메라 줌인 (4.5, 0.3)
				if not is_camera_resized then
					camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.5, 0.3)
					is_camera_resized = true
				end
				-- 카메라 shake (0.05)
				camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.1)
			end
		})

		screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
		self:hide_common_ui()

		if not is_qte_success then
			-- 실패 연출
			-- 왼쪽 상단에서 황색 산양이 등장하며 충돌

			local goat_start_pos = character.Position + vector(-8, 6, 0)
			goat.Position = goat_start_pos
			scene_util.set_direction(goat, 'right', false)

			local goat_speed = 4
			goat.SpineController.TimeScale = 2
			field_object_util.set_active_state(goat, active_state_type.enabled)

			scene_util.set_anim(goat, self, { name = 'walk' })

			--region goat_in_routine
			do
				local time_passed = 0
				local start_pos = goat_start_pos
				local end_pos = character.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0)

				local falling_speed = 6
				local diff = math.abs(start_pos.x - end_pos.x)

				local duration = diff / falling_speed

				local height = math.abs(start_pos.y - end_pos.y)

				while time_passed < duration do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					local progress = time_passed / duration
					local cur_pos_x = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos.x, end_pos.x, progress)
					local cur_pos_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos.z, end_pos.z, progress)

					local cur_height = math.cos(math.pi / 2 * progress) * height
					if cur_height < 0 then
						cur_height = 0
					end
					local cur_pos_y = end_pos.y + cur_height

					goat.Position = vector(cur_pos_x, cur_pos_y, cur_pos_z)

					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				goat.Position = end_pos

			end

			wp_util.move_async(goat, character.Position, goat_speed)
			--region goat_in_routine

			-- 충돌과 동시에 fx_hit와 fx_lasthit가 출력
			-- 코르네는 (down, damaged, embarrassed) 출력되며 아래로 떨어지며 사라짐
			scene_util.set_direction(character, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

			local last_hit_fx = self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
			last_hit_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

			local hit_fx = self.fx:hit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
			hit_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

			--region goat_out_routine
			local goat_out_routine = true
			wp_util.move(goat, {
				character_pos + vector(6, 0, 0),
				character_pos + vector(-6, 0, 0),
			}, goat_speed)

			-- endregion

			local character_speed = 0
			local time_passed = 0
			local max_time = 2
			--TODO constants_data에서 가져오는 것으로 수정
			local gravity = 9.8
			local x_speed = 2

			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 720, max_time)
			while time_passed < max_time do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				character_speed = character_speed - gravity * unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local new_x = x_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local new_y = character_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
				character.Position = character.Position + vector(new_x, new_y, 0)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

			-- 마지막 발판 올라와서 진행하는 대사부터 진행
			scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
			character.Position = character_pos
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
			character_util.stop(character)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goat)
			scene_util.set_direction(goat, 'right', false)

			goat.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(goat, active_state_type.disabled)

			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0)

			wait_for_sec(1)

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
		end
	end

	-- 성공 연출

	-- 카메라 줌아웃 (5, 0.3)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0.3)

	-- 코르네 (right, attack, jump) 상태에서 현재 위치에서 0.5초에 걸쳐 Z축 +20 만큼 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'jump' })
	wp_util.move_async(character, character.Position + vector(0, 20, 0), nil, 0.5)

	-- 1초 후 ‘액티비티 완료’ 텍스트 출력
	wait_for_sec(1)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

function local_class:victory_scene_carp_girl(is_hard)
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)
	local stats_behaviour = character.CharacterStatsBehaviour
	local portrait_asset_name = stats_behaviour.CharacterSpec.PortraitAssetName.assetName

	local pivot_name = character_data.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)

	local character_pos = character.Position

	--<클리어 연출 대본 - 2섹션 미니게임>
	--
	--※현재 구성된 ‘코르네 연출’에서 크게 바뀌지 않습니다
	--(*마지막 발판에 오른 뒤) 금린 (right, idle, walk) 상태로, 0.5초에 걸쳐 마지막 발판 중앙으로 이동 후
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.4)
	
	character_util.hide_weapon(character, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
	camera_util.move(character_pos, 0.5)
	wp_util.move(character, vector(pivot_pos.x, character_pos.y, character_pos.z), 0.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
	character_util.hide_weapon(character, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)

	character_pos = character.Position

	local euler_angle = vector(0, 0, 0)

	--2섹션 - 금린 (right, tired, cast) : 후욱… 후욱….
	--5섹션 - 금린 (right, scared, cast) : 후욱…! 후욱…!
	do
		local speech_key = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_hard, 'mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_1', 'mm_carp_girl_mini_s2_1')
		local emotion = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_hard, 'scared', 'tired')
		local anim = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_hard, 'cast', 'cast')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(character, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				{ name = anim, keep = true },
				{ name = emotion, keep = true },
				{ key = speech_key, skip = true, euler_angle = euler_angle, portraitname = portrait_asset_name })

	end

	--표정 및 모션 유지한 채 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--2섹션 - 금린 (right, damaged, boong_attack_ready_loop) : 여, 여기만 넘으면 되네… 단숨에 뛰어보겠어!
	--5섹션 - 금린 (right, damaged, boong_attack_ready_loop) : 조, 조금만… 조금만 더 오르면 끝일세…!
	do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		local speech_key = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_hard, 'mm_carp_girl_mini_s5_2', 'mm_carp_girl_mini_s2_2')
		local emotion = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_hard, 'damaged', 'damaged')
		local anim = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_hard, 'boong_attack_ready_loop', 'boong_attack_ready_loop')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(character, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				{ name = anim, keep = true },
				{ name = emotion, keep = true },
				{ key = speech_key, skip = true, euler_angle = euler_angle, portraitname = portrait_asset_name })

	end

	qte_play_util.tap(10, {
		-- 1회 터치 시
		tap_count_callback = function()
			-- 카메라 shake (0.05)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_click_party_preset_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.1)
		end
	})

	--(*QTE 종료 시, 금린 상위로 뛰어오르는 연출에)
	--금린 있던 위치에 FX_lasthit 이펙트 1회 출력
	local character_bounds_center = character.Bounds.center
	local fx_last_hit = self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(character_bounds_center)
	fx_last_hit.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)


	--이후 액티비티 완료 연출 출력
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', volume = 0.5 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_11', volume = 0.5 })
	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'jump' })
	wp_util.move_async(character, character.Position + vector(0, 20, 0), nil, 0.5)

	--0.5초 뒤 액티비티 완료 UI 등장
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--이후 1초에 걸쳐  fade out
	self.fail_count = 0
	self:fade_out_waterfall_sfx()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)

	self:unload_all()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))

	self:show_common_ui()
end

function local_class:fade_in_waterfall_sfx()
	if self.amb_sfx == nil then
		self.amb_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_amb_waterfall_01', fade_in_time = 2, loop = true
		})
	end
end

function local_class:fade_out_waterfall_sfx()
	if self.amb_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.amb_sfx, 1)
		self.amb_sfx = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class();
	end
}

--- 드리블 볼 (DribbleBallGame) 미니 게임 컨트롤러
local local_class = newclass('DribbleBallGame')

local character_state_base = newclass('DribbleBallGameCharacterState')

local enemy_idle_state = newclass('DribbleBallEnemyIdleState', character_state_base)
local enemy_appear_state = newclass('DribbleBallEnemyAppearState', character_state_base)
local enemy_chase_state = newclass('DribbleBallEnemyChaseState', character_state_base)
local enemy_stun_state = newclass('DribbleBallEnemyStunState', character_state_base)
local enemy_stationary_state = newclass('DribbleBallEnemyStationaryState', character_state_base)

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 미니게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'DribbleBallGame'

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- game state
	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		play = 3,
		fail = 4,
		ending = 5,
	}
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none

	-- round state
	self.game_level_state = {
		tutorial = 0,
		level_1 = 1,
	}
	self.cur_level_state = self.game_level_state.tutorial

	-- game over type
	self.game_over_type = {
		none = 0,
		steal_ball = 1,
		ball_gose_over_the_line = 2,
	}
	self.game_over = self.game_over_type.none

	-- Constants Data
	self.game_data = nil

	-- 게임 진행중에 있는지?
	self.is_playing_game = false

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = nil

	-- string key
	self.string_key = nil

	self.tutorial_played_more_than_once = false
	self.played_more_than_once = false
	self.retry = false

	-- NPC
	-- 사용할 플레이어 캐릭터
	self.get_player = nil
	-- 공 기믹
	self.get_ball = nil

	-- 적이 터치할 공의 바운드
	self.enemy_touch_ball_bound = nil

	-- marker
	-- 유저 스폰 포인트
	self.player_spawn_pos = nil

	-- 카메라 위치
	self.get_minigame_camera_pos = nil

	-- 카메라 위치
	self.minigame_area_name = nil

	-- enemy npc list
	self.level_info_list = {}

	-- 게임 시간
	self.play_time = 0
	self.max_play_time = 0

	-- 파티원 백업
	self.backup_party_member_list = {}

	-- 공을 잡은 적 unique index
	self.captured_ball_enemy_index = -1

	-- effect
	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	-- 게임 데이터 및 키 세팅
	local before_data_key = self.constants_data_key
	self.constants_data_key = key
	if self.game_data == nil or before_data_key ~= self.constants_data_key then
		-- game_data 키가 세팅이 안되있거나 이전 데이터 키랑 다른 값이 세팅되어 있다면 game_data 다시 세팅
		self.game_data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(
				'minigame/DribbleBallGame/DribbleBallGameConstants', self.constants_data_key)
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	self.string_key = self.game_data.string_key

	self.fx:load_all()

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self:game_pre_init()

	-- 준비 끝났으면 콜백 보냄
	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none
	self.is_playing_game = false

	for i = 1, #self.level_info_list do
		if self.level_info_list[i] ~= nil then
			local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[i].enemy_info_list

			if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
				for j = 1, #enemy_info_list do
					enemy_info_list[j].enemy = nil
					enemy_info_list[j].info = nil

					enemy_info_list[j].state:exit()
					enemy_info_list[j].state:dispose()
					enemy_info_list[j].state = nil
				end

				enemy_info_list = nil
			end

			self.level_info_list[i] = nil
		end
	end

	if self.is_playing_game then
		self.is_playing_game = false
	end

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.play then
		self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none
	end

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.game_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(_)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return false
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.Zone.Name == self.minigame_area_name and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_ball()) then

		start_coroutine(self.get_out_game_line, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:event_subscribe()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
end

function local_class:game_pre_init()-- 게임 캐릭터 셋팅
	self.retry = false

	self.captured_ball_enemy_index = -1

	-- 오브젝트 셋팅
	self:initialize_object()

	-- 각 캐릭터 셋팅
	self:initialize_character_data()

	self:event_subscribe()

	-- 게임 로직 시작 전 카메라 크기 조정
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0.1)
end

function local_class:initialize_character_data()
	-- enemy setting
	if self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state] ~= nil then
		local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].enemy_info_list

		if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
			for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do
				enemy_info_list[i].enemy = nil
				enemy_info_list[i].info = nil
				enemy_info_list[i].state = nil
			end
			enemy_info_list = nil
		end

		enemy_info_list = {}
	end

	local level_data = self.game_data.level_info[self.cur_level_state]

	if level_data ~= nil then-- enemy
		self.max_play_time = level_data.max_play_time

		self.minigame_area_name = self.game_data.minigame_area

		-- player
		local leader = get_party_leader()

		-- 캐릭터 게임 시작 위치로 이동
		self.player_spawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(level_data.player_start_marker_name)

		-- 파티 멤버 백업
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local member = user_party[i]

			table.insert(self.backup_party_member_list, member)
		end

		party_util.remain_only_leader()

		character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(leader, self.player_spawn_pos)
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, level_data.player_start_direction, false)

		for i = 0, #self.game_data.level_info do
			level_data = self.game_data.level_info[i]

			local enemy_list = level_data.appear_enemy_list

			local save_enemy_info_list = {}

			for j = 1, #enemy_list do
				local enemy_info = enemy_list[j]
				local enemy = get_character(enemy_info.name)

				if enemy ~= nil then
					if self.cur_level_state == i then
						character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'enabled')

						if enemy_info.appear_start_marker_name ~= nil then
							local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(enemy_info.appear_start_marker_name)

							character_util.set_position(enemy, start_pos)

							scene_util.set_direction(enemy, enemy_info.dir, false)
						end
					else
						character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'disabled')

						character_util.set_position(enemy, vector(999, 0, 999))
					end

					if enemy_info.ethereal_crash then
						enemy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
					end

					-- enemy_info 객체
					local add_enemy_info = {
						enemy = nil,
						info = nil,
						state = nil,
					}

					add_enemy_info.enemy = enemy
					add_enemy_info.info = enemy_info

					add_enemy_info.state = enemy_idle_state(self, add_enemy_info)
					add_enemy_info.state:enter()

					table.insert(save_enemy_info_list, add_enemy_info)
				end
			end

			local audience_list = level_data.audience_list

			for k = 1, #audience_list do
				local audience_info = audience_list[k]
				local audience = get_character(audience_info.name)

				if audience ~= nil then
					if self.cur_level_state == i then
						character_util.set_active_state(audience, 'enabled')

						if audience_info.marker_name ~= nil then
							local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(audience_info.marker_name)

							character_util.set_position(audience, start_pos)

							scene_util.set_direction(audience, audience_info.dir, false)
						end
					end

					-- 오브젝트의 캐릭터 스텟UI 지우기
					field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(audience, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
				end
			end

			self.level_info_list[i] = {
				max_play_time = level_data.max_play_time,

				player_start_marker_name = level_data.player_start_marker_name,
				player_start_direction = level_data.player_start_direction,

				starting_line_list = level_data.starting_line_list,
				ending_line_list = level_data.ending_line_list,
				reset_line_list = level_data.reset_line_list,

				enemy_info_list = save_enemy_info_list,

				audience_list = level_data.audience_list,
			}
		end
	end
end

function local_class:reset_game()
	local level_info = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state]
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.retry = true

	self.captured_ball_enemy_index = -1

	self:clean_up_enemies(true, self.cur_level_state - 1)

	-- 게임 플레이 시간 재설정
	self.max_play_time = level_info.max_play_time

	-- 캐릭터 게임 시작 위치로 이동
	self.player_spawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(level_info.player_start_marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.player_spawn_pos)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, level_info.player_start_direction, false)

	self:initialize_object()

	local enemy_info_list = level_info.enemy_info_list

	for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do
		local enemy_info = enemy_info_list[i]

		if enemy_info.info.appear_start_marker_name ~= nil then
			local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(enemy_info.info.appear_start_marker_name)

			character_util.set_position(enemy_info.enemy, start_pos)

			scene_util.set_direction(enemy_info.enemy, enemy_info.info.dir, false)
		end

		enemy_info.state = enemy_idle_state(self, enemy_info)
		enemy_info.state:enter()
	end

	for k = 1, #level_info.audience_list do
		local audience_info = level_info.audience_list[k]
		local audience = get_character(audience_info.name)

		if audience ~= nil then
			if self.cur_level_state == i then
				character_util.set_active_state(audience, 'enabled')

				if audience_info.marker_name ~= nil then
					local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(audience_info.marker_name)

					character_util.set_position(audience, start_pos)

					scene_util.set_direction(audience, audience_info.dir, false)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:initialize_object()
	local level_data = self.game_data.level_info[self.cur_level_state]

	if self.get_ball == nil then
		self.get_ball = function()
			return get_field_object(self.game_data.ball_name)
		end
	end

	local ball = self.get_ball()

	ball.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos(level_data.player_start_marker_name) + vector(1, 0, 0)

	self.enemy_touch_ball_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(ball.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.05)
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	-- 미니게임 로직
	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.game_data.camera_pos_marker_name)
	local is_success = false

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.start

	-- bgm 정보가 있다면 해당 bgm 재생
	if self.game_data.level_info[self.cur_level_state].play_bgm ~= nil then
		if self.cur_level_state == self.game_level_state.tutorial then

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.game_data.level_info[self.cur_level_state].play_bgm,
												 state = 'event', mix = 1 })

		elseif self.cur_level_state > self.game_level_state.tutorial then

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.game_data.opening_bgm,
												 state = 'event', volume = 0.6, mix = 1 })

		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	if self.retry then
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	else
		-- 페이드 인
		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	end

	self:start_event()

	local wait_start_title = false
	if self.cur_level_state > self.game_level_state.tutorial then
		local activity_start_signal = self.game_data.string_key

		wait_start_title = true

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(activity_start_signal .. 'activity_title_1'), 1)

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		wait_start_title = false
	end

	sp_util.exit_scene({ show_ui = false, show_weapon = false }, get_party_leader())

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	self:hide_ui(user_party.Leader)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.play

	self.is_playing_game = true

	if self.cur_level_state > self.game_level_state.tutorial then
		while wait_start_title do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.game_data.level_info[self.cur_level_state].play_bgm,
											 state = 'event' })
	end

	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.max_play_time, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished', show_ui = true })

	local ball = self.get_ball()

	while self.is_playing_game and self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.play do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		self:update_ball_state(ball)

		self:update_enemy_state(dt)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 게임 끝났으니 컨트롤 뺏는다.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self:stop_ball_from_moving()

	self:all_stop_current_enemies(true)

	-- 대기 0.6초
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	local wait_for_end_text_effect = false

	if self.cur_level_state > self.game_level_state.tutorial then
		local enemy_anim_name = nil
		local leader_anim_name = nil
		local enemy_emotion_name = nil
		local leader_emotion_name = nil
		local audience_anim_name = nil
		local audience_emotion_name = nil

		if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
			--enemy_anim_name = 'dead1'
			--enemy_emotion_name = 'damaged'
			leader_anim_name = 'victory_get'
			leader_emotion_name = 'smile'
			audience_anim_name = 'clap'
			audience_emotion_name = 'smile'

		elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.fail then
			-- 공 스파인을 hold 한 꼬마 NPC를 뺀 나머지 꼬마 NPC들 smile 표정, success 자세 지속.
			-- 그레모리 tired 표정 전환.
			-- 오딜(플레이어) (left, tired, frustration) 자세.
			-- 액티비티 실패 문구 출력
			enemy_anim_name = 'success'
			enemy_emotion_name = 'smile'
			leader_anim_name = 'frustration'
			leader_emotion_name = 'tired'
			audience_emotion_name = 'tired'

			self:game_over_dialogue_trigger()
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].enemy_info_list

		for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do

			while not self:is_enemy_idle(enemy_info_list[i].state) do
				-- last update
				enemy_info_list[i].state:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if enemy_info_list[i].info.unique_index == self.captured_ball_enemy_index then
				goto continue
			end

			if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.fail then
				local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(enemy_info_list[i].enemy.Direction)

				if enemy_anim_name ~= nil then
					scene_util.set_direction(enemy_info_list[i].enemy, side_dir, false)
					scene_util.set_anim(enemy_info_list[i].enemy, self, enemy_anim_name)
				end

				if enemy_emotion_name ~= nil then
					scene_util.set_emotion(enemy_info_list[i].enemy, self, enemy_emotion_name)
				end
			elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy_info_list[i].enemy)
			end

			:: continue ::
		end

		local audience_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].audience_list

		for i = 1, #audience_info_list do
			local audience = get_character(audience_info_list[i].name)

			if audience_anim_name ~= nil then
				scene_util.set_anim(audience, self, audience_anim_name)
			end

			if audience_emotion_name ~= nil then
				scene_util.set_emotion(audience, self, audience_emotion_name)
			end
		end

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_end_text_effect = true

			if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.fail then
				local activity_start_signal = self.game_data.string_key

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_yuze_whistle_01')

				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(activity_start_signal .. 'activity_title_2'), 1)

				wait_for_sec(2.5)

				wait_for_end_text_effect = false
			elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

				wait_for_sec(2)

				wait_for_end_text_effect = false
			end
		end)

		-- 리더 표정 변경
		if leader_emotion_name ~= nil then
			local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(user_party.Leader.Direction)

			scene_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, side_dir, false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, self, leader_emotion_name)

			if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
				scene_util.show_victory_get_async(user_party.Leader, self, { emotion = 'smile', end_delay = 0.8 })
			elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.fail then
				scene_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, self, leader_anim_name)
			end
		end
	end

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
		self:end_event()

		is_success = true
	elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.fail then
		self:failure_and_reset_event()

		is_success = false
	end

	if self.cur_level_state == self.game_level_state.tutorial then
		if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
			-- 미니게임 본편으로 이동.
			self.cur_level_state = self.game_level_state.level_1
		end

		self:clear_enemy_holdup_state()

		self:reset_game()

		start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)

		self.tutorial_played_more_than_once = true

		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	while wait_for_end_text_effect do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local stage_field_music_volume = 1

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

		stage_field_music_volume = 0.6
	elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.fail then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if self.cur_level_state > self.game_level_state.tutorial then
		self:clear_enemy_holdup_state()
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = stage_field_music_volume })

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
	self:show_ui(user_party.Leader)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 1, #self.backup_party_member_list do
		local member = self.backup_party_member_list[i]
		member.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		party_util.add_member(member)
	end

	self:all_stop_current_enemies(false)
	self:clean_up_enemies(false)

	-- 1번 이상 플레이 체크
	self.played_more_than_once = true

	-- 성공 여부에 따라 재생
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
end

function local_class:get_out_game_line()
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.fail

	self.game_over = self.game_over_type.ball_gose_over_the_line

	local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].enemy_info_list

	if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do
			local enemy = enemy_info_list[i].enemy

			if self:is_enemy_chase(enemy_info_list[i].state) then
				-- 스턴 게이지 보이지 않게
				character_util.hide_attack_timer(enemy)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:hide_ui(owner)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
					CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
					CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton |
					CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton |
					CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton, owner)
end

function local_class:show_ui()
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
					CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
					CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton |
					CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton |
					CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton, owner)
end

function local_class:enable_current_level_enemy()
	for i = 0, #self.game_data.level_info do
		local level_data = self.game_data.level_info[i]

		if level_data ~= nil then
			local enemy_list = level_data.appear_enemy_list
			for j = 1, #enemy_list do
				local enemy_info = enemy_list[j]
				local enemy = get_character(enemy_info.name)

				if enemy ~= nil then
					if self.cur_level_state == i then
						character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'enabled')
					else
						character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'disabled')
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 드리블 게임 튜토리얼시작 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()
	if self.constants_data_key == 'nightmare_lilithtower_2' then
		local level_info = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state]

		if self.cur_level_state == self.game_level_state.tutorial then
			-- 튜토리얼 시작 이벤트

			if not self.tutorial_played_more_than_once then
				-- 꼬마 : 제한시간동안 공을 굴려서 가지고 있으면 돼!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
						level_info.starting_line_list[1], true,
						{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

				-- 꼬마 : 상대한테 공을 뺏기거나, 선 밖으로 공이 나가면 실패 처리야!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
						level_info.starting_line_list[2], true,
						{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

				-- 꼬마 : 처음이니까, 연습 삼아서 한번 공을 굴려 봐!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
						level_info.starting_line_list[3], true,
						{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })
			else
				if self.game_over == self.game_over_type.steal_ball then
					-- 꼬마 : 다시 해봐! 공을 뺏기지 말고 계속 가지고 있어야 돼!
					scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
							level_info.reset_line_list[2], true,
							{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })
				elseif self.game_over == self.game_over_type.ball_gose_over_the_line then
					-- 꼬마 : 다시 해봐! 공이 선 밖으로 나가면 안돼!
					scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
							level_info.reset_line_list[4], true,
							{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })
				end

				-- 플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
			end
		elseif self.cur_level_state == self.game_level_state.level_1 then
			-- 본판 시작 이벤트

			if not self.played_more_than_once then
				-- 꼬마 : 지금부터 나랑 내 친구들이 계속 따라다니면서 방해할 거야!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
						level_info.starting_line_list[1], true,
						{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

				-- 꼬마 : 그럼… 시작!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
						level_info.starting_line_list[2], true,
						{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })
			end
		end
	end

	self.game_over = self.game_over_type.none
end

function local_class:game_over_dialogue_trigger()
	local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].enemy_info_list

	if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do
			if enemy_info_list[i].info.unique_index == self.captured_ball_enemy_index and
					enemy_info_list[i].info.caught_ball_line ~= nil then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(enemy_info_list[i].enemy,
						enemy_info_list[i].info.caught_ball_line[1], true)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:failure_and_reset_event()
	if self.constants_data_key == 'nightmare_lilithtower_2' then
		local level_info = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state]

		if self.cur_level_state == self.game_level_state.tutorial then
			-- 튜토리얼 실패 & 리셋 이벤트

			if self.game_over == self.game_over_type.steal_ball then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_yuze_whistle_01')

				-- 꼬마 : 실패! 공을 뺏겼어!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
						level_info.reset_line_list[1], true,
						{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })
			elseif self.game_over == self.game_over_type.ball_gose_over_the_line then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_yuze_whistle_01')

				-- 꼬마 : 실패! 공이 선 밖으로 나갔어!
				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
						level_info.reset_line_list[3], true,
						{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

			--  1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 아웃.
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:end_event()
	if self.constants_data_key == 'nightmare_lilithtower_2' then
		local level_info = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state]

		if self.cur_level_state == self.game_level_state.tutorial then
			-- 튜토리얼 성공 이벤트

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')

			-- 꼬마 : 잘했어. 그렇게 하면 돼.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
					level_info.ending_line_list[1], true,
					{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

			-- 꼬마 : 연습 끝! 이제 제대로 해보자고!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader,
					level_info.ending_line_list[2], true,
					{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2) })

			--  1초에 걸쳐 화면 페이드 아웃.
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end
	end
end

-- 적 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_enemy_collision(chaser)
	local leader = self.get_acting_player()
	local ball = self.get_ball()

	local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(
			leader.Bounds.center, leader.Bounds)

	for i = 0, collide_fos.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_fos[i]
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0 and lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, ball) then
			self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.fail
			collide_fos:Dispose()
			return true
		end

		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle or
				((fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0 and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, leader)) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_hit_wall_01')
			self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.fail
			self.is_playing_game = false
			collide_fos:Dispose()
			return true
		end
	end

	collide_fos:Dispose()
	return false
end

function local_class:all_stop_current_enemies(end_of_gameplay)
	local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].enemy_info_list

	if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy_info_list[i].enemy)

			-- 히트박스에 닿은 꼬마NPC가 ‘공 스파인’을 hold 하여 머리에 듬.
			if end_of_gameplay then
				if enemy_info_list[i].info.unique_index == self.captured_ball_enemy_index then
					local holder = enemy_info_list[i].enemy

					local ball = self.get_ball()
					local ball_spine = ball:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

					ball_spine.IsShadowActive = false

					message_system:SendSync(ball, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)

					scene_util.set_anim(holder, self, { name = 'hold', loop = false })

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')

					local end_pos = holder.Position + vector(0, 0.6, 0)
					sp_util.sine_move(ball, { from = ball.Position, to = end_pos,
											  duration = 0.15, height = 0.5 })

					-- 울보 아이 npc만 예외로 smile 표정 지음
					if enemy_info_list[i].info.caught_ball_line ~= nil and enemy_info_list[i].info.emo_after_fail ~= nil then
						scene_util.set_emotion(enemy_info_list[i].enemy, self, enemy_info_list[i].info.emo_after_fail)
					end

					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear_enemy_holdup_state()
	local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].enemy_info_list

	if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do
			if enemy_info_list[i].info.unique_index == self.captured_ball_enemy_index then
				local holder = enemy_info_list[i].enemy

				local ball = self.get_ball()
				local ball_spine = ball:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

				ball_spine.IsShadowActive = true

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(holder)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stop_ball_from_moving()
	local ball = self.get_ball()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(ball.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState)) then
		ball.FieldObjectBehaviour:ChangeState(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance)

		local spine_controller = ball.UnityGameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
		local base_track = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base)
		local current_anim_entry = spine_controller.SkeletonAnimation.state:GetCurrent(base_track)

		current_anim_entry.TimeScale = 0
	end
end

function local_class:clean_up_enemies(disable_enemies, select_level)
	for i = 0, #self.level_info_list do
		if select_level ~= nil and i ~= select_level then
			goto continue
		end

		if self.level_info_list[i] ~= nil then
			local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[i].enemy_info_list

			if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
				for j = 1, #enemy_info_list do
					local enemy = enemy_info_list[j].enemy

					if disable_enemies then
						character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'disabled')
					else
						character_util.set_position(enemy, vector(999, 0, 999))
					end

					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy)
				end
			end
		end

		:: continue ::
	end
end

function local_class:update_ball_state(ball, dt)
	self.enemy_touch_ball_bound.center = ball.Bounds.center
end

--region enemy_state_update
function local_class:update_enemy_state(dt)
	local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].enemy_info_list

	if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do
			enemy_info_list[i].state:update(dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_enemy_state(unique_index, next_state)
	local enemy_info_list = self.level_info_list[self.cur_level_state].enemy_info_list
	local index = nil

	if enemy_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #enemy_info_list do
			if enemy_info_list[i].info.unique_index == unique_index then
				index = i

				break
			end
		end
	end

	if enemy_info_list[index].state then
		enemy_info_list[index].state:exit()
		enemy_info_list[index].state:dispose()
		enemy_info_list[index].state = nil
	end

	enemy_info_list[index].state = next_state
	enemy_info_list[index].state:enter()
end

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.play then
		timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	self.controller.game_over = self.controller.game_over_type.steal_ball

	-- 히트박스에 닿은 꼬마NPC 기록
