--region enemy_idle_state
function enemy_idle_state:init(controller, character_info)
	self.super:init(controller, character_info)
end

function enemy_idle_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function enemy_idle_state:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.state_name = 'enemy_idle_state'

	character_util.set_active_state(self.character_info.enemy, 'enabled')

	-- 게임 상태가 실패일 경우
	if self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.fail then
		-- 해당 캐릭터 정보 중 실패 후 emotion이 있다면 아래 애니, 이모션 리셋은 하지 않음
		if self.character_info.info.emo_after_fail ~= nil then
			return
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.character_info.enemy)
end

function enemy_idle_state:exit()
end

function enemy_idle_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	local char_info = self.character_info

	if self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.play then
		if char_info.info.appear_time == -1 then
			-- 처음부터 맵에 등장하는 enemy
			self.controller:change_enemy_state(char_info.info.unique_index, enemy_chase_state(self.controller, char_info))
		elseif char_info.info.appear_time > 0 and char_info.info.appear_time < self.time_passed then
			-- 바깥에서 등장하는 enemy
			self.controller:change_enemy_state(char_info.info.unique_index, enemy_appear_state(self.controller, char_info))
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region enemy_appear_state
function enemy_appear_state:init(controller, character_info)
	self.super:init(controller, character_info)
end

function enemy_appear_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function enemy_appear_state:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.state_name = 'enemy_appear_state'

	start_coroutine(self.play_appear_moving, self)
end

function enemy_appear_state:exit()
end

function enemy_appear_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)
end

function enemy_appear_state:play_appear_moving()
	local char_info = self.character_info
	local char = char_info.enemy

	local move_list = {}

	for i = 1, #char_info.info.appear_move_marker_name_list do
		move_list[i] = field_util.get_marker_pos(char_info.info.appear_move_marker_name_list[i])
	end

	if char_info.info.appearance_line ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(char_info.info.appearance_one_shot)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(char, { key = char_info.info.appearance_line[1], skip = false })

		scene_util.set_emotion(char, self.controller, char_info.info.first_emo)
	end

	wp_util.move_async(char, move_list,
			char_info.info.speed,
			nil, { run = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_anim(char, self.controller, 'get')

	character_util.jump_move(char, field_util.get_marker_pos(char_info.info.appear_last_jump_move_marker_name),
			char_info.info.jump_speed, 2.5, true)

	character_util.stop(char)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	if char_info.info.can_not_move_in_chase_state then
		self.controller:change_enemy_state(char_info.info.unique_index, enemy_stationary_state(self.controller, char_info))
	else
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		self.controller:change_enemy_state(char_info.info.unique_index, enemy_chase_state(self.controller, char_info))
	end
end
--endregion

--region enemy_chase_state
function enemy_chase_state:init(controller, character_info)
	self.super:init(controller, character_info)

	self.enable_stun_event = false
end

function enemy_chase_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.enable_stun_event = false
end

function enemy_chase_state:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.state_name = 'enemy_chase_state'

	if self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending or
			self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.fail then
		self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
		return
	end

	local enemy = self.character_info.enemy

	scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self.controller, { name = 'run' })

	if self.character_info.info.stun_info ~= nil then
		local stun_data = self.character_info.info.stun_info

		if stun_data.stun_type == 1 then
			scene_util.set_emotion(self.character_info.enemy, self.controller, 'attack')
		end

		if stun_data[stun_data.stun_type].show_timer_ui then
			character_util.show_attack_timer(self.character_info.enemy, stun_data[stun_data.stun_type].wait_time)
		end

		self.stun_wait_time_passed = 0
		self.prev_stun_wait_time_passed = 0

		self.enable_stun_event = true
	end
end

function enemy_chase_state:exit()
end

function enemy_chase_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.play then
		local stun_data = self.character_info.info.stun_info

		if not bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(self.character_info.enemy.Bounds, self.controller.enemy_touch_ball_bound) then
			self:move_by_one_frame(self.character_info.enemy, self.character_info.enemy.Position, self.target.Position, self.character_info.info.speed)
		else
			self.super:enemy_caught_ball()

			if stun_data ~= nil and stun_data[stun_data.stun_type].show_timer_ui then
				-- 스턴 게이지 보이지 않게
				character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.character_info.enemy)
			end
		end

		if self.enable_stun_event then
			self.stun_wait_time_passed = self.stun_wait_time_passed + dt

			if self.stun_wait_time_passed >= stun_data[stun_data.stun_type].wait_time then
				if stun_data[stun_data.stun_type].show_timer_ui then
					character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.character_info.enemy)
				end

				self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_stun_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
			end
		end
	elseif self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending or
			self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.fail then
		self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
	end
end

function enemy_chase_state:move_by_one_frame(fo, pos_from, pos_to, speed)
	local dir = (pos_to - pos_from).normalized

	if dir == unity_class.vector3.zero then
		return
	end

	fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
	local move_result = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
			fo,
			dir,
			speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
end
--endregion

--region enemy_stun_state
function enemy_stun_state:init(controller, character_info)
	self.super:init(controller, character_info)
end

function enemy_stun_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function enemy_stun_state:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.state_name = 'enemy_stun_state'

	start_coroutine(self.play_stun_event, self, self.character_info.info.stun_info.stun_type)
end

function enemy_stun_state:exit()
end

function enemy_stun_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(self.character_info.enemy.Bounds, self.controller.enemy_touch_ball_bound) then
		self.super:enemy_caught_ball()
	end
end

function enemy_stun_state:play_stun_event(stun_type_num)
	local stun_info = self.character_info.info.stun_info
	local side_dir = direction_util.to_side_dir(self.character_info.enemy.Direction)

	scene_util.set_direction(self.character_info.enemy, side_dir, false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.character_info.enemy)

	if stun_type_num == 1 then
		-- 해당 NPC가 damgaed 표정/ prostrate 자세로 전환되며 넘어짐.
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.character_info.enemy, self.controller, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_1_emo)
		scene_util.set_anim(self.character_info.enemy, self.controller, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_1_anim)

		-- 자세가 전환될 때 해당 NPC에게 FX_hit , FX_lasthit 이펙트 출력.
		self.controller.fx:hit():Instantiate(self.character_info.enemy.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		self.controller.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(self.character_info.enemy.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')

		-- 0.5초 대기
		if not self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_1_duration) then
			self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
			return
		end

		-- 0.5초 동안 0.03값으로 shake , 0.5초 대기 이후 한번 더 0.5초 동안 0.03값으로 shake.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		character_util.shake(self.character_info.enemy, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_magnitude, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_duration)

		if not self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_duration * 2) then
			self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		character_util.shake(self.character_info.enemy, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_magnitude, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_duration)

		if not self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_duration) then
			self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
			return
		end

		-- 0.5초 대기
		if not self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_2_duration) then
			self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
			return
		end

		-- 해당 NPC가 get 자세로 jump.
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.character_info.enemy)
		scene_util.set_anim(self.character_info.enemy, self.controller, stun_info[stun_type_num].wake_up_anim)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

		character_util.mario_jump_async(self.character_info.enemy, side_dir)
	elseif stun_type_num == 2 then
		-- 해당 꼬마(여) NPC가 제자리에 멈추고 (damaged 표정, idle 자세로 0.3값으로 shake 1초)
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.character_info.enemy, self.controller, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_emo)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

		character_util.shake(self.character_info.enemy, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_magnitude, stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_duration)

		if not self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(stun_info[stun_type_num].stun_shake_duration) then
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.character_info.enemy)

			self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
			return
		end

		-- 이후 대기 상태 돌입 ( 대기 시간은 아래 중 1가지 랜덤)
		local rand_num = nil

		if #stun_info[stun_type_num].post_stun_wait_time > 1 then
			rand_num = unity_class.random.Range(1, #stun_info[stun_type_num].post_stun_wait_time)

			rand_num = math.floor(rand_num)
		else
			rand_num = 1
		end

		-- 1.5 또는 2.5초
		if not self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(stun_info[stun_type_num].post_stun_wait_time[rand_num]) then
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.character_info.enemy)

			self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))
			return
		end

		-- 이후 다시 플레이어를 쫓음.
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.character_info.enemy)
	end

	local char_info = self.character_info

	if self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending or
			self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.fail then
		self.controller:change_enemy_state(char_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, char_info))
	else
		self.controller:change_enemy_state(char_info.info.unique_index, enemy_chase_state(self.controller, char_info))
	end
end

function enemy_stun_state:wait_for_sec_to_stop(sec)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < sec do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 모든 시간 기다리지 않고 탈출
		if self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending or
				self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.fail then
			return false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 기다림 완료
	return true
end
--endregion

--region enemy_stationary_state
function enemy_stationary_state:init(controller, character_info)
	self.super:init(controller, character_info)
end

function enemy_stationary_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function enemy_stationary_state:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.state_name = 'enemy_stationary_state'

	start_coroutine(self.play_stationary_event, self)
end

function enemy_stationary_state:exit()
end

function enemy_stationary_state:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending or
			self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.fail then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character_info.enemy)

		self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))

		return
	end

	if bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(self.character_info.enemy.Bounds, self.controller.enemy_touch_ball_bound) then
		self.super:enemy_caught_ball()

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character_info.enemy)
	end
end

function enemy_stationary_state:play_stationary_event()
	local enemy_info = self.character_info.info
	local enemy = self.character_info.enemy

	if self.controller == nil or self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending or
			self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.fail then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.character_info.enemy)

		self.controller:change_enemy_state(self.character_info.info.unique_index, enemy_idle_state(self.controller, self.character_info))

		return
	end

	local move_list = {}
	for i = 1, #enemy_info.appear_add_move_marker_name_list do
		move_list[i] = field_util.get_marker_pos(enemy_info.appear_add_move_marker_name_list[i])
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(enemy)

	local move_duration = enemy_info.time_to_move_inside_the_line
	wp_util.move(enemy, move_list,
			nil,
			move_duration, { run = true })

	if not self:wait_for_sec_to_stop(move_duration) then
		character_util.remove_emotion(enemy)
		character_util.stop(enemy)

		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cry_01')

	scene_util.set_direction(enemy, enemy_info.dir_after_move, false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(enemy, self.controller, enemy_info.emo_after_move)
	scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self.controller, enemy_info.anim_after_move)
end

function enemy_stationary_state:wait_for_sec_to_stop(sec)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < sec do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 모든 시간 기다리지 않고 탈출
		if self.controller == nil or self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending or
				self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.fail then
			return false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 기다림 완료
	return true
end
--endregion
--endregion

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

--- 적(공) 피하기 (EnemyBallDodgeGame) 미니 게임 컨트롤러
local local_class = newclass('EnemyBallDodgeGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 미니게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'EnemyBallDodgeGame'

	-- game state
	self.game_state_enum = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		play = 3,
		fail = 4,
		ending = 5,
	}
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.none

	-- Constants Data
	self.game_data = nil

	-- 게임 진행중에 있는지?
	self.is_playing_game = false

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = nil

	-- string key
	self.string_key = nil

	self.play_count = 0

	-- NPC
	-- 적(인베이더)
	self.get_acting_enemy = nil
	-- 사용할 플레이어 캐릭터
	self.get_acting_player = nil
	-- 도착지점 NPC 캐릭터
	self.get_switch_npc = nil
	self.get_switch_npc_pos_marker = nil

	-- marker
	-- 유저 스폰 포인트
	self.player_spawn_pos = nil

	-- 카메라 위치
	self.get_minigame_camera_pos = nil

	-- enemy npc list
	self.enemy_info_list = {}

	self.get_enemy_turn_pos = nil

	-- fo
	self.saved_party_leader = nil
	self.saved_party_member_list = {}

	-- flag
	-- 입력한 방향
	self.input_player_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	-- 최초 입장 체크 (s1, s2, 챌린지 순)
	self.first_play_check_list = {
		queenship_1_4_s14_s1 = false,
		queenship_1_4_s14_s2 = false,
		queenship_1_4_s14_c = false,
	}

	-- 오퍼레이더 UI (queenship 전용)
	self.operator_ui_controller = nil
	self.operator_ui_obj = nil

	self.scene_callbacks = {
		on_start = nil,
		on_lose = nil,
	}

	self.opened_door_colors = create_lua_hashset()
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	-- 게임 데이터 및 키 세팅
	local before_data_key = self.constants_data_key
	self.constants_data_key = key
	if self.game_data == nil or before_data_key ~= self.constants_data_key then
		-- game_data 키가 세팅이 안되있거나 이전 데이터 키랑 다른 값이 세팅되어 있다면 game_data 다시 세팅
		self.game_data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(
				'minigame/EnemyBallDodgeGame/EnemyBallDodgeGameConstants', self.constants_data_key)
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	self.string_key = self.game_data.string_key

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self:game_pre_init()

	local not_use_operator_ui = lua_helper.get_value(self.game_data, 'not_use_operator_ui', false)

	if not not_use_operator_ui then
		yield_return_func(CS.ScreenPlay.QueenShipOperatorUIExtensions.LoadOperatorUI, function(operator_ui)
			self.operator_ui_controller = operator_ui
			-- GT-1333 아랍어 대응
			if game_string.IsRTL and self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale.x > 0 then
				local scale = self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale
				scale.x = -scale.x

				self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale = scale
				self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.alignment = CS.TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.TopRight
			end
		end)

		self.operator_ui_obj = self.operator_ui_controller.gameObject
		self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(false)
	end

	-- 준비 끝났으면 콜백 보냄
	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.none
	self.is_playing_game = false

	if self.enemy_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.enemy_info_list do
			self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy = nil
			self.enemy_info_list[i].around_wp_list = nil
			self.enemy_info_list[i].speed = 0
		end
	end

	self.enemy_info_list = nil
	self.saved_party_member_list = nil
	self.saved_camera_transform = nil

	if self.is_playing_game then
		self.is_playing_game = false
	end

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.play then
		self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.none
	end

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.game_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.scene_callbacks.on_lose = nil
	self.scene_callbacks.on_start = nil

	self.opened_door_colors:clear()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(_)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return false
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_acting_player()) then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if e.FullEnter then
		if zone_name == self.game_data.clear_zone_name then
			self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.ending
			self.is_playing_game = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		if self.is_playing_game then
			self.input_player_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:event_subscribe()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
end

function local_class:game_pre_init()

	-- 게임 캐릭터 셋팅

	self.get_acting_enemy = function(num)
		return get_character(self.game_data.acting_enemy_character_name .. num)
	end

	self.get_acting_player = function()
		return get_character(self.game_data.acting_manual_character_name)
	end

	if self.game_data.arrivel_switch_npc_name ~= nil then
		self.get_switch_npc = function()
			return get_character(self.game_data.arrivel_switch_npc_name)
		end
	end
	if self.game_data.arrivel_switch_npc_pos_marker_name ~= nil then
		self.get_switch_npc_pos_marker = function()
			return field:GetMarker(self.game_data.arrivel_switch_npc_pos_marker_name).position
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local leader = self.get_acting_player()

	self:event_subscribe()

	-- 캐릭터 게임 시작 위치로 이동
	self.player_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker(self.game_data.player_start_marker_name).position

	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(leader, self.player_spawn_pos)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, self.game_data.player_start_direction, false)

	-- 초기 플레이어 캐릭터 시작 방향
	self.input_player_direction = leader.Direction

	leader.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.45, 0.75, 0.45))

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- switch npc 셋팅
	local switch_npc = self.get_switch_npc()
	character_util.set_position(switch_npc, self.get_switch_npc_pos_marker())
	character_util.set_active_state(switch_npc, 'enabled')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(switch_npc, 'red')

	-- 오브젝트의 캐릭터 스텟UI 지우기
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(switch_npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- enemy setting
	local enemy_turn_marker_name = self.game_data.enemy_turn_marker_name
	self.get_enemy_turn_pos = function(group, index)
		return field:GetMarker(enemy_turn_marker_name .. group .. '_' .. index).position
	end

	if self.enemy_info_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.enemy_info_list do
			self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy = nil
			self.enemy_info_list[i].around_wp_list = nil
			self.enemy_info_list[i].speed = 0
		end
		self.enemy_info_list = nil
	end

	self.enemy_info_list = {}

	local enemy_infos = self.game_data.enemy_ball_info
	for enemy_name, data in pairs(enemy_infos) do
		local enemy = get_character(enemy_name)
		if enemy ~= nil then
			enemy.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.7, 1, 0.7))

			character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'enabled')

			if data.start_pos_marker ~= nil then
				local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(data.start_pos_marker) + vector(data.add_wp_pos_x, 0, data.add_wp_pos_z)
				character_util.set_position(enemy, start_pos)
			else
				character_util.set_position(enemy, vector(data.start_pos_x, 0, data.start_pos_z))
			end

			-- 오브젝트의 캐릭터 스텟UI 지우기
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(enemy, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

			local test = 1
			local around_wp = {}
			local index = 0
			for i = data.first_target_merker_index, data.use_moving_marker_max_index do
				table.insert(around_wp,
						self.get_enemy_turn_pos(data.group, i) + vector(data.add_wp_pos_x, 0, data.add_wp_pos_z))
				index = index + 1
			end

			for i = 1, (data.use_moving_marker_max_index - index) do
				table.insert(around_wp,
						self.get_enemy_turn_pos(data.group, i) + vector(data.add_wp_pos_x, 0, data.add_wp_pos_z))
			end

			-- enemy_info 객체
			local enemy_info = {
				enemy = nil,
				around_wp_list = nil,
				speed = 1,
			}

			enemy_info.enemy = enemy
			enemy_info.around_wp_list = around_wp
			enemy_info.speed = data.speed
			table.insert(self.enemy_info_list, enemy_info)

			--character_util.move_waypoint(enemy, around_wp, data.speed, false, 'loop')
		end
	end

	if self.game_data.key_infos ~= nil and self.game_data.door_infos ~= nil then
		for key_name, info in pairs(self.game_data.key_infos) do
			local key = get_character(key_name)
			local anim_name = info.color .. '_idle'

			character_util.set_anim(key, { name = anim_name })
			character_util.set_active_state(key, 'enabled')

			key.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 0, -0.3)
			-- 스위치는 캐릭터보다 밑에 깔리도록 함
			character_util.set_sorting_layer(key, 'Default', -1)

			character_util.set_active_shadow(key, false)

			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(key, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end

		for door_name, info in pairs(self.game_data.door_infos) do
			local door = get_character(door_name)
			local anim_name = info.color .. '_idle'

			character_util.set_anim(door, { name = anim_name })
			character_util.set_active_state(door, 'enabled')

			door.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 0, -0.5)
			character_util.spine_scale(door, unity_class.vector3.one * 2, 0)

			character_util.set_active_shadow(door, false)

			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(door, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

			door.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 2))
		end
	end
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	-- 미니게임 로직
	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.game_data.camera_pos_marker_name).position
	local is_success = false
	self.play_count = self.play_count + 1

	self.is_playing_game = true
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.start

	local target_cam_size = self.game_data.override_cam_size or 5

	camera_util.move(center_pos, 0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(target_cam_size, 0)

	-- bgm 정보가 있다면 해당 bgm 재생
	if self.game_data.play_bgm ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.game_data.play_bgm, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	end

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.play

	self:pre_event()

	-- 적들 움직임
	for i = 1, #self.enemy_info_list do
		character_util.move_waypoint(self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy,
				self.enemy_info_list[i].around_wp_list, self.enemy_info_list[i].speed, false, 'loop')
		character_util.set_anim(self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy, { name = 'run', loop = true })
	end

	-- 게임 루프 시작
	--local leader = user_party.Leader
	local leader = self.get_acting_player()

	leader.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.35, 0.75, 0.35))

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'resource_ui_off' }))

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'run', loop = true })

	while self.is_playing_game and self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.play do

		self:update_player_pos_by_one_frame(leader, self.input_player_direction, self.game_data.acting_player_move_speed)

		self:check_enemy_collision()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 게임 끝났으니 컨트롤 뺏는다.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 파티 스테이트 원복
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down', false)

	local enemy_anim_name = nil
	local knight_anim_name = nil
	local enemy_emotion_name = nil
	local knight_emotion_name = nil
	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.ending then
		enemy_anim_name = 'dead1'
		knight_anim_name = 'victory_extra'
		--enemy_emotion_name = 'damaged'
		--knight_emotion_name = 'awesome'

	elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.fail then
		enemy_anim_name = 'victory_extra'
		knight_anim_name = 'dead1'
		--enemy_emotion_name = 'awesome'
		--knight_emotion_name = 'damaged'
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 모든 적들 멈춤, 표정 변경
	for i = 1, #self.enemy_info_list do
		character_util.stop(self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 1, #self.enemy_info_list do
		if enemy_anim_name ~= nil then
			--character_util.set_emotion(self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy, { name = enemy_emotion_name })
			scene_util.set_direction(self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy, enemy_anim_name)
		end
	end

	-- 기사 표정 변경
	if knight_anim_name ~= nil then
		--character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = enemy_emotion_name })
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, knight_anim_name)
	end

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.ending then

		self:success_event()
		is_success = true

	elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.fail then

		self:failure_event()
		is_success = false
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 실패했을 경우에만
	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.fail then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_drown_02')
	end

	-- Fade Out
	if self.game_data.play_bgm ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.game_data.play_bgm ~= nil then
		if self.game_data.end_bgm_data == nil then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
		else
			music_player_util.play_stage_music(self.game_data.end_bgm_data)
		end
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()

	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'disabled')

	for i = 1, #self.enemy_info_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.enemy_info_list[i].enemy, 'disabled')
	end

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	self.first_play = false

	self.scene_callbacks.on_start = nil
	self.scene_callbacks.on_lose = nil

	-- 성공 여부에 따라 재생
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
end

				--크로셀 : 크로셀 : 핵심 스위치에 도착하는 것은 문제 없어 보이는군요.

						self.game_data.string_key .. 3, -1, 0.05, 2, nil,
						true, self.game_data.string_key .. 3, true, nil, true, false)

				-- 크로셀 : 핵심 스위치 도착에는 문제 없어 보이는군요.

				-- 크로셀 : 아, 여러분들도 여기 오셨군요.
				self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(true)
				yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller,
						self.game_data.string_key .. 1, -1, 0.05, 2, nil,
						true, self.game_data.string_key .. 1, true, nil, true, false)

				-- 크로셀 : 보안 시스템 접근을 시도하고 있습니다만… 이번 건은 시간이 걸리는 군요.
				yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller,
						self.game_data.string_key .. 2, -1, 0.05, 2, nil,
						true, self.game_data.string_key .. 2, true, nil, true, false)

				-- 크로셀 : 뭐, 패턴은 파악했습니다. 잠깐 보고계시죠.
				yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller,
						self.game_data.string_key .. 3, -1, 0.05, 2, nil,
						true, self.game_data.string_key .. 3, true, nil, true, false)
			end
		end

		if string.find(self.constants_data_key, 'substage_crosselle_') then

	wait_for_sec(2)
end

-- 적 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_enemy_collision()
	local leader = self.get_acting_player()
	local switch = self.get_switch_npc()

	local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(
			leader.Bounds.center, leader.Bounds)

	local test = 0
	if collide_fos.Count > 1 then
		test = 1
	end

	for i = 0, collide_fos.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_fos[i]
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0 and lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, switch) then
			self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.ending
			self.is_playing_game = false
			collide_fos:Dispose()
			return true
		end

		if self.game_data.key_infos ~= nil and self.game_data.door_infos ~= nil then
			local key_info = self.game_data.key_infos[fo.Name]

			if key_info ~= nil then
				if self.opened_door_colors:add(key_info.color) then
					for key_name, info in pairs(self.game_data.key_infos) do
						if info.color == key_info.color then
							local key = get_character(key_name)
							local anim_name = info.color .. '_push'

							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_result_01')
							character_util.set_anim(key, { name = anim_name })
							character_util.set_active_state(key, 'visible')
						end
					end

					-- 도어 오픈 처리
					for door_name, info in pairs(self.game_data.door_infos) do
						if info.color == key_info.color then
							local door = get_character(door_name)
							local anim_name = info.color .. '_open'

							music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_danger_01')
							character_util.set_anim(door, { name = anim_name, loop = false })
							character_util.set_active_state(door, 'visible')
						end
					end
				end

				goto continue
			end
		end

		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle or
				((fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0 and
						not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, leader)) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_hit_wall_01')
			self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.fail
			self.is_playing_game = false
			collide_fos:Dispose()
			return true
		end

		::continue::
	end

	collide_fos:Dispose()
	return false
end

function local_class:update_player_pos_by_one_frame(fo, dir, speed)
	local direction_vector = self:direction_to_vector(dir)

	scene_util.set_direction(fo, dir, false)

	character_util.set_position(fo, fo.Position + direction_vector * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
	--
	--CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
	--		fo,
	--		direction_vector,
	--		speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
end

-- 방향을 벡터로 변환
function local_class:direction_to_vector(direction)
	local v = vector(0, 0, 0)
	if (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) then
		v = vector(1, 0, 0)
	elseif (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) then
		v = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
		v = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif (direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
		v = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	return v
end

-- 플레이어 캐릭터 변경
function local_class:change_manual_character(new_manual_character_name)
	self.saved_party_leader = user_party.Leader
	local manual_character = get_character(new_manual_character_name)

	-- 파티 리더 변경
	party_util.switch_leader(manual_character)

	character_util.remove_emotion(manual_character)
	scene_util.set_direction(manual_character, 'right', false)

	-- 기존 캐릭터 보이지 않는 곳으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.saved_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)

	local constants_data = require(
			'minigame/EnergyballShootingMiniGame/EnergyballShootingMiniGameConstants')

	self.spawn_enable_normal_mob = self.data.enable_spawn_normal_mob
	self.spawn_enable_fast_mob = self.data.enable_spawn_fast_mob
	self.spawn_enable_heavy_mob = self.data.enable_spawn_heavy_mob
	self.spawn_enable_item_mob = self.data.enable_spawn_item_mob

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	-- 오브젝트 풀 로드
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.normal_energy_ball_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.big_energy_ball_o_name)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.normal_explosion_effect_name)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.big_explosion_effect_o_name)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.item_destroy_effect_name)

	gamepad_util.preload_joypad_label()

	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')

	while not CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.IsLoaded(pool) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local pooled_object = {}

	local background_order = -4

	self.player_pos_marker = field:GetMarker(self.data.player_start_stand_name)

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	------- 맵 셋팅

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/theatres/arcade_shooting', 'arcade_shooting', function(prefab)
				self.mini_game_scene = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
			end)

	---[[ 아이템 효과 스프라이트 #1
	pooled_object[1] = pool:Instantiate(
			self.player_pos_marker.position)
	---]]

	---[[ 아이템 효과 스프라이트 #2
	pooled_object[2] = pool:Instantiate(
			self.player_pos_marker.position)
	---]]

	---[[ 아이템 효과 스프라이트 #3
	pooled_object[3] = pool:Instantiate(
			self.player_pos_marker.position)
	---]]
	------------- 아이템 몬스터 파괴 시 나오는 스프라이트

			self.player_pos_marker.position)
	---]]

	---[[ 아이템 효과 스프라이트 #3
	pooled_object[6] = pool:Instantiate(
			self.player_pos_marker.position)
	---]]

	-- 아이템 효과 아이콘 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/ui', 'GuildArcadeBuffUI', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))

			end)

	if self.custom_atlas ~= nil then

	end

	local item_effect_sprite = {}
	item_effect_sprite[1] = pooled_object[1]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	item_effect_sprite[2] = pooled_object[2]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	item_effect_sprite[3] = pooled_object[3]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	item_effect_sprite[4] = pooled_object[4]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	item_effect_sprite[5] = pooled_object[5]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	item_effect_sprite[6] = pooled_object[6]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	for i = 1, #item_effect_sprite do
		if not is_unity_null(item_effect_sprite[i]) then
			item_effect_sprite[i].Atlas = self.custom_atlas
			item_effect_sprite[i].SortingLayer = 'UI'
		end
	end

	self.sprites_data = {
		{
			sprite = item_effect_sprite[1],
			sprite_name = 'arcade_ic_buff_power.png',
			local_scale = unity_class.vector2.one * 0.65,
		},
		{

			sprite_name = 'arcade_ic_buff_ball_size_up.png',

		{

		{
			sprite = item_effect_sprite[4],

			local_scale = unity_class.vector2.one,
		},
		{
			sprite = item_effect_sprite[5],

			local_scale = unity_class.vector2.one,
		},

	end
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GamepadEvent) then
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown then
			self.gamepad_button_pressed = true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.Zone.Name == self.data.monster_fade_out_zone_name
			and table_util.contain_key(self.active_monsters, e.FieldObject)then
		self.active_monsters[e.FieldObject] = false
		self:monster_fade_out(e.FieldObject)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return true end

	if e.FullLeave and e.Zone.Name == self.data.game_area_name
			and table_util.contain_key(self.active_monsters, e.FieldObject)
			and not table_util.contain_value(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.item], e.FieldObject) then
		if self.active_monsters[e.FieldObject] == true then
			self.current_life = self.current_life - 1
			if self.current_life <= 0 then
				self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.fail
				self:play_victory_all_gagoyle_ani()
			end
			self.active_monsters[e.FieldObject] = false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	-- 게임 플레이 중이 아니면 터치 관련 처리 하지않음.
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then
		return true
	end

	if self.current_touch_state== self.touch_state.none and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		self.current_touch_state = self.touch_state.hold
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.charge_energy_ball, self))
	elseif self.current_touch_state == self.touch_state.hold and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchUp then
		self.current_touch_state = self.touch_state.up
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	if table_util.contain_key(self.active_monsters, e.FieldObject) then
		self.active_monsters[e.FieldObject] = false
		local monster_type = self:get_available_monster_type(e.FieldObject)
		-- 아이템 몬스터(박스) 파괴 체크
		if self.data.monster_type.item == monster_type then
			-- 아이템 파괴 시 랜덤으로 아이템 효과 획득/지속시간 셋팅
			local item_effect = random_util.get_random_int(self.item_effect_type.attack_power, self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed)

			-- item effect icon twinkle check
			if self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[item_effect] == true then
				self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[item_effect] = false
				self:show_item_effect_icon(true, item_effect)
			end

			self:set_item_effect(item_effect, 10)

			local destory_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.item_destroy_effect_name):Instantiate(e.FieldObject.Position)
			destory_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

			-- 아이템 효과 획득 sfx
			-- (공격력 증가, 에너지볼 크기 증가 : 01_arcade_power_up_01)
			-- (적들 이동속도 감소 : 01_arcade_slow_01)
			if item_effect == self.item_effect_type.attack_power or item_effect == self.item_effect_type.ball_size then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_power_up_01')
			else
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_slow_01')
			end

			-- 아이템 효과 아이콘 표시
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.show_item_effect_text_sprite, self, item_effect + 3, e.FieldObject.Position))
		end

		-- 점수 체크
		self:add_score(monster_type)
		if monster_type == self.data.monster_type.item then
			self.catch_item_count = self.catch_item_count + 1
		else
			self.catch_monsters_count = self.catch_monsters_count + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local event_name = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if event_name ~= nil then
		if event_name == self.item_effect_twinkle_event_name then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.check_item_effect_twinkle, self))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_connected(_)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return true end

	self:show_gamepad_label()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_disconnected(_)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return true end

	self:hide_gamepad_label()

	return false
end
--endregion

--region Game Logic
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start_routine()
	self:game_init()

	self:game_ui_show()

	-- 공격버튼 활성화
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.CustomAttack

	-- 이미 게임패드가 활성화되있는 상태라면 게임패드 라벨을 보여준다.
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self:show_gamepad_label()
	end

	self.game_loop = true
	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing

	-- 게임 시작 - 컨트롤 활성화 시 BGM 재생 (처음부터)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/arcade/audio:bgm_arcade_shooting', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	self:game_routine()

	self:hide_gamepad_label()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:HideAndBackup()

	self.game_loop = false

	self:game_over()
end

function local_class:event_subscribe()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_fo_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'on_gamepad_connected')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'on_gamepad_disconnected')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
end

function local_class:game_pre_init()
	-- 남녀 확인 후 파티 리더 변경
	local select_male = user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.KnightFemale, true) == nil
	local manual_character_name

	if select_male then
		manual_character_name = self.knight_male_refugee_name
	else
		manual_character_name = self.knight_female_refugee_name
	end

	self:change_manual_character(manual_character_name)
	----------------------------
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	self:event_subscribe()

	user_party.Leader.Position = self.player_pos_marker.position
	user_party.Leader.Direction = self.player_pos_marker.direction

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		member.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	local offset_x = 5
	camera_util.move_async(self.player_pos_marker.position + unity_class.vector3.right * offset_x, 0.05)
	camera_util.resize_to(5.5, 0)
end

	self.spawn_time_passed = 0
	self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.normal] = {}
	self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.fast] = {}
	self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.heavy] = {}
	self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.item] = {}

	self.active_monsters = {}

	self.monster_spawn_count = 1
	self.available_normal_monster_count = 1
	self.available_fast_monster_count = 1
	self.available_heavy_monster_count = 1
	self.available_item_monster_count = 1

	self.value_of_monsters_spawned = 0

	self.current_score = 0
	self.ability_point = 0

	if self.data ~= nil then
		self.current_life = self.data.max_life
	end

	-- 각 몬스터 스폰 사이클 기본 값 셋팅
	self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.normal] = 2
	self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.fast] = 2
	self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.heavy] = 2
	self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.item] = 2

	-- 사용된 각 몬스터 수 초기 값 셋팅
	self.available_monster_count[self.data.monster_type.normal] = 1
	self.available_monster_count[self.data.monster_type.fast] = 1
	self.available_monster_count[self.data.monster_type.heavy] = 1
	self.available_monster_count[self.data.monster_type.item] = 1

	self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = 0
	self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = 0
	self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = 0

	self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = false
	self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = false
	self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = false
	self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = false
	self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = false

	self.item_effects_twinkling_count[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = 0
	self.item_effects_twinkling_count[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = 0

	if self.spawn_enable_normal_mob == true then
		self:set_spawn_cycle(self.data.monster_type.normal)
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_fast_mob == true then
		self:set_spawn_cycle(self.data.monster_type.fast)
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_heavy_mob == true then
		self:set_spawn_cycle(self.data.monster_type.heavy)
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_item_mob == true then
		self:set_spawn_cycle(self.data.monster_type.item)
	end
	self.game_level = self.game_level + 1

	self:set_spawn_monsters()
end

function local_class:game_reset_data()
	self.current_touch_state = self.touch_state.none
	self.spawn_time_passed = 0

	for i = 1, #self.available_monsters do
		for _, monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[i]) do
			character_util.stop(monster)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.active_monsters do
		self.active_monsters[i] = false
	end

	self.monster_spawn_count = 1
	self.available_normal_monster_count = 1
	self.available_fast_monster_count = 1
	self.available_heavy_monster_count = 1
	self.available_item_monster_count = 1

	self.value_of_monsters_spawned = 0

	-- score init
	self.current_score = 0
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameScoreChangeEvent.Create('EnergyballShootingMiniGame', self.current_score))

	self.catch_monsters_count = 0
	self.catch_item_count = 0

	self.ability_point = 0

	self.play_time = 0

	self.game_level = 1

	self.energy_ball_rotate_up = true

	if self.data ~= nil then
		self.current_life = self.data.max_life
	end

	-- 아이템 효과 아이콘 제거
	self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.attack_power)
	self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.ball_size)
	self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed)

	-- 각 몬스터 스폰 사이클 기본 값 셋팅
	self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.normal] = 2
	self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.fast] = 2
	self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.heavy] = 2
	self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.item] = 2

	-- 사용된 각 몬스터 수 초기 값 셋팅
	self.available_monster_count[self.data.monster_type.normal] = 1
	self.available_monster_count[self.data.monster_type.fast] = 1
	self.available_monster_count[self.data.monster_type.heavy] = 1
	self.available_monster_count[self.data.monster_type.item] = 1

	self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = 0
	self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = 0
	self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = 0

	if self.spawn_enable_normal_mob == true then
		self:set_spawn_cycle(self.data.monster_type.normal)
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_fast_mob == true then
		self:set_spawn_cycle(self.data.monster_type.fast)
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_heavy_mob == true then
		self:set_spawn_cycle(self.data.monster_type.heavy)
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_item_mob == true then
		self:set_spawn_cycle(self.data.monster_type.item)
	end
	self.game_level = self.game_level + 1

	self:revive_spawn_all_monsters()
end

-- 실패 후 게임 재시작
function local_class:game_retry_routine()
	self:game_reset_data()

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	-- UI 백업된 것 다시 불러옴
	field_ui_manager:ShowAndRestore()

	-- 왼쪽 상단 미니맵 UI 제거
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	-- 공격버튼 활성화
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.CustomAttack

	-- 이미 게임패드가 활성화되있는 상태라면 게임패드 라벨을 보여준다.
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self:show_gamepad_label()
	end

	self.game_loop = true
	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing

	self:game_routine()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:HideAndBackup()

	-- 게임 다시 실패 루틴
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fail_reaction, self))
end

function local_class:game_ui_show()
	-- 인터랙트, 공격, 들기, 스킬 전부 막아놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)

			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

function local_class:shoot_energy_ball(energy_ball, direction, radius)
	local life_time = 7
	local time_passed = 0
	local speed = self.data.energy_ball_shot_speed
	local add_attack_point = 0
	local explosion_effect_scale = 1
	local explosion_damage_area = 0.3
	if self.increase_attack_power == true then
		add_attack_point = self.data.increase_attack_value
	end

	while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and time_passed < life_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local hit = false
		local hit_ifos = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(energy_ball.transform.position, radius)
		for i = 0, hit_ifos.Count - 1 do
			local target = hit_ifos[i]

			if (table_util.contain_key(self.active_monsters, target) and
					self.active_monsters[target] == true) then
				hit = true
			end

			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(target, user_party.Leader) and
					not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(target.CrashBehaviour) and
					self.active_monsters[target] == true then
				hit = true
			end

			if hit then
				break
			end
		end

		-- 무언가에 맞았다면 루프 탈출
		if hit then
			hit_ifos:Dispose()
			break
		end

		-- 몬스터와 충돌하지 않고 에너지볼 유지시간이 지났으면 Dispose되고 더 이상 처리하지 않고 나감
		if time_passed > life_time then
			energy_ball:Dispose()
			return
		end

		energy_ball.transform.position = energy_ball.transform.position + direction * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.1)
	local explosion_effect = nil

	if self.increase_max_ball_size == true then
		explosion_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.big_explosion_effect_o_name)
	else
		explosion_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.normal_explosion_effect_name)
	end

	local explosion = explosion_effect:Instantiate(energy_ball.transform.position)
	explosion.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * explosion_effect_scale

	-- 반경 1의 범위만큼 폭발 데미지를 부여
	local hittable_targets = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(energy_ball.transform.position, radius + explosion_damage_area)
	for i = 0, hittable_targets.Count - 1 do
		local target = hittable_targets[i]
		local attackable = self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and
				table_util.contain_key(self.active_monsters, target) and self.active_monsters[target]
		if attackable then
			target.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
			-- 패시브 데미지는 주지않기위해 데미지 타입에 패시브를 포함해줌.
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
			damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.damage = 1 + add_attack_point
			damage_info.noCritical = true
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true, '01_arcade_explosion_01')
			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_explosion_01')
		end
	end

	hittable_targets:Dispose()

	energy_ball:Dispose()
end

function local_class:charge_energy_ball()
	local chargeable_duration = 1.5
	local energy_ball = nil
	local offset = vector(0.5, 0, 0.25)
	local ball_max_scale = 0.8
	local ball_pos_offset = vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	local rotate_angle = 60
	local rotate_speed = self.data.energy_ball_rotate_speed

	-- data Change
	if self.data ~= nil then
		if self.increase_max_ball_size == true then
			chargeable_duration = self.data.big_ball_growing_speed
		else
			chargeable_duration = self.data.ball_growing_speed
		end
	end

	local shotable_duration = chargeable_duration / 3
	local radius_ratio = 0.5

	user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('boong_attack_ready_loop_2', true)

	local energy_ball_effect = nil
	if self.increase_max_ball_size == true then
		energy_ball_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.big_energy_ball_o_name)
		radius_ratio = self.data.big_ball_radius_ratio
	else
		energy_ball_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.normal_energy_ball_name)
	end

	energy_ball = energy_ball_effect:Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position + offset)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, shotable_duration))

	local charge_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_arcade_charge_01', loop = true})

	local start_dir = unity_class.vector3.right
	local current_dir
	local time_passed = 0
	while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and self.current_touch_state == self.touch_state.hold do

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 공을 쏠수있는 시간이 됐다면 반짝이는 차징 애니 재생
		if time_passed >= shotable_duration then
			user_party.Leader:SetAnimation('boong_attack_ready_loop', true)
		end

		-- 공이랑 캐스트 이펙트 크기 & 반지름 업데이트
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / chargeable_duration)
		energy_ball.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0.1, ball_max_scale, progress)

		-- 공이랑 캐스트 이펙트 위치 업데이트
		local sine_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(time_passed * rotate_speed) * -1
		local current_angle = rotate_angle * sine_val
		local rotate_dir = unity_class.vector3.up
		if self.energy_ball_rotate_up == false then
			rotate_dir = unity_class.vector3.down
		end
		current_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(current_angle, rotate_dir) * start_dir
		local ball_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + ball_pos_offset + current_dir
		energy_ball.transform.position = ball_pos

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 차징 소리 스탑
	charge_sfx:Stop()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

	-- 게임플레이가 끝나서 취소된거라면 에너지볼도 해제
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then
		energy_ball:Dispose()
		return
	end

	local shotable = time_passed >= shotable_duration
	if shotable then
		-- 에너지볼 발사 sfx
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_shot_01')

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.shoot_energy_ball,
				self, energy_ball, current_dir, energy_ball.transform.localScale.x * radius_ratio))
	else
		energy_ball:Dispose()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	-- 탄이 다 나가거나 실패 리액션이 끝나야 재터치 가능할수있게해준다.
	self.current_touch_state = self.touch_state.none

	if self.energy_ball_rotate_up == true then
		self.energy_ball_rotate_up = false
	elseif self.energy_ball_rotate_up == false then
		self.energy_ball_rotate_up = true
	end
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and self.game_loop == true do
		if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing then
			self:monster_spawn_update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:monster_spawn_update(dt)
	if self.spawn_enable_normal_mob == true then
		self.normal_monster_spawn_time_passed = self.normal_monster_spawn_time_passed + dt
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_fast_mob == true then
		self.fast_monster_spawn_time_passed = self.fast_monster_spawn_time_passed + dt
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_heavy_mob == true then
		self.heavy_monster_spawn_time_passed = self.heavy_monster_spawn_time_passed + dt
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_item_mob == true then
		self.item_monster_spawn_time_passed = self.item_monster_spawn_time_passed + dt
	end

	-- 아이템 효과 시간 측정
	if self.increase_attack_power == true then
		self.attack_power_time_passed = self.attack_power_time_passed + dt
	end
	if self.increase_max_ball_size == true then
		self.ball_size_time_passed = self.ball_size_time_passed + dt
	end
	if self.decrease_monster_speed == true then
		self.monster_speed_time_passed = self.monster_speed_time_passed + dt
	end

	self.play_time = self.play_time + dt
	-- normal monster spawn time check
	if self.spawn_enable_normal_mob == true then
		if self.normal_monster_spawn_time_passed > self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.normal] then
			self.normal_monster_spawn_time_passed = 0
			self:spawn_monster(self.data.monster_type.normal)
		end
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_fast_mob == true then
		-- fast monster spawn time check
		if self.fast_monster_spawn_time_passed > self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.fast] then
			self.fast_monster_spawn_time_passed = 0
			self:spawn_monster(self.data.monster_type.fast)
		end
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_heavy_mob == true then
		-- heavy monster spawn time check
		if self.heavy_monster_spawn_time_passed > self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.heavy] then
			self.heavy_monster_spawn_time_passed = 0
			self:spawn_monster(self.data.monster_type.heavy)
		end
	end
	if self.spawn_enable_item_mob == true then
		-- item monster spawn time check
		if self.item_monster_spawn_time_passed > self.monster_spawn_cycle[self.data.monster_type.item] then
			self.item_monster_spawn_time_passed = 0
			self:spawn_monster(self.data.monster_type.item)
		end
	end

	self:check_game_play_time()
	self:check_item_effect_time()
end

--플레이 타임 체크하여 조건 만족 시 게임 레벨 증가
function local_class:check_game_play_time()
	if self.game_level < 3 and self.play_time > self.game_level_up_terms[self.game_level-1] then
		self.game_level = 3
		return
	elseif self.game_level < 4 and self.play_time > self.game_level_up_terms[self.game_level-1] then
		self.game_level = 4
		return
	end
end

function local_class:check_item_effect_time()
	if self.attack_power_time_passed > self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] then
		self.attack_power_time_passed = 0
		self.increase_attack_power = false
		self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.attack_power)
	end
	if self.ball_size_time_passed > self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] then
		self.ball_size_time_passed = 0
		self.increase_max_ball_size = false
		self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.ball_size)
	end
	if self.monster_speed_time_passed > self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] then
		self.monster_speed_time_passed = 0
		self.decrease_monster_speed = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.activate_decrease_monster_speed, self, false, self.data.monster_type.normal))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.activate_decrease_monster_speed, self, false, self.data.monster_type.fast))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.activate_decrease_monster_speed, self, false, self.data.monster_type.heavy))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.activate_decrease_monster_speed, self, false, self.data.monster_type.item))
		self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed)
	end

	self:call_item_effect_twinkle_routine()
end

function local_class:call_item_effect_twinkle_routine()
	local call_custom_event = false
	-- 각 아이템 효과 시간 2초 남았는지 확인하여 2초 이하이고 플래그 조건 충족 시 커스텀 이벤트 메세지 보냄
	if self.attack_power_time_passed > self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] - 2.0
			and self.increase_attack_power == true
			and self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] == false then
		call_custom_event = true
		self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = true
	end
	if self.ball_size_time_passed > self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] - 2.0
			and self.increase_max_ball_size == true
			and self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] == false then
		call_custom_event = true
		self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = true
	end
	if self.monster_speed_time_passed > self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] - 2.0
			and self.decrease_monster_speed == true
			and self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] == false then
		call_custom_event = true
		self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = true
	end

	if call_custom_event == true then
		local event_name = 'item_effect_twinkle'
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { event_name }))
	end
end

function local_class:check_item_effect_twinkle()
	-- 아이템 효과 종료 2초 전 아이콘 깜빡임 효과
	while self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] == true
			or self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] == true
			or self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] == true do

		if self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] == true then
			if self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] == true then
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.attack_power].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(-0.7, 0.1, 1.5)

				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = false
			elseif self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] == false then
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.attack_power].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				unity_class.vector3.one * 999
				self.item_effects_twinkling_count[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] =
				self.item_effects_twinkling_count[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] + 1
				self:play_item_effect_twinkle_sound(self.item_effect_type.attack_power)

				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = true
			end
		end
		if self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] == true then
			if self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] == true then
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.ball_size].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(0, 0.1, 1.7)

				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = false
			elseif self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] == false then
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.ball_size].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				unity_class.vector3.one * 999
				self.item_effects_twinkling_count[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] =
				self.item_effects_twinkling_count[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] + 1
				self:play_item_effect_twinkle_sound(self.item_effect_type.ball_size)

				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = true
			end
		end
		if self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] == true then
			if self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] == true then
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(0.7, 0.1, 1.5)

				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = false
			elseif self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] == false then
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				unity_class.vector3.one * 999
				self.item_effects_twinkling_count[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] =
				self.item_effects_twinkling_count[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] + 1
				self:play_item_effect_twinkle_sound(self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed)

				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = true
			end
		end

		-- 트윙클 스위치 off
		if self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] == true then
			-- 아이템 효과 끝난 경우 효과 아이콘 제거
			if self.increase_attack_power == false then
				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = false
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.attack_power].sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
				self:init_item_effect_twinkle_info(self.item_effect_type.attack_power)
			end
			-- 아이템 효과 끝나거나 효과 시간 충전되었을 경우
			if self.attack_power_time_passed < (self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] - 2.0) and
					self.attack_power_time_passed > 0 then
				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = true
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.attack_power].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(-0.7, 0.1, 1.5)
				self:init_item_effect_twinkle_info(self.item_effect_type.attack_power)
			end
		end
		if self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] == true then
			-- 아이템 효과 끝난 경우 효과 아이콘 제거
			if self.increase_max_ball_size == false then
				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = false
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.ball_size].sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
				self:init_item_effect_twinkle_info(self.item_effect_type.ball_size)
			end
			-- 아이템 효과 끝나거나 효과 시간 충전되었을 경우
			if self.ball_size_time_passed < (self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] - 2.0) and
					self.ball_size_time_passed > 0 then
				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = true
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.ball_size].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(0, 0.1, 1.7)
				self:init_item_effect_twinkle_info(self.item_effect_type.ball_size)
			end
		end
		if self.item_effects_twinkle_switch[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] == true then
			-- 아이템 효과 끝난 경우 효과 아이콘 제거
			if self.decrease_monster_speed == false then
				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = false
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed].sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
				self:init_item_effect_twinkle_info(self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed)
			end
			-- 아이템 효과 끝나거나 효과 시간 충전되었을 경우
			if self.monster_speed_time_passed < (self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] - 2.0) and
					self.monster_speed_time_passed > 0 then
				self.item_effects_twinkling[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = true
				self.sprites_data[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed].sprite.Transform.localPosition =
				self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(0.7, 0.1, 1.5)
				self:init_item_effect_twinkle_info(self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:init_item_effect_twinkle_info(item_effect_type)

function local_class:spawn_monster(monster_type)

	local available_monster_count = nil
	local available_monsters = self.available_monsters[monster_type]
	available_monster_count = self.available_monster_count[monster_type]

	local monster = available_monsters[available_monster_count]
	available_monster_count = available_monster_count + 1


	local rb = self.area_bound.min + unity_class.vector3.right * self.area_bound.size.x
	local rt = self.area_bound.max
	rt.z = rt.z - 1
	rb.z = rb.z + 1
	local spawn_point = unity_class.vector3.right * rt.x +
			unity_class.vector3.forward * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(rt.z, rb.z, unity_class.random.value)

	spawn_point.x = spawn_point.x - 0.5

	character_util.convert_to_monster(monster)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Disappear
	monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
	monster.Position = spawn_point
	monster.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	monster.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 10)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 1, 0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.start_monster_moving, self, monster))

	self.active_monsters[monster] = true

	if self.data.hitbox_resize == true then
		monster.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(self.data.hitbox_pivot_value[monster_type].x,
				self.data.hitbox_pivot_value[monster_type].y,
				self.data.hitbox_pivot_value[monster_type].z),
				vector(self.data.hitbox_size_value[monster_type].x,
						self.data.hitbox_size_value[monster_type].y,
						self.data.hitbox_size_value[monster_type].z))
	end

	-- 몬스터 스폰 카운팅
	self.value_of_monsters_spawned = self.value_of_monsters_spawned + 1

	if #available_monsters < available_monster_count then
		available_monster_count = 1
	end
	local next_monster = available_monsters[available_monster_count]

	self.available_monster_count[monster_type] = available_monster_count
	if self.active_monsters[next_monster] ~= nil and self.active_monsters[next_monster] == false then
		self:revive_spawn_monster(next_monster)
	end
	self:set_spawn_cycle(monster_type)
end

function local_class:start_monster_moving(monster)
	coroutine.yield()
	local move_point = unity_class.vector3.right * (self.area_bound.min.x - monster.Bounds.size.x * 2) +
			unity_class.vector3.forward * monster.Position.z
	move_point.x = move_point.x - 5
	local speed = monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.WalkSpeed
	wp_util.move_way_points(monster, { waypoints = move_point, speed = speed, run = false })
end

-- 맵 맨 왼쪽 도착지점에 몬스터가 거의 도착했을 시 fade out
function local_class:monster_fade_out(monster)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(monster, 0, 0.5)
end

function local_class:set_spawn_monsters()
	local npcs = stage.CharacterManager:GetAllNpcs()
	for i = 0, npcs.Count - 1 do
		local npc = npcs[i]
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(npc)
		npc.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
		-- normal monster 테이블에 npc요소 추가
		if string.match(npc.Name, self.normal_monster_name) then
			self:revive_spawn_monster(npc)
			table.insert(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.normal], npc)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.fast_monster_name) then
			self:revive_spawn_monster(npc)
			table.insert(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.fast], npc)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.heavy_monster_name) then
			self:revive_spawn_monster(npc)
			table.insert(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.heavy], npc)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.item_monster_name) then
			self:revive_spawn_monster(npc)
			table.insert(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.item], npc)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:revive_spawn_monster(npc)
	npc.Position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(0)
	stage.DropManager:AddToNoDrop(npc)
	character_util.remove_anim(npc)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
	npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 죽어있던 몬스터들에겐 힐을 준다.
	if npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP ~= npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP then
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = npc
		heal_info.target = npc
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.heal = npc.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	end
end

function local_class:revive_spawn_all_monsters()
	for _, normal_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.normal]) do
		self:revive_spawn_monster(normal_monster)
	end

	for _, fast_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.fast]) do
		self:revive_spawn_monster(fast_monster)
	end

	for _, heavy_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.heavy]) do
		self:revive_spawn_monster(heavy_monster)
	end

	for _, item_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.item]) do
		self:revive_spawn_monster(item_monster)
	end
end

function local_class:get_monster_type_name(monster_type)
	if monster_type == self.data.monster_type.normal then
		return 'normal_monster'
	elseif monster_type == self.data.monster_type.fast then
		return 'fast_monster'
	elseif monster_type == self.data.monster_type.heavy then
		return 'heavy_monster'
	elseif monster_type == self.data.monster_type.item then
		return 'item_monster'
	end
end

function local_class:get_available_monster_type(monster)
	if table_util.contain_value(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.normal], monster) then
		return self.data.monster_type.normal
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.fast], monster) then
		return self.data.monster_type.fast
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.heavy], monster) then
		return self.data.monster_type.heavy
	elseif table_util.contain_value(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.item], monster) then
		return self.data.monster_type.item
	end
end

function local_class:set_spawn_cycle(monster_type)
	-- 첫 몬스터 생성 스폰사이클을 세팅해준다. 값을 찾을 수 없으면 기본값 2로 세팅해줌
	if self.data.respawn_cooltime[self.game_level] == nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log('ESMG - respawn fail')
	else
		local monster_type_name = self:get_monster_type_name(monster_type)
		local monster_spawn_term = self.data.respawn_cooltime[self.game_level][monster_type_name]
		if monster_spawn_term == nil then
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log('ESMG - get monster_spawn_term fail')
			return
		end

		local random_spawn_time = 0
		if self.game_level == 1 then
			random_spawn_time = monster_spawn_term
		else	-- game_level 1 이후 랜덤 값으로 스폰 진행
			if monster_type == self.data.monster_type.item then
				random_spawn_time = monster_spawn_term
			else
				random_spawn_time = random_util.get_random_int((monster_spawn_term[1] * 10), (monster_spawn_term[2] * 10))
				random_spawn_time = random_spawn_time * 0.1
			end
		end

		self.monster_spawn_cycle[monster_type] = random_spawn_time == nil and 2 or random_spawn_time
	end
end

function local_class:show_gamepad_label()
	self.gamepad_label = gamepad_util.show_joypad_label({
		string_key = 'joypad_tutorial_push_label'
	})
end

function local_class:hide_gamepad_label()
	gamepad_util.hide_joypad_label(self.gamepad_label)

	self.gamepad_label = nil
end

function local_class:game_over()
	-- BGM 종료
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})

	-- 아이템 효과 제거
	self.increase_attack_power = false
	self.increase_max_ball_size = false
	self.decrease_monster_speed = false
	self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.attack_power)
	self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.ball_size)
	self:show_item_effect_icon(false, self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed)

	for _, normal_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.normal]) do
		character_util.stop(normal_monster)
	end

	for _, fast_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.fast]) do
		character_util.stop(fast_monster)
	end

	for _, heavy_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.heavy]) do
		character_util.stop(heavy_monster)
	end

	-- 실패 동작
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dead1' })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
end
