function local_class:show_item_effect_icon(show, item_effect_type)
	if show == true then
		-- 아이템 효과 플래그 체크해 아이콘 이미지 표시
		if item_effect_type == self.item_effect_type.attack_power then
			self.sprites_data[item_effect_type].sprite.Transform.localPosition = self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(-0.7, 0.1, 1.5)
		elseif item_effect_type == self.item_effect_type.ball_size then
			self.sprites_data[item_effect_type].sprite.Transform.localPosition = self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(0, 0.1, 1.7)
		elseif item_effect_type == self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed then
			self.sprites_data[item_effect_type].sprite.Transform.localPosition = self.player_pos_marker.position + vector(0.7, 0.1, 1.5)
		end
	elseif show == false then
		-- 아이템 효과 플래그 체크해 아이콘 이미지 표시 해제
		self.sprites_data[item_effect_type].sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	end
end

function local_class:show_item_effect_text_sprite(item_type, pos)
	self.sprites_data[item_type].sprite.Transform.localPosition = pos
	coroutine.yield(self:move_effect_text_sprite(self.sprites_data[item_type].sprite, 1, 0.8))
	self.sprites_data[item_type].sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end

-- 아이템 효과 적용 함수
function local_class:set_item_effect(type, duration)
	if type == self.item_effect_type.attack_power then
		self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.attack_power] = duration
		self.attack_power_time_passed = 0
		self.increase_attack_power = true
		self:show_item_effect_icon(true, self.item_effect_type.attack_power)
	elseif type == self.item_effect_type.ball_size then
		self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.ball_size] = duration
		self.ball_size_time_passed = 0
		self.increase_max_ball_size = true
		self:show_item_effect_icon(true, self.item_effect_type.ball_size)
	elseif type == self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed then
		self.item_effect_duration_time[self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed] = duration
		self.monster_speed_time_passed = 0
		self:show_item_effect_icon(true, self.item_effect_type.mob_move_speed)
		if self.decrease_monster_speed == false then
			self.decrease_monster_speed = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.activate_decrease_monster_speed, self, true, self.data.monster_type.normal))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.activate_decrease_monster_speed, self, true, self.data.monster_type.fast))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.activate_decrease_monster_speed, self, true, self.data.monster_type.heavy))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.activate_decrease_monster_speed, self, true, self.data.monster_type.item))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:move_effect_text_sprite(sprite, height, duration)
	local start_pos = sprite.Transform.localPosition

	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		local cur_y = (duration * timer) * height

		sprite.Transform.localPosition = start_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:activate_decrease_monster_speed(active, monster_type)
	-- 따로 활성화 시킬 아이템 효과 (아이템 박스 제외)
	for _, monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[monster_type]) do
		if monster ~= nil then
			if active == true then
				character_util.stop(monster)
				--coroutine.yield()
				buff_manager:AddBuff(monster, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, monster,
						"speed_down_persistent", self.data.decrease_monster_speed_rate, false, false)
				--coroutine.yield()
				if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_monster_moving, self, monster))
				end
			elseif active == false then
				character_util.stop(monster)
				--coroutine.yield()
				buff_manager:RemoveBuff(monster, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, monster, "speed_down_persistent")
				--coroutine.yield()
				if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_monster_moving, self, monster))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:play_victory_all_gagoyle_ani()
	for _, normal_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.normal]) do
		character_util.stop(normal_monster)
		character_util.set_direction(normal_monster, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(normal_monster, {name = 'victory'})
	end

	for _, fast_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.fast]) do
		character_util.stop(fast_monster)
		character_util.set_direction(fast_monster, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(fast_monster, {name = 'victory'})
	end

	for _, heavy_monster in ipairs(self.available_monsters[self.data.monster_type.heavy]) do
		character_util.stop(heavy_monster)
		character_util.set_direction(heavy_monster, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(heavy_monster, {name = 'victory'})
	end

	-- game over 가고일 웃음소리 BGM sfx
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_laugh_01')
end

-- 플레이어 캐릭터 변경
function local_class:change_manual_character(new_manual_character_name)
	self.saved_party_leader = user_party_leader
	local manual_character = get_character(new_manual_character_name)

	-- 파티 리더 변경
	party_util.switch_leader(manual_character)

	character_util.set_direction(manual_character, self.saved_party_leader.Direction)

	-- 기존 캐릭터 보이지 않는 곳으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.saved_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

------------- 점수 계산
function local_class:add_score(monster_type)
	--일반 가고일 처리 시 : 800점 + 100*(총 처리한 가고일 + 아이템 박스의 수)
	--빠른 가고일 처리 시 : 1000 + 100*(총 처리한 가고일 + 아이템 박스의 수)
	--대형 가고일 처리 시 : 1200 + 100*(총 처리한 가고일 + 아이템 박스의 수)
	--아이템 풍선을 처리 시 : 1500점+ 100*(총 처리한 가고일 + 아이템 박스의 수)
	local base_score = 0
	if monster_type == self.data.monster_type.normal then
		base_score = 500
	elseif monster_type == self.data.monster_type.fast then
		base_score = 800
	elseif monster_type == self.data.monster_type.heavy then
		base_score = 1000
	elseif monster_type == self.data.monster_type.item then
		base_score = 1000
	end
	local add_score = base_score + 100 * (self.catch_monsters_count + self.catch_item_count)
	self.current_score = math.min(self.current_score + add_score, CS.System.Double.MaxValue)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameScoreChangeEvent.Create('EnergyballShootingMiniGame', self.current_score))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent))

	self.game_loop = false

	self:hide_gamepad_label()

	self.data = nil
	self.player_pos_marker = nil
	self.monster_spawn_cycle = nil
	self.gamepad_label = nil
	self.available_monster_count = nil
	self.saved_party_leader = nil
	self.guild_arcade_button = nil

	self.game_progress = nil
	self.touch_state = nil
	self.monster_spawn_type = nil
	self.active_monsters = nil
	self.available_monsters = nil
	self.item_effect_duration_time = nil
	self.custom_event_listener = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.item_effects_twinkle_switch = nil
	self.item_effects_twinkling = nil
	self.item_effects_twinkling_count = nil

	self.sprites_data = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

		second_bishop = self.constants_data['second_bishop'].casting_duration,

-- 게임 실행
function local_class:start()
	stage:SetGameOver(CS.Oak.UIGameOver.UIGameOverButtonType.LobbyWithWaypoint, false, false)

	self.current_state = self.state.none;

	start_coroutine(self.first_pattern, self)

	self.next_state = nil
	self.wait_duration = 0
end

-- update_frame 사용 시 반환값 true
function local_class:use_update_frame()
	return true
end

-- use_update_frame 반환값이 true일 경우 작동(즉시 작동)
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		mini_game_util.game_dispose(self.minigame_name)

		return false
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none or self.current_state == self.state.done then
		return ;
	end

	if self:ending_condition_check() then
		--종료 루틴 시작
		self.current_state = self.state.ended
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not self.current_state ~= self.state.ended then
		self:set_bishop_time_passed(dt)

		self:bishop_casting_routine()
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.start then
		--시작 시 꼬마 공주가 물통을 찾는 스테이트
		if self.time_passed >= self.eat_wait_duration then
			self.current_state = self.state.hold_up_wait

			start_coroutine(function()
				scene_util.set_anim_async(self.get_character.princess(), self, { name = 'hold_loop', loop = true, keep_anim = true })

				self.get_fo.bucket(1).Position = self.get_character.princess().Position + vector(0, 0.9, 0)

				self.time_passed = 0
				self.current_state = self.state.tracking

				character_util.show_attack_timer(self.get_character.princess(), self.tracing_total_wait_duration + self.throw_time)

				attack_range_util.show(self.princess_attack_range_blue, self.tracing_total_wait_duration + self.throw_time)
			end)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.hold_up_wait then
		--대기
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then

		--작으면 세팅
		if self.time_passed < self.tracing_wait_duration then
			self.bucket_target_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.princess_attack_range_blue, self.bucket_target_pos, 0.1)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.tracing_total_wait_duration then
			--크면 종료
			self.bucket_start_pos = self.get_fo.bucket(1).Position
			self.bucket_end_pos = self.bucket_target_pos
			self.time_passed = 0

			self.current_state = self.state.thrown
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.thrown then
		--꼬마공주가 던짐
		do
			--해당 부분을 스피드로 변경할 수도 있음
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.throw_time

			local pos = self:bezier_curves(self.bucket_start_pos, self.bucket_end_pos, progress, 3, -1, 1)

			self.get_fo.bucket(1).Position = pos
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.throw_time then
			self.get_fo.bucket(1).Position = self.bucket_end_pos

			character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.get_character.princess())

			attack_range_util.hide(self.princess_attack_range_blue)

			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.princess_attack_range_blue, self.wait_pos, 0.1)

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.current_state = self.state.wait
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		--대기상태
		--if self.time_passed >= self.wait_duration then
		self:change_next_state()
		--end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ended then
		mini_game_util.game_end(self.minigame_name)

		self.current_state = self.state.done
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:change_next_state()
	if self.next_state then
		self.current_state = self.next_state
		self.next_state = nil

		self.wait_duration = 0
		self.time_passed = 0
	end
end

-- 게임 엔딩 연출
function local_class:game_end(is_success, data)
	--캐스팅 UI 제거
	do
		local member_name = {
			--기르가스
			'dragon_boy',

			--비슈바크
			'fire_bishop',

			--라크리마
			'second_bishop',

			--칼로르
			'first_bishop',

			--니드호그
			'fire_dragon_king'
		}

		for idx = 1, #member_name do
			character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.get_character[member_name[idx]]())
		end
	end

	--npc 모두 출격
	self:join_party_with_jump()

	message_system:SendSync(self.get_fo.bucket(1), CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

	self:dispose_princess_attack_range_blue()

	self.get_fo.bucket(1).Position = self.wait_pos

	self.current_state = self.state.done

	return true
end

--파티 합류
function local_class:join_party_with_jump()
	local npc_data = {
		--기르가스
		{
			target = self.get_character.dragon_boy(),
			offset = vector(-2, 0, 0),
			is_party_member = true
		},
		--꼬마공주
		{
			target = self.get_character.princess(),
			offset = vector(-1, 0, 0),
			is_party_member = true
		},
		--비슈바크
		{
			target = self.get_character.fire_bishop(),
			offset = vector(0, 0, 0)
		},
		--라크리마
		{
			target = self.get_character.second_bishop(),
			offset = vector(1, 0, 0)
		},
		--칼로르
		{
			target = self.get_character.first_bishop(),
			offset = vector(2, 0, 0)
		},
		--니드호그
		{
			target = self.get_character.fire_dragon_king(),
			offset = vector(0, 0, -1)
		},
	}

	for _, data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = data.target
		local offset = data.offset
		local is_party_member = data.is_party_member

		start_coroutine(self.join_party, self, target, offset, is_party_member)
	end
end

function local_class:join_party(target, offset, is_party_member)
	local start_pos = target.Position
	local duration = 1.5
	local end_pos = self.get_marker_pos.center() + offset

	scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'get')

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local pos = self:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, 6)

		target.Position = pos
	end)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

	if is_party_member then
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(target, user_party, true)
	else
		character_util.convert_to_non_party_player(target)
		character_util.set_immortal(target, true)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if not user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		local battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
		battle:AddAlly(target)
		message_system:SendSync(target, CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent.Create(battle))
	end

	self.exit_count = self.exit_count + 1

	if self.exit_count == 6 then
		mini_game_util.game_dispose(self.minigame_name)
	end
end

-- 게임 종료 시 인스턴스 제거 및 데이터 제거
function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LavaRockChangedEvent))

	self:all_hide_attack_timer()

	local bucket = self.get_fo.bucket(1)

	if bucket then
		message_system:SendSync(self.get_fo.bucket(1), CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

		self.get_fo.bucket(1).Position = self.wait_pos
	end

	if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	if self.virtual_wall then
		self.virtual_wall:Dispose()
		self.virtual_wall = nil
	end

	--rock을 넘긴다
	local quest_controller = get_quest_event_controller('FireWorldMainController')

	if quest_controller then
		quest_controller.boss_gimmick_phase_rock_list = self.lava_rock_list
	end

	self:dispose_rock()

	self:dispose_attack_range()

	self:dispose_princess_attack_range_blue()

	stage:SetGameOver(CS.Oak.UIGameOver.UIGameOverButtonType.All, false, false)
end

function local_class:first_pattern()

	self:convert_to_npc_all()

	if self.virtual_wall then

function local_class:bishop_casting_routine()
	local member_name = {
		--기르가스
		'dragon_boy',

		--비슈바크
		'fire_bishop',

		--라크리마
		'second_bishop',

		--칼로르
		'first_bishop',

		--니드호그
		'fire_dragon_king'
	}

	for idx = 1, #member_name do
		--기르가스
		if not self.is_bishop_wait[member_name[idx]] and self.bishop_time_passed_list[member_name[idx]] >= self.bishop_casting_duration_list[member_name[idx]] then
			scene_util.set_anim(self.get_character[member_name[idx]](), self, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

			self:bishop_create_rock()
			self.is_bishop_wait[member_name[idx]] = true
			self.bishop_time_passed_list[member_name[idx]] = 0

			character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.get_character[member_name[idx]]())

		elseif self.is_bishop_wait[member_name[idx]] and self.bishop_time_passed_list[member_name[idx]] >= self.bishop_wait_duration_list[member_name[idx]] then
			scene_util.set_anim(self.get_character[member_name[idx]](), self, 'cast')

			character_util.show_attack_timer(self.get_character[member_name[idx]](), self.bishop_casting_duration_list[member_name[idx]])

			self.bishop_time_passed_list[member_name[idx]] = 0

		end
	end

function local_class:set_bishop_time_passed(dt)
	if not self.bishop_time_passed_list then
		return
	end

	self.bishop_time_passed_list.dragon_boy = self.bishop_time_passed_list.dragon_boy + dt
	self.bishop_time_passed_list.fire_bishop = self.bishop_time_passed_list.fire_bishop + dt
	self.bishop_time_passed_list.second_bishop = self.bishop_time_passed_list.second_bishop + dt
	self.bishop_time_passed_list.first_bishop = self.bishop_time_passed_list.first_bishop + dt
	self.bishop_time_passed_list.fire_dragon_king = self.bishop_time_passed_list.fire_dragon_king + dt
end

function local_class:bishop_create_rock()
	local max_count = #self.lava_fire_flow_list
	local leader_pos = get_party_leader().Position
	local save_object = nil

	for idx = 1, max_count do
		local target_fo = self.lava_fire_flow_list[idx]

		if target_fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
			--저장된 오브젝트가 없다면 그냥 넣어준다.
			if not save_object then
				save_object = self.lava_fire_flow_list[idx]
			else
				--저장된 오브젝트가 있다면 리더와의 거리가 누가 더 가까운지 비교
				local old_dist = (leader_pos - save_object.Position).magnitude
				local new_dist = (leader_pos - self.lava_fire_flow_list[idx].Position).magnitude

				save_object = old_dist > new_dist and self.lava_fire_flow_list[idx] or save_object
			end
		end
	end

	if save_object then
		field_object_util.set_active_state(save_object, active_state_type.visible)

		self.fx.lava_smoke():Instantiate(save_object.Position)

		self:create_rock(save_object.Position)

		self.bishop_time_passed = 0
	end

	return
end

--캐릭터 날아가는 연출
function local_class:launch_character_scene(target, end_pos, duration, height, direction)
	local start_pos = target.Position

	scene_util.set_direction(target, direction)
	scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(target, self, 'prostrate')

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local pos = self:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height)

		target.Position = pos
	end)

	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(target, direction)

	character_util.remove_anim(target)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_character.princess(), target) then
		--꼬공의 애니메이션을 변경해준다. (물통 찾기)
		local princess = self.get_character.princess()

		princess.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)

		scene_util.set_emotion(princess, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(princess, self, 'eat')
	else
		self:set_bishop_casting()
	end

	self.exit_count = self.exit_count + 1

	if self.exit_count == 6 then
		self.current_state = self.state.none

		wait_for_sec(1)

		do
			local member_name = {
				--기르가스
				'dragon_boy',

				--비슈바크
				'fire_bishop',

				--라크리마
				'second_bishop',

				--칼로르
				'first_bishop',

				--니드호그
				'fire_dragon_king'
			}

			for idx = 1, #member_name do
				character_util.show_attack_timer(self.get_character[member_name[idx]](), self.bishop_casting_duration_list[member_name[idx]])
			end
		end

		self.current_state = self.state.start
	end
end

--베지어 곡선
function local_class:bezier_curves(start_pos, end_pos, progress, height, height_x1, height_x2)
	height_x1 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x1, 0)
	height_x2 = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_x2, 0)

	local pos = {
		start_pos,
		start_pos + vector(height_x1, height, 0),
		end_pos + vector(height_x2, height, 0),
		end_pos
	}
	local a_pos, b_pos, c_pos, d_pos, e_pos, f_pos

	a_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[1], pos[2], progress)
	b_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[2], pos[3], progress)
	c_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos[3], pos[4], progress)
	d_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(a_pos, b_pos, progress)
	e_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(b_pos, c_pos, progress)
	f_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(d_pos, e_pos, progress)

	return f_pos
end

function local_class:check_collision()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local target_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.get_marker_pos.center(), unity_class.vector3(6, 1, 6))

	if self:aabb(target_bounds, leader.Bounds) then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

function local_class:aabb_by_point(bounds, point)
	return bounds.min.x <= point.x and bounds.max.x >= point.x
			and bounds.min.z <= point.z and bounds.max.z >= point.z
end

function local_class:enable_all_lava_fire_flow()
	local tilemap = field.Tilemap

	local gimmick_layer = tilemap.transform:Find('gimmick_lava')

	for i = 0, gimmick_layer.childCount - 1 do
		local fieldobject = gimmick_layer:GetChild(i):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))

		if fieldobject.Name == '[gimmick]lava_fire_flow' then
			table.insert(self.lava_fire_flow_list, fieldobject)

			field_object_util.set_active_state(fieldobject, active_state_type.enabled)
		end
	end

	self.rock_max_count = #self.lava_fire_flow_list
end

		if fo_name == "[gimmick]safe_stone" then

function local_class:load_sea_bg()
	local start_pos_transform_offset = vector(-4.6, 0, 0.2)
	local bg_pos = self.system_data.bg_center_pos + start_pos_transform_offset
	local shine_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.1)

	-- 배경 크기가 작아 해상도 대응 하려면 3개 이어 붙여야함
	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		local bg_prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
				'ondemand/short_story_summer/tilesets', 'swim_minigame')

		self.background.pooled[i] = {
			prefab = bg_prefab,
			background = bg_prefab.transform:Find('swim_minigame_background_0.5').transform,
			front = bg_prefab.transform:Find('swim_minigame_front_1.0').transform,
			middle_1 = bg_prefab.transform:Find('swim_minigame_middle1_0.8').transform,
			middle_2 = bg_prefab.transform:Find('swim_minigame_middle2_0.6').transform,
			shine = bg_prefab.transform:Find('swim_minigame_shine_0.5').transform,
		}

		-- 리소스 크기가 작아 scale을 확대해서 사용
		self.background.pooled[i].prefab.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1.5, 1) * self.background.scale
		self.background.pooled[i].shine.localPosition = shine_offset
		self.background.pooled[i].prefab.transform.position = bg_pos
		bg_pos = bg_pos + self.background.size
	end
end

function local_class:background_scroller_routine(dt)
	local scroll_speed = {
		background = 0.5,
		front = 1,
		middle_1 = 0.8,
		middle_2 = 0.6,
		shine = 0.5,
	}

	local boundary_pos_x = -128
	local bg_size = 38.4
	local dir_vector = -1

	local scrolling_routine = function(fo, speed)
		local cur_x = fo.position.x + dir_vector * speed * dt
		local cur_z = fo.position.z
		if cur_x < boundary_pos_x then
			cur_x = cur_x + bg_size
		end
		local cur_pos = vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)
		fo.position = cur_pos
	end

	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		scrolling_routine(self.background.pooled[i].background, scroll_speed.background)
		scrolling_routine(self.background.pooled[i].front, scroll_speed.front)
		scrolling_routine(self.background.pooled[i].middle_1, scroll_speed.middle_1)
		scrolling_routine(self.background.pooled[i].middle_2, scroll_speed.middle_2)
		scrolling_routine(self.background.pooled[i].shine, scroll_speed.shine)
	end
end

-- 게임 클리어 연출 중 배경 스크롤 지속용
function local_class:background_scroller_game_clear_scene_update()
	while not self.background.end_update_routine do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not self.background.scrolling_end then
			self:background_scroller_routine(dt)
		end

		if self.background.end_update_routine then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	if self.background.pool_destroy then
		self:background_dispose()
		self:screen_bubble_effect_dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:background_dispose()
	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		if self.background.pooled[i] ~= nil then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.background.pooled[i].prefab)
		end
		self.background.pooled[i] = nil
	end

	self:screen_bubble_effect_dispose()
end

function local_class:screen_bubble_effect_dispose()
	if self.screen_bubble_effect ~= nil then
		self.screen_bubble_effect:Dispose()
		self.screen_bubble_effect = nil
	end
end

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	else
		self:fail_mini_game_routine(is_fishing_hook_hit)
		self.background.end_update_routine = true
		self:screen_bubble_effect_dispose()
	end

	self:reset_ui()

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_clear))

	self.background.scrolling_end = false
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	while self.is_playing_game do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		self.obstacle.blowfish:update_manager(dt)
		self.obstacle.piranha:update_manager(dt)
		self.obstacle.fishing_hook:update_manager(dt)
		self:player_moving_update(dt)
		self:background_scroller_routine(dt)

		if time_passed < self.system_data.time_limit then
			local wave_check = #self.wave >= self.wave_count

			if not self.player.hit then
				-- 지속시간이 wave 패턴의 시간을 넘겼을 시 해당 장애물 생성
				if wave_check and time_passed >= self.wave[self.wave_count].time then
					if wave_check then
						self.obstacle[self.wave[self.wave_count].obstacle_type]:spawn_manager()
						self.wave_count = self.wave_count + 1
					end
				end
			else
				-- 장애물에 닿아서 게임 실패 시
				self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.leader.Position + vector(0.25, 0.5, 0))

				self.is_playing_game = false

				local is_clear = false
				local is_fishing_hook_hit = false
				self:game_end(is_clear, is_fishing_hook_hit)
			end

			-- 낚시 패턴에 걸렸을 시
			if self.hit.fishing_hook and not self.player.immortal then
				self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.leader.Position + vector(0.25, 0.5, 0))

				self.is_playing_game = false

				local is_clear = false
				local is_fishing_hook_hit = true
				self:game_end(is_clear, is_fishing_hook_hit)
			end
		else
			-- 제한시간 동안 살아남아 게임 클리어
			if not self.is_game_clear then
				self.is_game_clear = true

				local is_clear = true
				local is_fishing_hook_hit = false
				self:game_end(is_clear, is_fishing_hook_hit)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:tutorial_qte()
	--인어가 자리에 위치한 후, 액티비티 최초 1회 하단의 이벤트 진행.
	--인어 (right, idle, idle) : 분명 이 근처 어딘가에 떨어졌을텐데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.leader, { key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_tutorial_1', skip = true })

	--인어 (right, smile, idle) : 꼭 찾아서 기쁘게 해드려야지!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.leader, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.leader, { key = 'short_story_mm_sub_fb_minigame_tutorial_2', skip = true })

	--인어 idle 표정 전환.
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.leader)

	--게임이 정지되며 QTE 튜토리얼 버튼 출력.
	--QTE 종류 : 탭
	--제한시간 : 무제한 / QTE 실패 유무 : 무
	--횟수 : 1번
	time_util.mod('qte', 0.1)

	self.qte_tap = false

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActionTap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, 1 * 0.1)

	while not self.qte_tap do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--플레이어가 버튼을 탭했을 시, 인어가 up 방향을 향해 상승하며 플레이어 컨트롤 풀리고 미니 게임 시작.
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	time_util.unmod('qte')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1, 1)

	--이후 해당 튜토리얼 이벤트는 출력되지 않음.
	self.is_tutorial = false
end

function local_class:player_immortal(fishing_hook_hit)
	if fishing_hook_hit then
		--플레이어가 장애물에 피격당했을 시
		--인어 캐릭터에 FX_hit 이펙트가 출력되며, damaged 표정으로 embarrassed 애니메이션 0.5초 진행함.
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.leader.Position + vector(0.25, 0.5, 0))
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

		-- 인어 캐릭터에 Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력.
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.leader)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.leader)

		-- 낚시 줄에 걸리면 플레이어 멈춰서 낚시 바늘에 걸릴 때 까지 대기
		while self.hit.fishing_line do
			coroutine.yield()

			if self.hit.fishing_hook then
				self.hit.fishing_line = false

				break
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self.embarrassed_reaction_end = true

		self.player.immortal = true
	end

	self.hit.reaction = false
	self.is_immortal_end = true
end

function local_class:fail_mini_game_routine(is_fishing_hook_hit)
	--화면에 출현한 인어 캐릭터 및 모든 몬스터 제자리 정지.
	--플레이어 damaged 표정, idle 애니메이션 상태로 반시계 방향으로 180도 회전하며 액티비티 실패 문구 출력.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.leader)

	local rotate_dur = 2
	local fade_out_dur = 1

	if not is_fishing_hook_hit then
		local rotate_angle = 180
		character_util.spine_rotate(self.leader, rotate_angle, rotate_dur)

		fade_out_dur = rotate_dur - 1.3
	else
		fade_out_dur = 1
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	self:stop_bgm()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('short_story_mm_fb_game_fail'))

	wait_for_sec(fade_out_dur)

	--이후 서큘러 페이드 아웃하며 미니게임 진입 전 위치로 이동.
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(fade_out_dur + 0.3, 'linear')

	character_util.spine_rotate(self.leader, 0, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
end

function local_class:stop_bgm()
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.water_loop_sfx, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
end

--region Player Moving State
function local_class:player_moving_update(dt)
	local max_z = self.system_data.max_z
	local min_z = self.system_data.min_z
	local padding_top = self.system_data.padding_top
	local padding_bottom = self.system_data.padding_bottom
	local bubble_fx_offset = vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	self.touch_delay_timer = self.touch_delay_timer + dt

	if self.jump_key_press then
		if self.touch_delay_timer > self.system_data.ignore_touch_delay then

			if not self.hit.fishing_hook and not self.hit.fishing_line then
				-- 낚시 패턴에 걸렸을 땐 fx 와 소리 안나오게
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_01')
				self.get_fx_swimming_bubble():Instantiate(self.leader.Bounds.center + bubble_fx_offset,
						unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.leader.Transform)
			end

			self.player.drop_speed = self.player.constants.drop_speed
			self.player.jump_velocity = self.player.constants.jump_velocity
			self.touch_delay_timer = 0
			self.jump_key_press = false
		end
	end

	local cur_z = self.leader.Position.z + (self.player.jump_velocity - self.player.drop_speed) * dt

	-- 배경에 따른 캐릭터의 상하 최대 이동 거리
	if cur_z > max_z - padding_top then
		cur_z = max_z - padding_top
	elseif cur_z < min_z + padding_bottom then
		cur_z = min_z + padding_bottom

		self.player.drop_speed = self.player.constants.drop_speed
		self.player.jump_velocity = self.player.constants.jump_velocity
		self.player.hit = true
		self.player.immortal = true
	end

	local cur_x = self.leader.Position.x
	local cur_pos = vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)

	-- 낚시 바늘에 걸리면 제자리에 멈춤
	if not self.hit.fishing_hook then
		self.leader.Position = cur_pos
	end

	if self.player.jump_velocity > 0 then
		self.player.jump_velocity = self.player.jump_velocity - (self.player.constants.jump_acceleration * dt)
		self.player.drop_speed = self.player.drop_speed + (self.player.constants.drop_acceleration * dt)
	else
		self.player.jump_velocity = 0
	end

	-- 장애물에 피격 당했을 때, 각 장애물이 체크하고 있음
	if self.player.immortal and not self.hit.reaction then
		self.hit.reaction = true

		if self.hit.fishing_hook and not self.is_immortal_end then
			start_coroutine(self.player_immortal, self, true)
		elseif not self.hit.fishing_hook then
			start_coroutine(self.player_immortal, self)
		end
	end
end
--endregion Player Moving State

function obstacle_base:collision_check(target_pos)
	local collision_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.3)

	local dist_to_player = (self.controller.leader.Bounds.center - (target_pos + collision_offset)).sqrMagnitude
	if not self.controller.player.immortal and dist_to_player < self.controller.player.constants.hit_dist ^ 2 then
		self.controller.player.hit = true
		self.controller.player.immortal = true
	end
end

		for _, fishing_hook in pairs(self.update_fishing_hook_list) do

			fishing_hook.rope:Dispose()
		end
	end

	self.pooled_fishing_hook = nil
	self.fishing_hook_pooled_num = nil

	self.fishing_hook_item_id = nil
end

function obstacle.fishing_hook:dispose()
end

function obstacle.fishing_hook:update_manager(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	local dir_vector_x = nil
	local cur_x = nil
	local cur_z = nil
	local hook_speed = 5

	local screen_out_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', self.controller.leader.Position, 2)

	for _, fishing_hook in pairs(self.update_fishing_hook_list) do
		if not fishing_hook.hook_hit_check and not fishing_hook.line_hit_check then
			dir_vector_x = -1
			cur_x = fishing_hook.obstacle.Position.x +
					dir_vector_x * self.controller.obstacle_constants.fishing_hook.speed * dt
			cur_z = self.controller.system_data.max_z - fishing_hook.line

			--낚시 줄에만 닿았을 때
		elseif not fishing_hook.hook_hit_check and fishing_hook.line_hit_check then
			cur_x = fishing_hook.obstacle.Position.x
			cur_z = fishing_hook.obstacle.Position.z

			-- 낚시줄 위로 상승함
			cur_z = cur_z + hook_speed * dt

			-- 낚시 바늘 닿았을 때
		elseif fishing_hook.hook_hit_check then
			cur_x = fishing_hook.obstacle.Position.x
			cur_z = fishing_hook.obstacle.Position.z

			-- embarrassed 리액션 동안 대기 후
			if self.controller.embarrassed_reaction_end then
				-- 플레이어 낚시줄과 같이 위로 끌려올라감
				local leader_cur_z = self.controller.leader.Position.z + hook_speed * dt
				self.controller.leader.Position = vector(self.controller.leader.Position.x, 0, leader_cur_z)

				cur_z = cur_z + hook_speed * dt

				-- 화면 밖으로 나가면 루틴 종료
				if screen_out_pos.z < leader_cur_z then
					self.controller.player.immortal = false
				end
			end
		end

		local cur_pos = vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)
		fishing_hook.obstacle.Position = cur_pos

		local rope_offset = cur_pos + vector(0.1, 0, 0.2)
		fishing_hook.rope.transform.position = rope_offset

		-- 낚시 바늘은 따로 커스텀하게 충돌 체크
		local fishing_hook_collision_center_pos = fishing_hook.obstacle.Position + vector(-0.2, 0, -0.7)
		local leader_collision_center_pos = self.controller.leader.Bounds.center
		local dist_to_player = (leader_collision_center_pos - fishing_hook_collision_center_pos).sqrMagnitude

		if not self.controller.player.immortal and not self.controller.hit.fishing_hook then
			self:fishing_line_hit_check(fishing_hook, fishing_hook_collision_center_pos, leader_collision_center_pos)

			if dist_to_player < self.controller.obstacle_constants.fishing_hook.fishing_hook_hit_dist ^ 2 then
				self.controller.player.immortal = true
				self.controller.hit.fishing_hook = true
				fishing_hook.hook_hit_check = true
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 플레이어의 좌표가 낚시 바늘의 center 를 기준으로 z는 높고 x는 작으면 낚시 줄에 걸린 것으로 판단
function obstacle.fishing_hook:fishing_line_hit_check(fo, fishing_hook_collision_center_pos, leader_collision_center_pos)
	local fishing_line_bound_x = 0.2
	local fishing_line_bound_z = 0.3
	local hit_check_x = leader_collision_center_pos.x > (fishing_hook_collision_center_pos.x - fishing_line_bound_x)
			and leader_collision_center_pos.x < (fishing_hook_collision_center_pos.x + fishing_line_bound_x)
	local hit_check_z = leader_collision_center_pos.z > (fishing_hook_collision_center_pos.z + fishing_line_bound_z)

	if hit_check_z and hit_check_x then
		fo.line_hit_check = true
		self.controller.hit.fishing_line = true
	end
end

function obstacle.fishing_hook:spawn_fishing_hook()
	local pooled_fishing_hook = {
		obstacle = self.pooled_fishing_hook[self.fishing_hook_pooled_num],
		line = self.controller.wave[self.controller.wave_count].line,
		rope = self.controller.get_rope_trap():Instantiate(vector(999, 0, 999)),
		hook_hit_check = false,
		line_hit_check = false
	}
	self.update_fishing_hook_list[self.fishing_hook_pooled_num] = pooled_fishing_hook

	pooled_fishing_hook.obstacle.Position = vector(self.controller.obstacle_constants.start_pos.x, 0, 999)

	self.fishing_hook_pooled_num = self.fishing_hook_pooled_num + 1
end

function obstacle.fishing_hook:fishing_hook_pooled_setting()
	for i = 1, self.controller.obstacle_constants.fishing_hook.pool_count do
		local rock = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
			itemid = self.fishing_hook_item_id,
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			skip_text = true,
			showoncharacter = true
		})

		self.pooled_fishing_hook[i] = rock
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('GoStopMiniGame')

---@class GoStopNpcPoolManager
---@type GoStopNpcPoolManager
local dynamic_character_pool = newclass('GoStopNpcPoolManager')

local linked_list = {}
linked_list.__index = linked_list

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
  self.cs_controller = cs_controller
  -- 게임 이름
  self.game_name = 'GoStopMiniGame'

  self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

  self.res_holder = nil
  self.custom_atlas = nil
  self.ui_buttons = {}

  -- 게임 상태
  self.game_state = {
    none = 1,
    playing = 2,
    game_clear = 3,
    game_fail = 4,
  }

  self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
  self.ui_num_counter = nil

  self.use_circular_fade_in = false

  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none
  self.detected_npc = nil

  self.dynamic_character_pool = dynamic_character_pool()

  -- npc pool table
  ---@type table<string, GoStopNpcPool>
  self.pools = {}

  -- npc 생성 대기열
  self.npc_spawn_list = {}

  -- 생성된 npc linked-list
  self.npc_list = linked_list.new()
  self.wait_signal = {}
  self.signal_objects = {}

  -- 생성된 순찰병 리스트
  self.watcher_list = {}
  self.attack_range_list = {}

  self.instance_id = 1
end

function local_class:load_resource(key)
  self.constants_data = require('minigame/GoStopMiniGame/GoStopMiniGameConstants')[key]

  for i = 1, #self.constants_data.npc_specs do
    local spec = self.constants_data.npc_specs[i].name
    self.pools[spec] = self.dynamic_character_pool:create(spec, 1)
  end
  self.pools[self.constants_data.watcher_spec] = self.dynamic_character_pool:create(self.constants_data.watcher_spec, 2)

  local function shallow_copy(original)
    local copy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(original) do
      copy[key] = value
    end
    return copy
  end

  local function shuffle(list)
    for i = #list, 2, -1 do
      local j = math.random(i)
      list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i] -- Swap elements
    end
  end

  self.npc_spawn_list = shallow_copy(self.constants_data.npc_specs)
  shuffle(self.npc_spawn_list)

  self.get_num_counter_ui = function()
    return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUINumCounter')
  end

  self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
  yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
      self.res_holder, self.constants_data.ui_button_atlas_path, self.constants_data.ui_button_atlas_name, function(prefab)
        self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
        self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
      end)
end

function local_class:start()
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

  self:load_num_counter()

  self.npc_success_count = 0
  self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(self.npc_success_count)

  start_coroutine(function()
    for i = 1, #self.constants_data.signals do
      local signal_data = self.constants_data.signals[i]
      local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(signal_data.object_name)
      while pool.State ~= CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolState.Loaded do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
      end
    end

    for i = 1, #self.constants_data.signals do
      local signal_data = self.constants_data.signals[i]
      self.wait_signal[signal_data.index] = false

      local position = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[signal_data.index]
      local obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(signal_data.object_name):Instantiate(position)
      obj.transform:Find('on').gameObject:SetActive(true)
      obj.transform:Find('off').gameObject:SetActive(false)
      self.signal_objects[i] = obj
    end

    -- 순찰병 생성
    for i = 1, #self.constants_data.watchers do
      start_coroutine(self.watcher_routine, self, self.constants_data.watchers[i])
    end

    start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
    start_coroutine(self.detect_update, self)
  end)
end

--- 게임 초기화
function local_class:reset()
  self.instance_id = self.instance_id + 1

  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

  if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_fail then
    self.use_circular_fade_in = true
  else
    self.use_circular_fade_in = false
  end

  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none
  self.detected_npc = nil

  -- 생성된 npc 반환
  local pivot = self.npc_list.head
  while pivot ~= nil do
    local invalid_node = pivot
    pivot = pivot.next

    self.npc_list:remove(invalid_node)
    self.pools[invalid_node.value.spec_name]:return_back(invalid_node.value.character)
  end

  self.npc_success_count = 0

  for i = 1, #self.watcher_list do
    self.pools[self.constants_data.watcher_spec]:return_back(self.watcher_list[i])
  end
  self.watcher_list = {}

  for i = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
    self.attack_range_list[i]:Dispose()
  end
  self.attack_range_list = {}

  for i = 1, #self.signal_objects do
    self.signal_objects[i]:Dispose()
  end
  self.signal_objects = {}

end

function local_class:dispose()
  self.instance_id = self.instance_id + 1

  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

  if self.res_holder ~= nil then
    self.res_holder:Dispose()
    self.res_holder = nil
  end

  self.custom_atlas = nil
  self.ui_buttons = {}

  self.constants_data = nil

  self:unload_num_counter()

  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none

  if self.dynamic_character_pool ~= nil then
    self.dynamic_character_pool:dispose()
    self.dynamic_character_pool = nil
  end

  self.pools = nil

  self.npc_list = nil

  self.watcher_list = nil
  self.attack_range_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
  return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
  if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
    return false
  end

  for i = 1, #self.constants_data.ui_buttons do
    local data = self.constants_data.ui_buttons[i]

    if e.TouchEventType == data.touch_event then

      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_party_add_01')

      local signal_index = self.constants_data.signals[i].index
      local value = self.wait_signal[signal_index]
      self.wait_signal[signal_index] = not value

      self.signal_objects[i].transform:Find('on').gameObject:SetActive(value)
      self.signal_objects[i].transform:Find('off').gameObject:SetActive(not value)

      if value then
        self.ui_buttons[i].touch.SpriteName = data.pass_icon
        self.ui_buttons[i].touch:Rebuild()

        self.ui_buttons[i].pad.SpriteName = data.pass_icon
        self.ui_buttons[i].pad:Rebuild()
      else
        self.ui_buttons[i].touch.SpriteName = data.stop_icon
        self.ui_buttons[i].touch:Rebuild()

        self.ui_buttons[i].pad.SpriteName = data.stop_icon
        self.ui_buttons[i].pad:Rebuild()
      end
    end
  end

  return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none
  return true
end

function local_class:use_update_frame()
  return true
end

function local_class:use_late_update_frame()
  return false
end

-- npc 이동
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
  if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
    return
  end

  -- 움직일 npc 가 없는 경우 return
  if self.npc_list.head == nil then
    return
  end

  -- npc 이동
  local pivot = self.npc_list.head
  while pivot ~= nil do
    self:npc_move_delta(pivot, dt)

    -- 도착한 npc 삭제
    if pivot.waypoint_index > #self.constants_data.npc_waypoints then
      local invalid_node = pivot
      pivot = pivot.next

      self.npc_list:remove(invalid_node)
      self.pools[invalid_node.value.spec_name]:return_back(invalid_node.value.character)

      self.npc_success_count = self.npc_success_count + 1
      self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(self.npc_success_count)
    else
      pivot = pivot.next
    end
  end
end

function local_class:game_routine()
  local ins_id = self.instance_id

  -- 카메라 초기 위치로 이동
  camera_util.move(self.constants_data.start_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })
  camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.constants_data.camera_ratio, 0)

  -- 페이드 인
  if self.use_circular_fade_in then
    screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')
  else
    screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
  end

  -- 미니 게임 시작 연출
  do
    music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', name = 'bgm_chasing', volume = 0.6, mix = 2 })

    -- 경기 시작 카운트
    local start_count = 3
    local title_mod = 2.1
    for i = start_count, 1, -1 do
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
      CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format('{0}', i), title_mod)

      wait_for_sec(1)
    end
  end
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.playing

  music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_escape' })
  self:show_ui()

  wait_for_sec(1)

  start_coroutine(self.spawn_routine, self)

  while true do
    if ins_id ~= self.instance_id then
      return
    end

    if self.npc_success_count >= #self.npc_spawn_list then
      self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.game_clear
    end

    if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_clear or self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_fail then
      break
    end

    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  self.instance_id = self.instance_id + 1

  self:hide_ui()

  if self.detected_npc ~= nil then

    character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(self.detected_npc.value.character, 'down', 'embrassed', 'damaged')
    character_util.normal_jump_async(self.detected_npc.value.character)

    wait_for_sec(1)

    self.detected_npc = nil
  end

  if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_fail then
    mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, false)
  elseif self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.none then
    self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.game_clear
    mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, true)
  end
end

function local_class:spawn_routine()
  local ins_id = self.instance_id

  for i = 1, #self.npc_spawn_list do
    if ins_id ~= self.instance_id then
      return
    end

    start_coroutine(self.create_npc, self, self.npc_spawn_list[i])

    wait_for_sec(self.constants_data.npc_spawn_interval)
  end
end

--- 게임 성공 실패 연출용
function local_class:game_end(is_success, data)
  start_coroutine(function()
    if not is_success then
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
      screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')
    else
      music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
      CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

      wait_for_sec(3)

      screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
    end

    message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
  end)
end

function local_class:hide_ui()
  field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(get_party_leader(), self.constants_data.ui_buttons_bits)
  field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
end

function local_class:show_ui()
  field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
      | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
      | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

  field_ui_manager:SetUI(get_party_leader(), self.constants_data.ui_buttons_bits)
  field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(self.constants_data.ui_buttons_bits)

  coroutine.yield(nil)

  for i = 1, #self.constants_data.ui_buttons do
    local data = self.constants_data.ui_buttons[i]
    local ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(get_party_leader())[data.type]

    local touch_button_sprite = ui.transform:Find('Touch/Icon'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
    touch_button_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
    touch_button_sprite.SpriteName = data.pass_icon
    touch_button_sprite:Rebuild()

    local pad_button_sprite = ui.transform:Find('JoyPad/Icon'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
    pad_button_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
    pad_button_sprite.SpriteName = data.pass_icon
    pad_button_sprite.LocalScale = vector(0.7, 0.7)
    pad_button_sprite:Rebuild()

    self.ui_buttons[i] = {
      touch = touch_button_sprite,
      pad = pad_button_sprite
    }

    local button_component = ui.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUISpecialFunctionButton))
    button_component:BindingKeyCode(data.key_code)
    button_component:SetKeyboardStringKey(data.gpg_key_code)
    button_component:SetButtonCoolTime(3)
    button_component:SetButtonCoolDown(0)
    button_component:SetButtonActive(true)

    local touch_screen_positioner = ui.transform:Find('Touch'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
    touch_screen_positioner.AnchorPosition = data.anchor_direction
    touch_screen_positioner.Position = data.position
    touch_screen_positioner:Rebuild()

    local pad_screen_positioner = ui.transform:Find('JoyPad'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
    pad_screen_positioner.AnchorPosition = data.anchor_direction
    pad_screen_positioner.Position = data.position
    pad_screen_positioner:Rebuild()
  end

  field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:create_npc(spawn_data)
  local ins_id = self.instance_id

  local position = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[1]
  local next_position = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[2]

  -- 공간이 충분하지 않으면 생성 취소
  if self.npc_list.tail ~= nil then
    local distance_to_tail = (self.npc_list.tail.value.character.Position - self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[1]).magnitude
    if distance_to_tail < self.constants_data.npc_distance then
      return
    end
  end

  local npc = self.pools[spawn_data.name]:get()
  assert(npc ~= nil)

  if ins_id ~= self.instance_id then
    self.pools[spawn_data.name]:return_back(npc)
    return
  end

  local direction = next_position - position
  character_util.set_position(npc, position)
  character_util.set_direction(npc, direction:ToDirection())

  local node = self.npc_list:push_tail({ character = npc, spec_name = spawn_data.name, move_speed = spawn_data.move_speed })
  node.waypoint_index = 2
  node.wait_move_signal = true
end

function local_class:npc_move_delta(node, delta_time)
  local waypoint_index = node.waypoint_index

  -- 다음 웨이포인트 까지 이동
  while waypoint_index <= #self.constants_data.npc_waypoints do
    local target_pos = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[waypoint_index]
    local current_pos = node.value.character.Position
    local direction = target_pos - current_pos

    -- 다음 웨이포인트로 갈 수 있는지 검사
    if node.wait_move_signal then
      character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(node.value.character, direction:ToDirection(), 'walk', 'idle')

      -- 신호에 막혀있으면 대기 (node.waypoint_index 는 이미 다음 목적지를 가리키고 있으므로 -1)
      local signal_index = node.waypoint_index - 1
      if self.wait_signal[signal_index] then
        return
      end

      node.wait_move_signal = false
    end

    local distance_to_target = (target_pos - current_pos).magnitude
    if distance_to_target >= 0.001 then

      -- 앞 캐릭터에 막혀서 못가는지 검사
      if node.prev ~= nil then
        local distance_to_prev = self:calculate_distance(node, node.prev)
        if distance_to_prev <= self.constants_data.npc_distance then
          return
        end
      end

      local move_speed = node.value.move_speed
      local new_position = vector_util.move_towards(current_pos, target_pos, move_speed * delta_time)
      node.value.character.Position = new_position
      current_pos = node.value.character.Position
      distance_to_target = (target_pos - current_pos).magnitude

      break
    else
      node.value.character.Position = target_pos

      waypoint_index = waypoint_index + 1
      node.waypoint_index = waypoint_index
      node.wait_move_signal = true
    end
  end
end

function local_class:watcher_routine(data)
  local ins_id = self.instance_id

  local pool = self.pools[self.constants_data.watcher_spec]
  local watcher = pool:get()
  assert(watcher ~= nil)

  if ins_id ~= self.instance_id then
    pool:return_back(watcher)
    return
  end

  table.insert(self.watcher_list, watcher)

  character_util.set_position(watcher, data.position)
  character_util.set_dir_anim_emotion(watcher, data.direction, 'idle', 'idle')

  local attack_range = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(watcher, data.sight_distance, data.sight_angle);
  attack_range.AttackRange:Show(0)
  attack_range:Update(watcher)
  table.insert(self.attack_range_list, attack_range)

  wait_for_sec(data.start_delay)

  local waypoint_index = 1
  while true do
    if ins_id ~= self.instance_id then
      return
    end

    local waypoint_data = data.waypoints[waypoint_index]
    local is_moving = true
    character_util.set_anim(watcher, { name = 'walk', loop = true })
    wp_util.move(watcher, waypoint_data.pos, waypoint_data.speed, nil, {
      last_direction = waypoint_data.direction,
      callback = function()
        character_util.set_anim(watcher, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
        is_moving = false
      end })

    coroutine.yield(nil)

    if ins_id ~= self.instance_id then
      return
    end

    attack_range:Update(watcher)

    -- 이동 끝날 때 까지 대기
    while is_moving do
      if ins_id ~= self.instance_id then
        return
      end

      coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    wait_for_sec(waypoint_data.wait_time)

    waypoint_index = waypoint_index + 1
    if waypoint_index > #data.waypoints then
      waypoint_index = 1
    end
  end
end

function local_class:detect_update()
  local ins_id = self.instance_id

  while true do
    if ins_id ~= self.instance_id then
      return
    end

    local npc_pivot = self.npc_list.head
    while npc_pivot ~= nil do

      local cur_pivot = npc_pivot
      npc_pivot = npc_pivot.next

      for i = 1, #self.watcher_list do
        local watcher = self.watcher_list[i]
        local watcher_data = self.constants_data.watchers[i]

        if self:is_in_sight(watcher, cur_pivot.value.character, watcher_data.sight_distance, watcher_data.sight_angle) then
          self.detected_npc = cur_pivot
          self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.game_fail
          music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
          music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
          return
        end
      end
    end

    wait_for_sec(0.1)
  end
end

-- target 이 감시에 보이는지 체크
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target, sight_distance, sight_angle)
  if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
    return false
  end

  -- local full_diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center
  local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

  if diff.magnitude > sight_distance then
    return false
  end

  diff.y = 0

  if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > sight_angle / 2 then
    return false
  end

  --if field:IsAnythingBlocking(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
  --    CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
  --  return false
  --end

  return true
end

function local_class:load_num_counter()
  -- 카운트 ui
  self.ui_num_counter_object = self:get_num_counter_ui():Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 1))
  self.ui_num_counter = self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUINumCounter))

  local layout_positioner = self.ui_num_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
  layout_positioner.Position = self.constants_data.num_counter_position

  self.ui_num_counter:Reposition()
  self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(0)
  self.ui_num_counter:SetMaxCount(#self.npc_spawn_list)
end

function local_class:unload_num_counter()
  -- 카운터 ui 제거
  self.ui_num_counter = nil

  if self.ui_num_counter_object ~= nil then
    self.ui_num_counter_object:Dispose()
    self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
  end
end

function local_class:calculate_next_position(node, add_distance)
  assert(add_distance > 0)

  local waypoint_index = node.waypoint_index
  local current_pos = node.value.character.Position
  local target_pos = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[waypoint_index]
  local result = current_pos

  while add_distance > 0 do
    local direction = target_pos - current_pos
    local distance = direction.magnitude

    if distance >= add_distance then
      result = current_pos + direction.normalized * add_distance
      add_distance = 0
    else
      current_pos = target_pos

      waypoint_index = waypoint_index + 1
      if waypoint_index <= #self.constants_data.npc_waypoints then
        target_pos = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[waypoint_index]
      else
        result = target_pos
        break
      end

      add_distance = add_distance - distance
    end
  end

  return result
end

function local_class:calculate_prev_position(node, subtract_distance)
  assert(subtract_distance > 0)

  local waypoint_index = node.waypoint_index - 1
  local current_pos = node.value.character.Position
  local target_pos = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[waypoint_index]
  local result = current_pos

  while subtract_distance > 0 do
    local direction = target_pos - current_pos
    local distance = direction.magnitude

    if distance >= subtract_distance then
      result = current_pos + direction.normalized * subtract_distance
      subtract_distance = 0
    else
      current_pos = target_pos

      waypoint_index = waypoint_index - 1
      if waypoint_index >= 1 then
        target_pos = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[waypoint_index]
      else
        result = target_pos
        break
      end

      subtract_distance = subtract_distance - distance
    end
  end

  return result
end

function local_class:calculate_distance(from, to)
  assert(from.waypoint_index <= to.waypoint_index)

  local waypoint_index = from.waypoint_index
  local current_pos = from.value.character.Position
  local distance = 0

  while waypoint_index < to.waypoint_index do
    local waypoint = self.constants_data.npc_waypoints[waypoint_index]
    distance = distance + (waypoint - current_pos).magnitude

    current_pos = waypoint
    waypoint_index = waypoint_index + 1
  end

  distance = distance + (current_pos - to.value.character.Position).magnitude

  return distance
end

-- Implement Linked-List
function linked_list.new()
  return setmetatable({ head = nil, tail = nil, size = 0 }, linked_list)
end

function linked_list:push_tail(value)
  local new_node = { value = value, next = nil, prev = nil }

  if not self.tail then
    self.head = new_node
    self.tail = new_node
  else
    new_node.prev = self.tail
    self.tail.next = new_node
    self.tail = new_node
  end

  self.size = self.size + 1
  return new_node
end

function linked_list:push_head(value)
  local new_node = { value = value, next = nil, prev = nil }

  if not self.head then
    self.head = new_node
    self.tail = new_node
  else
    new_node.next = self.head
    self.head.prev = new_node
    self.head = new_node
  end

  self.size = self.size + 1
  return new_node
end

function linked_list:remove(node)
  if not node then
    return nil
  end

  if node.prev then
    node.prev.next = node.next
  else
    self.head = node.next
  end

  if node.next then
    node.next.prev = node.prev
  else
    self.tail = node.prev
  end

  self.size = self.size - 1
  node.next = nil
  node.prev = nil
  return node.value
end
-- End of Implementation Linked-List

-- Implement dynamic_character_pool
---@class GoStopNpcPool
---@field prefix string
---@field dyn_table table<string, IFieldObject>
---@field remain_count number
---@field get fun(this:GoStopNpcPool):IFieldObject
---@field return_back fun(this:GoStopNpcPool, fo:IFieldObject)
do
  function dynamic_character_pool:init()
    ---@type table<string, GoStopNpcPool>
    self.pool_table = {}
  end

  ---@return GoStopNpcPool
  function dynamic_character_pool:create(spec, count)
    local spec_names = {}

    for i = 1, count do
      spec_names[spec .. '_' .. i] = spec
    end

    local pool_dyn_table = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(spec_names)

    local pool = {
      prefix = spec .. '_',
      spec = spec,
      dyn_table = pool_dyn_table,
      remain_count = count,
      spawn_seq = count
    }

    metatable_helper.inherit(pool, {
      ---@param this GoStopNpcPool
      ---@return IFieldObject
      get = function(this)
        if this.remain_count > 0 then
          local fo = this.dyn_table[this.prefix .. this.remain_count]

          field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)

          this.dyn_table[this.prefix .. this.remain_count] = nil

          this.remain_count = this.remain_count - 1

          return fo
        else
          this.spawn_seq = this.spawn_seq + 1
          local key = this.prefix .. this.spawn_seq
          local overflow_table = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({ [key] = this.spec })

          for k, v in pairs(overflow_table) do
            this.dyn_table[k] = v
          end

          local fo = this.dyn_table[key]
          this.dyn_table[key] = nil
          field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
          return fo
        end
      end,

      ---@param this GoStopNpcPool
      ---@param fo IFieldObject
      return_back = function(this, fo)
        this.remain_count = this.remain_count + 1

        this.dyn_table[this.prefix .. this.remain_count] = fo

        field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
      end
    })

    self.pool_table[spec] = pool

    return self.pool_table[spec]
  end

  function dynamic_character_pool:dispose()
    for _, pool in pairs(self.pool_table) do
      load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(pool.dyn_table)
      pool.dyn_table = {}
    end

    self.pool_table = nil
  end
end
-- End of Implementation dynamic_character_pool

local fish_speed = self.const.speed local fish_dir_point = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2) local fish_dir, fish_start_pos, fish_end_pos if fish_dir_point == 1 then --NOTE: 스파인 방향(반대) local pos_idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.spawn_pos.left) fish_dir = direction_constants.left fish_start_pos = self.spawn_pos.left[pos_idx] fish_end_pos = self.spawn_pos.right[pos_idx] elseif fish_dir_point == 2 then local pos_idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.spawn_pos.right) fish_dir = direction_constants.right fish_start_pos = self.spawn_pos.right[pos_idx] fish_end_pos = self.spawn_pos.left[pos_idx] end if not self.next_fish_struct then self.next_fish_struct = { fo = fish_fo, spec = spec, pool = self.pools[spec], scale = fish_scale, start_pos = fish_start_pos, end_pos = fish_end_pos, speed = fish_speed, duration = vector_util.distance(fish_start_pos, fish_end_pos) / fish_speed, move_time_passed = 0, bounds_center_offset = self.const.bounds_center_offset, default_half_box = self.const.default_half_box } else self.next_fish_struct.fo = fish_fo self.next_fish_struct.spec = spec self.next_fish_struct.pool = self.pools[spec] self.next_fish_struct.scale = fish_scale self.next_fish_struct.start_pos = fish_start_pos self.next_fish_struct.end_pos = fish_end_pos self.next_fish_struct.speed = fish_speed self.next_fish_struct.duration = vector_util.distance(fish_start_pos, fish_end_pos) / fish_speed self.next_fish_struct.move_time_passed = 0 self.next_fish_struct.bounds_center_offset = self.const.bounds_center_offset self.next_fish_struct.default_half_box = self.const.default_half_box end --활성 중 물고기 딕셔너리에 등록 self.controller.enable_normal_fishes[fish_fo] = normal_fish_controller(self.controller, self.next_fish_struct) --fo 초기화 fish_fo.Position = fish_start_pos fish_fo.Direction = fish_dir end function normal_fish_spawner:update_frame(dt) self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt --일정 시간 지났을 시 물고기 스폰(time_passed 같은 경우 생성 시간이 각각 다를 수 있는데 controller 가져오는 게 이상하긴 함) if self.time_passed >= self.next_spawn_time then self.next_spawn_time = self.next_spawn_time + self.const.spawn_time self:spawn_fish() end end function normal_fish_spawner:exit() --매번 초기화 필요한 변수 self.next_spawn_time = self.const.spawn_time self.spawn_index = 1 self.time_passed = 0 end function normal_fish_spawner:dispose() --테이블 제거 self.controller = nil self.const = nil self.dynamic_character_pool = nil self.pools = nil self.spawn_order = nil self.spawn_pos = nil end end return local_class
