function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/HelicopterMiniGame/HelicopterMiniGameConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	self.get_rope_trap()
	self.get_grenade_bullet_effect()
	self.get_slash_effect()
	self.get_explosion_effect()
	self.get_hit_effect()
	self.get_muzzle_effect()
	self.get_muzzle_effect_2()
	self.get_grenade_way_effect()
	self.get_fx_critical_hit_blood()
	self.get_extreme_hit()
	self.get_custom_sprite()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self.grenade_bullet_effect_pool_transform = self.get_grenade_bullet_effect().Transform
	self.custom_sprite_pool_transform = self.get_custom_sprite().Transform
	self.grenade_way_effect_pool_transform = self.get_grenade_way_effect().Transform

	-- Load Prefab
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	self.helicopter_map = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('demonworld_boss')
	local tilemap_loader = CS.Tilemaps.TilemapLoader('demonworld_boss.bytes', self.helicopter_map, true, CS.Tilemaps.Difficulty.Normal)
	coroutine.yield(tilemap_loader:Load())

	self.helicopter_map.transform.position = vector(500, 0, 500)
	self.helicopter_map:SetActive(false)

	self.shader_container = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_17_demonworld_2/theatres/boss','boss_shader_container')

	coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom'), function(prefab)
		self.projectiles_custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
		self.projectiles_custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end))

	coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('spritesheets/items', 'questItems_custom'), function(prefab)
		self.eyeball_custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
		self.eyeball_custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end))

	-- 카메라, 서브 카메라 맵 아래에 붙임(이전이랑 같은 방식)
	local camera_main = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_17_demonworld_2/theatres/boss','Camera_main', self.helicopter_map.transform)
	local camera_sub = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_17_demonworld_2/theatres/boss','Camera_sub', self.helicopter_map.transform)

	-- 배경용 오브젝트 붙임
	local obj_bg = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_17_demonworld_2/theatres/boss','demonworld_boss_bg', self.helicopter_map.transform)
	obj_bg.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3(49.39795, 17.28125, 89.25)

	-- 프리팹 내에 붙어있던 위치
	camera_main.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3(-10.5, 25, -34)
	camera_sub.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3(11, 14.99, -23.95)

	self.camera = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.helicopter_map.transform, 'Camera_rotate')
	self.camera_animator = camera_main:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	self.screen_play_camera = camera_sub:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	self.camera_offset = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.helicopter_map.transform, 'Camera_offset')
	self:reset_helicopter_animation()

	self.helicopter = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.helicopter_map.transform, 'helicopter')
	self.helicopter_transform = self.helicopter.transform:GetChild(0)

	self.rope_point = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.helicopter.transform, 'rope_point')

	yield_return_func(self.create_rope, self, 5, 1)

	self.mk2 = get_character('mk2')
	self.mk2_transform = self.mk2.Transform
	self.user = user_party.Leader
	self.user_transform = self.user.Transform

	self.mk2_transform:SetParent(self.helicopter_transform)
	self.mk2.Position = self.mk2_position

	self.melee_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, 2, 150)
	self.melee_attack_range:Hide()

	-- 헬리콥터 미니게임에선 카메라를 Perspective로 사용하기 때문에 Shear를 끈다.
	self.shear_prop_id = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.PropertyToID('_Shear')
	-- FIXME: HACK: 스트리핑 이슈로 GetGlobalFloat 불가.
	-- self.shear_value = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.GetGlobalFloat(self.shear_prop_id)
	self.shear_value = 0.025
	CS.UnityEngine.Shader.SetGlobalFloat(self.shear_prop_id, 0)

	-- 카메라나 Spine이 회전하면서 찌그러지지 않게끔 하기 위해 미니게임 진행 동안에 Shader 변경
	local shader_list = self.shader_container:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShaderContainer)).ShaderList
	local shader = shader_list[0]
	self.origin_spine_controller_shader = self.user.SpineController.CustomShader
	self.user.SpineController.CustomShader = shader
	self.mk2.SpineController.CustomShader = shader

	self.helicopter_map:SetActive(true)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 헬리콥터 미니게임에선 카메라를 Perspective로 사용하기 때문에 Shear를 껐던걸 다시 켜준다.
	if self.shear_value then
		CS.UnityEngine.Shader.SetGlobalFloat(self.shear_prop_id, self.shear_value)
		self.shear_value = nil
	end

	if self.origin_spine_controller_shader then
		self.user.SpineController.CustomShader = self.origin_spine_controller_shader
		self.mk2.SpineController.CustomShader = self.origin_spine_controller_shader
		self.origin_spine_controller_shader = nil
	end

	if self.rope_sprite_list then
		for i = 1, #self.rope_sprite_list do
			local rope_sprite = self.rope_sprite_list[i]
			rope_sprite.transform:SetParent(self.custom_sprite_transform)
			rope_sprite:Dispose()
		end
		self.rope_sprite_list = nil
	end

	if self.field_transform then
		self.user_transform:SetParent(self.field_transform)
		self.mk2_transform:SetParent(self.field_transform)
		self.field_transform = nil
	end

	self.rotate_effect_list = nil

	self.mk2_stats_ui = nil
	self.mk2_attack_bar_transform = nil

	self.mk2 = nil
	self.mk2_transform = nil
	self.user = nil
	self.user_transform = nil

	if self.mk2_current_state then
		self.mk2_current_state:exit()
		self.mk2_current_state = nil
	end

	if self.user_current_state then
		self.user_current_state:exit()
		self.user_current_state = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	if self.helicopter_map then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.helicopter_map)
		self.helicopter_map = nil
	end

	if self.shader_container then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.shader_container)
		self.shader_container = nil
	end

	self.projectiles_custom_atlas = nil

	self.eyeball_custom_atlas = nil

	self.helicopter = nil
	self.camera = nil
	self.camera_animator = nil
	self.screen_play_camera = nil
	self.camera_offset = nil

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.grenade_bullet_effect_pool_transform = nil
	self.custom_sprite_pool_transform = nil
	self.grenade_way_effect_pool_transform = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	self:stop_propeller_sfx()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_qte_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.tap_sfx_name then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.tap_sfx_name)
		end
		self.swipe_type = 'tap'
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:game_start()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.is_game_playing = true
	self.helicopter_map:SetActive(true)

	local ui_dict = stage.FieldUIManager:GetUI(self.mk2)
	if ui_dict:ContainsKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats) then
		self.mk2_stats_ui = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats]
		self.mk2_stats_ui.Level.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.mk2_attack_bar_transform = self.mk2_stats_ui.AttackBar.Transform
	end

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, self.user)

	self.user:HideWeapon(true)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.user, 'right')
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.user, false)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.mk2, false)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(self.user, 'Default', 2)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.phase_1_routine, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rope_attach_helicopter_routine, self))
end

function local_class:game_end()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))

	self.is_game_playing = false

	if self.field_transform then
		self.user_transform:SetParent(self.field_transform)
		self.mk2_transform:SetParent(self.field_transform)
		self.field_transform = nil
	end

	self.user:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.user, 'none')
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.user, true)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.mk2, true)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(self.user, 'Default', 0)

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, self.user)

	if self.mk2_stats_ui then
		self.mk2_stats_ui.Level.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.helicopter_map:SetActive(false)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
end

function local_class:skip_first_screen_play()
	self.is_skip_first_screen_play = true
end

function local_class:mk2_change_state(next_state)
	if self.mk2_current_state then
		self.mk2_current_state:exit()
	end

	self.mk2_current_state = next_state
	self.mk2_current_state:enter(self)
end

function local_class:user_change_state(next_state)
	if self.user_current_state then
		self.user_current_state:exit()
	end

	self.user_current_state = next_state
	self.user_current_state:enter(self)
end

function local_class:get_user_rope_offset()
	local rope_offset = self.constants_data.user_offset
	local offset = vector(rope_offset[1], rope_offset[2], rope_offset[3])

	-- 오른쪽에서 왼쪽을 바라보며 붙어 있을 땐, offset의 x값만 반전시킴
	if direction_util.to_str(self.user.LockedDirection) == 'left' then
		offset.x = -offset.x
	end

	return offset
end

--region rope
-- 커스텀 스프라이트를 연결하여 로프를 생성
function local_class:create_rope(size, scale_y)
	self.rope_sprite_list = {}
	self.rope_sprite_offset_list = {}

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local rope_trap_custom_atlas = nil
	coroutine.yield(res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('theatres/rope_trap', 'rope_trap_custom'), function(prefab)
		rope_trap_custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
		rope_trap_custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end))
	res_holder:Dispose()

	for i = 1, size do
		-- 바로 헬리콥터 밑에 자식으로 붙이면, 헬리콥터가 비활성화 된 상태일 경우 Dispose 되어버려서 일단 안보이는 곳에다 생성해둠.
		local rope_sprite = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 0))
		rope_sprite.transform.localScale = vector(1, scale_y, 1)
		rope_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		local custom_sprite = rope_sprite.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'rope.psd'
		custom_sprite.Atlas = rope_trap_custom_atlas
		custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 0
		custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)

		local offset = vector(0, -(i - 1) * scale_y, 0)
		if i == 1 then
			offset = offset + vector(0, -0.9, 0)
		end

		table.insert(self.rope_sprite_list, rope_sprite)
		table.insert(self.rope_sprite_offset_list, offset)
	end

	-- 바로 헬리콥터 밑에 자식으로 붙이면, 헬리콥터가 비활성화 된 상태일 경우 Dispose 되어버려서 일단 안보이는 곳에다 생성해둠.
	local rope_end_sprite = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 0))
	rope_end_sprite.transform.localScale = vector(1, scale_y, 1)
	rope_end_sprite.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	local custom_sprite = rope_end_sprite.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'rope_end.psd'
	custom_sprite.Atlas = rope_trap_custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 1
	custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)

	local offset = vector(0, (-(size - 1) * scale_y) - 0.8, 0)

	table.insert(self.rope_sprite_list, rope_end_sprite)
	table.insert(self.rope_sprite_offset_list, offset)
end

-- 로프 스프라이트를 연결하여 헬리콥터 특정 위치에 메달린 채로 진자운동을 하는 루틴
function local_class:rope_attach_helicopter_routine()
	-- 헬기 밑에 자식으로 붙여준다.
	for i = 1, #self.rope_sprite_list do
		local rope_sprite = self.rope_sprite_list[i]
		local rope_offset = self.rope_sprite_offset_list[i]

		rope_sprite.transform:SetParent(self.rope_point)
		rope_sprite.transform.localPosition = rope_offset
	end

	-- 게임 끝나면 코루틴 벗어나야 함
	while self.is_game_playing do
		-- 1페이즈 에서는 로프 진자운동을 유저 state에서 처리하고 있는데, 이후에는 여기서 계속 처리하도록
		if self.current_phase > 1 then
			self:rope_normal_pendulum(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		end

		local rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, self.rope_angle)
		self.rope_point.localRotation = rotation

		local camera_position = self.camera.position
		if not self.camera.gameObject.activeSelf then
			camera_position = self.screen_play_camera.transform.position
		end

		for i = 1, #self.rope_sprite_list do
			local rope_sprite = self.rope_sprite_list[i]

			-- 로프에 빌보드 적용
			rope_sprite.transform:LookAt(camera_position)
			rope_sprite.transform.localRotation = rotation * rope_sprite.transform.localRotation

			-- x축은 카메라를 따라가지 않도록 함.
			-- 로프가 카메라가 바라보고 있는 기준으로 y축으로 정렬된게 아니라, 헬리콥터 하위로 쭉 정렬되어 있어서
			-- x축을 조정하면 이상하게 보임.
			local euler = rope_sprite.transform.localEulerAngles
			euler.x = 0
			rope_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(euler)
		end

		-- Field UI도 카메라를 바라보게끔 회전해줌
		if self.mk2_stats_ui then
			self.mk2_stats_ui.Offset:LookAt(camera_position)
			self.mk2_stats_ui.Offset.rotation = self.mk2_stats_ui.Offset.rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
			self.mk2_attack_bar_transform:LookAt(camera_position)
			self.mk2_attack_bar_transform.rotation = self.mk2_attack_bar_transform.rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
		end

		self.user_transform:LookAt(camera_position)
		self.user_transform.rotation = self.user_transform.rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 로프 idle 상태 때 좌우 진자운동 각도 계산
function local_class:rope_normal_pendulum(dt)
	self.rope_time_passed = self.rope_time_passed + dt

	local speed = self.rope_time_passed / self.constants_data.rope_pendulum_duration
	local max_angle = self.constants_data.rope_max_angle
	self.rope_angle = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * speed) * max_angle
end
--endregion

--region phase_1

function local_class:phase_1_routine()
	self.current_phase = 1

	self.field_transform = self.user_transform.parent
	self.mk2_transform:SetParent(self.helicopter_transform)
	self.user_transform:SetParent(self.rope_point)

	self.mk2.Position = self.mk2_position

	self:mk2_change_state(mk2_screen_play_state)
	self:user_change_state(user_screen_play_state)
	while not self.is_skip_first_screen_play do
		if self.mk2_current_state then
			self.mk2_current_state:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		end

		if self.user_current_state then
			self.user_current_state:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	while true do
		-- 페이즈1 수치 초기화
		self:mk2_change_state(mk2_start_delay_state)
		self:user_change_state(user_idle_state)

		self.percent = 0
		self.is_game_over = false

		if not (self.is_skip_swipe_tutorial and self.is_skip_tap_tutorial) then
			self.is_skip_swipe_tutorial = false
			self.is_skip_tap_tutorial = false
		end

		local is_loop_end = false
		local is_run_game_over_routine = false
		while not is_loop_end do
			if self.mk2_current_state then
				self.mk2_current_state:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			end

			if self.user_current_state then
				self.user_current_state:update(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			end

			if self.is_game_over and not is_run_game_over_routine then
				is_run_game_over_routine = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					self:fade_out_propeller_sfx(1)
					screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

					is_loop_end = true

					self:play_propeller_sfx(1)
					screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
				end))
			elseif self.is_current_phase_clear then
				is_loop_end = true
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.is_current_phase_clear then
			self.mk2_current_state:exit()
			self.user_current_state:exit()
			self.mk2_current_state = nil
			self.user_current_state = nil
			yield_return_func(self.phase_2_routine, self)
			break
		end
	end
end

-- mk2 state
--region mk2_screen_play_state
function mk2_screen_play_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	-- mk2 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.mk2 = self.controller.mk2

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.duration = 0
end

function mk2_screen_play_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)

	self.mk2 = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function mk2_screen_play_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion

--region mk2_start_delay_state
function mk2_start_delay_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	-- mk2 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.mk2 = self.controller.mk2

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.duration = 2
end

function mk2_start_delay_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)

	self.mk2 = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function mk2_start_delay_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.controller:mk2_change_state(mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state)
	end
end
--endregion

--region mk2_idle_state
function mk2_idle_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	-- mk2 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.mk2 = self.controller.mk2

	self.time_passed = 0


	character_util.set_direction(self.mk2, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(self.mk2, { name = 'eat' })

	if self.controller.is_skip_swipe_tutorial and not self.controller.is_skip_tap_tutorial then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		self.controller.is_show_tap_tutorial = true
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1, false)
	end
end

function mk2_idle_state:exit()
	if self.controller.is_show_tap_tutorial then
		self.controller.is_skip_tap_tutorial = true
		self.controller.is_show_tap_tutorial = false
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)

	self.mk2 = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function mk2_idle_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local cooldown_time = self:get_cooldown_time()
	if self.time_passed >= cooldown_time then
		if self.controller.percent < 0.85 then
			-- 0~80% 유탄 발사
			self.controller:mk2_change_state(mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state)
		else
			-- 80~100% 근접 공격
			self.controller:mk2_change_state(mk2_melee_attack_state)
		end
	end
end

function mk2_idle_state:get_cooldown_time()
	-- 플레이어의 현재 밧줄 높이의 %에 따라 cooldown 시간이 다르게 반환됨.
	local condition_list = self.controller.constants_data.idle.waiting_condition_list

	for i = 1, #condition_list do
		local condition = condition_list[i]

		if self.controller.percent < condition.condition_percent then
			return condition.cooldown_duration
		end
	end

	return 0
end
--endregion

--region mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state
function mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.is_attack_hit = false
	self.is_shoot_grenade_bullet = false

	self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.grenade_launcher_attack.reload_duration
	self.grenade_bullet_offset = vector(0, -0.8, 0)
	self.grenade_bullet_size = self.controller.constants_data.grenade_launcher_attack.grenade_bullet_size
	self.grenade_bullet_speed = vector(0, -((self.controller.constants_data.rope_length + self.grenade_bullet_offset.y)
		/ self.controller.constants_data.grenade_launcher_attack.grenade_shoot_duration), 0)

	-- mk2 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.mk2 = self.controller.mk2
	self.mk2_transform = self.controller.mk2_transform

	-- 유탄 총알 이펙트
	self.grenade_bullet = nil
	self.grenade_bullet_sprite = nil
	self.grenade_way_effect = nil

	-- 미리 계산한 탄환 이펙트 회전값
	self.effect_rotation = self.controller.bullet_effect_rotation
	self.sprite_rotation = self.controller.sprite_rotation
	self.grenade_way_effect_rotation = self.controller.grenade_way_effect_rotation

	-- 진행도
	self.progress = {
		reload = 1,
		move_to_attack = 2,
		ready = 3,
		attack = 4,
		move_to_return = 5
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.reload

	self.origin_position = self.mk2.Position
	self.attack_position = vector(0.2, 1, 2.8)

	self.mk2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'mk2_grenade_launcher')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_03')
	local scale = spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.mk2, 'rifle_reload') / self.duration
	character_util.set_anim(self.mk2, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false, scale = scale })
end

function mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state:exit()
	if self.controller.is_show_swipe_tutorial then
		self.controller.is_show_swipe_tutorial = false
		time_util.unmod('swipe')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)
	character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.mk2)

	self:grenade_bullet_dispose()
	self:grenade_way_dispose()

	self.mk2 = nil
	self.mk2_transform = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state:get_cooldown_time()
	-- 플레이어가 밧줄 높이의 0~50%일 경우 5초, 50~80%일 경우 3.5초
	local condition_list = self.controller.constants_data.grenade_launcher_attack.ready_condition_list

	for i = 1, #condition_list do
		local condition = condition_list[i]

		if self.controller.percent < condition.condition_percent then
			return condition.ready_duration
		end
	end

	return 0
end

function mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_progress == self.progress.reload then
		-- 유탄 장전
		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.move_to_attack

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.grenade_launcher_attack.move_to_attack_duration

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)
			character_util.jump(self.mk2, 0.5, self.duration)
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.move_to_attack then
		-- 공격 위치로 이동
		local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
		self.mk2.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.origin_position, self.attack_position, progress)

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.ready

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.duration = self:get_cooldown_time()

			character_util.set_direction(self.mk2, 'down')
			character_util.set_anim(self.mk2, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, scale = 0, mix_duration = 0 })
			character_util.show_attack_timer(self.mk2, self.duration)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hyper_laser_01')
			self.grenade_way_effect = self.controller.get_grenade_way_effect():Instantiate(self.mk2_transform.position + vector(0, -0.7, 0))
			self.grenade_way_effect.transform:SetParent(self.mk2_transform)
			self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(self.grenade_way_effect, self.grenade_way_effect_rotation)

			if not self.controller.is_skip_swipe_tutorial and not self.controller.is_show_swipe_tutorial then
				self.controller.is_show_swipe_tutorial = true
				time_util.mod('swipe', 0.3)
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('left')
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.ready then
		-- 유탄 발사 준비
		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.attack

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.grenade_launcher_attack.grenade_shoot_duration

			character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)
			character_util.set_direction(self.mk2, 'down')
			character_util.set_anim(self.mk2, { name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false })
			character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.mk2)

			self:grenade_way_dispose()
		elseif self.controller.percent >= 0.85 then
			-- 90% 올라왔다면, 공격하던걸 캔슬하고 근접 공격으로 전환
			self.controller:mk2_change_state(mk2_idle_state)
			return
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.attack then
		-- 유탄 발사
		-- 실제 공격 연출 및 판정
		-- 유탄이 발사되고 폭파한 다음, 다시 원래 상태로 돌아가서 대기

		-- 유탄 발사 애니메이션 재생 0.1초 후 유탄 생성
		if not self.is_shoot_grenade_bullet and self.time_passed >= 0.15 then
			-- HACK: 유탄 이펙트가 헬기(카메라)를 따라가면서 보여야 하기 때문에, 헬기 밑에 자식으로 지정함.
			-- LateUpdate를 사용해야 하는데, 여건이 안되어서 별 수 없이 이렇게 처리함.
			self.is_shoot_grenade_bullet = true
			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - 0.15

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_01')
			self.grenade_bullet = self.controller.get_grenade_bullet_effect():Instantiate(self.mk2_transform.position + self.grenade_bullet_offset)
			self.grenade_bullet.transform:SetParent(self.controller.helicopter.transform.parent)
			self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(self.grenade_bullet, self.effect_rotation)

			self.grenade_bullet_sprite = self.controller.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(self.mk2_transform.position + self.grenade_bullet_offset)
			self.grenade_bullet_sprite.transform:SetParent(self.controller.helicopter.transform.parent)
			local custom_sprite = self.grenade_bullet_sprite.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(0.8, 0.8)
			custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'projectile_grenade_launcher.png'
			custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
			custom_sprite.Atlas = self.controller.projectiles_custom_atlas
			custom_sprite.SortingLayer = 'Top Effects'
			custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 2
			custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)
			self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(self.grenade_bullet_sprite, self.sprite_rotation)

			local muzzle_effect = self.controller.get_muzzle_effect():Instantiate(self.mk2_transform.position + vector(0, -0.5, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.mk2_transform)
			local muzzle_effect_2 = self.controller.get_muzzle_effect_2():Instantiate(self.mk2_transform.position + vector(0, -1, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.mk2_transform)
			muzzle_effect.transform.localScale = muzzle_effect.transform.localScale * 3
			self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(muzzle_effect, self.effect_rotation)
			self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(muzzle_effect_2, self.effect_rotation)
		end

		if self.is_shoot_grenade_bullet then
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
			local prev_progress = (self.time_passed - dt) / self.duration

			if prev_progress < 0 then
				prev_progress = 0
			end

			if self.grenade_bullet then
				self.grenade_bullet.transform.position = (self.mk2_transform.position + self.grenade_bullet_offset) + (self.grenade_bullet_speed * (self.time_passed))
				self.grenade_bullet_sprite.transform.position = (self.mk2_transform.position + self.grenade_bullet_offset) + (self.grenade_bullet_speed * (self.time_passed))

				if self.grenade_bullet.transform.position.y <= 0 then
					self:grenade_bullet_dispose()
				end

				-- 피격 판정 체크
				if not self.is_attack_hit and (not self.controller.rope_move_direction or self.controller.rope_move_direction == 'down') then
					local grenade_bullet_size_half = self.grenade_bullet_size / 2
					local hit_min_percent = (1 - progress) - grenade_bullet_size_half
					local hit_max_percent = (1 - prev_progress) + grenade_bullet_size_half

					-- FIXME: 피격 판정을 해야 하는데, 일단 여기서 직접적으로 state를 바꿔주는 식으로 처리
					-- 플레이어가 회피(스와이프)를 하지 않은 상태면 피격 처리
					if self.controller.percent >= hit_min_percent and self.controller.percent <= hit_max_percent then
						self.is_attack_hit = true
						self.controller.rope_move_hit_percent = self.controller.constants_data.grenade_launcher_attack.rope_move_hit_percent
						self.controller:user_change_state(user_hit_state)

						self:grenade_bullet_explosion()
					end
				end
			end

			-- 유탄은 플레이어가 피격당해서 터지던가, 회피해서 지면에서 터지던가 무조건 터지기 때문에 터지는 기점으로 state를 바꾼다.
			if self.time_passed >= self.duration and self.grenade_bullet == nil then
				self.current_progress = self.progress.move_to_return

				self.time_passed = 0
				self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.grenade_launcher_attack.move_to_return_duration

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
				character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)
				character_util.jump(self.mk2, 0.5, self.duration)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.move_to_return then
		-- 원래 위치로 이동
		local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
		self.mk2.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.attack_position, self.origin_position, progress)

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.controller:mk2_change_state(mk2_idle_state)
			return
		end
	end
end

function mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state:grenade_bullet_explosion()
	local position = self.grenade_bullet.transform.position

	if position.y <= 0 then
		position = vector_util.get_x0z(position)
		self.controller.get_explosion_effect():Instantiate(position)
	else
		local explosion_effect = self.controller.get_explosion_effect():Instantiate
			(position + vector(0, -1, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.controller.helicopter.transform.parent)
		self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(explosion_effect, self.effect_rotation)
	end

	self:grenade_bullet_dispose()
end

function mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state:grenade_bullet_dispose()
	if self.grenade_bullet then
		-- 유탄 이펙트 부모를 원래 오브젝트 풀로 돌려놓고, 해제
		self.grenade_bullet.transform:SetParent(self.controller.grenade_bullet_effect_pool_transform)
		self.grenade_bullet:Dispose()
		self.grenade_bullet = nil
	end

	if self.grenade_bullet_sprite then
		self.grenade_bullet_sprite.transform:SetParent(self.controller.custom_sprite_pool_transform)
		self.grenade_bullet_sprite:Dispose()
		self.grenade_bullet_sprite = nil
	end
end

function mk2_grenade_launcher_attack_state:grenade_way_dispose()
	if self.grenade_way_effect then
		self.grenade_way_effect.transform:SetParent(self.controller.grenade_way_effect_pool_transform)
		self.grenade_way_effect:Dispose()
		self.grenade_way_effect = nil
	end
end
--endregion

--region mk2_melee_attack_state
function mk2_melee_attack_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.is_show_slash_effect = false

	self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.melee_attack.move_to_attack_duration

	-- mk2 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.mk2 = self.controller.mk2
	self.mk2_transform = self.controller.mk2_transform

	-- 베기 공격 이펙트
	self.slash = nil

	-- 미리 계산한 탄환 이펙트 회전값
	self.effect_rotation = self.controller.slash_effect_rotation
	self.attack_range_rotation = self.controller.attack_range_rotation

	-- 진행도
	self.progress = {
		move_to_attack = 1,
		ready = 2,
		attack = 3,
		move_to_return = 4
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.move_to_attack

	self.origin_position = self.mk2.Position
	self.attack_position = vector(0.2, 1, 2.8)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(self.mk2, 0.5, self.duration)
	character_util.set_direction(self.mk2, 'down' )

	self.attack_range = self.controller.melee_attack_range
	self.attack_range_parent = self.attack_range.transform.parent
	self.attack_range.transform:SetParent(self.mk2_transform)
	self.attack_range.transform.localPosition = vector(0, 0, 0)
end

function mk2_melee_attack_state:exit()
	self.controller.is_skip_swipe_down_tutorial = true
	self.controller.is_show_swipe_down_tutorial = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)

	self.attack_range.transform:SetParent(self.attack_range_parent)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.slash = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_range_parent = nil

	self.mk2 = nil
	self.mk2_transform = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function mk2_melee_attack_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_progress == self.progress.move_to_attack then
		-- 공격 위치로 이동
		local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
		self.mk2.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.origin_position, self.attack_position, progress)

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.ready

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.melee_attack.ready_duration

			self.mk2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
			self.mk2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'mk2_beam_saber')
			character_util.set_anim(self.mk2, { name = 'unique/melee_attack_ready', loop = false, next_anim = 'unique/melee_attack_ready_loop' })
			character_util.show_attack_timer(self.mk2, self.duration)

			self.attack_range:Show(0)
			self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(self.attack_range, self.attack_range_rotation)

			if not self.controller.is_skip_swipe_down_tutorial and not self.controller.is_show_swipe_down_tutorial then
				self.controller.is_show_swipe_down_tutorial = true
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('down')
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.ready then
		-- 공격 시전 대기
		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.attack

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.melee_attack.attack_duration

			character_util.set_anim(self.mk2, { name = 'unique/melee_attack', loop = false })
			character_util.hide_attack_timer(self.mk2)

			self.attack_range:Hide()
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.attack then
		-- 공격 시전 후 대기
		-- 근접 공격 애니메이션 재생 0.2초 후 이펙트 생성
		if not self.is_show_slash_effect and self.time_passed >= 0.2 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_android_sword_02')
			self.is_show_slash_effect = true
			self.slash = self.controller.get_slash_effect():Instantiate(self.mk2_transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.mk2_transform)
			self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(self.slash, self.effect_rotation)

			-- FIXME: 피격 판정을 해야 하는데, 일단 여기서 직접적으로 state를 바꿔주는 식으로 처리
			-- 플레이어가 올라온 퍼센트 기준으로 피격 체크. 나중에 좀 더 손봐서 방식을 바꿔야 할 듯
			if self.controller.percent >= self.controller.constants_data.melee_attack.attack_range and self.controller.rope_move_direction ~= 'down' then
				local hit_effect = self.controller.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(self.controller.user_transform.position + vector(1, 0, 0))
				self.controller:add_rotate_effect_list(hit_effect, self.effect_rotation)

				self.controller.rope_move_hit_percent = self.controller.constants_data.melee_attack.rope_move_hit_percent
				self.controller:user_change_state(user_hit_state)
			end
		end

		if self.slash then
			if not self.slash.gameObject.activeSelf then
				self.slash = nil
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration + 0.2 then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.move_to_return

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.melee_attack.move_to_return_duration

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			self.mk2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
			character_util.remove_anim(self.mk2)
			character_util.jump(self.mk2, 0.5, self.duration)
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.move_to_return then
		-- 원래 위치로 이동
		local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
		self.mk2.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.attack_position, self.origin_position, progress)

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.controller:mk2_change_state(mk2_idle_state)
			return
		end
	end
end
--endregion

-- user state
--region user_screen_play_state
function user_screen_play_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	-- mk2 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.user = self.controller.user

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.duration = 0
end

function user_screen_play_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.user)

	self.user = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function user_screen_play_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.controller:rope_normal_pendulum(dt)
	local angle = self.controller.rope_angle

	local rope_length = self.controller.constants_data.rope_length
	local rope_offset = self.controller.constants_data.rope_offset
	local user_position = vector(0, -(rope_length * (1 - self.controller.percent) + rope_offset), 0)
	local user_rope_offset = self.controller:get_user_rope_offset()

	self.user.Position = user_position + user_rope_offset
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.user, -angle, 0)
end
--endregion

--region user_idle_state
function user_idle_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.controller.rope_move_direction = nil

	-- 유저 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.user = self.controller.user

	character_util.set_emotion(self.user, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'push', mix_duration = 0.2 })

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
end

function user_idle_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.user)

	self.user = nil
	self.controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
end

function user_idle_state:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then
		-- 플레이어가 밧줄을 타고 점차 올라감
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_rope_move_up_state)
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		-- 플레이어가 왼쪽, 오른쪽으로 피할 수 있음
		self.controller.rope_move_direction = 'left'
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_rope_move_side_state)
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		-- 플레이어가 왼쪽, 오른쪽으로 피할 수 있음
		self.controller.rope_move_direction = 'right'
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_rope_move_side_state)
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		-- 플레이어가 약간 밑으로 내려가서 공격을 피할 수 있음
		self.controller.rope_move_direction = 'down'
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_rope_move_down_state)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function user_idle_state:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function user_idle_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.controller:rope_normal_pendulum(dt)
	local angle = self.controller.rope_angle

	local rope_length = self.controller.constants_data.rope_length
	local rope_offset = self.controller.constants_data.rope_offset
	local user_position = vector(0, -(rope_length * (1 - self.controller.percent) + rope_offset), 0)
	local user_rope_offset = self.controller:get_user_rope_offset()

	self.user.Position = user_position + user_rope_offset
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.user, -angle, 0)
end
--endregion

--region user_rope_move_up_state
function user_rope_move_up_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.controller.rope_move_direction = nil

	self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.rope_move_up_duration
	self.prev_percent = self.controller.percent
	self.next_percent = self.controller.percent + self.controller.constants_data.rope_move_up_percent

	-- 유저 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.user = self.controller.user

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'dance', scale = 2 })
end

function user_rope_move_up_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.user, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.user)

	self.user = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function user_rope_move_up_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.controller.percent = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(self.prev_percent, self.next_percent, self.time_passed / self.duration)

	self.controller:rope_normal_pendulum(dt)
	local angle = self.controller.rope_angle

	local rope_length = self.controller.constants_data.rope_length
	local rope_offset = self.controller.constants_data.rope_offset
	local user_position = vector(0, -(rope_length * (1 - self.controller.percent) + rope_offset), 0)
	local user_rope_offset = self.controller:get_user_rope_offset()

	self.user.Position = user_position + user_rope_offset
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.user, -angle, 0)

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration or self.controller.percent >= 1 then
		self.controller.percent = self.next_percent
		if self.controller.percent >= 1 then
			self.controller.percent = 1
			self.controller.is_current_phase_clear = true
		end
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_idle_state)
	end
end
--endregion

--region user_rope_move_side_state
function user_rope_move_side_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.rope_move_direction = self.controller.rope_move_direction
	if self.rope_move_direction == 'right' then
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.user, 'right')
		self.direction = -1
	else
		character_util.set_locked_dir(self.user, 'left')
		self.direction = 1
	end
	self.is_control_able = false

	self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.rope_move_side_duration
	self.prev_rope_angle = self.controller.rope_angle / 2 * unity_class.mathf.PI
	self.rope_max_angle = self.controller.constants_data.rope_move_max_angle

	-- 유저 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.user = self.controller.user

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.user, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'push' })

	if self.controller.is_show_swipe_tutorial then
		self.controller.is_skip_swipe_tutorial = true
		self.controller.is_show_swipe_tutorial = false
		time_util.unmod('swipe')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end
end

function user_rope_move_side_state:exit()
	-- rope_move_side 에서 state가 변경될 때, 평상시 떄의 로프 진자운동과 시간(싱크)를 맞추기 위한 계산
	local progress = (self.time_passed / (self.duration * 2)) % 1
	self.controller.rope_time_passed = progress * self.controller.constants_data.rope_pendulum_duration
	if self.rope_move_direction == 'right' then
		self.controller.rope_time_passed = self.controller.rope_time_passed + self.controller.constants_data.rope_pendulum_duration / 2
	end

	self.user = nil
	self.controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
end

function user_rope_move_side_state:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then
		-- 플레이어가 밧줄을 타고 점차 올라감
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_rope_move_up_state)
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		-- 플레이어가 왼쪽, 오른쪽으로 피할 수 있음
		self.controller.rope_move_direction = 'left'
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_rope_move_side_state)
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		-- 플레이어가 왼쪽, 오른쪽으로 피할 수 있음
		self.controller.rope_move_direction = 'right'
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_rope_move_side_state)
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		-- 플레이어가 약간 밑으로 내려가서 공격을 피할 수 있음
		self.controller.rope_move_direction = 'down'
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_rope_move_down_state)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function user_rope_move_side_state:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
		e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function user_rope_move_side_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
	local max_angle = self.rope_max_angle

	-- FIXME: 임시 진자운동 폭 점차 줄어드는 코드
	if progress > 3 then
		max_angle = max_angle / 3
	elseif progress > 2 then
		max_angle = max_angle / 3
	elseif progress > 1 then
		max_angle = max_angle / 1.5
	end

	-- 스와이프 직전에 유지하고 있던 각도를, 4회 진자운동 시간동안 선형보간으로 0으로 만들어서 자연스럽게 로프가 흔들리듯이 연출함
	local sin = math.sin(math.pi * progress)
	local angle = sin * max_angle * self.direction
	angle = angle + (self.prev_rope_angle * unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(1 - (progress / 1)))
	self.controller.rope_angle = angle

	local rope_length = self.controller.constants_data.rope_length
	local rope_offset = self.controller.constants_data.rope_offset
	local user_position = vector(0, -(rope_length * (1 - self.controller.percent) + rope_offset), 0)
	local user_rope_offset = self.controller:get_user_rope_offset()

	self.user.Position = user_position + user_rope_offset

	-- 로프의 각도가 0에서부터 최고 지점까지 올라갈 때는, 캐릭터는 로프의 각도를 그대로 따라간다.
	-- 로프의 각도가 최고 지점에 도달 한 이후, 로프의 각도가 최고 지점의 절반까지 내려가는 동안 캐릭터는 최고 지점 때의 각도가 그대로 유지된다.
	-- 이후에는, 각도가 0이 될 때 까지 선형보간된다.
	-- 이 지점을 1 ~ 0.5, 0.5 ~ 0 으로 보았을 때, 각각 PI 기준으로 0.5 ~ 0.75, 0.75 ~ 1 로 치환할 수 있다.
	-- 반대 방향의 경우에는 1.5 ~ 1.75, 1.75 ~ 2
	--local pi_range_list
	local user_angle = angle

	-- progress의 값이 1 = PI, 2 = 2PI 이다.
	-- 원하는 지점(0.5 ~ 1 PI) 때만 계산을 하기 위해 진동 주기 단위로 쪼갬
	local user_angle_progress = (progress % 1) - 0.5

	if user_angle_progress >= 0 then
		if (sin <= pi_range_list[1] and sin > pi_range_list[2]) or (sin >= pi_range_list[4] and sin < pi_range_list[5]) then
			-- 로프의 각도가 1 ~ 0.5 사이일 때
			if sin >= 0 then
				user_angle = max_angle * self.direction
			else
				user_angle = -max_angle * self.direction
			end
		elseif (sin <= pi_range_list[2] and sin > pi_range_list[3]) or (sin >= pi_range_list[5] and sin < pi_range_list[6]) then
			-- 로프의 각도가 0.5 ~ 0 사이일 때
			--local user_angle_progress = ((progress % 0.5) - 0.25) / 0.25
			user_angle_progress = (user_angle_progress - 0.25) / 0.25

			if sin >= 0 then
				user_angle = max_angle * (1 - user_angle_progress) * self.direction
			else
				user_angle = -max_angle * (1 - user_angle_progress) * self.direction
			end
		end

		user_angle = user_angle + (self.prev_rope_angle * unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(1 - (progress / 1)))
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(self.user, -user_angle, 0)

	if not self.is_control_able and self.time_passed >= self.duration * 2 then
		self.is_control_able = true
		character_util.set_emotion(self.user, { name = 'attack' })
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration * 4 then
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_idle_state)
	end
end
--endregion

--region user_rope_move_down_state
function user_rope_move_down_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.rope_move_down_duration
	self.prev_percent = self.controller.percent
	self.next_percent = self.controller.percent - self.controller.constants_data.rope_move_down_percent

	-- 유저 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.user = self.controller.user

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'dance' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.user, { name = 'attack' })

	if self.controller.is_show_swipe_down_tutorial then
		self.controller.is_skip_swipe_down_tutorial = true
		self.controller.is_show_swipe_down_tutorial = false
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end
end

function user_rope_move_down_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.user)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.user)

	self.user = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function user_rope_move_down_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.controller.percent = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(self.prev_percent, self.next_percent, self.time_passed / self.duration)

	self.controller:rope_normal_pendulum(dt)
	local angle = self.controller.rope_angle

	local rope_length = self.controller.constants_data.rope_length
	local rope_offset = self.controller.constants_data.rope_offset
	local user_position = vector(0, -(rope_length * (1 - self.controller.percent) + rope_offset), 0)
	local user_rope_offset = self.controller:get_user_rope_offset()

	self.user.Position = user_position + user_rope_offset
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.user, -angle, 0)

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration or self.controller.percent <= 0 then
		self.controller.percent = self.next_percent
		if self.controller.percent <= 0 then
			self.controller.percent = 0
		end
		self.controller:user_change_state(user_idle_state)
	end
end
--endregion

--region user_hit_state
function user_hit_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.rope_move_hit_duration
	self.prev_percent = self.controller.percent
	self.next_percent = self.controller.percent - self.controller.rope_move_hit_percent

	-- 유저 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.user = self.controller.user

	-- 진행도
	self.progress = {
		rope_down = 1,
		recovery = 2
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.rope_down

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	character_util.shake(self.user, 0.035, self.controller.constants_data.rope_move_hit_duration + self.controller.constants_data.hit_recovery_duration)
	character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.user, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.user, 1.5, 0.5, 1, 0.7)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.user, unity_class.color.red, 1, 1, 0.7)

	if self.is_show_swipe_tutorial or self.is_show_swipe_down_tutorial then
		self.is_show_swipe_tutorial = false
		self.is_show_swipe_down_tutorial = false
		time_util.unmod('swipe')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end
end

function user_hit_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.user)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.user)

	self.user = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function user_hit_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.controller:rope_normal_pendulum(dt)
	local angle = self.controller.rope_angle

	character_util.spine_rotate(self.user, -angle, 0)

	if self.current_progress == self.progress.rope_down then
		self.controller.percent = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Lerp(self.prev_percent, self.next_percent, self.time_passed / self.duration)
		if self.controller.percent <= 0 then
			-- 밧줄에서 떨어지는 처리
			self.controller:user_change_state(user_drop_state)
			return
		end

		local rope_length = self.controller.constants_data.rope_length
		local rope_offset = self.controller.constants_data.rope_offset
		local user_position = vector(0, -(rope_length * (1 - self.controller.percent) + rope_offset), 0)
		local user_rope_offset = self.controller:get_user_rope_offset()

		self.user.Position = user_position + user_rope_offset

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.recovery

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.duration = self.controller.constants_data.hit_recovery_duration

			character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'push' })
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.recovery then
		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.controller.percent = self.next_percent
			self.controller:user_change_state(user_idle_state)
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region user_drop_state
function user_drop_state:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.duration = 1

	-- 유저 캐릭터 캐싱
	self.user = self.controller.user

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.user, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.user, self.user.Position + vector(12, -15, 0), 8, nil)
end

function user_drop_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.user)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.user)

	self.user = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function user_drop_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self.controller:rope_normal_pendulum(dt)
	local angle = self.controller.rope_angle

	-- 가디언이 밧줄을 놓치고 떨어지는 연출이 나오며 FADE OUT, 게임 오버
	-- 게임 오버 후 다시 FADE IN 하며 페이즈 1부터 시작된다.
	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		-- 게임오버 및 재시작 처리
		character_util.stop(self.user)
		self.controller.is_game_over = true
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:phase_3_routine()
	self.current_phase = 3

	local hit_effect

	local kick_loop_check = false

	-- mk2와 플레이어가 몸싸움 하는 연출
	local kick_loop = function()
		while kick_loop_check do
			character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'push' })
			character_util.set_anim(self.mk2, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false })

			local time_passed = 0
			local duration = 0.05
			while time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if kick_loop_check == false then return end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			if kick_loop_check == false then return end

			self:camera_shake(0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.user, 1.2, 0.8, 1, 0.25)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.user, unity_class.color.red, 1, 0.5, 0.25)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			hit_effect = self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(
				self.user_transform.position + vector(0, 0.7, 0), unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-72.76, 7.278663, 1.131371), self.helicopter.transform.parent)

			time_passed = 0
			duration = 0.35
			while time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if kick_loop_check == false then return end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			if kick_loop_check == false then return end

			character_util.set_anim(self.mk2, { name = 'push' })
			character_util.set_anim(self.user, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false })

			time_passed = 0
			duration = 0.05
			while time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if kick_loop_check == false then return end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			if kick_loop_check == false then return end

			self:camera_shake(0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.mk2, 1.2, 0.8, 1, 0.25)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.mk2, unity_class.color.red, 1, 0.5, 0.25)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			hit_effect = self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(
				self.mk2_transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-72.76, 7.278663, 1.131371), self.helicopter.transform.parent)

			time_passed = 0
			duration = 0.35
			while time_passed < duration do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				if kick_loop_check == false then return end

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			if kick_loop_check == false then return end
		end
	end

	-- mk2 눈알이 카메라 쪽으로 날아가서 사라지는 연출
	local eyeball = function()
		local eye_sprite = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(self.mk2_transform.position)
		local custom_sprite = eye_sprite.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'mk2_eyeball'
		custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(0.3, 0.3)
		custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
		custom_sprite.Atlas = self.eyeball_custom_atlas
		custom_sprite.SortingLayer = 'Top Effects'
		custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 2
		custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)

		custom_sprite.transform.position = self.mk2_transform.position
		custom_sprite.transform:SetParent(self.screen_play_camera.transform)

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.5
		local start_position = custom_sprite.transform.localPosition + vector(0, 0.4, 0)
		local end_position = vector(0, 0, -0.1)
		local start_rotation = vector(0, 0, 0)
		local end_rotation = vector(0, 0, 330)
		local start_scale = 0.3
		local end_scale = 1.5

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
			local position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
			local rotation = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_rotation, end_rotation, progress)
			local scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)

			custom_sprite.transform.localPosition = position
			custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(rotation)
			custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(scale, scale)

			custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		custom_sprite.transform.localPosition = end_position
		custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(end_rotation)

		eye_sprite:Dispose()
	end

	local talk = function()
		-- 보이스가 있는 경우 speech_bubble_async로 대신 사용한다
		local speech_routine = function(talker, table)
			if CS.Oak.ResourceSelector.Instance:HasScenarioDialogue(music_player.CurrentVoiceBundleCode) then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, table)
			else
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(talker, table)
				wait_for_sec(2.5)
			end

--region util
-- QTE 함수
function local_class:qte_swipe(type, duration, is_wait_duration)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 9999)

	if type == 'tap' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTap()
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	end

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.is_qte_start and self.swipe_type ~= type and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	while is_wait_duration and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end
end

-- 터치 연타 함수
function local_class:turbo_tap(duration, count, delay, is_wait_duration)
	local animation_time_scale = 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(animation_time_scale)

	if delay then
		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	self.turbo_tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_start = true

	while self.is_qte_start and self.turbo_tap_count < count and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	while is_wait_duration and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end
--endregion

--region rotate_effect
-- 이리저리 회전하는 카메라에 맞춰, 지속적으로 회전시켜줄 이펙트를 등록한다.
function local_class:add_rotate_effect_list(effect, rotation)
	if self:is_contained_rotate_effect(effect) then
		return
	end

	local effect_data = {
		effect = effect,
		rotation = rotation
	}
	table.insert(self.rotate_effect_list, effect_data)

	-- rotate_effect_list_update_routine랑 호출 순서가 엇갈릴 수 있으므로, 최초에 등록 될 때 한번 카메라에 맞춰서 회전시켜 준다.
	local camera_position = self.camera.position
	effect.transform:LookAt(camera_position)
	effect.transform.localRotation = effect.transform.localRotation * rotation

	if #self.rotate_effect_list == 1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_effect_list_update_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:is_contained_rotate_effect(effect)
	for i = #self.rotate_effect_list, 1, -1 do
		local effect_data = self.rotate_effect_list[i]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(effect_data.effect, effect) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:remove_rotate_effect_list(effect)
	for i = #self.rotate_effect_list, 1, -1 do
		local effect_data = self.rotate_effect_list[i]

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(effect_data.effect, effect) then
			table.remove(self.rotate_effect_list, i)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:rotate_effect_list_update_routine()
	while #self.rotate_effect_list > 0 do
		for i = #self.rotate_effect_list, 1, -1 do
			local effect_data = self.rotate_effect_list[i]
			local effect = effect_data.effect
			local rotation = effect_data.rotation

			-- 생명 주기가 끝났으면, list 에서 삭제함
			if not effect.gameObject.activeSelf then
				table.remove(self.rotate_effect_list, i)
			end

			local camera_position = self.camera.position
			effect.transform:LookAt(camera_position)
			effect.transform.localRotation = effect.transform.localRotation * rotation
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end
--endregion

--region animation
-- 헬기가 옥상에서 떠오르는 애니메이션 리셋
function local_class:reset_helicopter_animation()
	self.camera.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.screen_play_camera.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self.camera_animator:Play('demonworld_boss_start', -1, 0)
	self.camera_animator.speed = 0
end

-- 헬기 애니메이션 시작
function local_class:start_helicopter_animation()
	self.camera.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.screen_play_camera.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.camera_animator.speed = 1
end
--endregion

--region camera
-- 메인 섹션 연출용 보조 카메라 위치 설정
function local_class:screen_play_camera_set_position(position)
	self.screen_play_camera.transform.position = position
end

function local_class:screen_play_camera_move_async(position, duration, is_local_position)
	self.screen_play_camera_move_req_id = self.screen_play_camera_move_req_id + 1

	local req_id = self.screen_play_camera_move_req_id
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_position = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_local_position,
	self.screen_play_camera.transform.localPosition, self.screen_play_camera.transform.position)
	local end_position = position

	while time_passed < duration and req_id == self.screen_play_camera_move_req_id do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / duration

		if is_local_position then
			self.screen_play_camera.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
		else
			self.screen_play_camera.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:screen_play_camera_move(position, duration, is_local_position)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.screen_play_camera_move_async, self, position, duration, is_local_position))
end

function local_class:get_screen_play_camera_position()
	return self.screen_play_camera.transform.position
end

function local_class:screen_play_camera_zoom_async(fov, duration)
	self:screen_play_camera_zoom_stop()
	local req_id = self.camera_zoom_req_id

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_fov = self.screen_play_camera.fieldOfView
	local end_fov = fov

	while req_id == self.camera_zoom_req_id and duration > 0 and time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		self.screen_play_camera.fieldOfView = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_fov, end_fov, progress)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if req_id == self.camera_zoom_req_id then
		self.screen_play_camera.fieldOfView = end_fov
	end
end

function local_class:screen_play_camera_zoom(fov, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.screen_play_camera_zoom_async, self, fov, duration))
end

function local_class:screen_play_camera_zoom_stop()
	self.camera_zoom_req_id = self.camera_zoom_req_id + 1
end

function local_class:change_to_screen_play_camera(position, rotation, fov, duration)
	self.screen_play_camera.transform:SetParent(self.camera_offset)
	self.screen_play_camera.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.camera.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_position = self.camera.localPosition
	local end_position = position
	local start_rotation = self.camera.localRotation
	local end_rotation = rotation
	local start_fov = self.camera:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera)).fieldOfView
	local end_fov = fov

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		self.screen_play_camera.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
		self.screen_play_camera.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(start_rotation, end_rotation, progress)
		self.screen_play_camera.fieldOfView = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_fov, end_fov, progress)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.screen_play_camera.transform.localPosition = end_position
	self.screen_play_camera.transform.localRotation = end_rotation
end

function local_class:change_to_main_camera(duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_position = self.screen_play_camera.transform.localPosition
	local start_rotation = self.screen_play_camera.transform.localRotation
	local start_fov = self.screen_play_camera.fieldOfView
	local end_fov = self.camera:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera)).fieldOfView

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local end_position = self.camera.localPosition
		local end_rotation = self.camera.localRotation
		self.screen_play_camera.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
		self.screen_play_camera.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(start_rotation, end_rotation, progress)
		self.screen_play_camera.fieldOfView = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_fov, end_fov, progress)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.screen_play_camera.transform:SetParent(self.helicopter_map.transform)
	self.camera.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.screen_play_camera.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:camera_shake_async(magnitude, duration)
	self:camera_shake_stop()
	local req_id = self.camera_shake_req_id

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()

	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = true

	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	while req_id == self.camera_shake_req_id and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if shake_calculator.IsActive then
			shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			self.camera_offset.localPosition = shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.camera_offset.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:camera_shake(magnitude, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camera_shake_async, self, magnitude, duration))
end

function local_class:camera_shake_stop()
	self.camera_shake_req_id = self.camera_shake_req_id + 1
end
--endregion

--region sfx
function local_class:play_propeller_sfx(time)
	self.propeller_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_propeller_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = time, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object' })
end

function local_class:stop_propeller_sfx()
	if self.propeller_sfx then
		self.propeller_sfx:Stop()
		self.propeller_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:fade_out_propeller_sfx(time)
	self.propeller_sfx:FadeOut(time)
	self.propeller_sfx = nil
end
--endregion

function local_class:get_rope_point_transform()
	return self.rope_point
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}
