	self.hot_spring_data_list = nil

	-- 악령 등장 스테이트
	self.npc_state = { hide = 0, showing = 1, show = 2, hiding = 3, dead = 4 }

	-- 현재 목표까지의 수치
	self.cur_goal_count = 0

	-- 실패한 횟수
	self.cur_fail_count = 0

	-- 게임 진행 시간
	self.game_play_time = 0
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	-- 게임 데이터 및 키 세팅
	local before_data_key = self.constants_data_key
	self.constants_data_key = key
	if self.game_data == nil or before_data_key ~= self.constants_data_key then
		-- game_data 키가 세팅이 안되있거나 이전 데이터 키랑 다른 값이 세팅되어 있다면 game_data 다시 세팅
		self.game_data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(
				'minigame/HotSpringExorcismGame/HotSpringExorcismGameConstants', self.constants_data_key)

		-- 사용할 npc들의 characterStat을 지우고 암살 못하게 한다.
		for i = 1, #self.game_data.customer_list do
			for j = 1, self.game_data.spawner_count do
				local customer = get_character(self.game_data.customer_list[i].name .. j)
				character_util.set_scale_factor(customer, nil, self.game_data.customer_list[i].scale)
				field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(customer, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
				stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(customer)
			end
		end
	end

	self.cur_goal_count = 0
	self.cur_fail_count = 0
	self.game_play_time = self.game_data.game_play_time

	-- hot_spring_data_list가 세팅 되어 있다면 이전에 character들 다 disabled
	if self.hot_spring_data_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.hot_spring_data_list do
			if self.hot_spring_data_list[i].character ~= nil then
				character_util.set_position(self.hot_spring_data_list[i].character, vector(999, 0, 999))
				character_util.set_active_state(self.hot_spring_data_list[i].character, 'disabled')
			end
		end
	end

	-- 손님 정보 세팅
	self.hot_spring_data_list = {}
	local first_name = self.game_data.spawner_first_name
	for i = 1, self.game_data.spawner_count do
		local point_data = { }
		local position = field:GetMarker(first_name .. i).position

		-- 스폰 시간 설정
		point_data.min_spawn_time = self.game_data.min_spawn_time[i]
		point_data.max_spawn_time = self.game_data.max_spawn_time[i]

		-- 랜덤 값으로 설정될 스폰 시간
		point_data.cur_spawn_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(point_data.min_spawn_time, point_data.max_spawn_time)

		-- 스폰 좌표 설정
		point_data.spawn_pos = position

		-- 시간 계산용 변수
		point_data.cur_time = 0
		point_data.npc_action_time = 0

		-- 캐릭터가 스폰 됐을 때 대기하는 시간
		point_data.npc_stay_time = 0

		-- 현재 npc state
		point_data.npc_state = self.npc_state.hide

		-- 손님 정보
		point_data.customer_data = nil

		-- 활성화된 캐릭터
		point_data.character = nil

		-- 활성화된 캐릭터의 hp
		point_data.hp = 0

		table.insert(self.hot_spring_data_list, point_data)
	end

	-- 캐릭터 게임 시작 위치로 이동
	self.user_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker(self.game_data.user_spawn_point).position
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, self.user_spawn_pos)

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	self.get_ui_num_counter()
	self.get_ui_fail_counter()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 준비 끝났으면 콜백 보냄
	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.is_playing_game then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
		timer_util.end_timer(self)
	end

	-- 피자 카운터 ui
	self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
	self.ui_num_counter = nil

	self.is_playing_game = false
	self.hot_spring_data_list = nil
	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.game_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(_)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return false
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not self.is_playing_game or self.hot_spring_data_list == nil then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.hot_spring_data_list do
		-- 보여지고 있을 때
		local hot_spring_data = self.hot_spring_data_list[i]
		local character = hot_spring_data.character

		if character ~= nil and hot_spring_data.npc_state >= self.npc_state.show
				and hot_spring_data.npc_state <= self.npc_state.hiding then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, character)
					and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_party_leader()) then
				if hot_spring_data.hp <= 1 then
					-- 사망
					character.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(hot_spring_data.customer_data.dead_sfx)
					damage_util.show_damage_number(character, 1, unity_class.color.red, character.Position)
					local dir = character.Position.x > get_party_leader().Position.x and vector(1, 0, 0)
							or vector(-1, 0, 0)
					character_util.air_spin(character, { offset = dir, speed = 1.5 })
					self:update_goal_point(hot_spring_data.customer_data.get_point)

					hot_spring_data.npc_state = self.npc_state.dead
					hot_spring_data.cur_time = 0
				else
					damage_util.show_damage_number(character, 1, unity_class.color.red, character.Position)
					hot_spring_data.hp = hot_spring_data.hp - 1
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	-- 미니게임 로직
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

function local_class:update_goal_point(get_point)
	if get_point < 0 then
		self.cur_fail_count = self.cur_fail_count + 1
		if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
			self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(self.cur_fail_count)
		end
		return
	end

	self.cur_goal_count = self.cur_goal_count + get_point
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(self.cur_goal_count)
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	-- 악령 피격 판정을 위한 데미지 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
	self.is_playing_game = true

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	-- 3, 2, 1 카운팅 후 시작
	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(tostring(i), 2.1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- bgm 정보가 있다면 해당 bgm 재생
	if self.game_data.play_bgm ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.game_data.play_bgm, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 타이머 시작
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.game_play_time, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	-- 카운팅용 UI 추가
	self.ui_num_counter_object = self.get_ui_num_counter():Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 1))
	self.ui_num_counter = self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUINumCounter))

	self.ui_num_counter:Reposition()
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(0)
	self.ui_num_counter:SetMaxCount(self.game_data.goal_count)

	-- 데스카운트용 UI 추가
	local ui_fail_counter_obj = self.get_ui_fail_counter():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.ui_fail_counter = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))
	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)
	self.ui_fail_counter:Reposition()

	-- 게임 루프 시작
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local cur_play_time = 0
	local is_success = false

	local change_hide_state = function(data)
		character_util.set_position(data.character, vector(999, 0, 999))
		data.cur_time = 0
		data.cur_spawn_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(data.min_spawn_time
		, data.max_spawn_time)
		data.npc_state = self.npc_state.hide
	end

	while self.is_playing_game do
		-- 시간 계속 체크
		cur_play_time = cur_play_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 할당량을 다 채웠다면 게임 클리어
		if self.cur_goal_count >= self.game_data.goal_count then
			self.is_playing_game = true
			is_success = true
			break
		end

		if self.cur_fail_count >= self.game_data.death_count then
			self.is_playing_game = false
			is_success = false
			break
		end

		-- 게임 시간 다되었다면 바로 게임 오버 (동시에 될 수 있으므로 할당량 체크를 먼저해서 성공더 쉽도록)
		if cur_play_time >= self.game_play_time then
			self.is_playing_game = false
			is_success = false
			break
		end

		if self.hot_spring_data_list ~= nil then
			for i = 1, #self.hot_spring_data_list do
				local hot_spring_data = self.hot_spring_data_list[i]

				-- 시간 지속적으로 체크
				hot_spring_data.cur_time = hot_spring_data.cur_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				-- 스폰중이면 악령 로직 타고 스폰 중이지 않으면 시간 체크 후 랜덤으로 악령 스폰 하는 함수 시작
				if hot_spring_data.npc_state == self.npc_state.show then
					if hot_spring_data.character == nil then
						-- 캐릭터가 nil이면 지정 안된거니 hide로 변경
						hot_spring_data.npc_state = self.npc_state.hide
					else
						if hot_spring_data.cur_time < hot_spring_data.npc_stay_time then
							-- 캐릭터 딜레이가 더 적으면 각 type에 맞는 계산 (두리번 두리번 / 가만히 있기 / 런)
							if hot_spring_data.customer_data.customer_type == 'look_around_evil' then
								-- 두리번 거리는 악령이기에 1초 마다 두리번 두리번 한다.
								hot_spring_data.npc_action_time = hot_spring_data.npc_action_time
										+ unity_class.time.deltaTime
								if hot_spring_data.npc_action_time > 0.5 then
									hot_spring_data.npc_action_time = 0
									local dir = hot_spring_data.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right
											and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or CS.Oak.Direction.Right
									character_util.set_direction(hot_spring_data.character, dir)
								end
							elseif hot_spring_data.customer_data.customer_type == 'shameful_evil' then
								-- 등장 후 0.5초 딜레이 이후 hide_distance만큼 가까워지면 바로 사라진다.
								local diff = leader.Position - hot_spring_data.character.Position
								if diff.magnitude < hot_spring_data.customer_data.hide_distance
										and hot_spring_data.cur_time > 0.5 then
									self:hide_customer(i)
								end
							end
						else
							-- 시간 다되면 사라진다.
							self:hide_customer(i)
						end
					end
				elseif hot_spring_data.npc_state == self.npc_state.hide then
					-- 숨어 있는 상태인 경우 딜레이 다되면 showing 상태로 진입 및 등장 연출 끝나고 난 뒤 show State로 변경
					if hot_spring_data.cur_time >= hot_spring_data.cur_spawn_time then
						self:set_customer(i)
					end
				elseif hot_spring_data.npc_state == self.npc_state.showing then
					if hot_spring_data.character == nil then
						-- 캐릭터가 nil이면 지정 안된거니 hide로 변경
						hot_spring_data.npc_state = self.npc_state.hide
					else
						-- showing 상태로 들어오면 스폰 연출을 일정 시간동안 진행 한 뒤 등장한다.
						local customer = hot_spring_data.character
						local progress = hot_spring_data.cur_time / self.game_data.spawn_time
						if progress <= 1 then
							local start_pos = vector(customer.Position.x, -0.9, customer.Position.z)
							local target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, hot_spring_data.spawn_pos, progress)
							customer.Position = target_pos
						else
							character_util.set_position(customer, hot_spring_data.spawn_pos)
							hot_spring_data.cur_time = 0
							hot_spring_data.npc_state = self.npc_state.show
						end
					end

				elseif hot_spring_data.npc_state == self.npc_state.hiding then
					if hot_spring_data.character == nil then
						-- 캐릭터가 nil이면 지정 안된거니 hide로 변경
						hot_spring_data.npc_state = self.npc_state.hide
					else
						-- showing 상태로 들어오면 스폰 연출을 일정 시간동안 진행 한 뒤 등장한다.
						local customer = hot_spring_data.character
						local progress = hot_spring_data.cur_time / self.game_data.spawn_time
						if progress <= 1 then
							local end_pos = vector(customer.Position.x, -0.9, customer.Position.z)
							local target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(hot_spring_data.spawn_pos, end_pos, progress)
							customer.Position = target_pos
						else
							character_util.set_active_state(customer, 'disabled')
							change_hide_state(hot_spring_data)
						end
					end
				elseif hot_spring_data.npc_state == self.npc_state.dead then
					if hot_spring_data.character == nil then
						-- 캐릭터가 nil이면 지정 안된거니 hide로 변경
						hot_spring_data.npc_state = self.npc_state.hide
					else
						-- 죽는 연출 중 비활성화 되면 hide 상태로 변경
						if hot_spring_data.character.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
							change_hide_state(hot_spring_data)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- 게임 끝났으니 컨트롤 뺏는다.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 타이머 엔드
	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	-- 카운팅 UI Dispose
	self:dispose_ui_num_counter()
	ui_fail_counter_obj:Dispose()

	-- 이벤트 구독해지
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

	-- 파티 스테이트 원복
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	if is_success then
		-- 성공했다면 아래보며 smile
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
	else
		-- 실패시 왼쪽보고 주저 앉음
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	end

	-- 성공 여부에 따라 재생
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
end

-- 타이머 종료 시 호출되는 함수
function local_class:timer_finished()
	timer_util.end_timer(self)
end

-- 악령 또는 놀고 있는 일반 유령을 가져오는 함수
function local_class:set_customer(index)
	-- 진행도
	local progress = self.cur_goal_count / self.game_data.goal_count

	-- 스폰을 하기 위한 랜덤 값 받아오기
	local rnd_value = random_util.get_random_value()

	-- 캐릭터 및 customer_data 데이터 리셋
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].character = nil
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].customer_data = nil

	-- 진행도에 따라 customer_data 세팅
	local phase = self.game_data.phase
	local start_phase_progress = 0
	local end_phase_progress = phase[1]

	-- 페이즈에 맞는 customer_data 가져오기
	local customer_data
	for i = 1, #phase do
		if i >= #phase then
			customer_data = self:get_customer_data(i, rnd_value)
			break
		end

		if progress >= start_phase_progress and progress < end_phase_progress then
			customer_data = self:get_customer_data(i, rnd_value)
			break
		end

		start_phase_progress = start_phase_progress + phase[i]
		end_phase_progress = end_phase_progress + phase[i + 1]
	end

	-- 가져온 customer_data 및 유령 character 세팅

	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].character = self:get_customer(customer_data.name)
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].character.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy

	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].cur_time = 0
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].cur_spawn_time = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.hot_spring_data_list[index].min_spawn_time
	, self.hot_spring_data_list[index].max_spawn_time)

	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].npc_action_time = 0
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].customer_data = customer_data
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].hp = customer_data.hp
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].npc_stay_time = customer_data.stay_time

	local character = self.hot_spring_data_list[index].character
	local pos = vector(self.hot_spring_data_list[index].spawn_pos.x
	, -0.4, self.hot_spring_data_list[index].spawn_pos.z)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(character, pos)
	character_util.set_active_state(character, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(character, 'down')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, self.game_data.spawn_time)

	-- showing State로 변경
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].npc_state = self.npc_state.showing
end

function local_class:get_customer_data(index, rnd_value)
	local npc_spawn_data = self.game_data.phase_spawn_probability[index]
	local start_pro = 0

	local customer_count = 1
	for i = 1, #npc_spawn_data do
		local probability = npc_spawn_data[i]
		if probability ~= 0 then
			if start_pro <= rnd_value and (probability + start_pro) > rnd_value then
				return self.game_data.customer_list[customer_count]
			end
			start_pro = start_pro + npc_spawn_data[i]
		end
		customer_count = customer_count + 1
	end

	return self.game_data.customer_list[1]
end

function local_class:hide_customer(index)
	if self.hot_spring_data_list[index].character ~= nil then
		character_util.set_direction(self.hot_spring_data_list[index].character, 'down')
		self.hot_spring_data_list[index].character.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Neutral0
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.hot_spring_data_list[index].character
		, 0, self.game_data.spawn_time)
	end

	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].cur_time = 0
	self.hot_spring_data_list[index].npc_state = self.npc_state.hiding
end

-- 비활성화 중인 npc를 가져온다.
function local_class:get_customer(npc_name)
	for i = 1, self.game_data.spawner_count do
		local npc = get_character(npc_name .. i)
		if npc.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			return npc
		end
	end

	-- 여기까지 내려오면 안되지만 터지지 않게 1번 npc를 가져오도록 수정
	return get_character(npc_name .. 1)
end

-- 카운터 ui 삭제
function local_class:dispose_ui_num_counter()
	if self.ui_num_counter_object ~= nil then
		self.ui_num_counter_object:Dispose()
		self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
	end

	self.ui_num_counter = nil
end
return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

			field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}), 0)
		end
	end
end
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.judgement_room_event_zone_name then
			field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.judgement_table) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.judgement_room_minigame_start_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.show_o_event then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_feedback_ui, self, true))
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.show_x_event then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_feedback_ui, self, false))
	end
end
--endregion

--region Game Logic
-- 심판의 방 미니게임 시작 이벤트
function local_class:judgement_room_minigame_start_event()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create(self.game_name))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local desk_center_pos = vector(-97.5, 0, -191)

	camera_util.move_async(desk_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 7), 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0)

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), true)
	party_util.align_party(desk_center_pos, 'down', 0, 'arc')

	-- 대기 줄 NPC들 설정
	for n = 1, self.constants_data.wait_npc_num do
		self:add_wait_list(n)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.wait_npc_list do
		local cur_npc = self.wait_npc_list[i].character

		-- 대기 줄 NPC Alpha 값을 0으로 설정함 (연출 위함)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cur_npc, 0, 0)

		-- 대기 줄 NPC 위치 설정
		character_util.set_position(cur_npc, vector(-97.5, 0, -182))
		character_util.set_direction(cur_npc, 'down')
	end

	-- 집게 위치 설정
	character_util.set_position(self.claw_machine, vector(-104, 0, -189.5))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local elevator_animator = self.judgement_elevator_door.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	elevator_animator:Play('open')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_02')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 시작 시 영혼들이 줄지어 내려오는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.walk_down_ghost_at_first, self))

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.move(desk_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), 2.5)

	wait_for_sec(3)

	if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
		self.is_show_pc_narration = true
		field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')
	end

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('afterworld_judgement_minigame_countdown_'..i), 2.1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- BGM 실행함
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/afterworld/audio:bgm_afterworld_game'})

	-- 타이머 실행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')

	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.constants_data.minigame_duration + self.add_time,
			  handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('afterworld_judgement_minigame_start'), 2.1)

	-- 게임패드 이벤트 활성화
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')

	-- UI 활성화
	self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self:set_up_ui_button()

	-- 기존 UI 비활성화
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	-- 미니게임 루프 시작
	self.game_loop = true

	coroutine.yield(self:minigame_loop())

	self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.left_button:SetActive(false)
	self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
			unity_color({0.7255, 0.1059, 0.1059, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))

	self.right_button:SetActive(false)
	self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
			unity_color({0.1059, 0.7255, 0.1059, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))

	self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 성공 시
	local is_success = self.correct_num >= self.constants_data.correct_max

	self.wait_npc_list = {}
	self.wait_for_tong_npc_list = {}

	for _, target in pairs(self.judgement_character_list) do
		target.active = false
	end

	self.correct_num = 0
	self.fail_num = 0
	self.combo_count = 0

	if is_success then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'success' })
		character_util.set_emotion(get_party_leader(), { name = 'smile' })

		for i = 1, #self.judgement_character_list do
			character_util.stop(self.judgement_character_list[i].character)
			character_util.set_anim(self.judgement_character_list[i].character, { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.judgement_character_list[i].character, { name = 'smile' })
		end

		wait_for_sec(3)
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('afterworld_judgement_minigame_fail'), 2.1)

		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'dead', loop = false })
		character_util.set_emotion(get_party_leader(), { name = 'damaged' })

		wait_for_sec(3)
	end

	-- 게임패드 이벤트 비활성화
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 게임패드 버튼 플래그 초기화
	self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
	self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(0)

	elevator_animator:Play('close')

	for _, target in pairs(self.optimized_npcs) do
		character_util.set_position(target, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_anim(target)
		character_util.remove_emotion(target)
	end

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), false)
	character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader())
	character_util.remove_emotion(get_party_leader())

	character_util.set_position(self.claw_machine, vector(999, 0, 999))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 성공 시
	if is_success then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))

		-- 메인 퀘스트 섹션 3일 경우에는 메인 퀘스트에서 이벤트 이어서 진행하므로 컨트롤 돌려주지 않는다
		local afterworld_main_quest_id = 60049
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(afterworld_main_quest_id)

		if quest_progress.InnerProgress ~= 2 then
			field_ui_manager:Show()

			party_util.reset_controllers()
		end
	else
		self.game_over_num = self.game_over_num + 1

		if self.game_over_num > 2 then
			local plus_time = 5 * math.floor(self.game_over_num / 2)

			self.add_time = self.add_time + plus_time
		end

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, false))

		field_ui_manager:Show()

		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end
end

-- 대기 리스트에 영혼 추가
function local_class:add_wait_list(index)
	-- 악 성향인지 선 성향인지 랜덤으로 결정함 (확률은 Constants에서 가져옴)
	local rand_num = unity_class.random.Range(0, 1)
	local is_bad = false

	if rand_num < self.constants_data.bad_npc_per_all then
		is_bad = true
	end

	-- 성향 따라서 현재 NPC 리스트에서 사용중이지 않은 NPC 찾아 할당
	local cur_npc
	local cur_ref

	for _, target in pairs(self.judgement_character_list) do
		if (is_bad and target.is_bad) or (not is_bad and not target.is_bad) then
			if not target.active then
				target.active = true
				cur_npc = target.character
				cur_ref = target

				break
			end
		end
	end

	if cur_npc == nil then
		for _, target in pairs(self.judgement_character_list) do
			if not target.active then
				target.active = true
				cur_npc = target.character
				cur_ref = target

				break
			end
		end
	end

	-- 대기 줄 NPC 리스트에 삽입
	self.wait_npc_list[index] = {
		character = cur_npc,
		is_bad = is_bad,
		ref = cur_ref
	}
end

-- 미니게임 시작 전에 영혼들이 줄지어서 내려오는 연출
function local_class:walk_down_ghost_at_first()
	local speed = 2

	for i = 1, #self.wait_npc_list do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.wait_npc_list[i].character, 1, 1)

		self:walk_down_ghost(
				self.wait_npc_list[i].character, -8 + self.constants_data.character_dist * i, speed)

		wait_for_sec(self.constants_data.character_dist / speed)
	end
end

-- 유령 순차적으로 걸어 내려오는 연출
function local_class:walk_down_ghost(character, dist_z, speed)
	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list:Add(character.Position + vector(0, 0, dist_z))

	character_util.move_waypoint(character, waypoint_list,
			speed, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')
end

-- 미니게임 로직
function local_class:minigame_loop()
	-- 버튼 연속 누르기 방지
	local timer = 0
	local ignore_touch_delay = self.constants_data.ignore_touch_delay

	-- 버튼 눌러진 상태 체크
	local left_pressed = self.left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
	local right_pressed = self.right_button_touch_handler.Pressed

	local left_button_pos = self.left_button.transform.localPosition
	local right_button_pos = self.right_button.transform.localPosition

	while self.game_loop do
		-- 전체 성공 횟수 >= 목표 성공 횟수면 미니게임 종료
		if self.correct_num >= self.constants_data.correct_max then
			self.game_loop = false

			timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

			break
		end

		-- 터치 상태면 일정 시간 대기 후 다시 터치 가능한 상태로 변경
		if self.is_ignore_touch_event then
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if timer >= ignore_touch_delay then
				timer = 0
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = false
			end
		end

		-- 터치 체크 (버튼에서 손 땔 때 애니메이션 처리도 해야 되서 ignore_touch_event 상태여도 실행함)
		-- 버튼 누르거나 떼는 Animation 처리 (down : 누른 상태, up : 뗀 상태)
		local left_down = false
		local left_up = false
		local right_down = false
		local right_up = false

		-- 버튼이 눌러졌는지 체크 코드
		local current_left_pressed = self.left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
				or self.gamepad_left_button_pressed == true

		local current_right_pressed = self.right_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D)
				or self.gamepad_right_button_pressed == true

		self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
		self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

		self.left_button_touch_handler:Update()
		self.right_button_touch_handler:Update()

		-- 눌렀는지 떼었는지 확인
		if current_left_pressed ~= left_pressed then
			if current_left_pressed then
				left_down = true
			else
				left_up = true
			end

			left_pressed = current_left_pressed
		elseif current_right_pressed ~= right_pressed then
			if current_right_pressed then
				right_down = true
			else
				right_up = true
			end

			right_pressed = current_right_pressed
		end

		-- 왼쪽 버튼 눌렀을 때 애니메이션 처리
		if left_down then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')

			self.left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)

			self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1}),
					unity_color({1, 0.7921, 0.3647, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))

			-- 버튼 터치 가능한 상태면 입력 처리
			if not self.is_ignore_touch_event then
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = true

				self:touch_left_button()
			end
		-- 왼쪽 버튼 떼었을 때 애니메이션 처리
		elseif left_up then
			self.left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos

			self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
					unity_color({0.7255, 0.1059, 0.1059, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))
		end

		-- 오른쪽 버튼 눌렀을 때 애니메이션 처리
		if right_down then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')

			self.right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)

			self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1}),
					unity_color({1, 0.7921, 0.3647, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))

			-- 버튼 터치 가능한 상태면 입력 처리
			if not self.is_ignore_touch_event then
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = true

				self:touch_right_button()
			end
		-- 오른쪽 버튼 떼었을 때 애니메이션 처리
		elseif right_up then
			self.right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos

			self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
					unity_color({0.1059, 0.7255, 0.1059, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 터치 이벤트 로직
function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if not self.is_ignore_touch_event then
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftTriggerDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftShoulderDown then
			self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
			self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = true
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 버튼 애니메이션
function local_class:set_button_tint(button, ic_color, circle_color, border_color)
	local ic_sprite = button.transform:Find("ic"):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local circle_sprite = button.transform:Find("circle"):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local border_sprite = button.transform:Find("border"):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	ic_sprite.TintColor = ic_color
	circle_sprite.TintColor = circle_color
	border_sprite.TintColor = border_color

	ic_sprite:Rebuild()
	circle_sprite:Rebuild()
	border_sprite:Rebuild()
end

-- 우측 버튼 입력 처리 (영혼이 우측으로 이동하고 올바른 선택이면 완료 숫자 증가)
function local_class:touch_right_button()
	-- 현재 대기 중인 영혼 정보
	local cur_spirit = self.wait_npc_list[1]
	local correct = false

	-- 대기 중인 영혼이 선한 영혼이면 성공
	if not cur_spirit.is_bad then
		correct = true
	end

	-- 대기 리스트에서 현재 영혼 제거하고 새 영혼 추가함
	self:wait_list_update()

	-- 성공 시
	if correct then
		self:success_ui(cur_spirit.character)

		character_util.set_emotion(cur_spirit.character, { name = 'smile' })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.spirit_move_right, self, cur_spirit))
	-- 실패 시
	else
		self:fail_ui(cur_spirit.character)

		character_util.set_emotion(cur_spirit.character, { name = 'doyagao' })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.spirit_move_right, self, cur_spirit))
	end

	-- 플레이어 행동 처리
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(
			get_party_leader(), vector(0.3, 0, 0.5), 0.12, 0.06)
	character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'spear_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	-- 성공, 실패 UI 표시
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_feedback_ui, self, correct))

	-- 버튼 점멸
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activate_button, self, true))
end

-- 좌측 버튼 입력 처리 (영혼이 좌측으로 이동하고 올바른 선택이면 완료 숫자 증가)
function local_class:touch_left_button()
	-- 현재 대기 중인 영혼 정보
	local cur_spirit = self.wait_npc_list[1]
	local correct = false

	-- 대기 중인 영혼이 악한 영혼이면 성공
	if cur_spirit.is_bad then
		correct = true
	end

	-- 대기 리스트에서 현재 영혼 제거하고 새 영혼 추가함
	self:wait_list_update()

	-- 성공 시
	if correct then
		self:success_ui(cur_spirit.character)

		character_util.set_emotion(cur_spirit.character, { name = 'tired' })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.spirit_move_left, self, cur_spirit))
	-- 실패 시
	else
		self:fail_ui(cur_spirit.character)

		character_util.set_emotion(cur_spirit.character, { name = 'damaged' })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.spirit_move_left, self, cur_spirit))
	end

	-- 플레이어 행동 처리
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(
			get_party_leader(), vector(-0.3, 0, 0.5), 0.12, 0.06)
	character_util.set_anim(get_party_leader(), { name = 'spear_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	-- 성공, 실패 UI 표시
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_feedback_ui, self, correct))

	-- 버튼 점멸
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activate_button, self, false))
end

-- 성공 연출 UI 처리
function local_class:success_ui(effect_character)
	-- 콤보 증가
	self.combo_count = self.combo_count + 1
	self.combo_text_object:SetActive(true)
	self.combo_text.text = string.format("%d", self.combo_count)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.minigame_correct_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			effect_character.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	-- 숫자 카운터 UI 증가
	self.correct_num = self.correct_num + 1
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(self.correct_num)
end

-- 실패 연출 UI 처리
function local_class:fail_ui(effect_character)
	-- 콤보 초기화
	self.combo_count = 0
	self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.minigame_fail_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			effect_character.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	-- 제한 시간 감소 처리
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerModifiedEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer,
			self.constants_data.fail_time))
end

-- 대기줄 갱신 (첫 번째 원소를 제거하고 나머지 1개씩 앞으로 당긴 다음 마지막 원소 추가함)
function local_class:wait_list_update()
	-- 첫 원소 제거 + 나머지 원소 1개씩 당김
	for i = 2, #self.wait_npc_list do
		self.wait_npc_list[i - 1] = self.wait_npc_list[i]
	end

	-- 마지막 원소 추가
	self:add_wait_list(#self.wait_npc_list)

	local new_npc = self.wait_npc_list[#self.wait_npc_list]
	character_util.set_position(new_npc.character,
			self.wait_npc_list[#self.wait_npc_list - 1].character.Position +
					vector(0, 0, self.constants_data.character_dist))
	character_util.set_direction(new_npc.character, 'down')

	-- 대기 위치 1칸씩 이동
	for i = 1, #self.wait_npc_list do
		local cur_npc = self.wait_npc_list[i].character

		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list:Add(cur_npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -(self.constants_data.character_dist)))

		character_util.move_waypoint(cur_npc, waypoint_list,
				4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')
	end
end

-- 영혼 우측 이동 루틴
function local_class:spirit_move_right(cur_spirit)
	-- 우측으로 걸어가서 화면에 안 보이면 사라짐
	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list:Add(cur_spirit.character.Position + vector(8, 0, 0))

	-- 이동 완료 되면 대기 리스트에 추가
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(cur_spirit.character, waypoint_list,
			3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', false)

	character_util.set_position(cur_spirit.character, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_emotion(cur_spirit.character)

	cur_spirit.ref.active = false

-- 영혼 좌측 이동 루틴
function local_class:spirit_move_left(cur_spirit)
	-- 지정된 위치로 이동
	local target_marker = field:GetMarker(
			self.constants_data.evil_soul_wait_for_judgement_marker_name..(#self.wait_for_tong_npc_list + 1))

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	waypoint_list:Add(vector(target_marker.position.x, 0, cur_spirit.character.Position.z))
	waypoint_list:Add(target_marker.position)

	-- 대기 리스트에 추가
	table.insert(self.wait_for_tong_npc_list, cur_spirit.ref)

	-- 대기 리스트가 꽉 차면 영혼들 잡아가는 집게 등장하는 루틴 처리
	if #self.wait_for_tong_npc_list >= self.constants_data.evil_soul_wait_for_judgement_num then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activate_tong, self, cur_spirit))

	local deactive_obj
	local active_obj

	if is_right then
		deactive_obj = self.judgement_table_green_button.Transform:GetChild(0).gameObject
		active_obj = self.judgement_table_green_button.Transform:GetChild(1).gameObject
	else

		active_obj = self.judgement_table_red_button.Transform:GetChild(1).gameObject
	end

	active_obj:SetActive(false)

-- 집게 머신 작동
function local_class:activate_tong(last_target)
	local saved_wait_npc_list = {}

	for i = 1, #self.wait_for_tong_npc_list do
		table.insert(saved_wait_npc_list, self.wait_for_tong_npc_list[i])
	end

	-- 대기 리스트 리셋
	self.wait_for_tong_npc_list = {}

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	while last_target.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 대기 중에 게임 루프 중단된 경우에는 머신 작동도 중지
	if not self.game_loop then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_screen_effect_robot_01')

	character_util.set_anim(self.claw_machine, { name = 'launch', loop = false, scale = 2 })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	for i = 1, #saved_wait_npc_list do
		character_util.set_anim(saved_wait_npc_list[i].character, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(saved_wait_npc_list[i].character, { name = 'damaged' })
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.claw_machine, { name = 'grab', loop = false, scale = 2 })

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_anim(self.claw_machine, { name = 'grab2', loop = false, scale = 2 })

	for i = 1, #saved_wait_npc_list do
		character_util.move_to(saved_wait_npc_list[i].character,
				saved_wait_npc_list[i].character.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0),
				0.2, nil, false, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_robot_03')

	character_util.remove_anim(self.claw_machine)

	for i = 1, #saved_wait_npc_list do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_down_npc, self, saved_wait_npc_list[i]))
	end
end

-- NPC들 추락하는 연출
function local_class:fall_down_npc(cur_spirit)
	local cur_npc = cur_spirit.character

	local timer = 0
	local fall_duration = 0.5

	local start_pos = cur_npc.Position

	local start_y = 0
	local end_y = -0.3

	local start_z = 0
	local end_z = -0.3

	local end_rotation = 720
	local end_scale = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')

	character_util.spine_rotate(cur_npc, end_rotation, fall_duration)
	character_util.spine_scale(cur_npc, unity_class.vector3.one * end_scale, fall_duration)

	while timer < fall_duration do
		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(timer, start_y, end_y - start_y, fall_duration)
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(timer, start_z, end_z - start_z, fall_duration)

		character_util.set_position(cur_npc, vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z + cur_z), true)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	cur_spirit.active = false

	character_util.set_position(cur_npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim(cur_npc)
	character_util.remove_emotion(cur_npc)
	character_util.spine_rotate(cur_npc, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_scale(cur_npc, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
end

-- 제한 시간 다 되서 실패하는 연출
function local_class:timer_finished()
	self.game_loop = false

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.judgement_gate = nil
	self.judgement_table = nil
	self.judgement_table_red_button = nil
	self.judgement_table_green_button = nil
	self.judgement_elevator_door = nil
	self.claw_machine = nil

	-- 동적 할당 NPC 초기화
	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
		self.optimized_npcs = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

local player_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/JumpingOnTrainGame/JumpingOnTrainGamePlayerController')

local local_class = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
  self.cs_controller = cs_controller
  -- 게임 이름
  self.game_name = 'JumpingOnTrainGame'

  self.center_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

  -- 게임 상태
  self.game_state = {
    ready = 1,
    intro = 2,
    playing = 3,
    end_game = 4,
    game_clear = 5,
  }

  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.ready
  self.is_active_control = false

  -- 게임 처리용 데이터
  self.people_info = nil
  self.round_info = nil
  self.cur_round = 0

  -- 버튼 delay
  self.shot_delay = 0.5

  -- 조작용
  self.move_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
  self.is_pressed = false
  self.button_delay = 0.3
  self.cur_pressed_time = 1
  self.target_index = 1

  self.custom_atlas = nil

  self.action_button = nil
  self.minigame_ui_prefab = nil
  self.minigame_ui = nil

  player_controller:init(self)
end

function local_class:load_resource(key)
  -- 게임 데이터 세팅
  self.constants_data = require('minigame/JumpingOnTrainGame/JumpingOnTrainGameConstants')[key]

  self.config = self.constants_data['config']
  self.center_pos = vector(self.config.pos.x, self.config.pos.y, self.config.pos.z)

  self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

  yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
      self.res_holder, 'ondemand/bridge_story_seira/minigame_jumping_on_train', 'JumpingOnTrainMinigameUI', function(prefab)
        self.minigame_ui_prefab = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
        self.minigame_ui = self.minigame_ui_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.JumpginOnTrainMinigameUI))
      end)

  self.minigame_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)
  player_controller:setting_player(self)

  self.change_leader_character = get_character(self.constants_data['player_spec'].npc_name)

end

function local_class:dispose()
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ControllerBlockEvent))

  player_controller:dispose()

  self.constants_data = nil

  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none

  if self.res_holder ~= nil then
    self.res_holder:Dispose()
    self.res_holder = nil
  end

  if self.minigame_ui_prefab ~= nil then
    CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.user_hp_prefab)
    self.minigame_ui_prefab = nil
  end

  self.is_pause = false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

  return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)

  if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing or self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.end_game then
    return player_controller:action_input_processing(e)
  end
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
  if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing or not self.is_active_control then
    return false
  end

  return player_controller:joy_stick_input_processing(e)
end

function local_class:on_controller_block_event(e)

  if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ControllerBlockEvent) then

    if e.IsAllow then
      start_coroutine(function()
        self:hide_ui_setting()
        wait_for_sec(0.2)
        self:game_ui_setting()
      end, self)

      if self.is_pause then
        player_controller:set_pause(false)
        self.is_pause = false
      end
    else
      self:hide_ui_setting()
      player_controller:set_pause(true)
      self.is_pause = true
    end
  end
end


function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)

  return true
end

function local_class:use_update_frame()
  return true
end

function local_class:update_frame_priority()
  return CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent
end

--- 플레이어 조작 처리용

--
--  if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ready or self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_clear then

--end

function local_class:late_update_frame(dt)
  if self.is_pause then
    return
  end

  if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.ready or self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_clear then
    return
  end

  --background_controller:scrolling(dt) 플레이어 컨트롤러로 옮김.
  player_controller:update_frame(dt)
end

function local_class:use_late_update_frame()
  return true
end

function local_class:start()
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
  message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ControllerBlockEvent), 'on_controller_block_event')

  start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_routine()

  screen_util.fade_out_circular(0, 'linear')
  self.is_active_control = true

  if self.change_leader_character ~= get_party_leader() then
    -- 리더 변경
    self.origin_leader = get_party_leader()

    self.change_leader_character.Position = self.origin_leader.Position

    local leader =  self.change_leader_character

    character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
    local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
    --character_util.convert_to_manual_character(leader, param, true)
    character_util.convert_to_manual_character(leader, param, true)

    coroutine.yield(nil)
    player_controller:set_player()

    --컨트롤 뻇기
    self.manual_touch_state = leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
    if self.manual_touch_state ~= nil and
        lua_helper.type_compare(self.manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
      self.manual_touch_state:RequestDisableControl(leader, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
    end

    coroutine.yield(nil)

    wait_for_sec(0.1) -- 이걸 대기해줘야 정상적으로 필드 UI가 세팅됨.

    -- Action 버튼은 점프로 변경
    self.action_button = field_ui_manager:GetUIByKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, leader)
    self.action_button.OverridenButtonAction = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Jump -- 적이 근처에 있을 경우 CustomAttack으로 교체
  end

  character_util.set_active_state(self.change_leader_character , 'enabled')

  wait_for_sec(0.2) -- 리더 변경 후 액션UI가 정상 설정될 수 있도록 대기
  self:hide_ui_setting()

  camera_util.move_async(self.center_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })
  camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(self.config.camera_size, 0)
  --
  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.intro
  player_controller:play_intro()
end

--- 게임 성공 실패 연출용
function local_class:game_end(is_success, data)

  self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.game_clear

  --여기서 판별을 하지 않아 파라매터 무시
  --screen_util.fade_out_circular(0, 'linear')

  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

  start_coroutine(
      function()

        character_util.set_active_state(self.change_leader_character , 'disabled')
        character_util.set_active_state(self.origin_leader , 'enabled')

        self.manual_touch_state:RemoveDisableControl(self.change_leader_character)

        local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
        character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.origin_leader , param, true)

        self.action_button.OverridenButtonAction = nil

        ui_quest_marker:Show(true)
        stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
        field_ui_manager:Show()
        party_util.reset_controllers()
        wait_for_sec(0.1)
        camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 0)
        camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

        message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))

      end, self)

end

--- 게임 초기화
function local_class:reset()
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
  message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
end

function local_class:hide_ui_setting()
  ui_quest_marker:Show(false)

  -- 미니맵 네비게이션바 제거
  stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

  if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
    CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
  end

  self.minigame_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)

  local hide_ui_type = CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad
      | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton

  if not CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC then
    hide_ui_type = hide_ui_type | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton
  end

  field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(hide_ui_type)

function local_class:game_ui_setting()

  if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
    CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
  end

  -- Dpad와 Action 버튼은 활성화
  field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)


  self.minigame_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

return local_class

local background_controller = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGameBgController')

function background_controller:init(_)
  self.controller = nil
  self.bg_center = nil
  self.res_holder = nil

  -- 배경 프리팹 담음 테이블
  self.bg_map_pools = {}
  self.bg_reset_pos = {}
  self.bg_data = nil

  self.bg_scroll_dir = 'left'
  self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = nil
  self.cur_speed = 10
  self.mid_idx = 0
  self.pause = false
  self.time_scale = 1
end

function background_controller:setting_background(controller)
  self.controller = controller

  self.bg_data = self.controller.constants_data['background_data']

  local bg_offset = vector(0, 0, -3)

  self.bg_center = self.controller.center_pos + bg_offset
  self.cur_speed = 0
  self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(self.bg_scroll_dir)

  self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

  for i = 1, #self.bg_data do
    self.bg_map_pools[i] = {}

    local mid_idx = 2

    local gap = self.bg_scroll_dir_vec * self.bg_data[i].size

    for j = 1, 3 do
      local idx_from_mid = mid_idx - j
      local pos = self.bg_center + (gap * idx_from_mid)

      yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
          self.res_holder, self.bg_data[i].asset_path, self.bg_data[i].asset_name, function(prefab)
            local bg_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
            bg_pool.transform.localPosition = pos

            table.insert(self.bg_map_pools[i], bg_pool)
          end)
    end

    self.bg_reset_pos[i] = self.controller.center_pos.x + gap.x
  end

end

local target_offset = nil
local local_is_horizontal = false
local async_duration = 0
local time_passed = 0
local has_async = false
function background_controller:move_to_async(pos, is_horizontal, duration)
  target_offset = pos
  local_is_horizontal = is_horizontal
  async_duration = duration
  time_passed = 0
  has_async = true
end

function background_controller:scrolling(dt)

  for i = 1, #self.bg_data do

    local bg_data = self.bg_data[i]
    local speed = 0

    if bg_data.is_auto_move then
      speed = bg_data.speed
      if bg_data.is_apply_player then
        speed = speed + self.cur_speed
      end
    end

    speed = speed * self.time_scale

    background_scroller_util.update_by_frame(self.bg_map_pools[i], bg_data.size,
        self.bg_reset_pos[i], speed ,  self.bg_scroll_dir, dt)
  end

  if has_async then
    if async_duration == 0 then
      self:move_to(target_offset, local_is_horizontal)
      has_async = false
    elseif time_passed <= async_duration then
      local progress = math.min(time_passed / async_duration, 1.0)
      local prev_progress = math.max(0, (time_passed - dt) / async_duration)
      local delta_progress = progress - prev_progress
      local move_step = target_offset * delta_progress
      self:move_to(move_step, local_is_horizontal)
      time_passed = time_passed + dt
    else
      target_offset = nil
      local_is_horizontal = false
      async_duration = 0
      time_passed = 0
      has_async = false
    end
  end

  self:apply_train_physics(dt)
end

function background_controller:set_timescale(time_scale)
  self.time_scale = time_scale
end

function background_controller:move_to(pos, is_horizontal)
  for i = 1, #self.bg_data do
    if is_horizontal then
      self.bg_reset_pos[i] = self.bg_reset_pos[i] + pos.x
    else
      self.bg_reset_pos[i] = self.bg_reset_pos[i] + pos.z
    end
    local bg_data = self.bg_data[i]

    for j = 1, # self.bg_map_pools[i] do
      if not bg_data.is_apply_player then
        self.bg_map_pools[i][j].transform.localPosition = self.bg_map_pools[i][j].transform.localPosition + pos
      end
    end
  end
end

function background_controller:reset()
  for i = 1, #self.bg_data do
    local mid_idx = 2

    local gap = self.bg_scroll_dir_vec * ( self.bg_data[i].size - 0.01)

    for j = 1, #self.bg_map_pools[i] do
      local idx_from_mid = mid_idx - j
      local pos = self.bg_center + (gap * idx_from_mid )

      self.bg_map_pools[i][j].transform.localPosition = pos
    end

    self.bg_reset_pos[i] = self.controller.center_pos.x + gap.x * 1.5
  end
end

function background_controller:set_speed(speed)
  self.cur_speed = speed
end

function background_controller:dispose()
  self:dispose_bg_pool()

  self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = nil
  self.res_holder = nil
end

function background_controller:dispose_bg_pool()
  if self.bg_map_pools == nil then
    return false
  end

  for i = 1, #self.bg_map_pools do
    for j =1, #self.bg_map_pools[i] do
      CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.bg_map_pools[i][j])
    end
  end

  self.bg_map_pools = nil
end

local pos = 0       -- 현재 Y축 오프셋
local vel = 0       -- 현재 이동 속도 (관성)
local stiffness = 50 -- 탄성 (얼마나 강하게 당기는지)
local damping = 8    -- 감쇠 (얼마나 빨리 멈추는지)
local next_shake = 0
local frequency = 1

function background_controller:apply_train_physics(dt)
  local clamped_dt = math.min(dt, 0.05) -- 0.05초(20fps) 이상으로는 계산하지 않음
  -- 1. 충격 발생 시 초기 속도 부여
  local impulse = 0
  if unity_class.time.time >= next_shake then
    impulse = 1 -- 순간적인 힘 (값을 조절해 세기 조정)
    next_shake = unity_class.time.time + frequency
    camera_util.shake(0.02, 0.5)
  end
  -- 2. 스프링 물리 계산 (F = -kx - cv)
  -- pos: 현재 위치, vel: 현재 속도
  local force = (-stiffness * pos) - (damping * vel)

  vel = vel + (force * clamped_dt) - impulse --배경은 위가 아니라 아래로 움직여야 됨.
  pos = pos + (vel * clamped_dt) * self.time_scale
  local originalY = 0.1 -- 기본 높이값

  for i = 1, #self.bg_map_pools do
    for j = 1, # self.bg_map_pools[i] do
        self.bg_map_pools[i][j].transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_x0z(self.bg_map_pools[i][j].transform.localPosition, pos + originalY)
    end
  end
end

return {
  create = function()
    return background_controller()
  end
}

function train_platform:init(player_controller, train_kind, train_data)

function train_platform:load_async()
  yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
      self.player_controller.res_holder, self.train_data.asset_path, self.train_data.asset_name, function(prefab)
        self.game_object = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
        self.game_object.transform.localPosition = reset_pos_val
      end)

function train_platform:dispose()

  end
  self.game_object = nil
  self.is_using = false
end

function train_platform:set_position(pos)
  self.game_object.transform.localPosition = pos
  self.is_using = true
end

function train_platform:get_position()
  return self.game_object.transform.localPosition
end

function train_platform:is_in_screen(center_pos, half_screen_size)
  local size_x = half_screen_size.x + self.train_data.size

  -- 왼쪽으로 벗어난 경우 체크
  if self.game_object.transform.localPosition.x < center_pos.x - size_x then
    return false
  end
  return true
end

function train_platform:is_on_train(pos)

  if pos.x > self:get_min_x()
  and pos.x < self:get_max_x() then
    return true
  end

  return false

end

function train_platform:get_min_x()
  return self.game_object.transform.localPosition.x -  self.train_data.size/2 - 0.2
end

function train_platform:get_max_x()
  return self.game_object.transform.localPosition.x +  self.train_data.size/2 + 0.3
end

function train_platform:reset_pos()
  self.game_object.transform.localPosition = reset_pos_val
  self.is_using = false
end

  stage.ProjectileManager:ClearProjectiles()

function player_controller:set_train(from, to)
  if from + to - 1 > #self.sequence_data then
    if from > #self.sequence_data then return end
    to = #self.sequence_data - from
  end

  local index = 1
  local last_train = self.current_train_queue:last()
  local pos = reset_pos

  for i = from, #self.sequence_data do

    local sequence_data = self.sequence_data[i]

    local new_train = self.reuse_train_multi_queue[sequence_data.train_kind]:pop()

    if new_train == nil then
      return
    end

    new_train.is_missile_attack = false

    local gap = direction_util.to_vector3('right') * (new_train.train_data.size + self.train_data.train_distance)

    if last_train ~= nil then
      gap = direction_util.to_vector3('right') * (last_train.train_data.size + self.train_data.train_distance)
      pos = last_train:get_position() + (gap * (index))
    else
      pos = self.controller.center_pos + self.train_pos_offset + (gap * (index - 1))
    end

    new_train:set_position(pos)
    self.current_train_queue:push(new_train)
    index = index + 1
    self.sequence_set_index = self.sequence_set_index + 1

    if sequence_data.enemy_sequence_info ~= nil then
      enemy_controller:set_enemy(new_train, sequence_data.enemy_sequence_info)
    end

    if sequence_data.coin_sequence_info ~= nil then
      purple_coin_controller:set_coins(new_train, sequence_data.coin_sequence_info)
    end

    if sequence_data.is_missile_attack ~= nil then
      new_train.is_missile_attack = sequence_data.is_missile_attack
      if sequence_data.missile_height then
        new_train.missile_height = sequence_data.missile_height
      else
        new_train.missile_height = 0.2
      end
    end

    if index >= to then
      break
    end
  end
end

local alpha_check = 0

function player_controller:check_immortal_state(dt)
  if self.is_immortal then
    self.cur_immortal_time = self.cur_immortal_time + dt

    if self.cur_immortal_state == self.immortal_state.attacking then

      if self.cur_immortal_time >= self.player_spec.immortal_attack_time then
        character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'idle' })
        self.is_immortal = false
        self.cur_immortal_state = self.immortal_state.recovery
        character_util.remove_spine_pulse_color(self.character, 'immortal', 0)
        self.is_immortal_attack_pulse = false
      end
    else
      if self.cur_immortal_time >= self.immortal_state_change_time and
          self.cur_immortal_state == self.immortal_state.hurt then
        self.cur_immortal_state = self.immortal_state.recovery
        character_util.remove_emotion(self.character)
      end

      if self.cur_immortal_time >= self.player_spec.immortal_time then
        self.is_immortal = false
        character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.character, 1, 0)
        alpha_check = 0
      else
        -- 전체 주기(0.4초) 중 현재 어디쯤 위치해 있는지 계산 (0.0 ~ 0.4 소수점 왕복)
        local current_cycle = self.cur_immortal_time % 0.4

        -- 앞의 0.2초 동안은 0.5, 뒤의 0.2초 동안은 0.9
        local alpha = (current_cycle < 0.2) and 0.5 or 0.9

        if alpha_check ~= alpha then
          character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.character, alpha, 0)
          alpha_check = alpha
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

function player_controller:damaged_event(damage_val, move_factor)

  local is_falling = move_factor == nil
  if self.is_immortal and is_falling then
    return false
  end

  if self.is_immortal_attack_pulse then
    return false
  end

  self.is_immortal = true
  self.cur_immortal_time = 0
  self.cur_immortal_state = self.immortal_state.hurt

  local damage = damage_val

  if damage == nil then
    damage = 1
  end

  self:set_damage(damage)

  if not is_falling then
    local effect_pos = self.character.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
    self.effect_name_list['hit']():Instantiate(effect_pos)
    self.effect_name_list['last_hit']():Instantiate(effect_pos)

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
    character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'damaged' })
    character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.character)
    character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.character)
    character_util.shake(self.character, 0.03, 0.3)

    --이 경우만 직접 리셋
    if self.user_hp <= 0 then
      self:game_over()
      return
    end
  end

  character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.character, 0.5, 0)

  if not is_falling then
    start_coroutine(self.damaged_motion_async, self, move_factor)
  end

  return true
end

function player_controller:collision_damaged_event(enemy)

  if self.is_immortal or self.is_knock_back or  self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.reviving then return end

  self:stop_dash_sfx()

  self.is_knock_back = true

  self.current_running_state = self.running_state.none
  self.horizontalVel = 0
  self.moveInput = 0

  if not self.is_immortal then
    self:set_damage(1)

    self.is_immortal = true
    self.cur_immortal_time = 0
    self.cur_immortal_state = self.immortal_state.hurt
  end

  character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'damaged' })
  character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.character)
  character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.character)

  --이 경우만 직접 리셋
  if self.user_hp <= 0 then
    self:game_over()
    return
  end

  character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.character, 0.5, 0)

  local move_factor = -1
  if enemy.character.Position.x < self.character.Position.x then
    move_factor = 1
  end

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_knockback_wall_01')
  start_coroutine(self.damaged_motion_async, self, move_factor)

  return true
end

function player_controller:damaged_motion_async(move_factor)

  self.is_knock_back = true

  character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'damaged' })

  local movePos = self.character.Position + vector(self.player_spec.knock_back_move_val,0,0) * move_factor

  --넉백 거리가 중심을 벗어날 경우 만큼 카메라 보정
  if movePos.x > self.controller.center_pos.x then
    self.controller.center_pos = self.controller.center_pos + vector(self.player_spec.knock_back_move_val,0,0) * move_factor
    self.camera_pos = self.camera_pos + vector(self.player_spec.knock_back_move_val,0,0) * move_factor
    camera_util.move(self.camera_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })
  elseif movePos.x < self.controller.center_pos.x - self.camera_screen_size.x then
    movePos = vector_util.get_0yz(movePos, self.controller.center_pos.x - self.camera_screen_size.x + 0.01)
  end

  character_util.move_to_async(self.character, movePos,0.5, nil, false, false)

  character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'twohand_idle' })
  self.is_knock_back = false
end

  self:check_immortal_state(dt)

    self:apply_train_horn(dt)

function player_controller:action_input_processing(e)
  if self.is_pause then
    return false
  end

  if self.cur_jump_cool_time > 0 or is_attacking then
    return false
  end

  if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
    --if is_attack_mode then
    --  self:attack_input()
    --else

      -- 액션 버튼 누를 시 점프 상태로 변경
      self.is_jump_pressed = true
      self.is_a_button_pressed = true
    --end
    return true
  elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchUp then
    self.is_jump_pressed = false
    self.is_a_button_pressed = false
    return true
  end

  if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown then
    self:attack_input()
    return true
  end

  return false
end

function player_controller:joy_stick_input_processing(e)
  if self.is_pause then
    return false
  end

  if self.is_attacking then
    self.horizontalVel = 0
    self.moveInput = 0
    return false
  end
  if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
    if e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
      self.moveInput = -1
      return true
    elseif e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
      self.moveInput = 1
      return true
    end
  elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickNeutral) then
    self.moveInput = 0
    return true
  end
  return false
end

function player_controller:attack_input()

  if self.controller.cur_game_state ~= self.controller.game_state.playing then
    return
  end

  if self.is_attacking or self.current_jump_state ~= self.jump_state.none then
    return
  end
  self:stop_dash_sfx()
  self.is_attacking = true
  start_coroutine(self.attack_motion, self)
end

function player_controller:attack_motion()

  local cur_immortal_time = self.cur_immortal_time
  self.cur_immortal_time = 0
  if not self.is_immortal_attack_pulse then
    --self.is_immortal_attack_pulse = true
    --character_util.spine_pulse_color_with_name(self.character, 'immortal', unity_class.color.yellow, 300, 0.5,  100, 0.5)
  end

  local targets = enemy_controller:get_attackable_enemies(self.character, self.player_spec.attack_range)

  self.current_running_state = self.running_state.idle
  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
  character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'twohand_attack',  loop = false, scale = 2 })
  character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'attack' })

  enemy_controller:set_attacked_cutscene(targets)

  wait_for_sec(0.2)
  if #targets > 0 then
    camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
    self.is_immortal = true
    self.cur_immortal_state = self.immortal_state.attacking
    character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'mad' })
    character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.character, 1, 0)
  else
    self.cur_immortal_time = cur_immortal_time
    character_util.remove_spine_pulse_color(self.character, 'immortal', 0)
    self.is_immortal_attack_pulse = false
    character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'idle' })
  end

  wait_for_sec(0.2)

  character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'twohand_idle'})


  self.is_attacking = false
end

local frequency = 1
local next_train_horn = 0
