function player_controller:apply_jump_physics(dt, is_jump_pressed)
  local clamped_dt = math.min(dt, 0.05) -- 0.05초(20fps) 이상으로는 계산하지 않음

  if self.is_attacking or self.is_knock_back then
    return
  end

  if not is_jump_pressed then
    self.is_jump = false
  end
  -- 1. 땅에 닿아 있을 때
  if  self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.none then
    self.verticalVel = 0
    if is_jump_pressed and not self.is_jump then
      self.verticalVel = self.player_spec.jump_force
      self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.jump
      self.is_jump = true
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
      character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'get' })
    end
  else
    -- 2. 공중일 때: 중력 적용
    self.verticalVel = self.verticalVel + (self.player_spec.gravity * clamped_dt)

    if self.verticalVel < self.player_spec.gravity then
      self.verticalVel = self.player_spec.gravity
    end

    if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.free_fall then
      self.verticalVel = self.player_spec.gravity * 0.1

    end

    -- 3. 가변 점프 (버튼을 일찍 떼면 상승 속도 감소)
    if not is_jump_pressed and self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.jump and self.verticalVel > 0 then
      self.verticalVel = self.verticalVel * 0.5
    end
  end

  if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.reviving and self.verticalVel < 0 then
    self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.jump
    character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'idle' })
  end

  -- 위치 업데이트 (z축 이동)

  local movement =  vector(0, 0, self.verticalVel * clamped_dt)
  local pos = self.character.Position + movement

  if pos.z > self.maximum_z_val then
    pos.z = self.maximum_z_val

    movement = pos - self.character.Position
  end

  self.character.Position = pos

  if self.character.Position.z - self.controller.center_pos.z > self.camera_screen_size.y then
    self.camera_pos = self.camera_pos + movement
  else
    self.camera_pos = self.controller.center_pos
  end

  if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.free_fall then
    if self.character.Position.z < self.controller.center_pos.z -  4 then
      self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.none
      self:player_revive()
    end
  end
end

function player_controller:player_revive()

  self:damaged_event(self.falling_damage)

  if self.user_hp <= 0 then
    self:game_over()
    return
  end

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
  character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'get' })
  self.verticalVel = self.player_spec.gravity * -0.6

  self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.reviving
  character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'attack' })
end

function player_controller:collision_stamping_event(enemy)

  if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.reviving then return end

  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
  character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'get' })

  self.character.Position = vector_util.get_xy0(self.character.Position, enemy.character.Bounds.max.z + 1)

  self.verticalVel = self.player_spec.gravity * -0.2

  self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.jump
end




function player_controller:apply_horizontal_movement(dt, move_input)
  if self.is_attacking or self.is_knock_back then
    return
  end

  self:check_player_falling()

  -- 1. 지면/공중 여부에 따른 기본 가속도
  local currentAccel = self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.none and self.player_spec.acceleration or (self.player_spec.acceleration * 2)

  -- 2. 방향 전환 판별: 입력과 현재 속도 방향이 다르면 마찰력 배율 증가
  local isTurning = (move_input > 0 and self.horizontalVel < 0) or (move_input < 0 and self.horizontalVel > 0)
  local activeFriction = isTurning and (self.player_spec.friction * 2) or self.player_spec.friction

  -- 3. 가속 및 감속 통합 로직
  if move_input ~= 0 then
    -- 입력 방향과 속도 방향이 다르면(방향 전환) 마찰력을 적용해 속도를 먼저 깎음
    if isTurning then
      self.horizontalVel = unity_class.mathf.MoveTowards ( self.horizontalVel, 0, activeFriction * dt)
    end

    -- 이동 가속 적용
    self.horizontalVel = self.horizontalVel + (move_input * currentAccel * dt)
  else
    -- 입력이 없으면 기본 마찰로 멈춤
    self.horizontalVel = unity_class.mathf.MoveTowards(self.horizontalVel, 0, self.player_spec.friction * dt)
  end

  -- 4. 최대 속도 제한
  local current_speed = math.abs(self.horizontalVel)
  if current_speed > self.player_spec.move_speed then
    self.horizontalVel = (self.horizontalVel > 0 and 1 or -1) *  self.player_spec.move_speed
  end

  if self.horizontalVel > 0 and self.current_direction ~= direction_constants['right'] then
    self.current_direction = direction_constants['right']
    character_util.set_direction(self.character, self.current_direction)
  elseif self.horizontalVel < 0  and self.current_direction ~= direction_constants['left'] then
    self.current_direction = direction_constants['left']
    character_util.set_direction(self.character, self.current_direction)
  end

  if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.none then
    if current_speed == 0 and self.current_running_state ~= self.running_state.idle then
      self.current_running_state = self.running_state.idle
      character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'twohand_idle' })
      self:stop_dash_sfx()
    elseif current_speed > 3  then
      if self.current_running_state ~= self.running_state.run then
        self.current_running_state = self.running_state.run
        character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'twohand_run' })
        self:play_dash_sfx()
      end

      if unity_class.time.time >= self.next_smoke_time then
        stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(self.character.Position + vector(0,0.1,0))
        self.next_smoke_time = unity_class.time.time + self.smoke_delay
      end
    elseif current_speed > 0 and self.current_running_state ~= self.running_state.walk then
      self.current_running_state = self.running_state.walk
      character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'twohand_walk' })
    end
  else
    self.current_running_state = self.running_state.none

    self:stop_dash_sfx()
  end

  -- 5. 위치 업데이트
  local movement = vector ( self.horizontalVel * dt, 0, 0)
  local next_pos = self.character.Position + movement

  if next_pos.x > self.controller.center_pos.x - self.camera_screen_size.x then
    self.character.Position = next_pos
    --전체적으로 움직인다.
    if next_pos.x > self.controller.center_pos.x then
      self.controller.center_pos = self.controller.center_pos + movement
      self.camera_pos = self.camera_pos + movement
      background_controller:move_to(movement, true)
    end
    background_controller:set_speed ( self.horizontalVel * dt)
  end


  self:refresh_train_platform()
end

function player_controller:check_player_falling()

  if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.reviving  then
    return
  end

  if self.character.Position.z <= self.ground_z_val  and self.current_jump_state ~= self.jump_state.free_fall then

    local isfalling = true
    for train in self.current_train_queue:iterate() do
      if train:is_on_train(self.character.Position) then
        self.current_train = train
        self:end_game_check(self.current_train_queue:get_real_index(train))
        isfalling = false
        break
      end
    end

    if not isfalling then
      self.character.Position = vector_util.get_xy0(self.character.Position, self.ground_z_val)
      self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.none
    else
      self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.free_fall
      character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'embarrassed' })
      character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'surprise' })
      music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
    end
  end
end

function player_controller:end_game_check(index)
  if self.sequence_data[index].is_finish_line then
    self:play_end_game(index)
  end
end

function player_controller:missile_update_motion(missile, time_passed, dt)

  local target_pos = missile.target_pos
  local current_pos = missile.current_pos

  local particle_system = missile.particle_system

  -- 1. 목표 방향 계산
  local target_dir = vector_util.normalized(target_pos - current_pos)


  -- 2. [곡선 핵심] 관성을 이용한 부드러운 방향 전환
  if time_passed > missile.lerp_timer then

    -- 목표 방향에 사인 파 오프셋을 더함
    --local steer_dir = vector_util.normalized(target_dir + vector(0, s_curve, 0))
    --missile_velocity = vector_util.lerp(missile_velocity, steer_dir * missile_speed, dt * turn_speed)

    if missile.initial_offset.z > 0.5 then
      local t = time_passed * 0.5
      local ease_t = t * t * t  -- 3차 함수(Cubic)를 사용하면 가속 곡선이 만들어집니다.
      missile.missile_velocity = vector_util.lerp(missile.missile_velocity, target_dir * missile.missile_speed, dt * missile.turn_speed * ease_t)
    else
      missile.missile_velocity = vector_util.lerp(missile.missile_velocity, target_dir * missile.missile_speed, dt * missile.turn_speed)
    end
  end

  -- 3. 회전 적용 (현재 속도 방향을 바라보도록)
  local dir = vector_util.normalized( missile.missile_velocity)

  local safe_x = (math.abs(dir.x) < 0.001) and 0.001 or math.abs(dir.x)
  local pitch = - math.atan(dir.z, safe_x) * 180 / math.pi

  if dir.x > 0 then
    pitch = 180 - pitch
  end

  local yaw = -math.atan(dir.y, math.abs(dir.x)) * 180 / math.pi * 0.2
  local roll = time_passed * 100

  local target_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Slerp(missile.prefab.transform.localRotation, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45,0, pitch + 90), 6 * dt)--unity_class.quaternion.Euler(roll, yaw, pitch) * missile_rot
  missile.prefab.transform.localRotation = target_rot

  -- 4. 이동 (속도 벡터를 그대로 적용)
  local scaling = self.time_scale

  if missile.missile_speed_offset then
    scaling = scaling * missile.missile_speed_offset
  end

  missile.current_pos = current_pos + (missile.missile_velocity * dt) * scaling
  missile.prefab.transform.localPosition = vector(current_pos.x, missile.prefab.transform.localPosition.y, current_pos.z)

  -- 5. 스케일 보정
  --local scale_factor = 0.8 + (current_pos.y * 0.2)
  --missile.prefab.transform.localScale =  unity_class.vector3.one * scale_factor


  local parent = missile.prefab.transform.parent
  missile.prefab.transform:SetParent(nil)
  missile.prefab.transform:SetParent(parent)

  --particle_system:Simulate(time_passed, true, true)
end

function player_controller:missile_move(dt)
  for i = 1, #self.enemy_small_missile do

    local small_missile = self.enemy_small_missile[i]
    if small_missile.is_launch then
      self:missile_update_motion(small_missile, small_missile.missile_timer, dt)
      self.enemy_small_missile[i].missile_timer =   self.enemy_small_missile[i].missile_timer + dt
    end
  end
end

function player_controller:check_collision_bounds(bounds1, bounds2)
  local x_overlap = bounds2.min.x <= bounds1.max.x and bounds2.max.x >= bounds1.min.x
  local z_overlap = bounds2.min.z <= bounds1.max.z and bounds2.max.z >= bounds1.min.z

  return x_overlap and z_overlap
end

local warning_timer = 0
local warning_time = 1.5
local is_show_warning_sign = false

function player_controller:missile_attack()

  if self.is_missile_attack then
    return
  end

  if self.current_train ~= nil and self.current_train.is_missile_attack then
    self.is_missile_attack = true
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03')

    local start_pos = vector( self.camera_pos.x + self.camera_screen_size.x + warning_time * self.missile_speed,  self.character_start_pos.y + 0.6, self.ground_z_val + self.current_train.missile_height)

    warning_timer = 0
    is_show_warning_sign = true
    self.warning_sign.transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_0yz(start_pos, self.camera_pos.x + self.camera_screen_size.x - 0.5)

    for i = 1, #self.enemy_small_missile do
      local missile = self.enemy_small_missile[i]
      missile.prefab.transform.localPosition = start_pos + (i - 1) * vector(self.current_train.missile_gap,0,0)
    end
  end
end

function player_controller:missile_attack_update_frame(dt)

  self:missile_attack()

  if self.is_missile_attack then



    local screen_states = {
      out_screen = 1,
      in_screen = 2,
      not_yet = 3,
    }
    local function is_in_screen(pos)
      local size_x = self.camera_screen_size.x

      -- 왼쪽으로 벗어난 경우 체크
      if pos.x < self.camera_pos.x - self.camera_screen_size.x - 4 then
        return screen_states.out_screen
      end

      if pos.x > self.camera_pos.x + self.camera_screen_size.x + 2 then
        return screen_states.not_yet
      end

      return  screen_states.in_screen
    end

    for i = 1, #self.enemy_small_missile do
      local missile = self.enemy_small_missile[i]
      missile.prefab.transform.localPosition = missile.prefab.transform.localPosition - vector(dt * self.missile_speed, 0,0)

      if missile.prefab.activeSelf and self:check_collision_bounds(self.character.Bounds, missile.hit_box.bounds) then
        if not self.is_immortal and not self.is_knock_back and self.current_jump_state ~= self.jump_state.reviving then
          music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
          self.effect_name_list['missile_explosion']():Instantiate(missile.prefab.transform.localPosition)
          --missile.prefab.transform.localPosition = reset_pos_val
          missile.prefab:SetActive(false)
          local dir_factor = 1
          if missile.hit_box.bounds.center.x > self.character.Bounds.center.x then
            dir_factor = -1
          end
          self:damaged_event(self.missile_damage, dir_factor)
        end
      else
        local screen_state =  is_in_screen(missile.prefab.transform.localPosition)

        if screen_state == screen_states.out_screen then
          missile.prefab.transform.localPosition = reset_pos_val
        elseif screen_state == screen_states.in_screen then
          is_show_warning_sign = false
          self.warning_sign.transform.localPosition = reset_pos_val
        else
          if is_show_warning_sign then
            self.warning_sign.transform.localPosition = vector_util.get_0yz(self.warning_sign.transform.localPosition, self.camera_pos.x + self.camera_screen_size.x - 0.5)
          end
        end
      end
    end

    --마지막 미사일이 화면 밖으로 나가면!
    if self.enemy_small_missile[3].prefab.transform.localPosition == reset_pos_val then
      self:reset_missile()
    end
  end
end

return {
  create = function()
    return player_controller()
  end
}

local purple_coin_controller = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGamePurpleCoinController')

function purple_coin_controller:init(controller)

function purple_coin_controller:setting_coins(player_controller, enemy_controller)
  self.player_controller = player_controller
  self.enemy_controller = enemy_controller

  self.purple_coins = {}

      -- 퍼플 코인 그림자 제거

    end

  end

  --private set인 shadow에 접근하기 위해
  xlua.private_accessible(typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceBehaviour))
  self.star_piece_name = config.star_piece_name
  self.star_piece =  get_field_object(config.star_piece_name)

  if self.star_piece then
    if self.star_piece.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
      self.star_piece.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
      self.star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.shadow.gameObject:SetActive(false)
    end
  end
end

function purple_coin_controller:dispose()
  self:remove_all_coins()
  self.purple_coins = nil
end

function purple_coin_controller:set_coins(train, coin_sequence_info)

  for i = 1, #coin_sequence_info do

    local coin_info = coin_sequence_info[i]

    local purple_coin = self.purple_coins[coin_info.index]

    if purple_coin then
      purple_coin.Position =  vector(train:get_position().x + coin_info.x, 0.1, self.player_controller.ground_z_val + coin_info.z)
    end
  end
end

function purple_coin_controller:check_collision(player)

  for i = 1, #self.purple_coins do
    local purple_coin = self.purple_coins[i]

    if purple_coin ~= nil and purple_coin.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and self:check_collision_bounds(player.Bounds, purple_coin.Bounds) then
      message_system:SendSync(
          purple_coin.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(player))
    end
  end

  if self.star_piece ~= nil and self.star_piece.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and self:check_collision_bounds(player.Bounds, self.star_piece.Bounds) then
    self.enemy_controller:set_remove_stars()
    message_system:SendSync(
        self.star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(player))
  end
end

function purple_coin_controller:check_collision_bounds(bounds1, bounds2)
  local x_overlap = bounds2.min.x <= bounds1.max.x and bounds2.max.x >= bounds1.min.x
  local z_overlap = bounds2.min.z <= bounds1.max.z and bounds2.max.z >= bounds1.min.z

  return x_overlap and z_overlap
end

function purple_coin_controller:remove_all_coins()
  if self.purple_coins ~= nil then
    for i = 1, #self.purple_coins do

      self.purple_coins[i].Position = vector(999,0, 999)
    end
  end

  if self.star_piece then
    self.star_piece.Position = vector(999,0, 999)
  end
end

return {
  create = function()
    return purple_coin_controller()
  end
}

	self.jump_height = 6

	-- 착지 전 성공 시간 값 (널뛰기 점프 시간 / 값)
	-- ex) 값이 2라면 점프 시간의 절반이라 최고점부터 낙하까지 성공 시간
	self.success_time_value = 6

	-- 터치하지 않고 착지했을 때 바로 실패가 아니고 성공할 수 있도록 주는 추가 시간
	self.success_extra_time = 0.1

	-- 널뛰기 애니메이션 시간
	self.seesaw_anim_duration = 0.03

	-- 널뛰기 점프 이벤트 실행할 횟수(플레이어 점프)
	self.jumping_count = 10

	-- 널뛰기 점프 이벤트 때 튜토리얼(Tap 이벤트)을 보여줄 횟수
	self.tutorial_jumping_count = 2

	-- 널뛰기 점프 최소 시간
	self.jump_time_limit = 0.8

	-- 널뛰기 점프 감소 시간
	self.jump_time_reduction = 0.08

	--endregion

	-- 점프를 실패했는지
	self.jumping_fail = false

	-- 널뛰기가 끝났는지
	self.end_play_jumping = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'on_mini_game_start_event')

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
		self.jumping_effect_name,
		self.success_effect_name
	)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent))

	if self.touch_handler ~= nil then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end
end

-- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

-- MiniGameStartEvent
function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	-- 현재 널뛰기 점프 시간
	self.current_jump_duration = self.jump_duration

	self.jumping_fail = false
	self.end_play_jumping = false

	-- 널뛰기 시작 전 세팅
	local seesaw_gimmick = get_field_object(self.seesaw_gimmick_name)
	local seesaw_board = seesaw_gimmick.transform:Find(self.seesaw_board_name)
	seesaw_board.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, 11))

	local opponent = get_character(self.opponent_name)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	leader.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(seesaw_gimmick.Bounds.center) + vector(2, 0.3, -0.2)
	opponent.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(seesaw_gimmick.Bounds.center) + vector(-2, 1.1, -0.2)

	camera_util.move(
		vector_util.get_x0z(seesaw_gimmick.Bounds.center) + 2 * unity_class.vector3.forward, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--region 폭스 스테이지 시작 전 대사

	--발판에 닫기 직전에 점프하면 돼!
	character_util.set_anim(opponent, {name = 'cast2'})
	character_util.normal_double_jump(opponent, '01_small_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(opponent, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_4_2', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(opponent)

	-- 간다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(opponent, { key = 'fox_1_jumping_5', skip = true })

	--endregion

	-- 처음에 상대방이 약하게 뜀
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(opponent, 3, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	yield_return_func(self.seesaw_anim, self)

	local current_jumping_count = 1

	-- 널뛰기 지정 횟수만큼 널뛰기 이벤트 실행 (상대방 뛰는 것 때문에 * 2)
	while not self.end_play_jumping and current_jumping_count < self.jumping_count * 2 do

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')

		if current_jumping_count < self.tutorial_jumping_count * 2 then
			-- 튜토리얼 점프
			yield_return_func(self.play_jumping, self, true, false)
		else
			-- 튜토리얼 없는 점프
			yield_return_func(self.play_jumping, self, false, false)
		end

		yield_return_func(self.seesaw_anim, self)

		current_jumping_count = current_jumping_count + 1
		-- 널뛰기 속도 제한
		if self.current_jump_duration > self.jump_time_limit then
			self.current_jump_duration = self.current_jump_duration - self.jump_time_reduction
		end
	end

	-- 성공 후 연출용 널뛰기 점프
	if not self.jumping_fail then
		character_util.set_emotion(opponent, { name = 'smile' })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			for _ = 1, 3 do
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
				yield_return_func(self.play_jumping, self, false, true)

				yield_return_func(self.seesaw_anim, self)
			end
		end))
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.mini_game_name, not self.jumping_fail))
end

--- 널뛰기 이벤트
--- @param tutorial boolean 튜토리얼(Tap 이벤트)를 실행할 것인지
--- @param theater_jumping boolean 터치 이벤트 없이 연출용으로만 뛸 것인지
function local_class:play_jumping(tutorial, theater_jumping)
	local seesaw_gimmick_name = get_field_object(self.seesaw_gimmick_name)
	local seesaw_board = seesaw_gimmick_name.transform:Find(self.seesaw_board_name)

	local opponent = get_character(self.opponent_name)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local start_z = seesaw_board.transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.z
	if start_z > 180 then
		start_z = start_z - 360
	end

	-- 상대방이 점프할 타이밍
	if start_z > 0 then
		-- 상대방: 점프, 플레이어: 대기
		character_util.set_anim(opponent, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		yield_return_func(self.opponent_jump, self, opponent, self.jump_height, self.current_jump_duration)

		character_util.remove_anim(opponent)
		return
	end

	-- 상대방: 대기, 플레이어: 점프
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- Tap 터치
	local tap = false

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
				tap = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- Tap 이벤트를 실행했는지 (중복 방지)
	local is_tap_event = false

	-- Tap 이벤트를 보여주고 있는지
	local is_showing_turbo_tap = false

	-- 연출용이 아닐 때만 터치 이벤트 구독
	if not theater_jumping then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')
	end

	local smoke_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.jumping_effect_name)
	smoke_effect_pool:Instantiate(leader.Position)

	local success_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.success_effect_name)

	local spine_container_transform = leader.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform

	self.jumping_fail = false

	local time_passed = 0

	-- 플레이어 뛰는 연출 시작
	while time_passed < self.current_jump_duration do
		-- 실패했을 때 낙하 속도 조절
		if not self.jumping_fail then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		else
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.current_jump_duration
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / self.current_jump_duration)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * self.jump_height

		leader.SpineController.SpineOffset = cur_y * unity_class.vector3.up

		-- 실패했을 때 플레이어 회전하면서 낙하
		if self.jumping_fail then
			character_util.spine_rotate(user_party.Leader, 360 * 3,
				self.current_jump_duration - time_passed)
		end

		-- 현재 착지 전 성공 시간
		local current_success_time = self.current_jump_duration / self.success_time_value

		-- Tap UI가 나오는 시간이 좀 느려서 성공 타이밍보다 0.1초 더 빠르게 나오도록 함
		if tutorial and not self.jumping_fail and not is_showing_turbo_tap and not is_tap_event and
			self.current_jump_duration - time_passed < current_success_time + 0.1 then

			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)
			is_showing_turbo_tap = true
		end

		-- 터치했을 때 성공 타이밍인지 아닌지에 따른 처리
		if tap and not is_tap_event then
			message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

			is_tap_event = true

			if self.current_jump_duration - time_passed < current_success_time then
				-- 성공
				success_effect_pool:Instantiate(spine_container_transform.position + vector(0.1, -0.5, 0),
					unity_class.quaternion.identity, spine_container_transform)

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_enhance_light_01')
			else
				-- 실패
				self.jumping_fail = true
				character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
			end

			-- Tap 이벤트 종료
			if tutorial and is_showing_turbo_tap then
				is_showing_turbo_tap = false
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 플레이어 착지 후

	if tap and not is_tap_event then
		success_effect_pool:Instantiate(spine_container_transform.position + vector(0.1, -0.5, 0),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, spine_container_transform)
	end

	-- 연출용 점프가 아닌데 착지 되기 전까지 Tap하지 않았을 때
	if not tap and not theater_jumping then
		time_passed = 0

		-- 착지 후 주는 성공 추가 시간
		while time_passed < self.success_extra_time do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if tap then
				-- 추가 시간 안에 Tap하면 성공
				message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

				success_effect_pool:Instantiate(spine_container_transform.position + vector(0.1, -0.5, 0),
					unity_class.quaternion.identity, spine_container_transform)

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_enhance_light_01')
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 추가 시간 안에도 Tap을 하지 못 했다면 실패
		if not tap then
			self.jumping_fail = true
		end
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- Tap 이벤트 종료
	if tutorial and is_showing_turbo_tap then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 결과에 따른 처리
	if not self.jumping_fail then
		-- 성공
		smoke_effect_pool:Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0, -0.5, -0.2))
	else
		-- 실패
		self.end_play_jumping = true

		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')

		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	end
end

-- 널뛰기용 상대방 캐릭터 점프
function local_class:opponent_jump()
	local opponent = get_character(self.opponent_name)

	local smoke_effect_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.jumping_effect_name)
	smoke_effect_pool:Instantiate(opponent.Position)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < self.current_jump_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / self.current_jump_duration)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * self.jump_height

		opponent.SpineController.SpineOffset = cur_y * unity_class.vector3.up

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	smoke_effect_pool:Instantiate(opponent.Position + vector(0, -0.5, -0.2))
end

-- 널뛰기 기믹 애니메이션
function local_class:seesaw_anim()
	local seesaw_gimmick = get_field_object(self.seesaw_gimmick_name)
	local seesaw_board = seesaw_gimmick.transform:Find(self.seesaw_board_name)

	local opponent = get_character(self.opponent_name)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local start_z = seesaw_board.transform.localRotation.eulerAngles.z
	if start_z > 180 then
		start_z = start_z - 360
	end

	-- 널뛰기 각도에 따른 이동 처리 (상대방: 좌, 플레이어: 우)
	-- 널뛰기 초기 높이: 좌 > 우
	if start_z > 0 then
		-- 상대방: 하강, 플레이어: 상승
		character_util.move_to(opponent, vector_util.get_x0z(opponent.Position, 0.3), self.seesaw_anim_duration)
		character_util.move_to(leader, vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position, 1.1), self.seesaw_anim_duration)
	else
		-- 상대방: 상승, 플레이어: 하강
		character_util.move_to(opponent, vector_util.get_x0z(opponent.Position, 1.1), self.seesaw_anim_duration)
		character_util.move_to(leader, vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position, 0.3), self.seesaw_anim_duration)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_seesaw_01')

	-- 널뛰기 기믹 애니메이션 실행
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < self.seesaw_anim_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_z, start_z * -1, time_passed / self.seesaw_anim_duration)
		seesaw_board.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, cur_z))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('LeafletDistribution')

local npc_state_base = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCStateBase')
local npc_state = {
	appear = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCAppearState', npc_state_base),
	walk = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCWalkState', npc_state_base),
	talk = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCTalkState', npc_state_base),
	stop = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCStopState', npc_state_base),
	walk_with_paper = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCWalkWithPaperState', npc_state_base),
	disappear = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCDisappearState', npc_state_base),
	disappear_with_paper = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCDisappearWithPaperState', npc_state_base),
	crash_walk = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCCrashWalkState', npc_state_base),
	null = newclass('LeafletDistribution_NPCNullState', npc_state_base),
}

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.minigame_name = 'LeafletDistribution'
	self.constants_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 현재 미니게임 진행 상태
	self.game_state = {
		none = 0,
		loaded = 1,
		starting = 2,
		in_game = 3,
		ending = 4,
		disposing = 5,
	}
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	--region NPC
	-- key를 NPC로,
	-- value를 { type, state, start_pos, target_pos, speed, line_index }로 하는 테이블
	self.npc_infos = {}

	-- type으로 분할된 풀
	self.npcs_pool = {}

	-- type으로 분할된 spawn info.
	-- { time_passed, next_cooldown }
	self.npc_spawn_infos = {}

	-- 라인 별로 분할된 리스폰 포지션 정보
	-- 마계 악몽의 경우 "좌우 4개 + 상하 4개 = 라인 8개" 됨
	-- key는 direction, value는 { pos = { (vec), (vec) }, using }
	self.spawn_lines_infos = {}

	-- 사용중인 라인의 개수
	-- 사용 가능한 라인이 0개 남은 경우 랜덤하게 찾는 루틴을 아예 안돌게 막기 위함
	self.using_spawn_line_count = 0

	-- npc의 각 스테이트별 풀
	-- 새로 생성하거나 갖다쓰는 방식
	self.npc_state_pool = {
		appear = {},
		walk = {},
		talk = {},
		stop = {},
		walk_with_paper = {},
		disappear = {},
		disappear_with_paper = {},
		crash_walk = {},
		null = {},
	}

	--endregion

	-- 플레이어의 상태
	self.player_state = {
		none = 0, -- 기본
		screen_playing = 1, -- 연출 중
	}
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.none

	self.player_crash_cooldown = 0

	-- 점수 관련 변수 및 오브젝트
	self.score = 0
	self.target_score = 50
	self.score_ui_obj = nil
	self.score_ui_controller = nil
	self.resholder = nil

	-- 미니게임을 시도한 횟수
	self.play_count = 0
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_key = key
	self.constants_data = require(
			'minigame/LeafletDistribution/LeafletDistributionConstants')[self.constants_key]

	self.target_score = self.constants_data.target_score

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadStageTitle()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)

	local ui_info = self.constants_data.ui_info

	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, ui_info.asset_path, ui_info.asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.score_ui_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(
						stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				-- FIXME : 공용 클래스 생기면 변경되어야 함
				self.score_ui_controller = self.score_ui_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SteampunkLaborBoardMini))
				self.score_ui_controller:Init(0, self.target_score)
				self.score_ui_controller.Deactivated = true
			end)

	self:change_sprite()

	self:change_ui_title()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loaded

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	self:game_dispose()

	if self.npc_state_pool ~= nil then
		for type, _ in pairs(self.npc_state_pool) do
			for index, _ in pairs(self.npc_state_pool[type]) do
				local object = self.npc_state_pool[type][index]
				object:dispose()
			end
		end
		self.npc_state_pool = nil
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.score_ui_obj) == false then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.score_ui_obj)
	end
	self.score_ui_obj = nil
	self.score_ui_controller = nil

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end
	self.resholder = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
end

function local_class:game_start_routine()
	-- 로드가 안됐을 경우 대기함
	while self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.loaded do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.starting

	--region 세팅

	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.screen_playing

	-- NPC Pool, Infos, Spawn Infos 세팅
	self.npcs_pool = {}
	self.npc_infos = {}
	self.npc_spawn_infos = {}

	for type, info in pairs(self.constants_data.npc_type_info) do
		-- 한 번만 등장하는 type의 NPC 정보는 한 번 이상 플레이한 경우 추가하지 않도록 함
		if not (info.appear_once and self.play_count > 0) then
			local typical_npcs = {}

			for i = 1, info.count do
				local npc = get_character(info.name .. i)
				-- 물리 충돌 삭제
				npc.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

				table.insert(typical_npcs, npc)

				self.npc_infos[npc] = {
					type = type,
					speed = self.constants_data.npc_speed
				}

				-- 기본 스테이트 적용
				local null_state = self:create_npc_state('null', npc)
				self:change_npc_state(npc, null_state)
			end

			self.npcs_pool[type] = typical_npcs

			-- 리스폰 정보 채워넣기
			self.npc_spawn_infos[type] = {
				time_passed = 0,
				next_cooldown = random_util.get_random_value() * (info.first_spawn_delay.max - info.first_spawn_delay.min)
						+ info.first_spawn_delay.min
			}
		end
	end

	-- 스폰되는 라인 정보 저장
	-- NPC가 한 라인을 점유하면 해당 NPC가 사라지기 전까지 다른 NPC의 스폰을 막을 것임
	self.spawn_lines_infos = {}
	for _, line_info in pairs(self.constants_data.spawn_line_info.lines) do
		for i = 1, line_info.count do
			table.insert(self.spawn_lines_infos, {
				-- 라인의 양 끝점 저장 (랜덤하게 하나 뽑아서 어디서 나올지 결정할 것임)
				pos = {
					field                               :GetMarker(string.format(self.constants_data.spawn_line_info.marker_name_format,
							line_info.directions[1], i)).position,
					field                               :GetMarker(string.format(self.constants_data.spawn_line_info.marker_name_format,
							line_info.directions[2], i)).position,
				},
				using = false
			})
		end
	end

	self.using_spawn_line_count = 0

	-- 점수 초기화
	self:set_score(0)

	--리리스, 미니 게임 공간 중앙에 배치 되어 시작.
	stage_camera:SetTarget()
	party_util.position_party(field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.start_marker_name).position,
			'right', 'linear')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 카메라 이동 1프레임 더 기다림
	coroutine.yield()

	--endregion

	-- 게임 시작

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--홍보 시작, 스트링 문구 출력
	local activity_title = self.constants_data.ui_info.activity_title

	if activity_title == nil then
		activity_title = 'leaflet_distribution_minigame_1'
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(activity_title), 1.5)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 타이머 시작
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.constants_data.time_limit, handler = self,
			  callback = 'on_timer_alarm_event', show_ui = true })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', mix = 0, name = 'bgm_chasing' })

	self.score_ui_controller.Deactivated = false

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	self:player_screenplay_off()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_game
	self.play_count = self.play_count + 1

	-- 업데이트용 루틴 실행
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.update_routine, self))
end

-- 상호작용 연출 도중일 수 있기 때문에 끝날 때 까지 기다림
function local_class:wait_interact_done()
	while self.current_player_state == self.player_state.screen_playing do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 연출이 끝났을 때 목표 점수에 도달한 경우
	if self.score >= self.target_score then
		self:game_success()
	else
		self:game_failed()
	end
end

-- 실패
function local_class:game_failed()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 타이머 종료
	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	-- 실패 연출
	character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader(), true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	character_util.set_side_direction(get_party_leader())
	character_util.set_emotion(get_party_leader(), { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(get_party_leader(),
			{ name = 'dead', keep_anim = true, sfx = '01_hit_npc_01' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:game_dispose()

	character_util.remove_emotion(get_party_leader())
	character_util.remove_anim(get_party_leader())

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loaded

	-- 게임 실패를 브로드캐스팅함
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.minigame_name, false))
end

-- 성공
function local_class:game_success()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 타이머 종료
	timer_util.end_timer(self)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

	local game_success_stage_music = self.constants_data.game_success_stage_music
	if game_success_stage_music ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music(game_success_stage_music)
	else
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:game_dispose()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loaded

	-- 게임 성공을 브로드캐스팅함
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.minigame_name, true))
end

-- 게임 해제
-- 사용중인 스테이트 전부 풀에 되돌림
function local_class:game_dispose()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.disposing

	for type, npcs in pairs(self.npcs_pool) do
		for _, npc in pairs(npcs) do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
			npc.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end

	for npc, _ in pairs(self.npc_infos) do
		self.npc_infos[npc].state:exit()
		self.npc_infos[npc].state.using = false
	end

	if self.score_ui_controller ~= nil then
		self.score_ui_controller.Deactivated = true
	end
end

--region Subscribed Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game
			and self.current_player_state == self.player_state.none
			and self:npc_state_compare(e.Target, 'walk') then
		self:interact_reaction(e.Target)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_timer_alarm_event(e)
	if e.IsComplete and self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.ending
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.wait_interact_done, self))

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--region Main Logic

function local_class:update_routine()
	while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game or self.current_game_state == self.game_state.ending do
		local delta_time = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 리스폰 로직
		for type, _ in pairs(self.npc_spawn_infos) do
			local info = self.npc_spawn_infos[type]

			-- 쿨타임이 돌면 NPC 리스폰
			if info.time_passed > info.next_cooldown then
				local appear_line_index = self:find_appear_line_index()

				-- 어떤 상황에서든 못찾으면 다음 프레임에 계산하도록 추가적인 처리를 하지 않음
				if appear_line_index > 0 then
					local target_npc = self:get_pooled_npc(type)
					if target_npc ~= nil then
						local line_info = self.spawn_lines_infos[appear_line_index]
						local npc_info = self.npc_infos[target_npc]

						-- 양쪽 끝 시작 / 도착 지점 나누기
						local start_pos_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
						npc_info.start_pos = line_info.pos[start_pos_index]
						npc_info.target_pos = line_info.pos[3 - start_pos_index]
						npc_info.line_index = appear_line_index

						line_info.using = true
						self.using_spawn_line_count = self.using_spawn_line_count + 1

						-- 스타트 지점에서 등장하도록 스테이트 변경
						local next_state = self:create_npc_state('appear', target_npc,
								{ speed = self.constants_data.npc_speed,
								  start_pos = npc_info.start_pos, end_pos = npc_info.target_pos })
						self:change_npc_state(target_npc, next_state)

						-- 리스폰 쿨타임 다시 세팅
						local cooltime_info = self.constants_data.npc_type_info[type].spawn_cooltime
						info.time_passed = 0
						info.next_cooldown = cooltime_info.min + random_util.get_random_value()
								* (cooltime_info.max - cooltime_info.min)
					end
				end
			else
				info.time_passed = info.time_passed + delta_time
			end
		end

		-- npc 스테이트의 update를 돌림
		for npc, _ in pairs(self.npc_infos) do
			self.npc_infos[npc].state:update(delta_time)
		end

		-- 플레이어 충돌 쿨다운 돌림
		if self.player_crash_cooldown > 0 then
			self.player_crash_cooldown = self.player_crash_cooldown - delta_time
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:find_appear_line_index()
	-- 사용할 수 있는 라인 수가 남은 경우
	if self.using_spawn_line_count < #self.spawn_lines_infos then
		-- 계속 겹칠 수 있기 때문에 20번정도 돌려봄
		for loop_count = 1, 20 do
			local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.spawn_lines_infos)

			if self.spawn_lines_infos[random_index].using == false then
				return random_index
			end
		end
	end

	-- 여러번 돌렸는데도 못찾은 운나쁜 경우 -1을 반환함. (다음 프레임에 계산을 양도함)
	return -1
end

-- 사용된 라인 정보를 반환
function local_class:return_used_line(npc)
	local npc_info = self.npc_infos[npc]
	self.spawn_lines_infos[npc_info.line_index].using = false
	self.using_spawn_line_count = self.using_spawn_line_count - 1
end

-- 풀링된 npc 중 기본 상태인 (필드에 없는) 캐릭터를 뽑아 반환함
-- 없으면 nil을 반환하여 다음 프레임에 계산하도록 함
function local_class:get_pooled_npc(type)
	for _, npc in pairs(self.npcs_pool[type]) do
		if self:npc_state_compare(npc, 'null') then
			return npc
		end
	end

	-- FIXME : 풀링된 NPC의 개수가 너무 적으면 계속 nil을 반환할 수도 있음

	return nil
end

--endregion

--region Score Setting
function local_class:set_score(value)
	self.score = value
	self:refresh_score_ui()
end

-- value만큼 더해줌
function local_class:add_score(value)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_point_01')
	self.score = math.min(self.score + value, self.target_score)

	-- 목표 수치에 도달한 경우
	if self.score == self.target_score then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.ending
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_success, self))
	end

	self:refresh_score_ui()
end

-- ui 갱신
function local_class:refresh_score_ui()
	self.score_ui_controller:SetQuota(self.score, self.target_score)
end
--endregion

--region Interplay

function local_class:get_npc_type_info(npc)
	return self.constants_data.npc_type_info[self.npc_infos[npc].type]
end

--점수 제공 NPC 인터랙션 시 이벤트
function local_class:interact_reaction(npc)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'throw', loop = false, upper = true, remove_after = 0.3 })

	local item_info = self.constants_data.leaflet_item_info
	local item_target_pos = npc.Position + (leader.Position - npc.Position).normalized * 0.3

	--리리스, 전단지 아이템을 건네줌.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
	local paper_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = item_info.id, notforinven = true, sprscale = item_info.scale,
			  lootstate = 'FixLooter', pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0), target = item_target_pos })
	paper_item.ConsumeTarget = npc

	local npc_type_info = self:get_npc_type_info(npc)

	local reaction_infos = npc_type_info.reaction
	local reaction

	if #reaction_infos > 0 then
		reaction = reaction_infos[random_util.get_random_int(1, #reaction_infos)]
	end

	-- NPC 스테이트 Talk로 변경
	-- reaction == nil일 수 있음
	local next_state = self:create_npc_state('talk', npc, { reaction_info = reaction })
	self:change_npc_state(npc, next_state)

	-- 점수 추가
	self:add_score(npc_type_info.score_delta)

	-- 해당 연출 직후에 깡패들과 충돌하는 현상을 최대한 막기 위해 쿨타임 부여
	self.player_crash_cooldown = self.constants_data.player_hit_cooltime_after_interact
end

-- npc와 충돌이 일어난 경우, 상태 체크하여 연출 진행할지 여부 결정
function local_class:on_npc_crash(npc)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game and
			self.current_player_state == self.player_state.none and self.player_crash_cooldown <= 0 then
		local next_state = self:create_npc_state('stop', npc)
		self:change_npc_state(npc, next_state)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.crash_reaction, self, npc))
	end
end

-- 불량 npc와 충돌 시
function local_class:crash_reaction(npc)
	--플레이어, 조작 뺏기고 멈춤.
	self:player_screenplay_on()

	local npc_info = self.npc_infos[npc]
	local npc_type_info = self:get_npc_type_info(npc)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local leader_target_pos
	local away_look_dir
	local npc_move_diff

	-- 방향 및 이동 위치 지정
	if (npc.Direction & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		if npc.Position.z > leader.Position.z then
			away_look_dir = 'up'
			leader_target_pos = vector(leader.Position.x, 0, npc.Position.z - 1.2)
		else
			away_look_dir = 'down'
			leader_target_pos = vector(leader.Position.x, 0, npc.Position.z + 1.2)
		end

		if npc.Position.x > leader.Position.x then
			npc_move_diff = vector(1, 0, 0)
		else
			npc_move_diff = vector(-1, 0, 0)
		end
	else
		if npc.Position.x > leader.Position.x then
			away_look_dir = 'right'
			leader_target_pos = vector(npc.Position.x - 1.2, 0, leader.Position.z)
		else
			away_look_dir = 'left'
			leader_target_pos = vector(npc.Position.x + 1.2, 0, leader.Position.z)
		end

		if npc.Position.z > leader.Position.z then
			npc_move_diff = vector(0, 0, 1)
		else
			npc_move_diff = vector(0, 0, -1)
		end
	end

	--패널티 이벤트 진행 연출
	--방해 NPC 히트 박스와 플레이어가 충돌 시
	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)

	--방해 NPC, 플레이어를 바라봄.
	character_util.look_at(leader, npc)
	character_util.look_at(npc, leader)
	character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'attack' })

	-- Reaction 데이터를 넣지 않았다면 터질 것임
	local reaction_infos = npc_type_info.reaction

	local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #reaction_infos)

	local reaction = reaction_infos[random_index]

	if reaction.sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(reaction.sfx)
	end

	if reaction.anim ~= nil then
		character_util.set_anim(npc, reaction.anim)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc, { key = reaction.talk, skip = true })

	if reaction.anim ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_anim(npc, reaction.anim.upper)
	end

	npc.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	--이후 리리스, 해당 캐릭터가 지나가게 끔 뒤로 물러남.
	character_util.set_direction(leader, away_look_dir)

	-- 뒷걸음질할 거리가 충분할 때
	if (leader_target_pos - npc.Position).sqrMagnitude > (leader.Position - npc.Position).sqrMagnitude then
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader_target_pos,
				0.5, nil, false, true)
	else
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	--다시 조작 복구
	character_util.remove_emotion(npc)

	local next_state
	if (npc_info.target_pos - npc.Position).magnitude > 2 then
		-- NPC State Crash Walk로 변경
		local npc_type_info = self:get_npc_type_info(npc)
		next_state = self:create_npc_state('crash_walk', npc,
				{ end_pos = npc_info.target_pos, speed = npc_info.speed,
				  hitbox_size = vector(npc_type_info.hitbox_scale.x, 1, npc_type_info.hitbox_scale.z) })
	else
		-- 최종 목표 지점에 너무 가까이 있는 경우에는 사라지도록 함
		next_state = self:create_npc_state('disappear', npc,
				{ end_pos = npc_info.target_pos, speed = npc_info.speed })
	end

	self:change_npc_state(npc, next_state)

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
		self.current_player_state = self.player_state.none
		return
	end

	self:player_screenplay_off()
end

--endregion

--region Player State

-- 플레이어 상호작용 연출 시작
function local_class:player_screenplay_on()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.screen_playing
end

-- 플레이어 상호작용 연출 종료
function local_class:player_screenplay_off()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.none

	-- 다시 쿨타임 부여
	-- 연출 끝나고 불량 npc와 바로 충돌하지 않도록 함
	self.player_crash_cooldown = self.constants_data.player_hit_cooltime_after_screenplay
end

--endregion

--region NPC State

-- npc의 스테이트 변경
function local_class:change_npc_state(npc, state)
	local next_state = state

	local prev_state = self.npc_infos[npc].state

	if prev_state then
		prev_state:exit()
		-- 풀에 되돌림
		prev_state.using = false
	end

	next_state:enter()
	self.npc_infos[npc].state = next_state
end

-- 풀링된 npc 스테이트 가져와서 멤버 변수 세팅하여 반환
-- params는 Array가 아닌 Table 형태로 넣는 것을 권장
function local_class:create_npc_state(state_name, npc, params)
	local pooled_state = self:get_or_create_pooled_npc_state(state_name)

	pooled_state.fo = npc

	if params then
		for param_name, _ in pairs(params) do
			pooled_state[param_name] = params[param_name]
		end
	end

	return pooled_state
end

-- 풀링된 npc 스테이트들 중 사용중이지 않은 것을 뽑아서 반환
function local_class:get_or_create_pooled_npc_state(state_name)
	local target_pool = self.npc_state_pool[state_name]

	for index, _ in pairs(target_pool) do
		if target_pool[index].using == false then
			target_pool[index].using = true
			return target_pool[index]
		end
	end

	-- 만약 없다면 새로 하나 만들어서 풀에 넣고 반환함
	local new_state = npc_state[state_name](self)
	new_state.using = true
	table.insert(self.npc_state_pool[state_name], new_state)

	return new_state
end

-- npc의 스테이트 비교
function local_class:npc_state_compare(npc, state_name)
	local current_npc_state = self.npc_infos[npc].state
	return current_npc_state ~= nil and npc_state[state_name]:made(current_npc_state)
end

function npc_state.appear:init(controller)

	--- Constants

	--- Public Member
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.end_pos = nil
	self.speed = 0

	--- Calculated Values
	self.duration = 0
	self.target_pos = nil
end

function npc_state.appear:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.start_pos = nil
	self.end_pos = nil

	self.target_pos = nil
end

function npc_state.appear:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	local dir_vector = (self.end_pos - self.start_pos).normalized
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)

	self.fo.Direction = direction
	self.fo.Position = self.start_pos

	-- speed 값이 0이 되면 안됨
	self.duration = self.move_dist / self.speed
	self.target_pos = self.start_pos + dir_vector * self.move_dist

	character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.fo, 1, self.duration)
end

function npc_state.appear:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	if self.controller == nil then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.fo)
end

function npc_state.appear:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration

	if progress >= 1 then
		self.fo.Position = self.target_pos

		local next_state
		local npc_type_info = self.controller:get_npc_type_info(self.fo)
		-- 상호작용 타입에 따라 다음 스테이트 결졍
		if npc_type_info.interplay_type == 'crash' then
			next_state = self.controller:create_npc_state('crash_walk',
					self.fo, { end_pos = self.end_pos, speed = self.speed,
							   hitbox_size = vector(npc_type_info.hitbox_scale.x, 1, npc_type_info.hitbox_scale.z) })
		else
			next_state = self.controller:create_npc_state('walk',
					self.fo, { end_pos = self.end_pos, speed = self.speed })
		end

		self.controller:change_npc_state(self.fo, next_state)
	else
		self.fo.Position = self.start_pos * (1 - progress) + self.target_pos * progress
	end
end

function npc_state.talk:take_paper()
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	if self.updating == false then
		return
	end

	local npc_info = self.controller.npc_infos[self.fo]
	local emotion = 'smile'

	-- 마지막 대사는 출력하지 않도록 함
	-- "액티비티 완료" 연출 도중에 뜨는게 이상해서 수정
	if self.controller.current_game_state ~= self.controller.game_state.ending and self.reaction_info then
		emotion = self.reaction_info.emotion
		character_util.set_emotion(self.fo, { name = emotion })

		if self.reaction_info.sfx then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.reaction_info.sfx, parent = self.fo,
										 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		end
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.fo, { key = self.reaction_info.talk })
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(self.fo, { name = emotion })
		wait_for_sec(0.8)
	end

	if self.updating == false then
		return
	end

	--NPC, (smile, push) 전단지를 든 상태로 이동.
	--전단지를 받은 NPC들은 다시 인터랙션이 불가능 하게 처리.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.fo)

	local next_state = self.controller:create_npc_state('walk_with_paper', self.fo,
			{ end_pos = npc_info.target_pos, speed = npc_info.speed, emotion = emotion })
	self.controller:change_npc_state(self.fo, next_state)

				self.fo, { end_pos = self.end_pos, speed = self.speed })

		self.controller:change_npc_state(self.fo, next_state)
	else
		self.fo.Position = self.start_pos * (1 - progress) + self.target_pos * progress

		self:refresh_bounds()

		if self:check_crash_with_player() then
			self.controller:on_npc_crash(self.fo)
		end
	end

function npc_state.crash_walk:refresh_bounds()
	self.bounds.center = self.fo.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
end

function npc_state.crash_walk:check_crash_with_player()
	return self:aabb(get_party_leader().Bounds, self.bounds)
end

function npc_state.crash_walk:aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

	--region Sprite
	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			rice = 21209,
			friedrice = 21210,
			omurice = 21211,

			menu_restaurant = 21213,
			empty_dish = 21214,
			bird_egg = 21215,
			potato = 21216,
			cut_potato = 21217,
			carrot = 21218,
			cut_carrot = 21219,
			frypan = 21221,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = showoncharacter,
					  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = scale })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:ConsumeComplete()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = {}
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = {}
		end
	}

	--재료 관련 저장 풀 (테이블 + string)
	self.ingredient_pool = nil

function local_class:exit()
	--인터렉트 비활성화
	self:disable_publish_interact_fo()

	self:timer_finished()

	--스프라이트 제거
	self.sprite:dispose_all()

	if self.fx_table then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_table) do
			target:Dispose()
		end
	end

	--타이머 바 제거
	self.cooker.burner:exit()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.sprite:dispose_all()

	self:exit()

	if self.fx_table then
		for _, target in pairs(self.fx_table) do
			target:Dispose()
		end
	end

	self.ingredient_pool = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.item_container = nil
	self.leader = nil
	self.player = nil
	self.ingredient = nil
	self.cutting_board = nil
	self.burner = nil
	self.system_data = nil
	self.empty_dish = nil
	self.is_playing_game = nil
	self.is_game_clear = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:game_end(is_clear)
	self.is_playing_game = false

	-- 타이머 정지
	self:timer_finished()

	while self.is_qte_scene do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_maid(3), self.cs_controller)

	-- 중지 강제 이벤트 중일 때 선택지 취소
	self:stop_interact_intterupt()

	self:player_state_reset()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader)

	if is_clear then
		start_coroutine(self.game_cleared_scene, self)
	else
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, false))
	end
end

function local_class:game_start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	start_coroutine(self.game_start_routine, self)

end

function local_class:game_start_routine()
	self:pre_setting()

	self.cooker.burner:enter()

	-- 화면에 보이는 퀘스트 마커를 임시로 숨겨줌
	ui_quest_marker:Show(false)

	self.item_container = self.get_item_container(1)

	local attach_item_container_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.item_container.Position,
			self.player.constants.hold_height)

	self.item_container.Position = attach_item_container_pos

	self.item_container.Transform:SetParent(self.leader.transform)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_chasing', state = 'event', mix = 4 })

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	local start_count = 3
	local start_count_string_key = 'nm_ds_sub_maid_cafe_activity_count'
	local title_mod = 2.1
	for i = start_count, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format(start_count_string_key, i), title_mod)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(self.leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(self.leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader,
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)

	sp_util.exit_scene({ show_weapon = false }, self.leader)

	self:update_routine()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if (lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_burner(1)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_burner(2)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_burner(3)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_cutting_board(1)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_empty_dish(1)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_empty_dish(2)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_empty_dish(3)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_vegetable_bucket()) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_bird_egg_bucket()) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_rice_bucket()) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_trash_can()))
	then
		start_coroutine(self.interact_fo, self, e.Target.Name)

		return true
	end

	if self.is_playing_game and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_maid(3)) then
		start_coroutine(self.mini_game_stop_interact, self)

		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	local str = e:GetParamAt(0)

	if str == 'sub_mc_mini_game_reset' then
		self:exit()
	end
end
--endregion event

function local_class:mini_game_stop_interact()
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6, 1)

	local maid_3 = self.get_maid(3)
	--플레이 중 (C) 에게 인터랙트하여 중도 포기가 가능하다.
	--해당 중도 포기 이벤트 도중 타이머가 모두 소진되면 대화 이벤트가 중단되고 하단의 타이머 소진 이벤트가 우선 출력된다.
	--메이드 C (left,idle,idle): 주방에 문제라도 생기셨나요?
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(maid_3, self,
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			{ key = 'nm_ds_sub_maid_cafe_s2_mini_game_3', skip = true })

	--대사 중 종료시
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	self.choice_wait = true

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_async({
		--다시 도전한다. (mercy)
		{ 'nm_ds_sub_maid_cafe_s2_mini_game_choose_1', 'brutal' },
		--아무 일도 아니다. (normal)
		{ 'nm_ds_sub_maid_cafe_s2_mini_game_choose_2', 'normal' },
	}, nil, function()
		return self.choice_wait
	end)

	--선택지
	if choose_result == 1 then
		--실수가 생겼다. (brutal)
		self.is_playing_game = false

		self:game_end(false)
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		--아무 일도 아니다. (normal)
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1, 1)

		--공격 및 스킬이 안뜨도록
		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(self.leader, false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(self.leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader,
				CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)

		sp_util.exit_scene({ show_weapon = false }, self.leader)
	end
	--별도 이벤트 없이 컨트롤 복귀
end

function local_class:stop_interact_intterupt()
	self.choice_wait = false
end

function cooker.burner:recipe_cooker(burner)
	local recipe_name = burner.recipe_name
	local burner_name = burner.name

	--레시피 타이머 반복횟수 인덱스
	local burner_idx = burner.idx

	--버너 번호
	local burner_number = string.sub(burner_name, string.len(burner_name), string.len(burner_name))

	if recipe_name == 'friedrice' then

		return true
	end

	if recipe_name == 'omurice' then
		if burner_idx == 1 then
			--self.controller.fx.dead():Instantiate(self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos)

			self.controller:burner_table_reset(burner_number)

			self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1] = self.controller:pop_pool_sprite_name('omurice')

			local omurice = self.controller.sprite.sprite_table[self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1]]

			local item_sprite = omurice.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1 })

			item_sprite:Rebuild()

			local omurice = self.controller.sprite.sprite_table[self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1]]

			omurice.Position = self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos
		elseif burner_idx == 2 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_item_01')
				self.controller.fx.get():Instantiate(self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos)

				local omurice = self.controller.sprite.sprite_table[self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1]]

				local item_sprite = omurice.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

				item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })

				item_sprite:Rebuild()

				local burner_fo = self.controller.get_mc_object(burner_name)

				burner_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				while self.controller.is_playing_game and
						(not self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].is_finished) do
					coroutine.yield()
				end
				if self.controller.is_playing_game then
					burner.time_passed = burner.time_passed + 15
				end
			end)
		elseif burner_idx == 3 then
			if burner.fx then
				burner.fx:Dispose()
			end

			if self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].is_succeded then
				--구운계란 성공
				--디시가 들어올려진 상태이므로 버너 초기화
				self.controller:finished_dish(burner_number)

				self.controller.burner.pool['burner_' .. burner_number].is_finished = false
				self.controller.burner.pool['burner_' .. burner_number].is_succeded = false

				self.controller:burner_table_reset(burner_number)
			else
				--self.controller.fx.dead():Instantiate(self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos)

				local omurice = self.controller.sprite.sprite_table[self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1]]

				local item_sprite = omurice.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

				item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 })

				local burner = self.controller.get_mc_object(burner_name)

				burner.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				--디시 완성
				self.controller:finished_dish(burner_number)

				item_sprite:Rebuild()
			end

		end

		return true
	end

	if recipe_name == 'ketchup_omurice' then
		--8초가 지난 후 실행
		if burner_idx == 2 then
			start_coroutine(function()
				for idx = 1, #self.controller.burner.pool['burner_' .. burner_number].burner_table do
					local item_name = self.controller.burner.pool['burner_' .. burner_number].burner_table[idx]
					local len = string.len(item_name)
					local item_number = string.sub(item_name, len, len)
					local sub_item_name = string.sub(item_name, 1, len - 2)

					if sub_item_name == 'cut_vegetable' then
						self.controller:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event('cut_potato_' .. item_number)
						self.controller:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event('cut_carrot_' .. item_number)

						self.controller:return_pool_sprite('cut_potato_' .. item_number)
						self.controller:return_pool_sprite('cut_carrot_' .. item_number)
					else
						self.controller:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event(item_name)
						self.controller:return_pool_sprite(item_name)
					end
				end
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_item_01')
				self.controller.fx.get():Instantiate(self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01', 0.5)

				self.controller.fx.dead():Instantiate(self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos)

				--버너 테이블 초기화
				self.controller:burner_table_reset(burner_number)

				--테이블에 볶음밥 추가
				self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1] = self.controller:pop_pool_sprite_name('friedrice')

				local friedrice = self.controller.sprite.sprite_table[self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1]]

				friedrice.Position = self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos

				local burner_fo = self.controller.get_mc_object(burner_name)

				burner_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				while self.controller.is_playing_game and
						(not self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].is_finished) do
					coroutine.yield()
				end

				if self.controller.is_playing_game then
					burner.time_passed = burner.time_passed + 15
				end
			end)
			--15초가 지난 후 실행
		elseif burner_idx == 3 then
			if burner.fx then
				burner.fx:Dispose()
			end

			--케찹 오므라이스 만들기 성공
			if self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].is_succeded then
				local item_name = self.controller.burner.pool['burner_' .. burner_number].burner_table[1]

				self.controller:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event(item_name)
				self.controller:return_pool_sprite(item_name)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_item_01')
				self.controller.fx.get():Instantiate(self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos)

				--버너 테이블 초기화
				self.controller:burner_table_reset(burner_number)

				--테이블에 볶음밥 추가
				self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1] = self.controller:pop_pool_sprite_name('ketchup_omurice')

				local friedrice = self.controller.sprite.sprite_table[self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1]]

				friedrice.Position = self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos

				self.controller:finished_dish(burner_number)
			else
				--실패
				--self.controller.fx.dead():Instantiate(self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].pos)

				local friedrice = self.controller.sprite.sprite_table[self.controller.burner.pool[burner_name].burner_table[1]]

				local item_sprite = friedrice.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

				item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 })

				local burner = self.controller.get_mc_object(burner_name)

				burner.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

				--디시 완성
				self.controller:finished_dish(burner_number)

				item_sprite:Rebuild()
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

	self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].is_finished = true
end

--버너 테이블 리셋
function local_class:burner_table_reset(number)

	burner.burner_table = {}
end

--버너 테이블 리셋
function local_class:burner_data_reset(number)

	burner.is_finished = false
end

--도마 야채 커팅 완성

end

--도마 테이블 리셋
function local_class:cutting_board_table_reset(number)

end

--도마 데이터 리셋
function local_class:cutting_board_data_reset(number)

	self:cutting_board_table_reset(number)
