--캐릭터 상태 별 인터렉트 처리
---@param target_name  string 인터렉트 대상 Field Object 이름  (ex. burner_1)
function local_class:interact_fo(target_name)
	local string_length = string.len(target_name)

	local number = string.sub(target_name, string_length, string_length)

	-- _1 _2 와 같은 인덱스 제거
	local sub_target_name = string.sub(target_name, 1, string_length - 2)

	if sub_target_name == 'sub_mc_burner' and
			self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].is_finished then
		-- 완성된 요리가 존재하는 지 체크 (캐릭터가 아무것도 들지 않은 상태일때만 가능)

		if self.player.current_state == self.state.character.normal then
			self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].is_finished = false
			self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].is_succeded = false

			self:hold_up_finished_dish('burner_' .. number)

			self:burner_table_reset(number)

			return true
		else
			self:holding_item_event()
			return true
		end
	end

	if self.player.current_state == self.state.character.normal then
		--기본 상태 (아무 것도 들고 있지 않은 상태)
		if target_name == 'sub_mc_vegetable_bucket' then
			--야채인 경우 들어 올림
			self:vegetable_bucket_interact_event()

		elseif target_name == 'sub_mc_bird_egg_bucket' then
			--계란인 경우 들어 올림
			self:bird_egg_bucket_interact_event()

		elseif target_name == 'sub_mc_rice_bucket' then
			--쌀인 경우 들어 올림
			self:rice_bucket_interact_event()

		elseif sub_target_name == 'sub_mc_cutting_board' and
				self.cutting_board.pool.cutting_board_1.cutting_board_table and
				not self.cutting_board.pool['cutting_board_' .. number].is_finished then
			--도마인 경우, 테이블에 값이 존재할 경우, 완성된 요리가 없는 경우 (야채를 써는 연출)
			start_coroutine(self.cutting_vegetable_scene, self, number)

		elseif sub_target_name == 'sub_mc_cutting_board' and
				self.cutting_board.pool.cutting_board_1.cutting_board_table and
				self.cutting_board.pool['cutting_board_' .. number].is_finished then
			--도마인 경우, 테이블에 값이 존재할 경우, 완성된 요리가 있는 경우 (썰린 야채를 들어올림)
			self:cut_vegetable_interact_event(number)

		elseif self.player.current_state == self.state.character.normal and
				sub_target_name == 'sub_mc_burner' and
				self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'omurice') then
			self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].is_finished = true
			self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].is_succeded = true

			self:hold_up_finished_dish('burner_' .. number)

			self:burner_table_reset(number)

			return true
		else
			--노말 상태에서도마 버너 접시 등 인터렉트 시 여기서 처리
			self:burner_in_use()
		end

		return
	elseif self.player.current_state == self.state.character.holding then
		--재료를 들고 있는 상태
		if sub_target_name == 'sub_mc_burner' then
			self:burner_interact_event(number)

		elseif sub_target_name == 'sub_mc_cutting_board' and
				not self.cutting_board.pool['cutting_board_' .. number].is_finished and
				not self.cutting_board.pool['cutting_board_' .. number].cutting_board_table then
			local len = string.len(self.player.hold_item_name)
			local sub_hold_item_name = string.sub(self.player.hold_item_name, 1, len - 2)

			if sub_hold_item_name == 'vegetable' then
				self:cutting_board_interact_event(number)
			end

		elseif target_name == 'sub_mc_trash_can' then
			self:trash_can_interact_event()
		else
			start_coroutine(self.holding_item_event, self)
		end

		return
	elseif self.player.current_state == self.state.character.finished_dish_holding then
		--완성된 요리를 들고 있는 상태
		local len = string.len(self.player.hold_item_name)
		local sub_hold_item_name = string.sub(self.player.hold_item_name, 1, len - 2)
		local sub_hold_item_number = string.sub(self.player.hold_item_name, len, len)

		if target_name == 'sub_mc_empty_dish_' .. number and
				string.sub(self.player.hold_item_name, 1, string.len(self.player.hold_item_name) - 2)
						== 'ketchup_omurice' then

			self:sucsess_finished_dish(number)
		elseif target_name == 'sub_mc_burner_' .. number and
				sub_hold_item_name == 'omurice' then

			local item_sprite = self.sprite.sprite_table['omurice_' .. sub_hold_item_number].SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			if item_sprite.TintColor == unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }) then
				self:burner_interact_event(number)
			else
				start_coroutine(self.holding_item_event, self)
			end

			return true
		elseif target_name == 'sub_mc_trash_can' then
			self:trash_can_interact_event()
		else
			start_coroutine(self.holding_item_event, self)
		end

		return
	end
end

--region Cooking Space
--버너
function local_class:empty_dish_sucsess_check()
	local result = (self.empty_dish.pool.empty_dish_1.is_succeded and
			self.empty_dish.pool.empty_dish_2.is_succeded) and self.empty_dish.pool.empty_dish_3.is_succeded
	return result
end

--완성된 요리을 empty_dish에 놓는다.
function local_class:sucsess_finished_dish(number)
	local target_item = self.player.hold_item_name
	local len = string.len(target_item)
	local target_item_number = string.sub(target_item, len, len)

	local target_pool = self.empty_dish.pool['empty_dish_' .. number]

	self.get_empty_dish(number).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	target_pool.empty_dish_table = target_item
	target_pool.is_succeded = true

	self:player_state_reset(target_pool.pos)

	if self:empty_dish_sucsess_check() then
		self.is_game_clear = true
	end
end

--해당 버너가 사용 중 인지 확인
--버너 인터렉트
---@param number string 버너 번호
function local_class:burner_interact_event(number)
	local len = string.len(self.player.hold_item_name)
	local sub_item_name = string.sub(self.player.hold_item_name, 1, len - 2)

	if sub_item_name == 'cut_vegetable' then
		--같은 재료가 있는지 확인

		--라이스가 있는지 확인
		if self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'rice') then
			table.insert(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].burner_table, self.player.hold_item_name)
			-- 있을 경우
			self.cooker.burner:cooking_burner_manager('burner_' .. number,
					self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].pos, 'ketchup_omurice')

			self:player_state_reset(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		elseif self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'cut_vegetable') or
				self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'omurice') or
				self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'friedrice') then
			self:burner_in_use()
		else
			--없을 경우 테이블에 넣는다.
			table.insert(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].burner_table, self.player.hold_item_name)

			self:player_state_reset(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].pos)
		end


	elseif self.player.hold_item_name == 'bird_egg' then
		if #self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].burner_table == 0 then
			self.cooker.burner:cooking_burner_manager('burner_' .. number,
					self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].pos, 'omurice')

			self:player_state_reset()

			return
		else
			self:burner_in_use()
		end
	elseif sub_item_name == 'omurice' then
		if #self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].burner_table == 1 then
			local burner_table_item_name = self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].burner_table[1]
			local len = string.len(burner_table_item_name)
			local sub_item_name = string.sub(burner_table_item_name, 1, len - 2)

			if sub_item_name == 'friedrice' then
				table.insert(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].burner_table, self.player.hold_item_name)

				self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].is_finished = true
				self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].is_succeded = true

				self:return_pool_sprite(self.player.hold_item_name)

				self:player_state_reset()
			else
				self:burner_in_use()
			end
		else
			self:burner_in_use()
		end
	elseif sub_item_name == 'rice' then
		-- 같은 재료가 있는지 확인

		--야채가 있는지 확인
		if self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'cut_vegetable') then
			table.insert(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].burner_table, self.player.hold_item_name)
			-- 있을 경우
			self.cooker.burner:cooking_burner_manager('burner_' .. number,
					self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].pos, 'ketchup_omurice')

			self:player_state_reset(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		elseif self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'rice') or
				self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'omurice') or
				self.burner.pool:table_check(number, 'friedrice') then
			self:burner_in_use()
		else
			--없을 경우 테이블에 넣는다.
			table.insert(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].burner_table, self.player.hold_item_name)

			self:player_state_reset(self.burner.pool['burner_' .. number].pos)
		end
	else
		--해당 재료는 맞지 않는 재료이다.
		self:burner_in_use()
	end
end

--도마 (야채를 처음으로 올렸을 때 들어오는 함수)
function local_class:cutting_board_interact_event(number)
	local target_item = self.player.hold_item_name
	local len = string.len(target_item)
	local target_item_number = string.sub(target_item, len, len)

	local target_pool = self.cutting_board.pool['cutting_board_' .. number]

	local interval = self.ingredient.constants.vegetable.interval

	--위치 옮겨 놓음 (이미 풀에서 꺼낸상태)
	local potato_sprite = self.sprite.sprite_table['potato_' .. target_item_number]
	local carrot_sprite = self.sprite.sprite_table['carrot_' .. target_item_number]

	potato_sprite.Position = target_pool.pos + vector(interval.potato.x, interval.potato.y, interval.potato.z)
	carrot_sprite.Position = target_pool.pos + vector(interval.carrot.x, interval.carrot.y, interval.carrot.z)

	target_pool.cutting_board_table = target_item

	self:player_state_reset(false)
end

--커팅 시 교체 연출 용 (일반 야채에서 썰린 야채로 변경)
---@param target_number string 도마 번호
---@param item_number string 야채 번호
function local_class:cutting_board_change_vegetable(target_number, item_number)
	--새로운 썰린 야채 풀에서 가져옴
	local cut_potato_sprite_name = self:pop_pool_sprite_name('cut_potato')
	local cut_carrot_sprite_name = self:pop_pool_sprite_name('cut_carrot')

	local len = string.len(cut_potato_sprite_name)
	local cut_vegetable_number = string.sub(cut_potato_sprite_name, len, len)

	local target_pool = self.cutting_board.pool['cutting_board_' .. target_number]

	local interval = self.ingredient.constants.cut_vegetable.interval

	--999로 안보이게 위치 변경
	self.sprite.sprite_table['potato_' .. item_number].Position = self.wait_pos
	self.sprite.sprite_table['carrot_' .. item_number].Position = self.wait_pos

	--기존 야채 반환
	self:return_pool_sprite('potato_' .. item_number)
	self:return_pool_sprite('carrot_' .. item_number)

	-- 새로운 썰린 야채 위치 세팅
	self.sprite.sprite_table[cut_potato_sprite_name].Position = target_pool.pos + vector(interval.potato.x, interval.potato.y, interval.potato.z)
	self.sprite.sprite_table[cut_carrot_sprite_name].Position = target_pool.pos + vector(interval.carrot.x, interval.carrot.y, interval.carrot.z)

	self:cutting_board_table_reset(target_number)

	target_pool.cutting_board_table = 'cut_vegetable_' .. cut_vegetable_number

	--완료 처리
	self:finished_cutting(target_number)
end

--도마 연출
---@param target_number string 해당 도마의 번호 (ex. cutting_board_1에서 1에 해당)
function local_class:cutting_vegetable_scene(target_number)
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	local target_name = self.cutting_board.pool.cutting_board_1.cutting_board_table

	local len = string.len(target_name)
	local item_number = string.sub(target_name, len, len)

	local potato_name = 'potato_' .. item_number
	local carrot_name = 'carrot_' .. item_number

	local target_pool = self.cutting_board.pool['cutting_board_' .. target_number]

	--현재 커팅 중일 경우 반환
	if self.is_cutting_scene then
		return
	end

	self.is_cutting_scene = true
	self.is_qte_scene = true

	--해당 판정이 다른 오브젝트를 든 상태보다 우선순위

	--onehandsword_kitchen_knife 를 클로드가 손에 든채로 (up,idle,sword_attack2) 애니메이션 재생
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(self.leader, '[base]weapon1', 'onehandsword_kitchen_knife')

	--플레이어가 아무것도 가지고 있지 않고, 도마위에 야채가 올라간 경우
	--QTE 연타 재생 (10회)
	local is_qte = true
	local qte_count = 0
	local is_qte_anim_playing = true

	local potato_sprite = self.sprite.sprite_table[potato_name]
	local carrot_sprite = self.sprite.sprite_table[carrot_name]

	start_coroutine(function()
		--while (is_qte or qte_count ~= 0) do
		while is_qte do
			if qte_count ~= 0 then
				--야채들 (shake0.03)
				drop_item_util.shake(potato_sprite, 'item_key_1', 0.03, 0.5)
				drop_item_util.shake(carrot_sprite, 'item_key_2', 0.03, 0.5)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_musarame_hit_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_hit_01')
				scene_util.set_anim_async(self.leader, self, { name = 'sword_attack2', count = 1, scale = 2 })

				qte_count = qte_count - 1
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		is_qte_anim_playing = false
	end)

	qte_play_util.tap(10, { tap_count_callback = function()
		qte_count = qte_count + 1
	end })

	is_qte = false

	while is_qte_anim_playing do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_qte_scene = false
	self.is_cutting_scene = false

	--무기 제거
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(self.leader, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	--QTE 실패 하지 않음
	--QTE 조건 충족시 (10 번 연타)
	--야채 스프라이트에 fx_dead 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01', 0.5)
	self.fx.dead():Instantiate(target_pool.pos)

	--도마 위에 cut_carrot, cut_potato 이 겹쳐서 생성 (썬 야채)
	--cut_potato는 중앙에서 0.1칸 좌측 cut_carrot은 중앙에서 0.1칸으로 배치
	self:cutting_board_change_vegetable(target_number, item_number)

	--공격 및 스킬이 안뜨도록
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(self.leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(self.leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader,
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)

	sp_util.exit_scene({ show_weapon = false }, self.leader)
end

--재료 인터렉트 시 활성화 해주는 함수 (들어올리는 함수)
---@param item_name string 재료 sprite 이름 (ex. omurice_1)
---@param interval table vector x, y, z 값이 dictionary 형태로 존재 (없을 시 false)
---@param is_get_fx boolean get 이펙트 출력 유무
function local_class:common_enable_ingredients_interact_event(item_name, interval, is_get_fx)
	local interval = lua_helper.get_or_default(interval, false)
	local is_get_fx = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_get_fx, true)

	local target = self.sprite.sprite_table[item_name]

	if not target then
		return
	end

	if interval then
		target.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position + vector(interval.x, 0, interval.z), self.player.constants.hold_height + interval.y)
	else
		target.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position, self.player.constants.hold_height)
	end

	if is_get_fx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_get_drop_item_01')
		self.fx.get():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(self.leader.Position, self.player.constants.hold_height))
	end

	target.SpriteTransform:SetParent(self.item_container.transform)
end

--아이템 초기화 이벤트 ( 아이템의 부모, 위치, 색상 등을 초기화)
---@param item_name string 재료 sprite 이름 (ex. omurice_1)
---@param is_wait_pos vector3 sprite 아이템이 이동 될 위치 (없을 시 (999, 0, 999) 위치)
function local_class:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event(item_name, is_wait_pos)
	local is_wait_pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_wait_pos, self.wait_pos)
	local item = self.sprite.sprite_table[item_name]

	item.SpriteTransform:SetParent(self.sprite.sprite_table_origin_parent[item_name])
	if is_wait_pos then
		item.Position = is_wait_pos
	end

	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })

	item_sprite:Rebuild()
end

---@param move_pos vector3 들고있는 아이템 위치 이동 (기본적으로 (999,0,999))
function local_class:player_state_reset(move_pos)
	if not self.player.hold_item_name then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader, true)

	local len = string.len(self.player.hold_item_name)
	local item_number = string.sub(self.player.hold_item_name, len, len)

	--야채의 경우 2개가 묶음으로 예외
	if self.player.hold_item_name == 'vegetable_' .. item_number then
		self:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event('potato_' .. item_number, move_pos)
		self:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event('carrot_' .. item_number, move_pos)
	elseif self.player.hold_item_name == 'cut_vegetable_' .. item_number then
		self:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event('cut_potato_' .. item_number, move_pos)
		self:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event('cut_carrot_' .. item_number, move_pos)
	else
		--그 외 하나짜리 아이템
		self:common_disable_ingredients_interact_event(self.player.hold_item_name, move_pos)
	end

	self.player.current_state = self.state.character.normal
	self.player.hold_item_name = nil
end

	if name == 'potato' then
		local target_name = self.ingredient_pool.potato[1]

		table.remove(self.ingredient_pool.potato, 1)

		return target_name
	elseif name == 'rice' then
		local target_name = self.ingredient_pool.rice[1]

		table.remove(self.ingredient_pool.rice, 1)

		return target_name
	elseif name == 'cut_potato' then
		local target_name = self.ingredient_pool.cut_potato[1]

		table.remove(self.ingredient_pool.cut_potato, 1)

		return target_name
	elseif name == 'carrot' then
		local target_name = self.ingredient_pool.carrot[1]

		table.remove(self.ingredient_pool.carrot, 1)

		return target_name
	elseif name == 'cut_carrot' then
		local target_name = self.ingredient_pool.cut_carrot[1]

		table.remove(self.ingredient_pool.cut_carrot, 1)

		return target_name
	elseif name == 'friedrice' then
		local target_name = self.ingredient_pool.friedrice[1]

		table.remove(self.ingredient_pool.friedrice, 1)

		return target_name
	elseif name == 'omurice' then
		local target_name = self.ingredient_pool.omurice[1]

		table.remove(self.ingredient_pool.omurice, 1)

		return target_name
	elseif name == 'ketchup_omurice' then
		local target_name = self.ingredient_pool.ketchup_omurice[1]

		table.remove(self.ingredient_pool.ketchup_omurice, 1)

		return target_name
	end
end

--재료 풀 반환 (사용 후 풀에 다시 넣는다)
---@param target_name string 재료 스프라이트 이름 (ex. vegetable_1)
function local_class:return_pool_sprite(target_name)
	local len = string.len(target_name)
	local sub_target_name = string.sub(target_name, 1, len - 2)
	local sub_target_number = string.sub(target_name, len, len)

	if sub_target_name == 'rice' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.rice, target_name)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'vegetable' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.potato, 'potato_' .. sub_target_number)
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.carrot, 'carrot_' .. sub_target_number)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'cut_vegetable' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.cut_potato, 'cut_potato_' .. sub_target_number)
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.cut_carrot, 'cut_carrot_' .. sub_target_number)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'potato' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.potato, target_name)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'cut_potato' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.cut_potato, target_name)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'carrot' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.carrot, target_name)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'cut_carrot' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.cut_carrot, target_name)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'omurice' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.omurice, target_name)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'friedrice' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.friedrice, target_name)
	elseif sub_target_name == 'ketchup_omurice' then
		table.insert(self.ingredient_pool.ketchup_omurice, target_name)
	end
end

-- 요리 관리 함수
---@param burner_name string 버너 이름 (ex. burner_1)
---@param burner_pos vector3 버너 위치
---@param recipe_name string 요리가 진행될 레시피 이름 (ex. ketchup_omurice)
function cooker.burner:cooking_burner_manager(burner_name, burner_pos, recipe_name)
	self:add_cooking_burner(burner_name, recipe_name, burner_pos)
end

--요리 관련 테이블에 요리 추가 (update에서 실행)
---@param burner_name string 버너 이름 (ex. burner_1)
---@param burner_pos vector3 버너 위치
---@param recipe_name string 요리가 진행될 레시피 이름 (ex. ketchup_omurice)
function cooker.burner:add_cooking_burner(burner_name, recipe_name, burner_pos)
	--레시피
	local cooking_burner = {
		burner_pos = burner_pos,
		recipe_name = recipe_name,
		recipe = self.controller.burner.constants.recipe[recipe_name],
		name = burner_name,
		time_passed = 0,
		idx = 1,
		timer_bar = nil,
		fx = self.controller.fx.plitvice_buff():Instantiate(burner_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	}

	self.super.controller.get_mc_object(cooking_burner.name).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')

	cooking_burner.fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

	--나중에 제거용
	table.insert(self.controller.fx_table, cooking_burner.fx)

	cooking_burner.timer_bar = field_ui_manager:SetUI(
			get_field_object('sub_mc_' .. burner_name),
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)[CS    .Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	cooking_burner.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
	cooking_burner.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, cooking_burner.recipe.timer[1]);

	cooking_burner.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true);
	cooking_burner.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);
	cooking_burner.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(false);

	self.update_burner_list[burner_name] = cooking_burner
end

function cooker.burner:update_manager(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.update_burner_list ~= nil then
		--데이터가 없으면 넘어간다.
		for _, burner in pairs(self.update_burner_list) do

			burner.time_passed = burner.time_passed + dt

			burner.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(burner.time_passed, 0)

			--constants 레시피 타이머 데이터 확인
			if burner.idx <= #burner.recipe.timer and
					burner.time_passed >= burner.recipe.timer[burner.idx] then
				burner.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(false);

				burner.time_passed = 0

				self:recipe_cooker(burner)

				burner.idx = burner.idx + 1

				if burner.idx > #burner.recipe.timer then
					self.update_burner_list[burner.name] = nil

					break
				end

				burner.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
				burner.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, burner.recipe.timer[burner.idx]);
				burner.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0);

				burner.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true);
			end
			--플레이어가 알맞은 오브젝트 (계란, 썬야채+밥)을 올리면 오브젝트가 익는 이벤트가 재생된다.
			--위 내용은 다른 곳에서 처리 후 리스트에 넣는다.

		end
	end
end
--endregion Cooker Burner

function local_class:timer_finished()
	print('jbs : ')
	timer_util.end_timer(self)
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	--제한 시간 70초 UI 생성과 함께 원샷 재생
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.system_data.time_limit, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	while self.is_playing_game do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		self.cooker.burner:update_manager(dt)

		if time_passed >= self.system_data.time_limit then
			self:game_end(false)

		elseif self.is_game_clear then
			self:game_end(true)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end
--endregion custom

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

--- 바구니로 물체를 잡는 게임 컨트롤러
local local_class = newclass("MayreelTrampolineController")

function local_class:init(cs_controller, scene)

	self.constants = require('minigame/MayreelTrampoline/MayreelTrampolineConstants').default

	self.game_name = 'mayreel_trampoline_game'

	self.kid_name = 'brother'
	self.kid = nil

	self.marker_name = 'trampoline_start'

	self.game_progress = {
		none = 1,
		playing = 2,
		clear = 3,
		area_out_fail = 4,
		catch_fail = 5
	}
	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.none

	self.free_fall = nil
	self.kid_progress = 0
	self.kid_velocity = unity_class.vector3.zero

	self.kid_valid_range = false
	self.kid_in_goal = false
	self.kid_out_bound = false

	self.is_game_playing = false

	self.is_clear = false

	self.pre_event_scene_played = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	yield_return_func(self.game_load, self)

	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitAll())
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent)) and not self.is_game_playing and e.Name == self.game_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent)) and e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.kid) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'trampoline_goal' then
				self.kid_in_goal = true
				return true
			end
			if e.Zone.Name == 'trampoline_zone' then
				self.kid_out_bound = false
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent)) and e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.kid) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'trampoline_zone' then
				self.kid_out_bound = true
				return true
			end
			if e.Zone.Name == 'trampoline_goal' then
				self.kid_in_goal = false
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'pre_play_scene_end' then
			self.pre_event_scene_played = true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:game_load()
	self.kid = get_character(self.kid_name)
	self.free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(15, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * 3, 0, 0)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
end

function local_class:game_init()
	local marker = field:GetMarker('trampoline_start')
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel')
	self.kid_progress = 0
	self.is_clear = false
	self:change_leader_to_mayreel()
	character_util.set_position(self.kid, marker.position + vector(-1, 0, 0), false)
	character_util.set_direction(self.kid, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(mayreel, marker.position, false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.kid)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.kid, {name = 'sing'}, {name = 'smile'})
	self.kid.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector(999, 0, 999), 0.20)
	self.attack_range.CacheTransform.localScale = vector(2, 1, 1)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
end

function local_class:game_reset()
	local marker = field:GetMarker('trampoline_start')
	self.kid_progress = 0
	self:change_leader_to_bari()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.kid)
	character_util.set_position(self.kid, marker.position, false)
	party_util.align_party(marker.position, 'right', 0)
	self.kid.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
end

function local_class:change_leader_to_mayreel()
	local bari = get_character('bari')
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel')

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(mayreel, param)
	character_util.set_active_state(mayreel, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(bari, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position(bari, field:GetMarker('trampoline_wait').position + vector(1, 0, 1), false)
	character_util.set_direction(bari, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(get_character('bari'))
end

function local_class:change_leader_to_bari()
	local bari = get_character('bari')
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel')

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(bari, param)
	character_util.set_active_state(mayreel, 'enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(mayreel, user_party)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(get_character('bari'))
	mayreel.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
end

function local_class:game_start()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.is_game_playing = true

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 게임 초기화
	yield_return_func(self.game_init, self)

	-- 로드 완료 이벤트를 퍼블리시해줌.
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'mayreel_trampoline_game_loaded' }))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	ui_quest_marker:Show(false)

	-- TODO: 튜토리얼 진행시, 튜토리얼 플래그 체크해서 update 내부에서 관리 가능하도록 하는 것이 안전할 것 같습니다.
	self.pre_event_scene_played = false
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'pre_play_scene_start' }))

	while not self.pre_event_scene_played do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	yield_return_func(self.mayreel_get_fluffy, self)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.move_to(self.kid, user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, nil, false, false)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(self.kid, 'right', 0.5, 1)

	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.kid, {name = 'cliff'}, {name = 'smile'})
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kid_rotate, self))

	self.kid_out_bound = false
	self.kid_in_goal = false

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 각종 키 제거
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- 게임 루틴
	yield_return_func(self.game_loop, self)

	self.is_game_playing = false
	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.none

	yield_return_func(self.reset_mayreel_fluffy, self)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if not self.is_clear then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	end
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black)

	yield_return_func(self.game_reset, self)

	ui_quest_marker:Show(true)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create('mayreel_trampoline_game', self.is_clear))
end

function local_class:game_loop()
	local time_passed = 0
	local prevHitBox = self.kid.Hitbox
	self.kid.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.3, 0.2, 0.3))
	while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		self:kid_update(dt)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.kid.Hitbox = prevHitBox
end

function local_class:kid_update(dt)
	local kid_y = self.free_fall:GetDistance(self.kid_progress)
	local pinnacle = self.free_fall:GetPinnacleDistance()

	local xz_move = self.kid_velocity * dt

	self.kid.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.kid.Position + xz_move, kid_y)
	self.kid.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.up * (0.03 - self.kid.Position.y)
	self.kid.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * unity_class.mathf.Max((pinnacle - kid_y) / pinnacle, 0.2)

	local bari = get_character('bari')

	if kid_y < 1 and kid_y > 0.3 and self.kid_progress > 0.5 then
	end

	if kid_y <= 0 then
		self.kid_progress = 0
		self.kid_velocity = self:get_distance()

		if self.kid_in_goal then
			-- 도착 연출
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			self.attack_range:Hide(0)
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
			self.is_clear = true
			self.is_game_playing = false
			self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.none

			self.kid_velocity = unity_class.vector3.zero
			self.kid.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.kid.Position, 0)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.kid, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.kid, {name = 'victory_extra'}, {name = 'smile'})
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bari, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})

			camera_util.move_async(self.kid.Position, 0.5)

		elseif self.kid_velocity.magnitude > 1.75 or self.kid_out_bound then
			-- 실패 연출
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			self.attack_range:Hide(0)
			self.is_game_playing = false
			self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.none

			self.kid_velocity = unity_class.vector3.zero
			self.kid.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.kid.Position, 0)
			if self.kid.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left or self.kid.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
				character_util.set_direction(self.kid, 'left')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(self.kid, 'right')
			end
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_vampire_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.kid, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bari, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.kid)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.kid)

			camera_util.move_async(self.kid.Position, 0.5)

		else
			self.kid_velocity = self:squish_distance(self.kid_velocity) * unity_class.mathf.Clamp(self.kid_velocity.magnitude, 0, 0.8) * 3

			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.kid.Position + self.kid_velocity, 0)
			attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, 0)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fat_gnome_03')
			character_util.set_emotion(self.kid, {name = 'awesome'})
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party.Leader, 0.7, 1.3, 1, 0.5)
		end
	end

	self.kid_progress = self.kid_progress + dt

function local_class:mayreel_get_fluffy()
	local inner_timer = 0
	local duration = 1
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mayreel_baloon_01')
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(mayreel, {name = 'unique/mayreel_draw'})

	while inner_timer < duration do
		local progress = 1 + (inner_timer / duration) * 0.7
		character_util.set_scale_factor(mayreel, 'mayreel_fluffy', progress)
		mayreel.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1 + (inner_timer / duration) * 0.5)
		inner_timer = inner_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(mayreel, {name = 'frown'})
	character_util.set_anim(mayreel, {name = 'unique/mayreel_clamp'})
end

function local_class:reset_mayreel_fluffy()
	local inner_timer = 0
	local duration = 0.3
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mayreel_baloon_02')
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(mayreel, {name = 'unique/mayreel_spit_start'})

	while inner_timer < duration do
		local progress = 1.7 - (inner_timer / duration) * 0.7
		character_util.set_scale_factor(mayreel, 'mayreel_fluffy', progress)
		mayreel.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * (1.5 - (inner_timer / duration) * 0.5)
		inner_timer = inner_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(mayreel)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(mayreel, {name = 'unique/mayreel_spit_end', count = 1})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mayreel)
	character_util.remove_scale_factor(mayreel, 'mayreel_fluffy')
end

function local_class:kid_rotate()
	local dir = {'down', 'left', 'up', 'right'}
	local index = 1

	while self.is_game_playing do
		character_util.set_direction(self.kid, dir[index])
		index = index + 1 > #dir and 1 or index + 1
		if index == 3 then character_util.remove_emotion(self.kid) end
		wait_for_sec(0.125)
	end
end

function local_class:get_distance()
	local mayreel_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position, 0)
	local kid_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.kid.Position, 0)

	local diff = kid_pos - mayreel_pos
	local norm = vector(diff.x, 0, diff.z * 2).normalized
	local dist = vector(diff.x, 0, diff.z * 2).magnitude

	return norm * dist
end

function local_class:squish_distance(v)
	return vector(v.x, 0, v.z / 2)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self.free_fall:Dispose()
end


return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}

local mini_game_base = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MazeEscape/MazeEscapeBase')
local mini_game = newclass('AfterWorldMazeEscape', mini_game_base)

function mini_game:init(controller, game_data)
	-- 부모 클래스 초기화
	self.super:init(controller, game_data)

	-- 게임내 필요한 캐릭터, 필드 오브젝트들의 이름들
	self.decapitated_soul = lua_helper.get_or_default(game_data.controllable_head_name, nil)
	self.goal_zone_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(game_data.goal_name, nil)

	-- Getters
	self.get_decapitated_soul = function() return get_field_object(self.decapitated_soul) end
end

function mini_game:game_start()
	-- 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(BrazierOnOffEvent), 'on_brazier_on_off_event')

	-- UI 초기화
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUIType.PartyState)
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	-- 카메라 사이즈 변경

	-- 조작 가능한 머리로 파티 리더 변경
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'enable_head_control' }))
end

function mini_game:on_event(e)
	return true
end

function mini_game:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
	local entered_object = e.FieldObject
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(entered_object, self.get_decapitated_soul()) then
		if zone_name == self.goal_zone_name then
			self:on_succeed()

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_succeed, self))
		end
	end
end

function mini_game:on_brazier_on_off_event(e)
end

function mini_game:on_succeed()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'disable_head_control' }))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.super.game_name, true))
end

function mini_game:on_failed()
end

function mini_game:game_end()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function mini_game:dispose()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return mini_game()
	end
}

end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	-- 미니 게임에 필요한 데이터를 먼저 로드
	self:load_game_data_by_script_name(key .. 'Data')

	-- 미니 게임 로드
	self:load_game_by_script_name(key)

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)

local local_class = newclass('MWRacingBackGround')

local manager_type = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerType')
local manager_container = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerContainer')

function local_class:init()
	-- 배경 프리팹 담음 테이블
	self.background_pools = {}

	-- 배경 프리팹의 길이
	self.background_pool_size = 0

	-- 배경 프리팹이 리셋되는 위치
	self.background_reset_pos = nil

	-- 플레이어가 이동 못하도록 막는 벽들
	self.walls = nil

	-- 배경 중심 위치 관련
	self.background_offset = nil
	self.background_center = nil

	-- 배경 이동 속도
	self.original_speed = 0
	self.booster_speed = 0
	self.obstacle_speed = 0
	self.cur_speed = 0

	-- 배경 이동 방향
	self.background_scroll_dir = 'left'
	self.background_scroll_dir_vec = vector(-1, 0, 0)

	-- 리셋할 때 더할 사이즈
	self.reset_adding_size = nil

	--관중 풀
	self.npc_pools = nil
	self.npc_name = nil
	self.npc_pools_size = 0

	self.mid_idx = 0
	self.ending_prefab_offset = vector(0, 0, 0)
	self.half_screen_size = nil

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.shared_materials = nil
end

function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.background_constants_data = self.controller.background_constants_data
	self.background_offset = vector(
			self.background_constants_data.offset.x, self.background_constants_data.offset.y, self.background_constants_data.offset.z)

	self.background_center = self.controller.center_pos + self.background_offset
	self.background_pool_size = self.background_constants_data.prefab_size
	self.original_speed = self.background_constants_data.speed
	self.booster_speed = self.background_constants_data.booster_speed
	self.obstacle_speed = self.background_constants_data.obstacle_speed
	self.background_reset_pos = self.controller.center_pos.x + (self.background_pool_size * -1.5)
	self.reset_adding_size = self.background_scroll_dir_vec * self.background_pool_size * -3

	local ending_prefab_offset = self.background_constants_data.ending_prefab_offset
	if ending_prefab_offset ~= nil then
		self.ending_prefab_offset = vector(ending_prefab_offset.x, ending_prefab_offset.y, ending_prefab_offset.z)
	end

	self.half_screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size() * 0.5

	self.controller.time_passed = 0

	--region Flag 세팅
	self.flag_clear = 0
	self.manual_flag = false

	self.start_flag = self.background_constants_data.flag:get_start_flag()
	self.end_flag = self.background_constants_data.flag:get_end_flag()

	self.start_flag_pos = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game).center_pos +
			vector(self.background_constants_data.flag.start_pos_offset, 0, 1.5)

	self.end_flag_pos = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game).center_pos +
			vector(self.background_constants_data.flag.end_pos_offset, 0, 1.5)

	if not self.controller.is_tutorial then
		self.start_flag.Position = self.start_flag_pos
		self.end_flag.Position = self.end_flag_pos
	else
		self.end_flag.Position = self.end_flag_pos
	end
	--endregion Flag 세팅

	-- 배경 생성
	local gap = direction_util.to_vector3(self.background_scroll_dir) * self.background_pool_size
	local mid_idx = math.floor(self.background_constants_data.prefab_num * 0.5)
	self.mid_idx = self.background_constants_data.prefab_num % 2 ~= 0 and mid_idx + 1 or mid_idx

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	self.shared_materials = {}

	for i = 1, self.background_constants_data.prefab_num do
		local idx_from_mid = self.mid_idx - i
		local pos = self.background_center + (gap * idx_from_mid)

		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder, self.background_constants_data.asset_bundle, self.background_constants_data.prefab_name, function(prefab)
					local background_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					background_pool.transform.localPosition = pos
					self:add_shared_materials(background_pool)
					table.insert(self.background_pools, background_pool)
				end)
	end
end

function local_class:add_shared_materials(pool)
	for i = 0, pool.transform.childCount - 1 do
		local layer = pool.transform:GetChild(i)

		local renderers = layer:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

		for j = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
			local renderer = renderers[j]
			local shared_material = renderer.sharedMaterial
			local new_shared_material = CS.UnityEngine.Material(shared_material)

			renderer.sharedMaterial = new_shared_material

			table.insert(self.shared_materials, new_shared_material)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:reset_setting()
	self:dispose()
	self:clean()
end

function local_class:clean()
	for _, target in pairs(self.controller.audience_npc_pools) do
		target.Position = self.wait_pos
	end

	-- 배경 프리팹 담음 테이블
	self.background_pools = {}

	-- 배경 프리팹의 길이
	self.background_pool_size = 0

	-- 배경 프리팹이 리셋되는 위치
	self.background_reset_pos = nil

	-- 플레이어가 이동 못하도록 막는 벽들
	self.walls = nil

	-- 배경 중심 위치 관련
	self.background_offset = nil
	self.background_center = nil

	-- 배경 이동 속도
	self.original_speed = 0
	self.booster_speed = 0
	self.obstacle_speed = 0
	self.cur_speed = 0

	self.half_screen_size = nil

	self.shared_materials = nil

	self.res_holder = nil
	self.walls = nil
	self.walls_original_pos = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.background_pools ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.background_pools do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.background_pools[i])
		end
		self.background_pools = nil
	end

	if self.ending_background_pool ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ending_background_pool)
		self.ending_background_pool = nil
	end
end

function local_class:pop_item(target_pools)
	for idx = 1, #target_pools do
		if not target_pools[idx][2] then
			target_pools[idx][2] = true

			return idx
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	self.cur_speed = self.original_speed

	self.npc_pools = {}

	self.npc_pools_size = #self.controller.audience_constants_data.npc.spine_name

	local npc_trio = {}
	for _, target in pairs(self.controller.audience_npc_pools) do
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(target, field_ui_type.character_stats)
		character_util.set_active_shadow(target, false)

		table.insert(npc_trio, target)

		if #npc_trio == 3 then
			table.insert(npc_trio, false)

			table.insert(self.npc_pools, npc_trio)

			npc_trio = {}
		end
	end

	self.npc_pools[1][4] = true
	self.npc_pools[2][4] = true
	self.npc_pools[3][4] = true
	self.npc_pools[4][4] = true
	self.npc_pools[5][4] = true
	self.npc_pools[6][4] = true
	self.npc_pools[7][4] = true
	self.npc_pools[8][4] = true
	self.npc_pools[9][4] = true

	--region Npc 세팅
	local gap = direction_util.to_vector3(self.background_scroll_dir) * self.background_pool_size

	self.audience_npc_constants_data = self.controller.audience_constants_data.npc

	self.start_pos = self.controller.center_pos + vector(self.audience_npc_constants_data.start_pos, 0, 0)
	self.pos = { x = -6, y = 0, z = -3.5 }
	self.npc_offset = {
		5,
		20,
		35
	}

	self.adding_pos = 88

	local npc_offset = {
		5,
		20,
		35
	}

	local party_count = 3

	local offset_count = 0

	local cur_party_count = 1

	for idx = 1, 9 do
		offset_count = offset_count + 1

		local offset = npc_offset[offset_count]

		local pos = self.background_center + (gap * cur_party_count)

		for npc_idx = 1, 3 do
			local start_offset = offset + pos.x + self.adding_pos
			local add_offset_y = self.start_pos.y + self.audience_npc_constants_data.npc_offset[npc_idx].y
			local add_offset_z = self.start_pos.z + self.audience_npc_constants_data.npc_offset[npc_idx].z

			self.npc_pools[idx][npc_idx].Position = vector(
					start_offset,
					add_offset_y,
					add_offset_z)
		end

		if offset_count == party_count then
			offset_count = 0
			cur_party_count = cur_party_count + 1
		end
	end

	--endregion Npc 세팅

	if self.walls == nil then
		self:create_boundary_walls()
	end

	if self.controller.is_tutorial then
		self.flag_clear = self.flag_clear + 1
	end
end

function local_class:update_routine(dt)
	self:scroll_background(dt)

	self:scroll_flag(dt)
end

function local_class:scroll_flag(dt)
	local is_flag_start_time_overed = self.controller.time_passed >= self.background_constants_data.flag.start_time

	if (self.flag_clear == 0) and is_flag_start_time_overed then
		local velocity = self.background_scroll_dir_vec * self.cur_speed * dt

		self.start_flag.Position = self.start_flag.Position + velocity

		if self.background_reset_pos > self.start_flag.Position.x then
			self.start_flag.Position = self.controller.wait_pos
			self.flag_clear = self.flag_clear + 1
		end

	elseif (self.flag_clear == 1) and self.manual_flag then
		local velocity = self.background_scroll_dir_vec * self.cur_speed * dt

		self.end_flag.Position = self.end_flag.Position + velocity

		if self.background_reset_pos > self.end_flag.Position.x then
			self.end_flag.Position = self.controller.wait_pos
			self.flag_clear = self.flag_clear + 1
			self.manual_flag = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:scroll_background(dt)
	local is_game_state_clear = self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.clear
	local is_game_state_none = self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.none

	if is_game_state_clear and is_game_state_none then
		return
	end

	local moved_per_frame = self.background_scroll_dir_vec * self.cur_speed * dt

	for _, npc_pool in pairs(self.npc_pools) do
		if npc_pool[4] then
			for npc_idx = 1, 3 do
				npc_pool[npc_idx].Position = npc_pool[npc_idx].Position + moved_per_frame
			end
		end
	end

	self.background_pools[1].transform.position = self.background_pools[1].transform.position + moved_per_frame

	local bg_setting = function()
		for i = 2, #self.background_pools do
			local target_pos = self.background_pools[i - 1].transform.position + unity_class.vector3.right * self.background_pool_size
			self.background_pools[i].transform.position = target_pos
		end
	end

	bg_setting()

	while self.background_reset_pos > self.background_pools[1].transform.position.x do
		local cur_first_bg_pool = self.background_pools[1]

		for i = 1, #self.background_pools do
			if i < #self.background_pools then
				self.background_pools[i] = self.background_pools[i + 1]
			else
				self.background_pools[i] = cur_first_bg_pool
			end
		end

		bg_setting()

		for _, value in pairs(self.npc_offset) do
			-- x 값이 가장 작은 파티를 해제
			local smallest_npcs = self:npc_with_smallest_x()

			-- 사용하지 않음
			for npc_idx = 1, 3 do
				smallest_npcs[npc_idx].Position = self.wait_pos
			end

			-- [4] : boolean 사용중인지 아닌지 체크
			-- [1~3] : 실제 관중 NPC 들
			smallest_npcs[4] = false

			-- 그리고 랜덤 할당
			local npc_target = self:random_pop_npc()

			for npc_idx = 1, 3 do
				local add_offset_y = self.audience_npc_constants_data.npc_offset[npc_idx].y
				local add_offset_z = self.audience_npc_constants_data.npc_offset[npc_idx].z

				npc_target[npc_idx].Position = vector(
						cur_first_bg_pool.transform.position.x + value,
						self.start_pos.y + add_offset_y,
						self.start_pos.z + add_offset_z
				)
			end
		end
	end
end

--가장 작은 npc를 반환
function local_class:npc_with_smallest_x()
	local return_data = nil
	for idx, npc_pool in pairs(self.npc_pools) do
		if npc_pool[4] then
			if return_data and
					npc_pool[1].Position.x > return_data[1].Position.x then
				return_data = return_data
			else
				return_data = npc_pool
			end
		end
	end

	return return_data
end

function local_class:random_pop_npc()
	local return_data = false

	while not return_data do
		local random_factor = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.npc_pools - 1)

		if not self.npc_pools[random_factor][4] then
			self.npc_pools[random_factor][4] = true

			return_data = self.npc_pools[random_factor]
		end
	end

	return return_data
end

-- 맵 밖으로 못 나가도록 투명 벽 설치
function local_class:create_boundary_walls()
	local wall_data = {
		top_wall = {
			hitbox_size = vector(60, 1, 1),
			position = self.background_center + vector(0, 0, 7.5)
		},
		bot_wall = {
			hitbox_size = vector(60, 1, 1),
			position = self.background_center + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
		},
		left_wall = {
			hitbox_size = vector(1, 0.2, 60),
			position = self.controller.center_pos + vector(-stage_camera.HalfWidth, 0, 0)
		},
		right_wall = {
			hitbox_size = vector(1, 0.2, 60),
			position = self.controller.center_pos + vector(stage_camera.HalfWidth, 0, 0)
		}
	}

	self.walls = {}
	self.walls_original_pos = {}

	for wall_name, wall_info in pairs(wall_data) do
		local wall = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		wall.Name = wall_name
		wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(wall_info.hitbox_size)
		wall.Position = wall_info.position
		wall.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.DefaultCrashBehaviour.Instance
		wall.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

		self.walls[wall_name] = wall
		self.walls_original_pos[wall_name] = wall.Position

		message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(wall))
	end
end

function local_class:set_speed(speed)
	self.cur_speed = speed
end

function local_class:change_speed(speed, duration)
	local start_speed = self.cur_speed
	local end_speed = speed

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local change_speed = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_speed, end_speed, progress)

		if self.controller and self.controller.current_game_state ~= self.controller.game_state.ending then
			self.cur_speed = change_speed
		end
	end)

	----기존 속도로
	--if self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending then
	--	return
	--end

	self:set_speed(end_speed)

	return true
end

function local_class:scene_change_speed(speed, duration)
	local start_speed = self.cur_speed
	local end_speed = speed

	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(duration, function(progress)
		local change_speed = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_speed, end_speed, progress)

		self.cur_speed = change_speed
	end)

	self:set_speed(end_speed)

	return true
end


-- 플레이어의 z축 이동을 막는 함수
function local_class:block_vertical_movement(e)
	local player = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).player
	local top_wall = self.walls.top_wall
	local bot_wall = self.walls.bot_wall

	if player.Bounds.center.z >= (top_wall.Position.z + -0.5) then
		if e.StickDirection.z > 0 then
			return true
		end
	elseif player.Bounds.center.z <= (bot_wall.Position.z + 1.5) then
		if e.StickDirection.z < 0 then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class();
	end
}

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  장애물/부스터 매니저
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region item_base
local item_manager = newclass('MWRacingItem')

local item_base = newclass('MWRacingitemBase')
local obstacle_item = newclass('MWRacingitemObstacle', item_base)
local booster_item = newclass('MWRacingitemBooster', item_base)

local manager_type = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerType')
local manager_container = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerContainer')
local state_type = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/State')

function item_manager:init(controller)
	self.item = nil
	self.obstacle = nil
	self.booster = nil

	--region FX
	self.fx = {
		collision_obstacle = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_collision_obstacle')
		end,
		collision_booster = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_collision_booster')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion FX

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
end

function item_manager:load_resource(constants, item_pools, npc_name)
	local hit_box = constants.hit_box

	for _, target in pairs(item_pools) do
		target.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(target.Hitbox.pivot.x, target.Hitbox.pivot.y,
				target.Hitbox.pivot.z + 0.25), vector(hit_box.x, hit_box.y, hit_box.z))
	end
end

function item_manager:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.fx:load_all()
end

function item_manager:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end

function item_manager:start_routine()
	self.obstacle = obstacle_item(self)
	self.booster = booster_item(self)

	self.obstacle:enter()
	self.booster:enter()
end
function item_manager:reset_setting()
	if self.state then
		self.state:exit()
		self.state:dispose()
	end

	self:clean()

	for _, target in pairs(self.controller.obstacle_pools) do
		target.Position = self.controller.wait_pos
	end

	for _, target in pairs(self.controller.booster_pools) do
		target.Position = self.controller.wait_pos
	end
end

function item_manager:clean()
	self.item = nil
	self.obstacle = nil
	self.booster = nil
end

function item_manager:update_routine(dt)
	if not (self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending) then
		--메인 게임에서 체크
		self.obstacle:update(dt)
		self.booster:update(dt)
	end
end

function item_base:init(controller, item_type)
	self.controller = controller

	self.main_controller = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)
	self.player_controller = self.main_controller.player_manager
	self.opponent_controller = self.main_controller.opponent_manager

	self.constants_data = self.main_controller.item_constants_data

	self.booster_constants_data = self.main_controller.item_constants_data.booster
	self.obstacle_constants_data = self.main_controller.item_constants_data.obstacle

	self.player = self.player_controller.player
	self.opponent = self.controller.controller.opponent_constants_data:get_opponent()

	self.item_scroll_dir_vec = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	self.item_name = item_type

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.item_reset_pos = self.main_controller.center_pos + vector(-self.constants_data.item_reset_pos, 0, 0)--screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', self.main_controller.center_pos, -1).x

	self.item_type = nil

	self.pattern_count = nil

	self.item_pools = nil

	self.background_controller = manager_container:get(manager_type.background)

	self.start_pos = nil

	self.wait_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function item_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end

function item_base:scroll_item(target_pools, dt, item_name)
	local velocity = self.item_scroll_dir_vec *
			self.background_controller.cur_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

	for idx = 1, #target_pools do
		if target_pools[idx][2] then
			target_pools[idx][1].Position = target_pools[idx][1].Position + velocity

			self:check_collision(target_pools[idx], item_name)

			--해당 위치보다 타겟위치가 작아지면 리셋
			if self.item_reset_pos.x > target_pools[idx][1].Position.x then
				target_pools[idx][1].Position = self.wait_pos
				target_pools[idx][2] = false
			end
		end
	end
	--end
end

function item_base:check_collision(target, item_name)
	local opponent_controller = manager_container:get(manager_type.opponent)
	local player_controller = manager_container:get(manager_type.player)

	if self:aabb(opponent_controller.opponent.Bounds, target[1].Bounds) then
		self:on_collide(opponent_controller, target, item_name)

		return true
	end

	if self:aabb(player_controller.player.Bounds, target[1].Bounds) then
		self:on_collide(player_controller, target, item_name)

		return true
	end
end

function item_base:aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

function item_base:common_update_routine(dt)
	if manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game).time_stop then
		dt = 0
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local pattern_constants_data = self.constants_data.pattern[self.pattern_count]
	local time_is_the_same = false

	if pattern_constants_data then
		if self.time_passed >= pattern_constants_data.time and
				not (pattern_constants_data.time == 0) then
			while not time_is_the_same do
				local idx = self:pop_item(self.item_pools)
				local add_offset_z = self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[pattern_constants_data.track]

				self.item_pools[idx][1].Position = self.start_pos + vector(0, 0, add_offset_z)

				self.pattern_count = self.pattern_count + 1

				local post_time = self.constants_data.pattern[self.pattern_count]

				if not post_time then
					return
				end

				if pattern_constants_data.time ~= post_time.time then
					time_is_the_same = true
				end

				pattern_constants_data = self.constants_data.pattern[self.pattern_count]
			end
		end
	end

	self:scroll_item(self.item_pools, dt, self.item_name)
end

function item_base:pop_item(target_pools)
	for idx = 1, #target_pools do
		if not target_pools[idx][2] then
			target_pools[idx][2] = true

			return idx
		end
	end
end

function item_base:on_collide(controller, target_data, item_name)
	local opponent_controller = manager_container:get(manager_type.opponent)
	local player_controller = manager_container:get(manager_type.player)

	--충돌
	local is_collide = opponent_controller.current_state.type ~= state_type.opponent.special_attack and
			(player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.normal or
					player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.wait or
					player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.faint)

	if item_name == state_type.item.obstacle then
		self.controller.fx.collision_obstacle():Instantiate(target_data[1].Bounds.center)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_break_01')

		if is_collide then
			controller:on_collide(target_data[1], item_name)
		end
	elseif item_name == state_type.item.booster then
		if opponent_controller.current_state.type ~= state_type.opponent.special_attack and
				not (controller == opponent_controller and opponent_controller.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.wrestle) then
			controller:on_collide(target_data[1], item_name)
		end
		self.controller.fx.collision_booster():Instantiate(target_data[1].Bounds.center)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_power_up_01')
	end

	target_data[1].Position = self.wait_pos
	target_data[2] = false

	return
end
--endregion item_base

--region obstacle_item
function obstacle_item:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.item.obstacle)
end

function obstacle_item:enter()
	self.super.time_passed = 0
	self.super.pattern_count = 1

	self.super.item_pools = {}

	self.super.constants_data = self.super.main_controller.item_constants_data.obstacle
	self.super.common_constants_data = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game).common_constants_data

	for _, value in pairs(self.super.main_controller.obstacle_pools) do
		table.insert(self.super.item_pools, { value, false })
	end

	self.super.start_pos = self.super.main_controller.center_pos + vector(self.super.constants_data.start_pos, 0, 0)--screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', self.super.main_controller.center_pos, 1)
end

function obstacle_item:exit()
end

function obstacle_item:dispose()
end

function obstacle_item:update(dt)
	self.super:common_update_routine(dt)
end
--endregion obstacle_item

--region booster_item
function booster_item:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.item.booster)
end

function booster_item:enter()
	self.super.time_passed = 0
	self.super.pattern_count = 1

	self.super.item_pools = {}

	self.super.constants_data = self.super.main_controller.item_constants_data.booster
	self.super.common_constants_data = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game).common_constants_data

	for _, value in pairs(self.super.main_controller.booster_pools) do
		table.insert(self.super.item_pools, { value, false })
	end

	self.super.start_pos = self.super.main_controller.center_pos + vector(self.super.constants_data.start_pos, 0, 0)--screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', self.super.main_controller.center_pos, 1)
end

function booster_item:exit()
end

function booster_item:dispose()

end

function booster_item:update(dt)
	self.super:common_update_routine(dt)
end
--endregion booster_item

return {
	create = function()
		return item_manager();
	end
}

function container:init()

	end

end

function container:update_all(dt)
	for type, manager in pairs(self.managers) do
		local is_not_main_game_manager = type ~= manager_type.main_game
		local has_update_routine = manager.update_routine ~= nil

		if is_not_main_game_manager and has_update_routine then
			manager:update_routine(dt)
		end
	end
end

	for type, value in pairs(self.managers) do
		if type == manager_type.main_game then
			goto continue
		end

		local manager = value

		if manager then
			local execute_func = manager[function_name]

			if execute_func then
				execute_func(manager, param)
			end
		end

	end

		end
	end

	}

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)

	self.player_constants_data = self.constants_data.player
	self.opponent_constants_data = self.constants_data.opponent
	self.background_constants_data = self.constants_data.background
	self.item_constants_data = self.constants_data.item
	self.audience_constants_data = self.constants_data.audience

	self.center_pos = self.common_constants_data:center_pos()

	self.time_limit = self.common_constants_data.time_limit

	self.pattern_time = self.opponent_constants_data.pattern_time

	self.ending_scene_playing = false

	if key == 'tutorial' then
		self.is_tutorial = true
	else
		self.is_tutorial = false
	end

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	self.fx.booster_fail = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.player_constants_data.move_data.booster.booster_using_effect)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter')
	self.fx:load_all()

	-- 메니져 테이블에 넣는 순서 중요
	self.managers = {}

	self.player_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/Player')
	manager_container:register(manager_type.player, self.player_manager)

	-- 적군 로드
	self.opponent_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/Opponent')
	manager_container:register(manager_type.opponent, self.opponent_manager)

	-- 배경 로드
	self.background_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/BackGround')
	manager_container:register(manager_type.background, self.background_manager)

	-- UI 로드
	self.ui_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/UI')
	manager_container:register(manager_type.ui, self.ui_manager)

	-- 장애물 / 부스터 로드 (Item)
	self.item_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/Item')
	manager_container:register(manager_type.item, self.item_manager)

	-- 관중 (NPC)
	--self.audience_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/Audience')
	--manager_container:register(manager_type.audience, self.audience_manager)

	self.arrow = {
		parent = nil,
		right = nil,
		left = nil
	}
	self:load_arrow_ui_async()

	self.leader = get_party_leader()

	self.is_playing_game = nil

	if not self.is_tutorial then
		manager_container:execute_manager_func('init_manager', self)
	end

	--장애물 로드
	self.obstacle_pools = {}
	for idx = 1, self.item_constants_data.obstacle.pool_count do
		local target = self.item_constants_data.obstacle.get_obstacle(idx)
		self.obstacle_pools['first_obstacle_' .. idx] = target

		target.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.item_constants_data.obstacle.scale
	end

	--부스터 로드
	self.booster_pools = {}
	self.fx_booster = {}
	for idx = 1, self.item_constants_data.booster.pool_count do
		local booster = self.item_constants_data.booster.get_booster(idx)
		local fx_booster = self.fx.booster():Instantiate(booster.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, booster.Transform)

		fx_booster.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.item_constants_data.booster.scale

		self.booster_pools['first_booster_' .. idx] = booster
		table.insert(self.fx_booster, fx_booster)

	--region 섹션5 튜토리얼용

			'shortstory_mw_summer_powergirl',
			'shortstory_mw_opponent_boat_3',

		self.dynamic_npcs:create_npcs()
	end

	--endregion 섹션5 튜토리얼용

	--관중 로드
	local audience_npc_pools = {}
	for idx = 1, #self.audience_constants_data.npc.spine_name do
		audience_npc_pools['first_audience_npc_' .. idx] = self.audience_constants_data.npc.spine_name[idx]
	end

	self.audience_npc_pools = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(audience_npc_pools)

	self.item_manager:load_resource(self.item_constants_data.obstacle, self.obstacle_pools, 'first_obstacle_')
	self.item_manager:load_resource(self.item_constants_data.obstacle, self.booster_pools, 'first_booster_')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 상대편이 화면 밖으로 나갔을 시 위치 표시해주는 녀석 로드
function local_class:load_arrow_ui_async()
	local path = 'ondemand/short_story_milkyway/ui'
	local item_name = 'RacingArrow'

	self.arrow_ui_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.arrow_ui_res_holder, path, item_name, function(prefab)
				self.arrow.parent = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab, stage.UIRoot.transform)
				self.arrow.right = self.arrow.parent.transform:Find('Right')
				self.arrow.left = self.arrow.parent.transform:Find('Left')

				self.arrow.parent.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			end)
end

function local_class:dispose_arrow_ui()
	self.arrow.right = nil
	self.arrow.left = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.arrow.parent) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.arrow.parent)
		self.arrow.parent = nil
	end

	self.arrow = nil
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:dispose()
	self:dispose_arrow_ui()

	for idx = 1, #self.fx_booster do
		local fx = self.fx_booster[idx]

		if fx then
			fx:Dispose()
			self.fx_booster[idx] = nil
		end
	end
	manager_container:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:all_unsubscribe()

	self.dynamic_npcs:dispose_all()
end

function local_class:all_unsubscribe()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
end

function local_class:section5_tutorial_npc_setting(npc_data)
	for _, target_data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local target = target_data.target
		local target_pos = target_data.pos.first
		local target_dir = target_data.dir
		local target_emo = target_data.emo
		local target_anim = target_data.anim
		local target_is_anim_loop = target_data.is_anim_loop

		field_object_util.set_active_state(target, active_state_type.enabled)

		character_util.set_position(target, target_pos)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)

		scene_util.set_direction(target, target_dir, false)

		if target_emo then
			scene_util.set_emotion(target, self, target_emo)
		end

		if target_anim then
			scene_util.set_anim(target, self, { name = target_anim, loop = target_is_anim_loop })
		end
	end

	return npc_data
end
