function local_class:game_start(is_restarted)
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.starting

	start_coroutine(self.game_start_function, self, is_restarted)
end

function local_class:game_start_function(is_restarted)
	--시어 0
	self.ui_manager:set_zero_shear()

	if self.is_tutorial then
		start_coroutine(self.section5_tutorial_event, self)

		while self.is_tutorial do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))

		return true
	end

	self.ui_manager.navigation_ui:set_active(false)

	camera_util.resize_to(self.common_constants_data.camera_size, 0)
	camera_util.move(self.center_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	self.is_playing_game = true

	manager_container:execute_manager_func('start_routine', self)

	self:start_game(is_restarted)

	self.screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size() / 2

	start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)
end

function local_class:start_game(is_restarted)
	is_restarted = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_restarted, false)

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	local player = self.player_manager.player
	local opponent = self.opponent_manager.opponent

	character_util.set_active_shadow(player, false)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(opponent, false)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(player, field_ui_type.character_stats)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(opponent, field_ui_type.character_stats)

	player.Position = player.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	opponent.Position = opponent.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	local player_fx_ripple_wave = self.fx.ripple_wave():Instantiate(
			player.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.15))

	local opponent_fx_ripple_wave = self.fx.ripple_wave():Instantiate(
			opponent.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.15))

	local amb_fish_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_fish_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	--게임을 진행할 중앙 위치
	if is_restarted then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	--화면 사이즈
	self.screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size() / 2

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	local start_count = 3
	local start_count_string_key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_count'
	local title_mod = 2.1
	for idx = start_count, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format(start_count_string_key, idx), title_mod)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	--대기 이펙트 제거
	if player_fx_ripple_wave then
		player_fx_ripple_wave:Dispose()
		player_fx_ripple_wave = nil
	end

	if opponent_fx_ripple_wave then
		opponent_fx_ripple_wave:Dispose()
		opponent_fx_ripple_wave = nil
	end

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(amb_fish_sfx, 2)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = 'ondemand/short_story_milkyway/preload:bgm_milkyway_racing',
		state = 'event',
		mix = 0
	})

	--02_gun_shoot_01 + 01_crowd_arena_exclamation_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_01')

	self.boat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_boat_loop_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	--02_surfer_wave_01 + 02_bike_rush_01
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_surfer_wave_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bike_rush_01')

	local arcade_rampage_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_arcade_rampage_01', loop = true })

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.time_stop = true

		self.screen_half_size = stage_camera.HalfWidth

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('ss_milkyway_racing_activity_start'))

		--「시작!」 문구가 나오는 동시에, 플레이어와 상대 캐릭터 둘다 booster 자세로 전환되며 0.2초만에 오른쪽으로 3칸 이동 후,
		--0.5초에 걸쳐 왼쪽으로 2칸 이동.
		local wp_key = 'wp_key'

		local fx_booster_fail = self.fx.booster_fail():Instantiate(
				player.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, player.Transform)
		fx_booster_fail.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)

		local player_fx_booster_fire = self.fx.booster_fire():Instantiate(
				player.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5), unity_class.quaternion.identity, player.Transform)

		local opponent_fx_booster_fire = self.fx.booster_fire():Instantiate(
				opponent.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5), unity_class.quaternion.identity, opponent.Transform)

		scene_util.set_anim(player, self, 'booster')
		scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'booster')

		--카메라 패닝속도 35 시작.
		manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
				manager_container:get(manager_type.background).booster_speed)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(player,
				player.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				nil,
				2,
				self,
				wp_key)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(opponent,
				opponent.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
				nil,
				2,
				self,
				wp_key)

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		if player_fx_booster_fire then
			player_fx_booster_fire:Dispose()
			player_fx_booster_fire = nil
		end

		if opponent_fx_booster_fire then
			opponent_fx_booster_fire:Dispose()
			opponent_fx_booster_fire = nil
		end

		if fx_booster_fail then
			fx_booster_fail:Dispose()
			fx_booster_fail = nil
		end

		music_player_util.stop_sfx(arcade_rampage_sfx)
		arcade_rampage_sfx = nil

		scene_util.set_anim(player, self, 'run')
		scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'run')

		--기존 속도로
		manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
				manager_container:get(manager_type.background).original_speed)

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(player,
				player.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
				nil,
				1,
				self,
				wp_key,
				{ last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })

		wp_util.move_with_end_callback(opponent,
				opponent.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0),
				nil,
				1,
				self,
				wp_key,
				{ last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })

		wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

		--동시에 시작선 오브젝트는 1초에 걸쳐 왼쪽으로 8칸 이동하며 화면에서 사라짐. 이후 시작선 오브젝트 제거.
		self.ui_manager.navigation_ui:set_active(true)

		manager_container:get(manager_type.ui):show_minigame_field_ui()

		self.update_navigation = false

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')

		self.time_stop = false
	end)
end

--좌우 제한 상하 이동
function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	local is_stick_direction = lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection)
	local is_game_playing = self.current_game_state == self.game_state.playing
	local is_player_state_playable = (self.player_manager.state.type == state_type.player.normal
			or self.player_manager.state.type == state_type.player.booster
			or self.player_manager.state.type == state_type.player.wait)

	local player = self.player_manager.player
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
	local walls = self.background_manager.walls

	local is_movable = is_stick_direction
			and is_game_playing
			and not self.ui_manager.is_pause
			and is_player_state_playable

	if is_movable then
		local prev_pos = self.player_manager.player.Position
		local delta_move = vector(0, 0, e.StickDirection.z * self.player_constants_data.speed * dt)

		player.Position = player.Position + delta_move

		if player.Bounds.center.z >= (walls.top_wall.Position.z + -0.5) then
			if e.StickDirection.z > 0 then
				self.player_manager.player.Position = prev_pos

				return true
			end
		elseif player.Bounds.center.z <= (walls.bot_wall.Position.z + 1.5) then
			if e.StickDirection.z < 0 then
				self.player_manager.player.Position = prev_pos

				return true
			end
		end

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:reset_setting()
	self:off_opponent_navigation()

	manager_container:execute_manager_func('reset_setting', self)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader)

	self.time_passed = 0

	coroutine.yield()

	self:dispose()
	self:clean()
end

function local_class:clean()
	self.fx_booster = nil

	self.clear_special_event = false

	self.time_stop = false

	self.has_special_attack_event_played = false

	self.effect = nil
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.playing

	while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.playing or
			self.current_game_state == self.game_state.ending do

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not self.time_stop then
			self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
		end

		manager_container:update_all(dt)

		local is_fo_out_screen, direction = self:is_fo_out_screen(self.opponent_manager.opponent)

		self:check_collision()

		if self:should_display_arrow(is_fo_out_screen) then
			if not self.update_navigation then
				-- 한번 들어와서 켜줌
				self:on_opponent_navigation(direction)
				self.update_navigation = true
			else
				-- 켜진 이후 위치만 번경
				if self.effect then
					self:update_opponent_navigation(dt)
				end
			end
		else
			-- 이펙트가 있을 경우
			if self.effect then
				--카메라 안에 보일 경우
				self:off_opponent_navigation()
				self.update_navigation = false
			end
		end

		--거리가 30 이상 차이나면 게임 종료 (패배 시만 적용)
		if self:is_opponent_30_meter_far(direction, is_fo_out_screen) then
			self:game_end(false)
			return
		end

		--시간 초과 게임 종료
		--self.time_limit = 4.5
		if self:is_time_over() then
			self:game_end(nil, self.constants_name)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:on_opponent_navigation(direction)
	local ui_manual_width = (stage.UIRoot.manualWidth / 2) * 0.85

	if direction == direction_constants.right then
		self.effect = self.arrow.right
		self.arrow_x_pos = ui_manual_width
	else
		self.effect = self.arrow.left
		self.arrow_x_pos = -ui_manual_width
	end

	local opponent_row = self:find_opponent_located_row()

	if self.effect ~= nil then

		self.effect.transform.localPosition = vector(self.effect.transform.localPosition.x * self:get_rtl_offset(),
				22 + (-60 * opponent_row), 0)

		self.effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:off_opponent_navigation()
	if self.effect then
		self.effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.effect = nil
		self.arrow_move_timer = 0
	end

	self.update_navigation = false
end

function local_class:update_opponent_navigation(dt)
	local player_row = self:find_opponent_located_row()

	self.effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.arrow_move_timer = self.arrow_move_timer + dt
	local progress = (math.pi / 10) * math.deg(math.sin(10 * self.arrow_move_timer))

	self.effect.transform.localPosition = vector(
			(self.arrow_x_pos + progress) * self:get_rtl_offset(),
			22 + (-80 * player_row),
			0)
end

function local_class:get_rtl_offset()
	if CS.GameStrings.Instance.IsRTL then
		return -1
	else
		return 1
	end
end

function local_class:find_opponent_located_row()
	local opponent_z = self.opponent_manager.opponent.Position.z

	local row_1_z = self.center_pos.z + self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[1]
	local row_2_z = self.center_pos.z + self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[2]
	local row_3_z = self.center_pos.z + self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[3]
	local row_4_z = self.center_pos.z + self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[4]

	if opponent_z <= row_1_z and opponent_z > row_2_z then
		return 0
	elseif opponent_z <= row_2_z and opponent_z > row_3_z then
		return 1
	elseif opponent_z <= row_3_z and opponent_z > row_4_z then
		return 2
	else
		return 3
	end

	return -1
end

function local_class:is_opponent_30_meter_far(opp_heading_dir, is_fo_out_screen)
	local opponent = self.opponent_manager.opponent
	local player = self.player_manager.player

	local is_playing_special_attack = self.opponent_manager.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.special_attack
	local is_game_plyaing = self.current_game_state == self.game_state.playing
	local is_opp_above_30_meter = (opponent.Position - player.Position).magnitude > 30
	local is_opponent_moving_right = opp_heading_dir == direction_constants.right

	return not self.time_stop and is_playing_special_attack and is_game_plyaing and
			is_opp_above_30_meter and is_fo_out_screen and is_opponent_moving_right
end

function local_class:is_time_over()
	return self.time_passed >= self.time_limit and not self.ending_scene_playing
end

function local_class:should_display_arrow(is_fo_out_screen)
	local is_playing_special_attack = self.opponent_manager.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.special_attack

	return is_fo_out_screen and
			not is_playing_special_attack and
			self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.ending
end

--region custom
function local_class:aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

function local_class:check_collision()
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.ending then
		return
	end

	local opponent = manager_container:get(manager_type.opponent).opponent
	local player = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).player

	if self:aabb(opponent.Bounds, player.Bounds) then
		local player_hit_info = {
			target = opponent,
			state = self.opponent_manager.current_state.type
		}

		local opponent_hit_info = {
			target = player,
			state = self.player_manager.state.type
		}

		manager_container:get(manager_type.player):on_collide(player_hit_info)
		manager_container:get(manager_type.opponent):on_collide(opponent_hit_info)
	end
end

function local_class:winner_check()
	local distance = self.player_manager.player.Position.x -
			self.opponent_manager.opponent.Position.x

	if distance > 0 then
		--0보다 클 경우 플레이어 승리

		return true
	elseif distance <= 0 then
		--0보다 작을 경우 플레이어 패배

		return false
	end
end

--엔딩 시 초기화
function local_class:game_end_reset_state()
	self.player_manager:change_normal_state()
	self.opponent_manager:change_normal_state()
end

function local_class:game_end(is_win, stage_name)
	self.time_stop = true
	self.is_playing_game = false

	self:all_unsubscribe()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.ending

	--승패
	self:game_end_reset_state()

	self:remove_boat_sfx()

	--패배
	if not self:winner_check() or is_win and not self.ending_scene_playing then
		--보트 물에 잠길 떄 루프 종료, 믹스 1초
		--결승선 카메라 이동 시 루프 종료, 믹스 1초
		if stage_name == 'shortstory_milkyway_5' then
			self:failed_game_scene(self.section5_failed_scene)
		elseif stage_name == 'shortstory_milkyway_8' then
			self:failed_game_scene(self.section8_failed_scene)
		elseif stage_name == 'shortstory_milkyway_12' then
			self:failed_game_scene(self.section12_failed_scene)
		else
			-- 졌을 경우 재진행
			self:restart_game(false, nil, true)
		end

		return true
	end

	--승리 후 종료 엔딩 이벤트
	if stage_name == 'shortstory_milkyway_5' then
		self:succeed_game_scene(self.section5_ending)
	elseif stage_name == 'shortstory_milkyway_8' then
		self:succeed_game_scene(self.section8_ending)
	elseif stage_name == 'shortstory_milkyway_12' then
		self:succeed_game_scene(self.section12_ending)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:failed_game_scene(cb_failed_section_scene)
	self.ending_scene_playing = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		sp_util.enter_scene()

		self.ui_manager:hide_all_ui()

		cb_failed_section_scene(self)

		self.ending_scene_playing = false
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none

		while self.ending_scene_playing do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
		-- 졌을 경우 재진행
		self:restart_game()
	end)
end

function local_class:arrival_at_the_finish_line_scene(winner, loser, track_number)
	local player = self.player_manager.player

	local player_pos = player.Position

	local dist = winner.Position.x - loser.Position.x

	local wp_key = 'wp_key'

	--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗음.
	--상대 캐릭터 위치를 (2번 라인 / 플레이어 보다 12칸 오른쪽 ) 에 있도록 강제 위치 수정.
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(loser,
			vector(self.center_pos.x - 25 - dist, 0, loser.Position.z),
			40,
			nil,
			self,
			wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(winner,
			vector(self.center_pos.x - 25, 0, winner.Position.z),
			40,
			nil,
			self,
			wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })

	manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(80)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--오브젝트 : 밀키웨이 레이싱 타일셋/오브젝트 요청 문서
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.clear

	--1초에 걸쳐 카메라 오른쪽으로 14칸 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(20, 0, 0), 0.2)

	--플레이어 위치의 오른쪽 14칸에 ‘레이싱 도착선 (2x8)’ 오브젝트 출현.
	local mc = get_party_leader()

	local mc_bubble_scale = self.constants_data.common.mc_bubble_scale
	local mc_bubble_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

	--진행자 : [shout] 승자는…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(mc, {
		key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_end',
		skip = false,
		scale = mc_bubble_scale,
		viewport_pos = mc_bubble_pos,
		bubble_type = 'shout' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--02_surfer_wave_01 + 02_lucy_shoot_08
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_surfer_wave_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lucy_shoot_08')

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(winner,
			vector(player_pos.x + 54, 0, winner.Position.z),
			self.common_constants_data.scene_related.speed,
			nil,
			self,
			wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })

	wp_util.move_with_end_callback(loser,
			vector(player_pos.x + 54, 0, loser.Position.z),
			self.common_constants_data.scene_related.speed,
			nil,
			self,
			wp_key,
			{ last_direction = 'right', locked_dir = 'right' })

	wp_util.wait_move_end(self, wp_key)
	--상대 캐릭터, 플레이어 순으로 (속도값:8) 결승선 오브젝트 통과하며 화면 오른쪽으로 사라짐.

function local_class:section5_ending()
	--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗음.
	--상대 캐릭터 위치를 (3번 라인 / 플레이어 보다 12칸 왼쪽 ) 에 있도록 강제 위치 수정.
	--플레이어 위치의 오른쪽 14칸에 ‘레이싱 도착선 (2x8)’ 오브젝트 출현.
	--오브젝트 : 밀키웨이 레이싱 타일셋/오브젝트 요청 문서

function local_class:section12_ending()

		----플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗음.

		----1초에 걸쳐 카메라 오른쪽으로 14칸 이동.

		----대기 1초.
		local player = self.player_manager.player
		local opponent = self.opponent_manager.opponent

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		})

		local mc = get_party_leader()

		local mc_bubble_scale = self.constants_data.common.mc_bubble_scale
		local mc_bubble_pos = vector(0.5, 0.75)

		local center_pos = self.center_pos

		local track_add_offset = {
			vector(0, 0, self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[1]),
			vector(0, 0, self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[2]),
			vector(0, 0, self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[3]),
			vector(0, 0, self.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[4]),
		}

		player.Position = center_pos + track_add_offset[3] + vector(-4, 0, 0)
		opponent.Position = center_pos + track_add_offset[3] + vector(6, 0, 1)

		--매드팬더팀 보트 (right, idle, run)
		--붉은장미 해적단 보트 (right, idle, run)
		scene_util.set_anim(player, self, 'run')
		scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'run')

		local dynamic_npc_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({
			npc_1 = 'shortstory_mw_flag',
		})

		--for idx, target in pairs(dynamic_npc_list) do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(dynamic_npc_list['npc_1'], 0, 0)

		dynamic_npc_list['npc_1'].Position = player.Position
		--end

		--화면 1초에 걸쳐 일반 페이드 인.
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		--진행자 : 결승전 답게 아주 치열하군요!! 현재 매드팬더단이 좀 더 앞선 상태!!
		--진행자의 대사는 화면 상단에 1.5배 크기로 출력됨 (이하 공통)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_03')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(mc, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_1',
				  skip = false, scale = mc_bubble_scale, viewport_pos = mc_bubble_pos, type_speed = 0.01 })

		--대기 0.5초
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--매드팬더팀 보트의 스칼렛 (right, damaged, run) : 진짜 끈질긴 놈들이네…!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(opponent, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'damaged',
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_2', bubble_direction = 'none',
				  offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct],
				  skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		--매드팬더팀 보트의 스칼렛 (right, attack, run) : 팬더! 그걸 써!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(opponent, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'attack',
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_3', bubble_direction = 'none',
				  offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct],
				  skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		--매드 팬더단 중심으로 0.2초만에 줌 인 5로 실행.
		camera_util.move(opponent.Position, 0.2)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0.2)

		--매드 팬더 보트 (right, attack, cannon_up) 실행.
		scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'cannon_up')

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_01')

		local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(opponent, 'cannon_up')

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.9)

		scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'cannon_up_run')

		local missile_pos_adj = vector(-1.2, 3, 0)
		local spawn_pos = opponent.Position + missile_pos_adj

		--매드팬더팀 보트 좌상단 포구에서 fx_panda_boat_missile_shoot(임시 : fx_party_mad_panda_basic_missile_fire)이
		--5회 연속 0.2초 간격으로 실행
		-- + fx_cwp_villainandroid_helicopter_missile_proj 5개가 0.2초 간격으로 Y축 하늘로 올라갑니다.
		local missile_list = {}

		local missile_func = function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_01')

			local missile = self.fx.villainandroid_proj():Instantiate(spawn_pos)
			missile.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 90)

			table.insert(missile_list, missile)

			self.fx.missile_shoot():Instantiate(spawn_pos)

			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.5, function(progress)
				local cur_pos_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 5, progress)

				missile.transform.position = missile.transform.position + vector(0, cur_pos_y, 0)
			end)
		end

		local missile_attack_func = function(target)
			local missile = target
			missile.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -90)

			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.5, function(progress)
				local cur_pos_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(15, 0, progress)

				missile.transform.position = vector(
						missile.transform.position.x, cur_pos_y, missile.transform.position.z)
			end)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_02')
			self.fx.water_splash_in():Instantiate(missile.transform.position)

			missile.transform.position = self.wait_pos
		end

		--미사일 5발 발사
		for idx = 1, 5 do
			start_coroutine(function()
				missile_func()
			end)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end

		--매드팬더팀 보트의 팬더 (right, attack, run) : 이거나 먹고 떨어지라고!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(opponent, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'attack',
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_4', bubble_direction = 'none',
				  offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct],
				  skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		--카메라 붉은 장미 해적단 중심으로 0.2초만에 패닝.
		camera_util.move_to_target_async(player, 0.2)

		--이후 붉은장미단 보트 주위로 어택 레인지(붉은 원 지점 5곳 참조) 가 1초간 채워지며,
		local target_pos_list = {
			player.Position + vector(1, missile_list[1].transform.position.y, -1),
			player.Position + vector(0, missile_list[1].transform.position.y, 1.5),
			player.Position + vector(1.5, missile_list[1].transform.position.y, 1.25),
			player.Position + vector(-1, missile_list[1].transform.position.y, -1),
			player.Position + vector(-1.5, missile_list[1].transform.position.y, 1.25)
		}
		local target_range = {}

		local range = 1

		for idx = 1, 5 do
			local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos_list[idx], 0.1)

			local attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle(target_pos,
					range, nil, nil, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

			--어택 레인지 발생과 함께 한번 재생
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bombard_range_01')

			attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 1)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			table.insert(target_range, attack_range)
		end

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, 'scared')

			--폭탄이 붉은 장미 해적단 보트에 닿았을 때, 화면 0.4값으로 1초 shake
			camera_util.shake(0.4, 1)

			local background_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.background)

			background_manager:scene_change_speed(0, 1)

			--동시에 매드 팬더단 보트 0.5초에 걸쳐 2번 지점으로 이동하여 화면 이탈.
			wp_util.move_async(opponent, opponent.Position + vector(20, 0, 0),
					nil, 0.5)

			scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'run')
		end)

		--모두 채워지는 타이밍에 맞춰 fx_cwp_villainandroid_helicopter_missile_proj 5개가 일제히 떨어지고,
		--도착하면 fx_common_water_splash_in을 실행.
		for idx, target in pairs(missile_list) do
			local attack_range = target_range[idx]

			target.transform.position = target_pos_list[idx]

			start_coroutine(function()
				missile_attack_func(target)
				attack_range:Hide()
			end)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--붉은 장비 보트 (right, idle, idle) 전환 + 보트 하반부에 fx_mw_water_ripple_wave 출력.
		character_util.remove_anim(player)

		local fx_ripple_wave = self.fx.ripple_wave():Instantiate(
				player.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.15))

		self:remove_boat_sfx()

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 5 })

		local beach_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_amb_beach_01',
			loop = true,
			volume = 0.7,
			fade_in_time = 3
		})

		--대기 1초
		wait_for_sec(1)

		for idx = 1, 5 do
			local attack_range = target_range[idx]
			if attack_range ~= nil then
				attack_range_util.destroy(attack_range)
			end
		end

		target_range = nil

		--붉은장미 해적단 보트에서 fx_pirate_boat_smoke_start_loop(임시 : fx_black_smoke) 이펙트를 출력 후 달아줌.
		local boat_smoke_start = self.fx.boat_smoke_start_loop():Instantiate(player.Position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, player.transform)

		--진행자 : 아아아!!! 매드팬더단의 폭탄 공격을 맞은 붉은 장미 해적단! 보트에서 연기가 나기 시작합니다!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(mc, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_5',
				  skip = false, scale = mc_bubble_scale * 0.6, viewport_pos = mc_bubble_pos, type_speed = 0.01 })

		--5초간 아래의 대사 순서대로 + 해당 시점부터 각 캐릭터 대사 말꼬리로 실행.
		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
		scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, 'panic')

		local npc_offset = {
			pirate = vector(0.5, 0, 0.1),
			star_girl = vector(0.25, 0, 0.2),
			innuit = vector(-0.1, 0, 0.1),
			titan = vector(-0.3, 0, -0.3),
			human = vector(0.1, 0, -0.2),
		}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(player, {
			key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_6',
			bubble_direction = 'ct',
			offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct] + npc_offset.human,
			skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(player, {
			key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_7',
			bubble_direction = 'ct',
			offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct] + npc_offset.titan,
			skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(player, {
			key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_8',
			bubble_direction = 'ct',
			offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct] + npc_offset.innuit,
			skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(player, {
			key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_9',
			bubble_direction = 'ct',
			offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct] + npc_offset.star_girl,
			skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		--0.2초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 3으로 줌인.
		camera_util.move(player.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.2)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 0.2)

		--붉은장미 보트의 레이첼 (right, panic, idle) : ……아직이야.
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(player, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				'panic',
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_10', bubble_direction = 'ct',
				  offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct] + npc_offset.pirate,
				  skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		--붉은장미 보트의 레이첼 (right, attack, idle) : 우리 정비사가 비장의 수를 남겨뒀거든…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(player, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ name = 'attack', keep = true },
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_11', bubble_direction = 'ct',
				  offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct] + npc_offset.pirate,
				  skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		--붉은장미 보트의 레나 (right, attack, idle) : ……설마?! 안돼 레이첼! 그랬다간 이 보트가…!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(player, self,
				nil,
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'ss_milkyway_racing_activity_finish_s12_12', bubble_direction = 'ct',
				  offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct] + npc_offset.star_girl,
				  skip = true, scale = 1.5 })

		--붉은장미 보트의 레이첼 (right, attack, idle) : 그런 건 나도 알아! 하지만 이대로…!

local manager_type = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerType')
local manager_container = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerContainer')
local state_type = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/State')
local opponent_state = state_type.opponent
local player_state = state_type.player
local item_type = state_type.item

-- 프레임에 영향을 받지 않는 smoothing 기능. 아직 실험적 기능임.
local function exp_decay(a, b, decay, dt)
	return b + (a-b) * math.exp(-decay * dt)
end

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                상대편 상태 인터페이스
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--#region opponent_state_base
local opponent_state_base = newclass('IMWRacingOpponentState')

function opponent_state_base:init(controller, state_type)
	self.controller = controller
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state_finished = false
	self.type = state_type

	-- 매니저 캐싱
	self.game_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)
	self.player_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.player)
	self.ui_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.ui)
end

function opponent_state_base:enter(prev_state)
end

function opponent_state_base:exit()
end

function opponent_state_base:collided_with_player(state)
end

function opponent_state_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end

function opponent_state_base:intro_start()
	manager_container:get(manager_type.ui):hide_minigame_field_ui()

	-- 플레이어 화면 중앙 정렬
	local center = self.game_manager.center_pos
	wp_util.move(self.player_manager.player, { center - vector(0, 0, 2.5) }, nil, 1.5)
end

function opponent_state_base:outro_start()
	manager_container:get(manager_type.ui):hide_minigame_field_ui()

	-- 중앙 정렬
	wp_util.move(self.player_manager.player, { self.player_manager.player_data.start_pos }, nil, 1.5 , {
		locked_dir = 'right'
	})
end

function opponent_state_base:find_boundary_pos(opponent, dist_factor, row)
	row = lua_helper.get_or_default(row, 2)

	local has_found_boundary_pos = false
	local x_distance = 1

	local search_pos = self.game_manager.center_pos

	while not has_found_boundary_pos do
		if not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(search_pos) then
			break
		end

		search_pos = vector(self.game_manager.center_pos.x + (x_distance * dist_factor), 0, opponent.Position.z)

		x_distance = x_distance + 1
	end

	local add_offset_z = self.game_manager.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[row]
	local target_pos_z = add_offset_z + self.game_manager.center_pos.z

	local bound_size_adj = (opponent.Bounds.size.x * 0.75) * -dist_factor

	-- 좌표 1 단위로 보정해서 넘김
	return vector(math.floor(search_pos.x + bound_size_adj), 0, target_pos_z)
end

--endregion



-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                   기본 상태

--#region opponent_normal_state
local opponent_normal_state = newclass('MWRacingOpponentNormalState', opponent_state_base)

end

function opponent_normal_state:exit()
end

function opponent_normal_state:update(dt)
end

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                   부스터 상태
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--#region opponent_booster_state
local opponent_booster_state = newclass('MWRacingOpponentBoosterState', opponent_state_base)

function opponent_booster_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, opponent_state.booster)
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.fx_booster_fire = nil

	self.start_pos = controller.opponent.Position

	self.move_data = controller.constants_data.move_data.booster
	self.speed = self.move_data.distance / self.move_data.duration
	self.dest_pos = self.start_pos + vector(self.move_data.distance, 0, 0)
	self.player_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.player)

	self.end_pos = controller.opponent.Position + (self.move_data.distance * vector(1, 0, 0))
	self.duration = self.move_data.duration

	self.booster_sfx = nil

	self.has_collided_with_player = false
end

function opponent_booster_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.cur_speed = (self.end_pos - self.start_pos).magnitude / self.duration
	self.cur_direction = (vector(self.end_pos.x, 0, 0) - vector(self.start_pos.x, 0, 0)).normalized

	scene_util.set_emotion(self.controller.opponent, self.controller, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(self.controller.opponent, self.controller, 'booster')

	self.booster_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_arcade_rampage_01', loop = true, mix = 0.5 })

	self.fx_booster_fire = self.controller.fx.booster_fire():Instantiate(
			self.controller.opponent.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5), unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.controller.opponent.Transform)
	self.fx_booster_fire.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
end

function opponent_booster_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:move_speed_routine(dt)

	if self.state_finished then
		self.super.controller:change_state(opponent_normal_state(self.controller))
	end
end

function opponent_booster_state:move_speed_routine(dt)
	local velocity = self.cur_direction * self.cur_speed * dt

	if self.player_manager.state.type ~= state_type.player.booster then
		self.controller.opponent.Position = self.controller.opponent.Position + velocity
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.state_finished = true
	end
end

function opponent_booster_state:collided_with_player()
	-- 부스터 사용 중, 플레이어와 부딫혀서 받는 효과는 한번만 적용.
	if self.has_collided_with_player then
		return
	end

	-- 추가로 2 칸을 더 가게끔 해줌다.
	self.has_collided_with_player = true
	self.dest_pos = self.dest_pos + vector(2, 0, 0)
end

function opponent_booster_state:exit()
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.controller.opponent)
	scene_util.set_anim(self.controller.opponent, self.controller, 'run')

	if self.booster_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.booster_sfx)
		self.booster_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.fx_booster_fire then
		self.fx_booster_fire:Dispose()
		self.fx_booster_fire = nil
	end
end

function opponent_booster_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end
--#endregion opponent_booster_state

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  이동 상태
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region opponent_move_state
local opponent_move_state = newclass('MWRacingOpponentMoveState', opponent_state_base)

function opponent_move_state:init(controller, pos, duration)
	self.super:init(controller, opponent_state.move)
	self.opponent = controller.opponent
	self.end_pos = self.opponent.Position + pos
	self.duration = duration
	--self.speed = distance / duration
	self.start_pos = self.opponent.Position
	self.move_end = false
end

function opponent_move_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function opponent_move_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.cur_speed = (self.end_pos - self.start_pos).magnitude / self.duration
	self.cur_direction = (vector(self.end_pos.x, 0, 0) - vector(self.start_pos.x, 0, 0)).normalized
end

function opponent_move_state:exit(next_state)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.controller.opponent, { name = 'smile' })
end

function opponent_move_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	--self:move_lerp_routine()
	self:move_speed_routine(dt)
	if self.state_finished then
		self.super.controller:change_state(opponent_normal_state(self.controller))
	end
end

function opponent_move_state:move_lerp_routine()
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.duration)
	self.opponent.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.opponent.Position = self.end_pos
		self.state_finished = true
	end

	return true
end

function opponent_move_state:move_speed_routine(dt)
	local velocity = self.cur_direction * self.cur_speed * dt

	self.opponent.Position = self.opponent.Position + velocity

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.state_finished = true
	end
end
--endregion



-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////

--#region opponent_bump_behind_state
local opponent_bump_behind_state = newclass('MWRacingOpponentBumpBehindState', opponent_state_base)

function opponent_bump_behind_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, opponent_state.bump_behind)
	self.progress = {
		phase_1 = 1,
		phase_2 = 2,
	}
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.phase_1
	self.opponent = controller.opponent
	self.player = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).player
	self.move_data = controller.constants_data.move_data.behind

	self.target_data = nil
end

function opponent_bump_behind_state:enter(prev_state)
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('racing_center_pos')

	self.target_data = {}

	self.target_data[self.progress.phase_1] = {
		direction = self.opponent.Position.z < center_pos.z and
				vector(0, 0, -1) or vector(0, 0, 1),
		speed = self.move_data.height_distance / self.move_data.height_duration,
		duration = self.move_data.height_duration
	}

	--충돌 즉시
	--좌측에 있는 캐릭터 표정 damaged로 변경.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player, { name = 'damaged' })

	--A초 지난 후, 좌측에 있는 캐릭터 표정 smile로 변경.
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player)

	--카메라 shake 0.3초간 세기 0.15로.
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)

	if (center_pos.z) - 2 <= self.opponent.Position.z and
			self.target_data[self.progress.phase_1].direction == vector(0, 0, 1) then
		self.target_data[self.progress.phase_1].direction = self.target_data[self.progress.phase_1].direction * -1

	elseif (center_pos.z) - 6 >= self.opponent.Position.z and
			self.target_data[self.progress.phase_1].direction == vector(0, 0, -1) then
		self.target_data[self.progress.phase_1].direction = self.target_data[self.progress.phase_1].direction * -1
	end

	self.target_data[self.progress.phase_2] = {
		direction = self.opponent.Position.z < center_pos.z and
				vector(1, 0, 0) or vector(-1, 0, 0),
		speed = self.move_data.width_distance / self.move_data.width_duration,
		duration = self.move_data.width_duration
	}

	manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
			manager_container:get(manager_type.background).obstacle_speed)

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.phase_2
end

function opponent_bump_behind_state:exit()
	manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
			manager_container:get(manager_type.background).original_speed)
end

function opponent_bump_behind_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function opponent_bump_behind_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local cur_move_data = self.target_data[self.cur_progress]
	--local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.each_move_duration)
	--self.opponent.Position = vector_util.lerp(cur_move_data.start_pos, cur_move_data.target_pos, progress)

	local velocity = cur_move_data.direction * cur_move_data.speed * dt

	self.opponent.Position = self.opponent.Position + velocity

	if self.time_passed >= cur_move_data['duration'] then
		if self.cur_progress == self.progress.phase_1 then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.phase_2
			self.time_passed = 0
		elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.phase_2 then
			self.state_finished = true
		end
	end
end

--endregion opponent_bump_behind_state


-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////

local opponent_obstacle_state = newclass('MilkyWayRacingOpponentObstacleState', opponent_state_base)

function opponent_obstacle_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, opponent_state.obstacle)

	self.start_pos = controller.opponent.Position

	self.move_data = controller.constants_data.move_data.obstacle
	self.speed = self.move_data.distance / self.move_data.duration
	self.dest_pos = self.start_pos + vector(-self.move_data.distance, 0, 0)

function opponent_obstacle_state:enter(prev_state)

	character_util.set_emotion(self.controller.opponent, { name = 'damaged' })

	--카메라 shake 0.3초간 세기 0.15로.
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)

function opponent_obstacle_state:exit()

	character_util.set_emotion(self.controller.opponent, { name = 'smile' })

	self.time_passed = 0

	opponent.Position = exp_decay(opponent.Position, self.dest_pos, self.speed, dt)

		opponent.Position = self.dest_pos

	end

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  5 섹션용 특수 공격 이벤트
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--#region kanterbury_special_attack_state
local kanterbury_special_attack_state = newclass('MWKanterburySpecialAttackState', opponent_state_base)

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, opponent_state.special_attack)
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	controller.has_played_special_event = true

	self.is_intro_finished = false
	self.is_outro_playing = false

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state_duration = controller.special_attack_data.pattern_duration

	-- 이동 방향 벡터
	self.move_dir_vec = nil

	-- 충돌 체크용 벽 이름
	self.current_collided_wall = nil
	self.previous_collided_wall = nil

	-- 이동 정보
	self.move_info = nil

	self.move_speed = controller.special_attack_data.move_speed

	-- 플레이어와 부딫힌 횟수
	self.num_crashed_with_player = 0

	-- 이펙트
	self.whirlwind_fx = nil

	self.walls = nil

	self.sfx = nil
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:enter(prev_state)
	start_coroutine(self.intro, self)
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:exit()
	if self.sfx ~= nil then
		self.sfx:Stop()
		self.sfx = nil
	end

	if self.whirlwind_fx ~= nil then
		self.whirlwind_fx:Dispose()
	end
	self.whirlwind_fx = nil

	self.move_speed = 5
	self.move_duration = 1
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.walls = nil
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:update(dt)
	if not self.is_intro_finished then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local is_pattern_playing = self.time_passed < self.state_duration

	if is_pattern_playing then
		self.controller.opponent.Position =
			self.controller.opponent.Position + (self.move_dir_vec * self.move_speed * dt)

		if self:has_collide_with_wall() then
			self:find_reflect_vector()
		end
	else

		if not self.is_outro_playing then
			self.is_outro_playing = true
			start_coroutine(self.outro, self)
		end
	end
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:collided_with_player(cur_player_state)
	if not self.is_intro_finished then
		return
	end

	local player = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).player

	if cur_player_state ~= player_state.wait then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('')
		self.num_crashed_with_player = self.num_crashed_with_player + 1

		-- 플레이어는 캔터베리 배에 피격될 시, 스파인 레드 펄스 / 0.3 세기만큼 0.2초간 shake 실행.
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(player)
		character_util.shake(player, 0.3, 0.2)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.15)

		self.ui_manager:update_fail_counter_ui(self.num_crashed_with_player)

		if self.num_crashed_with_player >= 3 then
			manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game):restart_game(true)
		end
	end
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:has_collide_with_wall()
	local opponent = self.controller.opponent

	for _, wall in pairs(self.walls) do
		if bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(wall.Bounds, opponent.Bounds) then
			self.current_collided_wall = wall
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:is_pos_in_camera(pos)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	if math.abs(camera_pos.x - pos.x) > cam_half_width + 0.7 or
			-- 카메라의 y값도 보정해서 계산
			math.abs(camera_pos.y / 1.414 + camera_pos.z - pos.z) > cam_half_height + 0.5 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:find_reflect_vector()
	if self.previous_collided_wall ~= nil and
		lua_helper.reference_equals(self.current_collided_wall, self.previous_collided_wall) then
		return
	end

	local left = self.walls.left_wall.Bounds.max.x
	local right = self.walls.right_wall.Bounds.min.x
	local top = self.walls.top_wall.Bounds.min.z
	local bottom = self.walls.bot_wall.Bounds.max.z

	local opponent = self.controller.opponent
	local opponent_width = opponent.Bounds.size.x / 2
	local opponent_height =  opponent.Bounds.size.z / 2

	local dir_factor = {
		x = 1,
		z = 1
	}

	-- 초 간단 방법
	if opponent.Position.x + opponent_width >= right or opponent.Position.x - opponent_width <= left then
		dir_factor.x = -1
	end

	if opponent.Position.z + opponent_height >= top or opponent.Position.z - opponent_height <= bottom then
		dir_factor.z = -1
	end

	self.move_dir_vec = vector(self.move_dir_vec.x * dir_factor.x, 0, self.move_dir_vec.z * dir_factor.z)

	self.previous_collided_wall = self.current_collided_wall
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:intro()
	self.walls = manager_container:get(manager_type.background).walls
	self.controller:stop_timer()

	self.super:intro_start()

	-- 플레이어가 상대보다 앞서 있었다면, 1.5초에 걸쳐 1번 위치로 정렬.
	local player = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).player
	local opponent = self.controller.opponent

	local is_player_behind = player.Position.x < opponent.Position.x
	self.dir_factor = is_player_behind and 1 or -1
	local target_pos = self:find_boundary_pos(opponent, self.dir_factor)
	self.previous_collided_wall = is_player_behind and self.walls.right_wall or self.walls.left_wall

	-- -- 플레이어가 상대보다 뒤쳐져 있었다면, 1.5초에 걸쳐 2번 위치로
	wp_util.move_async(opponent, { target_pos - vector(0, 0, 1) }, nil, 1.5, { locked_dir = 'right' })

	local sb_offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct]

	local sb_data = {
		scale = 1.5,
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		offset = sb_offset + vector(-2.25 * self.dir_factor, 0, 0)
	}

	-- -- 꼬마공주 : $name! 에바! 이대로는 안되겠어!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_kanterbury_special_1', true, sb_data)

	-- 꼬마공주 (attack) : [shout] 그걸 하자!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_kanterbury_special_2', true, sb_data)

	-- 에바 (attack) : 그것… 말인가요 공주님?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_kanterbury_special_3', true, sb_data)

	-- 린다 (attack) : 좋아요 공주님! 다들 꽉잡아!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_kanterbury_special_4', true, sb_data)

	-- 전체 (burning) : 회전 회오리 온!
	--꼬마공주 보트 스파인 주위로 fx_kanturbury_boat_whirlwind_start(임시 : fx_yuze_basic_whirlwind_light_start) 가 실행된 후,
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_change_01')
	self.sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_cyclone_water_01', loop = true, volume = 0.5, fade_in_time = 1 })

	self.whirlwind_fx = self.controller.fx.kanturbury_whirlwind_start()
		:Instantiate(opponent.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 1), unity_class.quaternion.identity, opponent.Transform)
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'burning')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_kanterbury_special_5', true, sb_data)

	-- 첫 번째 이동 위치 잡음
	local start_pos = opponent.Position
	local next_dest = self:get_random_pos(is_player_behind)

	self.move_dir_vec = vector_util.get_x0z(next_dest - start_pos).normalized

	self.is_intro_finished = true
	self.controller:restart_timer()

	self.ui_manager:show_minigame_field_ui()
	self.ui_manager:show_fail_counter_ui()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:outro()
	self.ui_manager:hide_fail_counter_ui()

	local main_game_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)
	self.controller:stop_timer()

	self.super:outro_start()

	local opponent = self.controller.opponent

	self.whirlwind_fx:Dispose()
	self.whirlwind_fx = nil

	self.sfx:FadeOut(1)
	self.sfx = nil

	self.controller.fx.kanturbury_whirlwind_end()
		:Instantiate(opponent.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 1), unity_class.quaternion.identity, opponent.Transform)

	local is_located_left = opponent.Position.x < main_game_manager.center_pos.x
	self.dir_factor = is_located_left and -1 or 1
	local align_pos = self:find_boundary_pos(opponent, is_located_left and -1 or 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(opponent, align_pos, 1, nil, false, false)

	local sb_offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct]

	local sb_data = {
		scale = 1.5,
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		offset = sb_offset + vector(-2.25 * self.dir_factor, 0, 0)
	}

	-- 꼬마공주 (damaged) : 우리 비장의 기술을 피하다니…!
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_kanterbury_special_6', true, sb_data)

	-- 꼬마공주 (attack) : 좋아! 마지막까지 한 번 `해볼까?!
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_kanterbury_special_7', true, sb_data)
	character_util.remove_emotion(opponent)

	-- 소히 대사 종료되면 5섹션 미니게임 이어서 진행.

	self.state_finished = true
	manager_container:get(manager_type.ui).navigation_ui:set_active(true)
	self.controller:restart_timer()
	manager_container:get(manager_type.ui):show_minigame_field_ui()
end

function kanterbury_special_attack_state:get_random_pos(is_player_behind)
	local dir_factor = is_player_behind and -1 or 1
	local center_pos = self.controller.main_game.center_pos
	local random_factor = random_util.get_random_int(0, self.controller.special_attack_data.move_range)
	local top_wall_z = self.walls.top_wall.Bounds.min.z

	return vector(center_pos.x + (random_factor * dir_factor), 0, top_wall_z)
end
--#endregion kanterbury_special_attack_state

--#region senpai_special_attack_state
local senpai_special_attack_state = newclass('MWSenpaiSpecialAttackState', opponent_state_base)

function senpai_special_attack_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, opponent_state.special_attack)
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- 패턴 데이터 관련
	self.pattern_data = self.game_manager.constants_data.special_attack_event.pattern
	self.current_pattern = self.pattern_data[1]
	self.cur_pattern_index = 1
	self.is_pattern_finished = false
	self.is_player_behind = false
	self.dir_factor = 1

	-- AA72 관련
	self.aa72 = nil
	self.original_aa72_parent = nil

	-- 연출 관련
	self.is_intro_finished = false
	self.is_outro_playing = false

	-- 각 상태별 시간 경과
	self.cast_time_passed = 0
	self.attack_time_passed = 0
	self.move_time_passed = 0

	-- 플레이어가 맞은 횟수
	self.num_player_hitted = 0

	-- 이동 관련
	self.move_start_pos = nil
	self.move_dest_pos = nil

	-- 공격 관련
	self.target_range = nil

	-- 이펙트
	self.fx = self.controller.fx

	-- 이펙트 인스턴스
	self.fx_inst = {
		casting = nil,
		attack = nil,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.casting ~= nil then
				this.casting:Dispose()
			end

			this.casting = nil

			if this.attack ~= nil then
				this.attack:Dispose()
			end

			this.attack = nil
		end
	}

	-- 내부 상태 값
	self.inner_state = {
		none = 0,
		cast = 1,
		attack = 2,
		move = 3,
	}

	self.cur_state = self.inner_state.none

	controller.has_played_special_event = true
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.aa72 = get_character('summer_android')
	start_coroutine(self.intro, self)
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:exit()
	self.fx_inst:dispose()

	self.aa72.Transform.parent = self.original_aa72_parent
	self.aa72.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.aa72, active_state_type.disabled)

	if self.target_range ~= nil then
		attack_range_util.destroy(self.target_range)
	end
	self.target_range  = nil

	self.original_aa72_parent = nil
	self.aa72 = nil
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:update(dt)
	if not self.is_intro_finished or self.is_outro_playing then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not self.is_pattern_finished then
		if self.cur_state == self.inner_state.cast then
			self:cast(dt)

		elseif self.cur_state == self.inner_state.attack then
			self:attack(dt)

		elseif self.cur_state == self.inner_state.move then
			self:move_to_next_row(dt)
		end
	end

	if self.num_player_hitted >= 3 then
		manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game):restart_game(true)
	end

	-- 패턴이 끝났다면 상태 종료.
	if self.is_pattern_finished and not self.is_outro_playing then
		self.is_outro_playing = true
		start_coroutine(self.outro, self)
	end
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:on_collide(other)
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:create_attack_range()
	-- 바운드 사이즈는 임시
	local target_size = vector(50, 0, 0.75)
	local show_type = self.is_player_behind
		and CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayReverse
		or CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward

	self.target_range = attack_range_util.create_rect(
		self.game_manager.center_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
		vector(target_size.x, target_size.z),
		nil, nil,
		show_type)

	self.target_range:Hide()
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:intro()
	self.controller:stop_timer()

	local opponent = self.controller.opponent
	local player = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).player

	self.super:intro_start()

	self.dir_factor = self.is_player_behind and 1 or -1

	local align_pos = self:find_boundary_pos(opponent, self.dir_factor, 4)
	character_util.move_to_async(opponent, align_pos, 1, nil, false, false)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.aa72, active_state_type.enabled)

	self.controller.sb_data.offset = self.controller.sb_data.offset + vector(-2.25 * self.dir_factor, 0, 0)

	-- 상대편 : 끈질기게도 버티네!
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_senpai_special_1', true, self.controller.sb_data)
	character_util.remove_emotion(opponent)
	-- 이후 적 배치의 위치에 따라 화면 이탈과 가까운 X축 방향으로 1초간 이탈하여 화면을 벗어남.
	-- X축 최대 화면비에 맞춰 보트가 화면에서 사라질 위치까지 진행.
	self.is_player_behind = player.Position.x < opponent.Position.x

	self:create_attack_range()


	-- 화면을 벗어난 상태에서 1-1 / 2-1위치로 정렬한 후,
	character_util.move_to_async(opponent, align_pos + vector(10 * self.dir_factor, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)

	character_util.remove_anim(opponent)

	-- 선배 보트 (unique)aa72_out 애니메이션 실행 + AA72가 각 지점별 위치에서
	local opponent_width = opponent.Bounds.size.x / 2
	character_util.set_position(self.aa72, opponent.Position)
	self.original_aa72_parent = self.aa72.Transform.parent
	self.aa72.Transform.parent = opponent.Transform
	self.aa72.Transform.localPosition =
		vector(-((opponent_width * self.dir_factor) + (0.15 * self.dir_factor)), 0.25, 0.25 )

	scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'aa72_out')

	-- 플레이어 방향을 바라본 채, side, idle, (unique)fly애니메이션으로 배치.
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.aa72, self.is_player_behind and 'left' or 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim(self.aa72, self, 'unique/fly')

	-- 이후 1-2 / 2-2 위치로 1초간 이동.
		-- X축 최소 화면비에 맞춰 보트에 화면에 들어올 때 까지 실행.
	align_pos = align_pos + vector(opponent_width * self.dir_factor * 0.9, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_to_async(opponent, align_pos, 1, nil, false, false)

	-- 상대편 : 어디 이 공격도 피해보라고!
	local sb_offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct]
	local sb_data = {
		scale = 1.5,
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		offset = sb_offset + vector(-2.25 * self.dir_factor, 0, 0)
	}
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'burning')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_senpai_special_2', true, sb_data)

	self:update_attack_range_pos()
	self.cur_state = self.inner_state.cast
	self.is_intro_finished = true

	self.controller:restart_timer()

	self.ui_manager:show_minigame_field_ui()
	self.ui_manager:show_fail_counter_ui()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:outro()
	self.ui_manager:hide_fail_counter_ui()
	self.controller:stop_timer()

	self.super:outro_start()

	local opponent = self.controller.opponent

	local sb_offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct]
	local sb_data = {
		scale = 1.5,
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		offset = sb_offset + vector(-2 * self.dir_factor, 0, 0)
	}

	-- AA72 (side[플레이어 방향], damaged, (unique)fly) : 스, 스텔라… 슬립 모드로 전환…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(self.aa72, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_senpai_special_3', true, sb_data)

	-- 상단 대사와 함께 AA72 가까운 X축으로 2의 속도로 이탈 + Y축으로 0.5만큼 1초간 하락.
	self.aa72.Transform.parent = self.original_aa72_parent

	if self.is_player_behind then
		character_util.move_distance_async(self.aa72, vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 2, false, false)
	else
		character_util.move_distance_async(self.aa72, vector(-3, 0, 0), nil, 2, false, false)
	end
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.aa72, active_state_type.disabled)

	-- AA72 화면 이탈까지 대기.
	-- 소히 (damaged) : 젠장! 배터리가 다 됐잖아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_senpai_special_4', true, sb_data)

	local op_width = opponent.Bounds.size.x * 2

	-- 보트 현재 위치에서 가까운 X축으로 1초동안 이탈한 뒤, run 애니메이션으로 변경, 다시 플레이어 카메라 안으로 1초동안 진입.
	local move_dist = vector(op_width * self.dir_factor, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_distance_async(opponent, move_dist, 1, nil, false, false)
	scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'run')
	character_util.move_distance_async(opponent, vector(-move_dist.x * 1.5, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)

	-- 소히 (attack) : 아직 승부는 끝나지 않았다고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_senpai_special_5', true, self.controller.sb_data)

	self.state_finished = true
	manager_container:get(manager_type.ui).navigation_ui:set_active(true)
	self.controller:restart_timer()
	manager_container:get(manager_type.ui):show_minigame_field_ui()
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:cast(dt)
	self.cast_time_passed = self.cast_time_passed + dt

	if self.fx_inst.casting == nil then
		local opp_pos = self.controller.opponent.Position
		local aa72_bound_x = self.aa72.Bounds.size.x
		local fx_pos_x = opp_pos.x + (self.aa72.Position.x) - (aa72_bound_x * self.dir_factor)
		local fx_pos_y = self.aa72.Position.y + (self.aa72.Bounds.size.z / 2)
		local fx_pos_z = opp_pos.z + self.aa72.Position.z

		local fx_center_pos = vector(fx_pos_x, fx_pos_y, fx_pos_z)

		self:update_attack_range_pos()

		self.fx_inst.casting = self.fx.senpai_casting():Instantiate(fx_center_pos)

		local fx_angle = self.is_player_behind and -90 or 90
		self.fx_inst.casting.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, fx_angle, 0)
		self.fx_inst.casting.transform.localScale = vector(1, 0, 2)
	end

	if self.cast_time_passed >= self.current_pattern.cast_duration then
		self.fx_inst.casting:Dispose()
		self.fx_inst.casting = nil

		self.target_range:Hide()
		self.cast_time_passed  = 0
		self.cur_state = self.inner_state.attack
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.aa72, self, 'attack')
	end
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:attack(dt)
	self.attack_time_passed = self.attack_time_passed + dt

	local is_player_vulnerable = self.player_manager.state.type ~= player_state.wait
	local is_player_hit = attack_range_util.is_contains_attack_range(self.target_range, self.player_manager.player, 1)

	if self.fx_inst.attack == nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_android_shoot_01')

		local opp_pos = self.controller.opponent.Position
		local aa72_bound_x = self.aa72.Bounds.size.x

		local fx_pos_x = opp_pos.x + (self.aa72.Position.x) - (aa72_bound_x * self.dir_factor)
		local fx_pos_y = self.aa72.Position.y + (self.aa72.Bounds.size.z / 2)
		local fx_pos_z = opp_pos.z + self.aa72.Position.z

		local fx_center_pos = vector(fx_pos_x, fx_pos_y, fx_pos_z)

		self.fx_inst.attack = self.fx.senpai_attack():Instantiate(fx_center_pos)

		local fx_angle = self.is_player_behind and -90 or 90
		self.fx_inst.attack.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, fx_angle, 0)
		self.fx_inst.attack.transform.localScale = vector(1, 0, 2)
		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)
	end

	if is_player_vulnerable and is_player_hit then
		-- 플레이어는 각 레이저에 피격될 시, 스파인 레드 펄스 / 0.3 세기만큼 0.2초간 shake 실행.
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player_manager.player)
		character_util.shake(self.player_manager.player, 0.3, 0.2)
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.15)

		self.player_manager:on_collide({
			target = self.opponent,
			state = opponent_state.special_attack
		})

		self.num_player_hitted = self.num_player_hitted + 1
		self.ui_manager:update_fail_counter_ui(self.num_player_hitted)
	end

	if 	self.attack_time_passed >= self.current_pattern.attack_duration then
		local add_offset_z = self.game_manager.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[self.current_pattern.next_row]
		local target_pos_z = add_offset_z + self.game_manager.center_pos.z

		self.move_start_pos = self.controller.opponent.Position
		self.move_dest_pos = vector(self.controller.opponent.Position.x, 0, target_pos_z)

		self.fx_inst.attack:Dispose()
		self.fx_inst.attack = nil

		self.attack_time_passed = 0
		self.cur_state = self.inner_state.move
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.aa72)
	end
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:move_to_next_row(dt)
	self.move_time_passed = self.move_time_passed + dt

	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.move_time_passed / self.current_pattern.move_duration)
	self.controller.opponent.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.move_start_pos, self.move_dest_pos, progress)

	if self.move_time_passed >= self.current_pattern.move_duration then
		if self:is_able_to_set_next_pattern() then
			self.controller.opponent.Position = self.move_dest_pos
			self.move_time_passed = 0
			self.cur_state = self.inner_state.cast
		else
			self.is_pattern_finished = true
		end
	end
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:is_able_to_set_next_pattern()
	self.cur_pattern_index = self.cur_pattern_index + 1

	if self.pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_index] ~= nil then
		self.current_pattern = self.pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_index]
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function senpai_special_attack_state:update_attack_range_pos()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_android_charge_01')

	local tile_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.game_manager.center_pos):GetHeightAt(self.game_manager.center_pos)
	local range_pos = vector(self.game_manager.center_pos.x, 0, self.controller.opponent.Position.z)

	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.target_range, range_pos, tile_height)
	attack_range_util.show(self.target_range, self.current_pattern.cast_duration)
end
--#endregion senpai_special_attack_state

--#region mad_panda_special_sttack_state
local mad_panda_special_attack_state = newclass('MWMadPandaSpecialAttackState', opponent_state_base)

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, opponent_state.special_attack)
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- 패턴 시작 전 플레이어가 뒤에 있었는지
	self.is_player_behind = false

	-- 패턴 데이터 관련
	self.pattern_data = self.game_manager.constants_data.special_attack_event.pattern
	self.is_pattern_finished = false

	-- 연출 관련
	self.is_intro_finished = false
	self.is_outro_playing = false

	-- 각 상태별 시간 경과
	self.cast_time_passed = 0
	self.wait_time_passed = 0
	self.attack_time_passed = 0

	-- 플레이어가 맞은 횟수
	self.num_player_hitted = 0

	-- 공격 관련
	self.cur_target_track_idx = 1
	self.target_range = {}

	-- 이펙트
	self.fx = self.controller.fx

	-- 이펙트 인스턴스
	self.missile_move_speed = 80
	self.missiles = {}

	-- 내부 상태 값
	self.inner_state = {
		none = 0,
		cast = 0.5,
		wait = 1,
		attack = 2,
	}

	self.cur_state = self.inner_state.none

	controller.has_played_special_event = true
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:enter(prev_state)
	-- 어택 레인지 미리 생성
	local far_away = vector(999, 0.1, 999)
	local range = 1

	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local attack_range = attack_range_util.create_circle(far_away,
			range, nil, nil, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.target_range, attack_range)
	end

	-- 인트로 실행
	start_coroutine(self.intro, self)
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:exit()
	self:dispose_all_missiles_and_range()
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:update(dt)
	if not self.is_intro_finished then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt


	if not self.is_pattern_finished then
		if self.cur_state == self.inner_state.cast then
			self:cast(dt)

		elseif self.cur_state == self.inner_state.wait then
			self:wait(dt)

		elseif self.cur_state == self.inner_state.attack then
			self:attack(dt)
		end
	end

	if self.num_player_hitted >= 3 then
		manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game):restart_game(true)
	end

	-- 패턴이 끝났다면 상태 종료.
	if self.is_pattern_finished and not self.is_outro_playing then
		self.is_outro_playing = true
		start_coroutine(self.outro, self)
	end
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:on_collide(other)
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:dispose_all_missiles_and_range()
	if self.missiles ~= nil then
		for _, missile in ipairs(self.missiles) do
			missile:Dispose()
			missile = nil
		end
	end

	self.missiles = nil

	if self.target_range ~= nil then
		for _, range in ipairs(self.target_range) do
			attack_range_util.destroy(range)
		end
	end

	self.target_range = nil
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.missiles = nil
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:intro()
	self.controller:stop_timer()

	local opponent = self.controller.opponent
	local player = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).player

	self.super:intro_start()

	--플레이어가 상대보다 앞서 있었다면, 1.5초에 걸쳐 1번 위치로 정렬.
	--플레이어가 상대보다 뒤쳐져 있었다면, 1.5초에 걸쳐 2번 위치로
	self.is_player_behind = player.Position.x < opponent.Position.x
	self.dir_factor = self.is_player_behind and 1 or -1
	local align_pos = self:find_boundary_pos(opponent, self.is_player_behind and 1 or -1)
	character_util.move_to_async(opponent, align_pos, 1.5, nil, false, false)

	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'attack')

	self.controller.sb_data.offset = self.controller.sb_data.offset + vector(-2.25 * self.dir_factor, 0, 0)

	--스칼렛(attack) : 안되겠어! 팬더, 공격 준비!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_panda_special_1', true, self.controller.sb_data)

	--팬더(attack) : 로져! 미사일 발사 준비!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_panda_special_2', true, self.controller.sb_data)

	--대니(attack) : 대니, 미사일 쏜다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_panda_special_3', true, self.controller.sb_data)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_async(opponent, self, 'cannon_up')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'cannon_up_run')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.cur_state = self.inner_state.cast
	self.is_intro_finished = true

	self.controller:restart_timer()
	self.ui_manager:show_minigame_field_ui()
	self.ui_manager:show_fail_counter_ui()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:outro()
	self.ui_manager:hide_fail_counter_ui()
	self.controller:stop_timer()

	self.super:outro_start()

	local opponent = self.controller.opponent

	-- 대니 (tired) : 대, 대니 미사일 다 떨어졌다…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_panda_special_4', true, self.controller.sb_data)

	-- 스칼렛(attack) : 으으! 이 성가신 놈들!
	scene_util.set_emotion(opponent, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_panda_special_5', true, self.controller.sb_data)

	-- 팬더(attack) : 작작 버티고 탈락하란 말이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(opponent, 'mw_racing_panda_special_6', true, self.controller.sb_data)

	scene_util.set_anim_async(opponent, self, 'cannon_down')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_anim(opponent, self, 'run')

	-- 팬더 대사 종료되면 11섹션 미니게임 이어서 진행.
	self.state_finished = true

	manager_container:get(manager_type.ui).navigation_ui:set_active(true)

	self.controller:restart_timer()
	manager_container:get(manager_type.ui):show_minigame_field_ui()
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:cast(dt)
	self.cast_time_passed = self.cast_time_passed + dt

	if #self.missiles == 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_01')

		local tracks = self.pattern_data.track[self.cur_target_track_idx]
		local missile_pos_adj = vector(-1.2, 3, 0)
		local spawn_pos = self.controller.opponent.Position + missile_pos_adj

		for _ = 1, #tracks do
			local missile = self.fx.panda_missile():Instantiate(spawn_pos)
			missile.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 90)
			table.insert(self.missiles, missile)
		end

		for _ = 1, #tracks do
			self.fx.panda_missile_shoot():Instantiate(spawn_pos)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.missiles do
		local init_pos = self.missiles[i].transform.position
		self.missiles[i].transform.position = init_pos + vector(0, self.missile_move_speed * dt, 0)
	end

	if self.cast_time_passed >= self.pattern_data.cast_duration then
		for i = 1, #self.missiles do
			local init_pos = self.missiles[i].transform.position
			self.missiles[i].transform.position = vector(init_pos.x,
				self.missile_move_speed * self.pattern_data.cast_duration,
				init_pos.z)
		end

		self:update_attack_range_pos()
		self.cast_time_passed  = 0
		self.cur_state = self.inner_state.wait
	end
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:wait(dt)
	self.wait_time_passed = self.wait_time_passed + dt

	if self.wait_time_passed >= self.pattern_data.wait_duration / 2 then
		for _, missile in ipairs(self.missiles) do
			missile.transform.position = missile.transform.position
				- vector(0, self.missile_move_speed * dt, 0)
		end
	end

	if self.wait_time_passed >= self.pattern_data.wait_duration then
		for _, missile in ipairs(self.missiles) do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_02')
			local missile_pos = missile.transform.position
			self.fx.water_splash():Instantiate(vector(missile_pos.x, 0.1, missile_pos.z))
			missile:Dispose()
			missile = nil
		end

		local has_done_damage_calc = false

		for _, attack_range in ipairs(self.target_range) do
			if not has_done_damage_calc and
				self:is_contains_attack_range(attack_range, self.player_manager.player) then

				has_done_damage_calc = true

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_missile_02')

				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player_manager.player)
				character_util.shake(self.player_manager.player, 0.3, 0.2)
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.15)

				self.player_manager:on_collide({
					target = self.controller.opponent,
					state = opponent_state.special_attack
				})

				self.num_player_hitted = self.num_player_hitted + 1
				self.ui_manager:update_fail_counter_ui(self.num_player_hitted)
			end

			attack_range:Hide()
		end

		self.wait_time_passed = 0
		self.cur_state = self.inner_state.attack
	end
end

-- 커스텀 충돌 판정
function mad_panda_special_attack_state:is_contains_attack_range(attack_range, fo)
	local bounds_scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.pattern_data.hit_check_bound_scale, 1)
	local fo_bounds = fo.Bounds

	fo_bounds.center = fo_bounds.center + vector(0, 0, self.pattern_data.hit_check_bound_center_z_adj)
	fo_bounds.size = vector(fo_bounds.size.x * bounds_scale, fo_bounds.size.y, fo_bounds.size.z * bounds_scale)

	return CS.BoundsExtensions.IsIntersectingArc(fo_bounds, attack_range.CacheTransform.position,
			unity_class.vector3.forward, attack_range.Radius, 360)
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:attack(dt)
	self.attack_time_passed = self.attack_time_passed + dt

	local has_next_pattern = self.pattern_data.track[self.cur_target_track_idx + 1] ~= nil
	local has_waited_enough = self.attack_time_passed >= self.pattern_data.attack_duration

	if has_next_pattern then
		self.missiles = {}

		if has_waited_enough then
			self.attack_time_passed = 0
			self.cur_target_track_idx = self.cur_target_track_idx + 1
			self.cur_state = self.inner_state.cast
		end
	else
		self.is_pattern_finished = true
	end
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:is_able_to_set_next_pattern()
	self.cur_pattern_index = self.cur_pattern_index + 1

	if self.pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_index] ~= nil then
		self.current_pattern = self.pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_index]
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function mad_panda_special_attack_state:update_attack_range_pos()
	local tile_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.game_manager.center_pos):GetHeightAt(self.game_manager.center_pos)

	local current_track_data = self.pattern_data.track[self.cur_target_track_idx]

	for idx, track in ipairs(current_track_data) do
		local add_offset_z = self.game_manager.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[track]
		local target_pos_z = add_offset_z + self.game_manager.center_pos.z
		local range_pos = vector(self.player_manager.player.Position.x, 0, target_pos_z)

		local attack_range = self.target_range[idx]

		attack_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, range_pos, tile_height)
		attack_range_util.show(attack_range, self.pattern_data.wait_duration)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.controller.opponent, attack_range))

		self.missiles[idx].transform.position = vector(
			self.player_manager.player.Position.x,
			self.missiles[idx].transform.position.y,
			target_pos_z
		)

		self.missiles[idx].transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, -90)
	end
end
--#endregion mad_panda_special_sttack_state
