--#region opponent_manager
local opponent_manager = newclass('MWRacingOpponentManager')

function opponent_manager:init()
	self.opponent = nil
	self.opponent_data = nil
	self.player = nil

	self.current_state = nil

	self.opponent_hit_box = vector(0.5, 0.75, 0.3)

	self.item = {
		booster = false,
	}

	self.line_time_passed = nil

	self.pattern_count = nil

	self.cur_speed = nil
	self.cur_direction = nil
	self.active_line_move = nil

	--region FX
	self.fx = {
		kanturbury_whirlwind_start = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_kanturbury_boat_whirlwind_start')
		end,

		kanturbury_whirlwind_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_kanturbury_boat_whirlwind_end')
		end,

		senpai_casting = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_water_lastsnipe_casting')
		end,

		senpai_attack = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_water_lastsnipe_end')
		end,

		panda_missile_shoot = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_panda_boat_missile_shoot')
		end,

		panda_missile = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cwp_villainandroid_proj')
		end,

		water_splash = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_water_splash_in')
		end,
		booster_fire = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_booster_fire')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion FX

	-- 스페셜 공격 이벤트 관련
	self.has_played_special_event = false
	self.special_event_state = nil

	self.sb_data = {
		scale = 1.5,
		bubble_direction = 'none',
		offset = CS.SpeechBubbleOffset.Offsets[speech_bubble.bubble_directions.ct]
	}
end

function opponent_manager:init_manager(controller)
	self.fx:load_all()

	self.controller = controller
	self.constants_data = controller.opponent_constants_data
	self.special_attack_data = controller.constants_data.special_attack_event
	self.opponent = self.constants_data:get_opponent()
	self.main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)
	self.player = self.controller.player_constants_data:get_player()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.opponent, active_state_type.enabled)

	self.opponent_data = {
		--게임 시작시 히트박스
		hit_box = {
			origin_size = nil,
			in_game_size = nil
		},

		start_pos = controller.center_pos + self.constants_data.start_pos_offset
	}
	self.line_time_passed = 0
	self.pattern_count = 1

	self.special_event_state = switch(controller.constants_name, {
		['shortstory_milkyway_5'] = kanterbury_special_attack_state,
		['shortstory_milkyway_8'] = senpai_special_attack_state,
		['shortstory_milkyway_12'] = mad_panda_special_attack_state,
	})
end

function opponent_manager:start_routine()
	self.opponent.Position = self.opponent_data.start_pos

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.opponent, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.opponent)

	self.opponent_data.hit_box.origin_size = self.opponent.Hitbox.size

	self.opponent_data.hit_box.in_game_size = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(5, 0.75, 1))

	self.opponent.Hitbox = self.opponent_data.hit_box.in_game_size

	--종료 시 한번만 실행하기 위함
	self.is_ending = self.controller.is_playing_game

	self:change_state(opponent_normal_state(self))
end

function opponent_manager:update_routine(dt)
	if self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state.type ~= opponent_state.special_attack then
		self:update_opponent_position(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:update(dt)

		if not self.controller.is_playing_game and self.is_ending then
			self.is_ending = false

			self:change_state(opponent_normal_state(self))
		end

		if self.current_state.state_finished then
			if self:is_special_attackable() then
				local is_player_behind = self.opponent.Position.x > self.player.Position.x

				if is_player_behind then
					self.main_game:game_end(nil, self.main_game.constants_name)
				else
					self.controller.ui_manager.navigation_ui:set_active(false)
					self.cur_speed = nil
					self.cur_direction = nil
					self:change_state(self.special_event_state(self))
				end

			else
				if self.current_state.type ~= opponent_state.normal then
					self:change_state(opponent_normal_state(self))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function opponent_manager:update_opponent_position(dt)
	if not self.controller.time_stop then
		self.line_time_passed = self.line_time_passed + dt
	end

	if not (self.current_state.type == opponent_state.move and
			self.main_game.player_manager.state.type == player_state.booster) then
		if self.current_state.type ~= opponent_state.normal or
				self.main_game.player_manager.state.type == player_state.wrestle then
			return
		end
	end

	local updated_x = self:update_x_pos(dt)
	local updated_z = self:update_z_pos(dt)

	-- 움직임이 있었다면, 최종 위치를 적용
	if self.has_opponent_moved then
		self.opponent.Position = vector(updated_x, 0, updated_z)
	end

	self.has_opponent_moved = false
end

function opponent_manager:update_x_pos(dt)
	local direction = self.opponent.Position.x <= self.player.Position.x and 1 or -1
	local cur_speed = self.constants_data.move_data.pattern_data.horizontal_speed

	local player_x_adj = 0.1
	local player_pos = self.player.Position
	local opp_pos = self.opponent.Position

	-- 패턴시간에 맞춰 값을 이용해 스피드, 방향를 구해준다.
	local is_adjusted_player_pos_above_opp = player_pos.x + player_x_adj >= opp_pos.x
	local is_adjusted_player_pos_behind_opp = player_pos.x - player_x_adj < opp_pos.x

	if not (is_adjusted_player_pos_above_opp and is_adjusted_player_pos_behind_opp) then
		self.has_opponent_moved = true
		local velocity = direction * cur_speed * dt
		return opp_pos.x + velocity
	end

	-- 최종 x 값을 전달
	return opp_pos.x
end

function opponent_manager:update_z_pos(dt)
	local pattern_constants_data = self.constants_data.move_data.pattern[self.pattern_count]

	if pattern_constants_data == nil then
		return self.opponent.Position.z
	end

	local time = pattern_constants_data.time
	local track = pattern_constants_data.track

	if not (self.cur_speed or self.cur_direction) then
		local add_offset_z = self.main_game.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[track]
		local z_diff = self.main_game.center_pos.z + add_offset_z - self.opponent.Position.z

		self.cur_direction = vector(0, 0, z_diff).normalized
		self.cur_speed = self.constants_data.move_data.pattern_data.vertical_speed
	end

	--패턴시간에 맞춰 값을 이용해 스피드, 방향를 구해준다.
	if self.line_time_passed >= time then
		self.has_opponent_moved = true

		local target_pos_z = self.main_game.common_constants_data.track_offset_z[track] + self.main_game.center_pos.z

		local delta_moved_z = self.cur_direction.z * self.cur_speed * dt
		local moved_z = self.opponent.Position.z + delta_moved_z

		local has_reaced_dest_z = false

		if self.cur_direction.z == -1 then
			if self.opponent.Position.z <= target_pos_z then
				has_reaced_dest_z = true
			end
		else
			if self.opponent.Position.z >= target_pos_z then
				has_reaced_dest_z = true
			end
		end

		if has_reaced_dest_z then
			moved_z = target_pos_z

			self.pattern_count = self.pattern_count + 1
			self.cur_speed = nil
			self.cur_direction = nil
		end

		return moved_z
	end

	-- 최종 z 값을 전달
	return self.opponent.Position.z
end

function opponent_manager:on_collide(hit_info, item_type)
	-- 아이템인 경우 충돌 체크
	if self:when_collided_to_item(item_type) then
		return
	end

	self:when_collided_to_player(hit_info)
end

function opponent_manager:when_collided_to_item(type)
	if type == item_type.obstacle then
		if self.current_state.type ~= opponent_state.wrestle then
			self:change_state(opponent_obstacle_state(self))
		end
		return true
	elseif type == item_type.booster then
		if self.current_state.type ~= opponent_state.wrestle then
			self:change_state(opponent_booster_state(self))
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function opponent_manager:when_collided_to_player(hit_info)
	local other = hit_info.target

	-- 각 상태별 특수 처리 실행 (없을 수도 있음)
	self.current_state:collided_with_player(hit_info.state)

	if self.current_state.type == opponent_state.special_attack then
		return
	end

	local player_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.player)

	local is_player_behind = other.Position.x + 2 < self.opponent.Position.x

	-- 앞 / 뒤로 서로 부딫힐 경우
	if is_player_behind then
		if (self.current_state.type == opponent_state.normal or
				self.current_state.type == opponent_state.obstacle) and
				(player_manager.state.type == player_state.normal or
						player_manager.state.type == player_state.wait) then

			--충돌한 위치에 Fx_hit 실행.
			local fx_pos = ((self.player.Position + self.opponent.Position) * 0.5) + vector(0, 0, 1)

			self.controller.fx.hit():Instantiate(fx_pos)

			--플레이어 배 0.04만큼 0.2초간 shake 적용.
			scene_util.shake(self.opponent, 0.04, 0.2, false)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_hit_wall_01')

			self:change_state(opponent_bump_behind_state(self))
			manager_container:get(manager_type.player):change_wait_state(2)
		end
	end
end

function opponent_manager:create_wrestle_event()
	local main_game_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)
	local custom_event = CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.opponent, { main_game_manager.send_fight_event })
	message_system:PublishSync(custom_event)
end

function opponent_manager:is_special_attackable()
	local main_game_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)
	local special_time_condition = main_game_manager.constants_data.special_attack_event

	return not self.has_played_special_event and (main_game_manager.time_passed >= special_time_condition.start_time_condition)
end

function opponent_manager:item_event(type)
	if self.current_state.type ~= opponent_state.normal then
		return
	end

	if type == item_type.obstacle then
		self:change_state(opponent_obstacle_state(self))
	elseif type == item_type.booster then
		self:change_state(opponent_booster_state(self))
	end
end

function opponent_manager:reset_setting()
	if self.current_state then
		self.current_state:exit()
		self.current_state:dispose()
	end

	self:clean()
end

function opponent_manager:clean()
	self.opponent.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.opponent = nil
	self.opponent_data = nil
	self.player = nil

	self.current_state = nil

	self.opponent_hit_box = vector(0.5, 0.75, 0.3)

	self.item = {
		booster = false,
	}

	self.line_time_passed = nil

	self.pattern_count = nil

	self.cur_speed = nil
	self.cur_direction = nil
	self.active_line_move = nil
	self.has_played_special_event = false
	self.special_event_state = nil
end

function opponent_manager:change_state(next_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state

	if self.current_state then
		self.current_state:exit()
		self.current_state:dispose()
	end

	self.current_state = next_state

	if next_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

function opponent_manager:stop_timer()
	self.controller.time_stop = true
end

function opponent_manager:restart_timer()
	self.controller.time_stop = false
end

function opponent_manager:dispose()
end

--#endregion

--플레이어 직접 접근
function opponent_manager:change_move_state(pos, duration)
	self:change_state(opponent_move_state(self, pos, duration))
end

function opponent_manager:change_wrestle_state()
	self:change_state(opponent_wrestle_state(self))
end

function opponent_manager:change_normal_state()
	self:change_state(opponent_normal_state(self))
end

return {
	create = function()
		return opponent_manager()
	end
}

local player_manager = newclass('MWRacingPlayer')

local player_state_base = newclass('IMWRacingPlayerState')
local player_normal_state = newclass('MWRacingPlayerNormalState', player_state_base)
local player_wait_state = newclass('MWRacingPlayerWaitState', player_state_base)
local player_booster_state = newclass('MWRacingPlayerBoosterState', player_state_base)
local player_obstacle_state = newclass('MWRacingPlayerObstacleState', player_state_base)
local player_wrestle_state = newclass('MWRacingPlayerPhysicalFightState', player_state_base)
local player_faint_state = newclass('MWRacingPlayerFaintState', player_state_base)
local player_move_state = newclass('IMWRacingPlayerState', player_state_base)
local player_bump_behind_state = newclass('MWRacingOpponentBumpBehindState', player_state_base)

local manager_type = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerType')
local manager_container = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerContainer')
local state_type = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/State')

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                플레이어 상태 인터페이스
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region player_state_base

function player_state_base:init(controller, state_name)
	self.controller = controller
	self.player = self.controller.player
	self.opponent = self.controller.opponent
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state_finished = false
	self.type = state_name
	self.player_move_wait = nil
	self.opponent_move_wait = nil
	self.speed = nil
	self.move_data = nil
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.end_pos = nil
	self.player_move_wait_state = {
		none = 0,
		phase_1 = 1,
		phase_2 = 2,
		phase_3 = 3
	}
end

function player_state_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end
--endregion

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                   기본 상태
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region player_normal_state
function player_normal_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.player.normal)
end

function player_normal_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_normal_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.state_finished = true

	character_util.set_emotion(self.controller.player, { name = 'smile' })
end

function player_normal_state:exit(next_state)
end

function player_normal_state:update(dt)
	manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game):check_collision(self, self.player)
end

--endregion player_normal_state
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                    대기 상태
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region player_wait_state
function player_wait_state:init(controller, duration)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.player.wait)
	if duration then
		self.duration = duration
	else
		self.duration = self.controller.controller.common_constants_data.wait_duration
	end
	self.is_wait = false
end

function player_wait_state:enter(prev_state)
	if prev_state.type ~= state_type.player.wait then
		self.time_passed = 0
	end

	self.is_wait = true
end

function player_wait_state:exit(next_state)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.controller.player, { name = 'smile' })
end

function player_wait_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_wait_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.is_wait and self.time_passed > self.duration then
		self.is_wait = false
		self.super.controller:change_state(player_normal_state(self.controller))
	end
end
--endregion


-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                   부스터 상태
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region player_booster_state
function player_booster_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.player.booster)

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		phase_1 = 1,
		phase_2 = 2,
		phase_3 = 3
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress

	self.booster_sfx = nil
end

function player_booster_state:enter()
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none

	self.move_end_pos = nil
	self.super.move_data = self.super.controller.constants_data.move_data.booster

	self.super.start_pos = self.super.opponent.Position
	self.super.end_pos = self.super.opponent.Position + vector(-self.move_data.distance, 0, 0)

	self.cashing_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
	self.cashing_duration = self.move_data.duration

	self.cur_speed = self.move_data.distance / self.move_data.duration
	self.cur_direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)

	--부스터 - 발동하는 동안 루프 재생, 믹스 0.5초
	self.booster_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_arcade_rampage_01', loop = true, mix = 0.5 })
end

function player_booster_state:exit(next_state)
	if self.fx_booster then
		self.fx_booster:Dispose()
		self.fx_booster = nil
	end

	if self.fx_booster_fire then
		self.fx_booster_fire:Dispose()
		self.fx_booster_fire = nil
	end

	if self.booster_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.booster_sfx)
		self.booster_sfx = nil
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.super.player)
	scene_util.set_anim(self.super.player, self.super.controller, 'run')
end

function player_booster_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_booster_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		--동시에 프리펩 배경 속도는 1초동안 16로 증가. 이후 다시 12로 원상복귀.
		start_coroutine(function()
			local background_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.background)
			background_manager:change_speed(background_manager.booster_speed, 1)

			local main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)

			wait_for_sec(self.move_data.duration)

			--기존 속도로
			if main_game.current_game_state == main_game.game_state.ending then
				return
			end

			--기존 속도로
			manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
					manager_container:get(manager_type.background).original_speed)
		end)

		--해당 캐릭터 부스터 사용 시간동안 right, attack, booster 전환.
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.super.player, self.super.controller, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(self.super.player, self.super.controller, 'booster')

		--캐릭터 부스터 사용시간동안 fx_fail or fx_fail_wind 스크린에 우 → 좌로 출력.
		self.fx_booster_fire = self.super.controller.fx.booster_fire():Instantiate(
				self.super.player.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0.5), unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.super.player.Transform)

		self.fx_booster = self.super.controller.fx.booster():Instantiate(
				self.super.player.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.super.player.Transform)
		self.fx_booster.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0)

		self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_1
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_1 then

		if manager_container:get(manager_type.opponent).current_state.type ~= state_type.opponent.booster then
			local direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)

			self.super.controller:change_move_event(self.move_data.distance + self.cashing_pos.x, self.cashing_duration, direction)
			self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_2
		else
			local velocity = self.cur_direction * self.cur_speed * dt

			self.cashing_pos = self.cashing_pos + velocity
			self.cashing_duration = self.move_data.duration - self.time_passed

			if self.time_passed >= self.move_data.duration then
				self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_2
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_2 then
		start_coroutine(function()
			if not (self.time_passed >= self.move_data.duration) then
			end

			if self.progress then
				self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_3
			end
		end)
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_3 then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_data.duration then
			self.super.controller:change_state(player_normal_state(self.controller))
		end
	end
end
--endregion player_booster_state

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  장애물 부딛힘
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region player_obstacle_state
function player_obstacle_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.player.obstacle)

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		phase_1 = 1,
		phase_2 = 2,
		phase_3 = 3
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress
	self.time_passed_second = nil
end

function player_obstacle_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.super.player_move_wait = self.super.player_move_wait_state.none
	self.super.opponent_move_wait = false
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
	self.time_passed_second = 0

	self.super.move_data = self.super.controller.constants_data.move_data.obstacle
	self.end_pos_1 = self.super.player.Position + vector(-self.move_data.distance * 0.5, 0, 0)
	self.end_pos_2 = self.super.player.Position
	self.opponent_end_pos = self.super.opponent.Position + vector(self.super.move_data.opponent_distance, 0, 0)
	self.super.speed = self.super.move_data.distance / self.super.move_data.duration
	self.opponent_speed = self.super.move_data.opponent_distance / self.super.move_data.opponent_duration
end

function player_obstacle_state:exit(next_state)
	--속도가 원상복귀될 때에 맞추어 플레이어 표정 smile로 변경.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.super.player, { name = 'smile' })
end

function player_obstacle_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_obstacle_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		--동시에 프리펩 배경 속도는 1초동안 7로 감소. 이후 다시 12로 원상복귀.
		start_coroutine(function()
			local background_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.background)

			background_manager:change_speed(background_manager.obstacle_speed, 1)

			local main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)

			--기존 속도로
			if main_game.current_game_state == main_game.game_state.ending then
				return
			end

			background_manager:set_speed(background_manager.original_speed)
		end)

		self.super.player_move_wait = self.super.player_move_wait_state.phase_1

		local distance = self.super.move_data.opponent_distance
		local duration = self.super.move_data.opponent_duration
		local direction = vector(1, 0, 0)

		--플레이어 연출
		--플레이어 표정 damaged로 수정.
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.super.player, self.controller, 'damaged')
		--카메라 shake 0.3초간 세기 0.15로.
		camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)

		self.super.controller:change_move_event(distance, duration, direction)

		self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_1
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_1 then
		if self.super.player_move_wait == self.super.player_move_wait_state.phase_1 then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_2
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_2 then
		if self.time_passed >= self.super.move_data.opponent_duration then
			self.super.controller:change_state(player_normal_state(self.controller))
		end
	end
end

--endregion player_obstacle_state


-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  몸싸움 상태
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region player_wrestle_state
function player_wrestle_state:init(controller, type, pre_state_end_pos)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.player.wrestle)

	self.wrestle_type = type
	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		phase_1 = 1,
		phase_2 = 2,
		phase_3 = 3
	}
	self.pre_state_end_pos = pre_state_end_pos
	self.current_progress = self.progress
	self.fx_oppose_spark = nil
	self.qte_success = nil
	self.is_qte = nil
	self.spark_sfx = nil
end

function player_wrestle_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.super.player_move_wait = self.super.player_move_wait_state.none

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none

	if self.wrestle_type == state_type.wrestle.normal then
		self.super.move_data = self.super.controller.constants_data.move_data.wrestle.normal
	elseif self.wrestle_type == state_type.wrestle.booster then
		self.super.move_data = self.super.controller.constants_data.move_data.wrestle.booster
	end

	self.qte_duration = self.super.controller.common_constants_data.qte.duration
	self.qte_tap = self.super.controller.common_constants_data.qte.tap
	self.qte_background_speed = self.super.controller.common_constants_data.qte.background_speed
	self.qte_success = nil
	self.is_qte = nil
end

function player_wrestle_state:exit(next_state)
end

function player_wrestle_state:dispose()
	character_util.stop_shake(self.super.player)
	character_util.stop_shake(self.super.opponent)

	if self.fx_oppose_spark then
		self.fx_oppose_spark:Dispose()
		self.fx_oppose_spark = nil
	end

	if self.spark_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.spark_sfx)
		self.spark_sfx = nil
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	local main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)

	camera_util.move(main_game.center_pos, 0.1)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(
			main_game.common_constants_data.camera_size,
			0.1)

	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_wrestle_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.wrestle_type == state_type.wrestle.normal then
		self:update_normal(dt)
	elseif self.wrestle_type == state_type.wrestle.booster then
		self:update_booster(dt)
	end
end

function player_wrestle_state:update_normal(dt)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		self.super.controller:change_wrestle_event()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')

		self.spark_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_light_loop_03', loop = true })

		character_util.shake(self.super.player, 0.4, 9999)
		character_util.shake(self.super.opponent, 0.4, 9999)

		scene_util.set_emotion(self.super.player, self.super.controller, 'burning')
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.super.opponent, self.super.controller, 'burning')

		local fx_pos = ((self.super.player.Position + self.super.opponent.Position) * 0.5)

		fx_pos = fx_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)

		self.fx_oppose_spark = self.super.controller.fx.oppose_spark():Instantiate(fx_pos)

		start_coroutine(function()
			local main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)

			camera_util.move(self.super.player.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.1)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(
					main_game.common_constants_data.camera_size * 0.5,
					0.1)

			self.qte_success = qte_play_util.tap(self.qte_tap.normal, {
				duration = self.qte_duration.normal, darken = false, tap_count_callback = function()
					camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
				end })

			camera_util.move(main_game.center_pos, 0.1)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(
					main_game.common_constants_data.camera_size,
					0.1)

			self.is_qte = true
		end)

		self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_1
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_1 then
		if self.is_qte then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_2
		end
		self.super.time_passed = 0
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_2 then
		character_util.stop_shake(self.super.player)
		character_util.stop_shake(self.super.opponent)

		if self.spark_sfx then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.spark_sfx)
			self.spark_sfx = nil
		end

		if self.fx_oppose_spark then
			self.fx_oppose_spark:Dispose()
			self.fx_oppose_spark = nil
		end

		--상대 캐릭터가 1초에 걸쳐 왼쪽으로 2칸 이동
		if self.qte_success then
			--성공
			local distance = self.super.move_data.distance
			local duration = self.super.move_data.duration
			local direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)

			character_util.set_emotion(self.super.player, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.super.opponent, { name = 'damaged' })

			self.super.controller:change_move_event(distance, duration, direction)
		else
			--실패
			--동시에 프리펩 배경 속도는 1초동안 7로 감소. 이후 다시 12로 원상복귀.
			start_coroutine(function()
				manager_container:get(manager_type.background):change_speed(self.qte_background_speed.normal, 1)

				local main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)

				--기존 속도로
				if main_game.current_game_state == main_game.game_state.ending then
					return
				end

				--기존 속도로
				manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
						manager_container:get(manager_type.background).original_speed)
			end)

			--상대 캐릭터가 1초간 오른쪽으로 2칸 이동
			local distance = self.super.move_data.distance
			local duration = self.super.move_data.duration
			local direction = vector(1, 0, 0)

			character_util.set_emotion(self.super.opponent, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.super.player, { name = 'damaged' })

			self.super.controller:change_move_event(distance, duration, direction)
		end

		self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_3
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_3 then
		self.super.controller:change_state(player_wait_state(self.controller, 0.5))
	end
end

function player_manager:finished_wrestle_event()
	local main_game_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)
	local custom_event = CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.player, { main_game_manager.finished_wrestle_event })

	message_system:PublishSync(custom_event)
end

function player_manager:change_move_event(distance, duration, direction)
	manager_container:get(manager_type.opponent):change_move_state(distance * direction, duration)
end

function player_manager:change_wrestle_event()
	manager_container:get(manager_type.opponent):change_wrestle_state()
end

function player_wrestle_state:update_booster(dt)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		self.super.controller:change_wrestle_event()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')

		self.spark_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_light_loop_03', loop = true })

		character_util.shake(self.super.player, 0.4, 9999)
		character_util.shake(self.super.opponent, 0.4, 9999)

		scene_util.set_emotion(self.super.player, self.super.controller, 'burning')
		scene_util.set_emotion(self.super.opponent, self.super.controller, 'burning')

		local fx_pos = ((self.super.player.Position + self.super.opponent.Position) / 2)
		local direction = vector(0, 0, self.super.opponent.Position.z - self.super.player.Position.z).normalized

		fx_pos = fx_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)

		self.fx_oppose_spark = self.super.controller.fx.oppose_spark():Instantiate(fx_pos)

		start_coroutine(function()
			local main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)

			camera_util.move(self.super.player.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.1)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(
					main_game.common_constants_data.camera_size * 0.5,
					0.1)

			self.qte_success = qte_play_util.tap(self.qte_tap.booster, { duration = self.qte_duration.booster, darken = false, tap_count_callback = function()
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
			end })

			camera_util.move(main_game.center_pos, 0.1)
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(
					main_game.common_constants_data.camera_size,
					0.1)

			self.is_qte = true
		end)

		self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_1
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_1 then
		if self.is_qte then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_2
		end
		self.super.time_passed = 0
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_2 then
		if self.spark_sfx then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.spark_sfx)
			self.spark_sfx = nil
		end

		character_util.stop_shake(self.super.player)
		character_util.stop_shake(self.super.opponent)

		if self.fx_oppose_spark then
			self.fx_oppose_spark:Dispose()
			self.fx_oppose_spark = nil
		end

		--상대 캐릭터가 1초에 걸쳐 오른쪽으로 8칸 이동
		if self.qte_success then
			--성공
			local distance = self.super.move_data.distance
			local duration = self.super.move_data.duration
			local direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)

			self.super.controller:change_move_event(distance, duration, direction)
		else
			--실패
			--동시에 프리펩 배경 속도는 1초동안 7로 감소. 이후 다시 12로 원상복귀.
			start_coroutine(function()
				manager_container:get(manager_type.background):change_speed(self.qte_background_speed.booster, 1)

				local main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)

				--기존 속도로
				if main_game.current_game_state == main_game.game_state.ending then
					return
				end

				--기존 속도로
				manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
						manager_container:get(manager_type.background).original_speed)
			end)


			--상대 캐릭터가 1초간 오른쪽으로 2칸 이동
			local distance = self.super.move_data.distance
			local duration = self.super.move_data.duration
			local direction = vector(1, 0, 0)

			self.super.controller:change_move_event(distance, duration, direction)
		end

		self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_3
	elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_3 then
		self.super.controller:change_state(player_wait_state(self.controller, 0.5))
	end
end

--endregion player_wrestle_state

--region player_faint_state
function player_faint_state:init(controller, duration)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.player.faint)
	self.is_wait = false
	self.duration = duration
end

function player_faint_state:enter(prev_state)
	if prev_state.type ~= state_type.player.faint then
		self.time_passed = 0
	end

	if not self.duration then
		self.duration = self.controller.controller.common_constants_data.faint_duration
	end

	self.is_wait = true
end

function player_faint_state:exit(next_state)

end

function player_faint_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_faint_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.is_wait and self.time_passed > self.duration then
		self.is_wait = false
		self.super.controller:change_state(player_wait_state(self.controller, 0.5))
	end
end
--endregion

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  뒤에서 박혔을때 상태
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--#region player_bump_behind_state
function player_bump_behind_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.player.bump_behind)

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		phase_1 = 1,
		phase_2 = 2
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress

	self.super.move_data = self.super.controller.constants_data.move_data.behind
end

function player_bump_behind_state:enter(prev_state)
	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('racing_center_pos')

	self.super.start_pos = self.super.player.Position
	local direction = (self.super.player.Position.z < self.super.opponent.Position.z) and
			vector(0, 0, -1) or vector(0, 0, 1)
	self.super.end_pos = self.super.player.Position + direction

	self.cur_direction = direction

	--충돌 즉시
	--좌측에 있는 캐릭터 표정 damaged로 변경.
	--카메라 shake 0.3초간 세기 0.15로.
	--A초 지난 후, 좌측에 있는 캐릭터 표정 smile로 변경.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.super.opponent, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.super.opponent)

	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)

	if (center_pos.z) - 2 <= self.super.opponent.Position.z and
			self.cur_direction == vector(0, 0, 1) then
		self.cur_direction = self.cur_direction * -1

	elseif (center_pos.z) - 6 >= self.super.opponent.Position.z and
			self.cur_direction == vector(0, 0, -1) then
		self.cur_direction = self.cur_direction * -1
	end

	self.is_change_state = false
	self.distance = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).constants_data.move_data.behind.height_distance
	self.duration = manager_container:get(manager_type.player).constants_data.move_data.behind.height_duration
	self.cur_speed = self.distance / self.duration
end

function player_bump_behind_state:exit()
	manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
			manager_container:get(manager_type.background).original_speed)
end

function player_bump_behind_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_bump_behind_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:move_speed_routine(dt)
end

function player_bump_behind_state:move_speed_routine(dt)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress.phase_1 then
		manager_container:get(manager_type.background):set_speed(
				manager_container:get(manager_type.background).obstacle_speed)

		--화면 패닝 속도는 장애물 충돌값과 동일하게 낮아짐.
		self.current_progress = self.progress.phase_2
	else
		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self.super.controller:change_state(player_normal_state(self.controller))
		end
	end
end
--endregion player_bump_behind_state

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  이동 상태
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region player_move_state
function player_move_state:init(controller, target, distance, duration, direction)
	self.super:init(controller, state_type.player.move)
	self.target = target
	self.end_pos = self.target.Position + (direction * distance)
	self.duration = duration
	self.start_pos = self.target.Position
	self.move_end = false
end

function player_move_state:exit(next_state)
end

function player_move_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_move_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.state_finished = true
end

function player_move_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:move_lerp_routine(dt)

	if self.move_end then
		self.super.controller:change_state(player_wait_state(self.controller))
	end
end

function player_move_state:move_lerp_routine(dt)
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.duration)
	self.target.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.target.Position = self.end_pos
		self.move_end = true
	end

	return true
end

--endregion

-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--                  플레이어 매니저
-- //////////////////////////////////////////////////
--region player_manager

function player_manager:init()
	self.player = nil
	self.opponent = nil
	self.player_data = nil

	self.state = nil

	self.item = {
		booster = false,
	}

	--region FX
	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		oppose_spark = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_twosword_oppose_spark')
		end,
		booster_fire = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_booster_fire')
		end,
		booster = nil,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion FX
end

function player_manager:dispose()
	self.controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

function player_manager:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.constants_data = controller.player_constants_data
	self.common_constants_data = controller.common_constants_data

	self.player_controller = manager_container:get(manager_type.player)
	self.opponent_controller = manager_container:get(manager_type.opponent)

	self.player = self.controller.player_constants_data:get_player()
	self.opponent = self.controller.opponent_constants_data:get_opponent()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.player, active_state_type.enabled)
	local hitbox = self.controller.player_constants_data.hit_box
	local pivot = self.player.Hitbox.pivot

	self.player_data = {
		--게임 시작시 히트박스
		hit_box = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(hitbox.x, hitbox.y, hitbox.z)),
		start_pos = self.controller.center_pos + self.controller.player_constants_data.start_pos_offset
	}

	self.fx.booster = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.constants_data.move_data.booster.booster_using_effect)
	end

	self.fx:load_all()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function player_manager:start_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	--플레이어 기본 세팅
	self.player.Position = self.player_data.start_pos
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.player, 'right')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)

	self.player.Hitbox = self.player_data.hit_box

	--종료 시 한번만 실행하기 위함
	self.is_ending = self.controller.is_playing_game

	self:change_state(player_normal_state(self))
end

function player_manager:update_routine(dt)
	if self.state ~= nil and
			not (self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.ending) then
		self.state:update(dt)

		if not self.controller.is_playing_game and
				self.is_ending then
			self.is_ending = false

			self:change_state(player_normal_state(self))
		end
	end
end

function player_manager:reset_setting()
	if self.state then
		self.state:exit()
		self.state:dispose()
	end

	self:disable_booster()
	self:dispose()
	self:clean()
end

function player_manager:clean()
	self.player.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.player = nil
	self.opponent = nil
	self.player_data = nil

	self.state = nil

	self.item.booster = false
end

function player_manager:change_wrestle_state(is_booster)

	if is_booster then
		--부스터 상태에서 몸싸움
		self:change_state(player_wrestle_state(self, state_type.wrestle.booster))
	else
		--노말 상태에서 몸싸움
		self:change_state(player_wrestle_state(self, state_type.wrestle.normal))
	end
	return true
end

function player_manager:change_state(next_state)
	if self.state then
		self.state:exit(next_state)
		self.state:dispose()
	end

	local prev_state = self.state
	self.state = next_state

	if next_state ~= nil then
		self.state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

function player_manager:on_collide(hit_info, item_type)
	--플레이어가
	--아이템과 충돌 했을 때
	if item_type then
		if item_type == state_type.item.obstacle then
			self:change_state(player_obstacle_state(self))

			return true
		elseif item_type and item_type == state_type.item.booster then
			self:enable_booster()

			return true
		end

		return true
	end

	--사람 충돌
	self:when_collided_to_opponent(hit_info.target, self.opponent_controller.opponent)
end

function player_manager:when_collided_to_opponent(opponent)
	--스페셜 이벤트 진행 중일 시 return
	if self.opponent_controller.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.special_attack then
		character_util.set_emotion(self.player, { name = 'damaged' })
		self:change_state(player_wait_state(self))

		return true
	end

	if not (self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.normal or
			self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.booster) then
		return
	end

	--둘 다 노말 상태

	--상대편이 뒤에 있을경우 true
	local is_opponent_behind = self.player.Position.x > opponent.Position.x + 2

	--같은 상태인가 ?
	local is_same_state = ((self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.normal)
			and (self.opponent_controller.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.normal))
			or ((self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.booster)
			and (self.opponent_controller.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.booster))

	if is_opponent_behind then
		--왼쪽일 경우 (뒤)
		if self.state.type == state_type.player.normal and
				self.opponent_controller.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.normal then
			local distance = self.constants_data.move_data.behind.width_distance
			local duration = self.constants_data.move_data.behind.width_duration

			--충돌한 위치에 Fx_hit 실행.
			local fx_pos = ((self.player.Position + self.opponent.Position) * 0.5) + vector(0, 0, 1)

			self.controller.fx.hit():Instantiate(fx_pos)

			--플레이어 배 0.04만큼 0.2초간 shake 적용.
			scene_util.shake(self.opponent, 0.04, 0.2, false)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_hit_wall_01')

			--플레이어가 뒤에 있다 (상대편이 뒤에서 박았다)
			self:change_move_event(distance, duration, vector(-1, 0, 0))

			self:change_state(player_bump_behind_state(self))
		end
	else
		--위아래일 경우
		--같은 상태라면 qte 이벤트
		if is_same_state then
			-- 부스터, 부스터 / 노말, 노말 상태
			-- (일반 상태) 플레이어와 (일반 상태) 상대방이 서로 부딪힐 경우
			-- (부스터상태) 플레이어와 (부스터 상태) 상대방이 서로 부딪힐 경우
			if (self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.booster or
					self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.normal) then
				local is_player_behind = self.player.Position.x + 1.5 < self.opponent.Position.x

				--플레이어가 뒤에 있다면 탈출
				if not is_player_behind then
					self:change_wrestle_state(self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.booster)
				end
			end
		else
			--같은 상태가 아니라면 해당 상태를 제거하고 부스터 체크
			if (self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.normal) and
					(self.opponent_controller.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.booster) then
				--플레이어 : 노말 상태, 상대편 : 부스터 상태
				--(일반 상태) 플레이어와 (부스터 상태) 상대방이 서로 부딪힐 경우
				local distance = self.constants_data.move_data.wrestle.normal.distance + 3
				local duration = self.constants_data.move_data.wrestle.normal.duration

				local fx_pos = ((self.player.Position + self.opponent.Position) * 0.5) + vector(0, 0, 1)

				self.controller.fx.hit():Instantiate(fx_pos)

				--충돌한 위치에 Fx_hit 실행.
				--플레이어 배 0.04만큼 0.2초간 shake 적용.
				scene_util.shake(self.opponent, 0.04, 0.2, false)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_hit_wall_01')

				character_util.set_emotion(self.player, { name = 'damaged' })
				character_util.set_emotion(self.opponent, { name = 'smile' })
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player)

				--화면 패닝 속도는 장애물 충돌값과 동일하게 낮아짐.
				--동시에 프리펩 배경 속도는 1초동안 7로 감소. 이후 다시 12로 원상복귀.
				start_coroutine(function()
					local background_manager = manager_container:get(manager_type.background)

					background_manager:change_speed(background_manager.obstacle_speed, 1)

					local main_game = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game)

					--기존 속도로
					if main_game.current_game_state == main_game.game_state.ending then
						return
					end

					--기존 속도로
					background_manager:set_speed(
							background_manager.original_speed)
				end)

				self:change_move_event(distance, duration, vector(1, 0, 0))

				self:change_state(player_faint_state(self, duration))
				return true
			elseif (self.player_controller.state.type == state_type.player.booster) and
					((self.opponent_controller.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.normal) or
							self.opponent_controller.current_state.type == state_type.opponent.move) then
				--플레이어 : 부스터 상태, 상대편 : 노말 상태
				--(부스터 상태) 플레이어와 (일반상태) 상대방이 서로 부딪힐 경우
				local distance = self.constants_data.move_data.wrestle.normal.distance + 3
				local duration = self.constants_data.move_data.wrestle.normal.duration

				--충돌한 위치에 Fx_hit 실행.
				--플레이어 배 0.04만큼 0.2초간 shake 적용.
				scene_util.shake(self.opponent, 0.04, 0.2, false)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_hit_wall_01')

				local fx_pos = ((self.player.Position + self.opponent.Position) * 0.5) + vector(0, 0, 1)

				character_util.set_emotion(self.player, { name = 'smile' })
				character_util.set_emotion(self.opponent, { name = 'damaged' })
				self.controller.fx.hit():Instantiate(fx_pos)

				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.opponent)

				self:change_move_event(distance, duration, vector(-1, 0, 0))

				self:change_state(player_faint_state(self, duration))
			end
		end
	end
end

--부스터
function player_manager:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction1TouchDown and
			self.item.booster and
			(self.state.type == state_type['player'].normal or
					self.state.type == state_type['player'].wait) and
			self.opponent_controller.current_state.type ~= state_type.opponent.special_attack then
		self:disable_booster()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')
		self:change_state(player_booster_state(self))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function player_manager:set_booster(is_active)
	self.item.booster = is_active
end

function player_manager:enable_booster()
	if not self.item.booster then
		self:set_booster(true)

		self.controller.ui_manager:show_button_effect()
	end
end

function player_manager:disable_booster()
	self:set_booster(false)

	self.controller.ui_manager:hide_button_effect()
end
--endregion player_manager

--상대편 직접 접근
function player_manager:change_wait_state(duration)
	self:change_state(player_wait_state(self, duration))
end

function player_manager:change_normal_state()
	self:change_state(player_normal_state(self))
end

return {
	create = function()
		return player_manager();
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('MWRacingUI')

local manager_type = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerType')
local manager_container = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/MilkyWayRacing/ManagerContainer')

function local_class:init()
	--region FX
	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		booster_button_on = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_booster_button_on')
		end,
		booster_button_off = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_booster_button_off')
		end,

		fail_counter_ui = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion FX

	self.get_visual_controller = function()
		return get_field_object('[gimmick]visualController')
	end

	self.is_pause = false

	-- 실패 카운트 UI
	self.ui_fail_counter = nil
end

function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	-- 음 일단 임시로 이렇게 처리
	self.fx.fail_counter_ui()
	self.fx:load_all()

	self.navigation_ui = nil
	self.navigation_obj = nil
	self.fx_booster_button_on = nil

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	--navigation
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ui/stage/minigame', 'MiniGameNavigationBar', function(prefab)
				self.navigation_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.navigation_ui = self.navigation_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameNavigationBar)).GetControllerLuaTable
			end)

	--일시 정지 클릭 버튼 기능
	self.navigation_ui:set_pause_on_click_call_back(function()
		--사운드 전체 일시 정지
		music_player:PauseAllAudioExceptBgmAndNGUI()
		self.is_pause = true
		self:hide_all_ui()
	end)

	--일시 정지 클릭 이어하기 기능
	--사운드 일괄 일시 정지 해제는 Pause 버튼 기본 기능으로 적용 된 상태
	self.navigation_ui:set_pause_continue_call_back(function()
		self:show_all_ui()
		self.is_pause = false
	end)

	self.navigation_ui:set_pause_retry_call_back(function()
		self.controller:restart_game(false, false)
		self.is_pause = false
	end)

	self:init_fail_counter()
	self:hide_fail_counter_ui()
end

function local_class:init_fail_counter()
	-- 실패 카운트 UI 생성 및 초기화
	if self.ui_fail_counter == nil then
		local life = self.controller.constants_data.life == nil and 3 or self.controller.constants_data.life
		local ui_fail_counter_obj = self.fx.fail_counter_ui():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local counter_num = ui_fail_counter_obj.transform.childCount

		self.ui_fail_counter = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))

		if life > counter_num then
			self.ui_fail_counter:IncreaseMaxCountByNum(life - counter_num)
		end

		-- insrease 된 후의 childCount만큰 순회
		for i = 0, ui_fail_counter_obj.transform.childCount - 1 do
			local child_obj = ui_fail_counter_obj.transform:GetChild(i).gameObject
			if i < life then
				child_obj:SetActive(true)
			else
				child_obj:SetActive(false)
			end
		end

		self.ui_fail_counter:SetCenterPosOfActiveCount(vector(15, 275))
	end

	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)
end

function local_class:update_fail_counter_ui(hit_count)
	if hit_count ~= 0 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	end

	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(hit_count)
end

function local_class:reset_setting()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseOptionButton = true

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()

	--Dpad (SetUI 이후 사용해야 제거 가능)
	local dpad_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(get_party_leader())[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad]
	local right_tr = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(dpad_ui.transform, 'right')
	right_tr.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local left_tr = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(dpad_ui.transform, 'left')
	left_tr.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	self:update_fail_counter_ui(0)

	self:hide_all_ui()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(manager_container:get(manager_type.player).player)

	self:all_unsubscribe()
	self:dispose()
	self:clean()
end

function local_class:clean()
	self.is_pause = false
end

function local_class:all_unsubscribe()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:remove_ui_fail_counter()
	self:all_unsubscribe()
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	if not self.is_pause then
		self.is_pause = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	if self.is_pause then
		start_coroutine(self.show_minigame_field_ui, self)
	end
end

function local_class:hide_minigame_field_ui()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
end

function local_class:show_minigame_field_ui()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)

	--리더로 Dpad 설정 (SetUI를 하지 않을 경우 에러 발생)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(get_party_leader(), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1)

	coroutine.yield()

	--Dpad (SetUI 이후 사용해야 제거 가능)
	local dpad_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(get_party_leader())[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad]
	local right_tr = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(dpad_ui.transform, 'right')
	right_tr.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local left_tr = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(dpad_ui.transform, 'left')
	left_tr.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--region Booster
	self.booster_button = field_ui_manager:GetUI(get_party_leader())[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction1]

	local button_icon_name = manager_container:get(manager_type.main_game).item_constants_data.booster.button_icon_name
	--버튼 이미지, 크기 설정
	self.booster_button:SetButtonSprite(button_icon_name, vector(1, 1, 1))

	--키 바인딩
	self.booster_button:BindingKeyCode(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Z)
	self.booster_button:SetKeyboardStringKey('gpg_keycode_z')

	--버튼 위치 설정
	local positioner = self.booster_button.transform:Find('Touch').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
	positioner.Position = vector(-100, 100)
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		positioner.ScaleFactor = 1.25
	else
		positioner.ScaleFactor = 1
	end
	positioner:Rebuild()

	self.booster_button:SetButtonEffectPool("fx_mw_booster_button_off",
			"fx_ui_lw_moneyshot_event_special_button_end_b_pad")

	self:set_button_effect()

	--endregion Booster
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseOptionButton = false
end

--버튼 활성화 풀 등록
function local_class:set_button_effect()
	self.booster_button:SetButtonEffectPool("fx_mw_booster_button_on",
			"fx_ui_lw_moneyshot_event_special_button_b_pad")
end

--버튼 입력시 원샷 풀 등록
function local_class:set_button_end_effect()
	self.booster_button:SetButtonEffectPool("fx_mw_booster_button_off",
			"fx_ui_lw_moneyshot_event_special_button_end_b_pad")
end

function local_class:show_button_effect()
	local positioner = self.booster_button.transform:Find('Touch').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))

	local effect_size = positioner.ScaleFactor

	if self.controller.screen_half_size > 21 then
		effect_size = effect_size - 0.05
	elseif self.controller.screen_half_size < 15 then
		effect_size = effect_size + 0.35
	else
		effect_size = effect_size + 0.35
	end

	--게임패드 사이즈 대응
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		effect_size = 1
	end

	self:set_button_effect()

	music_player_util.play_multiple_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01', '01_enhance_light_01')

	self.booster_button:ShowButtonEffect(effect_size)
end

function local_class:hide_button_effect()
	local positioner = self.booster_button.transform:Find('Touch').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))

	local effect_size = positioner.ScaleFactor

	self.booster_button:DisposeButtonEffect()

	self:set_button_end_effect()

	self.booster_button:ShowButtonEffect(effect_size)
end

function local_class:setting_shear(value)
	local visual_controller = self.get_visual_controller()

	visual_controller.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = value
end

--시어 0으로 변경
function local_class:set_zero_shear()
	local visual_controller = self.get_visual_controller()
	self.origin_shear = visual_controller.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear

	self:setting_shear(0)
end

function local_class:set_origin_shear()
	self:setting_shear(self.origin_shear)
end

function local_class:booster_button_toggle(is_start)
	if is_start then
		local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height;
		local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight);
		local button_pos = vector(0, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 140, 0)

		self.fx_booster_button_on = self.fx.booster_button_on():Instantiate(field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).transform.position)
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.fx_booster_button_on.transform, 'UI')
		self.fx_booster_button_on.transform.localPosition = button_pos

	else
		if self.fx_booster_button_on then
			self.fx.booster_button_off():Instantiate()

			self.fx_booster_button_on():Dispose()
			self.fx_booster_button_on = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:hide_all_ui()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	self.navigation_ui:set_active(false)
	self:hide_fail_counter_ui()
end

function local_class:hide_fail_counter_ui()
	self.ui_fail_counter.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:dispose_navigation_ui()
	if not is_unity_null(self.navigation_obj) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.navigation_obj)
		self.navigation_obj = nil
		self.navigation_ui = nil
	end
end

function local_class:show_fail_counter_ui()
	self.ui_fail_counter.transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

function local_class:show_all_ui()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	--기존 환경 제거
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	self.navigation_ui:set_active(true)
end

function local_class:remove_ui_fail_counter()
	if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass("MonsterBentoShopController")

function local_class:init(cs_controller, scene)
	self.constants = require('minigame/MonsterBentoShop/MonsterBentoShopConstants').default

	self.game_name = "RinShop"
	self.game_time = 0
	self.bribed = false

	self.battle_group_name = 'BATTLE_'

	self.custom_atlas = nil

	self.recipes = nil

	self.sales = 0

	-- 각 객체별 enum
	self.save_data = {}

	self.table_positions = {}

	self.tables = {}

	self.cashier_positions = {}

	self.cashiers = {}

	self.customers = {}

	self.customer_state_enum = {
		appearing = 0,
		choosing = 1,
		waiting = 2,
		move_waiting = 3,
		leaving = 4,
		moving = 5,
		paying = 6,
		exiting = 7,
		idle = 8,
	}

	self.is_game_playing = false


	self.idle_table_indexes = {}
	self.idle_customer_indexes = {}

	self.shop_open = nil
	-- 손님 머리위에 띄워준 UI 묶음.
	self.place_states = nil

	-- 영업결과
	self.shop_result = nil

	self.customer_position_cache = {}
	self.waypoint_index_cache = {}

	self.paused = false

	self.merchant = nil
	self.hunter = nil
	self.idol = nil
	self.builder = nil

	--에픽 손님 등장 제한 용 flag/변소
	self.is_epic_flag = false
	self.num_epic_guests = 0


	--TODO: 진행도에 따라 해금된 사냥터의 제한을 다르게 설정할 수 있도록 한다.
	self.zone_limit = #self.constants.hunting_zone_tendency

	-- 레벨 업 연출 리소스
	self.fx_level_up = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	self.fx_level_up = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_levelup_new')
	unity_object_pool:WaitAll()

	return util.cs_generator(self.stage_load_resource, self)
end

--- Load Resources Here.
function local_class:stage_load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadStageTitle()

	yield_return_func(self.load_bento_shop, self)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
		return self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.zone_limit do
		if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name .. i then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunting_finished, self, i))
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.game_name then
		if e:GetParamAt(1) == 'merchant_interact_event' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.merchant_interact_event, self))
			return true
		elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'hunter_interact_event' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hunter_interact_event, self)
			return true
		elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'idol_interact_event' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.idol_interact_event, self))
			return true
		elseif e:GetParamAt(1) == 'builder_interact_event' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.builder_interact_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:hunter_interact_event()

	party_util.align_to_target(self.hunter, 'down', 0.5, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hunter, {key = 'rin_shop_hunter_talk_1', skip = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.hunter, {key = 'rin_shop_hunter_talk_2', skip = true})

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'rin_shop_hunter_branch_1', 'forced'},{'rin_shop_hunter_branch_2', 'normal'}})


	if choose_result == 1 then
		local zone = 0
		local tmp = 1
		while zone == 0 do
			local branches = {}
			-- FIXME : 진행도에 따라 zone_limit 수정하여 사냥터 제한을 설정함
			-- FIXME : 혹은 constants에 테이블 수 및 뇌물 단계 등을 통해 해금된 사냥터의 테이블을 만들어 쓸 수도 있다.
			-- FIXME : 우선 이미 클리어 한 사냥터는 선택지에서 제외하도록 함. 추후 수정 가능.
			while tmp <= self.zone_limit and #branches < 3 do
				local index = tmp
				if not self.recipes[self.constants.default_available_recipe_count + index - 1].Available then
					table.insert(branches,
							{'rin_shop_hunter_zone_' .. index,
							self.constants.hunting_zone_tendency[index], function() zone = index end})
				end
				tmp = tmp + 1
			end
			if tmp > self.zone_limit then
				table.insert(branches,
						{'rin_shop_hunter_zone_cancel', 'normal', function() zone = -1 end})
			else
				table.insert(branches,
						{'rin_shop_hunter_zone_next', 'normal', function() zone = 0 end})
			end

			choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(branches)
		end

		if zone == -1 then return end

		yield_return_func(self.go_to_hunting_zone, self, zone)
	end
end

function local_class:go_to_hunting_zone(index)
	if index <= 0 then return end

	local marker = field:GetMarker('hunting_zone_' .. index)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_with_marker(user_party.Leader, marker)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader,
			marker.position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1, nil,
			true, true, false)

	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_intro_china_01')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('rin_shop_hunter_zone_' .. index), 1.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:hunting_finished(index)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(6)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.PopUpState()
	popup_state.NoticePopUp = true
	popup_state.Title = game_string:GetString('rinshop_hunting_complete_title')
	popup_state.Text = game_string:Format('rinshop_hunting_complete_body',
			game_string:GetString(self.recipes[self.constants.default_available_recipe_count + index - 1].Name))
	popup_state.IsShowFanfareEffect = true
	popup_state.DontPopOverlay = true
	local wait_for_exit = true
	popup_state.OnYesOrNoClicked = function (ok)
		wait_for_exit = false
	end
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.PopUp.Instance, popup_state)

	while wait_for_exit do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local marker = field:GetMarker('default_start')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()

	self.recipes[self.constants.default_available_recipe_count + index - 1].Available = true

	yield_return_func(self.save_recipe, self)

	local heal_info_party = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info_party.sender = user_party.Leader
	heal_info_party.target = user_party.Leader
	heal_info_party.heal = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info_party.skipEffect = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info_party)

	character_util.set_with_marker(user_party.Leader, marker)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/v2_9_rinshop/audio:bgm_lynn_theme', state = 'field', mix = 2})
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:merchant_interact_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	party_util.align_to_target(self.merchant, 'down', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 장사를 시작할 준비가 되었나?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, {key = 'rin_shop_merchant_talk', skip = true})

	local branches = {
		{ 'rin_shop_choose_open_1', 'mercy' },
		{ 'rin_shop_choose_open_2', 'normal' }
	}
	if self.save_data.ShopLevel < #self.constants.bribe_cost then
		table.insert(branches, { game_string:Format('rin_shop_choose_open_3',
				self.constants.bribe_cost[self.save_data.ShopLevel + 1]),
								 'brutal' })
	end


	local choose_result = self:speech_while_choose_branch(self.merchant,
	game_string:Format('rin_shop_current_money_merchant', self.save_data.Money), branches)

	if choose_result == 1 then
		if self.save_data.Money <= self.constants.low_money_limit then
			-- 자금 {0} 골드…대체 운영을 어떻게 하면 자금 상태가 이 모양인가…
			character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, {name = 'question', loop = false})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = game_string:Format('rin_shop_merchant_low_gold_1',
					self.save_data.Money), skip = true})

			-- 일단 사신청에서 대출을 해줄테니 조금 더 제대로 운영을 해주게.
			character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = 'rin_shop_merchant_low_gold_2', skip = true})

			self.save_data.Money = self.constants.loan_money_amount
			coroutine.yield(self:save())
			-- wait_for_sec(0.3)
			character_util.remove_anim(self.merchant)
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create('RinShop'))
	else
		if choose_result == 3 then
			if self.save_data.Money > self.constants.bribe_cost[self.save_data.ShopLevel + 1] then
				self.save_data.Money = self.save_data.Money - self.constants.bribe_cost[self.save_data.ShopLevel + 1]

				-- 사신청에서 당신의 기부를 매우 고맙게 생각하고 있습니다
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, {key = 'rin_shop_merchant_talk_1', skip = true})
				-- 이대로 덕을 쌓으면 분명 좋은일이 있을것이에요
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, {key = 'rin_shop_merchant_talk_2', skip = true})

				local star_piece = get_field_object(self.constants.bribe_starpiece_name[self.save_data.ShopLevel + 1])
				star_piece.Position = self.merchant.Position + 1 * unity_class.vector3.right  + 1 * unity_class.vector3.back
				message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(self.merchant.Position))

				self.save_data.ShopLevel = self.save_data.ShopLevel + 1

				coroutine.yield(self:save())
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
				self.bribed = true
			else
				-- 돈이 생기면 기부하십시오!
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.merchant, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, {key = 'rin_shop_merchant_talk_3', skip = true})
			end
		end

function local_class:idol_interact_event()

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		party_util.align_to_target(self.idol, 'down', 0.5, 'linear')

		local branches

		-- 아이돌즈가 홍보를 하면 손님이 훨씬 더 몰려올거에요
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.idol, {key = 'rin_shop_idols_talk', skip = true})
		branches = {
			{game_string:Format('rin_shop_idols_hire_1', self.constants.idol_marketing_cost), 'mercy'},
			{'rin_shop_idols_hire_2', 'normal'}}
		choose_result = self:speech_while_choose_branch(self.idol,
				game_string:Format('rin_shop_current_money_idol', self.save_data.Money), branches)

		if choose_result == 1 then
			if self.save_data.Money < self.constants.idol_marketing_cost then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.idol, {key = 'rin_shop_idol_not_enough', skip = true})

			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			-- 로컬 세이브 데이터 갱신 후 save 호출해야 함.
			self.save_data.Marketing = 1
			self.save_data.Money = self.save_data.Money - self.constants.idol_marketing_cost

			screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			popup_state.Text = game_string:Format("rinshop_idols_hire_complete_body")

				wait_for_exit = false

function local_class:builder_interact_event()
	local branches = {}
	local purchase = false
	local answer_type = {
		cancel = 0,
		weapon = 1,
		table = 2,
		cashier = 3,
	}
	local answer

	party_util.align_to_target(self.builder, 'down', 0.5, 'linear')

	-- 가게 내부나 무기의 업그레이드는 제게 맡겨주세요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.builder, {key = 'rin_shop_builder_talk', skip = true})

	if self.save_data.WeaponLevel < #self.constants.weapon_upgrade_cost then
		table.insert(branches,
				{game_string:Format('rin_shop_weapon_upgrade', self.constants.weapon_upgrade_cost[self.save_data.WeaponLevel + 1]), 'intellect',
				 function()
					 purchase = true
					 answer = answer_type.weapon
					 end })
	end
	if self.save_data.NumTables < #self.constants.table_upgrade_cost then
		table.insert(branches,
				{game_string:Format('rin_shop_table_upgrade', self.constants.table_upgrade_cost[self.save_data.NumTables + 1]), 'intellect',
				 function()
					 purchase = true
					 answer = answer_type.table
				 end })
	end
	if self.save_data.NumCounters < #self.constants.cashier_upgrade_cost then
		table.insert(branches,
				{game_string:Format('rin_shop_cashier_upgrade', self.constants.cashier_upgrade_cost[self.save_data.NumCounters + 1]), 'intellect',
				 function()
					 purchase = true
					 answer = answer_type.cashier
				 end })
	end

	table.insert(branches,
			{'cancel', 'normal',
			function()
				answer = answer_type.cancel
			end })

	self:speech_while_choose_branch(self.builder, game_string:Format('rin_shop_current_money_builder', self.save_data.Money), branches)
	--[[
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.builder,
			{key = game_string:Format('rin_shop_current_money_builder', self.save_data.Money), skip = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.builder,
			{key = game_string:Format('rin_shop_current_money_builder', self.save_data.Money), life_time = 9999, type_speed = 0 })
	choose_util.play_choose_event(branches)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.builder)
	--]]

	if not purchase then
		return
	end

	if answer == answer_type.weapon then
		yield_return_func(self.upgrade_weapon, self)
	elseif answer == answer_type.table then
		yield_return_func(self.purchase_table, self)
	elseif answer == answer_type.cashier then
		yield_return_func(self.purchase_cashier, self)
	end

end

	local i = 1
	while i < self.save_data.ShopLevel + 1 do
		local star_piece = get_field_object(self.constants.bribe_starpiece_name[i])
		if not stage_progress:HasStarPiece(self.constants.bribe_starpiece_name[i]) and lua_helper.reference_equals(star_piece.ActiveState, CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled) then

-- 레시피 데이터 처리
function local_class:save_recipe(keep_waiting)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000401)
	local data = self:encode_recipe_data()

	local save_success = true
	local on_success = function (res)
		save_success = true
	end

	-- 먼저 custom state 를 set 한다
	local fail_count = 0
	while true do
		local r = CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetCustomState(nil, quest_progress, "RecipeAvailable", data)
		coroutine.yield(r)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		-- on_error 콜백을 안받아서 CustomState 가 실제로 변경되었는지로 체크해야 한다..
		save_success = true
		if quest_progress:GetCustomState("RecipeAvailable") ~= data then
			save_success = false
		end

		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("RinShop : SetCustomState Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end

	fail_count = 0
	while true do
		save_success = false
		local r = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendProgressQuest(stage.StageId, quest_progress.QuestId, quest_progress.InnerProgress, nil)
		r:Then(on_success)
		coroutine.yield(r:SuppressDefaultErrorHandler())
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("RinShop : SendProgressQuest Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end

	--quest_util.set_custom_state(quest_progress, 'RecipeAvailable', data)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
end

--TODO: 퀘스트 커스텀 스테이트에서 저장된 값을 불러옴. 저장된 정보가 없으면 기본값 제공
function local_class:load_recipe()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000401)
	local data = -1

	if quest_progress ~= nil then
		data = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, 'RecipeAvailable')
	end

	if data == -1 then
		data = 7
	end

	for i, _ in ipairs(self.constants.recipe_index) do
		local food = self.recipes[i - 1]
		local available = ((data >> (i - 1)) & 0x1 == 1)
		food.Available = available
	end

	-- 메인 퀘스트 InnerProgress가 2 이상이면 자동으로 recipes에 소일렌트 레드 추가
	if quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 2 then
		if not self.recipes[9].Available then
			self.recipes[9].Available = true
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
end

function local_class:encode_recipe_data()
	local data = 0

	for i, _ in ipairs(self.constants.recipe_index) do
		local temp = self.recipes[(i - 1)].Available and 1 or 0
		temp = ((temp << (i - 1)) & 0xffffffff)
		data = data | temp
	end

	return data
end

function local_class:init_recipes()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000401)

--- 필터링 되지 않은 전체 레시피 목록을 받아옴.
--- 현재 해금된 레시피만 새 리스트에 추가하여 반환함.
function local_class:filter_recipes_opened(recipes)
	local results = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeInfo)

	for i = 0, recipes.Count - 1 do
		local food_info = recipes[i]
		if food_info.Available then
			results:Add(food_info)
		end
	end

	return results
end

--- 해금된 레시피 리스트를 받아옴.
--- 재고가 1개 이상인 요리들만 새 리스트에 추가하여 반환함.
--- 요리 Amount 수정되면 모든 리스트에서 동시에 반영되어야 정상입니다.
function local_class:filter_recipes_empty(recipes)
	local results = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeInfo)

	for i = 0, recipes.Count - 1 do
		local food_info = recipes[i]
		if food_info.Amount > 0 then
			results:Add(food_info)
		end
	end

	return results
end


-- self.recipes 에 특정 name을 가진 음식을 추가.
-- 벌써 있으면 Amount+1, 없으면 1개를 생성해서 self.recipes 에 추가
function local_class:add_recipe(recipe_name)
	for i=0, self.recipes.Count - 1 do
		if self.recipes[i].Name == recipe_name then
			self.recipes[i].Amount = self.recipes[i].Amount + 1
			return
		end
	end

	for i,food_name in pairs(self.constants.recipe_index) do
		if food_name == recipe_name then
			local food = CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeInfo()
			local food_info = self.constants.recipes[food_name]
			food.Name = food_name
			food.SpriteName = food_info.sprite
			food.Amount = 1
			food.Cost = food_info.cost
			food.Stats[CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeStatType.StatA] = food_info.statA
			food.Stats[CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeStatType.StatB] = food_info.statB
			food.Stats[CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeStatType.StatC] = food_info.statC
			self.recipes:Add(food)
			return
		end
	end
end

	local custom_sprite = item:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
	custom_sprite.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

	custom_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.Alpha = 1
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = sprite

	custom_sprite:SetSortingLayer("Top Effects")
	custom_sprite:Rebuild()

end

function local_class:load_bento_shop()

	coroutine.yield(self:load())

	local max_num_tables = #self.constants.table_upgrade_cost + self.constants.default_stats.num_tables
	local max_num_counters = #self.constants.cashier_upgrade_cost + self.constants.default_stats.num_counters

	if self.optimized_npcs == nil then
		local spec_names = {}
		for i = 1, 6 do
			spec_names['customer_'..(i-1)*4+1] = self.constants.customer_stats[i].sprite_name
			spec_names['customer_'..(i-1)*4+2] = self.constants.customer_stats[i].sprite_name
			spec_names['customer_'..(i-1)*4+3] = self.constants.customer_stats[i].sprite_name
			spec_names['customer_'..(i-1)*4+4] = self.constants.customer_stats[i].sprite_name
		end

		end

		--spec_names['cashier_3']='china_female'

	self:set_table_fo_pos(self.save_data.NumTables)

			overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager

		end))

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/v2_9_rinshop/ui", "LynnShopCookMenu"), function(p)
			local menuObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			local overlay = menuObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
			overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
			menuObj:SetActive(false)
		end))

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('spritesheets/items', 'items_custom'), function(prefab)
					self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))

				end))

	local on_help_open = function ()
		self.paused = true
		for i = 0, num_tables -1 do
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	local on_help_close = function ()
		self.paused = false
		self:restore_place_states()
	end

	self.shop_open.OnHelpOpenAction = on_help_open
	self.shop_open.OnHelpCloseAction = on_help_close


	-- 미리 생성해놓은 select_state
