	self.open_select_table = -1

	local on_cancel_select = function ()
		self.open_select_table = -1
		camera_util.move(field:GetMarker('shop_center').position, 0.2)
		self:restore_place_states()
		self.paused = false
	end

	local on_confirm_select = function (selected_recipe)
		local table_index = self.open_select_table
		if not is_unity_null(selected_recipe) then
			local prev_table = -1
			if prev_table > 0 then
				CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Food depleted")
			else
				self.customers[table_index].select_food = selected_recipe
				character_util.set_direction(self.customers[table_index].npc, 'down')

				selected_recipe.Amount = selected_recipe.Amount - 1
				--[[
				local free_cashier = self:get_random_free_cashier_index()
				self.customers[table_index].place = free_cashier
				self.cashiers[free_cashier].customer = table_index
				--]]
				self:customer_change_state(table_index)
				--]]
				self:end_waiting(table_index)
				--]]
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_06')
			end
		end

	end

	self.set_colors = function (colors_list)
		if colors_list.Count > 0 then return end
		local tmp = CS.UnityEngine.Color(self.constants.stat_colors.statA.r,
				self.constants.stat_colors.statA.g,
				self.constants.stat_colors.statA.b)
		colors_list:Add(tmp)
		tmp = CS.UnityEngine.Color(self.constants.stat_colors.statB.r,
				self.constants.stat_colors.statB.g,
				self.constants.stat_colors.statB.b)
		colors_list:Add(tmp)
		tmp = CS.UnityEngine.Color(self.constants.stat_colors.statC.r,
				self.constants.stat_colors.statC.g,
				self.constants.stat_colors.statC.b)
		colors_list:Add(tmp)
	end

	self.select_state.OnConfirmAction = on_confirm_select
	self.select_state.OnCancelAction = on_cancel_select
	self.select_state.StatTypeColorAction = self.set_colors

	for i = 0, self.place_states.Count -1 do
		if i < num_tables then
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.place_states[i]:Init(i + 1, vector(999, 0, 999), nil, self.set_colors)
		else
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.place_states[i]:Clear()
		end
	end


	field_ui_manager:SetUI(get_character('lynn'), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

function local_class:show_payment(customer_index, amount)
	local pos = self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(nil, amount, unity_class.color.white, pos)

	self.sales = self.sales + amount

	local match_stat_value = self.customers[customer_index].select_food.Stats[self.customers[customer_index].target_stat]
	local effect = nil

		effect = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_9_rinshop/ui',

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		effect.transform.position = pos

				'fx_money_explosion_small')
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		effect.transform.position = pos
	end

	if self.customers[customer_index].level == 1 then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_get_heart_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_drop_gold_01')
	elseif self.customers[customer_index].level == 2 then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_get_heart_02')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_drop_gold_01')
	else

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_drop_gold_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(effect)
end

		local payment = self:calculate_payment(customer_index)
		self:end_paying(index, payment)

		self:customer_change_state(index)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_06')
	end
	self.place_states[customer_index - 1]:Init(customer_index,
			self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -2),

function local_class:end_paying(customer_index, pay)
	self.place_states[customer_index - 1].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_payment, self, customer_index, pay))

	-- self:show_payment(customer_index, pay)
end

function local_class:calculate_payment(customer_index)
	local selected_food = self.customers[customer_index].select_food
	local base_price = self.constants.recipes[selected_food.Name].price
	local payment_factor = self.constants.rank_payment_factor[self.customers[customer_index].level]
	local target_stat = self.customers[customer_index].target_stat


	if target_stat == CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeStatType.StatA then
		return base_price * payment_factor * selected_food.Stats[CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeStatType.StatA]
	elseif target_stat == CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeStatType.StatB then
		return base_price * payment_factor * selected_food.Stats[CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeStatType.StatB]
	else
		return base_price * payment_factor * selected_food.Stats[CS.Oak.UI.LynnShopRecipeStatType.StatC]
	end
end

function local_class:table_set_active(index, state)
	if state then
		self.tables[index].customer = 0
		for i, fo in ipairs(self.tables[index].table_fo) do
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
			-- 현재 이 테이블이 있어야 할 알맞은 위치에 있도록 재설정
			fo.Position = self.table_positions[index] + vector(((i - 1) % 3) - 1, 0, 1)
		end

		self.tables[index].position = self.table_positions[index]

	else
		self.tables[index].customer = -1
		for _,fo in ipairs(self.tables[index].table_fo) do
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_customer(index)
	if self.customers[index] == nil then
		local max_num_tables = #self.constants.table_upgrade_cost + self.constants.default_stats.num_tables
		local max_num_counters = #self.constants.cashier_upgrade_cost + self.constants.default_stats.num_counters

		local stat_index = math.floor(((index - 1) / 4)) + 1
		if index > 2 * (max_num_tables + max_num_counters) then
			stat_index = index - 18
		end
		self.customers[index] = {
			npc = self.optimized_npcs['customer_' .. index],
			state = self.customer_state_enum.idle,
			prev_progress = -1,
			progress = 0,
			level = self.constants.customer_stats[stat_index].level,
			place = -1,
			item = nil,
			target_stat = self.constants.customer_stats[stat_index].target_stat,
			select_food = nil
		}
	end

	self.waypoint_index_cache[index] = 1
	self.customers[index].npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(unity_class.time.deltaTime * 2)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.customers[index].npc, 0, 0)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.customers[index].npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	self.customers[index].npc.Position = vector(900 + index, 0, 900)
end

-- 영업 페이즈 루프
function local_class:run_shop()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- Load and Setting Sequence
	yield_return_func(self.load_bento_shop, self)

-- 손님 간 등장 간격을 리턴하는 함수
function local_class:get_customer_gen_interval()
	local gen_mult = 1
	if self.save_data.Marketing == 1 then
		gen_mult = self.constants.idol_marketing_effect_factor
	end

	local gen_base = self.constants.customer_regen_interval[self.save_data.NumTables + 1]

	return gen_base * gen_mult
end

function local_class:game_loop()
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
	local customer_gen_interval = self:get_customer_gen_interval()
	local customer_gen_timer = 0

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/v2_9_rinshop/audio:bgm_lynn_game', state = 'field', mix = 0})

	-- 영업 페이즈 Update loop
	while self.is_game_playing do
		if self.paused then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		else
			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i, _ in ipairs(self.tables) do
				self:table_progress(i, dt)
			end

			for i, _ in ipairs(self.cashiers) do
				self:cashier_progress(i, dt)
			end

			if self.game_time < self.constants.play_time - customer_gen_timer then
				self:enter_customer()
				customer_gen_timer = customer_gen_timer + customer_gen_interval
			end

			if self.sales > self.constants.default_maximum_money then
				self.sales = self.constants.default_maximum_money
			end

			self.shop_open:SetSales(self.sales, self.constants.default_maximum_money)
			self.shop_open:SetTimer(self.game_time)

			if self.game_time < 0 then self.is_game_playing = false end

			self.game_time = self.game_time - dt
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enter_customer()
	local customer = self:get_new_customer()
	local table = self:get_random_free_table_index()

	if table == -1 then
		return
	end

	if customer == -1 then
		return
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_door_push_01')

	self.tables[table].customer = customer
	self.customers[customer].place = table
	self:customer_change_state(customer)
	self.customers[customer].npc.Position = self.tables[table].position
	self.customer_position_cache[customer] = self.customers[customer].npc.Position
	self.waypoint_index_cache[customer] = 1
	self:set_customer_rarity(customer, table)
	self:set_rarity_icon_scale(customer, 1)
end

-- 각 테이블의 진행
--- 테이블에 할당된 손님이 있을 경우, 손님의 state에 따라 진행도를 갱신한다.
function local_class:table_progress(table_index, dt)
	local customer_index = self.tables[table_index].customer
	local end_state = false
	if customer_index > 0 then
		end_state = self:customer_progress(customer_index, dt)
	end

end

-- 각 가판대의 진행
--- 가판대에 할당된 손님이 있을 경우, 손님의 state에 따라 진행도를 갱신한다.
function local_class:cashier_progress(cashier_index, dt)
	local customer_index = self.cashiers[cashier_index].customer
	local end_state = false
	if customer_index > 0 then
		end_state = self:customer_progress(customer_index, dt)
	end

end

function local_class:customer_clear_on_table(customer_index)
	for i, _ in ipairs(self.tables) do
		if self.tables[i].customer == customer_index then
			self.tables[i].customer = 0
		end
	end
end


function local_class:customer_clear_on_cashier(customer_index)
	for i, _ in ipairs(self.cashiers) do
		if self.cashiers[i].customer == customer_index then
			self.cashiers[i].customer = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_longest_waiting(customer_index)
	for i, _ in ipairs(self.customers) do
		if self.customers[i].state == self.customers[customer_index].state then
			if self.customers[i].progress > self.customers[customer_index].progress then
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- 각 손님의 진행
function local_class:customer_progress(customer_index, dt)
	if not self.is_game_playing then return end

	local state = self.customers[customer_index].state
	self.customers[customer_index].prev_progress = self.customers[customer_index].progress
	self.customers[customer_index].progress = self.customers[customer_index].progress + dt
	local progress = self.customers[customer_index].progress
	local on_change_state = false

	-- 각 state별 진행도에 따른 처리
	if state == self.customer_state_enum.appearing then
		character_util.set_active_shadow(self.customers[customer_index].npc, true)
		character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
		character_util.stop_shake(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
		-- progress에 따라 테이블 앞에서 alpha 0 > 1 까지 증가.
		local duration = self.constants.state_durations.appearing
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.customers[customer_index].npc, progress / duration, 0)

		if progress > duration then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 1, 0)
			on_change_state = true
		end

	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.choosing then
		---[[
		-- progress에 따라 테이블 앞에서 고민 후 아이템 들어올림
		character_util.set_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc, { name = 'cross_arm'})
		local section = self.constants.state_durations.choosing / 4
		if progress < section then
			character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'right')
		elseif progress > section and progress < 2 * section then
			character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')
		elseif progress > 2 * section and progress <  3 * section then
			character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'right')
		elseif progress > 3 * section and progress < self.constants.state_durations.choosing then
			character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'up')
		elseif progress > self.constants.state_durations.choosing then
			on_change_state = true
		end
		--]]
		--[[
		if progress > self.constants.state_durations.choosing then
			on_change_state = true
		end
		--]]
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.waiting then
		-- progress에 따라 테이블 앞에서 대기하는 연출
		-- 8초가 지나면 Leaving으로 이동.
		if progress >= self.constants.state_durations.waiting then
			character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'down')
			character_util.stop_shake(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
			on_change_state = true
			-- 4초가 지나면 화난 표정으로 부르르 떨기 시작한다.
		elseif progress >= self.constants.state_durations.waiting / 2 then
			if self.customers[customer_index].prev_progress <= self.constants.state_durations.waiting / 2 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
			end
			character_util.shake(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 0.02, 10000)
			character_util.set_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc, { name = 'mad' })
		end
		self.place_states[customer_index - 1].cachedGameObject:SetActive(true)

	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.move_waiting then
		if progress >= 1 then
			if self.customers[customer_index].item ~= nil then
				-- 아이템을 제대로 들고 있어야 함
				local customer_head_position = vector(self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.x,
						self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.y + 1.2, self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.z)
				self.customers[customer_index].item.transform.position = customer_head_position

				local is_longest_waiting = self:is_longest_waiting(customer_index)
				if is_longest_waiting then
					local available_cashier_index = self:get_random_free_cashier_index()
					if available_cashier_index ~= -1 then
						self.customers[customer_index].place = available_cashier_index
						self.cashiers[available_cashier_index].customer = customer_index

						-- 빈 카운터가 있을 경우, Moving으로 State 전환
						on_change_state = true
					end
				end
				-- 없을 경우에는 최대 8초간 대기
				-- 8초가 지나면 Leaving으로 전환.
				if progress >= self.constants.state_durations.waiting then
					character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')
					character_util.stop_shake(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
					on_change_state = true
					-- 4초가 지나면 화난 표정으로 부르르 떨기 시작한다.
				elseif progress >= self.constants.state_durations.waiting / 2 then
					character_util.shake(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 0.02, 10000)
					character_util.set_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc, { name = 'mad' })
				end
			else
				-- 박수 다 치고 나서 아이템 hold
				local item_on_table = self:set_custom_sprite(self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position, self.customers[customer_index].select_food.SpriteName)

				local customer_head_position = vector(self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.x,
						self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.y + 1.2, self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.z)

				self.customers[customer_index].item = item_on_table

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_holdup_01')
				character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
				character_util.set_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name = 'hold_loop', upper = true})

				self.customers[customer_index].item.transform.position = customer_head_position
				character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')
			end
		else
			local match_stat_value = self.customers[customer_index].select_food.Stats[self.customers[customer_index].target_stat]
			if match_stat_value >= 75 then
				-- 1초 동안 박수
				character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')

				character_util.set_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name = 'smile'})
				character_util.set_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name ='clap'})

				if self.customers[customer_index].prev_progress == 0 then
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_clap_02')
				end
			elseif match_stat_value < 30 then
				-- question 후 sad
				character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')

				character_util.set_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name = 'sad'})
				character_util.set_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name ='question', loop = false})
			else
				-- nod twice 후 sad
				character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')

				character_util.set_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name = 'idle'})
				character_util.set_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name ='nod' })
			end
		end
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.leaving then
		-- 아이템을 내려놓고 화내는 연출
		character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc, { name = 'release'})
		self.place_states[customer_index - 1].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
		local duration = self.constants.state_durations.leaving
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 1 - progress / duration, 0)
		self:set_rarity_icon_scale(customer_index, 1 - progress / duration)

		if progress > duration then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 0, 0)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
			on_change_state = true
		end

	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.moving then
		character_util.stop_shake(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
		-- character_util.remove_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc)

		-- progress에 따라 캐릭터 이동. 일정 속도로 가판대까지 캐릭터의 이동이 끝난 시점에 change state
		local waypoint_idx = self.waypoint_index_cache[customer_index]
		local cashier_index = self.customers[customer_index].place
		local waypoints = self.constants.waypoint_to_cashier[cashier_index]
		-- 계산대 위치가 가변적이게 되서 바꿔줘야 함
		waypoints[2][3] = self.cashiers[cashier_index].position.z

		local dest_x = 0
		local dest_z = 0
		if waypoints[waypoint_idx][4] == true then
			dest_x = (waypoints[waypoint_idx][1] == nil) and self.customer_position_cache[customer_index].x or
					self.customer_position_cache[customer_index].x + waypoints[waypoint_idx][1]
			dest_z = (waypoints[waypoint_idx][3] == nil) and self.customer_position_cache[customer_index].z or
					self.customer_position_cache[customer_index].z + waypoints[waypoint_idx][3]
		else
			dest_x = lua_helper.get_or_default(waypoints[waypoint_idx][1], self.customer_position_cache[customer_index].x)
			dest_z = lua_helper.get_or_default(waypoints[waypoint_idx][3], self.customer_position_cache[customer_index].z)
		end

		local npc_init_pos = self.customer_position_cache[customer_index]
		local moving_speed = 1.5
		local duration = (vector(dest_x, 0, dest_z) - npc_init_pos).magnitude / moving_speed

		character_util.set_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc, { name = 'walk'})

		--[[
		-- 커스텀 삼항 연산을 통한 이동 방향에 다른 캐릭터의 direction 전환
		local x_direction = (self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.x < dest_x) and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or
				(self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.x > dest_x) and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or
				CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		local z_direction =  (self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.z <= dest_z) and CS.Oak.Direction.Up or
				(self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.z > dest_z) and CS.Oak.Direction.Down or
				CS.Oak.Direction.None
		local direction = x_direction | z_direction
		--]]

		character_util.set_direction(self.customers[customer_index].npc, CS.Oak.Direction.Left)
		self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position =
		unity_class.vector3.Lerp(npc_init_pos, vector(dest_x, 0, dest_z), self.customers[customer_index].progress / duration)

		local customer_head_position = vector(self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.x,
				self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.y + 1.2, self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position.z)

		self.customers[customer_index].item.transform.position = customer_head_position

		if self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position == vector(dest_x, 0, dest_z) then
			self.waypoint_index_cache[customer_index] = self.waypoint_index_cache[customer_index] + 1
			self.customers[customer_index].prev_progress = -1
			self.customers[customer_index].progress = 0
			self.customer_position_cache[customer_index] = self.customers[customer_index].npc.Position
		end

		self:update_rarity_ui(customer_index)
		if (self.waypoint_index_cache[customer_index] > #waypoints) then
			character_util.remove_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
			on_change_state = true
		end
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.paying then
		-- 별도 행동 없음

	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.exiting then
		-- 웃으며 fade out 되는 연출
		local duration = self.constants.state_durations.exiting
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 1 - progress / duration, 0)

		character_util.set_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(self.customers[customer_index].npc, {name ='clap'})

		if progress > self.constants.state_durations.exiting then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.customers[customer_index].npc, 0, 0)
			character_util.set_active_shadow(self.customers[customer_index].npc, false)
			self:customer_change_state(customer_index)
			return true
		end
	end

	if on_change_state then
		self:customer_change_state(customer_index)
	end

	return false
end

-- customer의 state가 바뀌는 함수.
function local_class:customer_change_state(customer_index)
	local state = self.customers[customer_index].state
	local progress = self.customers[customer_index].progress

	if state == self.customer_state_enum.idle then
		self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.appearing
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.appearing then
		self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.choosing
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.choosing then
		self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.waiting
		self:choosing_to_waiting(customer_index)
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.waiting then
		if progress >= self.constants.state_durations.waiting then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.leaving
			--self:throw_food(customer_index, true)
		else
			character_util.stop_shake(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
			self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.move_waiting
			self:remove_rarity_icon(customer_index)
		end
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.move_waiting then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.customers[customer_index].npc)
		if progress >= self.constants.state_durations.waiting then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.leaving
			self:throw_food(customer_index, true)
			self:remove_food(customer_index)
		else
			self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.moving
			--self:remove_rarity_icon(customer_index)
		end
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.leaving then
		self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.idle
		if self.customers[customer_index].level == 3 then self.is_epic_flag = false end
		self:remove_food(customer_index)
		self:customer_clear_on_table(customer_index)
		self:remove_rarity_icon(customer_index)
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.moving then
		self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.paying
		self:customer_clear_on_table(customer_index)
		self:moving_to_paying(customer_index)
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.paying then
		self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.exiting
		self:throw_food(customer_index, false)
		self:remove_food(customer_index)
		--self:customer_clear_on_cashier(customer_index)
	elseif state == self.customer_state_enum.exiting then
		self.customers[customer_index].state = self.customer_state_enum.idle
		if self.customers[customer_index].level == 3 then self.is_epic_flag = false end
		self:customer_clear_on_cashier(customer_index)
	end
	self.customers[customer_index].prev_progress = -1
	self.customers[customer_index].progress = 0
end

function local_class:restore_place_states()
	for i = 0, #self.customers -1 do
		local state = self.customers[i + 1].state
		if state == self.customer_state_enum.waiting or state == self.customer_state_enum.paying then
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject.transform:Find('Buttons/Change'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomFilledSprite)).SpriteName = 'slot_btn20_r4.png'
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject.transform:Find('Buttons/Change'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomFilledSprite)):Rebuild()
		end
	end
end

--- 현재 미사용중인 손님들 중 랜덤하게 뽑아서 인덱스를 반환
function local_class:get_new_customer()
	local idle_customers = {}

	local target_level  = 1

	local info = self.constants.customer_probability_info[self.save_data.NumTables + 1]
	local total_weight = info[1] + info[2] + info[3]
	local roll = math.random() * total_weight

	-- 가게에 벌써 에픽 손님이 있으면 에픽 손님을 등장시키지 않음.
	if self.is_epic_flag then
		roll = math.random() * (info[1] + info[2])
		if roll < info[1] then
			target_level = 1
		elseif roll < info[1] + info[2] then
			target_level = 2
		end
	else
		-- 시간 반이 지날 동안 에픽 게스트가 한번도 안나왔다면 강제로 에픽 게스트가 나오도록.
		if self.game_time < self.constants.play_time / 2.0 and self.num_epic_guests == 0 then
			target_level = 3
		else
			if roll < info[1] then
				target_level = 1
			elseif roll < info[1] + info[2] then
				target_level = 2
			else
				target_level = 3
			end
		end
	end

	if target_level == 3 then
		self.is_epic_flag = true
		self.num_epic_guests = self.num_epic_guests + 1
	end

	-- 목표 등급과 idle인 손님 중에서 랜덤하게 고름.
	for i = 1, #self.customers do
		if self.customers[i].state == self.customer_state_enum.idle  and self.customers[i].level == target_level then
			table.insert(idle_customers, i)
		end
	end

	-- 손님이 부족한 경우는 없지만 우선 예외를 둔다.
	if #idle_customers == 0 then
		-- FIXME: 에러를 뱉어야 함.
		return -1
	end

	-- 실제 등장 확률 검증해보고 싶을때 쓰는 디버그 로그
	-- CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log('target_level : '..target_level)

	local rand_table = math.random(1, #idle_customers)

	return idle_customers[rand_table]
end

-- 데이터 처리
function local_class:save(keep_waiting)
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000401)
	local data = self:encode_data()

	local save_success = true
	local on_success = function (res)
		save_success = true
	end

	-- 먼저 custom state 를 set 한다
	local fail_count = 0
	while true do
		local r = CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.SetCustomState(nil, quest_progress, "RinShopSaveData", data)
		coroutine.yield(r)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		-- on_error 콜백을 안받아서 CustomState 가 실제로 변경되었는지로 체크해야 한다..
		save_success = true
		if quest_progress:GetCustomState("RinShopSaveData") ~= data then
			save_success = false
		end

		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("RinShop : SetCustomState Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end

	fail_count = 0
	while true do
		save_success = false
		local r = CS.Oak.NetworkManager.ApiConnection:SendProgressQuest(stage.StageId, quest_progress.QuestId, quest_progress.InnerProgress, nil)
		r:Then(on_success)
		coroutine.yield(r:SuppressDefaultErrorHandler())
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("RinShop : SendProgressQuest Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
end

	end

		self.save_data.NumCounters = 0
		self.save_data.NumTables = 0
		self.save_data.WeaponLevel = 0
		self.save_data.Money = self.constants.default_stats.money
		self.save_data.Marketing = 0

	end

--- self.save_data의 값들을 int로 인코딩 후 반환
--- 32-bit int
--- MSB : 32, LSB : 1 일때 각 값들 bit number:
--- ShopLevel : 1-3
--- NumCounters : 4-6
--- NumTables : 7-9
--- WeaponLevel : 10-13
--- Money : 14-30, 최소단위가 100이라 100을 나눠서 인코딩
--- Marketing : 31
--- 32번째 비트를 사용하면 자동으로 64bit로 변환되어 저장됨.
--- Money 를 제외하고는 모드 실제 보유한 테이블 수/계산대 수 가 아니라 기본 값에다 + offset을 얼마나 해야 하는지를 저장하고 있음. (중요!!)
function local_class:encode_data()
	local data = 0

	local shop_level = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.save_data.ShopLevel , 0)
	local num_counters = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.save_data.NumCounters, 0)
	local num_tables = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.save_data.NumTables, 0)
	local weapon_level = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.save_data.WeaponLevel, 0)
	local marketing = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.save_data.Marketing, 0)
	local money = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.save_data.Money, self.constants.default_stats.money)

	shop_level = (shop_level) & 0x7
	num_counters = (num_counters << 3) & 0x38
	num_tables = (num_tables << 6) & 0x1C0
	weapon_level = (weapon_level << 9) & 0x1E00
	if money > self.constants.default_maximum_money then money = self.constants.default_maximum_money end -- clamp
	money = ((money/100) << 13) & 0x3FFFE000
	marketing = (marketing << 30) & 0x40000000

	data = data | shop_level | num_counters | num_tables | weapon_level | money | marketing

	return data
end

--- 받아온 int값 data를 self.save_data에 디코딩 하여 저장
--- 32-bit int
--- MSB : 32, LSB : 1 일때 각 값들 bit number:
--- ShopLevel : 1-3
--- NumCounters : 4-6
--- NumTables : 7-9
--- WeaponLevel : 10-13
--- Money : 14-30, 최소단위가 100이라 100을 나눠서 인코딩
--- Marketing : 31
--- Money 최대값 Clamp를 통해 마지막 비트를 사용할 일은 없지만 안전을 위해 18비트로 축소(실 사용 = 17bit)
function local_class:decode_data(data)
	local data = math.tointeger(data)

	if data ~= nil then
		self.save_data.ShopLevel = (data & 0x7)
		self.save_data.NumCounters = ((data >> 3) & 0x7)
		self.save_data.NumTables = ((data >> 6) & 0x7)
		self.save_data.WeaponLevel = ((data >> 9) & 0xF)
		self.save_data.Money = ((data >> 13) & 0x1FFFF) * 100
		self.save_data.Marketing = ((data >> 30) & 0x1)

		--- 로직상 세이브 데이터가 최대값을 초과할 일은 발생하지 않겠지만 만약을 대비하여 방어코드는 추가해둔다.

		if self.save_data.ShopLevel > #self.constants.bribe_cost  then
			self.save_data.ShopLevel = #self.constants.bribe_cost
		end

		if self.save_data.NumCounters > #self.constants.cashier_upgrade_cost then
			self.save_data.NumCounters = #self.constants.cashier_upgrade_cost
		end

		if self.save_data.NumTables > #self.constants.table_upgrade_cost then
			self.save_data.NumTables = #self.constants.table_upgrade_cost
		end

		if self.save_data.WeaponLevel > #self.constants.weapon_upgrade_cost then
			self.save_data.WeaponLevel = #self.constants.weapon_upgrade_cost
		end

		if self.save_data.Money > self.constants.default_maximum_money then
			self.save_data.Money = self.constants.default_maximum_money
		end

		if self.save_data.Marketing > 1 then
			self.save_data.Marketing = 1
		end
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('PacMan')

local player_state_base = newclass('PacManPlayerState')
local player_state = {
	idle = newclass('PacManPlayerIdleState', player_state_base),
	berserk = newclass('PacManPlayerBerserkState', player_state_base)
}

local monster_state_base = newclass('PacManMonsterState')
local monster_state = {
	idle = newclass('PacManMonsterIdleState', monster_state_base),
	patrol = newclass('PacManMonsterPatrolState', monster_state_base),
	chasing = newclass('PacManMonsterChasingState', monster_state_base),
	dead = newclass('PacManMonsterDeadState', monster_state_base),
	spawn = newclass('PacManMonsterSpawnState', monster_state_base)
}

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- game name
	self.game_name = 'PacMan'

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 게임 진행도
	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		in_game = 2,
		end_game = 3,
		exit_game = 4
	}

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none

	-- 각 오브젝트 스테이트
	self.states = {
		player_state = player_state,
		monster_state = monster_state,
	}

	-- state 풀
	self.pooled_states = {
		player_state = {},
		monster_state = {}
	}

	-- 플레이어 정보
	self.player_data = nil

	-- 몬스터 및 정보
	self.monsters = nil
	self.monster_data = nil

	-- 몬스터 목적지
	self.monster_destinations = nil

	-- 에너지 아이템
	self.energy_items = nil
	-- 파워 아이템
	self.power_items = nil

	self.fx = {
		blink = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/PacMan/PacManConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.fx:load_all()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.exit_game

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.player_data = nil

	if self.monsters then
		for i = 1, #self.monsters do
			local monster = self.monsters[i]
			monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.WalkSpeed = self.slow_speed
			monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DashSpeed = self.fast_speed
		end

		self.monsters = nil
	end

	self.monster_data = nil

	self.monster_destinations = nil

	if self.energy_items then
		for energy_item in pairs(self.energy_items) do
			energy_item:ConsumeComplete()
			self.energy_items:remove(energy_item)
		end

		self.energy_items:clear()
		self.energy_items = nil
	end

	if self.power_items then
		for power_item in pairs(self.power_items) do
			power_item:ConsumeComplete()
			self.power_items:remove(power_item)
		end

		self.power_items:clear()
		self.power_items = nil
		self.power_items = nil
	end

	if self.pooled_states then
		for _, types in pairs(self.pooled_states) do
			for _, states in pairs(types) do
				for i = 1, #states do
					states[i]:dispose()
				end
			end
		end

		self.pooled_states = nil
	end

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil
end

--region on_event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	for i = 1, 2 do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'pac_man_teleport_' .. i) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_guild_warp_01')
			leader.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('pac_man_teleport_pos_' .. i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

--- 미니게임 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	local origin_leader = get_party_leader()

	local leader
	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		leader = get_character(self.constants_data.player_name .. 'male')
	else
		leader = get_character(self.constants_data.player_name .. 'female')
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(leader, param, true)

	self:game_setting()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		screen_util.show_stage_title('pac_man_count_' .. i, 2.1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader,
		CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/audio:bgm_queenship_assassin', state = 'event' })

	sp_util.exit_scene(nil, origin_leader)

	for monster, monster_data in pairs(self.monster_data) do
		monster_data.state = self:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'idle', monster)
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_game

	-- 게임 성공했는지
	self.is_success_game = true

	while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 에너지 아이템 획득 체크
		for energy_item in pairs(self.energy_items) do
			if (leader.Position - energy_item.Position).sqrMagnitude < 0.5 * 0.5 then
				energy_item:ConsumeComplete()
				self.energy_items:remove(energy_item)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_porcupine_thrust_01')
			end
		end

		-- 파워 아이템 획득 체크
		for power_item in pairs(self.power_items) do
			if (leader.Position - power_item.Position).sqrMagnitude < 0.5 * 0.5 then
				power_item:ConsumeComplete()
				self.power_items:remove(power_item)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_pop_05')

				local state = self:get_or_create_state('player_state', 'berserk', leader)

				if not self:change_state(self.player_data, leader, state) then
					-- 이미 광폭화 상태였을 경우 강제로 상태 초기화
					self.player_data[leader].state:exit()
					self.player_data[leader].state:enter()
				end

				-- 몬스터 추격 상태 해제
				for i = 1, #self.monsters do
					local monster = self.monsters[i]

					-- 몬스터 속도 느려짐
					scene_util.set_anim(monster, self, { name = 'bomb_run', upper = true })
					monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.WalkSpeed = self.slow_speed
					monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DashSpeed = self.slow_speed

					if self.monster_data[monster].state.state_name == 'chasing' then
						local state = self:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'patrol', monster)
						self:change_state(self.monster_data, monster, state)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		self.player_data[leader].state:update(dt)

		-- 몬스터 업데이트
		for _, monster_data in pairs(self.monster_data) do
			monster_data.state:update(dt)
		end

		if #self.energy_items == 0 then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.exit_game then
		return
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.end_game

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	sp_util.enter_scene()

	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	local state = self:get_or_create_state('player_state', 'idle', leader)
	self:change_state(self.player_data, leader, state)

	for i = 1, #self.monsters do
		local monster = self.monsters[i]
		character_util.stop(monster)

		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.WalkSpeed = self.slow_speed
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DashSpeed = self.fast_speed

		local state = self:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'idle', monster)
		self:change_state(self.monster_data, monster, state)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(leader, direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction))

	if self.is_success_game then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

		-- 모두 습득하면 기사 (smile, victory_get)
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'victory_get')

		-- 괴물은 spindead 출력
		for i = 1, #self.monsters do
			local monster = self.monsters[i]
			character_util.air_spin(monster)
		end
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_tipsy_01')

		screen_util.show_stage_title('pac_man_fail')

		-- 기사 (현재 보이는 방향, damaged, dead) 출력
		scene_util.set_emotion(leader, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'dead')
	end

	wait_for_sec(3)

	if self.is_success_game then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if self.energy_items then
		for energy_item in pairs(self.energy_items) do
			energy_item:ConsumeComplete()
			self.energy_items:remove(energy_item)
		end

		self.energy_items:clear()
		self.energy_items = nil
	end

	if self.power_items then
		for power_item in pairs(self.power_items) do
			power_item:ConsumeComplete()
			self.power_items:remove(power_item)
		end

		self.power_items:clear()
		self.power_items = nil
		self.power_items = nil
	end

	if self.pooled_states then
		for _, types in pairs(self.pooled_states) do
			for _, states in pairs(types) do
				for i = 1, #states do
					states[i].using = false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 게임 끝난 후 세팅
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(origin_leader, param, true)
	character_util.set_active_state(origin_leader, 'enabled')

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
		state = 'field',
		name = 'ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/audio:bgm_civilwar_lab'
	})

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({
		state = 'combat',
		name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_battle_normal_02'
	})

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.is_success_game))
end

--- 게임 시작 시 세팅
function local_class:game_setting()
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.constants_data.center_pos_name)

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	leader.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.constants_data.start_pos_name)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	self.player_data = {}

	self.player_data[leader] = {
		state = self:get_or_create_state('player_state', 'idle', leader)
	}

	self.monsters = {}
	self.monster_data = {}

	self.slow_speed = get_character(self.constants_data.monster_data.name .. 1).FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.WalkSpeed
	self.fast_speed = get_character(self.constants_data.monster_data.name .. 1).FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DashSpeed

	-- 몬스터 설정
	for i = 1, self.constants_data.monster_data.count do
		local monster = get_character(self.constants_data.monster_data.name .. i)
		table.insert(self.monsters, monster)

		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')
		monster.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		local spawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.constants_data.spawn_pos_name .. i)
		monster.Position = spawn_pos

		local spawn_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(self.constants_data.spawn_pos_name .. i)
		monster.Direction = spawn_dir

		character_util.convert_to_monster(monster)
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(monster, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
		monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true

		self.monster_data[monster] = {
			spawn_pos = spawn_pos,
			spawn_dir = spawn_dir,
			research_radius = self.constants_data.monster_data.research_radius,
			state = nil
		}

		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.WalkSpeed = self.fast_speed
	end

	-- 몬스터 목적지 설정
	self.monster_destinations = {}

	for i = 1, self.constants_data.monster_destination_count do
		local monster_destination = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.constants_data.monster_destination_name .. i)

		table.insert(self.monster_destinations, {
			pos = monster_destination,
			using = false
		})
	end

	-- 아이템 설정
	self.energy_items = create_lua_hashset()

	local energy_item_zone_bounds = field_util.get_zone(self.constants_data.energy_item_zone_name).Bounds

	for x = math.floor(energy_item_zone_bounds.min.x + 0.5), math.floor(energy_item_zone_bounds.max.x - 0.5) do
		for y = math.floor(energy_item_zone_bounds.min.z + 0.5), math.floor(energy_item_zone_bounds.max.z - 0.5) do

			local target_pos = vector(x, 0, y)

			if field:IsThereFloorAt(target_pos) and self:check_except_energy_item_pos(target_pos) then
				local energy_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = target_pos,
					itemid = self.constants_data.energy_item_id,
					notforinven = true,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				})

				self.energy_items:add(energy_item)
			end
		end
	end

	self.power_items = create_lua_hashset()

	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.power_item_pos_data do
		local pos_data = self.constants_data.power_item_pos_data[i]

		local power_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = vector(pos_data.x, 0, pos_data.z),
			itemid = self.constants_data.power_item_id,
			notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
		})

		self.power_items:add(power_item)
	end

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(8.5, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0)
end

--- 아이템 제외 구역 체크
function local_class:check_except_energy_item_pos(pos)
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.except_energy_item_pos_data do
		local data = self.constants_data.except_energy_item_pos_data[i]

		-- 구역 제외
		if data.min and data.min.x <= pos.x and data.min.z <= pos.z and pos.x <= data.max.x and pos.z <= data.max.z then
			return false
		end

		-- 한 곳을 제외
		if data.x and pos.x == data.x and pos.z == data.z then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

--- 스테이트 변경
function local_class:change_state(data, target, next_state)
	local prev_state = data[target].state

	if prev_state.state_name == next_state.state_name then
		next_state.using = false
		return false
	end

	if prev_state then
		prev_state:exit(next_state)
		prev_state.using = false
	end

	if next_state ~= nil then
		next_state:enter(prev_state)
		data[target].state = next_state
	end

	return true
end

--- state 생성 및 가져오기
function local_class:get_or_create_state(state_name, type, fo)
	if not self.pooled_states[state_name][type] then
		self.pooled_states[state_name][type] = {}
	end

	for i = 1, #self.pooled_states[state_name][type] do
		local state = self.pooled_states[state_name][type][i]

		-- 사용 중이지 않은 state 가져옴
		if not state.using then
			state.super.fo = fo
			state.using = true

			return state
		end
	end

	-- 전부 사용 중일 때 state 생성
	local state = self.states[state_name][type](self)
	state.super.fo = fo
	state.using = true

	table.insert(self.pooled_states[state_name][type], state)

	return state
end

function player_state.berserk:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	self.state_name = 'berserk'

	-- 반짝이 색상
	self.color = {
		unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 1 }),
		unity_color({ 0.3, 0.3, 1, 1 }),
		unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 }),
		unity_color({ 1, 0.4, 0.5, 1 })
	}
end

function player_state.berserk:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_state.berserk:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.color_time_passed = 0
	self.color_index = 1

	self.white_fade_color = false

	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_arcade_charge_01', loop = true })

	character_util.add_color(self.fo, self.fo.Name, self.color[self.color_index], 1, 0)

	-- 플레이어 속도 변경
	self.origin_speed = self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed
	self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed = self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualDashSpeed
end

function player_state.berserk:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	character_util.remove_color(self.fo, self.fo.Name, 0)

	self.white_fade_color = false
	character_util.remove_fade_color(self.fo, self.fo.Name, 0)

	if self.loop_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.loop_sfx)
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.ManualWalkSpeed = self.origin_speed

	-- 몬스터 속도 다시 빨라짐
	for monster, monster_data in pairs(self.controller.monster_data) do
		character_util.remove_anim(monster, true)
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.WalkSpeed = self.controller.fast_speed
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DashSpeed = self.controller.fast_speed
	end
end

function player_state.berserk:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	self.color_time_passed = self.color_time_passed + dt

	if self.color_time_passed > 0.15 then
		self.color_time_passed = 0

		-- 색상 관련 처리
		if self.time_passed < self.controller.constants_data.berserk_duration - 2 then
			-- 2초 넘게 남았을 때는 무지개 반짝
			self.color_index = self.color_index + 1

			if self.color_index > #self.color then
				self.color_index = 1
			end

			character_util.add_color(self.fo, self.fo.Name, self.color[self.color_index], 1, 0)

		else
			-- 2초 남았을 때는 흰색 반짝
			character_util.remove_color(self.fo, self.fo.Name, 0)

			if not self.white_fade_color then
				self.white_fade_color = true
				character_util.add_fade_color(self.fo, self.fo.Name, unity_class.color.white, 1, 0)
			else
				self.white_fade_color = false
				character_util.remove_fade_color(self.fo, self.fo.Name, 0)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 몬스터 접촉 시 몬스터 사망 처리
	for i = 1, #self.controller.monsters do
		local monster = self.controller.monsters[i]

		if self.controller.monster_data[monster].state.state_name ~= 'dead' and
			self.controller.monster_data[monster].state.state_name ~= 'spawn' and
			(self.fo.Position - monster.Position).sqrMagnitude < 0.7 * 0.7 then

			local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'dead', monster)
			self.controller:change_state(self.controller.monster_data, monster, state)
		end
	end

	if self.time_passed > self.controller.constants_data.berserk_duration then
		local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('player_state', 'idle', self.fo)
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.player_data, self.fo, state)
	end
end

--region Patrol State
function monster_state.patrol:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	self.state_name = 'patrol'

	self.destination = nil

	self.states = {
		idle = 1,
		finding_path = 2,
		moving = 3
	}
end

function monster_state.patrol:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.destination = nil
end

function monster_state.patrol:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	self.current_state = self.states.idle

	self.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 1, 0.5))

	while true do
		local destination_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, self.controller.constants_data.monster_destination_count)
		local monster_destination = self.controller.monster_destinations[destination_index]

		if not monster_destination.using then
			self.destination = monster_destination.pos
			self.controller.monster_destinations[destination_index].using = true
			self.destination_index = destination_index
			break
		end
	end

	self.plan_path_done = false

	field.PathFinder:FindNormalPath(self.fo, self.destination, 100, self.fo, 0, nil, function(path, req_key)
		if req_key == 0 then
			self.plan_path_done = true
			self.plan_path = path
		end
	end)

	self.current_state = self.states.finding_path
end

function monster_state.patrol:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	character_util.stop(self.fo)

	self.controller.monster_destinations[self.destination_index].using = false
end

function monster_state.patrol:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.plan_path_done and self.current_state == self.states.finding_path then
		self.current_state = self.states.moving

		local waypoint = {}

		for i = 0, self.plan_path.Count - 1 do
			table.insert(waypoint, self.plan_path[i])
		end

		wp_util.move(self.fo, waypoint, -1, nil, {
			end_callback = function()
				local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'idle', self.fo)
				self.controller:change_state(self.controller.monster_data, self.fo, state)
			end
		})
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local radius = self.controller.monster_data[self.fo].research_radius

	if self.controller.player_data[leader].state.state_name ~= 'berserk' and (leader.Position - self.fo.Position).sqrMagnitude < radius * radius then
		local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'chasing', self.fo)
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.monster_data, self.fo, state)
	end
end
--endregion Patrol State

	self.super:init(controller)

	self.state_name = 'chasing'
end

function monster_state.chasing:enter()

	command_util.publish_monster_notice(self.fo, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	self.fo.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
end

function monster_state.chasing:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	self.fo.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
end

function monster_state.chasing:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	local radius = self.controller.monster_data[self.fo].research_radius + 1

	if (get_party_leader().Position - self.fo.Position).sqrMagnitude > radius * radius then
		local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'patrol', self.fo)
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.monster_data, self.fo, state)
	end

	if (get_party_leader().Position - self.fo.Position).sqrMagnitude < 0.7 * 0.7 then
		local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'idle', self.fo)
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.monster_data, self.fo, state)

		self.controller.current_game_state = self.controller.game_state.end_game

		self.controller.is_success_game = false
	end
end

function monster_state.spawn:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	self.color_time_passed = self.color_time_passed + dt

	-- 깜빡임 처리
	if self.color_time_passed > 0.15 then
		self.color_time_passed = 0

		if not self.alpha_fade then
			self.alpha_fade = true
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.fo, 0, 0)
		else
			self.alpha_fade = false
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.fo, 1, 0)
		end
	end

	if self.time_passed > 2 then
		local state = self.controller:get_or_create_state('monster_state', 'idle', self.fo)
		self.controller:change_state(self.controller.monster_data, self.fo, state)
	end
end
--endregion Spawn State

--endregion Monster State

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

--- 선로 연결 (pipe_game) 미니 게임 컨트롤러
local local_class = newclass('PipeGameController')

function local_class:load_resource()
