	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	-- 타겟(기차) 그림자를 꺼준다.
	local target = self.get_target()
	target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameLoadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.is_playing_game = false

	self.pipe_rotate_rail_states = nil
	self.inoperable_pipe_list = nil
	self.target_walk_sfx_name = nil
	self.constants = nil

	self.change_material = nil
	self.shared_material = nil

	self:dispose_select_marker()
	self:dispose_destination_marker()
	self:dispose_res_holder()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	-- 미니게임 스타트 이름이 파이프 게임이라면 미니게임 스타트
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_load_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		self.constants_data_key = e.DataKey
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_init, self, e.LoadEndCallback))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	-- 게임중이 아닐 때 타면 안되므로 return
	if self.is_playing_game == false then
		return false
	end

	-- 게임패드가 아닐때는 스크린 터치이벤트 함수를 타고
	if not self.is_using_game_pad then
		return self:screen_touch_event(e.TouchPos)
	end

	-- 게임 패드일 때는 버튼 터치이벤트 함수를 탄다.
	return self:button_touch_event(e)
end

function local_class:screen_touch_event(pos)
	-- 회전중이라면 체크하지 않는다.
	if self.is_rotate_pipe then
		return false
	end

	-- 터치 좌표를 월드좌표로 반환하고 바운스를 생성한다.
	local touch_pos_with_y = stage_camera.Camera:ScreenToWorldPoint(pos:GetXy0())
	local add_z = touch_pos_with_y.y
	local touch_pos = vector(touch_pos_with_y.x, 0, touch_pos_with_y.z + add_z)
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(touch_pos, unity_class.vector3.one * 2)

	-- 누른 좌표들과의 충돌 리스트를 가져와서 파이프이면서 제일 가까운 파이프를 회전 시킨다.
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(bounds, unity_class.vector3.down)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		-- fo가 nil이 아닐 때
		if fo ~= nil then
			-- 파이프 인덱스가 1이상이면 회전 선로이기에 해당 fo로 rotate_target_rail 루틴 실행
			local pipe_index = self:get_pipe_index(fo.Name)
			if pipe_index > 0 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_target_rail, self, pipe_index, fo))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
	return false
end

function local_class:button_touch_event(e)
	-- 버튼을 누르면 파이프를 돌리거나 다른 파이프를 선택한다.
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_next_pipe, self))
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown and self.is_rotate_pipe == false then
		local select_pipe = self.get_pipe(self.select_pipe_index)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rotate_target_rail, self, self.select_pipe_index, select_pipe))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- fo의 이름을보고 파이프 이름이라면 해당 인덱스를 리턴 아니라면 -1 리턴
function local_class:get_pipe_index(fo_name)
	for i = 1, self.max_pipe_count do
		local pipe_name = self.pipe_first_name .. i
		if pipe_name == fo_name then
			return i
		end
	end

	return -1
end

-- 미니게임 초기화
function local_class:game_init(load_end_callback)
	-- Constants Data 로드
	self.constants = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data('minigame/PipeGame/PipeGameConstants', self.constants_data_key)

	-- 따라오는 오브젝트 이름 및 파이프 길이 캐싱
	self.max_pipe_count = self.constants.pipe_count
	self.game_over_effect_name = self.constants.game_over_effect_name
	self.mesh_object_name = self.constants.mesh_object_name

	-- 변수 초기화
	self.select_pipe_index = 1
	self.is_success = false

	-- 게임 패드 체크
	self.is_using_game_pad = CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled

	-- 파이프 방향 초기화
	self.pipe_rotate_rail_states = {}
	local default_pipe_patterns = self.constants.pipe_start_directions
	for i = 1, self.max_pipe_count do
		local pipe = self.get_pipe(i)
		local pipe_diraction = self:get_pipe_diraction(default_pipe_patterns[i])
		pipe.FieldObjectBehaviour:SetRotateRailState(pipe_diraction)
		self.pipe_rotate_rail_states[i] = pipe_diraction
	end

	-- 게임 오버 이팩트 로드
	if self.game_over_effect_name ~= nil then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.constants.game_over_effect_name)
		yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
	end

	-- 튜토리얼 Preload
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	-- 도착지점 화살표 마커 및 (게임패드일 때) 타겟 레일 화살표 마커 스프라이트 가져오기
	self:set_custom_sprite()

	-- 타겟 세팅
	local target = self.get_target()
	target.SpineController:CancelDeviateLocalAngle()
	target.SpineController:CancelDeviateLocal()
	character_util.set_position(target, self:get_target_showing_marker().position, false)
	character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')
	character_util.set_active_state(target, 'enabled')

	-- 파티원 disabled
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(user_party[i], 'disabled')
	end

	-- 카메라 위치 및 스케일 세팅
	camera_util.move(self:get_camera_marker().position, 0)
	local camera_size = CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize > 4 and self.constants.camera_scale_size_pad or self.constants.camera_scale_size
	camera_util.resize_to(camera_size, 0)

	-- 기본 메터리얼 캐싱
	if self.shared_material == nil then
		local pipe = self.get_pipe(1)
		local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(pipe.Transform, self.mesh_object_name)
		local renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
		self.shared_material = renderer.sharedMaterial
	end

	-- 열차가 등장하는 연출
	-- FIXME: 첫 실행 때 열차의 walk 애니메이션이 작동안해서 일단은 애니메이션 재생하도록 해둠, 시간될 때 확인 필요
	self.target_walk_sfx_name = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.constants.target_walk_sfx_name, fade_in_time = 1.5, fade_out_time = 1.5, volume = 0.5, loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'walk' })
	wp_util.move_way_points(target, { waypoints = self:get_target_starting_marker().position, speed = self.constants.target_speed, callback = function()
		character_util.remove_anim(target)
		self.target_walk_sfx_name:Stop()
	end })

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 레일의 위치를 가져오는 스프라이트 세팅용 함수
function local_class:set_custom_sprite()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
	                  self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/battle', 'battle_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	-- custom_sprite를 가져올 때 까지 기다린다.
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 도착지점 마커 스프라이트 세팅
	local finish_marker_pos = field:GetMarker(self.final_pipe_marker).position + unity_class.vector3.up * 1.5
	self.destination_marker_object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(finish_marker_pos)

	local custom_sprite = self.destination_marker_object_pool:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 180, 0)
	custom_sprite.transform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	custom_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'arrow_quest_main.png'

	custom_sprite:SetSortingLayer("UI")
	custom_sprite:Rebuild()

	-- 게임 패드가 아니라면 타겟 레일 마커는 안보여주어도 되니 리턴
	if not self.is_using_game_pad then
		return
	end

	-- 게임패드 전용) 타겟 레일 마커 세팅
	self.marker_object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one * 999)

	custom_sprite = self.marker_object_pool:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 180, 0)
	custom_sprite.transform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	custom_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'arrow_quest_sub.png'

	custom_sprite:SetSortingLayer("UI")
	custom_sprite:Rebuild()
end

-- 파이프 방향 Enum값 가져오기
function local_class:get_pipe_diraction(pipe_diraction)
	if pipe_diraction == 'down_left' then
		return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.DownLeft
	elseif pipe_diraction == 'up_left' then
		return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.UpLeft
	elseif pipe_diraction == 'up_right' then
		return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.UpRight
	else
		return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.DownRight
	end
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine.yield()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 조작 버튼을 변경해주며 리더의 컨트롤을 disable 시킨다.
	self:set_mini_game_control()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 게임 루프 시작
	self.is_playing_game = true
	yield_return_func(self.game_loop, self)
	self.is_playing_game = false

	-- 파이프 색깔 리셋
	self.select_pipe_index = -1
	self:set_pipe_color()

	-- Constants Data 제거
	self.constants = nil

	-- 파이프 상태 리스트 nil
	self.pipe_rotate_rail_states = nil

	-- 캐싱한 파이프 메터리얼 nil
	self.change_material = nil

	-- dispose
	self:dispose_res_holder()
	self:dispose_select_marker()
	self:dispose_destination_marker()

	-- 조작을 돌려준다
	self:set_manual_control()

	-- 파티원 enabled
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_active_state(user_party[i], 'enabled')
	end

	-- MiniGameEndEvent로 성공 여부를 Publish 한다
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.is_success))
end

-- 미니게임 시작전 컨트롤 및 UI 세팅
function local_class:set_mini_game_control()
	-- DisableControl을 호출하여 컨트롤을 못하게한다.
	local manual_touch_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RequestDisableControl(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
	end

	-- UI Hide
	field_ui_manager:HideAndBackup()

	-- 만약 게임 패드일 경우는 굳이 class 버튼과 action 버튼을 활성화 시키지 않아도 된다.
	if not self.is_using_game_pad then
		return
	end

	-- 클래스 버튼 UI를 찾아서 아이콘 강제로 변경
	local class_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton)
	local class_button_icon = class_button.Content
	self.original_class_button_name = class_button_icon.SpriteName
	class_button_icon.SpriteName = 'actbtn_ic_change.png'
	class_button_icon:Rebuild()

	-- 조작할 때 쓰는 UI들은 켜준다.
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetUIByKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Push
	action_button:RefreshButton(CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Push, false)
end

-- 컨트롤 및 UI를 원래대로 변경한다.
function local_class:set_manual_control()
	-- 게임 패드일 때만 class 버튼 및 액션버튼을 원래대로 돌려주면 된다.
	if self.is_using_game_pad then
		--Class 버튼 원래 이미지로 변경
		local class_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton)
		local class_button_icon = class_button.Content
		class_button_icon.SpriteName = self.original_class_button_name
		class_button_icon:Rebuild()
	end
	field_ui_manager:ShowAndRestore()

	-- 오버라이드된 액션 버튼 nil
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction = nil
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- DisableControl 했던 것을 Remove 해준다.
	local manual_touch_state = user_party_leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RemoveDisableControl(user_party_leader)
	end
end

-- 미니게임 진행 루프
function local_class:game_loop()
	local target = self.get_target()

	-- 타겟 속도 초기화
	self.target_speed = self.constants.target_speed

	-- 조작 못해야하는 파이프 리스트 리셋
	self.inoperable_pipe_list = { 0 }

	-- 파이프 색 초기화
	self.pipe_default_color = self.constants.pipe_color.r

	-- 게임 패드일때만 self.marker_object_pool가 nil이 아니라 시작 파이프 마커 위치 설정
	if self.marker_object_pool ~= nil then
		local start_marker = self.get_pipe(1)
		self.marker_object_pool.transform.position = vector(start_marker.Position.x, 1, start_marker.Position.z)
	end

	-- 선택한 파이프의 색이 변경되도록 색 변경 루틴 시작
	self.is_all_pipe_color_change = false
	self:set_pipe_color()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pipe_color_routine, self))

	-- 첫 등장 연출때의 발소리 때문에 Stop
	self.target_walk_sfx_name:Stop()

	-- 튜토리얼 진행
	self.is_progress_qte_tutorial = true
	if self.constants.is_showing_qte_tutorial ~= nil and self.constants.is_showing_qte_tutorial then
		self:show_qte_tutorial()
	end

	-- 다시 파이프 색 바꾸는 방식을 조작방법에 맞추기
	self.is_all_pipe_color_change = self.is_using_game_pad == false

	-- 가속 루틴 시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.accelerate_routine, self))

	-- 미니게임 시작 사운드 없다면 재생을 안함
	if self.constants.game_start_sfx_name ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.constants.game_start_sfx_name)
	end

	-- 도중에 실패하거나 끝까지 갈 때까지 루프
	local current_pipe_data = nil
	local current_marker = self.first_pipe_marker
	local is_showing_fail_effect = true

	character_util.stop(target)
	self.target_walk_sfx_name = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.constants.target_walk_sfx_name, fade_in_time = 1.5, fade_out_time = 1.5, volume = 0.8, loop = true })
	while self.is_playing_game do
		-- 현재 파이프 데이터 갱신 데이터가 없다면 break
		current_pipe_data = self.constants.pipe_data[current_marker]
		if current_pipe_data == nil then
			break
		end

		-- 다음 파이프 마커 위치까지 이동
		local next_pipe_marker = field:GetMarker(current_marker)
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(target, { waypoints = next_pipe_marker.position, speed = self.target_speed })

		-- 퀘스트 마커가 pipe_marker_final일 경우 성공 했으니 is_success true로 바꿔주고 break
		-- pipe_game_starting_position일 경우 돌아온 것이니 실패
		if current_marker == self.final_pipe_marker then
			self.is_success = true
			local arrive_position = self:get_target_arrive_marker().position
			wp_util.move_way_points(target, { waypoints = arrive_position, speed = self.target_speed })
			break
		elseif current_marker == self.first_position_marker then
			self.is_success = false
			is_showing_fail_effect = false
			local exit_position = self:get_target_showing_marker().position + unity_class.vector3.right * 5
			wp_util.move_way_points(target, { waypoints = exit_position, speed = self.target_speed })
			break
		end

		-- 다음 파이프 정보를 가져온다. 없다면 break
		local next_pipe = self:get_next_destination(current_pipe_data, target)
		if next_pipe == nil then
			break
		end

		-- 컨트롤이 안되는 파이프 리스트 갱신
		self.inoperable_pipe_list = next_pipe.inoperable_pipe_list
		local is_active = true
		for i = 1, #self.inoperable_pipe_list do
			if self.inoperable_pipe_list[i] == self.select_pipe_index then
				is_active = false
				break
			end
		end

		-- 다음 마커의 이름을 찾아본다. next_pipe에 next_marker 값이 있을경우에는 검사가 필요없는 파이프이므로 next_target_marker에 바로 넣어준다.
		local next_target_marker
		if next_pipe.next_marker ~= nil then
			next_target_marker = next_pipe.next_marker
		else
			next_target_marker = self:get_next_marker(next_pipe, self.pipe_rotate_rail_states[next_pipe.check_pipe_index])
		end

		-- 다음 마커가 nil이면 실패했으니 빠져나옴
		if next_target_marker == nil then
			break
		end

		-- 현재 마커 갱신
		current_marker = next_target_marker
	end

	self.target_walk_sfx_name:Stop()
	self.target_walk_sfx_name = nil

	-- 실패 일 때 연출
	if not self.is_success and is_showing_fail_effect then
		self:directing_fail()
	end
end

-- qte 가이드 연출
function local_class:show_qte_tutorial()
	self.is_progress_qte_tutorial = false

	if self.is_using_game_pad then
		self:game_pad_qte_tutorial()
	else
		self:qte_tutorial()
	end

	self.pipe_default_color = self.constants.pipe_color.r
	self.is_progress_qte_tutorial = true
end

-- 게임패드용 qte 튜토리얼
function local_class:game_pad_qte_tutorial()
	-- 액션버튼(회전)을 눌러보게 한다.
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActionTap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	self.current_tutorial_step = self.tutorial_step.rotate
	while self.current_tutorial_step == self.tutorial_step.rotate do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:set_pipe_color()
	self.pipe_default_color = self.constants.pipe_color.r

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine(false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 클래스 버튼(파이프 변경)을 눌러보게한다.
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActionTap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton)
	self.current_tutorial_step = self.tutorial_step.change
	while self.current_tutorial_step == self.tutorial_step.change do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:set_pipe_color()
	self.pipe_default_color = self.constants.pipe_color.r

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine(false)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	stage.Field:Undarken('tutorial', 0.1)
end

-- 일반 qte 튜토리얼
function local_class:qte_tutorial()
	stage.Field:Darken("tutorial", 0.5, 0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01');

	self.current_tutorial_step = self.tutorial_step.rotate
	while self.current_tutorial_step == self.tutorial_step.rotate do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.current_tutorial_step = self.tutorial_step.none
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	stage.Field:Undarken('tutorial', 0.1)
end

-- 타겟 가속 루틴 시간 게임중일 때 시간이 지날수록 일정 수치의 가속도가 붙는다.
function local_class:accelerate_routine()
	local accel_value = self.constants.accel_value
	local time_to_accel = self.constants.time_to_accel
	local target_max_speed = self.constants.target_max_speed

	while self.is_playing_game do
		if target_max_speed <= self.target_speed then
			self.target_speed = target_max_speed
			break
		end
		wait_for_sec(time_to_accel)

		self.target_speed = self.target_speed + accel_value
	end
end

-- 선택한 파이프 마커 이동 함수
function local_class:move_select_marker(position)
	if self.marker_object_pool == nil then
		return
	end

	local target_pos = vector(position.x, 1, position.z)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo(self.marker_object_pool.transform, target_pos, 0.2, nil, -1, false))
end

-- 다음 파이프 마커 찾는 함수
function local_class:get_next_marker(pipe_data, pipe_state)
	if pipe_state == CS.Oak.RotateRailState.DownLeft then
		return pipe_data.dl_next_marker
	elseif pipe_state == CS.Oak.RotateRailState.UpLeft then
		return pipe_data.ul_next_marker
	elseif pipe_state == CS.Oak.RotateRailState.UpRight then
		return pipe_data.ur_next_marker
	elseif pipe_state == CS.Oak.RotateRailState.DownRight then
		return pipe_data.dr_next_marker
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_next_destination(pipe_data, fo)
	local key = self:get_direction(fo.Direction)

	if not table_util.contain_key(pipe_data, key) then
		return nil
	end

	return pipe_data[key]
end

function local_class:get_direction(direction)
	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return 'left'
	elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return 'right'
	elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return 'up'
	elseif direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return 'down'
	else
		return 'none'
	end
end

-- 다음 인덱스의 파이프로 이동시킨다.
function local_class:move_next_pipe()
	-- 튜토리얼 체크
	if not self.is_progress_qte_tutorial then
		if self.current_tutorial_step == self.tutorial_step.change then
			self.current_tutorial_step = self.tutorial_step.none
		else
			return
		end
	end

	-- 다음 파이프 인덱스 갱신
	local next_pipe_index = self.select_pipe_index + 1
	if next_pipe_index > self.max_pipe_count then
		next_pipe_index = 1
	end
	self.select_pipe_index = next_pipe_index

	-- 파이프 색 갱신
	local select_pipe = self.get_pipe(self.select_pipe_index)
	self:set_pipe_color()
	self.pipe_default_color = self.constants.pipe_color.r
	self:move_select_marker(select_pipe.Position)
end

-- 파이프의 색 변경 및 번쩍 번쩍 할 메터리얼 세팅
function local_class:set_pipe_color()
	for i = 1, self.max_pipe_count do
		local pipe = self.get_pipe(i)
		local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(pipe.Transform, self.mesh_object_name)
		local renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
		if i == self.select_pipe_index then
			self.change_material = renderer.material
		else
			renderer.material = self.shared_material
		end
	end
end

-- 선택한 파이프가 번쩍 번쩍 하도록 도는 루틴
function local_class:pipe_color_routine()
	local is_reverse = false
	while self.is_playing_game do
		if not self.is_rail_not_control then
			is_reverse = self:is_reverse_color_counting(is_reverse)
			self.pipe_default_color = self.pipe_default_color + (0.015 * (is_reverse and -1 or 1))

			if not self.is_all_pipe_color_change then
				self:select_pipe_color_routine(is_reverse)
			else
				self:all_pipe_color_routine(is_reverse)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 게임패드용) 선택된 파이프만 색깔 번쩍이도록 하는 루틴
function local_class:select_pipe_color_routine()
	if self.change_material == nil then
		return
	end

	self.change_material:SetColor("_Color", CS.UnityEngine.Color(self.pipe_default_color, self.pipe_default_color, self.constants.pipe_color.b, self.constants.pipe_color.a))
end

-- 일반용) 전체 파이프가 색깔 번쩍이도록 하는 루틴
function local_class:all_pipe_color_routine()
	for i = 1, self.max_pipe_count do
		local pipe = self.get_pipe(i)
		local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(pipe.Transform, self.mesh_object_name)
		local renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
		renderer.material:SetColor("_Color", CS.UnityEngine.Color(self.pipe_default_color, self.pipe_default_color, self.constants.pipe_color.b, self.constants.pipe_color.a))
	end
end

-- 타겟 레일을 Rotate 해주는 함수 RotateRailEvent 보낸다.
function local_class:rotate_target_rail(index, target_pipe)
	-- 튜토리얼 체크 튜토리얼 중이라면, 해당 튜토리얼에 맞는 조작만 작동 하도록 한다.
	if not self.is_progress_qte_tutorial then
		local is_tutorial = false
		if self.is_using_game_pad then
			is_tutorial = self:is_game_pad_rotate_tutorial()
		else
			is_tutorial = self:is_rotate_tutorial(index)
		end

		if not is_tutorial then return end
	end

	-- 컨트롤 못하는 파이프라면 레일에 빨간불 효과
	if self:is_inoperable_pipe(index) then
		if not self.is_rail_not_control then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')
			if not self.is_using_game_pad then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.not_control_effect_routine, self, index))
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gamepad_not_control_effect_routine, self))
			end
		end
		return
	end

	-- 회전 못하는 상태라면 리턴
	if target_pipe.FieldObjectBehaviour.CannotRotate then
		return
	end

	self.is_rotate_pipe = true

	-- 파이프 회전 이벤트를 보낸다.
	local next_state = self:get_next_rotate_rail_state(target_pipe.FieldObjectBehaviour.State)
	self.pipe_rotate_rail_states[index] = next_state
	message_system:SendSync(target_pipe.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.RotateRailEvent.Create(next_state, target_pipe.name))
	wait_for_sec(target_pipe.FieldObjectBehaviour.RotateTime)

	self.is_rotate_pipe = false
end

-- 게임 패드일 때의 회전 튜토리얼 확인용
function local_class:is_game_pad_rotate_tutorial()
	-- 회전 튜토리얼중에는 회전 튜토리얼 스탭일 때만 넘어가게 한다.
	if self.current_tutorial_step == self.tutorial_step.rotate then
		self.current_tutorial_step = self.tutorial_step.none
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 일반 회전 튜토리얼 확인용
function local_class:is_rotate_tutorial(index)
	-- 회전 튜토리얼중에는 첫번째 레일일 때만 넘어가게 한다.
	if self.current_tutorial_step == self.tutorial_step.rotate and index == 1 then
		self.current_tutorial_step = self.tutorial_step.none
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- index에 해당하는 파이프는 조작 못하는 파이프 인가 판단하기 위한 함수
function local_class:is_inoperable_pipe(index)
	if self.inoperable_pipe_list == nil then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.inoperable_pipe_list do
		if self.inoperable_pipe_list[i] == index then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- index에 해당하는 파이프를 돌릴 수 없다고 색을 잠시 바꿔주는 효과 루틴
function local_class:not_control_effect_routine(index)
	self.is_rail_not_control = true

	local pipe = self.get_pipe(index)
	local mesh = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(pipe.Transform, self.mesh_object_name)
	local renderer = mesh:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))
	renderer.material:SetColor("_Color", CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, self.constants.pipe_color.g, self.constants.pipe_color.b, self.constants.pipe_color.a))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.is_rail_not_control = false
end

-- 게임패드에서 선택된 파이프를 돌릴 수 없다고 색을 잠시 바꿔주는 효과 루틴
function local_class:gamepad_not_control_effect_routine()
	if self.change_material == nil then
		return
	end
	self.is_rail_not_control = true
	self.change_material:SetColor("_Color", CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, self.constants.pipe_color.g, self.constants.pipe_color.b, self.constants.pipe_color.a))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.is_rail_not_control = false
end

-- 실패 연출 타겟에게 game_over_effect_name에 맞는 이팩트를 연출한다.
function local_class:directing_fail()
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)

	local target = self:get_target()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.constants.game_over_sfx_name)
	character_util.shake(target, 0.08, 0.5)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.game_over_effect_name):Instantiate(vector(target.Position.x, target.Position.y, target.Position.z + 0.75))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

-- 선택되어 파이프가 번쩍 번쩍 거리는 색 반전용 함수
function local_class:is_reverse_color_counting(is_reverse)
	if self.pipe_default_color > 1 or self.pipe_default_color < self.constants.pipe_color.r then
		return is_reverse ~= true
	end
	return is_reverse
end

-- 돌아가야하는 다음 레일 찾기
function local_class:get_next_rotate_rail_state(current_state)
	if current_state == CS.Oak.RotateRailState.DownLeft then
		return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.UpLeft
	elseif current_state == CS.Oak.RotateRailState.UpLeft then
		return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.UpRight
	elseif current_state == CS.Oak.RotateRailState.UpRight then
		return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.DownRight
	elseif current_state == CS.Oak.RotateRailState.DownRight then
		return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.DownLeft
	end
	return CS.Oak.RotateRailState.None
end

-- Select Marker Dispose
function local_class:dispose_select_marker()
	if self.marker_object_pool == nil then
		return
	end

	self.marker_object_pool:Dispose()
	self.marker_object_pool = nil
end

-- Destination Marker Dispose
function local_class:dispose_destination_marker()
	if self.destination_marker_object_pool == nil then
		return
	end

	self.destination_marker_object_pool:Dispose()
	self.destination_marker_object_pool = nil
end

-- Resource Holder Dispose
function local_class:dispose_res_holder()
	if self.res_holder == nil then
		return
	end

	self.res_holder:Dispose()
	self.res_holder = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.queenship_animator = nil
	self.qte_action_check = nil

	-- 스테이지 라이트 다시 켜줌
	get_field_object('directional_light_demonworld').gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 스테이지 카메라 다시 켜줌
	stage_camera.Camera.enabled = true

	if not is_unity_null(self.speech_bubble_camera_obj) then
		self.speech_bubble_camera_obj:SetActive(true)
	end

	self.speech_bubble_camera_obj = nil

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.player_manager ~= nil then
		self.player_manager:dispose()
		self.player_manager = nil
	end

	if self.enemy_manager ~= nil then
		self.enemy_manager:dispose()
		self.enemy_manager = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.player_hp_bar) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.player_hp_bar.gameObject)
	end
	self.player_hp_bar = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.main_prefab) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.main_prefab)
	end
	self.main_prefab = nil

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil
	self.game_center = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end
	self.res_holder = nil

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.disposed
end

function local_class:game_end()
end

function local_class:game_start()

	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	-- 안개 걷히는 애니메이션
	local mesh_animator = self.main_prefab.transform:Find('mesh').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	mesh_animator:Play('airraid_opening_interude')

	-- 전함 재생 애니메이션
	local ship_animator = self.main_prefab.transform:Find('enemy_queenship').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	ship_animator:Play('enemy_fighter', -1, 0)
	ship_animator.speed = 0

	local dt = 0
	local game_time = 0
	local anim_time = 0
	local anim_index = 1
	local anim_times = { 3, 17, 31, 49, 63, 77, 9999 }
	local qte_time = 38.5
	local clear_time = 95.5

	self.player_manager:player_down_hill_start()

	-- 전함 애니메이션 다시 재생
	ship_animator.speed = 1

	-- 도시 이펙트 다시 켜줌
	local city_explo = self.main_prefab.transform:Find('city_explo')
	city_explo.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 조작 시작
	self:game_ui_show()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.play_game

	while self.current_game_state < self.game_state.in_success do
		if not self.game_pause then
			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

			anim_time = anim_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			game_time = game_time + dt

			self.player_manager:update_manager(dt)
			self.enemy_manager:update_manager(dt)

			if anim_time >= anim_times[anim_index] then
				anim_index = anim_index + 1
				self.queenship_animator:Play('airraid_silo', -1, 0)
			end

			-- qte 시작 임시 카운트
			if game_time >= qte_time and
					not self.qte_action_check and
					not self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.in_fail then
				self.qte_action_check = true
				start_coroutine(self.play_qte_action, self, 1, 0.5, 0.166)
			end

			if game_time >= clear_time then
				self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_success
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:game_ui_hide()

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_success then
		self:play_game_end_action(2)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_clear_01')
		if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
			self.loop_sfx:FadeOut(2)
			self.loop_sfx = nil
		end

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_fail then
		local bubble_default_pos = vector(-300, -5, 10)
		local bubble_angle = vector(15, 0, 0)
		local princess = get_character('princess_bat')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(princess, {
			key = 'qs_main_s6_37', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout',
			world_pos = bubble_default_pos, euler_angle = bubble_angle, scale = 2 })

		start_coroutine(self.player_move, self, 1,
				self.player_manager.player.transform.position - vector(0, 0, 1.5), 1)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_impact_lightning_01')

		if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
			self.loop_sfx:FadeOut(2)
			self.loop_sfx = nil
		end

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(princess)

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, false))
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.game_end
end

--region event
function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.play_game then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		self.player_manager:set_direction(e.StickOriginalDirection)
		return true
	end

	self.player_manager:set_direction(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.play_game then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction2TouchDown then
		self.player_manager:player_spin()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	self.game_pause = true
	self:game_ui_hide()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	self.game_pause = false
	self:game_ui_show()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.game_end
	return true
end
--endregion

--region 충돌 관리용 함수
function local_class:check_collision_enemy(bound_box)
	return self.enemy_manager:check_collision(bound_box)
end
--endregion

--region HP 바 관리용 함수
function local_class:update_player_hp_bar()
	if self.player_hp_bar ~= nil then
		local hp_bar = self.player_hp_bar:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ColumnHpBar))
		hp_bar:SetHp(self.player_manager.player_hp)

		if self.player_manager.player_hp <= 0 then
			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_fail
		end
	end
end
--endregion

-- 게임용 ui 세팅
function local_class:game_ui_show()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 파티 창 제거
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	--환경설정, 대화창 제거
	local transform = CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.transform
	local content = transform:Find('Content')
	local content_field = content.transform:Find('Field')

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction2)

function local_class:game_ui_hide()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SpecialFunction2)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if self.player_hp_bar ~= nil then
		self.player_hp_bar.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

function local_class:play_game_end_action(delay_time)
	self:player_move_center(delay_time)

	local bubble_default_pos = vector(-298, -5, 10)
	local bubble_angle = vector(15, 0, 0)
	local crosselle = get_character('crosselle')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_06')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_main_s6_36', true,
			{ world_pos = bubble_default_pos, euler_angle = bubble_angle, scale = 2 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dragon_03')
	local player_animator = self.main_prefab.transform:Find('Player').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	player_animator:Play('ending')
	player_animator = self.main_prefab.transform:Find('Player/Crosselle').transform:GetComponent(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	player_animator:Play('end_downhill')
	wait_for_sec(1.8)
end

function local_class:play_qte_action(delay_time, qte_duration, qte_time_mod)
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.qte_action
	self:game_ui_hide()

	-- delay_time 동안 중앙으로 복귀
	self:player_move_center(delay_time)

	local cur_qte_count = 1
	local qte_count = 3
	local qte_dir = { 'left', 'right', 'left' }
	while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.qte_action and cur_qte_count <= qte_count do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		local qte_check = qte_util.swipe(qte_dir[cur_qte_count], qte_duration - 0.1, qte_time_mod, true)

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_priscilla_laser_02')
		end)

		if qte_check then
			self.player_manager:player_spin()
			if cur_qte_count == 1 then
				self:player_move(0.3, self.game_center + vector(-2.5, 0, 1.5), 2)
				self.player_manager:set_direction(unity_class.vector3.zero)
				wait_for_sec(2.3)
			elseif cur_qte_count == 2 then
				self:player_move(0.3, self.game_center + vector(3, 0, -1.5), 2.1)
				self.player_manager:set_direction(unity_class.vector3.zero)
				wait_for_sec(2.3)
			else
				self:player_move(0.3, self.game_center - vector(2.5, 0, 0), 2)
			end
		else
			wait_for_sec(0.1)

			self.player_manager:set_damage(10)
			wait_for_sec(0.1)

			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_fail
			return
		end

		cur_qte_count = cur_qte_count + 1
	end

	self:game_ui_show()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.play_game
end

function local_class:player_move_center(delay_time)
	self.player_manager:set_direction(unity_class.vector3.zero)

	local start_pos = self.player_manager.player.transform.position
	local camera_start_pos = self.player_manager.main_camera.transform.localPosition
	local start_angle = self.player_manager.main_camera.transform.localEulerAngles
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < delay_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.player_manager.player.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
				start_pos, self.game_center, time_passed / delay_time)

		local lerp_x = unity_class.mathf.LerpAngle(start_angle.x,
				self.player_manager.camera_origin_angle.x, time_passed / delay_time)
		local lerp_y = unity_class.mathf.LerpAngle(start_angle.y,
				self.player_manager.camera_origin_angle.y, time_passed / delay_time)
		local lerp_z = unity_class.mathf.LerpAngle(start_angle.z,
				self.player_manager.camera_origin_angle.z, time_passed / delay_time)

		self.player_manager.player_cur_pos = self.player_manager.player.transform.position

		self.player_manager.main_camera.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
				camera_start_pos, self.player_manager.camera_origin_pos, time_passed / delay_time)
		self.player_manager.main_camera.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(lerp_x, lerp_y, lerp_z)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.player_manager.player_cur_pos = self.game_center
	self.player_manager.player.transform.position = self.game_center
	self.player_manager.main_camera.transform.localEulerAngles = self.player_manager.camera_origin_angle
end

function local_class:player_move(duration, move_pos, power)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.player_manager:set_direction(move_pos - self.game_center)
		self.player_manager:player_move(unity_class.time.deltaTime * power)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class();
	end
}

	convert_table_to_vector3 = convert_table_to_vector3,
}

qs_shooting_constants_manager = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/QSShootingGame/QSShootingGameConstantsManager')

local local_class = newclass('QSShootingGameEnemy')

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	--유닛 기체
	self.enemy = nil

	-- 유닛 정보
	self.unit_data = nil

	-- 발사 정보
	--self.shot_data = nil

	-- 기체 상태
	self.active = false

	-- 기체 활성화 시간
	self.cur_move_time = 0

	-- 피격 범위
	self.hit_box = nil

	-- 이동 범위
	self.move_size = nil

	-- 시작 위치
	self.origin_pos = nil

	-- 도착 위치
	self.end_pos = nil

	-- 시작 offset
	self.offset_y = 100

	-- 미사일 최대 크기
	self.enemy_size = 9

	-- 미사일 폭파 배율
	self.explosion_effect_size = 1.5

	-- 기체 발사 시간
	self.cur_shot_time = 0

	self.fo = nil
	self.loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:init_enemy(controller, fo)
	self.controller = controller

	self.fo = fo
end

function local_class:set_enemy_data(enemy, unit_data, sfx_add)
	self.enemy = enemy
	self.unit_data = unit_data
	--self.shot_data = shot_data

	self.move_size = vector(unit_data.move_size.x, unit_data.move_size.y, unit_data.move_size.z)

	local game_center = qs_shooting_constants_manager.get_constants_data().game_center
	game_center = vector(game_center.x, game_center.y, game_center.z)

	self.origin_pos = game_center + vector(unit_data.start_pos.x, unit_data.start_pos.y, unit_data.start_pos.z)

	self.end_pos = game_center + vector(unit_data.end_pos.x, unit_data.end_pos.y, unit_data.end_pos.z)

	self.hit_box = self.enemy.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider))

	self:set_active(true)

	if sfx_add and self.loop_sfx == nil then
		self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '02_missile_loop_01', loop = true, parent = self.fo,
				  type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'default', max_distance = 20 })
	end
end

function local_class:set_active(active, effect_option)
	effect_option = lua_helper.get_or_default(effect_option, true)

	self.active = active

	if not self.active then
		if effect_option then
			local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_qs_minigame_explosion'):Instantiate(self.enemy.transform.position)
			effect.transform.localScale = self.explosion_effect_size * unity_class.vector3.one
		end

		self.enemy.transform.position = vector(9999, 0, 9999)
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.active then
		return false
	end

	self:normal_move_pattern(dt)
	return true
end

function local_class:normal_move_pattern(dt)
	local start_pos = self.enemy.transform.position

	self.cur_move_time = self.cur_move_time + dt

	local progress = self.cur_move_time / self.unit_data.move_time

	self.enemy.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.enemy_size * unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress * 2)

	local y_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(progress, 0, 1, 0.5))
	local y_offset = self.offset_y - self.offset_y * y_progress
	local x_move = self.move_size.x * math.sin(math.pi * progress * self.unit_data.sin_acc.x)
	local y_move =  self.move_size.y * math.sin(math.pi * progress * self.unit_data.sin_acc.y)

	local move_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.origin_pos, self.end_pos, progress)

	self.enemy.transform.position = move_pos + vector(x_move, y_move + y_offset, 0)

	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.up, (self.enemy.transform.position - start_pos).normalized)
	self.enemy.transform.rotation = rot

	-- 사운드 적용을 위해 일정 시간 동안 더 유지하면서 뒤로 빠짐
	if progress > 1 and progress < 1.4 then
		self.enemy.transform.position = self.enemy.transform.position - (vector(0, 0, 40) * (progress - 1))
	elseif progress >= 1.4 then
		self:set_active(false, false)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_data()
	self.enemy = nil
	self.unit_data = nil

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	self.active = false
	self.cur_move_time = 0
	self.move_size = nil
	self.origin_pos = nil
	self.end_pos = nil
	self.hit_box = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.fo)
	self:reset_data()
	self.controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('QSShootingGameEnemyManager')

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	-- 등장 시간
	self.appear_time = 0
	-- 웨이브 순서
	self.wave_index = 1
	self.cur_wave_index = 0
	-- 등장 카운트 체크
	self.appear_count = 0
	self.appear_delay = 0

	self.pooled_enemy = nil
	self.check_pooled_count = nil
	self.using_enemy = nil
end

-- 로드 시 필요 정보 세팅
function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.pooled_enemy = {}
	self.check_pooled_count = {}
	self.using_enemy = {}

end

-- 적 기체 풀 생성
function local_class:setting_enemy(prefab_pool)

	for i = 1, qs_shooting_constants_manager.get_enemy_type_count() do
		table.insert(self.check_pooled_count, 0)
		self.pooled_enemy[i] = {}

		local enemy_type = qs_shooting_constants_manager.get_enemy_type(i)
		for j = 1, enemy_type.pooled_count do
			local enemy_pool = prefab_pool.transform:Find(enemy_type.spec_name)
			local enemy_object = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(
					enemy_pool, vector(9999, 0, 9999), unity_class.quaternion.identity)

			local fo = enemy_object.transform.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))
			local enemy = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('minigame/QSShootingGame/QSShootingGameEnemy')
			enemy:init_enemy(self.controller, fo)

			-- object : Instantiate Object
			-- script : Lua Script
			table.insert(self.pooled_enemy[i], { object = enemy_object, script = enemy })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_manager(dt)
	self:check_appear_pattern(dt)

	self:update_enemy(dt)
end

-- 적 기체 등장 로직
function local_class:check_appear_pattern(dt)
	if self.cur_wave_index ~= self.wave_index then
		self.appear_time = self.appear_time + dt
	end

	-- 모든 웨이브가 끝난다면 기능 정지
	if self.wave_index > qs_shooting_constants_manager.get_wave_count() then
		--self.controller.current_game_state = self.controller.game_state.in_success
		return
	end

	local wave_info = qs_shooting_constants_manager.get_wave_data(self.wave_index)
	if self.appear_time >= wave_info.appear_time then
		self.cur_wave_index = self.wave_index

		if self.appear_count < wave_info.count then

			if self.appear_delay < wave_info.appear_delay then
				self.appear_delay = self.appear_delay + dt
			else
				self.appear_count = self.appear_count + 1
				self:create_enemy(wave_info)
				self.appear_delay = 0
			end
		else
			self:next_wave()
		end
	end
end

-- 적 기체 생성
function local_class:create_enemy(wave_info)
	local unit_data = qs_shooting_constants_manager.get_unit_data(wave_info.unit_data_index)

	local enemy_type_index = unit_data.enemy_type_index
	local index = (self.check_pooled_count[enemy_type_index] % #self.pooled_enemy[enemy_type_index]) + 1
	self.check_pooled_count[enemy_type_index] =  self.check_pooled_count[enemy_type_index] + 1

	local enemy = self.pooled_enemy[enemy_type_index][index].object
	local script = self.pooled_enemy[enemy_type_index][index].script

	script:set_enemy_data(enemy, unit_data, wave_info.sfx)

	if self.using_enemy[self.wave_index] == nil then
		self.using_enemy[self.wave_index] = {}
	end

	table.insert(self.using_enemy[self.wave_index], script)
end

-- 다음 웨이브로 넘기는 용도
function local_class:next_wave()
	self.wave_index = self.wave_index + 1
	self.appear_count = 0
	self.appear_delay = 0
end

function local_class:update_enemy(dt)
	for i, enemy_list in ipairs(self.using_enemy) do
		for j, enemy in ipairs(enemy_list) do
			if not enemy:update_frame(dt) then
				enemy:reset_data()
				table.remove(self.using_enemy[i], j)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 몬스터 피격 체크
function local_class:check_collision(bound_box)
	for i, enemy_list in ipairs(self.using_enemy) do
		for j, enemy in ipairs(enemy_list) do
			if CS.BoundsExtensions.IsIntersectingOBB(bound_box,
					enemy.hit_box.bounds.center, enemy.hit_box.bounds.size, enemy.enemy.transform.localRotation) then
				enemy:set_active(false)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.check_pooled_count = nil
	self.appear_time = 0
	self.wave_index = 1
	self.cur_wave_index = 0
	self.appear_count = 0
	self.appear_delay = 0

	self.using_enemy = nil

	if self.pooled_enemy ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.pooled_enemy do
			for _, enemy in pairs(self.pooled_enemy[i]) do
				-- 스크립트 안에 field object 추가한 캐싱이 있으므로 먼저 제거
				enemy.script:dispose()
				enemy.script = nil

				CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(enemy.object.gameObject)
				enemy.object = nil

				enemy = nil
			end
		end
		self.pooled_enemy = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

end

function local_class:set_direction(direction)
	self.cur_direction = direction.normalized
end

-- 플레이어 이동 처리
function local_class:player_move(dt)
	self.cur_direction = vector(self.cur_direction.x, self.cur_direction.z, 0)

	self.player.transform.position = self.player_cur_pos + self.cur_direction * self.player_speed * dt

	local left_end = self.play_map_size.left + self.game_center.x
	local right_end = self.play_map_size.right + self.game_center.x
	local top_end = self.play_map_size.top + self.game_center.y
	local bottom_end = self.play_map_size.bottom + self.game_center.y

	local x_pos = math.max(left_end, self.player.transform.position.x)
	x_pos = math.min(right_end, x_pos)

	local y_pos = math.max(bottom_end, self.player.transform.position.y)
	y_pos = math.min(top_end, y_pos)

	-- 플레이어 이동 비율
	local center = 0.5
	local angle_x = center - (y_pos - bottom_end) / (top_end - bottom_end)
	local angle_y = (x_pos - left_end) / (right_end - left_end) - center

	-- 제한치를 설정해줌(일정 비율까지만 카메라가 같이 이동)
	local angle_weight = 0.3
	angle_x = math.min(angle_weight, math.max(-angle_weight, angle_x))
	angle_y = math.min(angle_weight, math.max(-angle_weight, angle_y))

	-- 위치 보정값
	local correction_y_pos = math.min(0, angle_x)

	-- 각도 보정치
	local correction_x_value = 18.75
	local correction_y_value = 12.5

	angle_x = angle_x * correction_x_value
	angle_y = angle_y * correction_y_value

	self.main_camera.transform.localEulerAngles = self.camera_origin_angle + vector(angle_x, angle_y, 0)

	-- 플레이어 shake
	self.shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	self.main_camera.transform.localPosition = self.camera_origin_pos + vector(0, correction_y_pos, 0)

	self.player_cur_pos = vector(x_pos, y_pos, self.player.transform.position.z)
	self.player.transform.position = self.player_cur_pos + self.shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
end

function local_class:player_down_hill_start()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dragon_03')
	self.animator:Play('downhill')
	wait_for_sec(9)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_06')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_07')
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1, 1)

	if self.controller.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.controller.loop_sfx:FadeOut(1)
		self.controller.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_dogfight_01', loop = true,
												type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)
end

-- 플레이어 애니메이션 처리
function local_class:player_animation(dt)
	if self.current_player_state ~= self.next_player_state then
		self.animation_time = 0

		self.current_player_state = self.next_player_state
		if self.current_player_state == self.player_state.spin then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dragon_04')
			self.animator:Play('spin')
		end
	end

	self.animation_time = self.animation_time + dt

	-- 모든 상태는 시간이 지나면 idle로 돌아옴
	if self.current_player_state == self.player_state.spin and
			self.animation_time >= self.animation_length[self.player_state.spin] then
		self.next_player_state = self.player_state.idle
	end
end

-- 플레이어 피격 체크
function local_class:check_collision_enemy()
	-- 데미지에 의한 컬러
	self.skinned_mesh_renderer.material.color = CS.UnityEngine.Color.Lerp(
			self.damage_color , self.original_color, unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(1 - self.damaged_time))

	if self.controller.current_game_state == self.controller.game_state.play_game and
			self.current_player_state ~= self.player_state.spin and
			self.damaged_time < 0 and
			self.controller:check_collision_enemy(self.player_hit_box.bounds) then
		self:set_damage(2)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:set_damage(damage)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_druid_stomp_03')

	self.player_hp = self.player_hp - damage
	self.damaged_time = 1

	shake_info.magnitude = 0.03

	self.leader_parent = nil

	get_character('princess_bat').Transform:SetParent(self.princess_parent)

	self.pymon_parent = nil

	get_character('andras').Transform:SetParent(self.ansras_parent)
	self.ansras_parent = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.player = nil
	self.animator = nil
	self.animation_length = nil
	self.player_speed = nil
	self.game_center = nil
	self.play_map_size = nil
	self.player_hit_box = nil

	self.player_hp = 10

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	-- 오브젝트 풀 로드
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.normal_explosion_effect_name)
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')

	while not CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.IsLoaded(pool) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local pooled_object = {}
	self.player_pos_marker = field:GetMarker(self.data.player_start_stand_name)
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 맵 셋팅
	self.mini_game_scene = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/theatres/arcade_racing', 'guild_arcade_racing_game_back')
	self.mini_game_scene.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	self.mini_game_scene.transform.position = vector(self.data.background_init_x, 0, -1)

	self.mini_game_scene2 = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/theatres/arcade_racing', 'guild_arcade_racing_game_back')
	self.mini_game_scene.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	self.mini_game_scene2.transform.position = vector(self.data.background_init_x2, 0, -1)

	-- UI를 위한 스프라이트 생성
	for i = 1, self.data.sprite_id.max do
		pooled_object[i] = pool:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one * 999)
	end

	-- Atlas 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/ui', 'GuildArcadeBuffUI', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
			end)

	if self.custom_atlas ~= nil then
		self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end

	self.custom_sprite = {}
	for i = 1, self.data.sprite_id.max do
		self.custom_sprite[i] = pooled_object[i]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if not is_unity_null(self.custom_sprite[i]) then
			self.custom_sprite[i].Atlas = self.custom_atlas
			self.custom_sprite[i].SortingLayer = 'UI'
		end
	end

	-- 점수 이펙트
	self.sprites_data = {}
	for i = self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_begin, self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_end do
		self:init_sprites_data(i, 'arcade_num_1000_00.png', 0, 2)
	end

	-- 시작 UI

	self.start_ui = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/ui', 'GuildArcadePizzaStartUI', ui_root):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.GuildArcadePizzaStartUI))

	self.temperature_ui = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/ui', 'GuildArcadeTemperatureUI', ui_root):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.GuildArcadeTemperatureUI))
	self.temperature_ui.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.temperature_ui.transform, CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer("UI"));
	self:show_temperature_ui(false)
	self.temperature_ui:SetReceiveFieldUIEvent(false)

	----------------------------------------

	self:game_pre_init()

	user_party.Leader.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 10)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		load_end_callback()
	end
