function local_class:set_text_adaptive(ui_object, ui_background, msg, screen_position, max_width, text_size, angle, text_color)
	max_width = lua_helper.get_or_default(max_width, 300)
	text_size = lua_helper.get_or_default(text_size, 25)

	ui_object:SetText(msg, screen_position, max_width, text_size, 0, text_color)
	ui_object.transform.eulerAngles = lua_helper.get_or_default(angle, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	if ui_background == nil then
		ui_background = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(ui_object.transform, 'bg'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomFilledSprite))
	end

	ui_background.Size = vector(max_width, ui_background.Size.y)
	ui_background:Rebuild(true)
end

function local_class:init_sprites_data(sprite_id, file_name, background_order, scale)
	self.sprites_data[sprite_id] = {
		sprite = self.custom_sprite[sprite_id],
		sprite_name = file_name,
		local_scale = unity_class.vector2.one * scale,
		init_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
	}

	local data = self.sprites_data[sprite_id]
	data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	data.sprite.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))
	data.sprite.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
	data.sprite.SpriteName = data.sprite_name
	data.sprite.LocalScale = data.local_scale
	data.sprite:SetSortingOrder(background_order)
	data.sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:show_sprites_data(data, is_show)
	if is_show then
		data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = data.init_pos
	else
		data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	end
end

function local_class:show_score_effect(position)
	for i = self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_begin, self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_end do
		local data = self.sprites_data[i]
		if self:is_show_sprites_data(data) == false then
			data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = position
			wait_for_sec(1)
			data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_show_sprites_data(data)
	local invisible_position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	if data.sprite.Transform.localPosition == invisible_position then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return true end

	if e.FullLeave and e.Zone.Name == self.data.game_area_name then
		e.FieldObject.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return false end

	self.input_direction = e.StickDirection

	return true
end
--endregion

--region Game Logic
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start_routine()
	self:game_init()
	self:game_ui_show()

	self.game_loop = true
	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing

	self:set_start_ui(1)
	self:game_routine()

	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.clear then
		-- BGM 종료
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:HideAndBackup()

	self.game_loop = false

	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:SetUIEventReceive(true)
	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.fail then
		self:game_over()
	else
		self:game_clear()
	end
end

function local_class:event_subscribe()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
end

function local_class:game_pre_init()
	self:change_manual_character(self.oni_girl_name)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	self:event_subscribe()

	self:reset_leader()

	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		member.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	local offset_x = 5
	camera_util.move_async(self.player_pos_marker.position + unity_class.vector3.right * offset_x, 0.05)
	camera_util.resize_to(5, 0)
end

function local_class:game_init()
	self:init_npc_list()
	self.accure_distance = 0
	self.spawn_interval = 0
	self.npc_spawn_interval = 0
	self.current_score = 0
	self.play_speed = self.data.default_speed
	self.move_distance = 0
	self.fever_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
	self.current_fever_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
	self.fever_z_change_interval = 0
	self.fever_z_change_interval_max = 10
	self.item_spawn_interval = self.data.default_item_spawn_interval
	self.enemy_spawn_count = 1
	self.phase = 1
	self.pie_temperature = self.data.pie_temperature
	self.hurt_time = 0

	-- 화면 중앙
	self.center_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	-- UI 갱신
	self:change_phase(self.phase)
	self:reset_leader()
	self:set_score(0)
end

function local_class:reset_leader()
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.player_pos_marker.position
	user_party.Leader.Direction = self.player_pos_marker.direction
	self.player_next_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
	self:set_player_anim('idle')
end

function local_class:game_ui_show()
	-- 인터랙트, 공격, 들기, 스킬 전부 막아놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(user_party.Leader)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- 보물상자, 환경설정, 대화창, 미니맵 제거
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end

	-- DPad 표시
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	while self.game_loop == true do
		self:start_scene()
		self.input_direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
		while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and self.game_loop == true do
			if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing then
				if self.is_pause == false then
					local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
					dt = math.min(dt, 0.05)	-- 프레임 드랍에 의한 오작동 방지
					self:game_update(dt)
					self:user_action(dt)
					self:check_collision()
				end
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end

		-- 게임 오버시 루프 탈출
		if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.fail then
			break
		end

		-- 클리어시 다음 스테이지로
		self:next_stage()
		-- 완전 클리어
		if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.clear
		and self.current_stage >= 3 then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield()	--안전 장치(무한 루프 방지)
	end
end

function local_class:start_scene()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
	self:show_start_ui(true)
	self.temperature_ui:Set(self.pie_temperature, self.data.max_temperature[self.current_stage])
	self:show_temperature_ui(false)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_bell_sfx, self))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self.start_ui:SetBubbleUI(true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:show_start_ui(false)
	self:show_temperature_ui(true)
	self.temperature_ui:SetReceiveFieldUIEvent(true)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/arcade/audio:bgm_arcade_pizza', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	self:set_player_anim('rapid_run')
end

function local_class:next_stage()
	self:pie_to_score()
	self.current_stage = self.current_stage + 1
	if self.current_stage > 3 then
		return
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.goal_in_check = false
	self:init_npc_list()
	self.accure_distance = 0
	self.spawn_interval = 0
	self.npc_spawn_interval = 0
	self.play_speed = self.data.default_speed
	self.move_distance = 0
	self.fever_z_change_interval = 0
	self.fever_z_change_interval_max = 10
	self.item_spawn_interval = self.data.default_item_spawn_interval
	self.enemy_spawn_count = 1
	self.phase = 1
	self.pie_temperature = self.data.pie_temperature
	self.fire_distance = 0
	self.ghost_time = 0
	self.roll_time = 0
	self.hurt_time = 0

	self:reset_leader()
	self:refresh_pie_temperature()
	self:change_phase(self.phase)

	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing

	-- 배경 초기화
	self.mini_game_scene.transform.position = vector(self.data.background_init_x, 0, -1)
	self.mini_game_scene2.transform.position = vector(self.data.background_init_x2, 0, -1)

	-- UI 초기화
	self:game_ui_show()
	coroutine.yield()
	self:set_start_ui(self.current_stage)
	self:show_start_ui(false)
	self:show_temperature_ui(false)
	self.temperature_ui:SetReceiveFieldUIEvent(true)
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:SetUIEventReceive(true)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

-- 피자 온도 점수 전환
function local_class:pie_to_score()
	local total_score = 0
	local sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_arcade_number_01', loop = true})
	self.pie_temperature = math.floor(self.pie_temperature)
	local count_time = 0.015
	local delay = 0
	while self.pie_temperature > 0 do
		delay = delay + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if delay >= count_time then
			local count = math.min(math.floor(delay / count_time), self.pie_temperature)
			self.pie_temperature = math.max(self.pie_temperature - count, 0)
			total_score = total_score + (self.data.score_per_pie_temperature[self.current_stage] * count)
			self.temperature_ui:ShowBonusScore(total_score)
			self:refresh_pie_temperature()
			delay = delay - (count_time * count)
		end
		wait_for_sec(count_time)
	end
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(sfx)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_record_01')

	for i = 1, 5 do
		self.temperature_ui:ShowBonusScore(total_score)
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		self.temperature_ui:HideBonusScore(total_score)
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
	end
	self:add_score(total_score)
end

-- 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_collision()
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then
		return
	end

	local hit_npc_data = nil
	local radius = 0.2
	local hit_ifos = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(user_party.Leader.transform.position, radius)
	for i = 0, hit_ifos.Count - 1 do
		for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
			if npc_data.is_crashable == true and npc_data.fo == hit_ifos[i] then
				hit_npc_data = npc_data
				break
			end
		end

		if hit_npc_data ~= nil then
			break
		end
	end

	-- 손님은 특별 처리
	if self.npc_customer.fo.ActiveState ~= active_state('disabled') then
		local diff = math.abs(user_party.Leader.Position.x - self.npc_customer.fo.Position.x)
		if diff <= 1.5 then
			self:set_player_anim('delivery')
			character_util.set_anim(self.npc_customer.fo, { name = 'love' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_emphasize_01')
			self:stop_run_sfx()
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})
			self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.clear
			return
		end
	end

	-- 충돌한 물체가 없으면 처리하지 않음
	if hit_npc_data == nil
	or hit_npc_data.fo.ActiveState ~= active_state('enabled') then
		return
	end

	local npc_type = hit_npc_data.type
	-- 아이템
	if npc_type == self.data.npc_type.item then
		if self.roll_time <= 0 or self.hurt_time <= 0 then	-- 게임 오버 전에 구르는 중 아이템 먹는 것 방지
			hit_npc_data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			self:take_item()
		end
	-- 스코어 아이템
	elseif npc_type == self.data.npc_type.fever then
		hit_npc_data.is_crashable = false
		hit_npc_data.is_busy = true
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(hit_npc_data.fo, { name = 'fever_get', count = 1, end_call_func = function()
			hit_npc_data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			hit_npc_data.is_busy = false
		end })
		self:add_score(self.data.score_per_pie_temperature[self.current_stage])
		self.pie_temperature = self.pie_temperature + 1
		self:refresh_pie_temperature()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_game_move_01')
		-- 적
	elseif self:is_enemy(hit_npc_data) and self.data.immortal == false then
		if self.fire_distance > 0 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_score_effect, self, hit_npc_data.fo.Position))
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_shot_01', 0.8)
			self:fly_away(hit_npc_data, false)
			self:add_score(self.data.score.enemy)
		elseif self.ghost_time <= 0 and self.roll_time <= 0 then
			self.roll_time = 1
			self.pie_temperature = self.pie_temperature - 10
			self:set_player_anim('dead1')
			self:change_speed(1)
			self:stop_run_sfx()
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_crash_sfx, self))
		end
	end
end

-- 아이템 먹음
function local_class:take_item()
	--폭탄
	if self.current_item_num == self.data.item_type.bomb then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_get_02')
		self:bomb()
	-- 투명
	elseif self.current_item_num == self.data.item_type.ghost then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_power_up_01')
		if self.roll_time > 0 then
			self.hurt_time = self.data.hurt_time
		end
		self.roll_time = 0
		self.ghost_time = self.data.ghost_time
		self:set_player_anim('ghost1')
		-- 파이어
	elseif self.current_item_num == self.data.item_type.fire then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_power_up_01')
		if self.roll_time > 0 then
			self.hurt_time = self.data.hurt_time
		end
		self.roll_time = 0
		self.fire_distance = self.data.fire_distance
		self:change_speed(self.data.fire_speed)
		self:set_player_anim('attack1')
	end
end

function local_class:bomb()
	for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		local score = 0
		if self:is_enemy(npc_data) == true
		and npc_data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
			self:fly_away(npc_data, true)
			local explosion_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.normal_explosion_effect_name)
			local explosion = explosion_effect:Instantiate(npc_data.fo.transform.position)
			explosion.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
			score = score + self.data.score.enemy
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_score_effect, self, npc_data.fo.Position))
		end
		self:add_score(score)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_explosion_01')
	end
end

-- 아이템 변신
function local_class:item_change(fo)
	local random_num = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)
	if random_num == 1 then
		self.current_item_num = self.data.item_type.bomb
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'bomb' })
	elseif random_num == 2 then
		self.current_item_num = self.data.item_type.ghost
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'ghost' })
	elseif random_num == 3 then
		self.current_item_num = self.data.item_type.fire
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'fire' })
	end
end

-- 유저의 행동 처리
function local_class:user_action(dt)
	if self:is_goal_in() then
		return
	end

	-- 조작에 따른 목적지 z좌표
	local current_z = user_party.Leader.Position.z
	if self.input_direction.z > 0 then
		self.player_next_z = math.floor(current_z + 1)
		self.player_dir = unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1)
	elseif self.input_direction.z < 0 then
		self.player_next_z = math.floor((current_z - 1) * -1) * -1
		self.player_dir = unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -1)
	end

	-- 트랙 밖으로는 못 벗어나도록
	if self.player_next_z < self.data.track_z_min then
		self.player_next_z = self.data.track_z_min
	elseif self.player_next_z > self.data.track_z_max then
		self.player_next_z = self.data.track_z_max
	end

	-- 아래로 이동이 끝났는지 체크
	if self.player_dir.z < 0 and current_z <= self.player_next_z then
		self:user_move_end()
		-- 위로 이동이 끝났는지 체크
	elseif self.player_dir.z > 0 and current_z >= self.player_next_z then
		self:user_move_end()
	end

	-- 이동 실행
	if self.player_dir ~= unity_class.vector3.zero then
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(user_party.Leader, self.player_dir, dt * self.data.track_change_speed)
	end
end

function local_class:user_move_end()
	self.player_dir = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self:set_transform_z(user_party.Leader.transform, self.player_next_z)
end

function local_class:move_by_one_frame(fo, pos_from, pos_to, speed, dt)
	local dir = (pos_to - pos_from).normalized
	if dir == unity_class.vector3.zero then
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
			fo,
			dir,
			speed * dt)
end

function local_class:game_update(dt)
	local move_x = dt * self.play_speed

	-- 거리 이동에 따른 이벤트
	self.accure_distance = self.accure_distance + move_x
	if self.accure_distance >= 1 then
		local extra_distance = self.accure_distance - math.floor(self.accure_distance)
		self:on_move_distance(extra_distance)
	end

	-- 배경 스크롤
	self:add_transform_x(self.mini_game_scene.transform, -move_x)
	self:add_transform_x(self.mini_game_scene2.transform, -move_x)

	-- 배경2가 배경1 시작위치에 오면 배경1,2 모두 초기 위치로 돌림
	if self.mini_game_scene2.transform.position.x <= self.data.background_init_x then
		self:set_transform_x(self.mini_game_scene.transform, self.data.background_init_x)
		self:set_transform_x(self.mini_game_scene2.transform, self.data.background_init_x2)
	end

	-- 시간에 따른 이벤트
	self:on_time_passed(dt)
end

-- 시간 흐름에 따른 이벤트
function local_class:on_time_passed(dt)
	-- 결승점 도착
	if self:is_goal_in() then
		self:change_speed(5)

		-- X좌표 이동
		local track_z_center = (self.data.track_z_min + self.data.track_z_max) / 2
		local target_pos = vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, track_z_center)
		local diff_z = math.abs(user_party.Leader.Position.z - target_pos.z)
		if diff_z > 0.1 then
			self:move_by_one_frame(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position, target_pos, 5, dt)
		end

		-- Z좌표 이동
		target_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right
		self:move_by_one_frame(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position, target_pos, 1.5, dt)

		-- npc 행동
		self:npc_action(self.npc_customer, dt)
		return
	end

	-- 가속
	if self.fire_distance <= 0 then
		local prev_speed = self.play_speed
		local speed = math.min(self.play_speed + (dt * 2), self.data.speed_max)
		self:change_speed(speed)
	end

	-- 피자 온도
	if self.pie_temperature > 0 then
		self.pie_temperature = self.pie_temperature - dt
		self:refresh_pie_temperature()
	end

	-- 투명 시간 처리
	if self.ghost_time > 0 then
		self.ghost_time = math.max(self.ghost_time - dt, 0)
		if self.ghost_time <= 0 then
			if self.hurt_time > 0 then
				self:set_player_anim('run')
			else
				self:set_player_anim('rapid_run')
			end
		elseif self.ghost_time <= 1 then
			self:set_player_anim('ghost2')
		end
	end

	-- 구르는 시간 처리
	if self.roll_time > 0 then
		self.roll_time = math.max(self.roll_time - dt, 0)
		if self.roll_time <= 0 then
			if self.hurt_time > 0 then
				self:failed()
				return
			else
				self.hurt_time = self.data.hurt_time
				self:set_player_anim('run')
			end
		end
	end

	-- 상처 회복
	if self.hurt_time > 0 then
		self.hurt_time = math.max(self.hurt_time - dt, 0)
	end

	-- 아이템 등장
	local item_spawn_interval_max = 10
	self.item_spawn_interval = self.item_spawn_interval + dt
	if self.item_spawn_interval >= item_spawn_interval_max then
		local spawn_z = random_util.get_random_int(self.data.track_z_min, self.data.track_z_max)
		local npc_data = self:spawn_npc(self.data.npc_type.item, spawn_z)
		if npc_data ~= nil then
			self:item_change(npc_data.fo)
			npc_data.fo.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
		end
		self.item_spawn_interval = self.item_spawn_interval - item_spawn_interval_max
	end

	-- npc 행동
	for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		self:npc_action(npc_data, dt)
	end
end

-- 피자 온도 갱신
function local_class:refresh_pie_temperature()
	self.temperature_ui:Set(self.pie_temperature, self.data.max_temperature[self.current_stage])
end

-- 페이즈 변경
function local_class:change_phase(phase)
	local phase_data = self:get_phase()
	if phase_data == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 적 그룹 세팅
	self.enemy_group = {}
	for _, enemy_id in ipairs(phase_data.enemy) do
		local type = self:get_enemy_type(enemy_id)
		table.insert(self.enemy_group, type)
	end
	self.enemy_spawn_count = phase_data.enemy_spawn_count
	self.enemy_spawn_idx = 1

	-- 역주행 패턴에서는 쉬지 않고 계속 피버 아이템 나옴
	if #self.enemy_group == 1 and self.enemy_group[1] == self.data.npc_type.run_npc then
		self.fever_spawn_x = {1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11}
	else
		self.fever_spawn_x = {3, 5, 7, 9}
	end
end

-- 골에 도착했는지 확인
function local_class:is_goal_in()
	if self.phase > self:get_phase_max() then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_phase()
	if self.current_stage < 1 or self.current_stage > #self.data.stage_list then
		return nil
	end

	local stage_data = self.data.stage_list[self.current_stage]
	if self.phase < 1 or self.phase > #stage_data then
		return nil
	end

	-- 해당 넘버의 페이즈 가져오기
	local phase_num = stage_data[self.phase]
	for _, data in ipairs(self.data.phase_list) do
		if data.number == phase_num then
			return data
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_phase_max()
	if self.current_stage < 1 or self.current_stage > #self.data.stage_list then
		return 0
	end

	return #self.data.stage_list[self.current_stage]
end

-- npc 행동
function local_class:npc_action(npc_data, dt)
	local npc = npc_data.fo
	if npc.ActiveState == active_state('disabled')
	or npc_data.is_busy == true then
		return
	end

	-- 차선 바꿀지 체크
	if npc.transform.position.z == math.floor(npc.transform.position.z) then
		if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.zigzag_npc then
			self:npc_track_change(npc_data)
		elseif npc_data.fo.Position.x < self.center_pos.x + 6
		and npc_data.change_track_count > 0 then
			self:group_track_change(npc_data.group_id)
		end
	end

	-- X좌표 이동 실행
	local next_pos = npc.transform.position + unity_class.vector3.left
	local speed = self.play_speed
	if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.run_npc then
		speed = speed + self.data.run_npc_speed
	elseif npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.item then
		speed = speed / 2
	end
	self:move_by_one_frame(npc, npc.transform.position, next_pos, speed, dt)

	-- Z좌표 이동 실행
	local dir = unity_class.vector3.zero
	if npc.transform.position.z < npc_data.next_z then
		dir = unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1)
	elseif npc.transform.position.z > npc_data.next_z then
		dir = unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -1)
	end
	next_pos = npc.transform.position + dir
	if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.zigzag_npc then
		speed = 2
	else
		speed = self.data.track_change_speed
	end
	self:move_by_one_frame(npc, npc.transform.position, next_pos, speed, dt)

	-- 이동이 끝나면 트랙에 멈추도록
	if dir == unity_class.vector3(0, 0, 1)
	and	npc.transform.position.z > npc_data.next_z then
		self:set_transform_z(npc.transform, npc_data.next_z)
	elseif dir == unity_class.vector3(0, 0, -1)
	and npc.transform.position.z < npc_data.next_z then
		self:set_transform_z(npc.transform, npc_data.next_z)
	end

	-- 아이템은 화면 밖을 나가면 비활성화
	if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.item then
		local size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size() / 2
		local x_min = self.center_pos.x - size.x
		if npc.Position.x < x_min then
			npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end
end

-- 그룹 단위 차선 변경
function local_class:group_track_change(group_id)
	if group_id <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local npc_list = {}
	for _, data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if data.group_id == group_id then
			self:npc_track_change(data)
			data.test_z = data.fo.transform.position.z
			data.test_done = false
			table.insert(npc_list, data)
		end
	end

	-- 혼자면 테스트 필요 없음
	if #npc_list == 1 then
		return
	end

	-- 이동 할 수 있는지 테스트
	for i = 1, #npc_list do
		self:move_test(npc_list)
	end

	-- 테스트 결과를 next_z에 반영
	for _, data in ipairs(npc_list) do
		data.next_z = data.test_z
		data.change_track_count = 0
	end
end

-- 차선 변경 문제 없는지 테스트
function local_class:move_test(npc_list)
	for i = 1, #npc_list do
		local data = npc_list[i]
		if data.test_done == true then
			return
		end

		-- 자신이 이동하려는 곳에 같은 그룹의 다른 차가 있는지 확인
		local movable = true
		for k = 1, #npc_list do
			if i ~= k then
				local target = npc_list[k]
				if data.next_z == target.test_z then
					movable = false
				end
			end
		end

		if movable == true then
			data.test_z = data.next_z
			data.test_done = true
		end
	end
end

-- npc 성격에 따라서 차선 변경
function local_class:npc_track_change(npc_data)
	local npc_z = npc_data.fo.transform.position.z
	local player_z = math.floor(user_party.Leader.Position.z)

	-- 차선을 바꾸는 차
	if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.move_npc or
		npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.drunk_npc then
		if npc_data.param == 0 then
			npc_data.next_z = npc_z + 1
		else
			npc_data.next_z = npc_z - 1
		end
		character_util.set_anim(npc_data.fo, { name = 'walk' })
	-- 위 아래 이동 차
	elseif npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.zigzag_npc then
		if npc_data.param == 0 then
			if npc_z <= self.data.track_z_min then
				npc_data.next_z = npc_z - 1
				npc_data.param = 1
			else
				npc_data.next_z = npc_z - 1
			end
			character_util.set_anim(npc_data.fo, { name = 'walk' })
			character_util.set_locked_dir(npc_data.fo, 'down')
		else
			if npc_z >= self.data.track_z_max then
				npc_data.next_z = npc_z + 1
				npc_data.param = 0
			else
				npc_data.next_z = npc_z + 1
			end
			character_util.set_anim(npc_data.fo, { name = 'walk' })
			character_util.set_locked_dir(npc_data.fo, 'up')
		end
	-- 한번에 차선 2개를 바꾸는 차
	elseif npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.move_twice_npc then
		if npc_data.param == 0 then
			npc_data.next_z = npc_z + 2
		else
			npc_data.next_z = npc_z - 2
		end
		character_util.set_anim(npc_data.fo, { name = 'walk' })
	-- 차선을 바꾸지 않음
	else
		npc_data.next_z = npc_z
	end

	-- 트랙을 벗어나지 않도록
	if npc_data.next_z < self.data.track_z_min then
		npc_data.next_z = self.data.track_z_min
	elseif npc_data.next_z > self.data.track_z_max then
		npc_data.next_z = self.data.track_z_max
	end

	npc_data.change_track_count = 0
end

-- 스피드 변경
function local_class:change_speed(speed)
	self.play_speed = math.max(speed, 0)
end

-- 1m 이동 할 때마다 처리해야 할 것
function local_class:on_move_distance(extra_distance)
	local move_x = math.floor(self.accure_distance)

	-- 거리 갱신
	self.move_distance = self.move_distance + move_x

	-- 스폰 처리
	self.spawn_interval = self.spawn_interval + move_x
	local min_interval = 1
	if self.spawn_interval >= min_interval then
		self.spawn_interval = self.spawn_interval - min_interval
		self.npc_spawn_interval = self.npc_spawn_interval + 1

		-- 적 배치
		if self.npc_spawn_interval >= 12 then
			self.current_group_id = self.current_group_id + 1
			local random_box = {}
			for i = self.data.track_z_min, self.data.track_z_max do
				table.insert(random_box, i)
			end
			self:random_shuffle(random_box)
			local spawn_count = math.min(self.enemy_spawn_count, 2)	-- 한줄에 최대 2명 등장
			for i = 1, spawn_count do
				-- 붙어서 나오지 않도록 막기
				while i > 1 and math.abs(random_box[1] - random_box[i]) <= 1 do
					i = i + 1
					if i > #random_box then
						break
					end
				end

				local npc_data = self:spawn_npc(self.data.npc_type.random_enemy, random_box[i], extra_distance)
				npc_data.fo.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
				if npc_data ~= nil and npc_data.type ~= self.data.npc_type.run_npc then	-- 역주행 차는 그룹에 포함되지 않음
					npc_data.group_id = self.current_group_id
				end
			end
			self.npc_spawn_interval = 0
		else
			local is_spawn = false
			for _, x in ipairs(self.fever_spawn_x) do
				if self.npc_spawn_interval == x then
					is_spawn = true
					break
				end
			end

			-- 피버 아이템 등장
			if is_spawn == true then
				if self.current_fever_z > self.fever_z then
					self.current_fever_z = self.current_fever_z - 1
				elseif self.current_fever_z < self.fever_z then
					self.current_fever_z = self.current_fever_z + 1
				end
				self:spawn_fever_item(self.current_fever_z, extra_distance)

				-- 피버 아이템 등장하는 줄 변경
				self.fever_z_change_interval = self.fever_z_change_interval + 1
				if self.fever_z_change_interval >= self.fever_z_change_interval_max then
					self.fever_z = random_util.get_random_int(self.data.track_z_min, self.data.track_z_max)
					self.fever_z_change_interval = 0
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 폭주 처리
	if self.fire_distance > 0 then
		self.fire_distance = math.max(self.fire_distance - move_x, 0)
		if self.fire_distance <= 0 then
			if self.hurt_time > 0 then
				self:set_player_anim('run')
			else
				self:set_player_anim('rapid_run')
			end
			self.play_speed = self.data.speed_max
		else
			local speed = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.data.speed_max, self.data.fire_speed, self.fire_distance / self.data.fire_distance)
			self:change_speed(speed)
			if self.fire_distance <= self.data.fire_distance / 2 then
				self:set_player_anim('attack2')
			end
		end
	end

	-- 페이즈 변경
	self.phase_change_distance = self.phase_change_distance + move_x
	if self.phase_change_distance > self.data.phase_distance then
		self.phase_change_distance = self.phase_change_distance - self.data.phase_distance
		self.phase = self.phase + 1
		-- 골인
		if self:is_goal_in() == true then
			if self.goal_in_check == false then
				self:bomb()
				for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
					if npc_data.fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled')
					and npc_data.is_crashable == true then
						npc_data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
					end
				end
				local track_z_center = (self.data.track_z_min + self.data.track_z_max) / 2
				local npc_data = self:spawn_npc(self.data.npc_type.customer, track_z_center, extra_distance)
				npc_data.fo.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
				field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
				self.ghost_time = 0
				self.roll_time = 0
				self.fire_distance = 0
				self:set_player_anim('run')
				self.goal_in_check = true

				-- UI 숨김
				self.temperature_ui:SetReceiveFieldUIEvent(false)
				field_ui_manager:Hide()
				CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:SetUIEventReceive(false)

			end
		-- 다음 페이즈
		else
			self:change_phase(self.phase)
		end

		-- 오일 아이템이 연속으로 나오는 길이 변화
		if self.phase >= 3 then
			self.fever_z_change_interval_max = 5
		elseif self.phase >= 6 then
			self.fever_z_change_interval_max = 1
		end
	end

	self.accure_distance = self.accure_distance - move_x
end

function local_class:spawn_fever_item(z, extra_distance)
	local data = self:spawn_npc(self.data.npc_type.fever, z, extra_distance)
	if data ~= nil then
		character_util.set_anim(data.fo, { name = 'fever', scale = 0 })
		data.fo.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	end
end

function local_class:random_shuffle(list)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

function local_class:add_score(score)
	self.current_score = math.min(self.current_score + score, CS.System.Double.MaxValue)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameScoreChangeEvent.Create('RacingGame', self.current_score))
end

function local_class:set_score(score)
	self.current_score = math.min(score, CS.System.Double.MaxValue)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameScoreChangeEvent.Create('RacingGame', self.current_score))
end

function local_class:add_transform_x(transform, add_x)
	transform.position = transform.position + vector(add_x, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:set_transform_x(transform, new_x)
	local new_pos = transform.position
	new_pos.x = new_x
	transform.position = new_pos
end

function local_class:set_transform_z(transform, new_z)
	local new_pos = transform.position
	new_pos.z = new_z
	transform.position = new_pos
end

function local_class:spawn_npc(npc_type, spawn_z, extra_distance)
	extra_distance = lua_helper.get_or_default(extra_distance, 0)

	-- 타입이 랜덤인 경우
	if npc_type == self.data.npc_type.random_enemy
	and #self.enemy_group > 0 then
		if self.enemy_spawn_idx > #self.enemy_group then
			self.enemy_spawn_idx = 1
		end
		npc_type = self.enemy_group[self.enemy_spawn_idx]
		self.enemy_spawn_idx = self.enemy_spawn_idx + 1
	end

	-- 해당 타입의 npc를 찾아서 활성화
	local npc_data = nil
	for _, data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if self:check_npc_type(data, npc_type) == true
		and data.fo.ActiveState ~= active_state('enabled')
		and data.is_busy == false then
			npc_data = data
			break
		end
	end

	-- 등장 가능한 npc 없음
	if npc_data == nil then
		return
	end

	-- npc 초기화
	local spawn_point = vector(self.area_bound.max.x - extra_distance, 0, spawn_z)
	local npc = npc_data.fo
	npc.Position = spawn_point
	npc.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 3
	npc.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	npc.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 10)
	npc_data.next_z = spawn_point.z
	npc_data.is_crashable = true
	npc_data.is_busy = false

	if self:is_enemy(npc_data) then
		-- 차선 변경 차의 이동 방향
		if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.move_npc
		or npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.move_twice_npc then
			if spawn_z == self.data.track_z_min then
				npc_data.param = 0
			elseif spawn_z == self.data.track_z_max then
				npc_data.param = 1
			else
				npc_data.param = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
			end
			if npc_data.param == 0 then
				character_util.set_locked_dir(npc, 'up')
			else
				character_util.set_locked_dir(npc, 'down')
			end
		end

		-- 애니메이션, 스킨 변경
		if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.move_npc then
			npc_data.fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'arcade_demon_beggar_a'
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'idle' })
			npc_data.change_track_count = 1
		elseif npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.zigzag_npc then
			npc_data.fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'arcade_demon_beggar_b'
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'idle' })
			npc_data.change_track_count = 1
		elseif npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.move_twice_npc then
			npc_data.fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'arcade_demon_beggar_c'
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'idle' })
			npc_data.change_track_count = 1
		elseif  npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.normal_npc then
			npc_data.fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'arcade_demon_female_a'
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'idle' })
			character_util.set_locked_dir(npc, 'left')
			npc_data.change_track_count = 0
		elseif  npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.run_npc then
			npc_data.fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'arcade_demon_female_b'
			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'walk', scale = 2 })
			character_util.set_locked_dir(npc, 'left')
			npc_data.change_track_count = 0
		end
	end

	return npc_data
end

function local_class:check_npc_type(data, type)
	if data.type == type then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 적인지 타입 검사
function local_class:is_enemy(data)
	if data.type == self.data.npc_type.fever
	or data.type == self.data.npc_type.item
	or data.type == self.data.npc_type.customer then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- npc가 튕겨 날아가는 연출
function local_class:fly_away(npc_data, is_bomb)
	npc_data.is_crashable = false
	npc_data.is_busy = true

	local npc_fly_away = function(data, end_position, duration)
		local start_position = data.fo.transform.position
		character_util.spine_rotate(data.fo, 360, duration)

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local now_position = vector_util.lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
			data.fo.transform.position = now_position
			coroutine.yield()
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
		data.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		data.is_busy = false
		character_util.spine_rotate(data.fo, 0, 0)
	end

	-- 날아갈 위치 구하기
	local rb = self.area_bound.min + unity_class.vector3.right * self.area_bound.size.x
	local rt = self.area_bound.max
	rt.z = rt.z - 1
	rb.z = rb.z + 1
	local end_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	if is_bomb == true then
		if npc_data.fo.transform.position.x < user_party.Leader.Position.x then
			end_position = unity_class.vector3.left * rt.x +
					unity_class.vector3.forward * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(rt.z, rb.z, unity_class.random.value)
		else
			end_position = unity_class.vector3.right * rt.x +
					unity_class.vector3.forward * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(rt.z, rb.z, unity_class.random.value)
		end
	else
		end_position = unity_class.vector3.right * rt.x +
				unity_class.vector3.forward * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(rt.z, rb.z, unity_class.random.value)
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(npc_fly_away, npc_data, end_position, 0.5))
end

function local_class:get_enemy_type(enemy_id)
	local type = self.data.npc_type.none
	if enemy_id == 'normal_npc' then
		type = self.data.npc_type.normal_npc
	elseif enemy_id == 'move_npc' then
		type = self.data.npc_type.move_npc
	elseif enemy_id == 'zigzag_npc' then
		type = self.data.npc_type.zigzag_npc
	elseif enemy_id == 'move_twice_npc' then
		type = self.data.npc_type.move_twice_npc
	elseif enemy_id == 'run_npc' then
		type = self.data.npc_type.run_npc
	end

	return type
end

	if self.data.immortal == false then
		self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.fail
	end
end

function local_class:init_npc_list()
	self.npc_data_list = {}
	local npc_list = stage.CharacterManager:GetAllNpcs()
	for i = 0, npc_list.Count - 1 do
		local npc = npc_list[i]
		npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(npc)
		npc.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		if string.match(npc.Name, self.move_npc_name) then
			self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.move_npc)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.zigzag_npc_name) then
			self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.zigzag_npc)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.move_twice_npc_name) then
			self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.move_twice_npc)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.normal_npc_name) then
			self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.normal_npc)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.run_npc_name) then
			self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.run_npc)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.fever_npc_name) then
			self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.fever)
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.item_npc_name) then
			self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.item)
		-- 손님 npc
		else
			if self.current_stage == 1 then
				if string.match(npc.Name, self.customer1_npc_name) then
					self.npc_customer = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.customer)
				end
			elseif self.current_stage == 2 then
				if string.match(npc.Name, self.customer2_npc_name) then
					self.npc_customer = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.customer)
				end
			else
				if string.match(npc.Name, self.customer3_npc_name) then
					self.npc_customer = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.customer)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:add_npc_data(fo, type)
	local npc_data = {
		fo = fo,	-- 필드 오브젝트
		type = type,	-- 타입
		next_z = 0,	-- 차선 변경시 목적지z
		change_track_count = 0,	-- 차선 변경 최대 횟수
		is_crashable = false,	-- 충돌 가능한지(중복 충돌 방지)

function local_class:init(_, _)

	self.stage_names = {
		halloween = 'shortstory_halloween_1'
	}

	self.get_func_tables = {}

	self.get_func_tables[self.stage_names.halloween] = {
		get_tagger = function() return get_character('red_green_tagger') end,
		get_mover = function(num) return get_character('red_green_mover_' .. num) end,

	}

		arrive_zone = 'red_green_arrive'
	}

		game_2 = 'halloween_red_green_47',
		game_3 = 'halloween_red_green_48',
	}

	self.party_members = {}

	self.is_racing = false
	self.tagger_look_left = false

	self.fast_mover_num = 1
	self.slow_mover_num = 2
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	return util.cs_generator(self.load_resource_routine, self)
end

function local_class:load_resource_routine()

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'red_green' and e.Params[1] == 'start' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ready_game, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self:get_zone_name().arrive_zone and self.is_racing then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_win, self))
				return true
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self:get_func().get_mover(self.fast_mover_num)) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_lose_to_competitor, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self:get_zone_name().game_zone and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
				and self.is_racing and not self.tagger_look_left then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_lose_escape, self))
			return true
		end

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.JoypadEvent) then
		if not self.is_racing or not self.tagger_look_left then return false end

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickNeutral) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_lose_moving, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.get_func_tables = nil
	self.zone_name_tables = nil
	self.party_members = nil
end

function local_class:get_func()
	return self.get_func_tables[stage.Name]
end

function local_class:get_zone_name()
	return self.zone_name_tables[stage.Name]
end

function local_class:get_string()
	return self.string_tables[stage.Name]
end

function local_class:ready_game()

	local mover_slow = self:get_func().get_mover(self.slow_mover_num)
	local tagger = self:get_func().get_tagger()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	local cheer_pos = self:get_func().get_cheer_pos()

	if stage.Name == self.stage_names.halloween then
		self.party_members = {}

		local fake_princess = get_character('princess')
		local real_princess = get_character('pumpkin_kid')
		local has_fake_princess = user_party:Contains(fake_princess)
		local has_real_princess = user_party:Contains(real_princess)

		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local member = user_party[0]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
			member.Position = cheer_pos + vector(i, 0, 0)
			member.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
			table.insert(self.party_members, member)
		end

		local play_character
		if has_fake_princess then
			play_character = fake_princess
		elseif has_real_princess then
			play_character = real_princess
		end

		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(play_character, param)

		play_character.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	else
		self.party_members = {}
		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			local member = user_party[1]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
			member.Position = cheer_pos + vector((i - 1), 0, 0)
			member.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
			self.party_members[i] = member
		end
	end

	--self.party_members = {}
	--for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
	--	local member = user_party[1]
	--	character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
	--	member.Position = cheer_pos + vector((i - 1), 0, 0)
	--	member.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	--	self.party_members[i] = member
	--end

	local camera_pos = self:get_func().get_camera_pos()
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(6, 0)

	local start_pos = self:get_func().get_start_pos()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	user_party.Leader.Position = start_pos
	user_party.Leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mover_fast)
	mover_fast.Position = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.7)
	mover_fast.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mover_slow)
	mover_slow.Position = start_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.7)
	mover_slow.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tagger)
	tagger.Position = self:get_func().get_tagger_pos()
	tagger.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	mover_fast.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	mover_slow.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	tagger.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:scene_before_start()

	-- 플레이어 달리기, 공격, 스킬 금지
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

function local_class:scene_before_start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_names.halloween then
		local tagger = self:get_func().get_tagger()

		character_util.set_direction(tagger, 'left')

		--규칙은 단 두가지.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tagger, {key = 'halloween_red_green_21', skip = true, scale = 1.5})

		--내가 바라보는 동안엔 움직이지 말 것.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tagger, {key = 'halloween_red_green_22', skip = true, scale = 1.5})

		--누구보다 먼저 여기 도착할 것.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tagger, {key = 'halloween_red_green_23', skip = true, scale = 1.5})

		--그럼, 시작하지.
		character_util.set_anim(tagger, {name = 'nod'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(tagger, {key = 'halloween_red_green_24', skip = true, scale = 1.5})
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tagger)

		character_util.set_direction(tagger, 'right')
	end
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	local mover_fast = self:get_func().get_mover(self.fast_mover_num)
	local mover_slow = self:get_func().get_mover(self.slow_mover_num)
	local tagger = self:get_func().get_tagger()

	self.tagger_look_left = false
	self.is_racing = true

	local race_round = 1

	-- 참가자들 이동
	local move_func = function(fo, target_x, is_fast)
		local target_pos = vector(target_x, 0, fo.Position.z)
		wp_util.move_way_points(fo, { waypoints = target_pos, speed = is_fast and 2.4 or 1})
	end

	-- 티탄 트리오의 시합 액션 루틴이 돌고있는지 체크
	self.is_in_action = true

	while true do
		-- 타이머 UI 켜기
		if race_round % 2 == 1 then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(tagger, 1.5))
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(tagger, 1.2))
		end

		self.tagger_look_left = false
		move_func(mover_fast, tagger.Position.x, true)
		move_func(mover_slow, tagger.Position.x, false)

		character_util.set_direction(tagger, 'right')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(tagger, { key = self:get_string().game_1 })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		if not self.is_racing then break end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(tagger, { key = self:get_string().game_2 })
		if race_round % 2 == 1 then
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		else
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end

		if not self.is_racing then break end

		-- 타이머 UI 끄기

local local_class = newclass('RedLightGreenLightGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'RedLightGreenLightGame'

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- 게임 상태
	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		playing = 2,
		game_clear = 3,
		game_fail = 4,
	}

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none

	-- 게임 처리용 데이터
	self.people_info = nil
	self.round_info = nil
	self.cur_round = 0

	-- npc
	self.soldier_name = 'pink_soldier_8'
	self.start_key = 'ww_red_light_green_light_game_0'
	self.fail_key = 'ww_red_light_green_light_game_13'

	-- fo
	self.fo = {
		yeonghee = function()
			return get_field_object('s2_yeonghee')
		end
	}

	-- fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		fx_laser_pointer = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_laser_pointer')
		end,
		move_icon = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('ch11_move_icon')
		end
	})

	self.arrow_fx = nil
	self.pointer_fx = nil
	self.fx_offset = vector(0, 1.25, 0)
	self.pointer_fx_offset = vector(0, 0.7, 0)

	-- 버튼 delay
	self.shot_delay = 0.5

	-- 조작용
	self.move_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	self.is_pressed = false
	self.button_delay = 0.3
	self.cur_pressed_time = 1
	self.target_index = 1

	self.custom_atlas = nil

	-- 살린 npc 저장용
	self.save_data_key = 'save_people'
end

function local_class:load_resource(key)
	--TODO fx와 액티비티 클리어 Pre load는 2섹션의 on_pre_load에서 로드중
	-- 게임 데이터 세팅
	self.constants_data = require('minigame/RedLightGreenLightGame/RedLightGreenLightGameConstants')[key]

	-- 참가자 npc 정보 세팅
	local people_data = self.constants_data.people
	self.people_info = {}

	for i = 1, #people_data do
		local npc = get_character(people_data[i].key)
		local marker = field_util.get_marker(people_data[i].marker)
		local npc_info = {
			npc = npc,
			-- 게임 진행 가능 여부
			live = true,
			-- 타겟으로 활성화 체크용(해당 대상이 아닌 경우 쏠 시 패배)
			is_target = false,
			marker = marker,
			-- 리더가 쏴서 살린 여부 저장용
			save = false,
		}

		character_util.set_position(npc, marker.position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, marker.direction)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)

		table.insert(self.people_info, npc_info)
	end

	-- 라운드 정보 세팅
	self.round_info = self.constants_data.round

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/ui', 'laboseworld_custom_top', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self:reset_people_info(true)

	if self.pointer_fx ~= nil then
		self.pointer_fx:Dispose()
		self.pointer_fx = nil
	end

	if self.arrow_fx ~= nil then
		self.arrow_fx:Dispose()
		self.arrow_fx = nil
	end

	self.constants_data = nil

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none
	self.people_info = nil
	self.round_info = nil
	self.cur_round = 0

	self.move_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	self.is_pressed = false
	self.cur_pressed_time = 1
	self.target_index = 1
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return false
	end

	self.move_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) and
			e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or
			e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_pressed = true
		return true
	else
		self.is_pressed = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction1TouchDown then
		self:shot_people()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none
	return true
end

function local_class:use_update_frame()
	return true
end

function local_class:update_frame_priority()
	return CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent
end

--- 플레이어 조작 처리용
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return
	end

	self:input_check(dt)
	self:fx_move()
end

function local_class:input_check(dt)
	if not self.is_pressed then
		self.cur_pressed_time = 1
		return
	end

	self.cur_pressed_time = self.cur_pressed_time + dt

	if self.cur_pressed_time >= self.button_delay and self.people_info ~= nil then
		self.cur_pressed_time = 0

		if self.move_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03', 0.5)
			self.target_index = self:get_live_index(self.target_index, true)
		elseif self.move_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_03', 0.5)
			self.target_index = self:get_live_index(self.target_index, false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_live_index(index, is_right)
	local origin_index = index

	if is_right then
		local cur_index = index == #self.people_info and 1 or index + 1

		while cur_index ~= origin_index do
			if self.people_info[cur_index].live then
				return cur_index
			end

			cur_index = cur_index == #self.people_info and 1 or cur_index + 1
		end
	else
		local cur_index = index == 1 and #self.people_info or index - 1

		if cur_index < 1 then
			cur_index = #self.people_info
		end

		while cur_index ~= origin_index do
			if self.people_info[cur_index].live then
				return cur_index
			end

			cur_index = cur_index == 1 and #self.people_info or cur_index - 1
		end
	end

	return origin_index
end

function local_class:fx_move()
	if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing or
			self.pointer_fx == nil or
			self.people_info == nil or
			self.arrow_fx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.pointer_fx.transform.position = self.people_info[self.target_index].npc.Position + self.pointer_fx_offset
	self.arrow_fx.transform.position = self.people_info[self.target_index].npc.Position + self.fx_offset
end

function local_class:shot_people()
	if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing or self.people_info == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.people_info[self.target_index].live then
		local npc = self.people_info[self.target_index].npc

		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(npc)
		character_util.stop(npc)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, 'dead')

		self.people_info[self.target_index].live = false
		self.people_info[self.target_index].save = true

		if not self.people_info[self.target_index].is_target then
			self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.game_fail
		end
	end
end

function local_class:use_late_update_frame()
	return false
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	--스트링 문구 : 사격 시작!
	--액티비티 시작 문구 출력과 함꼐 bgm 재생, 볼륨0.6, 페이드 인 믹스 2초

	end

		self.arrow_fx = self.fx.move_icon():Instantiate(vector(999, 0, 999))
		self.arrow_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
		self.arrow_fx.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'in', true)
	end

		local move = self.round_info[self.cur_round].move

		local move_duration = self.round_info[self.cur_round].move_duration

		--나레이션 : 무궁화 꽃이 피었습니다.
		--해당 말풍선은 한번에 출력됨.
		-- 말풍선 크기 2배
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_ww_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(yeonghee, {
			key = 'ww_red_light_green_light_game_1',
			skip = false,
			type_speed = 0,
			scale = 2
		})

		local yeonghee_progress = self.round_info[self.cur_round].yeonghee_duration / move_duration
		local animation_check = false

		coroutine_util.while_each_frame(move_duration, function(progress)
			if not animation_check and yeonghee_progress <= progress then
				animation_check = true
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_head_turn_01')
				animator_util.play(yeonghee, 'head_back')
			end

			return self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing
		end)

		if target ~= nil then
			local dead_index = {}

			if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing then

				--(화면비) x : 0.5 / y : 0.8
				--나레이션 탈락 대사
				-- 크기 2
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(leader, {
					key = target.narration_key,
					viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8),
					skip = false,
					scale = 2
				})

				for i = 1, #target.index do
					local dead_npc = self.people_info[target.index[i]].npc

					-- 해당 npc를 쏠 수 있는 대상으로 변경
					self.people_info[target.index[i]].is_target = true

					-- 참가자 (left, scared, embarrased 지속) : 히이이익!!!
					scene_util.set_emotion(dead_npc, self, 'scared')
					scene_util.set_anim(dead_npc, self, 'embarrassed')
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(dead_npc, { key = target.people_key })

					table.insert(dead_index, target.index[i])
				end
			end

			-- 정해진 대기 시간 부여
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(target.duration, function(_)
				if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
					return false
				end

				local dead_npc_check = true

				-- 살아있는 대상자 체크
				for i = 1, #dead_index do
					local cur_people_info = self.people_info[dead_index[i]]

					if cur_people_info.live then
						dead_npc_check = false
						break
					end
				end

				return not dead_npc_check
			end)

			-- 대상을 살렸는지 체크
			if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing then
				local live_check = true

				for i = 1, #dead_index do
					local cur_people_info = self.people_info[dead_index[i]]

					if cur_people_info.live then
						live_check = false

						-- 살리지 못한 대상 사망 처리
						--(left, hurt, dead + 0.5초 동안 npc 검은 틴트 100% 로 변경)
						local dead_npc = cur_people_info.npc

						cur_people_info.live = false
						cur_people_info.is_target = false
						speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(dead_npc)
						scene_util.set_emotion(dead_npc, self, 'hurt')
						scene_util.set_anim(dead_npc, self, 'dead')
						character_util.add_color(dead_npc, dead_npc.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0.5)
					end
				end

				if not live_check then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')
					camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)
					--0.5초 대기
					coroutine_util.while_each_frame(0.5, function(_)
						return self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing
					end)

					--핑크 솔저 말풍선 출력
					--(화면비) x : 0.5 / y : 0.2
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glitch_02')
					scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(leader, target.fail_key,
							false, { viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2), scale = 1.5 })
				end
			end
		end

		if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing and self.cur_round ~= #self.round_info then
			-- 2초 대기
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(2, function(_)
				return self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing
			end)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_teatan_head_turn_01')
			animator_util.play(yeonghee, 'head_front')

			-- 애니메이션 시간 + 1초 대기
			coroutine_util.while_each_frame(1.4, function(_)
				return self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing
			end)
		end

		self.cur_round = self.cur_round + 1
	end

	self:hide_ui()

	if self.pointer_fx ~= nil then
		self.pointer_fx:Dispose()
		self.pointer_fx = nil
	end

	if self.arrow_fx ~= nil then
		self.arrow_fx:Dispose()
		self.arrow_fx = nil
	end

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_fail then
		mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, false)
	elseif self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.none then
		self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.game_clear
		self.people_info[8].save = true
		self:save_data()
		mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, true)
	end
end

--- 게임 성공 실패 연출용
function local_class:game_end(is_success, data)
	start_coroutine(function()
		if not is_success then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })

			-- dead 끝날 때 까지 대기
			wait_for_sec(spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.people_info[8].npc, 'dead'))

			local pink_soldier = get_character(self.soldier_name)

			--1초 동안 Stage Camera 값 4로 인
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 1)
			--1초 동안 카메라 핑크 병정8 NPC로 패닝.
			camera_util.move_to_target_async(pink_soldier, 1)

			--화면 0.3값으로 0.5초 shake
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
			--핑크 병정8 (right, idle, idle) : [shout]방금 어떤 놈이 쏜거야!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(pink_soldier, self, 'right',
					{ name = 'release', keep = true }, nil, self.fail_key)

			--0.6초 동안 게임오버 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

			character_util.set_direction(pink_soldier, 'up')
			character_util.remove_anim(pink_soldier)

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
		else
			local npc = self.people_info[8].npc
			--이벤트 동시 실행
			--「액티비티 완료」 문구 스트링 출력
			--「액티비티 완료」 문구 스트링 출력과 함꼐 bgm 뮤트, 페이드 아웃 믹스 디폴트
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
			--참가자8 (left, damaged, frustration)
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = 'frustration', loop = false })
			--1초 동안 카메라 참가자8 NPC로 패닝.
			camera_util.move_to_target(npc, 1)
			--1초 동안 Stage Camera 값 3으로 줌인.
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(3, 1)

			wait_for_sec(2)

			--참가자8 (left, damaged, frustration 정지) : 살, 살았다…! 살았어…!!
			scene_util.shake(npc, 0.03, 20)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(npc, 'ww_squid_game_s2_44')

			--1초 동안 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			character_util.stop_shake(npc)

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
		end
	end)
end

--- 게임 초기화
function local_class:reset()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self:reset_people_info(false)

	if self.pointer_fx ~= nil then
		self.pointer_fx:Dispose()
		self.pointer_fx = nil
	end

	if self.arrow_fx ~= nil then
		self.arrow_fx:Dispose()
		self.arrow_fx = nil
	end

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none
	self.round_info = self.constants_data.round
	self.cur_round = 1

	self.move_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	self.button_delay = 0.3
	self.cur_pressed_time = 1
	self.target_index = 1
end

--- 참가자 npc 상태 리셋
function local_class:reset_people_info(is_disable)
	if self.people_info == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.people_info do
		self.people_info[i].live = true
		self.people_info[i].is_target = false
		self.people_info[i].save = false

		local npc = self.people_info[i].npc

		if is_disable then
			character_util.remove_emotion(npc)
			character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
		else
			scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'scared')
			character_util.set_position(npc, self.people_info[i].marker.position)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, self.people_info[i].marker.direction)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		character_util.remove_color(npc, npc.Name, 0)
	end
end

--- 액티비티 클리어 후 살린 npc들 저장
function local_class:save_data()
	if self.people_info == nil then
		return
	end

	local storage_create = require('utils/QuestDataStorage')
	local data_storage = storage_create.create(477)
	local save_bit = 0

	for i = 1, #self.people_info do
		local is_save = self.people_info[i].save

		if is_save then
			local add_bit = 1 << (i - 1)
			save_bit = save_bit | add_bit
		end
	end

	data_storage:set_data(self.save_data_key, save_bit)
end

				},
				target = nil
			},
		}
	}
