--- Rhythm minigame controller
local local_class = newclass("RhythmGameController")

function local_class:init(cs_controller, scene)
	-- Constants 를 여기서 로드 한다.
	self.hp_max = 5
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_red_node")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_blue_node")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_both_node")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_red")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_blue")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_text")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_clear")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_ready")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('stage_item')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:rhythm_game()
	yield_return_func(self.load_rhythm_game, self)

	self.dead = false
	self.combo_count = 0

	yield_return_func(self.run_rhythm_game, self)
	self:clear_rhythm_game()

	-- FIXME:
	--self.dead = false
	--self.combo_count = 10000

	if self.dead then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent.CreateGameOver())

		self.game_over_ended = false
		while not self.game_over_ended do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.game_over_branches == nil then
			self.game_over_branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		end
		self.game_over_branches:Clear()

		local branches = self.game_over_branches
		local wait_for_branch = true
		local choice = 0
		branches:Add({
			-- 재시도
			Text = game_string:GetString('rhythm_game_retry'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				choice = 1
			end
		})
		branches:Add({
			-- 그만 둔다
			Text = game_string:GetString('rhythm_game_exit'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				choice = 2
			end
		})
		local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = user_party[0]

		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if choice == 1 then
			-- 재시도
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent.CreateRestart())
		else
			screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black)
			--  HACK
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent.CreatePhase(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEventType.Restart, 99))
		end
	else
		local is_full_combo = self.combo_count >= self.left_notes.Count + self.right_notes.Count + self.both_notes.Count
		-- HACK: 노트가 씹히는 현상이 있어서 hp 로 체크한다
		is_full_combo = self.current_hp == self.hp_max
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent.CreateEnd(is_full_combo))
	end
end


--- Load Resources Here.
function local_class:load_rhythm_game()
	if self.res_holder == nil then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	end

	-- 채보 로드
	coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadTextAssetAsync(
			CS.Foundations.AssetName(string.format("%s/text", self.asset_name), string.format("%s_%s", self.song_name, self.difficulty)),
			function(p)
				local parser = CS.SharpJson.JsonDecoder()
				parser.parseNumbersAsFloat = true
				local data = parser:Decode(p.text)
				local iter = data:GetEnumerator()

				while true do
					if iter.Current.Key == "right" then
						self.right_notes = iter.Current.Value
					elseif iter.Current.Key == "left" then
						self.left_notes = iter.Current.Value
					elseif iter.Current.Key == "both" then
						self.both_notes = iter.Current.Value
					end

					if not iter:MoveNext() then
						break
					end
				end
			end))

	-- UI 셋업
	-- UI 버튼 셋업
	local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height;
	local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight);
	local left_button = nil
	local right_button = nil
	local left_button_pos = vector(0 - 250, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 140, 0)
	local right_button_pos = vector(0 + 250, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 140, 0)
	local start_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

	self.target_size = target_size

	local stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button'):Instantiate(start_pos)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(stage_item_obj.transform, "FieldUI")
	stage_item_obj.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos
	stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = vector(60, 60, 60)
	left_button = stage_item_obj
	left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, "blue_idle", true)

	stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button"):Instantiate(start_pos)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(stage_item_obj.transform, "FieldUI")
	stage_item_obj.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos
	stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = vector(60, 60, 60)
	right_button = stage_item_obj
	right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, "red_idle", true)

	local h_space = 0.35
	local hp_list = self.hp_list
	if hp_list == nil then
		hp_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)
	end

	for i = 0, self.hp_max - 1 do
		local pos = self.player.Position + vector((- (self.hp_max - 1) / 2.0 + i) * h_space, 1.75, -0.1)
		stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('stage_item'):Instantiate(pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.player.Transform)
		stage_item = stage_item_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
		stage_item:SetItem("knight_badge")
		stage_item.ShadowActive = false
		stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = vector(0.65, 0.65, 0.65)
		hp_list:Add(stage_item_obj)
	end

	local widget_offset = 0.2

	self.hit_text = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_text"):Instantiate(vector(0, -widget_offset, 0))
	self.hit_text_animator = self.hit_text:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	self.hit_text_perfect = self.hit_text.transform:Find("perfect").gameObject
	self.hit_text_good = self.hit_text.transform:Find("good").gameObject
	self.hit_text_miss = self.hit_text.transform:Find("miss").gameObject
	self.hit_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	if (game_string.IsRTL) then
		local s = self.hit_text_perfect.transform.localScale
		local x = s.x

		if (x > 0) then
			x = -x
		end

		s.x = x

		self.hit_text_perfect.transform.localScale = s

		s = self.hit_text_good.transform.localScale
		x = s.x

		if (x > 0) then
			x = -x
		end

		s.x = x

		self.hit_text_good.transform.localScale = s

		s = self.hit_text_miss.transform.localScale
		x = s.x

		if (x > 0) then
			x = -x
		end

		s.x = x

		self.hit_text_miss.transform.localScale = s
	end

	if self.combo_text_object == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder,
			'theatres/steampunk_rhythm_minigame', 'rhythm_combo', function (prefab)
				local go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				local t = go.transform
				t.localPosition = vector(0, -target_size.y * widget_offset, 0)
				local n_text = t:Find("number"):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
				self.combo_text_object = go
				self.combo_text = n_text
				go:SetActive(false)
			end	)
	end


	self.left_button = left_button
	self.right_button = right_button
	self.hp_list = hp_list

	-- 스테이지 셋업
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
end

function local_class:clear_rhythm_game()
	self.hit_text:Dispose()
	self.hit_text = nil
	self.hit_text_animator = nil
	self.hit_text_perfect = nil
	self.hit_text_good = nil
	self.hit_text_miss = nil

	self.left_button:Dispose()
	self.left_button = nil
	self.right_button:Dispose()
	self.right_button = nil

	for i = 0, self.hp_list.Count -1 do
		self.hp_list[i]:Dispose()
	end

	self.hp_list:Clear()

	self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:hide_rhythm_game(hide, combo_count, current_hp)
	self.left_button.gameObject:SetActive(not hide)
	self.right_button.gameObject:SetActive(not hide)
	if hide then
		self.hit_text.gameObject:SetActive(not hide)
		self.combo_text_object:SetActive(not hide)
		for i = 0, self.hp_list.Count -1 do
			self.hp_list[i].gameObject:SetActive(not hide)
		end
	else
		for i = 0, current_hp -1 do
			self.hp_list[i].gameObject:SetActive(not hide)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:run_rhythm_game()
	local left_notes = self.left_notes
	local right_notes = self.right_notes
	local both_notes = self.both_notes
	local left_button = self.left_button
	local right_button = self.right_button
	local target_size = self.target_size
	local hp_list = self.hp_list
	local end_time = self.end_time


	local note_speed = target_size.y / 1.0
	local note_appear_dist = target_size.y + 120
	local note_appear_time = note_appear_dist / note_speed
	local time_threshold = 0.12
	local note_disappear_time = 300 / note_speed
	local left_button_pos = left_button.transform.localPosition
	local right_button_pos = right_button.transform.localPosition
	local left_button_scale = left_button.transform.localScale
	local right_button_scale = right_button.transform.localScale
	local left_state = left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
	local right_state = right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state

	local left_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
	left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)

	local right_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
	right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)

	local left_max = left_button_pos.x + left_button_scale.x * 6
	local right_min = right_button_pos.x - right_button_scale.x * 6

	if left_max > right_min then
		local to_move = left_max
		local x_scale = left_button.transform.localScale.x
		left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(-to_move / x_scale, 0)
		right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(to_move / x_scale, 0)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.0, unity_class.color.black)

	if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
		self.is_show_pc_narration = true
		field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')
	end

	local current_hp = hp_list.Count

	local prev_frame_rate = CS.UnityEngine.Application.targetFrameRate
	CS.UnityEngine.Application.targetFrameRate = 60
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:SetMaximumDeltaTime(1)
	-- 음악 스타트
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		name = string.format("%s/audio:bgm_rhythm_game_%s", self.asset_name, self.song_name), state = 'event', mix = 0, volume = 0.5, loop = false
	})

	-- 게임 시작 알림
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent.CreatePhase(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEventType.PhaseStart, 0))

	local left_note_objects = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)
	local left_note_hits = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
	for i = 0, left_notes.Count - 1 do
		left_note_objects:Add(nil)
		left_note_hits:Add(0)
	end

	local right_note_objects = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)
	local right_note_hits = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
	for i = 0, right_notes.Count - 1 do
		right_note_objects:Add(nil)
		right_note_hits:Add(0)
	end

	local both_note_objects = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)
	local both_note_hits = create_generic_list(CS.System.Int32)
	for i = 0, both_notes.Count - 1 do
		both_note_objects:Add(nil)
		both_note_hits:Add(0)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	local left_pressed = left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
	local right_pressed = right_button_touch_handler.Pressed

	local time_since_last_hit_text = 0

	local combo_count = 0

	while true do
		local time_before = time_passed
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= end_time then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0.5 })
			break
		end

		local left_down = false
		local left_up = false
		local right_down = false
		local right_up = false
		local both_down = false

		local current_left_pressed =
		left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
				or self.gamepad_left_button_pressed == true

		local current_right_pressed =
		right_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D)
				or self.gamepad_right_button_pressed == true

		self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
		self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

		left_button_touch_handler:Update()
		right_button_touch_handler:Update()

		if current_left_pressed ~= left_pressed then
			if current_left_pressed then
				left_down = true
			else
				left_up = true
			end
			left_pressed = current_left_pressed
		end

		if current_right_pressed ~= right_pressed then
			if current_right_pressed then
				right_down = true
			else
				right_up = true
			end
			right_pressed = current_right_pressed
		end

		local hit_left = false
		if left_down then
			left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = "01_rhythm_o_01", fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'event'})
			left_state:SetAnimation(0, "blue_touch_on", false)
			hit_left = true
		elseif left_up then
			left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos
			left_state:SetAnimation(0, "blue_idle", true)
		end

		local hit_right = false
		if right_down then
			right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = "01_rhythm_o_01", fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'event'})
			right_state:SetAnimation(0, "red_touch_on", false)
			hit_right = true
		elseif right_up then
			right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos
			right_state:SetAnimation(0, "red_idle", true)
		end

		if right_down and left_pressed then
			both_down = true
		elseif left_down and right_pressed then
			both_down = true
		elseif right_down and left_down then
			both_down = true
		end

		local hit_both = false
		if both_down then
			hit_both = true
		end

		local decision = 0
		local damaged = false
		local hit_count = 0

		for i = 0, left_notes.Count -1 do
			local left_pos = left_button_pos + vector(0, note_speed * (left_notes[i] - time_passed), 0)
			if left_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (left_note_hits[i] == 0 or left_note_hits[i] == -1) then
				if time_passed >= left_notes[i] + note_disappear_time then
					left_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
					left_note_hits[i] = -2
				elseif time_passed >= left_notes[i] + time_threshold and left_note_hits[i] == 0 then
					damaged = true
					decision = -1
					left_note_hits[i] = -1
				elseif hit_left and unity_class.mathf.Abs(time_passed - left_notes[i]) <= time_threshold then
					left_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
					left_note_hits[i] = 1

					-- 왼쪽 적중
					bluehit = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_blue"):Instantiate(left_button.transform.position)
					bluehit.transform.localScale = vector(360, 360, 360)
					decision = 1
					hit_count = hit_count + 1
				else
					left_note_objects[i].transform.localPosition = left_pos
				end
			else
				if time_passed <= left_notes[i] and time_passed >= left_notes[i] - note_appear_time then
					if left_note_hits[i] == 0 then
						local stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_blue_node'):Instantiate(left_pos)
						stage_item_obj.transform.localPosition = left_pos
						stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = vector(125, 125, 125)
						left_note_objects[i] = stage_item_obj
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for i = 0, right_notes.Count -1 do
			local right_pos = right_button_pos + vector(0, note_speed * (right_notes[i] - time_passed), 0)
			if right_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (right_note_hits[i] == 0 or right_note_hits[i] == -1) then
				if time_passed >= right_notes[i] + note_disappear_time then
					right_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
					right_note_hits[i] = -2
				elseif time_passed >= right_notes[i] + time_threshold and right_note_hits[i] == 0 then
					damaged = true
					decision = -1
					right_note_hits[i] = -1
				elseif hit_right and unity_class.mathf.Abs(time_passed - right_notes[i]) <= time_threshold then
					right_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
					right_note_hits[i] = 1

					-- 왼쪽 적중
					redhit = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_red"):Instantiate(right_button.transform.position)
					redhit.transform.localScale = vector(360, 360, 360)
					decision = 1
					hit_count = hit_count + 1
				else
					right_note_objects[i].transform.localPosition = right_pos
				end
			else
				if time_passed <= right_notes[i] and time_passed >= right_notes[i] - note_appear_time then
					if right_note_hits[i] == 0 then
						local stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_red_node'):Instantiate(right_pos)
						stage_item_obj.transform.localPosition = right_pos
						stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = vector(125, 125, 125)
						right_note_objects[i] = stage_item_obj
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for i = 0, both_notes.Count -1 do
			local both_pos = (right_button_pos + left_button_pos) / 2 + vector(0, note_speed * (both_notes[i] - time_passed), 0)
			if both_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (both_note_hits[i] == 0 or both_note_hits[i] == -1) then
				if time_passed >= both_notes[i] + note_disappear_time then
					both_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
					both_note_hits[i] = -2
				elseif time_passed >= both_notes[i] + time_threshold and both_note_hits[i] == 0 then
					damaged = true
					decision = -1
					both_note_hits[i] = -1
				elseif hit_both and unity_class.mathf.Abs(time_passed - both_notes[i]) <= time_threshold then
					both_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
					both_note_hits[i] = 1

					music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = "01_rhythm_b_01", fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'event', volume = 0.8})
					redhit = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_red"):Instantiate(right_button.transform.position)
					redhit.transform.localScale = vector(360, 360, 360)
					bluehit = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_blue"):Instantiate(left_button.transform.position)
					bluehit.transform.localScale = vector(360, 360, 360)
					decision = 1
					hit_count = hit_count + 1
				else
					both_note_objects[i].transform.localPosition = both_pos
				end
			else
				if time_passed <= both_notes[i] and time_passed >= both_notes[i] - note_appear_time then
					if both_note_hits[i] == 0 then
						local stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_both_node'):Instantiate(both_pos)
						stage_item_obj.transform.localPosition = both_pos
						stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = vector(125, 125, 125)
						both_note_objects[i] = stage_item_obj
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if damaged then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_comic_01',  fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'event' })
			current_hp = current_hp - 1
			if current_hp >= 0 then
				hp_list[current_hp].gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end

			self.player.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
			self.player.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
			CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(self.player, 1, unity_class.color.red, self.player.Position)

			if current_hp <= 0 then
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1.5 })
				break
			end
		end

		local update_text = false
		if decision == 1 and not damaged then
			combo_count = combo_count + hit_count
			self.hit_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.combo_text_object:SetActive(true)
			self.combo_text.text = string.format("%d", combo_count)
		elseif damaged then
			combo_count = 0
			self.hit_text_perfect:SetActive(false)
			self.hit_text_good:SetActive(false)
			self.hit_text_miss:SetActive(true)
			update_text = true
			self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)
		end

		time_since_last_hit_text = time_since_last_hit_text + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if update_text then
			self.hit_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.hit_text.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			time_since_last_hit_text = 0
		elseif self.hit_text.gameObject.activeSelf then
			if time_since_last_hit_text > 1.0 then
				self.hit_text.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end

		local phase_prepare = false
		local phase_start = false
		local phase_end = false
		local phase = -1

		local prepare_time = 1.5
		local phase_1_prepare_time = self.phase_1_start_time - prepare_time
		local phase_2_prepare_time = self.phase_2_start_time - prepare_time
		local phase_3_prepare_time = self.phase_3_start_time - prepare_time

		if time_before < self.phase_1_start_time and time_passed >= self.phase_1_start_time then
			phase_start = true
			phase = 1
		elseif time_before < self.phase_2_start_time and time_passed >= self.phase_2_start_time then
			phase_start = true
			phase = 2
		elseif time_before < self.phase_3_start_time and time_passed >= self.phase_3_start_time then
			phase_start = true
			phase = 3
		elseif time_before < self.phase_1_end_time and time_passed >= self.phase_1_end_time then
			phase_end = true
			phase = 1
		elseif time_before < self.phase_2_end_time and time_passed >= self.phase_2_end_time then
			phase_end = true
			phase = 2
		elseif time_before < self.phase_3_end_time and time_passed >= self.phase_3_end_time then
			phase_end = true
			phase = 3
		elseif time_before < phase_1_prepare_time and time_passed >= phase_1_prepare_time then
			phase_prepare = true
			phase = 1
		elseif time_before < phase_2_prepare_time and time_passed >= phase_2_prepare_time then
			phase_prepare = true
			phase = 2
		elseif time_before < phase_3_prepare_time and time_passed >= phase_3_prepare_time then
			phase_prepare = true
			phase = 3
		end

		if phase_end then
			if phase < 3 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_quiz_o_02',  fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'event' })
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_clear"):Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 0))
			end
			self:hide_rhythm_game(true, combo_count, current_hp)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent.CreatePhase(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEventType.PhaseEnd, phase))
		elseif phase_start then
			if combo_count > 0 then
				self.combo_text_object:SetActive(true)
			end
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent.CreatePhase(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEventType.PhaseStart, phase))
		elseif phase_prepare then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_craft_hit_01',  fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'event', volume = 0.5 })
			local ready = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("steampunk_rhythm_minigame_ready"):Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 0))

			if (game_string.IsRTL) then
				local s = ready.transform.localScale
				local x = s.x

				if (x > 0) then
					x = -x
				end

				s.x = x

				ready.transform.localScale = s
			end

			self:hide_rhythm_game(false, combo_count, current_hp)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.Application.targetFrameRate = prev_frame_rate
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:ResetMaximumDeltaTime()

	for i = 0, left_note_objects.Count -1 do
		if left_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (left_note_hits[i] == 0 or left_note_hits[i] == -1) then
			left_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end
	left_note_objects:Clear()
	left_note_hits:Clear()

	for i = 0, right_note_objects.Count -1 do
		if right_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (right_note_hits[i] == 0 or right_note_hits[i] == -1) then
			right_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end
	right_note_objects:Clear()
	right_note_hits:Clear()

	for i = 0, both_note_objects.Count -1 do
		if both_note_objects[i] ~= nil and (both_note_hits[i] == 0 or both_note_hits[i] == -1) then
			both_note_objects[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end
	both_note_objects:Clear()
	both_note_hits:Clear()

	left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = nil
	left_button_touch_handler = nil

	right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = nil
	right_button_touch_handler = nil

	self.dead = current_hp <= 0
	self.combo_count = combo_count
	self.current_hp = current_hp
end


function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent) then
		if e.Type == CS.Oak.RhythmGameEventType.Start then
			self.asset_name = e.AssetBundleName
			self.song_name = e.SongName
			self.difficulty = e.Difficulty
			self.player = e.Player
			self.phase_1_start_time = e.Phase1StartTime
			self.phase_1_end_time = e.Phase1EndTime
			self.phase_2_start_time = e.Phase2StartTime
			self.phase_2_end_time = e.Phase2EndTime
			self.phase_3_start_time = e.Phase3StartTime
			self.phase_3_end_time = e.Phase3EndTime
			self.end_time = e.EndTime
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rhythm_game, self))
		elseif e.Type == CS.Oak.RhythmGameEventType.GameOverEnd then
			self.game_over_ended = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.RhythmGameEvent), 'on_event')
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}

function local_class:init(cs_controller)

	}

	-- 실패 카운트 UI
	self.get_fail_counter_ui = function()

	end

	self.res_holder = nil

	self.ox_ui_show_duration = 0.433
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)

	local constants_data = require('minigame/RhythmPunch/RhythmPunchConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	self.pattern_list = constants_data.pattern_list

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 콤보 텍스트
	local widget_offset = 0.2
	local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
	local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight)

	if self.combo_text_object == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder,
			'theatres/steampunk_rhythm_minigame', 'rhythm_combo', function(prefab)
				local go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				local t = go.transform
				t.localPosition = vector(0, target_size.y * widget_offset, 0)
				local n_text = t:Find('number'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
				self.combo_text_object = go
				self.combo_text = n_text
				go:SetActive(false)
			end)
	end

	-- ox ui
	if self.ox_object == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder,
			'ui/stage/minigame', 'minigame_ox', function(prefab)
				self.ox_object = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.ox = self.ox_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
				self.ox_object.transform.localScale = vector(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
				CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.ox_object.transform, 'UI')
				self.ox_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end)
	end

	self.get_fail_counter_ui()

	yield_return_func(unity_object_pool.WaitAll, unity_object_pool)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.combo_text = nil
	if self.combo_text_object then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.combo_text_object)
		self.combo_text_object = nil
	end

	self.ox = nil
	if self.ox_object then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ox_object)
		self.ox_object = nil
	end

	if self.ui_fail_counter then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.touchable and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.pattern_success = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

--- 미니게임 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	local ui_fail_counter_obj = self.get_fail_counter_ui():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	ui_fail_counter_obj.transform:GetChild(3).gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.ui_fail_counter = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))

	local layout_positioner = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
	layout_positioner.AnchorPosition = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	layout_positioner.Position = vector(15, -40)

	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)
	self.ui_fail_counter:Reposition()

	local success_mini_game = true

	local fail_count = 0
	local combo_count = 0

	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.pattern_index do
		local current_pattern = self.pattern_list[self.constants_data.pattern_index[i]]

		-- 현재 패턴의 연출을 전부 보여줌
		for index = 1, #current_pattern do
			local scene = current_pattern[index]
			if scene.camera_resize then
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(scene.camera_resize, scene.duration)
			end
			camera_util.shake(scene.camera_shake, scene.duration)
			field:Tint(nil, unity_class.color.black, scene.duration, scene.tint)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(scene.sfx)
			wait_for_sec(scene.duration + scene.wait_time)
		end

		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.touchable
		self.pattern_success = false

		-- 터치 가능한 시간
		wait_for_sec(self.constants_data.touchable_time[self.constants_data.pattern_index[i]])

		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.scene

		field:RemoveTint(nil, 0.05)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.05)

		-- 패턴 결과
		local pattern_result

		if self.pattern_success then
			pattern_result = 'success'
			combo_count = combo_count + 1
			self.combo_text_object:SetActive(true)
			self.combo_text.text = string.format("%d", combo_count)

		else
			pattern_result = 'fail'
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)
			combo_count = 0

			self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(fail_count)
			self.ui_fail_counter:Reposition()
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.game_name, pattern_result }))

		-- ox ui 출력
		self:show_result_ui(self.pattern_success)

		-- 패턴 사이 간격
		wait_for_sec(self.constants_data.pattern_interval - self.ox_ui_show_duration)

		-- 미니게임 성공 실패 판정
		if fail_count > self.constants_data.max_fail_count then
			success_mini_game = false
			break
		end
	end

	if self.ui_fail_counter then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, success_mini_game))
end

-- 성공 여부 ui 띄우기
function local_class:show_result_ui(success)
	self.ox_object.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	if success then
		self.ox.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, 'good', false)
	else
		self.ox.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, 'bad', false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(self.ox_ui_show_duration)

	self.ox_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	-- 마커용
	self.quest_spec = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.constants_data.quest_id).Spec

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	self.get_hit_effect()
	self.get_last_hit_effect()
	self.get_butt_bounce_effect()

	self.game_duration = self.constants_data.game_duration
	self.total_lane_num = self.constants_data.lane.number

	for i = 1, self.total_lane_num do
		-- 차선 정보
		self.lane_data[i] = {
			-- 해당 차선에 속한 자동차
			cars = {},
			-- 다음에 움직일 자동차 번호
			next_move_car_idx = 1,
			-- 다음 자동차가 나오는데 걸리는 남은 시간
			cur_delay = self.constants_data.lane.pattern[self.cur_pattern].spawn_start_time[i],
			-- 자동차 출발 위치
			start_pos = self.get_lane_start_marker(i).position,
			-- 자동차 도착 위치
			end_pos = self.get_lane_end_marker(i).position,
			-- 차선 방향
			lane_direction = nil
		}
	end

	-- 자동차 검색
	local zone = field:GetZone(self.constants_data.zone)
	local car_obj_data = self.constants_data.car
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, zone.Bounds)

	local cur_lane = 1
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		for j = 1, table_util.get_size(car_obj_data.name) do
			if fo.Name == car_obj_data.name[j] then
				fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
				fo.Transform.localScale = 0.85 * unity_class.vector3.one

				local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.lane_data[cur_lane].end_pos - self.lane_data[cur_lane].start_pos).normalized
				self.lane_data[cur_lane].lane_direction = dir
				fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.lane_data[cur_lane].lane_direction)

				local dir_str = direction_util.to_str(fo.Direction)

				local default_dir = car_obj_data.default_dir[j]
				if default_dir ~= nil then
					local dir_num = {
						left = 1,
						down = 2,
						right = 3,
						up = 4
					}

					local default_dir_num = dir_num[default_dir]
					local rot = math.abs(default_dir_num - dir_num[dir_str])
					rot = rot * 90

					fo.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, rot, 0))
				end

				-- 방향에 따라 히트박스 피봇 변경
				local hitbox = car_obj_data.hitbox
				if hitbox ~= nil then
					local pivot = hitbox.pivot[dir_str]
					local size = hitbox.size
					fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(pivot.x, pivot.y, pivot.z), vector(size.x, size.y, size.z))
				else
					fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 1))
				end

				fo.Position = self.lane_data[cur_lane].start_pos

				-- 자동차 정보
				local car_data = {
					-- 자동차
					fo = fo,
					-- 움직이고 있는지
					is_moving = false
				}

				fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

				table.insert(self.lane_data[cur_lane].cars, car_data)

				cur_lane = cur_lane + 1 > self.total_lane_num and 1 or cur_lane + 1
				break
			end
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()

	-- 타겟 설정
	local target = self.constants_data.target
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(target) do
		local target_character = get_character(target[i])
		if target_character ~= nil then
			character_util.add_listener(target_character, self.cs_controller)
			table.insert(self.targets, target_character)
		end
	end

	-- 파티 설정
	self.player = get_character(self.constants_data.player)

	if self.player == user_party.Leader then
		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			table.insert(self.origin_party, user_party[i])
			character_util.set_position(user_party[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[i])
		end
	else
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			table.insert(self.origin_party, user_party[i])
			character_util.set_position(user_party[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[i])
		end
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.player, param)
	end

	character_util.set_immortal(self.player, true)

	-- 타겟을 돌려주는 대상 위치 설정
	local target_return_data = self.constants_data.target_return
	self.target_return = get_character(target_return_data.name)
	self.target_return_oneline_key = target_return_data.oneline_key
	self.target_return_oneline_sfx = target_return_data.oneline_sfx
	character_util.set_position(self.target_return, self.get_target_return_marker().position)
	character_util.add_listener(self.target_return, self.cs_controller)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.is_game_playing = false

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	if self.car_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.car_sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.car_sfx_holder = nil
	end

	if self.target_return_oneline_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.target_return_oneline_sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.target_return_oneline_sfx_holder = nil
	end

	if self.cs_controller ~= nil then
		if self.target_return ~= nil then
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.target_return, self.cs_controller)
			self.target_return = nil
		end

		if self.targets ~= nil then
			for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.targets) do
				if self.targets[i] ~= nil then
					character_util.remove_relate_event(self.targets[i], self.cs_controller)
				end
			end
			self.targets = nil
		end

		self.cs_controller = nil
	end

	if self.collected_targets ~= nil then
		self.collected_targets = nil
	end

	self.constants = nil
	self.origin_party = nil
	self.lane_data = nil
	end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- 방어 코드
	if not self.is_game_playing then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.is_interacting and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.target_return) then
		if self.interacted_target_num - self.returned_target_num > 0 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_target_return, self))
		elseif self.target_return_oneline_key ~= nil then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.target_return_oneline_talk, self))
		end
		return true
	else
		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.targets) do
			if not self.is_interacting and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.targets[i]) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_target, self, i))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 타겟 돌려주는 대상 원라인 대사
function local_class:target_return_oneline_talk()
	if self.target_return_oneline_sfx ~= nil then
		if self.target_return_oneline_sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.target_return_oneline_sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.target_return_oneline_sfx_holder = nil
		end
		self.target_return_oneline_sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.target_return_oneline_sfx, loop = false })
	end
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.target_return)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.target_return, { key = self.target_return_oneline_key, scale = self.bubble_scale })
end

-- 타겟을 돌려주는 연출
function local_class:interact_target_return()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.is_interacting = true

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('target_return')

	local target_return = self.target_return
	local player = self.player

	-- 아기 와이번 세팅
	local targets = {}
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.collected_targets) do
		if not self.collected_targets[i].returned then
			self.collected_targets[i].returned = true
			local target = self.collected_targets[i].fo
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 1, 0)
			character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'blush' })
			table.insert(targets, target)
		end
	end

	party_util.align_party(target_return, target_return.Direction, 1)

	local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'eat' })

	self.returned_target_num = self.interacted_target_num
	local is_clear = self.returned_target_num >= table_util.get_size(self.targets)

	-- 미리 타이머 정지 (클리어 연출 중에 타임오버 방지)
	if is_clear then
		timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
	end

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(targets) do
		local target = targets[i]

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_03')

		character_util.set_position(target, player.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(player.Direction) * 0.2)

		character_util.move_to(target, target_return.Position,
				1, nil, true, true)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 0, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		character_util.set_position(target, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 1, 0)
	end

	equip_sfx:FadeOut(0)

	character_util.remove_anim(player)
	character_util.remove_emotion(player)

	-- 캬릉! 캬릉!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target_return, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_5', skip = true, scale = self.bubble_scale })

	self.is_interacting = false

	if is_clear then
		self:game_end(true)
		return
	end

	self:reset_minigame_controllers()
end

-- 타겟을 획득하는 연출
function local_class:interact_target(idx)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('target_' .. idx)

	local target = self.targets[idx]

	self.is_interacting = true

	local pattern = self.constants_data.lane.pattern
	if pattern[self.cur_pattern + 1] ~= nil then
		self.cur_pattern = self.cur_pattern + 1

		for i = 1, self.total_lane_num do
			self.lane_data[i].cur_delay = self.constants_data.lane.pattern[self.cur_pattern].spawn_start_time[i]
		end
	end

	party_util.align_party(target.Position - direction_util.to_vector3(target.Direction) * 0.5, target.Direction, 0.5)

	local player = self.player

	local equip_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'eat' })

	-- 이리 오자, 많이 무서웠지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(player, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_20', skip = true, scale = self.bubble_scale })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_03')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 0, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	equip_sfx:FadeOut(0)

	character_util.remove_anim(player)
	character_util.remove_emotion(player)

	character_util.set_position(target, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 1, 0)

	table.insert(self.collected_targets, { fo = target, returned = false })

	self.is_interacting = false

	self.interacted_target_num = self.interacted_target_num + 1
	if self.interacted_target_num == table_util.get_size(self.targets) then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('target_return', self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.target_return)
	end

	self:reset_minigame_controllers()
end

function local_class:game_start()
	for i = 1, self.total_lane_num do
		local cars = self.lane_data[i].cars
		for j = 1, table_util.get_size(cars) do
			-- 자동차 위치및 상태 초기화
			local car = cars[j]
			car.fo.Position = self.lane_data[i].start_pos
			car.is_moving = false
			car.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		self.lane_data[i].cur_delay = self.constants_data.lane.pattern[self.cur_pattern].spawn_start_time[i]
	end

	-- 자동차 먼저 이동 시작하도록 코루틴 분리 해서 실행
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset, self, true))

	-- 게임 진행
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_loop, self))
end

function local_class:game_over()
	if not self.in_game_over_routine then
		self.in_game_over_routine = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_end, self, false))
	end
end

function local_class:reset(player_start_event)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.collected_targets = nil
	self.collected_targets = {}
	self.interacted_target_num = 0
	self.returned_target_num = 0
	self.is_player_collided_with_car = false
	self.cur_pattern = 1

	-- 타겟 재설정
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.targets) do
		local target_character = self.targets[i]
		character_util.set_position(target_character, self.get_target_marker(i).position)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target_character, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'blush' })
		character_util.set_direction(target_character, 'right')
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('target_' .. i)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('target_' .. i, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, target_character)
	end

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('target_return')

	local player = self.player
	local target_return = self.target_return

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
	character_util.set_position(player, self.get_start_marker().position)
	character_util.look_at(player, target_return)

	character_util.remove_emotion(target_return)
	character_util.set_anim(target_return, { name = 'happy', loop = true })

	camera_util.resize_to(stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() * 1.5, 0)

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = player
	heal_info.target = player
	heal_info.heal = player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.car_sfx_holder == nil then
		self.car_sfx_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_car_loop_03', loop = true })
	end
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if player_start_event then
		-- 아이들이 더 힘들어지기 전에 어서 다녀올게!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(player, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_14', skip = true, scale = self.bubble_scale })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(target_return, { name = 'smile' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- 캬릉!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_04')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target_return, { key = 'nightmare_demonworld_rescue_wyvern_cub_13', skip = true, scale = self.bubble_scale })
		character_util.remove_emotion(target_return)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_chasing', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.game_duration, handler = self, callback = 'game_over' })

	self:reset_minigame_controllers()
end

function local_class:game_loop()
	self.is_game_playing = true

	while self.is_game_playing do
		local delta = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		self:car_update(delta)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:car_update(delta)
	for i = 1, self.total_lane_num do
		local cur_lane_data = self.lane_data[i]
		local cars = cur_lane_data.cars
		local speed = self.constants_data.lane.pattern[self.cur_pattern].speed[i] * delta
		local dir_vector = cur_lane_data.lane_direction
		local move_vector = speed * dir_vector

		for j = 1, table_util.get_size(cars) do
			local car = cars[j]

			-- 자동차 이동
			if car.is_moving then
				car.fo.Position = car.fo.Position + move_vector

				local car_pos = car.fo.Position
				local dest_pos = cur_lane_data.end_pos

				-- 평면 방정식으로 차가 도착지점을 지났는지 판단
				if (dir_vector.x * (dest_pos.x - car_pos.x)) + (dir_vector.z * (dest_pos.z - car_pos.z)) < 0 then
					car.fo.Position = cur_lane_data.start_pos
					car.is_moving = false
					car.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				end
			end

			if not self.in_game_over_routine then
				-- 충돌 체크 / 넉백 중일 때는 충돌하지 않도록
				if self:check_collision_bounds(car.fo.Bounds, self.player.Bounds) and
						not self.is_player_collided_with_car then

					-- 플레이어가 ScreenplayState가 아니거나 사망 상태가 아니면, 플레이어 에어스핀 루틴 실행
					if not lua_helper.type_compare(
							self.player.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
							CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) and
							not self.player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then

						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.player_air_spin, self, car.fo))
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 1, self.total_lane_num do
		local cur_lane_data = self.lane_data[i]
		cur_lane_data.cur_delay = cur_lane_data.cur_delay - delta

		-- 다음 자동차 이동 시작하도록 설정
		if cur_lane_data.cur_delay <= 0 then
			cur_lane_data.cur_delay = self.constants_data.lane.pattern[self.cur_pattern].spawn_delay[i]

			local car_idx = cur_lane_data.next_move_car_idx
			local car_moving = cur_lane_data.cars[car_idx].is_moving

			-- 움직이지 않는 자동차만 이동 시작 하도록 설정
			if not car_moving then
				cur_lane_data.cars[car_idx].fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
				cur_lane_data.cars[car_idx].is_moving = true
				cur_lane_data.next_move_car_idx = car_idx + 1 > table_util.get_size(cur_lane_data.cars) and 1 or car_idx + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:game_end(is_success)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 엑티비티 클리어 연출
	if is_success then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2.0 })
	end

	if self.car_sfx_holder ~= nil then
		self.car_sfx_holder:Stop()
		self.car_sfx_holder = nil
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	wait_for_sec(1)

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
	while self.is_player_collided do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 플레이어 치료 후 무적 상태 해제
	local player = self.player
	if player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP < player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP then
		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = player
		heal_info.target = player
		heal_info.heal = player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
	end
	character_util.set_immortal(player, false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.targets) do
		if self.targets[i] ~= nil then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('target_' .. i)
		end
	end
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('target_return')

	-- 자동차 설정 초기화
	for i = 1, self.total_lane_num do
		local cur_lane_data = self.lane_data[i]
		local cars = cur_lane_data.cars
		for j = 1, table_util.get_size(cars) do
			local car = cars[j]
			car.fo.Position = cur_lane_data.start_pos
			car.is_moving = false
			car.fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	-- 기존 파티 합류
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.origin_party) do
		local party = self.origin_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(party, user_party)
	end
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.origin_party[1])

	self:end_event_setting(is_success)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.is_game_playing = false
	self.in_game_over_routine = false

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
end

-- 이벤트 끝나는 연출 세팅하는 함수
function local_class:end_event_setting(is_success)
	local mother_wyvern = get_character('wyvern_mother')
	character_util.set_position(mother_wyvern, field:GetMarker('wyvern_mother').position)

	if is_success then
		party_util.align_party(field:GetMarker('wyvern_player_return_marker').position + vector(0, 0, -1), 'up', 0)
		character_util.set_anim(mother_wyvern, { name = 'happy', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
	else
		party_util.align_party(mother_wyvern, 'left', 0)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(mother_wyvern, { name = 'hurt', loop = true }, { name = 'tired' })
	end
end

-- 자동차 충돌 연출 (기존 연출과 동일)
function local_class:player_air_spin(damage_sender)
	self.is_player_collided_with_car = true
	self.is_player_collided = true

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')

	local player = self.player

	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(player.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	self.get_last_hit_effect():Instantiate(player.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local fall_time = 1.5
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(15, 20, 0, 0)

	character_util.spine_rotate(player, 360, fall_time)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(player)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(player)
	character_util.set_direction(player, direction_util.to_side_dir(player.Direction))

	character_util.remove_anim(player, true)
	character_util.set_emotion(player, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- 체력 비례 데미지를 줌
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = damage_sender
	damage_info.target = player
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.85)
	damage_info.notMortal = true
	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	-- 1% 이하로 체력이 내려가면 게임 오버
	local is_game_over = false
	if player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP <= player.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.01 then
		timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
		is_game_over = true
	end

	local start_pos = player.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	while (unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time) do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(player, start_pos + vector(0, dist_y, 0), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)

	self.get_butt_bounce_effect():Instantiate(player.Position)

	character_util.remove_anim(player)

	character_util.spine_rotate(player, 0, 0)
	player.Position = start_pos
	character_util.set_anim(player, { name = 'prostrate' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.is_player_collided = false

	if is_game_over then
		self:game_over()
	elseif not self.in_game_over_routine then -- 사운드 재생 및 게임 길이를 위해 조건 추가
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(player, 0.04, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_popup_01' })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
		character_util.mario_jump_async(player, player.Direction)

		self:reset_minigame_controllers()

		-- 무적 시간 대기
		local immune_duration = 1

		wait_for_sec(immune_duration)

		self.is_player_collided_with_car = false
	end
end

function local_class:check_collision_bounds(bounds1, bounds2)
	if bounds2.min.x <= bounds1.max.x and bounds2.max.x >= bounds1.min.x
			and bounds2.min.z <= bounds1.max.z and bounds2.max.z >= bounds1.min.z then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:reset_minigame_controllers()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 이동, 달리기, 상호작용 제외 컨트롤 불가능하도록 설정
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(self.player, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~
			(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move) +
					CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash) +
					(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact))))
	message_system:SendSync(self.player.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end

local screen_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RobotFight/Controller/ScreenController')
local player_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RobotFight/Controller/PlayerController')
local monster_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RobotFight/Controller/MonsterController')
local ui_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RobotFight/Controller/UIController')

local local_class = newclass('RobotFight')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.is_dispose = false

	-- game name
	self.game_name = 'RobotFight'

	--클리어 여부
	self.is_clear = false

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = ''

	self.constants_data = nil

	self.is_playing = true

	self.res_holder = nil

	--영상
	self.punch_media_path = 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/video/chapter18_MS_RPch.$codec.mp4'

	--투명 벽
	self.wall_invisible_list = {}

	--배틀 데이터
	self.zaco_battle_data = {}
	self.boss_battle_data = {}

	self.boss = nil

	self.lw_util = nil

	self.game_state = {
		none = 0,
		start = 1,
		pause = 2,
		boss_intro = 3,
		boss_middle = 4,
		boss_end = 5,
	}
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none

	self.hp_state = {
		hp_max = 1,
		hp_500 = 2,
		hp_150 = 3,
		dead = 4,
		none = 5,
	}
	self.current_hp_state = self.hp_state.hp_max

	-- effect
	self.fx = {
		lw_parry = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_minigame_parry')
		end,
		lw_strong = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_minigame_attack_strong')
		end,
		lw_booster_left_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_robot_booster_left_loop')
		end,
		lw_booster_right_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_robot_booster_right_loop')
		end,
		lw_laser_charge = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_robot_finish_laser_charge')
		end,
		lw_laser = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_robot_finish_laser')
		end,
		lw_laser_monster = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_robot_finish_laser_monster')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end,
	}

	self.operator_ui = nil

	--인 게임 bgm 관리
	self.sfx_manager = {
		handler_data = {},
		insert_handler = function(this, sfx_name, sfx_handler)
			if this.handler_data[sfx_name] ~= nil then
				return
			end

			this.handler_data[sfx_name] = sfx_handler
		end,
		get = function(this, sfx_name)
			if this.handler_data[sfx_name] == nil then
				return nil
			end

			return this.handler_data[sfx_name]
		end,
		change_volume = function(this, sfx_name, volume, duration)
			local handler = this:get(sfx_name)

			if this.handler_data[sfx_name] == nil then
				return nil
			end

			music_player_util.change_sfx_volume(this.handler_data[sfx_name], volume, duration)
		end,
		dispose = function(this, sfx_name, mix)
			if this.handler_data[sfx_name] ~= nil then
				if mix == nil then
					this.handler_data[sfx_name]:Stop()
				else
					this.handler_data[sfx_name]:FadeOut(mix)
				end

				this.handler_data[sfx_name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			for name, data in pairs(this.handler_data) do
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	self.operator_ui = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/CivilWar/Common/OperatorUI')

	local constants_data = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/RobotFight/RobotFightConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	self.zaco_battle_data = self.constants_data.zaco_battle_data
	self.boss_battle_data = self.constants_data.boss_battle_data

	self.fx:load_all()

	--데이터 세팅
	for num, _ in pairs(self.zaco_battle_data) do
		self.zaco_battle_data[num].start = false
	end

	self.boss_battle_data.start = false

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShearToggleEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), false))

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	screen_controller:load_async(self.constants_data, self.res_holder)
	player_controller:load_async(self.constants_data)
	monster_controller:load_async(self.constants_data)
	ui_controller:load_async(self.constants_data, self.res_holder)

	self.boss = get_character(self.boss_battle_data.monster_name)

	--battle
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		local virtual_obj = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		virtual_obj.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		virtual_obj.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 2, 2))
		virtual_obj.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		virtual_obj.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.InField
		message_system:Send(virtual_obj, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(virtual_obj))

		table.insert(self.wall_invisible_list, virtual_obj)
	end

	--sound
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'combat' })
	music_player_util.remove_stage_music_clip({ state = 'field' })
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = false
	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleEndEffect = false

	--subscribe
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HpChangeEvent), 'on_hp_change_event')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.is_dispose then
		return
	end

	self.is_dispose = true

	--unsubscribe
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HpChangeEvent))

	self.is_playing = false

	self.sfx_manager:dispose_all()

	--controller
	ui_controller:dispose()
	monster_controller:dispose()
	player_controller:dispose()
	screen_controller:dispose()

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.boss = nil

	self.lw_util = nil

	--shear
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShearToggleEvent.Create(get_party_leader(), true))

	--sound
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_battle_normal', state = 'combat' })
		stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true
		stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleEndEffect = true
	end)

	--배틀용 벽 제거
	if self.wall_invisible_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.wall_invisible_list do
			local obj = self.wall_invisible_list[i]
			obj:Dispose()
		end
		self.wall_invisible_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self.lw_util = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/LaboseWorld/Common/Util')

	player_controller:game_start()
	monster_controller:game_start()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.start

	start_coroutine(self.game_start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	player_controller:update(dt)
	monster_controller:update(dt)
	screen_controller:update(dt)
	ui_controller:update(dt)

	return self.is_playing
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	--일반 몬스터 존 엔터 처리
	for num, data in pairs(self.zaco_battle_data) do
		if not data.start and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), data.start_zone) then
			self.zaco_battle_data[num].start = true
			start_coroutine(self.battle_start, self, data)
			return true
		end
	end

	--보스 몬스터 존 엔터 처리
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.start and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.boss_battle_data.start_zone) then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.boss_intro
		start_coroutine(self.boss_intro_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	for num, data in pairs(self.zaco_battle_data) do
		if e.BattleGroupName == data.group_name then
			self:remove_battle_area()

			--두번째 배틀 그룹 처치 시 연출 실행
			if num == 1 then
				start_coroutine(self.zaco_battle_end_scene, self)
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local damage = e.Info:GetTotalDamage()
	local result = e.HpBefore - damage

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, get_party_leader()) then
		--플레이어 hp 별 연출
		if result <= 500 and self.current_hp_state == self.hp_state.hp_max then
			self.current_hp_state = self.hp_state.hp_500
			start_coroutine(self.hp_500_less_scene, self)
			return true
		elseif result <= 150 and self.current_hp_state == self.hp_state.hp_500 then
			self.current_hp_state = self.hp_state.hp_150
			start_coroutine(self.hp_150_less_scene, self)
			return true
		elseif result <= 0 and self.current_hp_state == self.hp_state.hp_150 then
			self.current_hp_state = self.hp_state.dead
			start_coroutine(self.restart_routine, self, true)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.boss) then
		if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.boss_intro and
				result < self.boss_battle_data.middle_hp then
			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.boss_middle
			start_coroutine(self.boss_middle_scene, self)
			return true
		elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.boss_middle and
				result < 0 then
			start_coroutine(self.boss_last_scene, self)
			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.boss_end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hp_change_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_party_leader()) then
		local hp_ratio = get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP / get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		ui_controller:refresh_player_hp(hp_ratio)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.boss) then
		local hp_ratio = self.boss.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP / self.boss.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		ui_controller:refresh_enemy_hp(hp_ratio)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for _, data in pairs(self.zaco_battle_data) do
		for i = 1, data.monster_count do
			local monster = get_character(data.monster_name .. i)
			if e.FieldObject.Name == monster.Name then
				start_coroutine(function()
					monster_controller:monster_dead_routine(monster)
				end)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

--restart game
function local_class:restart_routine(player_dead)
	self:disable_control_and_hide_ui()

	self.operator_ui:stop()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })

	self.sfx_manager:dispose('loop')

	monster_controller:boss_pause()

	if player_dead then
		player_controller:dead_routine()
	end

	ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()

	self:fade_out_screen(player_dead)

	--스테이트 초기화
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.boss_intro
	self.current_hp_state = self.hp_state.hp_max

	--npc 리셋
	player_controller:reset()
	monster_controller:boss_reset()

	--스킬 초기화
	player_controller:init_skill_cool_down_all()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/audio:bgm_heavenhold_battle_boss',
										 state = 'event', volume = 1, mix = 0 })

	--사운드 재 시작
	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_war_loop_04',
												  volume = 1, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', fade_in_time = 1 })

	self.sfx_manager:insert_handler('loop', loop_sfx)

	self:fade_in_screen()

	self:boss_battle_start()

	self:enable_control_and_show_ui()
end

function local_class:fade_out_screen(is_player_dead)
	if is_player_dead then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_magwi_shutdown_01', loop = false, loop = false, delayed_time = 0.5 })
		screen_util.fade_out_async(3, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	else
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
end

function local_class:fade_in_screen()
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

--일반 몬스터 배틀 시작
function local_class:battle_start(battle_data)
	local monster_data = {}

	for i = 1, battle_data.monster_count do
		local npc = get_character(battle_data.monster_name .. i)
		table.insert(monster_data, npc)
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)

		--적(attack_rush_end, loop = false, scale = 1, next_anim = idle)
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'attack_rush_end', loop = false, scale = 1 })
	end

	--애니메이션 끝날 때까지 대기
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(monster_data[1], 'attack_rush_end')
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

	for i = 1, battle_data.monster_count do
		local npc = get_character(battle_data.monster_name .. i)

		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(npc, battle_data.group_name, battle_data.battle_zone)
		command_util.publish_monster_notice(npc, get_party_leader(), 'battle')

		npc.DamagedBehaviour.SuppressDamageReaction = true
		npc.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None

		ui_controller:change_monster_hp_ui(npc)
	end

	self:set_battle_area(battle_data.battle_zone)
end

--보스 몬스터 배틀 시작
function local_class:boss_battle_start()
	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.boss, self.boss_battle_data.group_name, self.boss_battle_data.battle_zone)
	command_util.publish_monster_notice(self.boss, get_party_leader(), 'battle')
	self:set_battle_area(self.boss_battle_data.battle_zone)
	self.boss.DamagedBehaviour.SuppressDamageReaction = true
	self.boss.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.None
end

--게임 시작 시 나오는 연출
function local_class:game_start_scene()
	local robot = get_party_leader()
	self:disable_control_and_hide_ui()

	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_war_loop_04',
												  volume = 0.6, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', fade_in_time = 1 })

	self.sfx_manager:insert_handler('loop', loop_sfx)

	screen_util.play_dynamic_media(self.punch_media_path, {
		time_to_end_fade_out = 0.1,
		back_ground_visible = false,
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--로봇(이하 플레이어) 시작위치 15칸 왼쪽 지점에서 대기 - pos_x 45
	robot.Position = self.constants_data.player_start_pos + vector(-15, 0, 0)

	--카메라가 시작 위치로 가기 위한 x거리
	local distance_pos_x = self.constants_data.player_start_pos.x - screen_controller.camera_pivot.x

	--카메라 시작위치 15칸 오른쪽 지점에서 대기
	screen_controller:change_camera_state('normal', 0)
	screen_controller:camera_move_to_distance_async(vector(distance_pos_x + 15, 0, 0), 0)

	--화면 1초간 페이드인. 끝날 때까지 대기
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--다음 동작 동시에 실행
	--카메라 3초간 왼쪽으로 15칸 이동
	start_coroutine(function()
		screen_controller:camera_move_to_distance_async(vector(-15, 0, 0), 3)
	end)

	--sfx 키값에 맞춰서 카메라 shake(0.4, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(robot, { name = 'walk', sfx_name = function()
		screen_controller:shake(0.4, 0.2)
	end })

	--플레이어(walk) 5초간 오른쪽으로 15칸 이동
	self.lw_util:interpolation_move_async(robot,
			robot.Position + vector(15, 0, 0), 5, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim(robot)

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--비네트: 조종자의 컨디션 확인. 이상 없습니다.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_engineer', 'lw_main_s16_1')

	local finish_sfx_callback = function(_, sfx)
		local sfx_key = sfx.Data.Name

		if sfx_key == 'sfx1' then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavenhold_ready_01')
		elseif sfx_key == 'sfx2' then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavenhold_ready_03')
		end
	end

	--플레이어(finish_ready, loop = false) 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavenhold_ready_02')
	self:set_anim_async(robot, { name = 'finish_ready', loop = false, sfx_name = finish_sfx_callback })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--비네트: 목표물은 전방에 위치한 검은 장막, 이동 경로 상에 적대적 반응이 여럿 감지됩니다.
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_engineer', 'lw_main_s16_2')

--보스전 중간 연출
function local_class:boss_middle_scene()
	local robot = get_party_leader()
	local boss = self.boss
	local init_info = self.constants_data.middle_scene_info

	self.operator_ui:stop()

	screen_controller:change_camera_state('normal', 0)

	self:disable_control_and_hide_ui()

	--몬스터 피격 종료 대기
	while lua_helper.type_compare(boss.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterStunState)) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.convert_to_npc(boss)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.remove_anim(boss)

	--플레이어 공격 대기
	while CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.IsAnyBattleActionActive(robot) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(robot)

	--카메라 1초간 플레이어에게 이동
	--이후 카메라 플레이어 트레킹
	screen_controller:change_camera_state('target', 1, { and_target = robot })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--플레이어(attack_rush_ready) 애니메이션 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavenhold_ready_03')
	self:set_anim_async(robot, { name = 'attack_rush_ready', loop = false })

	local left_fx = self:create_bone_fx(robot, 'lw_booster_left_loop', 'boostL_eff')
	local right_fx = self:create_bone_fx(robot, 'lw_booster_right_loop', 'boostR_eff')

	--플레이어(run) 70의 속도로 보스와의 거리가 10이 될 때까지 이동
	do
		local distance = boss.Position.x - robot.Position.x - 10
		local speed = 70
		local duration = distance / speed

		screen_controller:shake(0.1, 99999)

		local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_08', loop = true })

		character_util.set_anim(robot, { name = 'run' })

		self.lw_util:interpolation_move_async(robot,
				boss.Position + vector(-10, 0, 0), duration, 'linear')

		--최소 0.7초는 run 애니메이션 유지하고 다음 동작으로 넘어감
		if duration < 0.7 then
			wait_for_sec(0.7 - duration)
		end

		run_sfx:FadeOut(0.7)
		run_sfx = nil

		screen_controller:cancel_shake()
	end

	left_fx:Dispose()
	left_fx = nil

	right_fx:Dispose()
	right_fx = nil

	screen_controller:set_fx_active(false)
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(robot, 'rocket_punch_ready')
	self:set_skill_darkness(anim_duration)

	--플레이어(rocket_punch_ready, loop = false) 애니메이션 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavenhold_ready_02')
	self:set_anim_async(robot, { name = 'rocket_punch_ready', loop = false })

	boss.Position = init_info.boss_init_pos

	local target_robot_pos = init_info.robot_init_pos
	local distance = target_robot_pos - robot.Position
	robot.Position = target_robot_pos

	--배경 변경 없도록 직접 update
	screen_controller.cashed_player_pos = robot.Position
	screen_controller.w18_bg_obj.transform.localPosition = screen_controller.w18_bg_obj.transform.localPosition + distance

	--비네트: 공격용 추가 부스터 전면 개방. 출력 120%.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_demonengineer_cwp_01')
	self.operator_ui:speech_async('demon_engineer', 'lw_main_s16_10')

	local is_playing = true
	start_coroutine(function()
		screen_util.play_dynamic_media(self.punch_media_path, {
			time_to_end_fade_out = 4,
			back_ground_visible = false,
			animation_key = 'scale',
			on_before_close_cb = function()
				is_playing = false
			end,
		})
	end)

	while is_playing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_controller:set_fx_active(true)
	self:remove_skill_darkness(0.1)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	--카메라 shake(1, 0.5)
	screen_controller:shake(1, 0.5)

	--플레이어(rocket_punch_side, mix_duration = 0)
	character_util.set_anim(robot, { name = 'rocket_punch', loop = false, mix_duration = 0 })

	--플레이어 위치 기준 vector(8, 13, 0) 위치에 fx_lw_minigame_attack_strong 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavenhold_punch_01')
	self.fx:lw_strong():Instantiate(robot.Position + vector(8, 13, 0))

	--보스(damaged2, loop = false mix_duration = 0, scale = 0)
	character_util.set_anim(boss, { name = 'damaged2', loop = false, mix_duration = 0, scale = 0 })

	--카메라 0.6초간 오른쪽으로 35칸 이동 시작
	screen_controller:change_camera_state('normal')
	start_coroutine(function()
		screen_controller:camera_move_to_distance_async(vector(35, 0, 0), 0.6)
	end)

	--보스 1초간 오른쪽으로 30칸 easeoutquad 넉백. 끝날 때까지 대기
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_21')
	self.lw_util:interpolation_move_async(boss,
			boss.Position + vector(30, 0, 0), 1, 'ease_out_quad')

	character_util.remove_anim(boss)
	character_util.set_anim(boss, { name = 'damaged2', loop = false, scale = 1, next_anim = 'idle' })

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--플레이어(rocket_punch_end) 애니메이션 끝날 때까지 대기
	self:set_anim_async(robot, { name = 'rocket_punch_end', loop = false })

	--플레이어 애니메이션 해제
	character_util.remove_anim(robot)

	--보스 애니메이션 해제
	character_util.remove_anim(boss)

	--카메라 거리만큼 줌아웃
	do
		local boss_x = boss.Position.x + 4.5
		local robot_x = robot.Position.x - 4.5
		local distance = boss_x - robot_x
		local camera_size = distance / 2 / screen_controller.camera.aspect
		local duration = 1.5

		if camera_size < screen_controller.camera_min_size then
			camera_size = screen_controller.camera_min_size
		elseif camera_size > screen_controller.camera_max_size then
			camera_size = screen_controller.camera_max_size
		end

		screen_controller:resize_camera(camera_size, duration, false)
		screen_controller:change_camera_state('boss_battle', duration)
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	self:boss_battle_start()

	self:enable_control_and_show_ui()

	local punch_damage = self.boss_battle_data.middle_punch_damage

	--보스 HP 감소
	boss.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:ChangeHpToFixedValue(boss.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP - punch_damage)
end
